\"Magic pipe\" — OWS'i by-pass ederek ya: The "magic pipe" — an illegal arrangement that bypasses the OWS and pumps oily water directly overboard — is one of the most heavily punished MARPOL violations. Authorities look for flange marks, extra hose connections, and discrepancies between the Oil Record Book and actual consumption and production.
\"Midships\" dümeni tam ortaya alır. \"S: "Midships" puts the rudder exactly amidships. "Steady" means reduce the swing as rapidly as possible, while "Steady as she goes" means steer on the compass heading at the time of the order; the helmsman reads the heading on the compass at that moment, reports it to the OOW and steers on that heading. "Hard a-starboard / Hard a-port" puts the rudder hard over to that side (emergency maneuver). "Ease to five" means reduce the large rudder angle previously ordered to 5°.
\"Sadece kısa bir iş\" veya \"deneyimliy: Skipping the harness or permit with the thought "it's only a short job" or "I'm experienced, there's no need" has led to accidents in which even experienced seafarers have died. The AB knows that experience is no substitute for precautions; every job aloft or overside is done with full equipment.
\"Single up\" komutuyla fazla halatlar t: On the "single up" order, surplus lines are taken in and the ship is held by single lines; on "let go", the last lines are released. The Bosun confirms that the released line has been recovered cleanly from the quay and has not fallen into the water and fouled the propeller ("all gone and clear"). The engine is not used until this confirmation has been given to the bridge.
\"Soğuk zincir\" ve \"sıcak tutma\" serv: The "cold chain" and "hot holding" are basic principles of service: cooked food is quickly brought to serving temperature and is not left in the danger zone until it is served. The longer service lasts, the greater the risk; food that has been left out for a long time is discarded, and a "that'll do" attitude is not accepted.
\"Şüphedeysen, ara\" altın kuraldır. Baş: "If in doubt, call" is the golden rule. The Chief Engineer must make it clear to the team that he or she does not mind being woken unnecessarily and that being informed late is much worse.
04-08 vardiyası şafağı, 16-20 vardiyası: Because the 04-08 watch covers dawn and the 16-20 watch covers dusk, the sole lookout arrangement on these watches must be reassessed as the light conditions change. During the transition to darkness, it may not be enough for the officer alone to monitor the steering and keep a lookout at the same time; for this reason, calling a lookout before nightfall is good seamanship practice.
04-08 ve 16-20 vardiyaları, ışık koşulun: The 04-08 and 16-20 watches cover transition periods in which the light conditions change rapidly. At dawn the officer must correctly determine the time to switch off the lights (lights off), and at dusk the time to switch them on (lights on); lights are shown "from sunset to sunrise" and at all times in restricted visibility. Switching off early or switching on late leads other ships to misjudge the ship's status.
08:00'de güverte ekibi toplanır. Reis, g: At 08:00 the deck team assembles. The Bosun explains the day's work, the team allocation, the risks and the PPE requirements. This toolbox meeting is the most important 15 minutes of the day; a well-planned morning means an accident-free and productive day.

The Chief Officer is primarily responsible for implementing the plan and for the accuracy of the records.

15 ppm aşıldığında otomatik olarak gemi: When 15 ppm is exceeded, recirculation on board starts automatically and discharge overboard is stopped.
15 ppm bilge alarm (OCM — Oil Content Mo: 15 ppm bilge alarm (OCM — Oil Content Monitor): approved under IMO MEPC.107(49); at 15 ppm or more it switches the three-way valve to the tank side.
15 ppm bilge alarm: Çıkıştaki yağ içeriğ: 15 ppm bilge alarm: measures the oil content at the outlet continuously. If 15 ppm is exceeded, the discharge valve closes automatically and the flow is directed to recirculation on board.
15 ppm bilge alarmı (oil content monitor: The 15 ppm bilge alarm (oil content monitor) measures the oil concentration in the outlet water continuously. If the value exceeds 15 ppm, the automatic three-way valve stops the water going overboard, diverts it back (to the bilge holding or slop tank) and gives an alarm. In this way water that exceeds the criterion never goes to sea.
15 ppm bilge separator ve Oil Discharge: All discharges made through the 15 ppm bilge separator and the Oil Discharge Monitoring Equipment (ODME — tankers) are recorded in the ORB. As a deck officer, the Chief Officer checks the accuracy of the discharge records (particularly slops and cargo tank washings on tankers) and works in coordination with the engine department.
180° meridyeni civarındaki Uluslararası: When crossing the International Date Line near the 180° meridian, a calendar day is skipped (sailing westbound, east→west) or repeated (sailing eastbound, west→east). This is managed carefully in ETA calculations, watch schedules and records; otherwise a one-day gap or duplication appears in the records.

20.000 DWT ve üzeri crude oil tankerlerd: On crude oil tankers of 20,000 DWT and above, COW (Crude Oil Washing) is mandatory under MARPOL Annex I; washing with the cargo itself (crude oil) minimizes oil residues. With the Inert Gas System (IGS), the tank atmosphere is kept at O2 < 8% at all times. After tank cleaning, entry into the enclosed space is prohibited until a gas-free certificate has been obtained.
200 nm mümkün değilse, kıyıdan en az 50: If 200 nm is not possible, it may be carried out at least 50 nm from the nearest land in water at least 200 m deep.
2008 IS Code minimum intact stability kr: The 2008 IS Code sets the minimum intact stability criteria: the area under the GZ curve, the angle of maximum GZ, the initial GM (≥0.15 m) and the weather criterion specific to the ship type. The Master verifies that these criteria are maintained throughout loading. Too small a GM makes the ship "tender" (risk of listing); too large a GM makes her "stiff" (violent rolling, overloading of the lashings).
2011: EEDI ve SEEMP zorunlu hale getiril: 2011: the EEDI and SEEMP were made mandatory.
2018 Houston ve Singapur'da geniş çaplı: In 2018, widespread contaminated HSFO batches in Houston and Singapore (high levels of phenolic/styrene compounds) caused fuel pump and injector seizures on dozens of ships. Standard ISO 8217 tests did not detect this contamination; special GC-MS analysis was needed. Lesson: when fuel quality is in doubt, ask for forensic analysis beyond the standard tests.
2020 Carriage Ban uyarınca, scrubber'sız: Under the 2020 carriage ban, a ship without a scrubber may not have on board (not even merely carry) fuel with a sulphur content above 0.50%. The Master guarantees that the fuel changeover on entering and leaving an ECA is made on time and that the changeover is recorded in the log book prescribed by the flag state.
2020 IMO global sulphur cap %0.50 m/m'di: The 2020 IMO global sulfur cap is 0.50% m/m. In ECAs (Baltic, North Sea, North America, the US Caribbean and, from 1 May 2025, the Mediterranean) the limit is 0.10% m/m. Ships operating with a scrubber (EGCS — Exhaust Gas Cleaning System) may use HSFO, but scrubber washwater must comply with MARPOL and port rules (some ports have banned open-loop scrubbers).

The changeover sequence is started before entering the ECA, as far in advance as calculated with the ChangeOver Calculator; the changeover to MGO is completed before the ECA boundary, and the date, time, position and the volume of low-sulfur fuel in the tanks are recorded in the log. High-sulfur fuel may only be used on ships operating with a scrubber.
2020: Global kükürt limiti %0.50'ye düşü: 2020: the global sulphur limit was reduced to 0.50%.
2023'ten itibaren yürürlükteki EEXI (Ene: EEXI (Energy Efficiency Existing Ship Index), in force since 2023, sets a one-off efficiency threshold for ships; CII (Carbon Intensity Indicator) measures the annual operational carbon intensity with an A–E rating. A ship rated D for three consecutive years or E once prepares a corrective action plan (SEEMP Part III). The Master directly affects the CII rating through slow steaming, trim optimisation and hull and propeller performance.
2024'ten itibaren EU ETS (Emission Tradi: Since 2024, the EU ETS (Emissions Trading System) has covered ships; allowances must be purchased for CO2 emissions. The CII (Carbon Intensity Indicator) is calculated annually; a corrective action plan is mandatory for ships rated D for three consecutive years or rated E in a single year. The Chief Engineer is directly responsible for tracking EEXI/CII performance.
2024'ten itibaren EU ETS, denizcilik emi: Since 2024, the EU ETS has covered shipping emissions; correct consumption/emissions data have a direct financial consequence for the calculation of allowances and for cost.

A fast rescue boat (FRB) and its launchi: A fast rescue boat (FRB) and its launching appliance have approved operating limits. Assess weather, ship movement, boat condition and crew readiness before launch or recovery. Constant-tension or shock-absorbing arrangements reduce some recovery loads but do not make every sea state safe. Recovery is a critical part of the man-overboard (MOB) plan; follow the installation instructions and trained procedure.
A man-overboard (MOB) response combines: A man-overboard (MOB) response combines an immediate alarm, suitable flotation and marking aids, continuous lookout, position marking and a coordinated recovery plan. Use the rescue boat only when appropriate within its approved launch and recovery limits. Assess other available recovery means. Cold-water exposure makes delay dangerous, but an unsafe launch can create further casualties.
A sınıfı (katılar): su, AFFF köpük, çok: Class A (solids): water, AFFF foam, multi-purpose dry chemical.
A ve B derecesi teşvik edilir; art arda: A and B ratings are encouraged; if a ship is rated D for 3 consecutive years or E in a single year, a revised SEEMP containing a corrective action plan must be prepared.
A1, bir Contracting Government tarafında: A1 is the area within continuous DSC alerting coverage of at least one VHF coast station, as defined by a Contracting Government; it is not a fixed 20–30 NM circle.
A2 gemisi MF DSC taşır; A4 (kutup) gemis: An A2 ship carries MF DSC; HF DSC is mandatory for an A4 (polar) ship because the Inmarsat GEO satellites give no coverage at the poles. A3 ships may also carry MF/HF as an alternative or back-up to Inmarsat.
A2, A1 dışında en az bir MF coast statio: A2 is the area, excluding A1, within continuous DSC alerting coverage of at least one MF coast station; propagation range alone does not create sea area status.
A3 gemisi GMDSS yedekliliğini Inmarsat +: An A3 ship provides GMDSS redundancy with a combination of Inmarsat + MF/HF or with dual Inmarsat. The GMDSS is now becoming multi-provider; low-earth-orbit (LEO) systems such as Iridium offer global coverage including the poles and can also meet A4 requirements.
A3, A1/A2 dışında gemideki tanınmış mobi: A3 is the area, excluding A1 and A2, within the continuous alerting coverage supported by the recognised mobile-satellite service of the ship's earth station; the modern GMDSS is not equated only with the Inmarsat geostationary area.
A3/A4 bölgelerinde NAVTEX kapsamı dışınd: In sea areas A3/A4, outside NAVTEX coverage, MSI is received through Inmarsat EGC (Enhanced Group Call) / SafetyNET. The Second Officer checks that the EGC receiver is subscribed (programmed) to the correct NAVAREA and coastal areas and that the ocean region selected is consistent with the ship's position.
A4, A1/A2/A3 dışındaki alandır. HF DSC/r: A4 is the area outside A1, A2 and A3. The HF DSC/radiotelephony arrangement and the MSI route are verified against the current SOLAS Chapter IV and the Radio Record; NBDP is no longer assumed to be a general requirement.
AB ETS, denizcilik CO2 emisyonlarına kar: The EU ETS has put a carbon price on shipping CO2 emissions; FuelEU Maritime sets a progressively tighter limit on the life-cycle GHG intensity of the fuel used. These regulations add a direct financial dimension to fuel choice.
AB limanları arasındaki seferlerde ve AB: Emissions are reported for voyages between EU ports and for the EU share (50%) of voyages arriving at or departing from an EU port.
AB limanlarında 2 saatten uzun yanaşık k: Ships staying alongside in EU ports for more than 2 hours must use 0.10% fuel (alternatives: shutting down all engines and using shore power, or an approved scrubber). In addition, as the EU ETS brings an emissions cost, fuel choice also gains a financial dimension.
AB standby olarak; giriş izninin (permit: As standby, the AB continuously confirms that the entry permit is valid, that the atmosphere has been tested, that the ventilation is running, and the condition of the person inside. In any uncertainty (loss of communication, the person inside not responding), the AB first raises the alarm and then acts according to the protocol WITHOUT going in.
AB, \"ben gördüm ama önemli değildir\" d: The AB does not filter reports by thinking "I've seen it but it's not important"; every object is reported, including small craft, sailing boats, unlit fishing boats and buoys. In many collisions, the lookout had seen a target but did not report it, assuming that "the officer must have seen it already".
AB, \"make fast\" komutunda halatı doğru: On the order "make fast", the AB makes the line fast at the correct tension; on the order "single up", before departure, the surplus lines are let go one by one to reduce them to the minimum. While letting go, the AB keeps checking which line is under tension; a line under tension is never cast off by hand: the tension is first taken off with the winch.
AB, \"muhtemelen güvenlidir\" varsayımın: The AB knows that the assumption "it's probably safe" is fatal on tankers; every value is measured, every connection is earthed and every doubt stops the operation. In this work, patience and discipline are worth more than speed.
AB, atmosfer testleri tamamlanıp giriş i: The AB never enters a tank before the atmosphere tests have been completed and an entry permit has been issued; an inerted tank is oxygen-deficient and may contain toxic or flammable gas. Tank cleaning is a job that "cannot be rushed and accepts no shortcuts"; every step is carried out in accordance with ISGOTT and the ship's procedures.
AB, atmosfer ölçüm cihazını (multi-gas d: The AB must know how to use the atmosphere measuring instrument (multi-gas detector / personal monitor), the principles of calibration and bump testing, and the meaning of the alarms. The entrant carries a personal monitor and leaves immediately if the alarm sounds. The standby AB monitors the atmosphere readings and stops the entry at any sign of deterioration. The atmosphere is not something "measured once and forgotten" but a parameter that is monitored continuously.
AB, denize düşme anında ne yapacağını ez: The AB must know by heart what to do if someone falls into the sea: throw the lifebuoy, shout "man overboard", do not lose sight of the person, inform the bridge. Seconds save lives; hesitation and searching ("where is the lifebuoy?") cause delay, which is why the equipment is always kept ready in the same, accessible place.
AB, gas freeing'in fiziksel işlerini (ve: The AB carries out the physical work of gas freeing (opening vents, running fans, handling tank lids), but the authority to declare a tank "gas-free" rests with the responsible officer and is given only on the basis of verified atmosphere tests. Tests are made at different levels, not at a single point; some gases collect at the bottom.
AB, halat alırken/verirken ayağını asla: When taking in or paying out a line, the AB never puts a foot inside a coil of line or on top of a line running underneath; if the line suddenly comes under tension, the foot is caught and the person is dragged. Hands are kept away from the turns on the bollard, the mouth of the fairlead and the winch drum; "nip points" are the main cause of lost fingers and hands.
AB, hiçbir gerekçenin (acele, kısa süre,: The AB must know that no reason (haste, a short duration, 'the air looks clean') justifies skipping precautions. Enclosed space rules are written in blood; every skipped step is a potential death.
AB, iletişimi bir an bile bırakmaz; içer: The AB never lets communication lapse, even for a moment: they do not lose contact with the person inside, do not get involved in other work and do not leave the entrance. If communication is lost, the alarm is raised immediately and the protocol is started. Silence does not mean "all is well"; it means "must be checked".
AB, izinde kendi rolünü (standby/giren): The AB clearly knows their own role in the permit (standby/entrant) and its conditions; no entry is made without a permit or with an expired permit. The permit is not a "paper formality" but confirmation that all precautions have been taken. A briefing (toolbox talk) is held, and everyone learns by heart what to do in an emergency.
AB, kendi işinin risk değerlendirmesini: The AB does not start a job without understanding its risk assessment and applying the control measures. When a step changes (the weather deteriorates, equipment fails), the job is stopped and the situation is reassessed. "Stop work authority", the authority to stop any job they consider unsafe, is every seafarer's right.
AB, kontrol sırasında bulduğu her eksik/: The AB immediately reports every deficiency or fault found during checks (an empty extinguisher, a light that does not work, a leaking SCBA, a missing lifejacket) to the Bosun/Safety Officer. A "we'll deal with it later" attitude means equipment that does not work in a real emergency. Records and follow-up are also looked for in ISM audits and PSC inspections.
AB, manevra planında kendi istasyonunun: From the Bosun and the station officer, the AB learns which lines their own station (forward/aft) will send out, and in which order, according to the maneuvering plan. Sending a line in the wrong order (e.g., sending the spring late) can make the ship move out of position; this is why the AB waits for the order and never sends lines on their own initiative.
AB, statik riskini azaltmak için: tüm il: To reduce the static risk, the AB bonds all conductive equipment (washing machines, hose nozzles, measuring instruments) to the ship's structure, observes the waiting period (relaxation/settling time) for sounding and measurement, and prevents free-falling jets and splashing. Anti-static (conductive) PPE and equipment are used; synthetic clothing or tools that hold a charge are not used.
AB, tankın \"inert\", \"gas-free\" veya: The AB must not confuse the "inert", "gas-free" and "non-inert" states of a tank; these states require different precautions. An inerted tank is not entered because it is oxygen-deficient; a gas-free (ventilated and tested) tank may become suitable for entry. The atmosphere status is monitored and recorded continuously.
AB, winch panelindeki mod (manuel/auto),: The AB knows the mode (manual/auto) on the winch panel, the selection between drum and warp end (warping head), and the emergency stop button. Work is not done on the warp end at the same time as a line is on the drum; mechanical confusion is dangerous.
AB, yangın ekipmanının (hortum, nozzle,: The AB must know the location and use of the fire equipment (hoses, nozzles, foam, portable extinguishers) and must select the extinguisher suited to the type of fire (spraying water on an oil or electrical fire is dangerous). The AB follows the chain of command (the fire team leader) and does not attempt heroics alone; a coordinated response as a team is essential.
AB, çalıştığı ve yaşadığı tüm bölgelerde: The AB must know at least two escape routes from every area where they work and live, the emergency exit doors, the escape lighting (low-location lighting) and the locations of EEBDs and fire equipment. Escape routes are always kept open, unobstructed and marked; blocking an escape route with stores or cargo is prohibited, and an AB who sees this clears it and reports it.
AB, çalışırken fark ettiği kusurları (ça: The AB reports defects noticed while working (cracks, heavy corrosion, loose connections, damaged equipment) to the Bosun. This feedback feeds the PMS; catching a small rust spot before it turns into major plate thinning depends on this reporting.
AB; baret, çelik burunlu bot, eldiven, k: The AB uses a safety helmet, steel-toe boots, gloves, safety goggles and, depending on the task, a high-visibility vest. A dust mask is added for dusty cargoes such as grain or ore, and ear protection in noisy environments. For dangerous cargoes (IMDG/IMSBC classified), additional precautions and special PPE apply; the AB learns these from the Bosun.
AB; can simidi, can yeleği ışıkları, pyr: The AB checks lifebuoys, lifejacket lights, pyrotechnic (distress flare) expiry dates, the condition of hoses and nozzles, and the emergency lighting, and reports anything missing. Expired pyrotechnics and lights with flat batteries are useless when it really matters; maintenance saves lives.
AB; güverte üstü işlemleri (butterworth: The AB carries out deck operations (opening/closing Butterworth machines, connecting hoses, handling tank lids/manholes, earthing, supporting atmosphere measurements) under the instructions and supervision of the responsible officer (Chief Officer). The operation plan, the sequence and approval rest with the officer; the AB carries out the plan and reports any deviation or abnormality immediately.
ABD APPS rejimi, kirliliği ihbar eden mü: The US APPS regime gives a reward (part of the fine) to crew members who report pollution. This means that it is impossible to hide falsified records. By building an open and honest environmental culture on board, the Master stays on the safe side both legally and ethically.
ABD sularında USCG, type-approved BWMS v: In US waters, the USCG requires a type-approved BWMS and detailed reporting (BWMR — Ballast Water Management Report); states such as California may have additional rules. Australia, New Zealand and some ports also apply their own biosecurity requirements. Before the operation, port information (port agent + company instructions) is checked.
AC veya DC kaynak makinesi kullanılabili: An AC or DC welding machine can be used. DC reverse polarity (DCEP) gives deeper penetration.
AC → Doğrultucu (rectifier) → DC → İnver: AC → rectifier → DC → inverter → variable-frequency AC.
ADE-BDE arası RF/IF kabloları ve konnekt: The RF/IF cables and connectors between ADE and BDE can cause signal loss (insertion loss) due to corrosion and moisture in the marine environment. The ETO checks the connector joints, their weatherproofing and the integrity of the cables. A corroded connector is a common and often overlooked cause of gradual signal degradation.
AFFF (Aqueous Film Forming Foam), hidrok: AFFF (Aqueous Film Forming Foam) forms a thin film on top of hydrocarbons; the common marine type.
AFFF (aqueous film-forming foam) yakıt ü: AFFF (aqueous film-forming foam) extinguishes quickly by forming a water film on the fuel; protein/fluoroprotein foam gives a durable blanket; alcohol-resistant (AR) foam forms a polymeric layer for polar solvents (alcohol, acetone). A foam suitable for the type of fuel must be selected.
AFS Convention, TBT içeren zararlı anti-: The AFS Convention prohibits harmful anti-fouling systems containing TBT; under recent amendments cybutryne has also been prohibited. The ship carries an AFS certificate or declaration. After dry-docking the Master verifies that the paints are compliant and that the certificate is up to date.
AHU: chilled water coil + ısıtıcı (steam: AHU: contains a chilled water coil + heater (steam or electric) + humidifier + filter + fan.
AIO'nun açık tutulması ve manuel update: Keeping the AIO switched on and maintaining discipline with manual updates make up, on ECDIS-only ships, for the loss of the paper T&P advantage. If this layer is left switched off, temporary dangers are missed.
AIS (Automatic Identification System), d: AIS (Automatic Identification System) broadcasts the identity, position, course, speed and maneuvering information of other ships. The cadet learns to read the MMSI, ship name, type and CPA/TCPA information of an AIS target. However, the cadet also understands that AIS can never be used on its own for collision avoidance: not all targets carry AIS, AIS data may have been entered incorrectly and AIS may update with a delay. COLREG Rule 7 requires the assessment of risk of collision to be based on radar/ARPA; AIS supplements this.
AIS (Automatic Identification System), h: AIS (Automatic Identification System) gives the target's identity, course, speed, draft and intentions (destination, navigational status); however, AIS is not a collision avoidance device. IMO Resolution A.1106(29) stresses that AIS data must be confirmed by radar/ARPA and that AIS must not be used on its own for maneuvering decisions. Incorrectly entered AIS data (e.g. wrong ROT, wrong position) is misleading.
AIS navigational status'ün güncellenmeme: Not updating the AIS navigational status and letting the VDR APT expire are deficiencies frequently found at inspections. Trusting a single position source (GNSS) blindly and neglecting to cross-check the equipment can lead to grounding.
AIS statik verileri (MMSI, çağrı işareti: AIS static data (MMSI, call sign, ship's name/type, length/beam) and dynamic data (position, SOG, COG, heading, navigational status) are verified regularly; in particular, the navigational status (under way, at anchor, NUC) must be kept up to date manually. Wrong AIS data leads to misunderstandings in traffic.
AIS sürekli açık tutulmalıdır; kaptan gü: AIS must be kept switched on at all times; the Master may switch it off for safety or security reasons, but this decision must be recorded in the log book.
AIS verileri tek başına çatışma önleme k: AIS data must not be used on its own for collision avoidance decisions; it must be assessed together with radar and a visual lookout.
AIS yalnızca AIS taşıyan ve cihazı açık: AIS shows only targets that carry AIS with the equipment switched on; it does not see craft without AIS, land or other objects. The primary means of collision avoidance is therefore radar; AIS is complementary. Before manoeuvring on the basis of an AIS target, it must be verified by radar or by sight.
AIS üç tür bilgi yayınlar: statik (IMO n: AIS transmits three types of information: static (IMO number, call sign, name, dimensions), dynamic (position, COG, SOG, heading, ROT) and voyage-related (draft, type of cargo, destination, ETA). Static and voyage data are entered manually; a wrong entry broadcasts wrong information.
AIS, COLREG manevra yorumu için tek başı: AIS alone is not sufficient for interpreting COLREG manoeuvres; it must be confirmed by radar. In areas where AIS spoofing or wrong data is common (the Black Sea, the Persian Gulf), the Master requires extra caution.
AIS, gemi kimliği ve seyir verisini VHF: AIS transmits and receives ship identity and navigation data over VHF. The ETO checks the AIS VHF and GPS antennas, the accuracy of the static data (MMSI, IMO number, ship type, dimensions) and the dynamic data feeds (heading, ROT). Wrong AIS data is dangerous for collision avoidance and is a cause of PSC findings.
AIS, hedefin gerçek rota/hızını verdiği: Because AIS gives the target's actual course and speed, it supports the assessment of CPA/TCPA; but AIS data may be delayed or wrong. Manoeuvring decisions under COLREG are taken after confirmation with radar/ARPA.
AIS, iki özel VHF kanalında (AIS 1 / AIS: AIS works on two dedicated VHF channels (AIS 1 / AIS 2) and divides time into 2250 slots per minute. With SOTDMA (Self-Organising Time Division Multiple Access) each station chooses a free slot and avoids collisions; the network organises itself and needs no central control.
AIS-SART, radar yerine AIS üzerinden çal: An AIS-SART works through AIS instead of radar: it transmits the position from its internal GPS as a special AIS message; the position of the SART appears as a symbol on the AIS display of nearby ships. It is an alternative or complement to the radar SART and gives the position numerically.
AIS-SART: AIS sinyali yayınlar, AIS rece: AIS-SART: transmits an AIS signal and appears as a MOB symbol on AIS receivers; shorter range, but it gives a digital position.
ARPA (Automatic Radar Plotting Aid), hed: ARPA (Automatic Radar Plotting Aid) acquires targets, calculates their vectors and gives the CPA (Closest Point of Approach) and TCPA (Time to CPA) values. The Second Officer teaches the difference between the vector modes (true/relative), the trial manoeuvre function and the use of guard zones. The trial manoeuvre shows in advance how a planned maneuver will change the CPA; however, the maneuver parameters must be entered realistically.

ARPA (Automatic Radar Plotting Aid) tracks targets automatically and calculates their CPA (Closest Point of Approach) and TCPA (Time to CPA). The cadet learns that after a target is acquired, the ARPA vector solution needs time to stabilize; the data from the first few minutes must not be trusted blindly. The cadet observes how the OOW uses the trial maneuver function to test how a course/speed change will affect the traffic.
ARPA ardışık radar ölçümlerinden hedef t: ARPA builds a target track from successive radar measurements; with the own ship's heading and speed input it produces relative and true course and speed, and CPA and TCPA estimates. The solution may be unstable for a newly acquired target, a target that is manoeuvring, one whose echo merges with another, or one that stays in clutter.
ARPA hedefleri en az üç dakika izlendikt: ARPA targets give reliable vectors only after they have been tracked for at least three minutes; the vectors cannot be fully trusted before then. The officer must know what each of the true vector and relative vector modes shows: the relative vector shows the CPA, the true vector shows the target's true course. After an avoiding maneuver, the way the vectors change is confirmed.
ARPA trial (deneme) manevrası, planlanan: The ARPA trial manoeuvre simulates the new CPA/TCPA with all tracked targets for a planned change of course or speed. It is used to check that the manoeuvre is sufficient and early, but the delay time must be set realistically.
ARPA'nın sınırlamaları kritik öneme sahi: The limitations of ARPA are critically important: target swap, loss of tracking at low SNR, the instability of the vector of a newly acquired target in the first minutes, and errors in the sensor inputs (gyro, log) corrupting the CPA calculation. The Second Officer stresses that ARPA is a decision support tool and does not replace the lookout or plotting.
ARPA, seçilen veya otomatik kazanılan he: ARPA tracks selected or automatically acquired targets and calculates their speed and course vectors and their CPA (Closest Point of Approach) and TCPA (Time to CPA). Vectors can be shown in true or relative mode; the relative vector is used to judge risk of collision, the true vector to understand the target's actual movement.
AVR (Automatic Voltage Regulator), alter: The AVR (Automatic Voltage Regulator) keeps the alternator terminal voltage constant despite load changes (class/IEC tolerance: ±2.5% in steady state, ±3.5% for emergency generators). Operating principle: it samples the output voltage, compares it with a reference and adjusts the excitation current through a brushless exciter or static excitation. The ETO calibrates the AVR droop/quadrature droop setting so as to balance reactive load sharing between generators running in parallel.
AVR (Automatic Voltage Regulator), yük d: The AVR (Automatic Voltage Regulator) keeps the terminal voltage constant by adjusting the alternator excitation as the load changes. Reactive load sharing (in parallel operation) is managed through the AVR droop setting; a faulty AVR causes over- or under-voltage and load sharing problems.
AVR, jeneratör çıkış gerilimini sürekli: The AVR continuously measures the generator output voltage and compares it with the reference value. When a deviation is detected, it corrects the voltage by increasing or decreasing the rotor excitation current.
Abandon ship (gemiyi terk) senaryosunda: In an abandon ship scenario, the muster list assigns every duty individually: lifeboat commander (usually an officer), engine operator, painter/line handler, embarkation ladder and davit operator, the person bringing the portable VHF, the person collecting the EPIRB and SART, the person carrying extra blankets, water and rations, the stretcher party, and the person taking the head count. The Safety Officer makes sure that no link in this chain is left empty.
Abandon ship'te Safety Officer; can fili: In abandon ship, the Safety Officer may coordinate boarding of the lifeboats/liferafts (embarkation), the crew head count and the transfer of distress equipment. Making sure that everyone has been counted, so that nobody is left behind, is the most critical part of this role.
Abandonment, armatörün denizciyle bağı k: Abandonment is defined as the shipowner severing its ties with the seafarer (failing to cover the cost of repatriation, failing to pay wages for at least 2 months, or leaving the seafarer without support). When a risk of abandonment appears on board (late wages, supplies cut off, the company going silent), the Master detects it early and informs the seafarers of their right to apply to the insurer named in the financial security certificate; the ILO tracks these cases in a public database.
Abort point, geminin manevrayı iptal edi: The abort point is the last point at which the ship can abandon the manoeuvre and withdraw to safe water. Beyond it, the manoeuvre can no longer be reversed. The point of no return is the point beyond which it is no longer possible to turn back, because of fuel, tide or the weather window. Failure to mark these points clearly on the plan is one of the most frequently repeated findings in MAIB reports.
Abort point; geminin kanaldan/yanaşmadan: The abort point is the last physical point at which the ship can give up the channel transit/berthing and return to safe water or the open sea. Beyond this point, the turning room or the depth is insufficient. The Second Officer determines the abort point from the maneuvering characteristics and the channel width and marks it clearly in the plan.
Abrazif aşınma: Yakıttaki katalizör kalı: Abrasive wear: catalyst residues in the fuel (Al+Si) and combustion residues wear the liner surface.
Accommodation ladder ve gangway; vinç/ha: Accommodation ladders and gangways are checked for the winch/falls system, the condition of the steps/platforms, the railings (stanchions/ropes) and the safety net. The Bosun ensures that lubrication, wear checks and load tests are carried out. The safety net, which protects against falls, must always be taut and correctly rigged.
Accommodation ladder, geminin bordasına: The accommodation ladder is a ladder mounted on the ship's side, designed so that its steps always remain horizontal. The AB checks that the lower platform of the ladder is at a safe angle, that the steps are non-slip and sound, and that the guardrails are rigged. The SWL (safe working load) is not exceeded; the number of persons allowed on it at one time is observed.
Acemilik eğitimi ve yeni personel desteğ: Training newcomers and supporting new personnel is the most valuable investment of the Bosun's leadership; a deckhand taught correctly today is a safe and competent team member tomorrow. Patient training, close supervision and sincere integration protect both the individual's life and the team's safety.
Acil anda Baş Mühendis hızlı durum değer: In an emergency, the Chief Engineer makes a rapid assessment of the situation: what has happened, what is at risk (people/ship/environment), what resources are available. Instead of panic, procedures internalized through training are applied.
Acil aydınlatma ESB üzerinden acil jener: Emergency lighting is supplied through the ESB from the emergency generator or batteries.
Acil aydınlatma ve kaçış yolu işaretleme: Emergency lighting and escape route marking (photoluminescent / battery-backed) are tested regularly. In a blackout scenario, the emergency lighting coming on is critical for the crew to escape safely.
Acil aydınlatma, ana güç kaybında belirl: Emergency lighting must work for a set period after loss of main power (usually 3-36 hours, depending on the space). In the weekly check, the emergency lighting is switched on to verify that the escape routes, muster stations, embarkation deck and engine room escape routes are adequately lit. The charge and visibility of the photoluminescent (low-location lighting) strips are checked.
Acil aydınlatma, blackout anında kaçış y: During a blackout, emergency lighting illuminates the escape routes, the engine room, the liferaft embarkation areas and other important areas. A central system fed from the emergency switchboard and/or self-contained fittings with their own batteries are used. The ETO periodically tests the battery condition of the self-contained fittings and that they switch on automatically when the main supply fails.
Acil durdurma (ESD — Emergency Shutdown): The emergency shutdown (ESD) system works in step with the terminal and, in danger, stops pumps and valves in a safe sequence. Pumping against a closed valve overpressurises the line; the valve sequence and pressure monitoring are therefore critical. Gas detection and ventilation of the pump room are mandatory.
Acil durum becerileri ancak düzenli, ger: Emergency skills stay alive only through regular, realistic drills. Under SOLAS III/19, fire and abandon ship drills are held at least once a month (III/19.3.2), and enclosed space entry and rescue drills at least every two months. A drill done "on paper", where everyone just waits their turn, is useless; a drill that simulates real conditions (smoke machine, darkness, real equipment) teaches.
Acil durum görevleri ve istasyonlar atan: Emergency duties and stations are assigned; on passenger ships, passenger guidance and counting duties are added. They are updated at crew changes and familiarisation is carried out.
Acil durum komuta yapısı tipik olarak üç: The emergency command structure is typically built around three centres: the bridge (command centre — the Master in command, overall coordination, navigation and communications), the scene of the incident (on-scene command — generally the Chief Officer, who directs the response teams) and the engine control room (the Chief Engineer — management of the engines, fire pumps, generators, steering gear and emergency power). The Master is not the person who runs to the scene, but the one who sees the whole picture, manages the resources and handles external communication. This separation prevents the mistake of "the Master getting lost at the scene".
Acil durum komutası, kaptanlığın en saf: Emergency command is the purest test of command at sea: being able to take the right decision at the moment of uncertainty and time pressure, with human lives in the balance. This ability is not innate; it comes from well-practised drills, procedures learned by heart, a sound command structure and a bridge culture open to "challenge". In a crisis the Master has to be the calmest, best prepared and clearest-thinking person on board, because at that moment everyone looks to the Master. And the best crisis management is often the preparation that prevents the crisis before it begins.
Acil durum override yetkisi, kriterleri: The authority, criteria and recording method for an emergency override must be defined in advance. Otherwise a compliance dispute may arise after power has been increased for safety.
Acil durum prosedürleri muster list ile: Emergency procedures are integrated with the muster list; every crew member's duty in an emergency (e.g. fire team, engine team) is clearly defined. Procedures are reviewed periodically and updated with drill findings.
Acil durum ve drill'ler için sınırlı ist: Although limited exceptions are defined for emergencies and drills, they must not be abused; compensatory rest is given after an exception. The Master avoids a crew that is "compliant on paper but tired in reality".
Acil durum ve yolcu yönlendirme görevler: Emergency and passenger guidance duties are assigned for every voyage; they are updated when crew or cruise staff change and familiarisation is carried out.
Acil durumda Yağcı/Fitter'ın değeri, pan: In an emergency, the value of the Oiler/Fitter lies in relying on procedure, not on panic. Cutting off the fuel source, choosing the right extinguisher, evacuating with discipline and giving the engineer a clear report stop a small incident before it turns into a disaster. The best emergency response is the routine round that prevents a fire before it starts; the best way out is an escape route kept clear in normal times. Preparedness is gained long before the moment of crisis, not during it.
Acil durumda emir zinciri ve haberleşme: In an emergency, the chain of command and the communication route are defined in advance: the bridge (Master/OOW) is the command center; communication with the muster stations and the fire party is by portable VHF or talkback. The Safety Officer checks that the portable VHFs are charged, set to the correct channels and sufficient in number (at least one per party).
Acil durumda iletişim disiplinlidir: köp: Communication in an emergency is disciplined: the bridge (command), the engine control room and the teams on scene coordinate by UHF/internal telephone. The Oiler reports observations (location of the fire, spread, smoke) clearly and briefly and does not give vague messages that could cause panic.
Acil durumda kamarot \"servis personeli\: In an emergency, the steward is not "service staff" but a crew member with assigned duties. The steward knows and carries out the role defined in the Station Bill. As one of the people who know the accommodation best, the steward can play a valuable role in evacuating it and in the head count.
Acil durumda kullanılacak ekipmanın yeri: The location and use of the equipment needed in an emergency are learned in normal times: SCBA, EEBD, portable extinguishers, fire stations, emergency stop and QCV boxes, escape routes, emergency generator/pump. A newly joined Oiler learns these points by walking round them at the first opportunity after joining the ship (familiarization), and this is recorded.
Acil durumda köprü (seyir kararı) ile ma: In an emergency, the bridge (navigational decisions) and the engine room (technical response) must be closely coordinated. The Chief Engineer clearly conveys the situation (remaining power, estimated restart time, maneuverability) to the Master; the Master in turn passes the navigational risk (anchor, tug, distance off the coast) to the engine room.
Acil durumda teknik müdahale, Baş Mühend: Technical response in an emergency is the moment of highest responsibility for the Chief Engineer. Success is the combination of technical knowledge, cool-headed decisions, rehearsed procedures and strong coordination with the bridge. The best response is the natural result of good preparation and continuous drills.
Acil durumlarda direktif liderlik zorunl: In emergencies directive leadership is essential; quick and clear instructions are given.
Acil durumlarda otoriter liderlik; rutin: Directive leadership is more effective in emergencies; supportive or delegating leadership is more effective in routine operations.
Acil dümen pompası ve lokal (steering ge: The emergency steering pump and the local (steering gear room) control arrangement are tested; communication (telephone/radio) between the bridge and the steering gear room is verified. It is confirmed that, if one power unit fails, the second unit cuts in, and that the rudder moves from hard over to hard over within the required time.
Acil dümen tatbikatında ekip, lokal kuma: In the emergency steering drill, the team rehearses steering the ship with the local control and communications. The Third/Fourth Engineer takes part in the drill and reports deficiencies, and the tests are entered in the logbook.
Acil ekipman erişim yolları boyaması (ge: The painted access routes to emergency equipment (usually marked in yellow) and the equipment location signs are checked periodically; faded or covered markings are renewed. The muster station area is always kept clear and accessible.
Acil güç sistemi, gemi en savunmasız anı: The emergency power system is the last safety net, coming into action when the ship is at its most vulnerable; therefore "tested but never needed" is the measure of success. The ETO's disciplined weekly testing, trending of battery condition and annual verification of the transfer logic ensure that this net deploys quietly and reliably at the moment of a critical blackout.
Acil güç, tahliye sistemlerinin (aydınla: Emergency power is vital for the evacuation systems (lighting, public address) to work.
Acil jeneratör ve acil yangın pompası gi: Weekly tests of critical electrical equipment such as the emergency generator and the emergency fire pump are recorded; these are among the first items that PSC and class inspections look at.
Acil jeneratör, ana makine dairesi dışın: The emergency generator is in its own space outside the main machinery spaces, above the uppermost continuous deck and aft of the collision bulkhead. The aim is for the source to keep working even if the engine room is flooded or on fire.
Acil kompresör (emergency air compressor: Emergency air compressor: a small compressor, diesel-driven or supplied from the emergency switchboard during a power failure; for the first start of the auxiliary generator engines from dead ship condition.
Acil konularda telefon/e-posta hızlı kul: For urgent matters, telephone/e-mail is used for speed, but decisions and approvals are confirmed in writing. This written trail is critical later for responsibility and continuity.
Acil sistem testleri ve tatbikatları, IS: Emergency system tests and drills are recorded as required by ISM and SOLAS. The test date, result, abnormalities found and corrective actions are documented. These records are the evidence in PSC inspections and class surveys that the system has been tested regularly. A system that the records show has not been tested constitutes a serious inspection finding.
Acil sistemler yalnızca var olmakla yetm: It is not enough for emergency systems simply to exist; they must be kept "ready to operate at any moment" by regular testing and maintenance. An emergency generator or fire pump that is not tested runs the risk of not working in a real emergency. For this reason, the regulations make periodic testing of these systems mandatory; the cadet learns by observing these tests.
Acil sistemler, \"her an çalışmaya hazır: Emergency systems must be "ready to operate at any moment"; this requires regular maintenance. The emergency generator fuel/oil levels and battery, the fire pump priming system, the air compressor and the quick-closing valve mechanisms are checked periodically. The PMS manages this maintenance through planned work orders.
Acil sistemler, geminin \"en kötü gün\": Emergency systems are the ship's preparation for its "worst day"; they remain invisible in normal operation but determine the survival of the ship and crew in a crisis. The emergency generator, fire pump, air compressor and steering gear; quick-closing valves and remote controls; blackout recovery — none of them is reliable unless tested regularly. By observing these tests, the cadet learns the answers to "how does the system work, and does it really work?" together. The emergency system logic grasped today as an observer forms the basis of the composure and preparedness of the engineer who will manage a crisis tomorrow.
Acil yangın pompasının güç kaynağı, ana: The source of power of the emergency fire pump must be outside the space where the main fire pumps and their sources of power are located.
Aciliyet kodlaması tipiktir: AOG/urgent: Typical urgency coding: AOG/urgent (risk of ship operations stopping), normal (for planned maintenance), routine (stock replenishment). The Chief Engineer limits urgent orders to those that are really critical; overuse of "urgent" means a loss of both money and credibility.
Adhezif aşınma (scuffing): Yağ filmi kop: Adhesive wear (scuffing): when the oil film breaks down, metal-to-metal contact occurs. It causes sudden and serious damage.
Adil appraisal, kişiye yüz yüze geri bil: A fair appraisal is given to the person with face-to-face feedback; it should not be a surprise. A Master who manages well gives feedback continuously throughout the period, so that the appraisal is only a written summary of what has been said all along. An unfair or arbitrary appraisal affects that person's career and also damages the sense of fairness on board, and therefore morale.
Adil süreç (due process), pozitif sonucu: Due process means that a positive result is not applied as an automatic conviction but together with the right to confirmation and review. MRO review, the declaration of prescription medicines and the possibility of retesting with the split sample are parts of this process. The Master files every step (observation, test, result, removal from duty, notification, sign-off) time-stamped and signed; this file is decisive in any later employment law dispute.
Admiralty Information Overlay (AIO), ENC: The Admiralty Information Overlay (AIO) is an additional layer that can be displayed over the ENC; it shows Admiralty T&P notices not yet included in the ENC and the differences between the ENC and the paper chart (ENC Preliminary Notices, EP). In this way, ECDIS-only ships can also see the temporary dangers that are known on paper charts.
Admiralty Notices to Mariners (NtM) haft: Admiralty Notices to Mariners (NtM) are published weekly, and each week's edition contains numbered notices. The notices are grouped into permanent corrections, Temporary (T) and Preliminary (P) notices, summaries of NAVAREA warnings, announcements of new charts/publications, and block corrections.
Adyabatik süreçte Q = 0 olduğundan W = −: In an adiabatic process Q = 0, so W = −ΔU. The temperature rises on compression and falls on expansion.
Aft bearing weardown, şaftın yatak içind: Aft bearing weardown measures how far the shaft has dropped in the bearing due to wear; it is usually measured with a poker gauge / wear-down gauge from the aft seal area. Regular measurement shows the wear trend and remaining life of the bearing.
Aft seal arızası, ya denize yağ sızıntıs: Aft seal failure results either in oil leakage to sea (pollution) or in water ingress (bearing damage). The Chief Engineer assesses the direction and severity of the leak; temporary control is achieved by adjusting the gravity tank level or by bringing the emergency seal into service.
Air cooler temizliği yakıt verimini doğr: Air cooler cleanliness directly affects fuel efficiency. A chemical cleaning procedure is applied for sea-water-side fouling (marine growth, sand), and periodic washing for the air side. In the scavenge air receiver, oil or particles dripping from the scavenge ports may be a sign of a "scavenge fire"; temperature monitoring and regular inspection are essential.
Air dryer: refrigerant (çiğ noktası yakl: Air dryer: refrigerant type (dew point approx. +3 °C) or desiccant type (dew point -20 to -40 °C).
Akan sıvı, su jeti, buhar/mist ve hareke: Flowing liquids, water jets, steam/mist and moving particles accumulate a static electric charge; when this charge discharges (spark), it can ignite a flammable atmosphere. Washing with water (Butterworthing) in particular carries a higher static risk than crude oil, because water droplets/mist carry a high charge. This is why water washing in a tank that is not inerted is carried out only under the controlled conditions defined in ISGOTT.
Akan yakıt statik elektrik üretir; uygun: Flowing fuel generates static electricity; if this is not handled properly, there is a risk of sparks and ignition. At hose connections, the insulating flange/bonding practice is applied in accordance with company procedure, and a low rate at the start reduces static build-up. The Oiler watches that these precautions are applied.
Akdeniz, Baltık, Karadeniz gibi özel ala: In special areas such as the Mediterranean, the Baltic and the Black Sea, discharge to sea of most garbage other than food waste is prohibited; in these areas, food waste may be discharged only while en route, comminuted or ground, and at least 12 nautical miles from the nearest land. Waste that cannot be discharged to sea must be delivered to port reception facilities.
Akdeniz, Baltık, Karadeniz, Kızıldeniz v: In special areas such as the Mediterranean, the Baltic, the Black Sea, the Red Sea and the Antarctic, the discharge rules are much stricter. The Antarctic area has the strictest rules of all; for example, no oil or oily mixture may be discharged there at all. The Master knows the status of the sea area the ship is in (special area, ECA, PSSA) and passes this on to the crew in a briefing.
Aksiyel türbin: Yüksek verimli, büyük tu: Axial turbine: high efficiency, used in large turbochargers. The gas flows along the axis.
Aktif uyarıların bir listesi köprüüstünd: A list of active warnings is kept on the bridge; warnings that have not been canceled are considered to be in force. At the watch handover, active warnings are passed on verbally and in writing; otherwise a critical temporary danger may drop out of the monitoring chain.
Akü şarj cihazları, sabit gerilim (CV),: Battery chargers work in constant voltage (CV), constant current (CC) or combined CC-CV mode. Marine batteries usually have an IU (CC-CV) charging profile: first they are charged at constant current up to about 80%, then at constant voltage with the current falling until fully charged.
Akümülatör, azot gazı ile önceden şarj e: The accumulator stores energy through a chamber pre-charged with nitrogen gas. The pre-charge pressure is set to the value given by the maker; in general practice it is kept slightly below the minimum working pressure.
Akım sinyali, gerilim sinyaline göre kab: A current signal is less affected by cable length and noise than a voltage signal.
Akış ölçerler (manyetik, vortex, corioli: Flow meters (magnetic, vortex, Coriolis), speed sensors (pickup, encoder), oxygen/gas analyzers and viscosity sensors require special calibration procedures. The ETO follows the vendor procedure and watches for signs of drift that call for calibration. A wrongly calibrated sensor produces both false alarms and dangerous "missed alarms".
Akışkanlar zıt yönlerde akar. Sıcaklık f: The fluids flow in opposite directions. The temperature difference is distributed more evenly along the heat exchanger. The outlet temperature of the cold fluid can exceed the outlet temperature of the hot fluid.
Alacakaranlıkta gözlerin karanlığa adapt: At dusk, because the eyes have not yet fully adapted to darkness, small targets are harder to detect, and background lights (shore lights) can be confused with ships' lights. At dawn, targets can be lost visually when looking towards the sun (sun glare). For this reason, on the dawn/dusk watches the radar lookout and the visual lookout are intensified together, and an additional lookout is posted as night begins/ends.
Alan, ex-proof (yanıcı gaz riski varsa): The space is lit with ex-proof lighting (if there is a flammable gas risk). Access/exit routes must be clear and safe; ladders/staging are checked for soundness. Hazardous systems (pipelines, pumps, heating) are isolated/locked (lock-out tag-out) so that no chemical/liquid/steam can enter. The Chief Officer verifies these isolations.
Alarm monitoring system (AMS) düzenli \": The alarm monitoring system (AMS) is checked regularly with a "lamp test" and for signal integrity. Frequently recurring false alarms (nuisance alarms) either get silenced and ignored, which is dangerous, or their root cause (sensor/cable) is eliminated. The right approach is not to ignore a false alarm but to fix its source.
Alarm sinyalleri tanıtılır: general emer: The alarm signals are explained: the general emergency alarm (≥7 short + 1 long), the fire alarm and other signals, and the fact that abandon ship is ordered verbally by the Master. A new crew member must know by reflex where to go and what to do for each signal.
Alarm sonrası AB; havalandırmayı artırma: After the alarm, the AB increases ventilation, prepares the rescue equipment and directs the team. Only a trained rescuer wearing SCBA, attached to a lifeline and with their own standby outside goes in. This rule of sequence is one of the strictest safety rules on board.
Alarm tanınır; acknowledge etmeden önce: The alarm is recognised; before acknowledging, its source and time are read and the position and heading trend is checked. The ASOG status is declared and the Master, the ECR and the task control centres are informed on the designated channel.
Alarm tipleri: Alarm (uyarı), Slowdown (: Alarm types: alarm (warning), slowdown (power reduction), shutdown (automatic stop).
Alarm ve event log'ları, sistemin gizli: Alarm and event logs are the most valuable data source for revealing hidden problems in the system. By regularly reviewing the alarm printer output and historian data, the ETO analyzes which alarms recur most often, at what times they concentrate and in which subsystem they cluster.
Alarm veren reefer hızlıca incelenir (pl: A reefer in alarm is investigated quickly (plug, defrost, compressor); if it cannot be resolved, the engine team and the company are informed and the event is documented.
Alarm yorgunluğu çoğunlukla yanlış safet: Alarm fatigue mostly comes from wrong safety settings, unnecessary user layers, an unsuitable look-ahead or XTD, or unresolved chart objects. The solution is not to desensitise the system but to correct the passage plan and the settings for the operational context.
Alarm çaldığında kamarot, can yeleğiyle: When the alarm sounds, the steward goes to the muster station with a lifejacket and carries out the assigned duty. The steward knows where the lifejacket is and how to put it on correctly, the alarm signals and the muster point. These basic skills are reinforced by repetition in drills.
Alarm çaldığında mühendis önce alarmı ta: When an alarm sounds, the engineer first acknowledges it, investigates the cause and then intervenes if necessary — the alarm is never reset blindly. Critical alarms (LO low pressure, jacket water high temp, oil mist high) can trigger a main engine slowdown/shutdown; in that case, the bridge is informed immediately.
Alarm çaldığında nöbetçi mühendis vakit: When an alarm sounds, the duty engineer goes down to the engine room without delay, assesses the situation and, if necessary, informs the bridge. For a critical alarm such as fire or water ingress, the emergency procedure is put into action. The better the preparation, the fewer and more manageable the night alarms.
Alarm çaldığında stajyer, can yeleğiyle: When the alarm sounds, the cadet goes to the muster station with a lifejacket and carries out the duty defined in the Station Bill. From the first day, the cadet learns the muster station, the alarm signals and their own duty. Muster is where everyone is counted and where an organized response begins.
Alarm, DP, PMS/VMS ve iletişim kayıtları: The alarm, DP, PMS/VMS and communication records are preserved; after the incident, authority to resume is obtained through the formal process.
Alarm, warning ve caution/indication üre: Alarms, warnings and cautions/indications may have different priorities and sound behaviour depending on the maker and the applicable performance standard. Acknowledging only manages the sound; it does not remove the danger or the sensor failure. Alarms are not silenced in bulk without reading the alarm list, the source and the consequence.
Alarmın erken aşamada 'nuisance alarm' e: The main causes were normalising the alarm at an early stage by labelling it a "nuisance alarm", watch handover notes containing no measurable data (value, trend, duration), and the deferral of maintenance not being linked to a risk score.
Alcohol Resistant (AR-AFFF), polar çözüc: Alcohol-resistant foam (AR-AFFF) is used on polar solvent fires (alcohols, ketones).
Alerjen yönetimi ciddi bir emniyet konus: Allergen management is a serious safety issue; a nut or seafood allergy can turn into a medical emergency on board. Cross-use of serving utensils is therefore prohibited, and dishes containing allergens are served separately.
Alet panosunda \"her aletin bir yeri\" i: The "a place for every tool" principle is applied on the tool board (shadow board); a missing tool is visible at once and shows that a job has been left unfinished or that a tool has been forgotten inside the machinery (FOD risk). The workshop bench and the grinding/lathe area are kept clean and free of swarf.
Alev dedektörü (UV/IR) hidrokarbon yangı: Flame detectors (UV/IR) are used for hydrocarbon fires: helicopter deck, pump room.
Alev gözü (flame eye): Brülör alevini iz: Flame eye: monitors the burner flame; if the flame goes out, the fuel is cut off.
Alkol genellikle breathalyzer ile, uyuşt: Alcohol is usually measured with a breathalyzer, and drugs with urine/saliva test kits. The Third Officer ensures that the test procedure is applied correctly and that the results are recorded.
Alkol testi gemide genellikle kalibre ed: On board, the alcohol test is usually carried out with a calibrated breathalyser (breath alcohol meter). The calibration date of the device must be valid and the calibration interval stated by the manufacturer (typically 6–12 months) must be followed. Before the test the person is expected not to have put anything in his or her mouth for at least 15–20 minutes (to prevent contamination by mouth alcohol or food); if the result is positive, a second measurement is taken after a short wait.
Alkol/uyuşturucu politikası (drug & alco: The drug and alcohol policy is safety-critical and is usually based on zero tolerance or a low limit (e.g. 0.05 BAC or lower); a breach calls for serious disciplinary action. The Master carries out random and for-cause tests in accordance with the SMS, with confidentiality and respect for dignity. Keeping the line between discipline and bullying is the Master's leadership responsibility.
Alt uçta (big end) ve üst uçta (small en: There are bearings at the lower end (big end) and the upper end (small end). The bearing clearances are checked periodically.
Alternatif olarak absorpsiyonlu (delikan: Alternatively, absorption (desiccant) dehumidification systems use silica gel or lithium chloride.
Alternatif yakıtlar: LNG, metanol, amony: Alternative fuels: LNG, methanol, ammonia, hydrogen.
Alternatif: filtrasyon + elektroklorinas: Alternative: filtration + electrochlorination or chemicals (active substance produced in line). It gives strong treatment, but the residual (TRO — Total Residual Oxidant) must be neutralised and monitored before discharge. Efficiency varies in cold or low-salinity water.
Alternatör sargılarının izolasyon direnc: The insulation resistance of alternator windings falls with moisture and aging. The ETO measures stator-to-earth and rotor-to-earth IR with a 500 V (LV) or 1000–5000 V (HV) megger. The Polarization Index (PI = ratio of the 10 min value to the 1 min value) and the corrected minimum IR value (IEEE 43) are evaluated. Low values call for drying out with the space heater or cleaning of the windings.
Alternatör, 3 fazlı AC gerilim üretir. G: The alternator produces three-phase AC voltage. The ship's main busbar voltage is usually 440 V or 6.6 kV.
Alıcı, gelen basınç sinyalini kontrol va: The receiver passes the incoming pressure signal to the control valve. It is a simple, reliable system that needs few mechanical connections.
Alım sırasında temsili numune alınır ve: A representative sample is taken and retained during delivery; the sample is the only objective evidence in disputes about fuel quality and sulphur compliance.
Alınan ders: Scavenge drain düzenli temi: Lesson learned: the scavenge drains should be cleaned regularly, the cylinder oil feed rate optimised and the exhaust temperature trend monitored.
Alınan ders: Yakıt boru bağlantıları per: Lesson learned: periodic checks of the tightness of fuel pipe connections, insulation of hot surfaces, leak detection.
Alınan miktar hacim olarak ölçülür; metr: The quantity received is measured by volume; conversion to metric tons requires the density (at 15°C) and a temperature correction (ASTM 54B / VCF). The Second Engineer compares the barge measurements with the ship's measurements; if there is a discrepancy (short delivery, expansion tricks through heating), a Letter of Protest is issued. Air pockets (gas pocket / froth) can artificially inflate the quantity; time is therefore allowed beforehand for the fuel to stabilize.
Ambar kapakları, krenler ve ırgat/güvert: Hatch covers, cranes and windlasses/deck winches are driven by hydraulic power packs. Oil level, filter ΔP, leaks and pressure are checked regularly. These systems directly affect the safety of the deck crew during cargo operations and anchor/mooring work.
Ambar kapalı mekandır; giriş enclosed sp: The hold is an enclosed space; entry is made with an enclosed space entry permit and atmosphere testing. High-pressure washing, slippery surfaces and working at height (hold ladders, edges) are additional risks. The Bosun ensures PPE, supervision and safe working practice.
Ambar, bir sonraki yüke uygun temizlik s: The hold must be handed over at a level of cleanliness suitable for the next cargo; otherwise residues of the previous cargo (taint), moisture or odor will damage the new cargo. Independent inspections are carried out for grain cargoes; a failed hold inspection leads to rejection for loading and major delays/costs. The Bosun knows and applies these standards.
An automatic-tension winch can heave or: An automatic-tension winch can heave or pay out as its control responds to load. This can cause unexpected line movement and change the mooring arrangement. Select the permitted operating mode under the approved instructions, brief the team and keep personnel clear of the line and equipment.
Ana bara gerilim kaybını algılayan röle,: A relay that detects the loss of voltage on the main busbar gives the emergency generator its start signal. The engine starts and takes the load on the emergency busbar within 45 seconds.
Ana bara gerilimi kaybolduğunda düşük ge: When the main busbar voltage is lost, an undervoltage relay gives the generator a start command; when the set reaches its rated voltage and frequency, the emergency switchboard breaker closes. During this changeover, emergency lighting and communications are supplied from the transitional source of power.
Ana dizel motorda yakıt enerjisinin dağı: Distribution of the fuel energy in a main diesel engine:
Ana dümen donanımı, gemi tam yüklü ve se: The main steering gear must be able to put the rudder over from 35° on one side to 30° on the other side in not more than 28 seconds with the ship at its deepest draft and at maximum service speed. The auxiliary steering gear must be able to do 15° to 15° in 60 seconds (at half speed). These criteria are the foundation of safe manoeuvring.
Ana hava kompresörü (main air compressor: Main air compressor: two-stage, 30 bar; charges the main air receiver.
Ana makine basınçlı hava ile çalıştırılı: The main engine is started with compressed air (starting air, usually ~30 bar). Air compressors fill the air bottles (air receivers). In addition, control air (control/service air) supplies the pneumatic systems. The cadet learns the difference between the two air systems and why they are kept separate.
Ana makine dairesinde yangın çıkıp pompa: If a fire breaks out in the main engine room and the pumps are lost, the emergency fire pump, located outside the engine room (in a separate compartment) and driven by an independent power source (its own diesel or the emergency generator), comes into use. It must have its own sea suction and priming, and be able to work without passing through the engine room.
Ana makine egzoz gazı sıcaklığı türboşar: The main engine exhaust gas temperature at the turbocharger outlet is about 200–350 °C. The economiser uses this heat to produce steam independently of the boiler.
Ana makine egzoz ısısı → ekonomizer → bu: Main engine exhaust heat → economiser → steam production → heating + turbine generator.
Ana makine performansı doğrudan yakıt ka: Main engine performance depends directly on fuel quality. The Second Engineer keeps the injection viscosity constant (typically 10-15 cSt) with the viscotherm/heater; low viscosity causes pump wear, while high viscosity causes poor atomization, poor injection and carbon formation.
Ana makine sistem yağı (sump), cylinder: Main engine system oil (sump), cylinder oil, generator oil and gear/turbocharger oils are monitored separately. The Second Engineer follows daily consumption and the sump level; excessive consumption is a sign of leakage, burning (blow-by) or contamination. The top-up plan is based on ROB and voyage duration; LO bunkers (drums or bulk) are requested in good time.
Ana makine starting-air receiver sayısı,: The number, isolation and total capacity of the main engine starting air receivers are verified against SOLAS II-1 and the class/maker arrangement. The general capacity criterion is 12 consecutive starts without recharging by the compressors for reversible engines and 6 starts for non-reversible engines; it is not to be generalised as "6 starts per receiver".
Ana makine trip ettiğinde şaft jeneratör: When the main engine trips, the shaft generator is lost too; the blackout risk is therefore assessed together with the automatic start time of the standby generator. Class and the flag state may set additional conditions for the shaft generator to be counted as a source of electrical power.
Ana makine ve essential auxiliary için m: A minimum spare parts list is defined for the main engine and essential auxiliaries (e.g. spare piston ring set, exhaust valve, fuel injector, bearing shells). On single-engine ships this list is longer.
Ana makine ve itki sisteminin sürekli op: Keeping the main engine and propulsion system continuously operational requires not only technical knowledge but a culture of systematic monitoring, careful decision-making and meticulous documentation. The modern Chief Engineer is not only a mechanical expert but also a data analyst, regulatory specialist and systems manager.
Ana makine ve jeneratörler, devrin tehli: The main engine and the generators are protected by an overspeed trip that prevents the speed from rising to a dangerous level. The mechanical type (spring-loaded bolt/flyweight) trips at a set speed; the electronic type works with a pickup sensor + governor. Overspeed occurs on loss of load (e.g. a generator breaker opening, the propeller coming out of the water) or on governor failure, and can wreck the engine.
Ana makine yağlama sistemi; LO sump tank: The main engine lubrication system consists of the LO sump tank, LO pumps, LO cooler, filters and distribution lines. The oil lubricates and cools the main bearings, the crosshead/crankpin bearings, the piston (piston cooling oil) and the cam mechanism, then returns to the sump. Circulation is continuous and under pressure.
Ana makine yol verme havası (starting ai: Main engine starting air is typically around 25–30 bar and is produced by two/three-stage reciprocating compressors. Compressor efficiency depends on the tightness of the suction/discharge valves (reed/plate valves). A leaking valve raises the interstage pressure and the discharge temperature; this creates a risk of carbon build-up and explosion (crankcase/air pipe explosion).
Ana makine, şaft, kazan veya emniyet sis: Major failures affecting the main engine, shaft, boiler or safety systems must be reported to the classification society and, where required, to the insurer (H&M). The Chief Engineer coordinates this notification with the Master and the Superintendent.
Ana makine; overspeed trip, LO low press: The main engine is equipped with multi-layered protection such as the overspeed trip, LO low pressure shut-down, jacket water high temp slow-down, oil mist detector and scavenge fire alarm. The cadet learns what each protection prevents: the overspeed trip prevents the engine from breaking apart on loss of load, and the OMD prevents a crankcase explosion.
Ana makinede her silindir için egzoz gaz: On the main engine, the exhaust gas temperature of each cylinder is a critical indicator. A temperature imbalance between cylinders (deviation) indicates a fuel injector fault, a combustion problem or a leaking exhaust valve. Bearing temperatures (main bearing, crankpin, crosshead), cooling water inlet/outlet temperatures and lubricating oil temperature are monitored on every round.
Ana makinede yeni bir vuruntu (knocking): A new knocking sound in the main engine may indicate a problem with injection timing, a combustion anomaly or a bearing clearance problem; it is reported to the engineer immediately. The color of the smoke from the exhaust funnel also gives information: black smoke (incomplete combustion/overload), blue smoke (burning oil), white smoke (water/fuel problem or cold combustion).
Ana makinenin alt sistemleri birbirine b: The main engine's subsystems are interconnected: fuel injection, scavenge air (turbocharger + air cooler), jacket cooling water, piston/crosshead LO, cylinder lubrication and exhaust. The cadet learns how each subsystem contributes to the healthy running of the engine.
Ana makinenin başlatılması (start) genel: The main engine is usually started with compressed air; this air is stored in air bottles (air receivers) and filled by the main air compressors. The emergency air compressor is an independent capacity that provides enough air to restart the main engine when the main compressors cannot operate (as in a blackout); on some ships it may be driven by an independent diesel or supplied from emergency power.
Ana motor jacket water ısısı (yaklaşık 8: The heat of the main engine jacket water (about 80 °C) evaporates seawater at low pressure (under vacuum). Because the evaporation temperature is lowered to 40–60 °C, no extra fuel is burned.
Ana parçalar: silindir gömleği (liner),: The main parts: cylinder liner, piston and piston rings, piston rod, crosshead, connecting rod, crankshaft and main bearings. The crosshead design separates the side thrust from the liner; this reduces liner wear and allows the cylinder lubrication to be managed separately.
Ana steering gear için yaygın SOLAS krit: The usual SOLAS criterion for the main steering gear is to put the rudder over from 35° on one side to 35° on the other side at the deepest draft and maximum ahead service speed, and in any case from 35° on either side to 30° on the other side in not more than 28 seconds.
On the main switchboard, the bus bar voltage (e.g. 440V), frequency (60 Hz or 50 Hz), megger/insulation condition and the current of major consumers are monitored. It is verified that auto-start of the standby generator is enabled; its automatic start on a sudden load increase or when a set trips prevents a blackout.
Ana yangın pompaları makine dairesinde,: The main fire pumps are in the engine room; the emergency fire pump is in a separate compartment outside the engine room.
Ana yatak, krank yatağı, kam mili yatağı: Temperature sensors (Pt100/thermocouple) are fitted to the main bearings, crankpin bearings, camshaft bearings and turbocharger bearings. The test is carried out by applying a simulated value to the sensor input (decade box / test resistor) and verifying that the alarm/slowdown setpoint triggers correctly. In actual operation, bearing temperature is monitored as a trend; a slowly rising trend is a sign of early wear.
Ana yataklar (main bearings) krank milin: The main bearings carry the main journals of the crankshaft. The crankpin (big end) bearings are at the lower end of the connecting rod. The crosshead bearings support the crosshead pin.
Anahtar (kilit) yalnızca işi yapan kişid: The key to the lock must be held only by the person doing the work; the "one person - one lock" principle applies. Where several people are working, each person fits their own lock (group lockout). The ETO ensures that removal of the isolation is also controlled: first a check of the area, then removal of tags/locks, and energizing last.
Anahtarlama frekansı (carrier frequency): The switching (carrier) frequency is typically between 2 and 16 kHz. A higher switching frequency gives lower motor noise but higher switching losses.
Analiz kalitesi, numune kalitesiyle başl: Analysis quality begins with sample quality. The sample must be taken while the machinery is running and the oil is hot, from a representative point in the system (running line / sampling valve). A sample taken from the bottom of a tank or from stagnant oil is misleading.
Analiz sonucu, üç olası kararı doğurur:: The analysis result leads to one of three possible decisions: change the oil (condition critical), top up with make-up oil (TBN/level low but oil sound), or clean it by purifier/filtration (water/particles present but oil chemistry good). The Chief Engineer makes the right decision.
Anchor ve chain cable, klas survey'inde: The anchor and chain cable are examined closely at the class survey; they are subject to a program under which, every 5 years, the whole cable is ranged out (extracted), inspected and, if necessary, turned end-for-end. Every day, the Bosun checks the chain locker ventilation, drainage of accumulated mud, the chain stopper, the bow stopper and the devil's claw.
Anchor ve mooring watch, geminin hareket: Anchor and mooring watches are the guardians of safety during the hours when the ship appears motionless but the danger persists. The AB's regular checks, early detection of signs of dragging and snap-back awareness keep the ship safe at anchor and alongside.
Anchor watch ile sürüklenme (dragging) i: Dragging is monitored with an anchor watch (GPS and bearings); the engine is kept ready if necessary. When heaving up the anchor, the windlass load and the condition of the chain are watched.
Anchor windlass (ırgat), demiri kaldırıp: The anchor windlass heaves up and lowers the anchor; the chain stopper (devil's claw/guillotine) takes the cable load off the windlass while the ship is riding at anchor. The Bosun coordinates the use of this equipment in the correct sequence and in a safe manner. The windlass brake, brake holding and clutch operations are critical control points.
Anchor windlass bakımı vinç bakımıyla be: Anchor windlass maintenance is similar to crane maintenance; in addition, the chain compressor (anchor secured at sea) and the riding pawl are tested periodically.
Ani dökülmelerde emici ped, granül veya: For sudden spills, absorbent pads, granules or rags are used; once the oil has been absorbed, these materials are collected as special waste and disposed of properly (oily rags can ignite spontaneously — they are kept in a metal container with a lid). The Wiper also checks that the SOPEP/SMPEP absorbent material stock is ready.
