Annex V (uygulama rehberi: MEPC.295(71)): Annex V (implementation guidelines: MEPC.295(71)) divides garbage into categories (plastics, food waste, incinerator ash, operational waste, animal carcasses, fishing gear, e-waste, cargo residues). Discharging plastics into the sea is prohibited in all circumstances. Outside special areas, food waste may be discharged more than 3 NM from the nearest land if comminuted, and more than 12 NM if not comminuted.
Annex V çöpü kategorilere ayırır: A (pla: Annex V divides garbage into categories: A (plastics), B (food waste), C (domestic waste — paper, rags, glass, metal, bottles), D (cooking oil), E (incinerator ash), F (operational waste), G (animal carcasses), H (fishing gear), I (e-waste), J (cargo residues — non-HME), K (cargo residues — HME). Each category has its own discharge/storage rules. The Chief Officer ensures that the crew categorizes garbage correctly.
Annex V, çöpün denize atılmasını çok büy: Annex V prohibits the discharge of garbage into the sea to a very large extent; plastics are strictly prohibited. Every disposal (ashore, incinerator, limited discharge to sea) is recorded under the Garbage Management Plan and in the Garbage Record Book. Engine room waste (oily rags, used filters, paint cans) is segregated into the correct category and landed ashore.
Annex VI ağırlıklı makine kapsamında ols: Although Annex VI mainly concerns the engine department, cargo VOC (Volatile Organic Compound) emissions on tankers are a deck matter. On tankers with a VOC Management Plan, the Chief Officer applies the vapor return and loading procedures in accordance with that plan. Ozone-depleting substances (ODS) and equipment containing them are also recorded.
Anormal her durum derhal İkinci Mühendis: Every abnormal situation is reported immediately to the Second Engineer or the Chief Engineer. The Third/Fourth Engineer knows the limits of their authority: jobs they can deal with on their own are kept separate from jobs that need a senior engineer's approval/support. When in doubt, a senior engineer is called — this is not a weakness but correct practice.
Anormal sonuç alındığında Baş Mühendis ö: When an abnormal result is received, the Chief Engineer first questions the sample and possible errors (re-sample), then moves on to mechanical diagnosis. A critical result calls for immediate action; at a moderate level, monitoring frequency is increased and a plan is made.
Anormal trendler (SFOC artışı, T/C verim: By turning abnormal trends (rising SFOC, loss of T/C efficiency, increasing Fe content) into an early maintenance plan, the risk of unexpected breakdown and of off-hire under the charter party is reduced.
Anten dönüş motoru, slip ring, encoder (: The antenna drive motor, slip ring, encoder (azimuth/heading marker) and waveguide need maintenance. The ETO checks the antenna mechanism, the motor brushes (if fitted), waveguide moisture (dehydrator/pressurization) and heading marker alignment. Moisture getting into the waveguide causes power loss and arcing.
Anten sistemleri köprüüstü elektroniğini: Antenna systems are the most heavily stressed external components of bridge electronics: salt, moisture, vibration and UV. The ETO checks the antenna bases, insulators and earthing and the SWR of the VHF/HF antennas. High SWR leads to power loss and failure of the transmitter output stage. Interference between antennas (mutual coupling) and shadowing are taken into account when siting them.
Anten stabilizasyonu; jiroskoplar/IMU, m: Antenna stabilization compensates for ship motion by means of gyroscopes/IMU, motors (azimuth, elevation, cross-level) and a control board. The ETO checks the condition of the motors and belts/gears, the gyro/sensor calibration and that the antenna tracks the satellite without losing it. A worn belt or a faulty motor leads to loss of signal when the ship is moving.
Anten, geminin yalpa/baş-kıç vurması (pi: To remain pointed at the satellite during the ship's rolling, pitching and yawing motions, the antenna has a stabilization system (gyro/sensor based) and a satellite tracking mechanism. The ETO monitors the antenna pointing accuracy, the blockage zones (shadow of the funnel/mast) and the skew/polarization setting.
Antenin radome (koruyucu kubbe) bütünlüğ: The integrity of the antenna radome (protective dome) is critical; a cracked or leaking radome lets in moisture and salt, leading to corrosion of the electronics and loss of signal. The ETO periodically checks the radome gaskets and bolts and the humidity inside the dome (desiccant/heater, if fitted).
Anti-paralel SCR (thyristor) çiftleri il: The motor voltage is increased in a controlled way with anti-parallel pairs of SCRs (thyristors). The voltage is raised gradually by reducing the firing angle.
Antifouling boya: Biyosit salınımı ile y: Antifouling paint: prevents attachment by releasing biocides. Self-polishing copolymer (SPC) and silicone-based (foul-release) types are common.
Apply the rope maker’s retirement criter: Apply the rope maker’s retirement criteria and the ship’s mooring-line management plan. Consider construction, abrasion, cuts, internal damage, heat, chemicals and service history. Do not use a universal percentage of damaged fibres for every line. Identify and segregate suspect lines and report them to the Chief Officer.
Appraisal aşamasında stajyer, gerekli tü: In the appraisal stage, the cadet helps to check that all required nautical publications are on board and up to date: the relevant charts (paper/ENC), Sailing Directions (Pilot Books), List of Lights, List of Radio Signals, Tide Tables, Tidal Stream Atlas, Ocean Passages for the World and Routeing Charts. The charts required are determined from the Admiralty NP Catalogue or the ECDIS chart catalogue.
Appraisal aşamasında tüm bilgi kaynaklar: In the appraisal stage, all sources of information are gathered and the voyage risks are assessed; alternative routes are compared. In the planning stage, the selected route is drawn on the chart/ECDIS, and the waypoints, courses, distances, UKC and abort points are determined. These two stages are the Second Officer's desk work.
Appraisal yalnızca bir not değil, bir ge: An appraisal is not just a mark but the start of a development plan. For a strong junior officer, the Master can plan steps to prepare for promotion (e.g. more supervised manoeuvring, responsibility for coastal navigation, mentoring in paperwork). Conversely, for a person who is struggling, concrete improvement goals and support are defined.
Appraisal'da geminin maksimum draught'ı,: In the appraisal, the ship's maximum draft, the expected trim and the water density as it changes along the voyage (fresh/brackish/salt) are considered. A company UKC policy usually specifies values such as a certain percentage of the draft in the open sea and a fixed minimum in restricted waters (e.g. 10% or 1.0-1.5 m).
Appraisal, eldeki tüm seyir bilgisinin s: Appraisal is a systematic review of all the navigational information available. The Second Officer considers together the charts (paper/ENC), Sailing Directions (Pilot Books), List of Lights, List of Radio Signals, Tide Tables, Tidal Stream Atlases, Ocean Passages of the World, Routeing Charts, the Mariner's Handbook (NP100), Notices to Mariners and the company's route-specific risk assessment.
Appraisal, sefere ait tüm verilerin topl: Appraisal is the gathering and evaluation of all the information relevant to the voyage. Publications (Sailing Directions, List of Lights, Tide Tables, Routeing Charts), electronic charts (ENCs) and the necessary T&P NM corrections are checked. Weather forecasts (long and short range), ice reports, piracy areas (HRA, VRA), war risk areas and health authority warnings (yellow fever, malaria, epidemics such as COVID) are compiled at this stage.
Ara ikmal yapılmayan bir seferde aşçı, \: On a voyage without intermediate provisioning, the cook predicts when each item will run out by calculating "consumption rate x number of days". The stock depletion table is linked one-to-one to the menu cycle; for example, if fresh milk runs out in the last week, the menu switches to powdered/UHT milk and suitable recipes are chosen.
Arayüz ünitesinin tasarımı, Bridge Mate: The design of the interface unit makes the Bridge Mate system suitable for retrofit and modernisation in all equipment classes. As the same hardware modules are used in the different classes, an upgrade to a higher class usually means more of the same hardware, not a new type of hardware.

The design of the interface unit makes the Bridge Mate system suitable for retrofit and modernisation in all equipment classes. The compact design and distributed architecture keep the cabling work on existing ships limited.
Araç ağırlıkları, DG beyanları ve çıkış: Vehicle weights, dangerous goods declarations and discharge ports are entered in the manifest, and agreement with the actual cargo is verified. Vehicles carrying dangerous goods are also checked for segregation.
Araç elleçleme sırasında ventilasyon tam: During vehicle handling the ventilation runs at full capacity and CO levels are monitored. On a closed deck, insufficient ventilation leads to a fatal build-up of CO.
Araç güvertesi yangını hızla yayılır; bö: A vehicle deck fire spreads quickly; subdivision and the drencher system are the critical defences.
Araç güvertesi yangını ve yolcu tahliyes: Vehicle deck fire and passenger evacuation scenarios are practised; use of the MES and lifeboats, mustering and passenger guidance procedures are drilled. A debrief is held.
Araç güvertesinde su birikmesi (water on: Water accumulating on the vehicle deck (water on deck) is the main cause of Ro-Ro capsizes; drainage and watertightness are managed together.
Araç güvertesinde yaya-araç ayrımı, PPE: On the vehicle deck, separation of pedestrians and vehicles, PPE (hi-vis, hard hat), management of exhaust gas and CO, and lashing checks are applied with standard checklists.
Araç güvertesine su girişi büyük serbest: Water entering the vehicle deck lowers GM quickly through a large free surface effect; the watertightness of doors and ramps is therefore part of stability. The loading condition must meet the intact and damage stability criteria.
Araç yüksekliği güverte clearance ile, a: The vehicle height is compared with the deck clearance and the weight with the deck load density; a special lashing plan is made. If it is not suitable, the vehicle is not accepted.
Araçlar CSM'deki pattern'e göre en az 4: Vehicles are secured at a minimum of four points according to the pattern in the CSM; the MSL of the chains or webbing is chosen for the vehicle weight and the sea conditions. Wheel chocks are fitted and brakes applied.
Arc flash riskini azaltmak için koruma r: The basic strategies for reducing arc flash risk are shortening the clearing time of the protection relays, using faster protection settings in maintenance mode (maintenance switch) and eliminating live work. The ETO ensures that arc flash warning labels (incident energy, boundary, required PPE) are posted on high-energy switchboards.
Arc flash, mevcut kısa devre akımı ve ar: Depending on the prospective short-circuit current and the arc clearing time, an arc flash releases a large amount of thermal energy (incident energy, cal/cm²). The ETO assesses the arc flash energy and the safe approach limits (arc flash boundary) at critical switchboards using the IEEE 1584 methodology. The appropriate level of arc-rated PPE is determined for high-energy switchboards.
Artan yemeğin değerlendirilmesi gıda güv: Using leftover food is subject to food safety rules: food that has been in the danger zone for a long time is discarded; food that has been properly and rapidly cooled and stored can be used under specific rules and reheated once only. Keeping unsafe food with the idea of "let's not waste it" is a food poisoning risk.
Arıtılmış atık su, onaylı STP ile kriter: Treated sewage may be discharged in compliance with the criteria through an approved STP; no distance or speed condition applies to it. Comminuted/disinfected sewage is discharged more than 3 nautical miles from the nearest land, and sewage that is not comminuted more than 12 nautical miles from the nearest land; discharge from a holding tank is made at a moderate rate while the ship is en route at not less than 4 knots. Discharge is restricted in port and in the special area (Baltic Sea; passenger ships); the sewage is retained in a tank or delivered to a shore facility.
Arıza noktasına en yakın devre kesicinin: The circuit breaker closest to the fault must open first. This is achieved by the upstream breaker opening later (time selectivity) or responding at a higher current (current selectivity). Lack of coordination causes the whole system to be de-energised unnecessarily.
Arıza sonrası bakım (corrective/reactive: Corrective (reactive) maintenance is the approach of waiting for equipment to fail and then intervening. It can be economical for non-critical and redundant systems, but on critical equipment it leads to unplanned stoppages and high costs.
Arıza ve yapılan bakım PMS/kayıt sistemi: Faults and the maintenance carried out are entered in the PMS/record system; recurring faults trigger spare parts/service planning. If critical equipment fails (e.g. the main oven or a refrigeration unit), the menu and preparation plan are adapted to this loss.
Arızada OOW önce seyri emniyete alır: ma: In a failure the OOW first makes the navigation safe: manual steering or an appropriate mode, a safe speed, an additional lookout and more frequent fixes, an alternative chart or navigation method, and calling the Master. A reboot or service work is carried out according to the maker and the SMS once the navigational risk is under control.
Aspirating smoke detection (ASD/VESDA) s: Aspirating smoke detection (ASD/VESDA) systems continuously draw air through a pipe network and pass it through a laser-based detector; they provide very early detection and are used in critical areas such as cargo holds and server rooms. The ETO checks the filters, fans and sampling holes of these systems for blockage.
Aspirating smoke detection (HSSD/VESDA): Aspirating smoke detection (HSSD/VESDA) gives highly sensitive early detection for cargo holds.
Astronomik seyirde (celestial navigation: In celestial navigation, all observations are timed in UTC, because the Greenwich Hour Angle (GHA) and declination values in the Nautical Almanac are based on UTC. Since even an error of seconds causes a position error of the order of a nautical mile, the accuracy of the chronometer and of the UTC reference is vital.
Astronomik seyirde boylam hatası doğruda: In celestial navigation, a longitude error arises directly from a time error: a time error of about 4 seconds corresponds to a longitude error of ~1 nautical mile at the equator. Even in the GPS era, the chronometer and accurate time remain important, both as a backup navigation method and for the consistency of records.
At anchor, maintain the planned watch us: At anchor, maintain the planned watch using suitable independent position and movement checks. Compare observations with the expected swinging area and conditions. Report suspected dragging and worsening weather promptly to the Master. Prepare propulsion and assess available responses under the ship-specific anchoring and emergency procedures.
At the anchoring station, repeat back th: At the anchoring station, repeat back the required operation and cable length. Read the actual shackle markings and report cable direction, load and length accurately, for example two shackles in the water. Distinguish heaving, walking back and letting go; do not substitute an ambiguous command.
Atmosfer basıncında su 100 °C'de kaynar;: At atmospheric pressure water boils at 100 °C, but the main engine jacket water is only about 70–90 °C. The FWG creates a vacuum inside it (with an ejector) that lowers the boiling point to about 40–60 °C, so that seawater can be evaporated with low-grade waste heat. The vapour is condensed into fresh water and the salt is left behind.
Atmosfer testi belirli sırayla yapılır:: The atmosphere test is carried out in a set order: first oxygen (must read a steady 21% by volume), then flammable gas (LEL <1%, hydrocarbons), then toxic gases (H₂S, CO). Measurements are taken with a calibrated and certified multi-gas detector. The test is carried out before entering the space, at different levels (top, middle, bottom — gases stratify according to density) and from outside (remote probe).
Atmosferi şüpheli veya solunamaz mekânla: In spaces where the atmosphere is suspect or unbreathable, SCBA (with its own air supply) or SAA (supplied through an air line) is used. The Bosun checks that this equipment is ready, charged and used correctly.
Attained CII, geminin bir yıldaki toplam: Attained CII is calculated by dividing the ship's total CO2 emissions in a year (fuel consumption × carbon factor) by its transport work (capacity × distance traveled). This value is compared with the required CII reference line specific to the ship type/size.
Attained EEXI ≤ Required EEXI kriteri sa: Even if the criterion attained EEXI ≤ required EEXI is met, compliance on paper can be fragile in the field if no operational risk analysis is made. Planning the power reserve becomes critical, especially in heavy weather, currents and safety manoeuvres.
Attended dönemde fiziksel turlar ve süre: In attended periods, physical rounds and continuous monitoring are essential. In UMS periods, the dead man alarm (personnel alarm) system is activated; personnel entering the engine room confirm that they are safe by pressing a button at set intervals. The cadet must be familiar with this system and learn the entry and exit procedure.
Atölye aletleri temiz, tam ve yerli yeri: Workshop tools are kept clean, complete and in their proper places. Damaged hand tools (a cracked hammer handle, a deformed wrench, a power tool with damaged insulation) are taken out of use; a bad tool is a source of both accidents and poor work.
Atık alım makbuzu alınır ve ilgili kayıt: A waste delivery receipt is obtained and entered in the relevant record book.
Atık disiplini doğrudan haşere kontrolün: Waste discipline is directly linked to pest control. A bin with food scraps left in it, or one emptied late, invites cockroaches, rodents and flies. Garbage trolleys and bins are washed and disinfected after each emptying. The garbage storage area (garbage station) is kept tidy and odor-free.
Atık gıda ve yağ bertarafı, aşçının deni: Disposal of food waste and oil is the cook's most tangible contribution to protecting the marine environment. Correct segregation, reducing waste at source, never putting oil into the sea or drains, disposing of food waste only under permitted conditions and providing accurate information for the Garbage Record Book: every link in this chain secures both MARPOL Annex V compliance and clean seas. When in doubt, always store it and deliver it in port.
Atık kapları düzenli boşaltılır ve temiz: Waste containers are emptied and cleaned regularly; accumulated waste causes odor and attracts insects/rodents. Plastics and recyclable waste can be compacted to reduce their volume (if a compactor is available), which reduces the storage burden.
Atık saklama alanlarında sızıntı (özelli: Leaks in garbage storage areas (particularly from food waste and oily waste) are prevented, and the risk of deck contamination and of waste reaching the sea is controlled. Mixing different categories (e.g. plastics + food) both spoils segregation and makes the waste ineligible for discharge. Orderly, clean storage is important for both hygiene and regulatory compliance.
Atık teslim öncesi bildirim (advance not: Advance notification is sent to the port before delivering waste.
Atık teslimi maliyetlidir; ancak yasadış: Delivering waste ashore costs money; however, this cost is insignificant compared with the penalty for illegal discharge. The company SMS usually applies a "no overboard discharge" policy and requires all waste to be delivered ashore. The Chief Officer ensures that cost pressure never leads to falsified records or illegal discharge.
Atık ve sona eren raf ömürlü kimyasallar: Managing waste and chemicals whose shelf life has expired (shelf-life expired) is also important for cost and for the environment. Old stock is used first on the FIFO (first-in-first-out) principle; chemicals past their shelf life are disposed of under MARPOL Annex V/the appropriate waste procedure.
Atık yönetimi, küçük günlük disiplinleri: Waste management is the sum of small daily disciplines, but it has major consequences at inspections. The Chief Officer succeeds by setting up a correct segregation system, keeping honest, real-time records, delivering waste through legal channels and instilling in the crew a culture of "not a single piece of garbage goes into the sea". Clean records and a clean sea protect the ship from heavy penalties and the company from loss of reputation.
Atık ısı geri kazanımı (Waste Heat Recov: Waste heat recovery (Waste Heat Recovery System — WHRS) increases overall efficiency by producing steam/electricity from exhaust gas heat. Where fitted, the Chief Engineer manages the optimum operation of the WHRS and the maintenance of the exhaust gas economizer.
Auto-synchronizing sistemi check-synch r: The auto-synchronizing system is equipped with a check-synch relay (25); even when the breaker is closed manually, this relay prevents it from closing at the wrong phase angle. The ETO regularly checks the sync panel lamps, the voltmeter/frequency meter pairs and the sync selector switch.
Automatic route check seçili safety cont: The automatic route check gives warnings based on the selected safety contour and mariner's objects, but it cannot be relied on to catch objects off the screen, a wrong display or scale, user charts, T&P information, chart quality or shortcomings in the software interpretation. Zero warnings is not a certificate of a safe route.
Autopilot ve joystick entegrasyonunda ko: In the integration of the autopilot and joystick, the way command priority and the transfer of control are resolved must be compared with the FMEA. A configuration in which more than one source can give commands at the same time must be prevented by design.
Auxiliary (oil-fired) boiler, port'ta ve: The auxiliary (oil-fired) boiler produces steam in port and at low load; the exhaust gas economizer produces steam at sea from the main engine exhaust heat (waste heat recovery). Steam is used for heating fuel/oil, tank heating and general services. The cadet learns how the two sources complement each other.
Auxiliary boiler: yakıtlı (HFO/MGO) veya: Auxiliary boiler: oil-fired (HFO/MGO) or exhaust gas economiser; produces saturated steam at 7–10 bar.
Auxiliary steering gear için kriter, yin: The criterion for the auxiliary steering gear is to put the rudder over from 15° on one side to 15° on the other side in not more than 60 seconds, again at the defined draft and at one half of the maximum ahead service speed or 7 knots, whichever is greater; exceptions and equivalent arrangements are checked in the approved documents.
Auxiliary/exhaust gas boiler için buhar: For the auxiliary/exhaust gas boiler, steam pressure, water level (gauge glass + remote), feed water temperature and burner status are monitored. Water level is the most critical parameter; at low-low level, the boiler shuts off firing automatically (flame failure/low water cut-off). Care is taken to guard against priming/foaming and cascade tank contamination.
Avantaj: deniz suyu korozyonu sadece cen: Advantage: seawater corrosion is confined to the central cooler and the SW line; maintenance and service life are improved.
Avantajları: Hafiflik (çeliğin 1/3'ü), k: Advantages: lightness (one third of steel), corrosion resistance. Disadvantages: low melting point (660 °C), fire risk, galvanic corrosion.
Avantajı: Gereksiz bakım (over-maintenan: Advantage: unnecessary maintenance (over-maintenance) is avoided and equipment life is extended. Disadvantage: it requires investment in monitoring equipment and specialist personnel.
Average adjuster (örneğin Richards Hogg: The average adjuster (firms such as Richards Hogg Lindley, for example) draws up the "general average statement", which determines each party's contribution by calculating the value of all the interests saved and the amount of the sacrifices. This process can take months or years. The Master's task is to give the adjuster accurate and complete documents; missing documents both delay the adjustment and can lead to items in the shipowner's favour not being admitted to GA.
Aylık ERM incelemesinde en az bir 'zinci: At the monthly ERM review, at least one "chain-breaking" case should be chosen, and the team should analyse at which link in the chain which intervention could have prevented the event.
Aylık olarak SCBA tüp basıncı, low-press: Every month, the SCBA cylinder pressure, low-pressure whistle and mask tightness; the EEBD seal, pressure gauge and expiry; and the completeness of the fireman's outfit and the safety lamp battery are checked. Deficiencies found are raised as defects.
Aylık olarak tüm portatif tüpler görsel: Every month, all portable extinguishers are inspected visually: is the pressure gauge in the green band, are the safety pin and tamper seal in place, is the shell free of corrosion, is the bracket sound, is it at the correct station? The annual weighing dates of CO2 and dry powder extinguishers are tracked separately.
Aylık overdue raporu çıkarılır; LSA/FFA: A monthly overdue report is produced; maintenance of critical safety equipment such as LSA and FFA has priority. Job records are kept complete.
Aylık overdue raporu çıkarılır; kritik e: A monthly overdue report is produced; overdue jobs on critical equipment are closed out at once or justified. Maintenance records (hours, parts, measurements) are kept complete.
A monthly overdue report is produced; critical equipment has priority; job records are kept complete.
Aylık overdue raporu çıkarılır; rampa/LS: A monthly overdue report is produced; critical equipment such as ramps, LSA and FFA has priority. Job records are kept complete.
Aylık projeksiyon, yıl sonu sürprizlerin: The monthly projection is the most powerful tool for preventing year-end surprises. Late actions may not be able to be made up within the same year.
Aylık spectroanalysis (Al, Cr, Cu, Fe, P: Monthly spectroanalysis (the metals Al, Cr, Cu, Fe, Pb, Sn, Si, and V, Na for fuel contamination) is plotted on a trend chart. An increase in Si means ingress of sand via the fuel or the air filter; Cu, wear of bearing surfaces; Fe, ring or liner wear.
Aylık teknik rapor; tamamlanan ve gecikm: The monthly technical report contains completed and overdue PMS work orders, the condition of critical equipment, open defects and the plan for the coming period. This report enables the technical office ashore to monitor maintenance performance (overdue ratio, planned vs. corrective).
Aylık zorunlu abandon ship ve fire drill: In addition to the mandatory monthly abandon ship and fire drills, enclosed space entry & rescue drills (at least once every 2 months, SOLAS III/19.3.3), man overboard (MOB), collision/grounding, oil spill (SOPEP), steering gear failure, blackout, security (ISPS) and medical emergency drills are also held periodically as required by the SMS. The Safety Officer tracks the schedule of all these drills in a single matrix.
Aynı test, stand-by LO pompasının otomat: The same test also covers the automatic start function of the standby LO pump: when the pressure of the main LO pump drops, the standby pump must cut in automatically. This auto-start function is vital on UMS ships.
Aynı zaman diliminde kontrol odasında ya: With only one officer in the control room at that time, monitoring the alarm panel clashed with carrying out the telegraph orders; because the team had no shared picture of the situation, the order of response was not clearly set.
Aynı ısı transfer alanı için ters akış d: For the same heat transfer area, the counter-flow arrangement transfers more heat. Counter-flow is therefore preferred in ships' heat exchangers.
Aynı şekilde sıcak iş (hot work — kaynak: In the same way, the cadet learns the purpose of the hot work (welding, grinding) and electrical lockout (LOTO) procedures. These procedures are covered in detail in later sections; during watch participation, the cadet observes how they relate to watch safety.
Aynı şekilde yağlı zemin, kayma-düşme ka: Likewise, an oily floor is the main cause of slip-and-fall accidents; slipping on ladders and platforms leads to serious injuries. By cleaning up oil deposits immediately, the Wiper reduces both the fire risk and the accident risk. For this reason, the Wiper's job is low in rank but of high importance for safety.
Ayrıca ORB (Oil Record Book), OWS 15 ppm: In addition, the ORB (Oil Record Book), OWS 15 ppm alarm test, emergency generator/fire pump test records, bilge alarm tests and sentinel valve test records are primary evidence for surveys and PSC.
Ayrıca düşük sıcaklık termal gerilmeleri: The lower temperature also reduces thermal stresses and lowers NOx emissions.
Ayrıca tüm gemi kayıtları (deck log, ORB: In addition, all ship's records (deck log, ORB, GMDSS log, rest hours) carry time stamps. Inconsistent or wrong time undermines the reliability of the records at an inspection and creates serious problems in an investigation after an incident.
Ayrıca İkinci Zabit, kariyer basamağında: In addition, on the career ladder the Second Officer is the closest superior to the cadets and junior officers, so a mentoring relationship develops naturally here. While the Master and the Chief Officer provide strategic oversight, day-to-day practical training and follow-up of the Training Record Book (TRB) fall to the Second Officer.
Ayrım verimi büyük ölçüde besleme sıcakl: Separation efficiency depends largely on the feed temperature; as the temperature rises, the viscosity of the fuel/oil falls and water/solids separate more easily. For HFO, the typical separator feed temperature is raised to ~98°C (without reaching boiling point); the preheater provides this temperature. For LO, lower values (~90-95°C) are used.
Açma işlemleri yorucu ve zaman alıcıdır;: Opening-up work is tiring and time-consuming; it requires a good plan, the right tools, availability of spare parts and an experienced team. With CMS, this burden can be lightened by spreading it over the years.
Açma/kapama sırasında kapağın hareket yo: During opening and closing, the path of travel of the cover is cleared; nobody stands under the cover or in its path. On side-rolling covers there must be no chocks or obstructions on the rails, and on pontoon covers the crane/forklift operation must be coordinated. While the cover is moving, the AB acts as lookout, watching for hazards, and if necessary stops the operator with "stop".
Açık denizde fix aralığı seyrek olabilir: In the open sea, fixes may be taken at long intervals, while close to the coast and in narrow waters the frequency of fixes increases. The cadet understands the importance of fixing the position every few minutes in coastal navigation, of the parallel indexing technique and of using clearing bearings/clearing ranges. Recording every position with its time in the deck logbook and on the chart (or in ECDIS) is a basic discipline.
Açık denizde otomatik pilot rotayı tutar: On the open sea, the autopilot keeps the course; however, hand steering is engaged for traffic, maneuvering, narrow waters and system failures. The change-over is a procedure: the OOW says "hand steering", the helmsman switches the mode to manual, checks the compass and confirms "hand steering, on course one-two-zero". SOLAS V/24 requires a helmsman to be ready so that hand steering can be engaged immediately in areas where maneuvering is required.
Açık döngü sistemde çıkış değeri ölçülme: In an open-loop system the output is not measured and there is no feedback. The control action follows a fixed or predetermined programme. Example: a ventilation fan run by a timer. It cannot adapt to external factors (load changes, ambient temperature).
Açık güvertede taşınan yükler (konteyner: Cargo carried on the open deck (containers, timber, pipes, project cargo) is exposed to the high accelerations of the ship's motions at sea (rolling/pitching); it therefore requires extra lashing and regular checks. When bad weather is expected, the Bosun plans an additional lashing round; the AB carries out this round under safe conditions (if going out on deck is risky, only on the officer's decision).
Açık güvertede yağ, gres, boya, su ve öz: On open deck, oil, grease, paint, water and especially ice are the main causes of slipping. The Bosun gives priority to keeping walkways clean; in cold climates, the Bosun plans anti-slip application, salt spreading and ice breaking. Non-slip paint and anti-slip strips on deck are checked periodically.
Açık güverteli container gemilerinde tor: On open-deck container ships, the torsional moment is also monitored; diagonal weight distribution and quartering sea conditions increase torsion. In addition, tank top strength, hatch cover load and container stack/corner casting limits are part of the local strength check.
Açık manhole, ullage port, sounding pipe: Open manholes, ullage ports, sounding pipe caps, hold accesses and missing guard rails are fatal fall hazards. The Bosun ensures that every opening is kept under supervision while open and is closed securely as soon as the work is finished. A manhole left open and unattended can cost a crew member's life in the dark at night.
Açık sistemde hem kütle hem enerji sınır: In an open system both mass and energy can cross the boundary. Ships' turbines, compressors and heat exchangers are examples of open systems. It is also called a control volume; its boundary is called the control surface.
Açıkta bırakılmış lashing malzemesi, hor: Lashing material, hoses, cables and line ends left lying about are the most frequent causes of tripping. Hoses and cables laid out temporarily are hung up where possible, or gathered to the side so that they do not obstruct passage; if necessary, they are marked with warning tape/cones.
Açılan NC'ler için kök neden analizi yap: For each NC raised, a root cause analysis is carried out, corrective action is defined and the evidence of closure (records, photographs) is documented. The Chief Officer ensures that deck-related NCs are closed on time and reported to the DPA.
Açılan defect, bir iş emrine (work order: The defect that has been opened is linked to a work order and tracked until the repair is complete. When the work is finished, the work order is closed by recording the work done, the parts used and the test result. The Third Officer prevents open safety defects from piling up on the "overdue" list.
Ağ switch'i, IP adresleme ve konfigürasy: Network switches, IP addressing and configuration changes must be kept under controlled change management. A switch replacement that looks minor can, without anyone noticing, make both branches dependent on a single device.
Ağır altta, hafif üstte istif ilkesi dev: The principle of heavy at the bottom and light on top reduces the overturning moment. Stack weight and tier limits must not be exceeded; a wrong weight declaration (VGM error) undermines the stowage plan and safety. The lashing plan is verified with software (lashing computer).
Ağır araçlar uygun güverteye/eksene yerl: Heavy vehicles are placed on the appropriate deck and along the right axis; the deck load density is not exceeded. Access and manoeuvring space are kept according to the order of the discharge ports. A vehicle tally is kept.
Ağır hava başladığında Birinci Zabit (Ka: When heavy weather begins, the Chief Officer (with the Master's approval) issues and enforces an order prohibiting or strictly restricting access to the deck. A wave coming on board (boarding sea/green water) can sweep a person overboard instantly. No one goes on the open deck unless it is essential; if it is necessary, they go with a lifeline, lifejacket and a companion.
Ağır hava beklendiğinde, fırtına gelmede: When heavy weather is expected, preparations must be completed before the storm arrives: checking and tightening the lashings, securing deck equipment, hatch covers and weathertight closures dogged, freeing ports (water drainage openings) clear, anchors secured and sounding pipe caps closed. The Second Officer coordinates this checklist with the Chief Officer.
Ağır hava beklentisinde açık güverteler/: When heavy weather is expected, open decks and pools are closed and outdoor activities are stopped. Passengers are warned by announcement and loose items are secured.
Ağır hava ve yük hasarı, çatışma, karaya: Situations such as heavy weather and cargo damage, collision, grounding, damage to shore installations or the berth, dragging anchor, unexpected delay or a dispute over cargo discharge may require a protest. When in doubt, noting a protest on the advice of the P&I Club or the company is the safe course.
Ağır hava, denizciliğin en eski ve en öl: Heavy weather is the oldest and deadliest hazard of seafaring. The Chief Officer's success depends on foreseeing the danger, completing preparations in calm seas, preventing water ingress and cargo shift and, above all, keeping the crew off the deck so that no life is put at risk. A well-prepared ship rides out the storm; an unprepared ship makes the news.
Ağır havada (Beaufort 8 ve üzeri) gemi y: In heavy weather (Beaufort 8 and above) ship handling tactics change: heaving to, scudding, riding it out, seeking shelter. The Master assesses the rolling period and the risks of parametric and synchronous rolling, and alters course and speed according to the GM and the wave period.
Ağır havada (heavy weather) mess servisi: In heavy weather, mess service carries a safety risk: hot food and boiling water can be knocked over by the ship's rolling and cause serious burns. In these conditions, fiddles (table-edge rails) and non-slip mats are used, jugs are only partly filled, hot drinks are carried covered and service is simplified. Personnel move carefully to avoid slipping and falling.
Ağır havada galley operasyonu özel riskt: Galley operation in heavy weather is a particular risk: a pot of boiling liquid tipped over by rolling causes serious burns. In bad weather, range fiddles (pot clamps) are used, pans are only partly filled and high-risk cooking/chopping is reduced. In these conditions, the steward moves more slowly and uses grab rails/handrails.
Ağır havaya girmeden önce rota/hız karar: The decision on course and speed is made before entering heavy weather; late action leads to the loss of containers.
Ağır kaldırmada yük gemi merkezinden uza: In heavy lifting, as the load moves away from the ship's centreline a heeling moment arises; this affects both the ship's stability and the crane's radius. Ballast adjustment and list control are mandatory in heavy lift operations.
Ağır konteynerlerin alt tier'lara, hafif: It is verified that heavy containers are in the lower tiers and light ones on top; the weights declared through the VGM (Verified Gross Mass) are reflected in the plan. Reefer plug positions, IMDG segregation and OOG positions are checked.
Ağır yakıt (HFO) makineye girmeden önce: Before entering the engine, heavy fuel oil (HFO) passes through the settling tank → purifier → service tank chain; water and solid sediment are separated, and the fuel is heated and its viscosity adjusted. The cadet learns why this treatment chain is critical for healthy combustion in the engine.
Ağır yakıt (HFO) purifier öncesi buhar/e: Before the purifier, heavy fuel oil (HFO) is heated by a steam/electric heater to ~98 °C; the correct separation temperature depends on viscosity and density. The heater high temperature alarm and trip circuit are tested regularly; overheating leads to fuel degradation and a safety risk.
Ağır yakıt (HFO), enjeksiyon için uygun: Heavy fuel oil (HFO) is heated in the FO heater (steam/electric) to bring it to the correct viscosity for injection. Overheating leads to fuel degradation, coking and a safety risk; this is why there is a high-temperature alarm and, where necessary, a heater cut-off. The test verifies, by simulating the temperature sensor, that the alarm/cut-off setpoint works correctly.
Ağır yakıt (HFO/RMG) yüksek viskoziteli: Heavy fuel oil (HFO/RMG) has a high viscosity and carries a heavy load of contaminants; it contains cat fines (aluminum-silicon particles), water, sludge and asphaltenes. For this reason, HFO systems are protected by a combination of purifier + booster + fine filter. When dismantling an HFO filter, the Oiler knows that the fuel is heated (60-90°C) and viscous, and that it will solidify as it cools.
Ağır yakıt (HFO/VLSFO) makineye doğru vi: Heavy fuel (HFO/VLSFO) must reach the engine at the correct viscosity; for this reason, heating (heating coils, trace heating) is fitted in the tanks and lines. The Viscotherm/viscosity controller automatically adjusts the temperature to bring the fuel to the optimum viscosity before injection (usually ~12-15 cSt). Incorrect viscosity causes poor atomization and combustion problems.
Ağır yalpa (parametric rolling) lashing: If heavy rolling (parametric rolling) exceeds the lashing forces, the stacks collapse. Weather routing and lashing tightness are managed together.
Ağır/büyük OOG için lashing planı mühend: For heavy or large OOG cargo, the lashing plan is applied on the basis of an engineering calculation and with the approval of the Chief Officer and the Master.
Ağır/büyük parçalar (silindir kapağı, kr: For heavy/large parts (cylinder cover, crank bearing), drydock or a suitable port is planned; crane capacity and manifold/access preparations are assessed in advance. Consumables containing dangerous substances (chemicals, gas cylinders) require IMDG shipping documentation.

Aşinalık sadece bir kutu işaretleme egze: Familiarization is not just a box-ticking exercise; it is the cadet loading a "mental picture" of the ship into memory so as to be able to act independently later. The cadet must reach the level of being able to find the escape route with eyes closed and of knowing where the emergency stop button is.
Aşçı bir arıza/anomali fark ettiğinde (s: When the cook notices a fault/anomaly (noise, smell, temperature deviation, sparks, leak), he or she first puts the equipment in a safe condition (switch off/unplug/warning tag) and reports the situation to the Master/engineer officer. The report includes the equipment, the symptom, when it started and the first action taken. Electrical/mechanical work is left to authorized personnel; the cook does not go beyond his or her area of authority.
Aşçı dışındaki yemek hazırlık personeli: Food preparation personnel other than the cook (mess man, steward) must also receive basic training/familiarization in food hygiene. Records of this training are presented during MLC inspections (PSC or flag State).
Aşçı menü döngüsünü kurarken her öğünü b: When setting up the menu cycle, the cook balances each meal in terms of food groups: main meals include one protein source, one complex carbohydrate, at least two vegetable side dishes and one dessert/fruit. Eggs, bread, cheese, jam, cereals and a hot drink are standard at breakfast. For the night watch (watchkeepers), a "night lunch" (night meal) available 24 hours a day is planned separately; sandwich ingredients, hot soup and snacks are left ready.
Aşçı, denize atımın yalnızca uygun mesaf: The cook knows that discharge to sea is made only at the appropriate distance and under the appropriate conditions, with the approval of and in coordination with the responsible officer; when in port or close to the coast, food waste is not discharged into the sea but stored. Every discharge to sea or delivery ashore is entered in the Garbage Record Book (see the records section).
Aşçı, dondurulmuş ürünleri bir gün önced: The cook moves frozen products to the refrigerator a day in advance for controlled thawing; thawing at room temperature is not done because of the bacterial risk. The thawing plan for meat and fish is carried out a day in advance according to the next day's menu.
Aşçı, dönemsel (aylık) gıda harcamasını: The cook monitors and reports periodic (monthly) food expenditure. Seasonal prices, expensive ports and exchange rate differences affect the budget; postponing non-critical purchases at expensive ports and stocking up at cheap ports is a smart tactic.
Aşçı, dönemsel olarak menü, harcama ve m: The cook periodically reviews menu, expenditure and satisfaction data and makes improvements: adjustments that reduce waste, increase satisfaction and maintain balance. Over time, this continuous improvement cycle raises budget efficiency, crew health and morale. Well-kept records are a valuable reference both during inspections and when planning the next voyage.
Aşçı, düzenli olarak (haftalık) raf tara: The cook regularly (weekly) checks the shelves, moves products nearing their expiry date to the front and includes them in the menu. The difference between "best before" (recommended consumption date) and "use by" (expiry date) is understood: a product past its use-by date is not used, for safety reasons; some durable products past their best-before date may be used after assessment. A product in doubt is thrown away; "if in doubt, throw it out" is the basic rule.
Aşçı, galley ve depo temizliğini (bkz. m: The cook carries out galley and store cleaning (see the galley organization task) as a direct pest prevention measure: "clean as you go", leaving the galley clean/dry at night, transferring opened packets into closed containers. Cardboard packaging (which may carry cockroach eggs) is disposed of quickly; incoming provisions are checked for insects/larvae before entering the stores.
Aşçı, gemi acil durum planındaki (muster: The cook knows his or her fire duty in the ship's emergency plan (muster list) and the escape route from the galley. STCW basic safety training (fire prevention and fire fighting) is mandatory for all seafarers; the cook takes part in the periodic fire drills.
Aşçı, gıda hazırlığında ve içme suyunda: The cook continuously monitors that the water used in food preparation and for drinking is safe; residual chlorine testing, visual/odor/taste checks and supporting sampling are part of this responsibility. In the event of an abnormality (color, odor, low chlorine), the cook immediately alerts the Master and the technical team; if necessary, drinking water is made safe by boiling or by using an alternative (bottled water). Water quality is an essential precondition of food safety.
Aşçı, harcamaları (provision faturaları,: The cook regularly records expenditure (provision invoices, quantities received) and periodically compares it with the budget; if a deviation is spotted early, the menu/orders can be adjusted. These records are reported to the company and presented during inspections. Transparent cost tracking supports budget control and prevents drifting to either extreme of overspending or underfeeding.
Aşçı, her temel kalem için minimum stok: The cook sets a minimum stock level (par level) and a safety buffer for each basic item. In addition to the quantity needed to reach the next provisioning port, several days' "emergency provisions" are kept in case the voyage is delayed. When an item approaches its minimum level, it is added to the order list; it is replenished before it runs out.
Aşçı, hesapladığı eksikleri kategori ve: The cook collects the calculated shortfalls in a requisition list arranged by category and supplier. The list is approved by the Master/chief steward and sent to the ship chandler (ship's supplies provider). The list states the product description, brand/quality, quantity, unit and port of delivery; a vague request leads to wrong deliveries.
Aşçı, kaptan adına bu alanların sürekli: On behalf of the Master, the cook ensures that these areas are always ready for inspection; the principle is continuous order, not "tidying up before the inspection". A nonconformity (deficiency) is one of the MLC breaches that can lead as far as detention of the ship.
Aşçı, menüyü taze ürünlerin bozulma hızı: The cook orders the menu according to how quickly fresh products spoil. The most perishable items (leafy vegetables, strawberries, fresh fish) are planned for the first 3-5 days of the voyage, the moderately durable ones (apples, carrots, cabbage, potatoes, onions) for the middle period, and the most durable ones (canned food, dried pulses, pasta, frozen food) for the end of the voyage. This staging both reduces food waste and makes stock management easier.
Aşçı, mutfak atığının türünü ve yaklaşık: The cook monitors the type and approximate quantity of galley waste and reports the times of delivery/discharge to the responsible officer promptly. This traceability proves the ship's compliance during MARPOL inspections and is the strongest barrier against abuses such as the "magic pipe" and falsified records.
Aşçı, mutfakta atığı kaynağında ayrıştır: The cook segregates waste at source in the galley: food waste, plastics/packaging, glass/metal and used cooking oil go into separate containers. This segregation is mandatory both for MARPOL compliance and for correct disposal; mixed waste (e.g. plastic contaminated with food) is handled according to the most restrictive category and increases the cost/complexity of delivery ashore.
Aşçı, periyodik (genellikle aylık) fizik: The cook carries out a periodic (usually monthly) physical stock count, comparing the records with the actual stock. During the count, expiry dates are checked, the FIFO/FEFO arrangement is renewed and spoiled/swollen cans are removed. This routine is critical both for accurate stock information and for catching hidden spoilage early.
Aşçı, rotasyonu sefer profiline (süre, i: The cook adapts the rotation to the voyage profile (duration, provisioning, climate, crew composition) and keeps fine-tuning it with feedback. A well-designed rotation brings crew satisfaction, budget discipline and nutritional balance together in the same system.
Aşçı, sefer rotasını ve geçilecek özel a: Knowing the voyage route and the special areas to be crossed, the cook plans waste storage capacity: before entering an area with strict rules, waste is delivered ashore or sufficient storage space is set aside. This foresight both guarantees MARPOL compliance and prevents odor/pest pressure in the stores.
Aşçı, yüksek temas yüzeylerini (tezgâh,: The cook frequently disinfects high-touch surfaces (worktops, handles, taps, knives). Cleaning cloths should be single-use or color-coded; the raw meat area and the salad area must not be wiped with the same cloth. Dishes are cleaned either in a dishwasher at high temperature or by the three-stage wash-rinse-disinfect method.
Aşçı; buzdolabı, dondurucu, sıcak tutma: The cook enters refrigerator, freezer, hot-holding and cooking temperatures on daily record forms. These records are evidence of the HACCP "monitoring" and "verification" principles. Thermometers are calibrated regularly (e.g. against iced water at 0°C and a boiling water reference) and a calibration record is kept.
Aşçı; temizlik, görsel kontrol, filtre/c: The cook is responsible for cleaning, visual checks, filter/seal checks, simple adjustments and user-level maintenance. Electrical panels, gas lines, compressors, motors and jobs requiring LOTO (lock out-tag out) fall under the authority of the engine/electrical team. A clear boundary prevents both safety hazards and confusion over authority.
Aşçının asıl ustalığı, \"kaliteli beslen: The cook's real skill is managing "good-quality nutrition" and "budget discipline" together without setting them against each other. Excessive saving leads to inadequate/unhealthy nutrition, while uncontrolled spending leads to budget overruns; the right answer is a balance of the two. This balance is achieved through correct ordering, low waste, choosing economical but good-quality sources, variety and a continuous supply of micronutrients.
Aşçının en değerli bilgi kaynağı mürette: The cook's most valuable source of information is the crew itself. Observation of consumption (which dish runs out, which is left on the plate), one-to-one conversation and the satisfaction surveys/suggestion boxes used on ships feed into menu decisions. The cook reads this feedback not as personal criticism but as data for improving the service, and fine-tunes the menu cycle accordingly.
Aşçının sağlık ve moral katkısı, gemidek: The cook's contribution to health and morale is the least visible but most strongly felt value on board. A well-fed team is more alert, safer and happier; a carefully prepared special-day menu or a surprise favorite dish can ease the tension of a long voyage. By using the plate as a tool for performance and a bridge to morale, the cook becomes the quiet but decisive foundation of both the crew's health and their solidarity.
Aşçının tuttuğu/destek olduğu temel kayı: The main records kept or supported by the cook: drinking water residual chlorine and test logs, potable water tank cleaning/disinfection and calibration records, cold chain (chiller/freezer/store) temperature logs, the food sample record, and cleaning and pest control records. These records are kept regularly, dated and accurately; the rule is real-time recording, not filling them in afterwards in bulk.
Aşçının yetki alanındaki basit bakım: co: Simple maintenance within the cook's authority: cleaning/checking seals, cleaning/replacing filters, deep cleaning, descaling, sharpening/changing blades (under safe conditions), checking thermometer calibration and reporting visibly loose connections. These jobs extend equipment life and prevent sudden breakdowns. Anything outside this authority is reported.
Aşınma hızı (wear rate) mm/1000 saat ola: The wear rate is calculated in mm per 1000 hours.
Aşınma ölçümleri yapılır: impeller-wear: Wear measurements are taken: impeller-to-wear ring clearance, shaft run-out, bearing clearance. The measurements are compared with the OEM tolerances; parts outside the limits are renewed. The cadet grasps the question "why do we measure": a part that looks good may be out of tolerance and cause a loss of performance/efficiency.
Aşırı akım koruma iki ana bileşenden olu: Overcurrent protection consists of two main parts: thermal protection (long-term overload) and magnetic protection (instantaneous short circuit). The thermal element works on the I²t principle; the higher the current, the shorter the tripping time. The magnetic element opens the circuit within milliseconds at short-circuit current (6–12 × In).
Aşırı alarm (alarm flood), operatörü kör: Excessive alarms (alarm flood) blind the operator and hide real danger. The ETO applies alarm rationalization to reduce recurring, meaningless or miscalibration-induced alarms; every alarm must have an associated action, and chattering alarms must be prevented with deadband and delay. The EEMUA 191 principles are the guide.
Aşırı kızartma, ağır ve şekerli öğünler: Excessive frying and heavy, sugary meals cause drowsiness in the short term (postprandial dip) and weight gain, fatigue and health problems in the long term. By balancing the menu so that it gives energy without being heavy, the cook supports watchkeeping performance; he or she offers light but filling options, especially for the night watch.
Aşırı kızartma, doymuş yağ ve şeker yükü: Excessive frying and a high intake of saturated fatty acids and sugar lead in the long term to weight gain, fatigue and health problems among the crew. The cook limits frying and alternates baking, steaming, grilling and boiling. To control salt intake, balanced seasoning during cooking is preferred to extra salt at the table.
Aşırı lokal yük yoğunluğu çift dip yapıs: Excessive local load density can damage the double-bottom structure.
Aşırı motor titreşimi; rulman aşınması,: Excessive motor vibration is a sign of bearing wear, unbalance, misalignment or looseness. The ETO measures the RMS velocity (mm/s) at the bearing points with a vibration analyzer and compares it with the ISO 20816 limits. Spectrum analysis identifies the fault type from the frequency components (1× running speed = unbalance, 2× = misalignment, high frequency = bearing).
Aşırı sagging (boğum çökmesi) durumu, ho: Excessive sagging results from loading heavy cargo in the midship holds + light cargo at the ends. Hogging is the opposite. Both lead to fatigue in the hull and, in the long term, to cracks. On bulk carriers, shear force can reach a critical level during "alternate hold" loading; it is therefore mandatory to keep to the CSR-approved sequence.
Aşırı tension, stabilite limiti, power/t: In the event of excessive tension, a stability limit, power or thruster degradation, or loss of command, the emergency release or abort plan is applied.
Aşırı yük altında halat koparmak yerine: Under excessive load, allowing the winch brake to slip in a controlled way (render) rather than letting the line part protects both the equipment and the people. When the Bosun notices that a line is overloaded (water squeezing out, noise, drum vibration), the Bosun intervenes immediately and, if necessary, warns the bridge: "line overloaded".
Aşırı ısınan yatak oil mist üretir; dete: An overheated bearing produces oil mist; the oil mist detector and the crankcase relief valves protect against an explosion. After an oil mist alarm, the crankcase is not opened until it has cooled down.
Aşırı ısınan yatak yağ buharı (oil mist): An overheated bearing produces oil vapor (oil mist); the oil mist detector and crankcase relief valves protect against explosion. Opening the crankcase after a hot bearing before it has cooled sufficiently carries a risk of explosion.
Aşırı ısıtma kargonun flashpoint'ine yak: Overheating brings the cargo close to its flashpoint and degrades it; the upper temperature limit is monitored.
A₁ (723 °C): the eutectoid transformation temperature; pearlite ↔ austenite transformation. A₃: the temperature at which the ferrite → austenite transformation is completed in hypoeutectoid steels. Acm: the temperature at which cementite dissolves in hypereutectoid steels.
B sınıfı (sıvılar): köpük, CO₂, kuru kim: Class B (liquids): foam, CO₂, dry chemical.
B/L Master/yetkili tarafından imzalanır;: The B/L is signed by the Master or an authorised person; a clean B/L is not signed until the quantity, description and condition have been verified. A wrong or unsigned B/L has serious commercial and legal consequences.
B/L üç temel işlev taşır: (1) yükün beli: The B/L has three basic functions: (1) a receipt showing that the cargo was received in the stated condition and quantity, (2) evidence of the contract of carriage, (3) a negotiable document of title representing delivery of the goods. These three functions make the declaration of the Master who signs the B/L extremely binding.
B/L'de tarih değiştirme (ante/post-datin: Changing the date on a B/L (ante- or post-dating), a false statement of quantity or condition, or issuing a forged document has serious legal consequences and can invalidate insurance cover. Despite commercial pressure, the Master signs only documents that reflect the truth.
BCC (Hacim Merkezli Kübik): α-demir (fer: BCC (body-centred cubic): α-iron (ferrite), stable at low temperature. It may be hard but brittle.
BDN (Bunker Delivery Note) MARPOL Annex: Under MARPOL Annex VI Reg. 18.5, the BDN (Bunker Delivery Note) must be kept on board for at least 3 years and must contain: ship's name/IMO number, port, date of delivery, supplier details, product name, quantity (MT), density@15°C, sulfur content (% m/m) and the supplier's declaration of MARPOL compliance.
BDN doğrulaması: Bunker Delivery Note mi: BDN verification: the quantities in the Bunker Delivery Note are compared with the tank measurements.
The BDN must be kept on board for three years. The fuel sample must be retained for at least 12 months.
BDN şu bilgileri içermelidir: Alıcı gemi: The BDN must contain the following information: the name and IMO number of the receiving ship, the fuel supplier, the quantity (metric tonnes), the density (at 15 °C), the sulphur content (%), the fuel grade (ISO 8217), and the date and port of delivery.
BDN'ler ve MARPOL numuneleri kurala uygu: BDNs and MARPOL samples are retained for the period required by the rules; the time/position of the changeover on entering/leaving an ECA is entered in a separate log. These records are evidence both of MARPOL Annex VI compliance and in fuel disputes.
BNWAS (Bridge Navigational Watch Alarm S: The BNWAS (Bridge Navigational Watch Alarm System) ensures that the officer of the watch is awake and on duty; if it is not reset within a set interval, it alerts the Master and the other officers in stages. The ETO tests the BNWAS timing, the reset sensors and the alarm chain. Correct operation of the bridge alarm panel (machinery, fire, general) is also verified.
BNWAS belirli bir süre (dormant period,: The BNWAS waits for a reset (movement or button) from the officer within a set time (the dormant period, adjustable at about 3–12 minutes). When the time runs out, it first gives an audible and visual warning on the bridge; if the officer still does not respond, an alarm sounds in the cabins of the Master and the back-up officers; finally a general alarm may be given throughout the ship. In this way the officer's condition is safeguarded.
BNWAS modları: Automatic (otopilot/seyir: BNWAS modes: Automatic (activated automatically with the autopilot or when under way), Manual ON (always on) and OFF. Selecting OFF and setting the dormant period are restricted to the Master (password or key protected); the officer cannot switch it off at will. It is usually activated automatically when the ship is under way.
BNWAS özellikle otopilotta (kimse aktif: The BNWAS is particularly important on autopilot (when no one is actively steering), because the risk of falling asleep increases while the officer is passively monitoring. The system can be set to activate automatically when the autopilot is engaged.
BRM (Bridge Resource Management), köprüü: BRM (Bridge Resource Management) is the effective use of all human and technical resources on the bridge. The cadet observes how orders given to the helmsman are repeated (closed-loop communication: "Starboard ten" → "Starboard ten" → "Ten of starboard wheel on") and learns how this discipline prevents misunderstandings. The cadet learns to report a hazard they have noticed to the OOW clearly and without hesitation (challenge and response); hierarchy must not prevent safety information from being shared.
BRM, 1990'lardan itibaren havacılıktaki: From the 1990s, BRM was adapted to bridge operations at sea, inspired by the CRM (Crew Resource Management) model from aviation.
BWM Convention, ballast suyunun aktarıla: To protect the ecosystem of the port to which ballast water is carried, the BWM Convention requires compliance with D-1 (ballast water exchange — in the open sea, >200 nm, >200 m depth) or D-2 (treatment — biological standard achieved with an approved BWMS). Most ships now carry a type-approved BWMS (UV, electrochlorination etc.) for D-2.
BWM Convention, ballast suyuyla taşınan: The BWM Convention prevents invasive species carried in ballast water from spreading into marine ecosystems. There are two ways of complying: D-1 (ballast water exchange — exchange in the open sea, at least 200 nautical miles offshore and in water at least 200 m deep, with 95% volumetric exchange) and D-2 (ballast water treatment — meeting the biological standard with an approved BWMS). The implementation schedule has been completed; modern ships carry a BWMS for D-2.
BWM Convention, geminin ballast suyundak: The BWM Convention makes compliance with the D-2 biological standard mandatory to control invasive organisms in a ship's ballast water. Modern ships are fitted with a type-approved BWMS (UV, electrochlorination, ozone). The Chief Engineer manages the correct operation of the BWMS, sensor calibration and the recording of ballast operations in the BWRB (Ballast Water Record Book).
BWM Convention, geminin ballast water'ın: To protect the ecosystem of the port where the ship discharges its ballast water, the BWM Convention makes compliance with the D-2 biological standard mandatory. Modern ships are fitted with an IMO type-approved BWMS (UV, electrochlorination, ozone etc.). The Chief Officer checks BWMS operation, the sampling port, the BWRB (Ballast Water Record Book) and SDC calibration.
BWM Convention, istilacı türlerin taşınm: To prevent the transfer of invasive species, the BWM Convention introduces the D-1 standard (ballast water exchange) and the final D-2 standard (the ballast water performance standard, met by treatment). Ships are fitted with IMO type-approved BWMS (UV, electrochlorination, ozone). The Ballast Water Record Book records every ballast uptake, discharge and exchange; the Ballast Water Management Plan is specific to the ship.
BWMS arızası veya bypass durumunda conti: If the BWMS fails or is bypassed, the contingency procedure is applied; if a bypass has been made, it is entered in the BWRB and reported to the port authority. An unauthorized bypass leads to heavy sanctions in USCG/PSC inspections.
BWMS arızasında contingency measures (al: If the BWMS fails, contingency measures (alternative port, mid-ocean exchange to D-1 as a temporary measure, shore reception) and notification of the relevant port authority come into play. The USCG in the USA and some ports inspect BWMS compliance strictly and take samples.
BWMS arızasında contingency planı uygula: If the BWMS fails, the contingency plan is applied (alternative method, adjustment of the voyage plan, port notification). If the OWS fails, bilge water is not pumped overboard; holding tank capacity is managed and shore reception is planned. In both cases, the records (BWRB/ORB) are kept complete and the Chief Engineer/company is informed.
BWMS, IMO BWMS Code'a göre tip onaylı ol: The BWMS must be type-approved under the IMO BWMS Code. The port state may take samples from the discharged water and check D-2 compliance. The operating parameters (flow rate, UV or TRO dose) must be kept within the approval limits.
Baca: cyclone/scrubber + sıcaklık sensör: Uptake: cyclone/scrubber + temperature sensor + emission control.
Back-up ECDIS'e ENC ve route senkronize: The ENCs and the route are synchronised to the back-up ECDIS, and check route is run again with the same safety settings. It is verified that the GPS, gyro and log inputs show correctly on both units.
Backup arrangement primary ECDIS arızala: The back-up arrangement must be ready for use the moment the primary ECDIS fails, it must be up to date, and the method of transferring or recreating the passage plan must be known. If the second ECDIS is affected by the same switchboard, GNSS or network failure, its real independence is addressed in the company risk assessment.
Backup thruster kontrolü ve bağımsız joy: The back-up thruster control and the independent joystick path must be separate from the main DP/TCS path. This separation is verified not only on the drawings but also at the level of the physical cable routes and power supplies.
Backwash/operating water sıcaklığı ve di: The backwash/operating water temperature and the discharge temperature are monitored; an abnormal change in temperature points to a preheater or separation problem. A drop in performance (rising filter DP, water/dirt reaching the engine) is indirect evidence of separator inefficiency.
Bakım alanı temiz, aydınlık ve düzenli o: The maintenance area must be clean, well lit and tidy. Dismantled parts are laid out in order on a tray/cloth, oily waste is collected in a suitable container and walkways are not blocked. A disorderly work area creates a risk both of slip/fall accidents and of lost parts/incorrect assembly.
Bakım aralıkları çalışma saati (running: Maintenance intervals may be based on running hours or on the calendar. For example, a purifier requires maintenance "every 2000 hours" or a safety valve "once a year". The PMS generates work orders automatically from running hours entries or as the date advances.
Bakım biten ekipman devreye alınmadan ön: Before equipment that has been maintained is put back into service, it is checked: are all bolts torqued, have the tools been collected (tool count), has the isolation been removed, is the valve line-up correct? The first start (recommissioning) is done under supervision; leaks, vibration, abnormal noise and temperature are monitored.
Bakım desteğinin önemli bir kazanımı, ek: An important gain from assisting with maintenance is learning the correct English/technical names of equipment parts: impeller, gland, bushing, journal, liner, gasket, O-ring, sleeve, key/keyway, circlip. The cadet learns that using the correct term prevents communication errors (such as ordering the wrong part).
Bakım sırasında boya kutuları, tiner, ha: During maintenance, materials such as paint tins, thinner, rope reels and lashing material are temporarily kept on deck. The Bosun ensures that they are stowed lashed (so that they cannot shift at sea), without obstructing passage, and, if they are dangerous substances, properly segregated.
Bakım sırasında geçici olarak inhibit ed: Alarms temporarily inhibited during maintenance must always be re-enabled before switching to UMS mode. The ETO checks the inhibit list regularly; a "forgotten inhibit" is the most common and most dangerous UMS error. Permanent inhibition of critical safety alarms is a class violation.
Bakım sırasında oluşan yağlı bez, kullan: Oily rags, used filters, waste oil and sludge generated during maintenance are collected separately under MARPOL Annex I/V and disposed of properly (burning in the incinerator or delivery ashore in port). The cadet learns the discipline of waste segregation (oily rags, contaminated waste, scrap metal).
Bakım tamamlanınca PMS'te iş emri kapatı: When the maintenance is completed, the work order is closed in the PMS: the work done, spare parts used, values measured and observations are recorded. This record builds up the ship's maintenance history and forms the basis for future failure analysis. The cadet observes the logic of closing a work order.
Bakım yapılan ekipmanın kazara çalıştırı: A system of physical locking and tagging that prevents equipment under maintenance from being started accidentally. A lock can be removed only by the person who fitted it. Isolation of energy sources: electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, thermal.
Bakım öncesi risk değerlendirmesi (risk: A risk assessment and a toolbox talk are held before maintenance: the hazards of the job, the need for isolation, the PPE required and emergency measures are discussed. The cadet attends the toolbox talk, asks questions and understands the allocation of tasks. The principle "think before you start" prevents most maintenance accidents.
Bakım üç temel yaklaşımla ele alınır: re: Maintenance follows three basic approaches: reactive (repair when it fails), preventive (planned maintenance based on time/running hours) and predictive/condition-based (according to the actual condition of the equipment). A modern ship uses all three in balance. While carrying out preventive maintenance, the Third/Fourth Engineer also learns to catch failures early from condition data.
Bakım; APT, mikrofon/ses kanalı kontrolü: Maintenance covers the APT, checks of the microphones and audio channels, correct recording of the sensor inputs (radar, GPS, gyro), the condition of the capsule, the battery (reserve power) and the expiry date of the float-free HRU.
Bakım; O₂ analizör kalibrasyonu, scrubbe: Maintenance covers calibration of the O₂ analyser, cleaning of the scrubber and demister, testing the deck seal level and the non-return valve, and checking the blowers and P/V valves.
Bakım; alarm kademelerinin fonksiyon tes: Maintenance covers function testing of the alarm stages, the motion sensors and reset button, the cabin alarm speakers and the power supply. The test verifies that the real chain of stages (bridge → cabins → ship) works.
Bakım; basınç göstergesi (manometre) kon: Maintenance covers checking the pressure gauge, the integrity of the seal and pin, weighing (CO₂), checking the hose, nozzle and extinguisher shell for corrosion, and periodic pressure testing (hydrostatic test) and recharging. Each unit is labelled and recorded.
Bakım; batarya son kullanma tarihi, self: Maintenance covers the battery expiry date, the self-test (test mode near a radar), checks of the casing and watertightness, and the bracket. The test is carried out with the maker's test procedure without a real SAR transmission.
Bakım; bowl/disc seti sökme-temizleme, c: Maintenance covers dismantling and cleaning the bowl and disc stack, renewing seals (O-rings), checking the gearbox and friction clutch, testing the water seal and monitoring vibration. Regular cleaning maintains the separation efficiency.
Bakım; brülör temizliği, gauge glass pur: Maintenance covers burner cleaning, gauge glass blow-through, safety valve testing, cleaning of the water side and the gas side, checking the refractory (firebrick) and soot blowing/water washing of the EGE. The safety valve set pressure is verified regularly.
Bakım; brülör temizliği, refraktör (ateş: Maintenance covers cleaning the burner, checking the refractory (firebrick), removing ash and checking the uptake, the fan and the temperature sensors.
Bakım; coalescer eleman temizlik/değişim: Maintenance covers cleaning or renewing the coalescer elements, cleaning and calibrating the glass/sensor of the 15 ppm monitor, function testing the three-way valve and checking the feed pump. Records of monitor tests and calibration are kept.
Bakım; conta esneklik/değişim, compressi: Maintenance covers the elasticity and renewal of the packing, straightness of the compression bars, cleaning of the drain non-return valves, cleat adjustment, wheels and rails, and the hydraulics. Packing that has taken a permanent set is renewed.
Bakım; conta esnekliği/yırtık kontrolü,: Maintenance covers the elasticity of the packing and checks for tears, the straightness of the compression bars, cleaning of the drain valves, the operation of the cleats, the condition of the wheels and rails, and the hydraulic system. When the packing has taken a permanent set, tightness is lost and the packing must be renewed.
Bakım; davit winch/fren, tel halat (fall: Maintenance covers the davit winch and brake, wear and the renewal period of the falls, the release mechanism and hydrostatic interlock, the engine and battery, hull integrity and the expiry dates of the equipment. The falls are turned end for end or renewed at set intervals.
Bakım; dedektör fonksiyon testi (test ga: Maintenance covers function testing of the detectors (test gas or heat source), cleaning off contamination, testing the manual call points, the panel batteries and back-up power, and checking the flow in the sample lines. Each detector tested is recorded, and the system is re-activated after maintenance.
Bakım; eductor nozul/aşınma, yıkama maki: Maintenance covers the eductor nozzles and wear, the washing machines, ODME calibration and checking the level and interface measurement of the slop tank.
Bakım; filtre temizlik/değişim, soğutucu: Maintenance covers cleaning or changing filters, refrigerant charge and leak checks, cleaning the drain pans, the fans and belts, damper movement and checking thermostats and sensors. Refrigerant gas leaks matter for the environment (F-gas) and for efficiency.
Bakım; hidrofor hava yastığı kontrolü, p: Maintenance covers checking the hydrophore air cushion, setting the pressure switch, the pump and non-return valves, the calorifier anode and element, tank cleaning and disinfectant dosing. Water samples are tested regularly.
Bakım; hidrolik sistem (sızıntı/basınç),: Maintenance covers the hydraulic system (leaks, pressure), locks and hinge pins, the condition of the seals, the indication sensors and the drain non-return valves. It is tested regularly that the indication system works correctly (that it does not give a false "closed").
Bakım; hidrolik yağ seviyesi/analizi, sı: Maintenance covers the hydraulic oil level and analysis, leak checks, ram or vane seals, the rudder stock bearing and carrier bearing, the feedback linkage and the safety and limit settings. Regular testing and alarm checks are mandatory.
Bakım; kompresör supap/segman, intercool: Maintenance covers compressor valves and piston rings, the intercooler and aftercooler, dryer elements and regeneration, automatic drains, safety valve testing and internal inspection and draining of the air receivers. Insufficient draining leads to moisture build-up.
Bakım; köpük konsantresi periyodik anali: Maintenance covers periodic analysis of the foam concentrate (deterioration, sedimentation), testing the proportioner and monitors, blowing through the lines, and checking the tank level and the expiry date. If the concentrate ages, its extinguishing efficiency falls.
Bakım; mekanik salmastra (mechanical sea: Maintenance covers mechanical seals or gland packing, impeller wear rings, bearings and lubrication, alignment and vibration, and cleaning of strainers. A leaking mechanical seal is dealt with early.
Bakım; mekanik salmastra ve sızdırmazlık: Maintenance covers mechanical seals and sealing (cofferdam monitoring), bearings, the hydraulic system oil and pressure (Framo), manifold valves and wear rings. Pump room gas detectors and the bilge alarm are tested regularly.
Bakım; motor tarafında supap/enjektör/ya: Maintenance covers valves, injectors, oil and filters on the engine side, and insulation resistance (megger), bearings and brushes/diodes (if fitted) on the alternator side. Regular test runs and protection relay tests are carried out.
Bakım; motor/su jeti çalıştırma testi, y: Maintenance covers running tests of the engine or waterjet, fuel and battery, the pressure and condition of the inflatable tubes (RIB), the davit winch and constant-tension system, and the release and equipment. The boat is always kept ready for quick launching.
Bakım; otomatik filtre geri yıkama (back: Maintenance covers automatic filter backflushing and element checks, UV lamp life and transparency or electrochlorination cell cleaning, TRO and sensor calibration, and monitoring of flow and pressure. A sensor failure can invalidate the compliance record.
Bakım; pompa otomatik start testi, basın: Maintenance covers testing the automatic start of the pump, the air cushion and level of the pressure tank, testing the section valves and flow switches, visual checks of the heads (paint, damage) and checking water mist nozzles for blockage. The heads must not be painted or obstructed.
Bakım; quick closing valf test (kapanma: Maintenance covers testing (verifying closure) and resetting the quick-closing valves, testing the emergency stop circuits, and checking damper movement and tightness.
Bakım; radar/float verici kalibrasyonu,: Maintenance covers calibration of the radar and float transmitters, alarm function tests, checking the UTI tape and sensor, and the tightness of the vapour lock valves. Automatic and manual readings are compared regularly.
