Bakım; soğutucu şarj ve kaçak kontrolü,: Maintenance covers refrigerant charge and leak checks, the compressor oil level, cleaning the condenser (seawater side), the defrost function, door seals and thermostats. Refrigerant gas leaks matter for the environment and for efficiency.
Bakım; steam trap test/temizlik, kondens: Maintenance covers testing and cleaning the steam traps, watching for oil in the condensate observation tank, the feed pump and line tightness, the insulation and water chemistry. The condensate return (recovery) rate is monitored; a fall is a sign of a leak.
Bakım; supap (suction/discharge) temizli: Maintenance covers cleaning the suction and discharge valves, wear of piston rings and liners, cleaning the intercooler and aftercooler, safety valve testing and checking the automatic drains and the unloader. The air receivers are inspected internally and drained regularly.
Bakım; supap klerans ayarı, enjektör tes: Maintenance covers setting valve clearances, testing injectors, measuring piston ring and liner wear, checking bearing clearances, cleaning the turbocharger and coolers and changing oil and fuel filters. The PMS is applied according to running hours.
Bakım; tel halat tel kopması/aşınma kont: Maintenance covers checking wire ropes for broken wires and wear, the bearings of blocks and sheaves, the hook safety latch, the hydraulic system and testing the overload cut-out. The wire rope discard criteria (broken wires, reduction in diameter) are applied strictly.
Bakım; tüp basıncı kontrolü ve dolum, ma: Maintenance covers checking and refilling cylinder pressure, mask tightness and cleaning, function testing of the regulator, checking seals and straps, and following the EEBD expiry dates. A used SCBA cylinder is refilled at once; the equipment is always kept charged and ready.
Bakım; tüp tartımı/seviye (CO₂ kaybı tes: Maintenance covers weighing the cylinders or checking the level (to detect loss of CO₂), testing the pilot line and valves (without discharging gas), testing the alarm and time delay, checking nozzles and pipes for blockage and function testing the release cabinet. The cylinders are subject to periodic pressure tests.
Bakım; yıkama makinesi dişli/nozul kontr: Maintenance covers checking the gears and nozzles of the washing machines, pressure testing the lines, calibrating the O₂ analyser and checking the drain lines. It is verified periodically that the machines sweep all surfaces.
Bakıma başlamadan önce gereken tüm takım: Before maintenance starts, all the tools, spare parts, gasket/O-ring sets, cleaning materials and sealing elements required are prepared. The cadet learns to recognize the right tool: torque wrench, hammer, puller, feeler gauge, micrometer, dial gauge, Allen key/socket sets. Using the wrong tool harms both the job and the operator.
Bakımda CIP kimyasalları kullanılırsa SD: If CIP chemicals are used during maintenance, PPE according to the SDS is essential.
Bakımda valf plakaları, yaylar ve segman: During maintenance, the valve plates, springs and piston rings are inspected for wear, the intercooler/aftercooler is cleaned and the relief valve setting is verified. The air receiver (bullet) is opened periodically, drained and checked for internal corrosion; the air bottle survey is a class requirement.
Bakımsız bir purifier, su/partikül geçiş: A poorly maintained purifier lets water/particles pass through and leads to wear in the engine fuel system. A well-maintained separator directly protects the fuel quality and, through it, the health of the main engine.
Balast değişimi geminin stabilitesini ve: Ballast exchange must not endanger the ship's stability or structural integrity.
Balast operasyonu yükleme/tahliye planıy: Ballast operations are carried out in step with the loading/discharge plan; in the intermediate stages draft, trim and strength limits are monitored with the loading computer. The ballast water management requirements and records apply in addition.
Balast pompaları genellikle santrifüj ti: Ballast pumps are usually centrifugal and connected to the tanks through the main ballast line. The valves are mostly remotely operated by hydraulics or pneumatics; the indication on the mimic panel may not always match the actual valve position, so during critical operations it is verified locally.
Balast suyu; yüksüz/kısmen yüklü gemide: Ballast water is taken on or discharged on a light or partly loaded ship for draft, trim, stability, hull strength (hull stress) and propeller immersion. But this water contains organisms from the port where it was taken on and carries them to where it is discharged. The BWM Convention aims to prevent this biological pollution.
Ballast alımı/değişimi BWTS aktif şekild: Ballast is taken on or exchanged with the BWTS in operation, in compliance with the D-2 standard; the operation is recorded in the Ballast Water Record Book (BWRB).
Ballast alırken/basarken kademeli soundi: When ballasting/deballasting, changes in trim and list are monitored by soundings at intervals; a sudden change is a sign of a valve fault or a wrong line-up. Operation records (start/finish levels, pump running time, quantity) are kept.
Ballast değişimi veya yakıt transferinde: During ballast exchange or fuel transfer, the Chief Officer avoids having more than one wide tank slack at the same time and fills/empties the tanks one after another. This keeps both the free surface and the list/trim deviations during transfer under control.
Ballast operasyonu, yük operasyonuyla se: The ballast operation is planned in step with the cargo operation: ballast is pumped out (deballasting) as cargo comes on board and taken in as cargo is discharged, so that draft, trim, GM and strength stay within limits at all times. The Chief Officer matches the ballast pumping rate to the loading rate and verifies the draft at each stage.
Ballast tanklarında biriken sediment (ça: Sediment (mud) accumulating in ballast tanks may harbor invasive species; periodic sediment removal and disposal are planned under the BWMP. Entry into a tank is made with an enclosed space entry permit; atmosphere testing (O2/LEL/H2S) and standby personnel are mandatory.
Ballast ve bilge sistemleri, hem geminin: Ballast and bilge systems are zero-tolerance areas, both for the safety of the ship (stability, underwater integrity) and for environmental compliance (BWM and 15 ppm). The Third/Fourth Engineer's work is built on correct line-ups, verified valve positions, working automatic safeguards and complete records. Every shortcut taken here comes back either as a pollution fine or as a flooding incident.
Ballast, bilge, FO/DO/LO ve FW tankların: The levels of ballast, bilge, FO/DO/LO and FW tanks are monitored by daily soundings. Manual measurement is done with a sounding tape + dip paste (to distinguish water from oil) and is cross-checked against automatic gauging (pneumercator, radar, capacitive). A discrepancy indicates a sensor fault or a line/valve leak.
Ballast, bilge, transfer, FO/LO servis p: The discharge pressure, sealing (gland/seal), vibration and bearing temperature of the ballast, bilge, transfer and FO/LO service pumps are checked. It is verified that auto-start of the standby pumps is enabled.
Ballast/bilge santrifüj pompaları suctio: Ballast/bilge centrifugal pumps cannot prime when there is air on the suction side; therefore a self-priming arrangement or a priming pump is used. Insufficient NPSH (Net Positive Suction Head) causes cavitation; cavitation produces noise, vibration and impeller erosion. At low tank levels, an eductor (jet pump) is used for stripping (removing the last of the water); the eductor driving water pressure must be sufficient.
Baltık Denizi, Kuzey Denizi, Kuzey Ameri: The Baltic Sea, the North Sea, the North American coasts (200 nm), the United States Caribbean Sea area and (since 1 May 2025) the Mediterranean Sea are designated as SOx ECAs.
Band freni (brake band), gypsy'nin dış k: The band brake is a brake band that wraps around the outer rim of the gypsy and is tightened with a handwheel. It is the main static element that holds the ship at anchor. The clutch engages and disengages the gypsy and the drive shaft. The chain stopper (devil's claw / guillotine) locks the chain mechanically once anchoring is complete and takes the load off the windlass.
Bar check: Transducer altına bilinen der: Bar check: the echo sounder is calibrated by lowering a metal plate to a known depth below the transducer.
Bara sistemi bakır veya alüminyum iletke: The busbars are made of copper or aluminium conductors. A single busbar or a split busbar arrangement is used.
Barometredeki kararlı düşüş, uzun periyo: A steady fall of the barometer, long-period swell, unusual cloud systems and wind that departs from the normal pattern are the classic signs of an approaching TRS. The Second Officer combines instrumental data (official warnings) with these natural signs.
Base cell, new edition ve incremental up: The sequence of base cells, new editions and incremental updates, permit validity, the update log and rejections, and presentation library/software compatibility are checked together. Updates are applied as they are issued by the official service; although most services use a weekly package, "pressing a button once a week" is not the only evidence that the charts are up to date.
Basınç genellikle 7-18 bar ile sınırlıdı: The pressure is generally limited to 7–18 bar and the steam raising rate is low. It is widely used as the auxiliary boiler and as the exhaust gas economiser.
Basınç tankı (pressure vessel): membran: Pressure tank (pressure vessel): membrane type; 100–500 L volume, the air cushion reduces how often the pump starts and stops.
Basınç/vakum (P/V) valfleri tankı aşırı: Pressure/vacuum (P/V) valves protect the tank against overpressure and vacuum. The P/V breaker (liquid-filled safety device) gives the last protection for the main line. The low inert gas pressure alarm and the automatic blower stop protect the integrity of the system.
Basınçlı hava cilde enjekte olabilir; ba: Compressed air can be injected into the skin; during maintenance the system is depressurised and isolated.
Basınçlı hidrolik kaçağı cilt altına enj: A pressurised hydraulic leak can inject oil under the skin; the pressure is released before maintenance.
Basınçlı hidrolik kaçağı yaralanma yapar: A pressurised hydraulic leak can cause injury; the pressure is released before maintenance.
Basınçlı sistem ve yapısal (structural): Welding on pressure systems and structural welding require an authorized/certified welder and generally class approval; the Fitter knows this limit and does not go beyond their authority. In critical repairs, weld quality may be verified by NDT (non-destructive testing).
Basınçlı sistemde flanş/cıvata gevşetmed: In a pressurised system, the equipment is isolated and the pressure released before any flange or bolt is slackened. Suitable PPE is used for chemical (acid) cleaning, and the work is followed by neutralisation and thorough rinsing. The condition of the anodes and coating on the seawater side is checked regularly.
Batarya terminalleri korozyona (sülfat b: Battery terminals are prone to corrosion (sulfate buildup); the ETO keeps the terminals clean, tight and protected with protective jelly (petrolatum). A loose or corroded connection creates high resistance, heating and voltage drop. The charger's output voltage and current must suit the battery type (float/boost/equalize) and be temperature-compensated.
Batarya yönetimi, \"iyi görünen ama çökm: Battery management requires constant vigilance against the "looks fine but has collapsed" trap: the real value of a battery is the capacity it can deliver when needed. The ETO's success is measured by proving reliability through regular capacity tests, managing hydrogen and Li-ion risks with safety discipline, and making sure that this silent reserve really comes on line at a critical blackout or GMDSS moment.
Batarya şarj cihazı, doğru voltaj/akım p: The battery charger must provide the correct voltage/current profile (float, boost, equalize) and apply temperature compensation. Overcharging leads to excessive gassing, water loss and plate corrosion; undercharging leads to sulfation and loss of capacity. The ETO measures the charger's output voltage/current and verifies that it suits the battery type.
Battery autonomy/capacity testi planlı p: The battery autonomy and capacity test is carried out under a planned procedure and weak cells are trended. After a bypass, two people verify that the system has returned to its normal redundant configuration.
Battery charger'ın çalıştığı ve aküyü ta: It is verified that the battery charger is working and keeping the batteries fully charged. Automatic (uninterrupted) changeover to the reserve battery when main power is lost is tested; during the changeover, the equipment must not reset and the listening watch must not be interrupted.
Bauxite yükü TML'in üzerinde yüklendi, V: The bauxite cargo was loaded above its TML, and the ship capsized off Vietnam. 18 dead. Lesson: do not trust the shipper's TML declaration blindly; carry out a can test and, if necessary, refuse to load.
Bayrak devleti idaresi (Flag State) ve k: Communication with the flag state administration (Flag State) and the class society (ABS, DNV, LR, BV, ClassNK, etc.) concerns the validity of certificates, survey planning, condition reports, casualty reports and deficiencies. In a serious accident the Master makes the mandatory casualty report to the flag state under SOLAS I/21 and MARPOL. This report later forms the basis of the MAIB/IMO casualty investigation.
Bayrak devleti veya akredite doğrulayıcı: The flag state or an accredited verifier audits the DCS and MRV reports. Non-compliance: if data is missing, figures are inconsistent or documents are lacking, the ship cannot obtain an SoC.
Bayrak devleti, SOLAS Chapter I gereğinc: Under SOLAS Chapter I, the flag state confirms with certificates that the ship complies with the international conventions; it often delegates this authority to a Recognized Organization (RO — e.g. a class society). Statutory surveys produce convention certificates such as the IOPP, SafCon, SafEquip, ISSC and SMC. Class surveys, on the other hand, check the structural integrity of the ship and the compliance of the machinery and equipment with the class rules, and maintain the Class Certificate.
Bayrak devletleri giderek elektronik kay: Flag states increasingly allow electronic record books (e-OLB, e-ORB); the 2020 amendments to MARPOL formally recognised the use of electronic record books. In a digital system, too, an unalterable audit trail, time stamps and identification of the authorised user are essential. The Master confirms that the system is approved (type-approved) and can produce a legible printout at an inspection.
Bazen en güvenli karar, fırtınanın geçme: Sometimes the safest decision is to reduce speed and wait for the storm to pass (heave to / riding out), or to alter the route and pass ahead of or behind the system. The Second Officer presents the balance between ETA pressure and safety clearly to the Master; commercial pressure must never take precedence over safety.
Bazı bakımlar makine durdurularak yapılı: Some maintenance is done with the engine stopped; it is therefore planned in line with the voyage/port schedule. The Third/Fourth Engineer prepares their own jobs for these windows (parts, tools and permits ready), so that downtime is kept to a minimum.
Bazı bakımlar takvim bazlıdır (yıllık, 2: Some maintenance is calendar-based (annual, every 2.5 years) and independent of running hours. The class survey schedule is binding.
Bazı batarya odalarında H₂ gaz dedektörü: Some battery rooms have an H₂ gas detector; the ETO checks its calibration and alarm. All electrical equipment in the room (lighting, fan motor, switches) must be of ignition-free / ex-proof type. The ETO periodically inspects the integrity of the room, the ventilation openings and the spill (acid/electrolyte) collection arrangement.
Bazı bölgelerde (tropikal limanlar) sivr: In some regions (tropical ports), mosquitoes can be vectors of diseases such as malaria/dengue; the ship is expected to eliminate standing water (pools, open containers) and, if necessary, to apply vector control. IHR 2005 requires ships to be kept free of vectors; these points are checked during port health authority inspections. The cook does not leave standing water or open pools in food/water areas.
Bazı bölgelerde GNSS spoofing nedeniyle: In some regions, GNSS spoofing caused ships' positions to be reported incorrectly; ECDIS showed a false position. Lesson: the ETO must make sure that the backups for GNSS-independent position checking (radar fix, gyro + log dead reckoning) are working, and must support the bridge team so that they do not depend on a single position source.
Bazı durumlarda B/L'yi acente \"for and: In some cases the agent signs the B/L "for and on behalf of the Master"; this authority may be used only with the approval of the Master/company and within the instructions given. The Master is responsible for the accuracy of documents signed on his or her behalf.
Bazı düzeltmeler manuel çizilemeyecek ka: Some corrections are too extensive to be drawn by hand; in this case the NtM issues a printed "block correction" (a self-adhesive or cut-and-paste piece of chart). The Second Officer cuts out this block carefully, positions it according to the alignment marks (register marks) and pastes it onto the chart, then enters it in the log.
Bazı ekipmanlar (otomasyon, purifier, öz: Some equipment (automation, purifiers, special pumps, BWMS) requires manufacturer-specific knowledge. The Second Engineer coordinates access to the vendor manuals and training, and makes sure that the team uses the equipment correctly and does not damage it through incorrect intervention.
Bazı gemilerde onaylı incinerator (yakma: Some ships have an approved incinerator or other processing equipment; however, incinerating food waste and oil is subject to the equipment's approval and to emission rules (linked to MARPOL Annex VI), and not every type of waste can be incinerated. The cook applies the methods permitted by the ship's garbage management plan; no unauthorized incineration is carried out. When in doubt, the waste is stored and the matter is coordinated with the responsible officer.
Bazı gemilerde sludge'ı daha da konsantr: Some ships have a separate sludge separator/decanter that concentrates the sludge further; by reducing the oil content of the liquid discharged, it reduces the volume to be disposed of. The separated sludge goes to the sludge tank under MARPOL Annex I and is burned in the incinerator or delivered ashore. Under no circumstances is it discharged into the sea.
Bazı gemilerde wire + sentetik tail komb: Some ships use a wire + synthetic tail combination; the tail offsets the stiffness of the wire and absorbs the dynamic load. The Bosun checks that the MBL of the tail is compatible with the wire (usually 125-150% of the wire's MBL) and that the connecting shackle/cow hitch is sound. A worn tail increases the risk of parting.
Bazı işler tek kişiyle yapılamaz: workin: Some jobs cannot be done by one person: working aloft requires a standby person at deck level, enclosed space entry a standby person plus atmosphere testing, and overside work a lookout ready for MOB. The Bosun sets the team size according to the minimum safe number of personnel for the job; risky work is not started with too few people.
Bazı kalibrasyonlar gemide (gaz dedektör: Some calibrations can be done on board (gas detector bump test/calibration, multimeter comparison), while others require a certified external service or a shore laboratory. For those that can be done on board, the ETO stocks calibrators/reference gas cylinders and also keeps track of their expiry dates.
Bazı lekeler (kan, çay/kahve, yağ, mürek: Some stains (blood, tea/coffee, oil/grease, ink) do not come out in a normal wash; pre-treatment is required. The type of stain is identified and the appropriate pre-treatment is applied: protein-based stains (blood) are treated with cold water, because hot water coagulates the protein and sets the stain. Oil-based stains, on the other hand, need pre-treatment and a higher temperature.
Bazı liman devletleri (örn. USCG) veya t: Some port States (e.g. USCG) or terminals may request a D&A inspection. The Third Officer coordinates the process during these inspections and presents the records of the ship's program. A ready and well-organized program gets through these inspections without problems.
Bazı limanlar pahalı veya kaliteli tedar: Some ports are expensive or lack good-quality supply. The cook bridges these ports by stocking up on durable items at the previous cheap/good port. Forward planning requires anticipating the provisioning opportunities along the route.
Bazı limanlarda exchange/treatment belir: In some ports, exchange/treatment must be carried out at specified coordinates or at a specified depth; records are kept with GPS position and time stamp. PSC cross-checks the records against the actual situation.
Bazı modern sistemlerde (ALCAP gibi) pur: In some modern systems (such as ALCAP) the purifier/clarifier function is handled automatically; no gravity disc change is needed.
Bazı modern sistemlerde air seal veya em: Some modern systems are fitted with an air seal or emergency seal arrangement; if the aft seal fails, it temporarily stops water ingress and buys time until drydock. The Chief Engineer knows whether these emergency arrangements are fitted and how they work.
Bazı yüklerde \"kargo terlemesi\" (cargo: With some cargoes, "cargo sweat" and "ship sweat" cause moisture damage; hold ventilation is opened or closed according to the dew point difference. This decision is the officer's; the AB carries out the physical work, such as opening/closing ventilator flaps and running the ventilation fans, and helps with the records.
Bazı şirketler ve ekipler, dinlenme hesa: Some companies and crews check rest on clock-change days on a UTC basis, to make sure the rest-hour calculations are correct. When preparing the plan, the Second Officer verifies on the schedule that every watchkeeper still has 10 hours of rest in 24 hours after the change; if there is a clash, the change must be moved to another watch or split over two days.
Bağlama operasyonunda halatlar geminin t: In a mooring operation, the lines carry the forces generated by the ship's entire tonnage; when a line is loaded close to its MBL, hundreds of kJ of energy are stored in it. When this line parts, the energy is released like a whip, creating the lethal recoil known as "snap-back". A rotating winch drum, a confined working area, a wet deck and restricted visibility increase the risk.
Bağlama ve manevra, Usta Gemici'nin en g: Mooring and maneuvering is the AB's most visible but most dangerous duty. A line sent out in the right order, a correctly set winch brake and a disciplined seaman standing outside the recoil zone: each of these saves a limb, a life. Mooring is routine, but carelessness within the routine is fatal; the AB must take every maneuver as seriously as on the first day.
Bağlama ve manevra, denizciliğin en eski: Mooring and maneuvering is one of the oldest, yet still one of the deadliest, operations at sea. The Bosun's disciplined leadership at the station — clear orders, correct technique, snap-back awareness and an unshakeable "safety first" attitude — keeps the crew alive and the ship safe. At this station, the smallest slackness is paid for at the highest price.
Bağlama ve manevra, sakin görünen ama bi: Mooring and maneuvering are operations that look calm but can turn lethal in an instant. The Chief Officer succeeds through a clear plan, a disciplined briefing, the right equipment and by instilling in the team a culture of "stay clear of a line under tension".
Bağlama, gemideki en tehlikeli operasyon: Mooring is one of the most dangerous operations on board. A drilled team, clear communication, keeping out of snap-back zones and wearing gloves and a hard hat are essential. While a line is under tension, no one should step over it or stand in a bight.
Bağlama/çözme manevralarında stajyer, ba: During mooring/unmooring maneuvers, the cadet works at the forward or aft station alongside the officer in charge (mooring officer). Radio communication (UHF) between the bridge and the station must be clear and closed-loop: "Heave away on the head line" → repeat back → execute. The cadet learns how the heaving line, the messenger line and the order of sending and receiving lines are managed.
Bağlamada çelik tel, yüksek modüllü sent: Steel wire, high-modulus synthetic (HMPE/Dyneema) and polyester/nylon ropes are used for mooring. Elongation and snap-back energy vary with the material; nylon is elastic but stores a lot of snap-back energy, while HMPE stretches little and is light.
Bağlantı, transfere başlamadan önce test: Before transfer starts, the connection is tested and all flanges are watched for leaks. If there is a leak, the pressure is released and the gasket/bolts are corrected.
Bağlantı; ya gemi generator'ları durduru: The connection is made either by stopping the ship's generators and making a dead-bus transfer or, in modern systems, without interruption by shore-to-ship synchronizing. The ETO verifies the protection settings of the shore breaker, the earthing connection and the shore/ship interlock.
Bağlantıdan önce manifold flanşları, con: Before connection, the manifold flanges, gaskets, bolts and drip tray are inspected visually. The correct manifold is selected for the parcel to be handled; unused manifolds are closed with blank (blind) flanges with the full number of bolts. Spill containment (drip trays) and scupper plugs must be in place.
Bağımsız surveyor (bunker surveyor) atan: An independent bunker surveyor is appointed to verify the measurements of both parties. The temperature correction, tank calibration tables and trim/list effects are checked.
Baş Mühendis ayrıca sabah, gece boyunca: In the morning, the Chief Engineer also reviews what happened during the night and gives feedback if necessary; this cycle continuously improves night operations.
Baş Mühendis bu akışların her biri için: The Chief Engineer manages the correct equipment, the correct record book and the correct disposal route for each of these streams. Each stream has its own record book, and these are cross-checked during inspections.
Baş Mühendis bu döngüyü bir disiplin ola: The Chief Engineer runs this cycle as a discipline; late or incomplete reports lead to wrong decisions ashore and wasted resources. Reports are prepared in a standard format with correct data.
Baş Mühendis bu trendleri aylık raporda: The Chief Engineer plots these trends in the monthly report and explains any deviations. Oil consumption is not only a cost; it is also an important indicator of machinery health.
Baş Mühendis değişiminde (handover), açı: At a change of Chief Engineer (handover), open requisitions, expected deliveries, critical stock status and actual budget spending are handed over in a written handover note. The incoming Chief Engineer takes over by comparing the physical stock with the PMS record; any discrepancies found are recorded at handover.
Baş Mühendis değişiminde detaylı bir han: At a change of Chief Engineer, a detailed handover report is prepared: main engine condition, open work orders, critical spare parts stock, survey schedule, outstanding problems and notes on crew competence. This continuity ensures that department performance is maintained independently of individuals.
Baş Mühendis gece talimatları, küçük bir: The Chief Engineer's night orders are a small document but a major safety tool. Clear thresholds, clear limits of authority and a strong "if in doubt, call" culture stop preventable failures from growing in the quiet hours of the night. Good night orders are an invisible lookout that carries the Chief Engineer's experience and priorities through the night.
Baş Mühendis için drill senaryosu: emerg: Drill scenario for the Chief Engineer: starting the emergency generator, paralleling the main generators, closing the bus-tie, the main engine restart sequence, restoration of navigation and communication services. The annual dead ship drill must be recorded.
Baş Mühendis için en güçlü kanıt, sürekl: For the Chief Engineer, the strongest evidence is a continuously and honestly kept log book and ECR decision log. Abnormal observations, interventions made, spare parts used, measurements taken and decisions made are recorded in writing. This discipline is the only documentation that protects the ship in survey, vetting, PSC and insurance processes.
Baş Mühendis için ilk adımlar: emergency: The Chief Engineer's first steps: confirm that the emergency generator is on line, determine the cause of the main generator stop (fuel, contamination, cooling, governor, breaker trip), check the preferential trip status and re-energize the main busbar.
Baş Mühendis için temel ilke: \"kayıtla: The basic principle for the Chief Engineer: "the record must match reality exactly". A bypass line (magic pipe), manipulation of records or tricking the 15 ppm equipment is never acceptable. Even if equipment fails, correct recording and proper disposal (shore reception) are the only right course.
Baş Mühendis'in onayı sadece bir tıklama: The Chief Engineer's approval is not just a click but a quality gate: if a measured value is illogical, there are no photographs or the remarks are empty, the job is sent back. This discipline is the guarantee that the PMS is carried out "on site, not on paper".
Baş Mühendis, AB sularındaki bu ek gerek: The Chief Engineer integrates these additional requirements in European Union waters into the changeover plan and adjusts fuel management according to the length of the port stay.
Baş Mühendis, CAP'in teknik içeriğini (h: The Chief Engineer prepares the technical content of the CAP (speed profile, hull/propeller cleaning, energy efficiency investments) and manages its implementation. The CAP must not be just a document; it must be a workable action plan.
Baş Mühendis, FONAR'a yol açan koşulları: The Chief Engineer carefully documents the conditions that led to the FONAR (bunker planning, efforts to obtain fuel). A FONAR is not a routine way out but is for genuine exceptions; misuse results in sanctions.
Baş Mühendis, ORB kayıtlarını oil monito: The Chief Engineer cross-checks the ORB entries against the oil monitor log, sludge soundings, incinerator hours, shore disposal receipts and tank levels. All these records must be consistent. The Chief Engineer carries out this reconciliation personally before an inspection; if there is an inconsistency, it is disclosed and corrected rather than hidden.
Baş Mühendis, OWS her çalıştırıldığında:: Every time the OWS is run, the Chief Engineer supervises the operator, matches the oil monitor record with the ORB, and verifies the overboard discharge time and the position. If the OWS is defective, the bilge water is delivered ashore; "bypass because of a defect" is never an option.
Baş Mühendis, PMS kayıtlarının sahaya ya: The Chief Engineer confirms that the PMS records reflect reality on site through regular "walk-around" inspections. Whether a job marked as completed has actually been done can be seen from the cleanliness of the equipment, new seals/gaskets, the oil color, the condition of the safety wires on bolts/nuts and the general condition. This inspection sends the team the message that "falsified records will be noticed".
Baş Mühendis, PMS sağlığını sayısal göst: The Chief Engineer reports the health of the PMS to the office with numerical indicators. These are the total numbers of due/completed/overdue jobs, overdue jobs on critical equipment, the ratio of planned to unplanned maintenance (a high unplanned ratio is a sign of poor reliability), the average job completion time and the number of spare-part stock-outs.
Baş Mühendis, PMS'ten gelen iş emirlerin: The Chief Engineer distributes the work orders coming from the PMS according to the team's capacity. The workload must be balanced during busy voyage periods, port stays and before drydock; otherwise fatigue increases and maintenance quality falls.
Baş Mühendis, UMS'e geçiş ön koşullarını: Through the night orders, the Chief Engineer reinforces that the preconditions for switching to UMS (alarms working, dead-man alarm active, standby equipment ready) are met every night. An alarm that is silenced and forgotten is a lethal risk.
Baş Mühendis, UMS'e geçiş öncesi günlük: Before switching to UMS, the Chief Engineer makes sure of the daily "rounds" discipline, that the alarm system has been tested and that the dead-man alarm is working. During maneuvering, port entry/departure and bad weather, the engine room is put on manual control (manned).
Baş Mühendis, analiz programını saatlik: The Chief Engineer uses the analysis program as a decision tool that replaces routine oil changes based on running hours. When managed correctly, it both extends equipment life and reduces the cost of unnecessary oil changes.
Baş Mühendis, arızanın türüne göre resta: Depending on the type of failure, the Chief Engineer assesses whether the engine can be restarted or needs repair. If there is a risk of crankcase explosion or suspected bearing damage, an uncontrolled restart can end in disaster; in that case the ship is stopped and anchoring/tug assistance is considered.
Baş Mühendis, boss cap/hub oil seviyesin: The Chief Engineer monitors the boss cap/hub oil level and pressure and, if water ingress is detected (rising water in the analysis), assesses whether there is a seal/O-ring problem. On CPP systems, hydraulic pitch control and oil cleanliness are also managed separately.
Baş Mühendis, bu analiz disiplinini sürd: By keeping up this analysis discipline, the Chief Engineer both monitors machinery health and can postpone the expensive, time-consuming shaft withdrawal survey. Missing analyses forfeit the right to a survey extension.
Baş Mühendis, bu düzenlemelerin gemi ope: The Chief Engineer understands the technical and cost impact of these regulations on ship operation; accurate data collection and reporting are critical for a correct cost calculation.
Baş Mühendis, bu indekslerin teknik tara: The Chief Engineer manages the technical side of these indices: correct collection of fuel consumption data, implementation of energy efficiency measures and optimal operation of the machinery/propulsion systems. As CII is operational, the Chief Engineer's daily decisions directly affect the rating.
Baş Mühendis, bu sık bulguları proaktif: The Chief Engineer checks these common findings proactively; before the PSC inspector boards, critical emergency equipment is tested and its records are updated. A detention is a serious financial and reputational loss for the company and the ship.
Baş Mühendis, ekibinde \"just culture\": The Chief Engineer establishes a "just culture" in the team, that is, an environment where mistakes are reported honestly without punishment. Near-miss and unsafe condition reporting is encouraged; these reports are early warnings of major accidents.
Baş Mühendis, ekipman tanıtımının teorik: The Chief Engineer ensures that equipment familiarization includes practical elements (start/stop, alarm reset, normal parameters) besides theoretical knowledge; familiarization "on paper" is not accepted.
Baş Mühendis, gecikmiş kritik bakımları: The Chief Engineer explains overdue critical maintenance with its reasons (spare parts, weather, port) and presents a recovery plan. Transparency is the key to getting the right support from ashore.
Baş Mühendis, geminin mevcut/planlanan y: The Chief Engineer evaluates the ship's existing/planned fuel flexibility (dual-fuel, biofuel-ready) and its effect on carbon intensity. Biofuel blending is a practical transition option that can lower CII on existing engines.
Baş Mühendis, header tank seviye trend'i: By monitoring the header tank level trend and oil consumption, the Chief Engineer tries to catch even small, invisible leaks. Using EAL reduces the environmental impact of a leak but does not remove the obligation to record it.
Baş Mühendis, header tank seviyesini gün: The Chief Engineer monitors the header tank level daily. A falling level (oil consumption) indicates an aft or fore seal leak; a sudden change indicates a serious seal failure. The tank level is the most important early warning indicator of the system.
Baş Mühendis, her bunker sonrası BDN mik: After every bunkering, the Chief Engineer compares the BDN quantity with the ship's tank measurements (sounding/ullage + temperature correction) and reports the difference. Regular ROB reconciliation ensures the accuracy of the consumption calculation and detects possible "short delivery" cases.
Baş Mühendis, her parametreyi bir trend: The Chief Engineer tracks each parameter on a trend chart and establishes a baseline for a new machinery/oil combination. Deviations are assessed against the baseline; it is the trend that is read, not a single point.
Baş Mühendis, her zabitin pratik yetkinl: The Chief Engineer assesses each officer's practical competence by observation: taking indicator cards, purifier overhaul, fuel changeover, paralleling and troubleshooting. TMSA Element 3 expects a documented competence assessment.
Baş Mühendis, kaydın gerçek operasyonla: The Chief Engineer ensures that the record is complete and consistent with the actual operation. ECA entry/exit positions are cross-checked with the bridge; inconsistent records create problems during inspections.
Baş Mühendis, makine dairesinin temizliğ: The Chief Engineer keeps the engine room clean and free of leaks and keeps labeling, the permit-to-work system and the consistency of the team's answers in good order. The visual order of the engine room sets the inspector's first impression.
Baş Mühendis, o gece özellikle izlenmesi: The Chief Engineer clearly writes down the parameters to be specially monitored that night and their threshold values: for example "call me if the ME exhaust temperature difference exceeds 40 °C", "inform me if the stern tube oil tank level drops", "take action if the generator load imbalance exceeds X".
Baş Mühendis, o geceye özgü bağlamı (örn: The Chief Engineer reflects the context specific to that night in the orders (for example an ECA approach, heavy weather, follow-up of an ongoing fault, a newly joined junior officer). It is orders written for that particular night, not template orders, that are effective.
Baş Mühendis, raporun makine tarafını (c: The Chief Engineer verifies the engine side of the report (consumption, RPM, ME load, generator running hours, ROB) on the basis of sounding and flowmeter data. Bridge and engine data must be consistent.
Baş Mühendis, seyirde intermediate ve th: At sea, the Chief Engineer monitors intermediate and thrust bearing temperatures; a sudden rise in temperature points to an alignment or lubrication problem. A hot bearing is a warning that requires immediate action.
Baş Mühendis, standart bir numune alma p: The Chief Engineer applies a standard sampling procedure: same point, same conditions, same method. Consistency is essential for reliable trend analysis; using a different method each time distorts the trend.
Baş Mühendis, sörvey öncesi şu kayıtları: Before a survey, the Chief Engineer keeps the following records ready: crank deflection measurements, exhaust valve overhaul, T/C overhaul, fuel injector pop test, safety device tests (overspeed, low LO pressure trip), boiler safety valve test and relief valve setting records.
Baş Mühendis, talimatların düzenli, okun: The Chief Engineer ensures that the orders are orderly, legible and action-oriented. Vague or general orders do not serve their purpose; concreteness is essential.
Baş Mühendis, tüm sertifikaların geçerli: The Chief Engineer tracks the expiry dates of all certificates and the survey windows. An expired certificate keeps the ship from sailing; planning must therefore be proactive.
Baş Mühendis, voyage instruction'a göre: Based on the voyage instructions, the Chief Engineer calculates the total fuel requirement: main engine consumption (sea consumption × steaming days), auxiliary engine consumption (auxiliary load × port + sea days), boiler/inert gas consumption and a safety margin (usually 10-15% reserve). The ROB (Remaining On Board) is verified by sounding/ullage, and the stem quantity is determined accordingly.
Baş Mühendis, yakıt tüketim verilerini (: The Chief Engineer is responsible for correctly reporting fuel consumption data (IMO DCS — Data Collection System). If a D rating is received for 3 consecutive years or an E rating in a single year, a corrective action plan under SEEMP Part III is mandatory. Fuel choice, speed profile and hull/propeller performance directly affect CII.
Baş Mühendis, yangının boyutuna göre lok: Depending on the size of the fire, the Chief Engineer directs local firefighting or moves to the decision to withdraw all personnel from the engine room and use the fixed extinguishing system. Fuel quick-closing valves and pump stops cut the fire off from its fuel.
Baş Mühendis, yoğun liman/bakım dönemler: During busy port/maintenance periods, the Chief Engineer monitors the rest hour records and prevents the risk of violations. Fatigue is the leading human factor in engine room accidents and must be managed deliberately.
Baş Mühendis-Superintendent ilişkisi, ge: The Chief Engineer-Superintendent relationship is the backbone of the ship's technical management. Effective communication must be timely, clear, solution-oriented and documented. When reporting a problem, the Chief Engineer usually also offers a proposal/plan.
Baş Mühendis/makine ekibi, steering gear: In the steering gear room, the Chief Engineer/engine team applies the procedure for changing over to the standby pump, switching to local control and carrying out helm orders received by telephone/talker. This changeover is rehearsed in periodic drills (under SOLAS, it is tested before leaving port).
Baş Mühendis; black-out, engine room fir: The Chief Engineer plans and conducts black-out, engine room fire, flooding, emergency steering and enclosed space rescue drills. Drills are run with realistic scenarios and timed, and deficiencies are identified in the debrief.
Baş istasyonu demir/halat ile, kıç istas: The forward station works with the anchor/lines and the aft station with lines, at the same time. The Bosun reports clearly to the bridge what is happening at the Bosun's own station, so that the bridge can manage both ends in step. A breakdown in communication creates dangerous situations, such as one end of the ship coming free while the other end is still made fast.
Baş mühendis ve kaptan, en az aylık peri: The Chief Engineer and the Master should compare speed-power performance with the sea trial baseline at least monthly and define deviation thresholds in the SMS.
Baş mühendis, liderlik tarzını duruma ve: The Chief Engineer should adapt his or her leadership style flexibly to the situation and the team.
Baş sayımı, terk kararında kimsenin geri: The head count is the critical step that ensures nobody is left behind when the decision to abandon is made. The responsible person ticks off everyone at their station on the list and reports anyone missing to the bridge immediately; search and rescue is directed on the basis of this information.
Baş tank seviyesinin düşmesi denize yağ: A fall in the header tank level can mean oil leaking into the sea, and a rise can mean water entering the stern tube bearing. Both require the seals to be examined, and in the case of a leak the obligation to report pollution is assessed.
Başlangıç sonrası SCR'lar tam iletime ge: After starting, the SCRs go into full conduction or a bypass contactor closes.
Başlatma yöntemi: Basınçlı hava veya akü: Starting method: compressed air or batteries (battery start). Some ships have both.
Başlıca risk kaynakları: aşırı ısınan/gö: The main sources of risk are an overheated/unattended deep fryer, oil left on the range, grease built up in the hood and exhaust duct, damaged/overloaded electrical installations, gas leaks and spilled flammable liquids. Grease in the hood duct is particularly insidious; once accumulated grease ignites, it can spread the fire out of the galley along the duct. For this reason, cleaning (see the galley organization task) is a direct fire prevention measure.
Bedplate üzerine oturan A şeklinde kolon: A-frames are columns that sit on the bedplate. They carry the crosshead guides. There is one frame for each cylinder.
Before the manoeuvre, prepare the statio: Before the manoeuvre, prepare the station according to the mooring plan: arrange lines safely, check leads and equipment, prepare the heaving line and confirm communication. Remove slip and trip hazards and plan safe standing positions. Preparation does not authorise releasing a loaded line without an order.
Beklenenden hızlı tükenen bir malzeme me: An ingredient that runs out faster than expected can upset the menu. With flexible recipe knowledge, the cook adapts the menu to the ingredients on hand; for example, when fresh meat runs out, he or she prepares a balanced alternative with frozen/canned protein. This flexibility is the key skill that distinguishes an experienced ship's cook.
Beklenmeyen etki hemen limitation/defect: An unexpected effect is reported at once as a limitation or defect and reflected in the CAMO and ASOG. After close-out the retest is evidenced; drawings, the software version and the FMEA revision are updated.
Belge dosyası kabul edildikten sonra ada: Once the document file has been accepted, the candidate enters the examination/assessment stage prescribed by the Administration; this may include written, oral and/or simulator assessment. In the oral examination, the tasks in the candidate's TRB may be questioned; honest and concrete TRB entries are therefore the best examination preparation.
Belge yönetimi, denizciliğin görünmeyen: Document management is one of the invisible but most decisive disciplines at sea. A well-kept log book is the strongest shield protecting the Master and the company in court; a careless or falsified entry destroys even the best defence. The Master's goal is to turn the principle "every document at the time it happens, as it happens and legibly" into a lasting culture on board.
Belge yönetimi, sadece bir bürokratik gö: Document management is not just a bureaucratic task; it is the protection of the evidence of a career. Even years later, in an application for a higher certificate (Second/Chief Engineer), these early records may serve as a reference. Disciplined filing is the foundation of a habit that lasts a whole career.
Belge zinciri ileride doğacak demurrage,: The chain of documents is the strongest defence protecting the Master and the company in later demurrage, off-hire, cargo damage or accident disputes. Time stamps (UTC and LT together), position, weather and the counterpart must always be stated. Back-dating documents, on the other hand, is a serious disciplinary and legal offence; when courts detect it, the credibility of all the records collapses.
Belge; gemi adı/bayrağı/tipi, görev tanı: The certificate contains information such as the ship's name/flag/type, the capacity in which the holder served, the dates of service (signing on - signing off), the trading area and the ship's tonnage/engine power, and is signed by the Master. These details determine whether the service counts as "valid" for certification.
Belgelenmeyen hasar, sonradan gemiye yük: Undocumented damage leaves the ship defenceless against claims made against it later.
Belgeler iki ana kategoriye ayrılır: (a): Documents fall into two main categories: (a) official books made mandatory by the flag state or international conventions (official log book, oil record book, garbage record book, rest hour records); (b) commercial and operational documents (NOR, SOF, mate's receipt, manifest). In official books no page number may be skipped, nothing may be erased and nothing may be filled in retrospectively; errors are struck through with a single line and initialled.
Belgeyi alırken stajyer tüm alanları kon: When receiving the certificate, the cadet checks all fields: are the dates correct, are the ship's details complete, is the engine power stated, are the signature and stamp present? An incorrect certificate may become almost impossible to correct when it is noticed at the time of the examination application.
Belirli bölge geçişlerinde (örn. sarı hu: For passages through certain regions (e.g. areas where yellow fever is endemic), vaccination and a valid vaccination certificate may be required. The Master follows the vaccination status of the crew. General hygiene, drinking water quality, food safety and pest control are the basic measures that prevent disease in the first place.
Belirli dalga periyodu/karşılaşma açısı: Certain combinations of wave period and encounter angle trigger parametric rolling; this resonance is avoided by changing course or speed. Weather routing advice is taken into account.
Belirli dalga periyotları geminin doğal: If certain wave periods are close to the ship's natural roll period, parametric rolling or synchronous rolling occurs; the roll angle reaches dangerous levels, lashing forces multiply and containers/cargo are lost. MSC.1/Circ.1228 recommends adjusting speed/course to change the encounter period in order to avoid these situations.
Belirli ekipman ve donanım, periyodik se: Certain equipment and gear require periodic servicing and certification: fire extinguishers, liferafts, EEBDs, SCBA, lifting equipment (lifting gear/LOLER), pressure vessels, calibrated measuring instruments (gas detectors, OWS 15 ppm monitor). The Chief Engineer tracks in the PMS the certificate expiry dates of those items that belong to the engine department.
Belirli ekipmanlar (MAN ES ME-C engine,: Certain equipment (MAN ES ME-C engine, Alfa Laval separator, high-voltage switchboard, BWMS) requires manufacturer training. The Chief Engineer tracks which personnel need which certificate and forwards requests for shore training to the Superintendent.
Belirli çalışma saatlerinde (tipik 500-1: Scavenge port inspections are carried out at set running-hour intervals (typically 500-1000 hours). The Second Engineer plans this work and ensures gas testing in line with the enclosed space entry permit procedure and safe isolation (turning gear engaged, starting air shut off). The inspection covers carbon deposits on the piston crown and ring zone, ring freedom/breakage, the liner surface (glazing, scuffing, vertical scratches) and the underside of the cylinder cover.
Belirti kapsamı aşıyorsa, güvenlik riski: If the symptoms go beyond this scope, if there is a safety risk or if the solution is unclear, the work is stopped and a senior engineer is called. Pressing ahead on an unfamiliar system "just to try" can turn a small problem into major damage.
Bending moment ve shear force, hold'lar: Bending moment and shear force depend on the distribution of cargo between the holds. Heavy cargo at the ends and light cargo in the middle causes "hogging"; the reverse causes "sagging"; both lead to hull fatigue and cracks. On bulk carriers, discharging by grab in stages carries a risk of overstress; the Master also checks the discharge sequence.
Benzer olayların tekrarlanmaması için si: To prevent similar events from recurring, the same scenario should be run in simulator drills at different workload levels; the accuracy of decisions should be measured as well as decision times.
Bertaraf yolları sınırlıdır: onaylı insi: The disposal routes are limited: burning in an approved incinerator or delivery to a shore reception facility. The sludge tank having no direct connection overboard and the discharge line having the standard connection are among the first things checked in inspections.
Besi suyu ön ısıtma (regeneratif ısıtma): Feed water preheating (regenerative heating), deaerator control and blowdown optimisation are critical areas for improvement, both for thermal efficiency and for equipment life.
Besleme pompası hat basıncını yükseltere: The supply pump raises the line pressure to prevent the fuel from vaporising when heated and causing a vapour lock (gassing); the booster pump provides the necessary circulation at the engine. This two-stage arrangement is needed for stable injection with heavy fuel.
Besleme suyu (feed water), besleme pompa: Feed water is pumped into the boiler by the feed pump and turns into steam with heat; after use it returns as condensate to the cascade/hotwell tank and is fed again. Steam traps separate the condensate from the steam. The water level is monitored with the gauge glass and a level sensor.
Beslenecek tüketici listesi gemiye özgüd: The list of consumers to be supplied is specific to the ship and is shown on the approved electrical diagrams: emergency lighting, navigation lights, GMDSS and internal communications, fire detection, the fire pump, watertight doors and, depending on the arrangement, the steering gear may be on this list.
Beslenme kalitesi öznel bir boyut da taş: Nutritional quality also has a subjective dimension: the same nutritional value is perceived very differently depending on presentation/flavor. The cook monitors the crew's likes and complaints through satisfaction surveys, a suggestion box and one-to-one feedback. This data both improves menu quality and raises morale; satisfaction increases when the crew feel that "their voice is heard". Survey results are reflected in menu decisions and may be included in company reporting.
Beyaz metal veya polimer (Thordon, Orkot: White metal or polymer (Thordon, Orkot) bearing material is used. The bearing space is filled with oil. There are seals (lip seals or face seals) at the propeller end and at the engine room end.
Bildirim, soğukkanlı ve olgusal olmalıdı: The report must be calm and factual. The Master avoids statements admitting liability ("we made a mistake"), because early and unconsidered admissions later become evidence against the ship. The report contains the place and time (UTC) of the incident, the weather and visibility conditions, the condition of the ship, whether there are injured or dead persons or pollution, and the immediate measures taken.
Bilge alarmları yağ/kir nedeniyle yapışa: Bilge alarms can stick because of oil/dirt; periodic cleaning and function testing are therefore done together. A bilge alarm that does not work allows water to collect silently in the engine room, with the risk that flooding is noticed late.
Bilge high-level alarm, makine dairesi s: The bilge high-level alarm is the early warning of engine room flooding (sea water pipe leak, cooler tube rupture, sea chest valve failure). The levels in the engine room bilge wells and the shaft tunnel are monitored. The alarm is tested and recorded in the PMS; an inoperative bilge alarm is a serious finding for PSC.
Bilge high-level alarmları periyodik fon: Bilge high-level alarms are subject to periodic function tests; the OCM 15 ppm alarm is calibrated and the response of the three-way valve is verified.
Bilge seviyesi yönetimi yalnızca emniyet: Bilge level management matters not only for safety but also for pollution prevention. The bilge alarm feeds into bilge holding tank management; OWS operations are planned according to this level. Tests and findings are recorded.
Bilge sistemi, gemi su altı bütünlüğünün: The bilge system is the last line of defense for the ship's underwater integrity; the bilge pump is therefore regarded as "critical equipment". For self-priming, the tightness of the air-water separator and the non-return valve (NRV) is critical; if the NRV does not seat, the pump cannot prime. During maintenance, the suction valve is overhauled, the NRV is ground in and the strainer is cleaned.
Bilge sistemi, makine dairesi ve hold bi: The bilge system is a safety system that collects oily/dirty water accumulating in the engine room and hold bilge wells. Each bilge well has a high-level alarm; these alarms are tested regularly. A steady rise in the engine room bilge level is an early sign of a leak (seawater, cooling water, oil) and is investigated immediately.
Bilge suyu, bilge primary tank/holding t: Bilge water is collected in the bilge primary tank/holding tank and is discharged to sea only through the OWS, below the 15 ppm limit. In an emergency (flooding), the emergency bilge suction can connect the main SW pump directly to the bilge; this is used only for the safety of the ship and is recorded.
Bilge suyunu OWS'yi by-pass eden gizli b: Pumping bilge water overboard through a hidden line bypassing the OWS (magic pipe), or making false entries in the ORB, is among the most severely punished offenses at sea. Companies have been fined millions of dollars and crew members have been sentenced to prison. The cadet must learn why the ORB is taken so seriously and why honest recording is non-negotiable.
Bilge well high-level alarm switch'leri: Bilge well high-level alarm switches (float/capacitive) are tested. Under MARPOL Annex I, bilge water may be discharged to sea only through the OWS (Oily Water Separator), below the 15 ppm limit and with OCM (Oil Content Meter) approval; the bilge pump must not be bypassed to pump directly overboard.
Bilge well high-level alarmları genellik: Bilge well high-level alarms are usually floater-type or capacitive level switches. The test is done by physically raising the switch (lifting the floater) or with the test button; it is verified that the alarm appears both on the local panel and on the repeater panel on the bridge/CCR (cargo control / engine control room). The automatic start function of the connected bilge pump is also tested.
Bilge well seviyeleri turun kritik bir p: Bilge well levels are a critical part of the round. A rising bilge level may indicate a hidden leak (seawater, cooling water, FO/LO). The cadet learns the bilge alarm system, the Oily Water Separator (OWS) and the logic of the 15 ppm bilge alarm/oil content monitor; however, pumping out bilges is never within the cadet's independent authority.
Bilge well ve sludge/bilge holding tank: Bilge well and sludge/bilge holding tank levels are monitored by daily soundings; trend monitoring points to the source of a leak. An abnormal increase in bilge water is entered in the watch report and reported to the Chief Engineer.
Bilge well'ler temiz tutulur; tıkalı str: Bilge wells are kept clean; a blocked strum box or bilge suction prevents water from being pumped out of the hold. The Bosun checks the condition of the bilge well rose boxes and non-return valves. On bulk carriers, a bilge well blocked with cargo residue makes sounding and drainage impossible; this is critical for hold safety.
Bilge, sludge ve çevresel deşarj yönetim: Bilge, sludge and environmental discharge management is the Second Engineer's most sensitive responsibility, both legally and ethically. An OWS without any bypass, an honest ORB and correct sludge disposal protect the sea, keep the ship away from heavy penalties and uphold the environmental integrity of the seafaring profession.
Bill of Lading, kaptanın imzasının doğru: The bill of lading is the weightiest commercial document in which the Master's signature binds the company directly. An honest signature, given only after verifying the cargo, clausing the truth and without giving in to pressure, protects both the commercial and the legal safety of the ship.
Bill of Lading, yükün taşınmak üzere alı: The Bill of Lading is the basic document showing that the cargo has been received for carriage, and it serves as a document of title/carriage. A "clean B/L" shows that the cargo was received in good order; a "claused (dirty) B/L" shows a condition with reservations. Signing a clean B/L for damaged cargo (usually under shipper pressure, against a letter of indemnity) is a serious P&I risk and may be considered fraud.
Bir D/G seti; sabit devirde çalışan bir: A diesel generator set consists of a diesel engine running at constant speed and a synchronous alternator coupled to it. Because the frequency (50/60 Hz) depends on the engine speed, the governor keeps the speed constant. The alternator produces its magnetic field through excitation; the output voltage is held constant by the AVR.
Bir HPU; yağ tankı, değişken deplasmanlı: An HPU consists of an oil tank, a variable or fixed displacement pump, a relief valve, filters, a cooler, an accumulator and directional control valves. The lines to the consumers also have locking and load-holding valves.
Bir IAS'te yedek server'ın yıllardır arı: In one IAS, it emerged that the standby server had been faulty for years but had gone unnoticed because it had never been tested; when the main server failed, the system stopped completely. Lesson: redundancy is assured not merely by its existence but by periodic failover testing.
Bir LNG terminalinde, brake holding capa: At an LNG terminal, a winch whose brake holding capacity test had been neglected could not hold its line in a swell, and the ship moved off the berth; a loading arm was damaged and the ESD was activated. Lesson: brake tests and MEG4 equipment maintenance must never be skipped; automation does not remove the need for human supervision.
Bir PSC denetimi tipik olarak initial in: A PSC inspection typically begins with an initial inspection: a check of the certificates, the general condition of the ship (general impression) and first contact with the crew. If "clear grounds" arise — for example a missing certificate, visibly defective equipment, crew who do not know their basic duties — the inspection is escalated to a more detailed inspection. For certain ship types and ages an expanded inspection is mandatory anyway.
Bir PSC, SIRE/CDI vetting veya klas dene: When a PSC, SIRE/CDI vetting or class inspector enters the store, the inspector looks at a few things: order, labeling, segregation of dangerous substances, presence of LSA/spare equipment and traceability of certificates. A store that is untidy, unlabeled or has incompatible substances mixed together immediately produces a "housekeeping" finding and gives a negative impression of the ship's general maintenance culture.
Bir akışkan boru demetinin içinden (tube: One fluid flows inside the tube bundle (tube side) and the other through the shell between the tubes (shell side); baffles direct the flow on the shell side. It withstands high pressure and temperature, is robust and tolerates fouling. It is preferred for fuel oil heaters, steam heaters and some large condensers.
Bir alarm çaldığında Yağcı önce alarmın: When an alarm sounds, the Oiler first identifies the type of alarm (sensor fault or real fault) and then immediately informs the engineer on watch. Within the limits of their authority, the Oiler may take simple actions (filter changeover, draining, starting the standby pump — if trained and authorized); however, critical interventions are carried out on the engineer's instructions.
Bir alarm çaldığında stajyer paniğe kapı: When an alarm sounds, the cadet, without panicking, reads the alarm, informs the EOOW and verifies the relevant parameter on the panel and locally. The cadet does not silence/reset the alarm independently. With multiple alarms (alarm flooding), identifying the most critical one and finding the root cause is the EOOW's job; the cadet assists.
Bir arıza tespit edildiğinde Baş Mühendi: When a failure is detected, the Chief Engineer quickly prepares a defect report: equipment, description of the failure, probable root cause, operational impact (voyage/safety/environment), temporary measures taken, the proposed permanent solution, and spare parts/service needs.
Bir bakım veya tadilat sırasında dedektö: During maintenance or alterations, a detector or zone may be temporarily disabled (disabled/isolated); however, the ETO must ensure that this is recorded under the permit system and that it is always re-enabled when the work is finished. A forgotten disablement means loss of detection in a real fire.
Bir bataryanın gerçek kapasitesi ancak d: The real capacity of a battery can only be known through a discharge test; even if the voltage looks normal, the capacity may have collapsed. The ETO carries out an annual load bank discharge test on critical banks (GMDSS, emergency) and assesses the capacity against the nominal value. Banks whose capacity falls below a set threshold (typically 80%) are replaced.
Bir bağlantı kesintisinde ETO, sorunu ka: In a connection outage, the ETO narrows down the problem layer by layer: is it the user device, the ship network/switch, the router/firewall, the modem or the satellite link (antenna/weather/hub)? The fault is located using ping/traceroute, the modem signal indicators and the service portal. A systematic approach avoids unnecessary intervention and service costs.
Bir buhar sıkıştırmalı soğutma çevrimi d: A vapor-compression refrigeration cycle consists of four basic components: the compressor (raises pressure/temperature), the condenser (rejects heat, gas→liquid), the expansion valve (lowers pressure) and the evaporator (takes heat from the space, liquid→gas). Knowing the "normal" pressures and temperatures of this cycle, the Third/Fourth Engineer diagnoses deviations.
Bir bulaşma (özellikle kemirgen veya yay: If an infestation (especially rodents or a widespread infestation) is detected, the cook immediately informs the Master; when required, the Master notifies the port health authority and control measures are coordinated. An infestation is never concealed — concealing it is both a public health risk and grounds for heavy sanctions. Affected food is destroyed, the source is sealed and the process is recorded.
Bir bulgu yanlış veya haksız görünüyorsa: If a finding seems wrong or unfair, the Master can discuss it during the closing meeting respectfully, with reasons and on the basis of documents; the discussion must not become personal but must proceed on the basis of the regulations and the evidence. If the inspector is convinced, the finding may be dropped before it enters the report; if not, the Master must sign the report, but the signature means "receipt of the report", not "acceptance of the finding".
Bir ciddi olay, eş zamanlı olarak birçok: A serious incident sets many parties in motion at the same time: the company (DPA / operations), the H&M and P&I insurers, the class society (condition of class), the flag state and, where necessary, the coastal state (accident investigation, pollution authority). ISM Code section 9 requires non-conformities and accidents to be reported to the company and analysed, with corrective action. At the centre of this multi-party communication, the Master presents one consistent, factual account.
Bir cihaz arızalandığında İkinci Zabit;: When equipment fails, the Second Officer records the failure, informs the Master and the technical department, brings in an alternative method if one is available and, if required, considers whether flag/class need to be notified. For example, on an ECDIS-only ship, a single ECDIS failure may result in navigational restrictions.
Bir denetçi gemiye geldiğinde, ilk gördü: When an inspector comes on board, the condition of the accommodation, which is the first thing seen, creates an impression of the ship's general maintenance culture. A clean, tidy environment inspires confidence, whereas an untidy one may trigger a stricter inspection. The steward plays a direct role in forming this impression.
Bir diğer hata, GPS pozisyonuna körü kör: Another error is to trust the GPS position blindly and neglect independent verification. Ignoring the ENC scale/CATZOC reliability is also dangerous.
Bir diğer hata, routing servisi önerisin: Another error is to follow a routing service's recommendation without questioning the ship-specific sensitivities. The service gives recommendations; it is the team that knows the ship. Blind obedience is as dangerous as blind rejection.
Bir diğer hata, talimatı sadece bir form: Another mistake is to treat the orders as a mere formality and not reflect the real risks. The orders must be the product of real thought about that particular night.
Bir döküntü veya ihlalde kaptan; SOPEP r: In the event of a spill or a violation, the Master informs the nearest coastal state, the port authority, the company (DPA) and the P&I Club using the SOPEP reporting format. The response is documented with the log book and photographs and video. Early, honest and complete reporting is the most effective attitude for limiting penalties and liability.
Bir dış kabuk (shell) içinde çok sayıda: An outer shell contains a large number of thin tubes. One fluid flows through the tubes and the other through the shell. Baffle plates direct the flow on the shell side and create turbulence.
Bir ekipman üzerinde bakım yapılacaksa,: If maintenance is to be carried out on equipment, the valves to be closed are determined from the drawing. For isolating a pump, the cadet identifies on the drawing the suction and discharge valves and, if necessary, the bypass and drains. Incorrect valve isolation can leave a line thought to be isolated still under pressure and lead to an accident.
Bir emniyet ekipmanı devre dışıyken risk: While a piece of safety equipment is out of service, the risk is compensated for: standby equipment is brought into use, an additional watch or precaution is put in place, or operations are restricted. The Third Officer determines this compensating measure and informs the Master; a gap is unacceptable, especially in fire-fighting and life-saving equipment.
Bir fazın kaybolması (single phasing), k: Loss of one phase (single phasing) causes overcurrent in the remaining two phases and rapid burnout of the motor. The ETO verifies that phase-loss protection is active and that phase imbalance (the difference between the phase currents) is monitored. In three-phase motors, a 5% voltage imbalance leads to about 30% current imbalance and overheating.
Bir filtreyi sürekli değiştirmek belirti: Changing a filter again and again manages the symptom; finding the source of the contamination that clogs the filter solves the failure. With simple methods such as 5-Why and fishbone, the chain of "why" is traced back to the root cause. The Third/Fourth Engineer contributes to this analysis with observations and data.
Bir gemi yalnızca radarla başka bir gemi: If a ship detects the presence of another ship by radar alone, she determines whether a risk of collision is developing. If there is a risk, Rule 19(d) requires certain maneuvers to be avoided: an alteration of course to port for a ship forward of the beam (other than a ship being overtaken), and an alteration of course towards a ship abeam or abaft the beam. Action is taken early and is substantial.
Bir gemi üst üste üç yıl D veya bir yıl: If a ship receives a D rating for three consecutive years or an E rating for one year, it must prepare a Corrective Action Plan (CAP), to be included in the SEEMP, and have it approved. The CAP contains concrete measures to bring the rating up to C or better.
Bir gemide bunker sonrası purifier verim: On one ship, purifier efficiency dropped after bunkering; the Oiler noticed shiny, sand-like particles in the LO/FO filter contents and informed the engineer. A fuel analysis showed a high Al+Si value (cat fines); purifier maintenance was made more frequent, the filter changeover interval was shortened and the injection equipment was protected from premature wear. Had this not been detected, nozzle and pump erosion would have been unavoidable.
Bir gemide kalibre edilmemiş yağ basınç: On one ship, an uncalibrated oil pressure transmitter slowly began to read low; eventually a false low-low pressure trip stopped the main engine, and the ship lost propulsion in confined waters. The investigation showed that the transmitter's calibration was overdue. Lesson: the calibration schedule for critical sensors must be followed strictly.
Bir gemide separatör su çıkışından yakıt: On one ship, the Oiler noticed fuel coming from the separator's water outlet (oil loss); the investigation revealed that the gravity disc had not been changed although the bunker density had changed. When the correct disc was fitted, the water seal was re-established, the fuel loss stopped and water was prevented from reaching the engine. Daily observation prevented both fuel waste and risk to the engine.
Bir gemide silindir kapağı kaldırılırken: On one ship, while a cylinder cover was being lifted, the load started to slip slowly because the brake of the chain block in use was worn; the Oiler noticed this early, immediately lowered the load onto a secure support and moved personnel out of the line of the load. The investigation revealed that the periodic inspection date of the block had passed; the equipment was taken out of service. A few seconds of attention prevented a serious crushing accident.
Bir geminin ticari kullanımı charter par: The commercial employment of a ship is governed by a charter party (C/P). Under a voyage charter the ship is hired for a specific voyage and under a time charter for a specific period; under a bareboat charter the ship passes entirely to the charterer. The concepts of NOR, laytime and demurrage are especially critical in voyage charters, because these documents allocate the cost of port time between the parties.
Bir görev yapıldığı gün TRB'ye işlenmeli: A task must be entered in the TRB on the day it is done. An entry written while the memory is fresh is accurate in terms of date, equipment, work done and lesson learned. Entries written in bulk weeks later are vague and general and have weak evidential value; the training engineer also finds it difficult to approve such entries.
Bir güvenlik olayı (yetkisiz erişim giri: In a security incident (an attempt at unauthorised access, a suspicious package or person, a bomb threat, a stowaway, an attack), the Master applies the response steps in the SSP, coordinates with the CSO and the PFSO, and notifies the relevant state authorities (flag/port) and, where necessary, uses the SSAS. After the incident detailed records are kept and the root cause is assessed; the SSP or procedures may be updated to prevent a recurrence (this is where the ISM and ISPS systems meet).
Bir halat koparsa Reis derhal \"line par: If a line parts, the Bosun immediately warns "line parted", informs the bridge and checks that the crew are safe. If anyone is injured, first aid and the MOB/medevac procedure are started. Since the load on the remaining lines increases, the operation is reassessed; if necessary, additional lines are put out.
Bir iş emri (work order), PMS'te bir bak: A work order represents a maintenance task in the PMS: which equipment, which job, which procedure, the spare parts and time required. The PMS generates work orders automatically for planned jobs; for an unplanned failure, a work order is opened manually. A work order passes through the stages of planning, material preparation, execution and close-out.
Bir iş emri açıldığında; ekipman, görev: When a work order is opened, the equipment, the job description, the spares/consumables required, the estimated duration and the assigned personnel are recorded. While the job is carried out, the parts used are deducted from the PMS stock module (consumption logging). When the job is complete, it is closed by entering the work done, the measured values (clearance, bearing temp, pressure), the serial numbers of the parts replaced and a note for the next maintenance (e.g. "approaching wear limit").
Bir jeneratörü baraya paralel bağlamak i: Four conditions must be met to connect a generator in parallel with the busbar:
Bir jeneratörü çalışan şebekeye almak (p: To connect a generator to a live switchboard (paralleling), four conditions must be met: the same voltage, the same frequency, the same phase sequence and the phases in step. The synchroscope and the check-synchronising relay verify these conditions; wrong paralleling causes a large current surge and damage.
Bir job; yedek parça gelmediği, hava/ope: A job may not be done on its due date because spare parts have not arrived, weather/operations do not permit, or there is not enough manpower. In this case, instead of an uncontrolled delay, a formal deferral record is opened: the reason, a risk assessment, temporary measures (mitigation) and a new target date are documented. Postponing jobs on critical equipment requires company (superintendent) approval.
Bir kabuk (shell) içine yerleştirilmiş b: Two fluids pass separately through a tube bundle placed inside a shell. Baffle plates create cross-flow on the shell side and increase heat transfer.
Bir kalemin beklenenden hızlı tükenmesi: An item running out faster than expected (e.g. a popular product) upsets the menu; the cook updates the consumption data and increases the quantity in the next order. Conversely, products that are over-ordered and spoil are both waste and cost; the order quantity is calibrated through stock counts and consumption tracking.
Bir kaza/near-miss sonrası olay araştırı: After an accident or near-miss, the event is investigated. The process includes collecting evidence (photos, witness statements, records), building a timeline, root cause analysis (5 Whys, fishbone, TRIPOD) and deciding on corrective/preventive actions. The aim is not to find someone to blame but to close the gap in the system.
Bir kazada VDR'ın köprü ses kanalının ay: After one accident, it emerged that the VDR's bridge audio channel had not been recording for months because a microphone was faulty. Lesson: regular verification of all VDR channels and never skipping the annual APT are of critical importance.
Bir kişi vana operasyonu yaparken diğeri: While one person carries out a valve operation, another checks that the right valve has been opened. In an electrical switching operation one person reads and the other operates. In maintenance work, torque and measurement values are verified by a second person.
Bir kompresör ünitesi birkaç depoyu (et: One compressor unit serves several rooms (meat freezer about −18 °C, fish about −25 °C, vegetables and daily stores about +2 to +5 °C); the evaporator of each room is kept at its own temperature by a thermostatic expansion valve and a solenoid valve. The compressor load is adjusted to the low-temperature demand.
Bir kritik ekipman arızalandığında yedek: When an item of critical equipment fails, the standby/alternative arrangement is brought into use and, if a "single point of failure" situation exists, the navigational risk is reassessed (e.g. if only one generator remains, speed/load restrictions or a decision to make for port). The Second Engineer reports this situation immediately to the Chief Engineer and the bridge.
Bir kusur varsa, açık defect ve telafi t: If there is a defect, showing it as an open defect with a compensating measure is always better than hiding it. When an inspector finds a concealed fault, trust is completely shaken and the ship is examined more closely.
Bir limit aşıldığında ilgili renge geçil: When a limit is exceeded, the corresponding colour status is declared, the parties are informed and the written action is carried out. Even if conditions improve, the status is not stepped down without authorised approval and a renewed check.
