Bir madde sağlanamıyorsa transfere başla: If an item cannot be met, the transfer is not started, or a transfer already under way is stopped. An incomplete or wrongly completed checklist is both a safety risk and a reason for PSC detention.
Bir mooring line gerildiğinde içinde dep: When a mooring line is under tension, elastic energy is stored in it; if the line parts, this energy is released as a whiplash (snap-back) movement in both directions from the point of parting. In highly elastic lines such as nylon, this movement reaches lethal speed. Snap-back is the source of the most frequent fatal accidents in seafaring; a line that strikes a person kills instantly.
Bir mühendis, bir sistemi sadece fizikse: An engineer cannot fully understand a system just by seeing it physically; where the pipes go, which valve isolates what and the design logic of the system can only be learned from the drawing. When a fault is being traced, an isolation is being planned or a transfer line is being set up, the drawing is the engineer's guide.
Bir mürettebatta bulaşıcı hastalık şüphe: When a communicable disease is suspected in a crew member, the patient is isolated, hygiene and contact measures are taken, TMAS is consulted and the health authority of the port of arrival is notified under the IHR. The Master manages the risk of an outbreak transparently, without concealment; this is both for the crew and for public health.
Bir olayın ardından birden çok surveyor: After an incident several surveyors may come on board, and each has a different principal. The H&M underwriter appoints its own surveyor (to establish hull and machinery damage); the P&I club appoints its own surveyor (for liability and cargo); the other party (for example the ship that was struck, or the cargo interests) may send its own surveyor; and the class society assesses the class status (condition of class). The Master must know which surveyor represents whom and adjust the level of cooperation accordingly.
Bir overhaul'a başlamadan önce gereken t: Before starting an overhaul, the availability of all required gaskets, O-rings and wear parts is physically verified. Otherwise the equipment ends up dismantled and out of service while waiting for parts; on critical equipment this creates a safety gap. The Second Engineer makes this verification a condition for opening the work order.
Bir reefer ünitesi arızalandığında ETO,: When a reefer unit fails, the ETO assesses the alarm priority (sensitivity of the cargo), rules out a supply/socket problem and, if necessary, diagnoses the fault inside the unit (compressor, fan, control). For critical cargo, transfer to a spare socket/container or a rapid repair is required; every incident is recorded.
Bir sabit objenin EBL bearing trendi, ra: The EBL bearing trend of a fixed object supports checks of the radar bearing alignment and the compass error. Because the radar overlay alignment may share the same GNSS/gyro error, it does not count on its own as an independent position check.
Bir siber olayda ETO, olay müdahale plan: In a cyber incident, the ETO applies the incident response plan: isolate the affected system (containment), preserve the evidence, assess the impact, report in accordance with the company/SMS procedure and recover from backup. When critical OT is affected, switching to a manual/backup operating mode (e.g. the backup ECDIS or paper charts, manual control) is vitally important.
Bir siber olayı yönetmek için önce tespi: To manage a cyber incident, it must first be detected. The ETO monitors logs (firewall, server, OT devices), network traffic anomalies and antivirus/EDR alerts. In OT, unexpected traffic, a new device, abnormal system behavior or failed login attempts are warning signs. Logs are kept regularly and in a form that cannot be altered.
Bir sistem arızalandığında etkisi diğerl: When one system fails, the effect spreads to the others: if cooling is insufficient, the oil thins, the oil pressure drops, bearings are damaged and the engine stops. By learning these chain dependencies, the cadet lays the foundation for fault-diagnosis logic.
Bir stowaway tespit edildiğinde öncelik: When a stowaway is discovered, the priority is human safety: the person's safety of life and basic needs (water, food, shelter, medical care) are provided. At the same time, for the security of the ship, the person is kept under supervision. The Master ensures that the person is treated humanely and in accordance with the regulations; ill-treatment is unacceptable.
Bir sörveyde tespit edilen ve hemen gide: A deficiency found during a survey that cannot be rectified immediately is recorded as a "Condition of Class" (or Memorandum) and must be rectified by a set date. The Chief Engineer tracks open CoCs in a register and closes them before the due date.
Bir tank veya kapalı alanda sıcak çalışm: If hot work is to be done in a tank or enclosed space, the risk multiplies: the atmosphere must be gas-free, and the welding/cutting fumes and gases must be removed by continuous ventilation. It is also verified that adjacent tanks and pipelines have been cleared of flammable residues.
Bir transfer veya switching işlemi önces: Before a transfer or changeover operation, the cadet learns to work out the line-up on the P&ID: which valve is open, which pump will run, which tank will be affected. This mental rehearsal reduces the likelihood of errors on site.
Bir work order; PMS tarafından otomatik: A work order is opened by the PMS automatically (when due) or manually (following a fault or inspection finding — corrective work order). At the weekly planning meeting, the Chief Engineer reviews the jobs due that week and those coming up, and prioritizes them according to manpower, spare parts availability, ship operations (in port or at sea) and safety risk.
Bir yangın söndürücüye veya can salına s: When a fire extinguisher or a liferaft has to be reached within seconds, an obstruction in front of it causes a fatal delay. A blocked escape route means being trapped. That is why safety equipment and routes must always be accessible, working and clear.
Bir yatak sıcaklığındaki kademeli yüksel: If a gradual rise in a bearing temperature is not entered in the logs, the trend can grow unnoticed and eventually lead to bearing damage. A well-kept trend record could have predicted the same failure weeks in advance. Recording discipline is machinery health, directly.
Bir yağ kaçağı/dökülmesi durumunda SOPEP: In the event of an oil leak/spill, the SOPEP is activated; the response equipment (absorbents, booms), the notification list (coastal State, company, P&I) and the initial response steps are applied. The Second Engineer takes part in the rapid response and notification for leaks originating in the engine room.
Birden fazla mürettebatta benzer belirti: If similar symptoms (diarrhea, vomiting) appear in more than one crew member, a foodborne illness is suspected; the cook informs the Master, the retained samples are preserved, the suspect product/batch is isolated and, if necessary, the matter is coordinated with telemedicine/the port health authority. The samples and the cold chain/cleaning records are the main evidence for the root-cause investigation.
Birden fazla mürettebatta benzer semptom: If similar symptoms (diarrhea, vomiting, fever) appear in more than one crew member, a foodborne outbreak is suspected. The cook withdraws the suspect food from service, preserves the samples, informs the Master and supports the instructions given through telemedicine/by the health authority. Intensified cleaning/disinfection is carried out in the galley; surface disinfection is especially critical for norovirus.
Birden fazla parametrenin aynı anda anor: Several parameters becoming abnormal at the same time (e.g. an increase in water + Cu) is a strong diagnostic signal: in this example a cooler tube leak (seawater + copper from the cooler) is highly likely. Parameters are interpreted together.
Birden çok alarm aynı anda çalarsa kök n: If several alarms sound at the same time, the root cause is sought; for example, after a blackout, dozens of alarms may stem from a single loss of power. The engineer turns to systematic diagnosis, not to panic.
Birikmiş yağ kanal içinde tutuşursa yang: If accumulated grease ignites inside the duct, the fire is not directly visible and can spread quickly; this is one of the most dangerous galley fire scenarios. The response is to stop cooking, trigger the suppression system, stop the fan and close the dampers, and call the ship's fire party. The cook does not try to tackle a duct fire alone; he or she raises the alarm and an organized response is started.
Birinci Zabit (veya elektrik işlerinde Ç: The Chief Officer (or, for electrical work, in coordination with the Chief Engineer) confirms by a "try-out" test that the isolation is effective: after the energy is cut off, a start is attempted and it is seen that nothing moves. Stored energy (capacitors, pressure, springs) is also released.
Birinci Zabit SoF'u hazırlar; terminal/a: The Chief Officer prepares the SoF; it is signed jointly with the terminal/agent. If the parties disagree on the time records, a reservation is entered in the "remarks" section. An error of one hour in the SoF can make a difference of thousands of dollars in the demurrage calculation.
Birinci Zabit'in personel yönetimindeki: The Chief Officer's success in managing people is the ship's invisible insurance: a well-trained, rested, motivated and disciplined deck team is what makes the difference in heavy weather, in an emergency and during intensive cargo operations. Managing people correctly comes before managing equipment correctly, because in the end every piece of equipment is operated by people.
Birinci Zabit'in sorumluluk alanındaki t: The main items within the Chief Officer's area of responsibility are deck/cargo cranes, mooring/anchor winches, the windlass, capstans, hatch covers (hydraulic/mechanical), air vent (ventilation) systems, sounding pipes, freeing ports, the accommodation ladder/gangway, the pilot ladder, deck pipelines (on tankers) and deck machinery.
Birinci Zabit'in yük operasyonundaki baş: The Chief Officer's success in cargo operations comes from disciplined records, cross-checks and regulatory knowledge, which remain invisible "when everything goes well" but are the only line of defense "when something goes wrong".
Birinci Zabit, GRB, ORB (güverte ilgili: The Chief Officer keeps the GRB, the ORB (deck-related parts), sewage records, delivery receipts, the SOPEP inventory and drill records ready for inspection. PSC and vetting inspectors check the consistency of these records, whether they match the actual condition, and how the plans are implemented. Regular internal checks (self-assessment) prevent findings.
Birinci Zabit, MR'deki çekincelerin B/L': The Chief Officer ensures that the reservations on the MR are correctly carried over to the B/L. The Hague-Visby Rules govern the carrier's liability and the right to make reservations. A wrongly issued clean B/L makes the carrier liable for the actual condition of the cargo and leads to large claims.
Birinci Zabit, NOR ve SoF'u zamanında ag: The Chief Officer forwards the NOR and SoF to the agent and the company in good time; the demurrage calculation is made by the operations/chartering department. Instructions are requested from the company on any uncertainties in the documents. In legally critical situations (major damage, claims), the P&I club becomes involved; the Chief Officer preserves the evidence and records.
Birinci Zabit, PMS (Planned Maintenance: The Chief Officer gives the Bosun the work orders generated by the PMS (Planned Maintenance System) software. Each order contains the equipment, the work to be done, the materials list, the PPE required, the relevant risk assessment reference, the estimated duration and the evidence of completion (photo, measurement, signature). Before carrying out the order, the Bosun confirms that the materials and tools are available.
Birinci Zabit, PMS çıktıları, klas/PSC t: The Chief Officer draws up the weekly work plan based on PMS output, the class/PSC schedule, charterer requests and the condition of the hull. The plan covers which areas will be painted, which equipment will be taken in for maintenance, which lashing/securing work will be done and which survey preparations will be carried out. At the short meeting with the Bosun every morning (toolbox talk), the day's jobs, their risks and the necessary permits (hot work, enclosed space, working aloft) are reviewed.
Birinci Zabit, abandon ship, fire, enclo: The Chief Officer plans abandon ship, fire, enclosed space rescue, MOB and emergency steering drills around scenarios, runs them under realistic conditions and identifies weak points in a debrief. Each drill is recorded with the date, participants, scenario, equipment used and observations; real hands-on practice is expected, not a "paper drill".
Birinci Zabit, ağır yükü mümkün olduğunc: The Chief Officer brings GM into a reasonable range by distributing heavy cargo as high as possible or by reducing double bottom ballast, while taking care not to go below the intact stability minimums.
Birinci Zabit, denizci olmasının yanında: Besides being a seafarer, the Chief Officer is the on-site representative of the ship's commercial interests. Correct and timely documents secure demurrage income and protect the ship against unjustified claims. Wrong or late documents leave the company defenseless in court. Care with documents is therefore as important as seamanship.
Birinci Zabit, ekibi line ile mümkün old: The Chief Officer positions the team as close as possible to right angles to the line and where the escape route is clear. Personnel throwing the heaving line move to a safe area before the line comes under load. Standard commands such as "slack away", "heave up", "hold on" and "make fast" are passed between the bridge and the station with clear radio confirmation; ambiguity is an invitation to an accident.
Birinci Zabit, free surface correction (: The Chief Officer works with the "fluid GM" after free surface correction (FSC), not the nominal GM. Partially filled tanks virtually reduce GM, and in large tanks this effect can cause a significant loss of GZ.
Birinci Zabit, güverte component ağacınd: The Chief Officer links each item in the deck component tree (crane, winch, hatch, mast, deck crane) to periodic jobs and distinguishes between calendar-based, running-hours-based and condition-based maintenance. Each completed job is closed out with a record of parts, hours and personnel.
Birinci Zabit, güverte departmanının tüm: The Chief Officer keeps all records of the deck department in a systematic archive: drill records (abandon ship, fire, enclosed space, oil spill), PMS work orders, risk assessments, PTW files, mooring/cargo records and environmental record books. When an inspector asks for any record, it must be possible to produce it within minutes.
Birinci Zabit, güverte için kritik yedek: The Chief Officer sets minimum stock levels for critical deck spares and raises requisitions through the PMS. Typical items are hatch cover seals, hydraulic seals, anodes, paint, wire/rope, twistlock/lashing equipment and greasing materials. Supply is coordinated with the port/agent and the company's purchasing department.
Birinci Zabit, güverte personelinin perf: The Chief Officer periodically evaluates the performance of deck personnel using the company appraisal forms. The appraisal covers technical competence, safety awareness, work ethic, teamwork and leadership potential. It is based on objective observation and examples; subjective bias is avoided. The results are shared with the person and areas for development are identified together.
Birinci Zabit, güverte personelinin yetk: The Chief Officer continuously develops the competence of deck personnel through drills and onboard training. Fire, abandon ship, enclosed space rescue, man overboard, pollution (SOPEP) and security drills are scheduled and coordinated with the Bosun. A debrief is held after each drill; deficiencies are recorded and corrected in the next drill.
Birinci Zabit, haftalık planlama toplant: At the weekly planning meeting, the Chief Officer prioritizes and allocates work orders together with the Bosun. Each work order includes the job description, the required PPE, the risk assessment reference, the required parts/materials and the estimated duration. For high-risk jobs (working aloft, overside work, hot work, enclosed space), a Permit to Work is also issued.
Birinci Zabit, hangi işin izne tabi oldu: The Chief Officer is the authority who decides which jobs are subject to a permit. Even if a job looks "small", a permit is mandatory if it involves a fatal energy source. Most accidents happen during tasks described as "just a short, simple job"; a culture of exceptions must therefore be avoided.
Birinci Zabit, hazırlık durumunu ve risk: The Chief Officer reports the state of preparation and the risks to the Master. Decisions on altering course, reducing speed (slow steaming/heave-to), seeking shelter (port of refuge) or waiting are taken by the Master; the Chief Officer carries them out on deck. MSC.1/Circ.1228 recommends speed/course adjustments to avoid dangerous situations such as parametric/synchronous rolling and broaching.
Birinci Zabit, her liman öncesi GRB-makb: Before each port, the Chief Officer checks GRB–receipt consistency, bin labels and the storage arrangements. PSC inspectors frequently examine garbage management; consistent records, orderly segregation and a valid plan prevent findings. Regular internal audits keep environmental compliance sustainable.
Birinci Zabit, kullanılan her ekipmanın: The Chief Officer knows the MSL of every item used and assesses the adequacy of the lashing arrangement against these values. A wrong MSL assumption leads to inadequate lashing and loss of cargo.
Birinci Zabit, köprüüstü ile koordineli: In coordination with the bridge, the Chief Officer monitors weather forecasts (NAVTEX, weather routing services, GMDSS broadcasts, GRIB files) and identifies the heavy weather window in advance. A weather routing service gives advance warning (e.g. of tropical cyclones, deep low-pressure systems), so that preparations can be made safely in calm seas. Working on deck after the storm has arrived is a fatal risk.
Birinci Zabit, manevra emniyeti için çev: The Chief Officer assesses the environmental limits for safe maneuvering together with the Master/pilot. Ships with high freeboard (container ships, PCCs, tankers in ballast) are very sensitive to wind load; with beam winds above 25–30 knots, tug assistance and additional lines are needed. The current, particularly in river ports, determines the berthing angle and the approach plan.
Birinci Zabit, permit imzalamadan önce a: Before signing the permit, the Chief Officer personally verifies the atmosphere test results, ventilation, rescue arrangements, communications and PPE. The permit is valid for a specified period and is renewed if conditions change (change of watch, atmosphere). The signature means taking on responsibility; it is not a routine formality.
Birinci Zabit, pilot station'a varmadan: Before arriving at the pilot station, the Chief Officer prepares a mooring plan based on the port's berthing prospectus, the type of berth (fixed jetty, dolphin, finger pier, SBM) and the available bollard arrangement. The plan shows the numbers of head lines, breast lines, springs and stern lines, which winch/windlass will be used and through which fairleads the lines will be led. Under MEG4, a symmetrical arrangement (lines balanced in each direction) and breast lines as close as possible to perpendicular (90°) to the berth are essential.
Birinci Zabit, port stay süresine ve atı: The Chief Officer plans delivery to the shore reception facility according to the length of the port stay and the amount of waste accumulated. Because some waste (plastics, e-waste, HME residues) can only be delivered ashore, a suitable port and facility are arranged in advance. Advance waste notification is mandatory in most ports; the Chief Officer submits this notification through the agent.
Birinci Zabit, tekrarlayan arızaları (re: The Chief Officer tracks recurring defects as a trend and carries out root cause analysis. If the same item keeps needing attention, there may be a design or usage problem; this is reported to the company in a defect report and the PMS interval is revised.
Birinci Zabit, weather routing ile birli: Together with weather routing, the Chief Officer coordinates with the Master the adjustment of GM to avoid resonance, speed/course alterations and lashing tightness. Awareness of the danger is the first defense.
Birinci Zabit, ölçüm sonuçlarını permit': The Chief Officer records the measurement results on the permit. If the values are not within the safe range, entry is prohibited; ventilation is continued and measurements are repeated. After entry, continuous monitoring is carried out inside (personal monitor), because the atmosphere can change.
Birinci Zabit; BWMS operasyonunu, sampli: The Chief Officer checks BWMS operation, access to the sampling port and the accuracy of the Ballast Water Record Book (BWRB). In open-sea exchange operations, stability and strength are also checked for the intermediate conditions; the flow-through method is carried out by overflowing the tank.
Birinci Zabit; DG manifest, packing cert: The Chief Officer checks the DG manifest, packing certificate, CTU (Cargo Transport Unit) packing inspection, stowage position and emergency response (EmS) preparations. During DG loading, special PPE, fire hoses ready, a cordoned-off area and an authorized supervisor are mandatory.
Birinci aşama: Gravite separasyonu ile b: First stage: large oil droplets are separated by gravity separation.
Birinci aşamada kaba ayırma (yerçekimi v: Coarse separation (gravity and coalescer) takes place in the first stage, and fine separation (membrane or absorption) in the second stage. The outlet is continuously monitored by the 15 ppm bilge alarm (oil content meter).
Birinci kademe çıkışındaki sıcak hava, b: The hot air from the first-stage outlet is cooled by passing it through a heat exchanger. The volume of the air decreases and the work of the second-stage compression is reduced.
Birçok container kaybı vakası (parametri: Many container loss cases (parametric/synchronous rolling): navigating at high speed in head/following seas without monitoring the swell period → stack collapse. Lesson: assess swell-roll resonance continuously and change speed/heading when necessary.
Birçok cruise limanı shore power/emisyon: Many cruise ports pay particular attention to shore power and emission rules.
Birçok gemi, muayene durumunu görsel tak: Many ships use a color coding system to track inspection status visually; equipment fitted with the colored tag/tape for the current inspection period is fit for use. If the color is out of date or there is no tag, the equipment is set aside. Damaged equipment is clearly marked with an "out of service" tag and physically removed from use (collected/locked away) so that it is not used by mistake.
Birçok gemide otomatik veya yarı-otomati: Many ships have an automatic or semi-automatic changeover system and "changeover calculator" software, which calculates the changeover duration and timing from the system parameters. The Chief Engineer verifies the result with engineering logic and does not trust it blindly.
Birçok gemide, servis edilen her ana öğü: On many ships, a reference sample is taken from each main meal served and kept in the refrigerator for at least 48 hours (usually up to 72 hours). If food poisoning is suspected, this sample is used for laboratory examination and the source of the agent can be identified. Samples are kept in clean, covered containers labeled with the date/meal.
Birçok kulüp, ayrıca FD&D (Freight, Demu: Many clubs also offer FD&D (Freight, Demurrage & Defence) protection as a separate cover; it meets legal costs in contractual disputes (charter party, freight, demurrage). The Master's practical task is to assess quickly whether an incident concerns H&M, P&I or both, and to inform both channels in time; because a collision can at the same time cause damage to his or her own ship (H&M), liability towards the other party (P&I) and a cargo claim (P&I).
Birçok makine dairesi yangını soruşturma: In many engine room fire investigations, the common factor is a short grinding/welding job done without a permit or without a fire watch. The spark ignited unseen bilge residue or oil-soaked insulation, and by the time the flames were noticed, the fire had grown. Lesson: no hot work is "small"; permit, isolation and fire watch are not negotiable.
Birçok şirket SMS'i, periyodik competenc: Many company SMSs provide for periodic competency assessment forms: a structured, observation-based tool that scores particular competence items and marks the areas for development. The Master or a senior officer designated by the Master carries out this assessment each period, shares the results with the person and links them to a development plan.
Bitt/bollard (baba), halatın volta edild: A set of bitts (bollard) is the double post on which the line is made fast in figure-of-eight turns; its SWL must be compatible with the MBL of the line. A fairlead is a roller or Panama chock that leads the line at the correct angle. A pedestal roller leads the line horizontally across the deck.
Bitts: İkili bağlama babası. Halat 8 şek: Bitts: a double mooring post. The line is made fast in figure-of-eight turns.
Biyolojik (extended aeration): 3 hücreli: Biological (extended aeration): three chambers — aeration (digestion by micro-organisms) → settling → chlorination → discharge. The traditional and common type.
Biyolojik sistemlerde bakteri kültürünün: In biological systems the health of the bacterial culture is critical; too many chemicals (detergent, chlorine) kill the bacteria and the treatment collapses. Maintenance covers the aeration blowers, disinfectant dosing, the sludge level and (on MBR systems) cleaning and renewal of the membranes.
Black water tuvalet (lağım) atığıdır ve: Black water is toilet waste (sewage) and carries pathogens; grey water is waste from washbasins, showers and the galley. MARPOL Annex IV regulates black water; in some areas (e.g. the Baltic special area) stricter rules apply, including to grey water. The STP treats the waste biologically or chemically and disinfects it.
Black-out recovery testi periyodik yapıl: The blackout recovery test is carried out periodically and the insulation resistance is measured. Automatic standby start and preferential tripping must work correctly.
Black-out recovery testi yapılır; DG'ler: The blackout recovery test is carried out; the generators are overhauled according to running hours. Insulation and preferential tripping are verified.
Black-out, tüm ana jeneratörlerin elektr: A black-out is the loss of electrical power from all main generators; the main engine, steering, cooling and lighting stop. Under SOLAS, the emergency generator starts automatically and within 45 seconds supplies the essential services (emergency lighting, communications, emergency steering, navigation).
Blackout olduğunda emergency generator o: In a blackout, the emergency generator starts automatically (auto-start) and is usually ready to take load within 45 seconds (SOLAS requirement). Its starting source is independent (battery or compressed air). By observing the auto-start test, the cadet learns how the system detects the loss of power and cuts in.
Blackout recovery sırası emergency gener: The ship-specific blackout recovery sequence is practised: emergency generator, essential auxiliaries, generator start, bus energisation and thruster connection. At each reconnection the frequency and voltage stability and the available power are checked; which thruster is brought in first is coordinated with the DPO according to the escape and drift directions.
Blackout recovery, jeneratörleri ve ana: Blackout recovery is the process of bringing the generators and the main engine back into service step by step. The engineer starts the standby generator, energizes the busbar and loads the consumers in sequence; the main engine is restarted. The Oiler provides on-site support in re-establishing pumps, lubrication and cooling, monitors fuel/starting air pressure and carries out the engineer's instructions.
Blackout tatbikatı ISM Code (SMS) gereği: Blackout drills must be carried out regularly as required by the ISM Code (SMS).
Blackout, tüm ana güç kaynağının kaybedi: A blackout is the loss of all main power; the ship is plunged into darkness and left immobile. In this case, the emergency generator starts automatically and supplies the critical loads (emergency lighting, steering gear, communications, fire pump). The recovery procedure includes diagnosing the cause, manual/automatic start of the generators, stepwise load acceptance and restarting the main engine.
Blackout, tüm ana jeneratörlerin güç kay: A blackout is when all main generators lose power and the ship is left without electricity and immobile. Causes may be a generator trip (overload, fault), interruption of the fuel supply, an automation fault or a main switchboard problem. At the moment of blackout, the emergency generator cuts in automatically and supplies the critical loads; the recovery process starts immediately.
Blackout, tüm jeneratörlerin devre dışı: A blackout is the loss of the ship's electrical power when all generators drop off line; the main engine stops, the steering gear and pumps do not work, and the ship loses navigational control. This is a very dangerous situation, especially in confined waters/during maneuvering. The emergency generator starts automatically and supplies the critical consumers (steering gear, emergency lighting, communications).
Blackout, özellikle dar suda veya manevr: A blackout is most dangerous in confined waters or during maneuvering; the ship rapidly loses maneuvering and steering capability, and a risk of collision/grounding arises. For this reason, the engine room is put on standby before maneuvering (an extra generator in parallel), and the speed of recovery is critical. Immediate coordination between the bridge and the engine room is essential.
Blower'lar gazı tank atmosferine basar;: The blowers deliver the gas to the tank atmosphere; typical pressure 800–1500 mmWC.
Boiler water treatment, kazan suyu kalit: Boiler water treatment prevents corrosion and scale formation by keeping the boiler water quality (pH, alkalinity, chloride, conductivity) within the correct range. Regular blow-down (bottom/surface blow-down) removes accumulated deposits and sludge. The Second Engineer manages these tests and the chemical dosing.
Boiler/cooling water kimyasalları, solve: Boiler/cooling water chemicals, solvents, paints and oils are labeled, their MSDS/SDS are kept accessible and they are stored in suitable compartments. Incompatible chemicals are kept apart; a spill kit is kept ready in case of spillage.
Bollard: a fixed post to which a line is made fast. It may be single, double or T-type. Its SWL is marked on it.
Booster pompa, uzun hat veya yüksek term: A booster pump is added in series with the main pump to maintain the flow with long lines or high back pressure from the terminal. A stripping pump takes the last liquid from the tank bottom (the low level that the centrifugal pump cannot take); it is usually a positive displacement pump or an eductor.
Booster pompası: terminalin manifold bas: Booster pump: connected in series at the main pump outlet to raise the line pressure if the terminal manifold pressure is high.
Borda iskelesi ve erişim ekipmanlarının: Rigging the accommodation ladder and other access equipment is a task that looks ordinary, but neglecting it can lead directly to death. The AB's discipline is shown in rigging every step of the pilot ladder, every guardrail of the gangway and every lashing of the safety net according to the rules. Whether a pilot, a crew member or a visitor gets on and off the ship safely depends on the AB's approach of rigging "exactly right, not roughly right".
Borda iskelesi, merdiven ve erişim ekipm: Maintenance of accommodation ladders, ladders and access equipment is one of the Bosun's most sensitive duties, as it relates directly to the safety of life. Certified equipment, correct rigging, a secondary safety line and constant supervision ensure that every embarkation/disembarkation and every overside job is completed safely.
Boru hatları renk kodlarıyla işaretlenir: Pipelines are marked with color codes (according to the type of fluid) and the flow direction is shown by arrows. By physically following a pipeline (line tracing), the cadet learns the path of a system from source to consumer; this is a basic skill for valve alignment and fault isolation.
Boru hatları renk koduyla işaretlidir (y: Pipelines are marked with a color code (fire line red, sea water green, etc.); cleaning helps keep these markings readable. If a loose bolt, cracked insulation or corrosion is noticed on a surface being wiped, it is reported to the engineer.
Boru onarımında doğru ölçü almak işin ya: In pipe repairs, taking correct measurements is half the job. The Fitter determines the routing, diameter, wall thickness and material (steel, galvanized, copper-nickel, stainless) of the existing line. The pipe is cut with a pipe cutting machine or a grinder; after cutting, the end is reamed (deburring) to remove burrs and any internal obstruction to flow.
Borularda ve silindir gömleğinde radyal: Heat transfer in the radial direction in pipes and cylinder liners is calculated with a logarithmic relationship.
Bosun's chair ile yüksekte (aloft) veya: Working aloft or overside in a bosun's chair is high-risk work; the integrity of the rope/chair, a separate safety line (independent lifeline), a full body harness and a permit to work are mandatory. The Bosun checks these preparations and does not let inexperienced personnel work aloft unsupervised.
Bosun's chair'da çalışan kişi ayrıca har: A person working in a bosun's chair also uses a harness + independent fall arrest (attached to a separate safety line); relying on the chair's rope alone is a single-point-of-failure risk. When rigging a stage or scaffolding, an independent lifeline and a harness are also required. The AB always applies the "two independent systems" principle.
Bosun's store yönetimi, dışarıdan basit: Although managing the bosun's store may look from the outside like a simple "storekeeping job", it is in fact a discipline that directly determines the ship's maintenance capability. Having the right material ready at the right time, safely and traceably, keeps planned maintenance running without interruption, keeps the crew safe and lets the ship pass inspections without problems.
Bosun's store, geminin baş tarafında (ge: The Bosun's store is a closed compartment in the forward part of the ship (usually under the forecastle) where rope, wire, paint, chemicals, hand tools, securing gear and small spare parts are stored. For the Bosun, this store is the logistical heart that sets the pace of daily work: if the right material is not at hand at the right time, planned maintenance stops and work orders fall behind.
Bourdon tüpü, basınç uygulandığında açıl: A Bourdon tube is a C-shaped or helical metal tube that tends to straighten when pressure is applied. The tip of the tube moves the pointer through a gear mechanism. It is mechanical, reliable and cheap, and is the most common pressure gauge in a ship's engine room.
Bow thruster arızası sık manevra yapan f: On a ferry that manoeuvres frequently, a bow thruster failure makes berthing much harder.
Bow visor + ramp: baş tarafta açılan kap: Bow visor + ramp: doors opening at the bow; the visor gives weathertight protection and the ramp is used for loading.
Bow/stern door açık/kapalı ve kilitli du: The open/closed and locked status of the bow and stern doors must be shown continuously on the bridge (indication system); there may also be leak detection or TV monitoring for water ingress. The ship cannot proceed to sea until the door is fully closed and locked; this is ensured by procedure and by the indicators.
Bowl ağır ve hassas bir parçadır; doğru: The bowl is a heavy and delicate part; correct lifting technique and balanced assembly are important. An unbalanced bowl creates dangerous vibration at high speed. In purifier maintenance, the cadet sees the direct relationship of cleanliness and precision with efficiency.
Bowl bileşenleri (bowl hood, sliding bow: The bowl components (bowl hood, sliding bowl bottom, disc stack, top disc, distributor) are dismantled in sequence; since each part is marked/numbered, it is refitted in the same sequence. The discs are cleaned one by one (with a suitable solvent/brush) without being scratched or deformed. The number and sequence of the discs in the stack are critical; a missing disc or a wrong sequence impairs separation.
Bowl montajında işaret hizalaması (match: When the bowl is assembled, the matchmarks are aligned and the tightening torque follows the manufacturer's values exactly. Incorrect assembly creates a risk of imbalance (vibration), water leakage or bursting. In these high-speed machines, imbalance is extremely dangerous.
Boya inceltme oranı (genelde max %5-10),: The thinning ratio (usually max 5-10%), mixing time, pot life (4-6 hours for epoxies) and application method (brush, roller, airless spray) are determined according to the product's TDS (Technical Data Sheet).
Boya kovaları, kimyasal bidonları, kayna: Paint tins, chemical drums, welding electrode stubs and other operational waste (category F) must not be discharged into the sea; they are stored separately as hazardous waste and delivered to a suitable facility. Chemical waste is managed in accordance with the MSDS; incorrect mixing creates a risk of fire or chemical reaction. The Chief Officer supervises the correct storage of this waste.
Boya programı ve korozyon yönetimi, Reis: The painting program and corrosion management are tasks through which the Bosun contributes directly to the ship's structural life. Good surface preparation, the correct coating system and respect for weather conditions build a lasting defense that protects steel from corrosion and secures the ship's long-term health.
Boya sistemi bir kalkandır: önce yüzey h: The paint system is a shield: first the surface is prepared, then the primer, intermediate coat and top coat are applied. When one of these layers breaks down, corrosion advances silently underneath. The AB's job is to keep this shield intact: removing rust early and restoring protection with the right paint.
Boya sistemi katmanlıdır: astar (primer): The paint system is layered: the primer adheres to the steel and forms the first barrier against corrosion; the intermediate coat provides thickness and barrier; the top coat gives UV, abrasion and cosmetic protection. For each coat, the thickness, drying time and overcoating interval given in the manufacturer's technical data sheet (TDS) are followed. Applying the next coat too early spoils the coat underneath.
Boya sistemi katmanlıdır: primer (yapışm: The paint system is layered: primer (adhesion/corrosion protection), intermediate (thickness/barrier) and topcoat (outer protection/appearance). The Bosun applies the coat sequence in accordance with the paint scheme, the dry film thickness (DFT) and the overcoating intervals between coats. The wrong sequence or insufficient thickness shortens the protection life.
Boya stoğu batch number, üretim/son kull: Paint stock is recorded by batch number, production/expiry date and system (primer/intermediate/topcoat). When a painting program is being planned, the Bosun calculates from the store stock how many liters are needed to reach the target DFT; if there is a shortfall, the Bosun raises a requisition in time.
Boya tatbiki için ortam koşulları kritik: Ambient conditions are critical for applying paint: the surface temperature must be at least 3 °C above the dew point, relative humidity below 85%, air temperature above +5 °C, and there must be no rain or salt spray. The Bosun measures these parameters with a psychrometer and a temperature probe. Paint applied in the wrong conditions comes off within 6 months.
Boya, hava ve yüzey koşulları uygun oldu: Paint is applied when the air and surface conditions are suitable. The surface temperature should generally be at least 3°C above the dew point; otherwise moisture condenses on the surface and the paint does not hold. Humidity, temperature and wind are measured. The Bosun plans the application according to these conditions.
Boya, tiner, gres, oksijen-asetilen tüpl: Flammable/dangerous materials such as paint, thinner, grease, oxygen-acetylene cylinders and solvents are kept in suitable, ventilated stores away from sparks. On open deck, gas cylinders are secured upright and firmly (with chains/clamps); oxygen and fuel gas cylinders are kept apart.
Boya, tiner, solvent ve epoxy sertleştir: Paints, thinners, solvents and epoxy hardeners are flammable and are usually kept in a separate paint locker with ventilation and a fire-extinguishing system. The Bosun enforces the ban on smoking/naked flames in this space and checks that the ventilation works and that spillage precautions are in place. Opened paint tins are closed tightly; a mix whose pot life has expired is disposed of, treated not as waste but as a safety risk.
Boya, yağ veya kimyasal döküntüsünün den: Paint, oil or chemical spills getting into the sea is a serious MARPOL violation. During maintenance, the scuppers are plugged (plug + putty), and when the work is finished the deck is cleaned and drained in a controlled way. Save-all trays are kept ready during oil/paint transfers.
Boya, üreticinin belirttiği sıcaklık ve: Paint is applied within the temperature and humidity range specified by the manufacturer. In very cold weather, drying takes longer and adhesion is poor; in very hot weather, the solvent evaporates too early and the film does not form properly. No painting is done in rain, sea spray or high humidity. During application, the AB keeps the film thickness even by eye, taking care not to leave sags, pinholes or missed spots.
Boyanın tutması, tümüyle yüzey hazırlığı: Paint adhesion depends entirely on surface preparation. The surface is cleaned by chipping, grinding and descaling (removal of scale/rust); loose rust, old paint and salt residues are removed. The Bosun ensures that the preparation level (e.g. Sa 2.5 blast cleanliness) is in line with the plan. On a poorly prepared surface, even the best paint will not hold.
Boyle yasası (PV = sabit) izotermik süre: Boyle's law (PV = constant) gives the pressure-volume relationship of an isothermal process.
Bozucu etki ölçülerek kontrol eylemine ö: The disturbance is measured and reflected in the control action in advance. It is used together with feedback.
Boğaz, kanal ve dar geçişlerde (Çanakkal: In straits, canals and narrow passages (the Turkish Straits, Suez, Panama, the Singapore Strait, the Dover Strait) the Master is on the bridge in person and usually takes the con directly. The bridge team is standard and drilled: the helmsman at the wheel (autopilot off), the Second Officer monitoring the position, the Third Officer on lookout or assisting, and the Master in command. If there is a pilot, the pilot's advice is assessed; the Master remains in command.
Boş yakıt tankı, kazan, krank karteri, s: Entry into enclosed spaces such as empty fuel tanks, boilers, crankcases, bilge wells and cofferdams is made under an enclosed space entry permit. Before entry, the atmosphere is measured: O2 20.9%, LEL 0%, toxic gases (H2S, CO) within safe limits. Continuous ventilation, a standby person (attendant), communications and a rescue plan are mandatory.
Boşalan veya kullanılan her tüp derhal r: Every extinguisher that has been discharged or used is refilled immediately, and a spare extinguisher is hung at the station in the meantime. CO2 and dry powder extinguishers are weighed annually; a weight loss of more than 10% requires refilling. The shell is subject to a hydrostatic test every 5–10 years according to the manufacturer's/flag requirements. All work is documented with date-stamped labels and records.
Boşaltma planı; pompa line-up'ını, termi: The discharge plan covers the pump line-up, the terminal rate limit, stripping of the tanks without any MARPOL violation and measurement of the ROB (remaining on board). At the end of discharge the tank bottoms are stripped and the lines drained with the eductor or stripping pump.
Boşaltma sırasında IG, inen sıvının yeri: During discharge, inert gas fills the space left by the falling liquid (the tank does not go into vacuum). During loading, the displaced gas is vented. Tank cleaning (COW/washing) is done in an inert atmosphere; the purging and gas-freeing procedures are controlled by O₂ and hydrocarbon measurements.
Boşaltma sırasında tank seviyesi düştükç: During discharge, inert gas takes the place of the cargo as the tank level falls; the tank is kept at positive pressure (typically around +200 mmWG). Negative pressure can let outside air in and cause the tank to implode.
Boşaltmadan önce pompa-hat-valf hattı (l: Before discharge the pump, line and valve line-up is verified; a wrong valve position causes contamination or a pressure surge. The pumps are primed to remove air and prevent cavitation.
Brake (fren) ayarı kritiktir: MEG4'e gör: The brake setting is critical: according to MEG4, the winch brake is set to "render" (slip, relieving the tension) at a specified percentage of the line's MBL (Minimum Breaking Load), so that under excessive tension the brake slips before the line parts. The AB carries out the brake holding (rendering) test and applies the correct brake pressure on the Bosun's instructions.
Breast line: Gemiden rıhtıma dik olarak: Breast line: a line leading from the ship to the quay at right angles. It keeps the ship close to the quay.
Bridge Mate DP konsepti, yedeklilik ve a: Using a distributed architecture that stresses the philosophies of redundancy and separation, and keeping cabling to a minimum, the Bridge Mate DP concept can be integrated into the operator's chair. The DP Chair puts full control of the ship at the operator's fingertips through a 15-inch touch-screen monitor built into the armrest.
Bridge Mate DP sistemine bağımsız bir jo: An independent joystick system can be interfaced to the Bridge Mate DP system. This independence is operationally critical: when the DP control path is lost, the ability to manoeuvre with the joystick is preserved as a separate path.
An independent joystick system can be interfaced to the Bridge Mate DP system. This is operationally important because it provides a separate means of manoeuvring when the DP control path is lost.
Bridge Mate JX sistemi DP 0'a kolayca yü: The Bridge Mate JX system can easily be upgraded to DP 0, because the thruster and sensor cabling and interface are the same in both systems. Similarly, a DP 0 system can be upgraded to a higher class by adding more of the same hardware components for increased redundancy. Upgrading from DP 1 to DP 2 is also straightforward; both types of system use the same hardware modules and only the number of units differs.
Bridge Mate JX sistemi de aynı dağıtık m: The Bridge Mate JX system is also based on the same distributed architecture and can be upgraded to DP 0, because the thruster and sensor cabling and interface are the same in both systems.
Bridge Mate Thruster Control System, üç: The Bridge Mate Thruster Control System uses three control computers and redundant communication networks. It is compatible with most types of thruster, engine and rudder, and works integrated with autopilot and joystick systems.
Bridge Mate ailesi DP'nin yanında itici: Besides DP, the Bridge Mate family also covers thruster control, the integrated bridge and position reference sensors. Knowing which products are installed on board is necessary to understand which layer is affected when a fault is assessed.
Bridge Resource Management (BRM); açık i: Bridge Resource Management (BRM) covers open communication, task sharing, cross-checking and a "speak up" culture. Most groundings arise from an error chain that develops because someone in the team noticed the risk but did not speak up.

Bridge Resource Management (BRM) covers open communication, task sharing, cross-checking, situational awareness and a "speak up / challenge and response" culture. Everyone on the bridge — including the helmsman, the lookout and junior officers — must speak up when they notice a risk, and the hierarchy must not prevent this. Most collisions arise from an error chain that develops because someone in the team did not share a risk they had seen.
Bridge Resource Management ve Engine-roo: Bridge Resource Management and Engine-room Resource Management became mandatory competences with the STCW Manila amendments. The basic principles are a clear division of roles (who has the con, who navigates, who keeps the lookout, who handles communications), closed-loop communication (an order given is confirmed by being repeated back), sharing situational awareness within the team, and error-trapping mechanisms (cross-checking, monitoring).
Bridge Resource Management; köprüüstünde: Bridge Resource Management is the discipline of ensuring safe navigation through the effective use of all resources on the bridge (people, equipment, information). The error chain concept describes the small errors and ignored signs that line up one after another on the path to an accident; an intervention that breaks any link in the chain prevents the accident. The Second Officer teaches the team to recognize the typical warning signs of the chain.
Bridge audio: conning station, radar/ECD: Bridge audio: coverage that distinguishes speech and audible alarms at the conning station, the radar/ECDIS and the communication workstations.
Bridge fitting: yan yana iki container'ı: Bridge fitting: locks two adjacent containers together at their top corners.
Bridge ve engine room watchkeeper'lar iç: For bridge and engine room watchkeepers, duty-specific familiarization (equipment, alarms, procedures) is also carried out as required by STCW. The Safety Officer ensures that the safety part has been completed and recorded; without this record, a new crew member should not be put on watch.
Brifing kayda geçer; katılımcılar imzala: The briefing is recorded and the participants sign. This is evidence both for safety and for inspections. The Chief Officer observes whether the team's morale and attention are as they should be and whether there are any signs of fatigue.
Brifing tek yönlü değildir; kaptan ve di: The briefing is not one-way; the Master and the other officers ask questions and test the assumptions (challenge and response). This lets the team catch a risk that one person has overlooked.
Brifing; alarm sinyalleri, muster statio: The safety briefing covers the alarm signals, the muster station, how to put on a lifejacket and the escape route; it is reinforced on the cabin TV and through public announcements and videos. It is given shortly after departure.
Broaching ve pooping (kıçtan dalga binme: Broaching and pooping (seas boarding over the stern) are dangerous in a following sea. The Chief Officer is prepared for these risks with regard to cargo/lashing; the final maneuvering decision lies with the bridge, but preparation on the deck side is critical.
Bronz (Cu-Sn): Yüksek aşınma direnci. Ya: Bronze (Cu-Sn): high wear resistance. Bearing bushes.
Brushless alternatörlerde rotating diode: In brushless alternators, the rotating diode bridge is a critical component; an open-circuit or short-circuited diode causes voltage fluctuation and loss of excitation. The ETO periodically tests the diodes with an RDFM (Rotating Diode Failure Monitor) or by offline measurement. Bu riske karşı pratik panzehir; bağımsız: The practical antidote to this risk is independent cross-checking. Bu rollerin gerçek bir acilde işe yarama: These roles can only work in a real emergency through realistic and regular drills. The Safety Officer plans drills with a wide variety of scenarios and also rehearses their own role; drills held only on paper turn into panic when it really matters.
Bu somut eşikler, vardiya zabitinin \"no: These concrete thresholds make it easier for the engineer officer of the watch to distinguish between a "normal deviation" and a "situation requiring action", and prevent late intervention.
Bu sorumluluk; aylık/haftalık kontrol ru: This responsibility takes the form of monthly/weekly check routines, annual/certified servicing, defect records and the procurement of missing or expired items. Bu sorunların çözümü reaktif değil önley: The solution to these problems is preventive, not reactive: obtain the complete certificate when leaving each ship, check the fields, enter the dates in your personal record sheet, learn the Administration's rules at the start of the voyage and track course validity with a calendar. Bu süreklilik, geminin yedek parça güven: This continuity ensures that the reliability of the ship's spare parts does not depend on a single person. A well-kept inventory and a clear handover enable the new Chief Engineer to make the right decisions from day one.
Bu süreklilik, sorunun gece gözden kaçma: This continuity prevents the problem from being missed and growing during the night. The Chief Engineer clearly writes down the items being followed up and the intervention thresholds.
Bu testler genellikle idrar (urine) bazl: These tests are usually carried out with urine-based multi-panel immunoassay test kits, which are kept on board. Bu vaka, zaman baskısında doğru kararın: This case shows that under time pressure the right decision comes from team discipline, not individual speed. Being fast is different from rushing; fast teams are teams that do not skip the standard procedure.
Bu vardiyalarda İkinci Zabit ayrıca seyi: On these watches, the Second Officer also has the opportunity to take star sights (celestial fix) in the short window (civil/nautical twilight) when the navigational stars are visible; this window, when the horizon and the stars can be seen at the same time, is the classic time for obtaining an astronomical position. Bu yetki soyut bir hak değil, iletişim d: This authority is not an abstract right but a tool tied to communication discipline. When the Master uses the overriding authority, he or she does not simply say "I am not doing it" but notifies the DPA in writing of the reasons, the alternative plan and the risk. Companies examine the records of the use of this authority in ISM internal audits; it never having been used is sometimes regarded as a sign of a "culture of fear".
Bu yetkinin kullanılması nadiren popüler: Using this authority is rarely a popular decision; but the Master not holding back when he or she should have is the common theme of fatal accidents. In ISM internal audits companies examine "records of the use of the overriding authority"; even its never having been used is sometimes seen as a sign of a "culture of fear".

Buhar gemilerinde ve LNG taşıyıcılarda a: It is used as the main propulsion boiler on steamships and LNG carriers; it produces superheated steam with a superheater.
Buhar kollektörü ve dağıtım hatları: izo: Steam manifold and distribution lines: insulated, with drain valves.
Buhar kondenserler, yağ soğutucular ve y: Steam condensers, oil coolers and fuel heaters are built in this type.
Buhar tuzağı, oluşan kondensi ve havayı: A steam trap lets condensate and air pass but holds back steam, so that the heat stays in the consumer and the line is protected from water hammer. A faulty trap stuck open wastes steam (loss of energy); one stuck closed stops the heating.
Buhar türbini: Üretilen buharla elektrik: Steam turbine: generates electricity with the steam produced.
Buhar ısıtıcılarda kondensat hattındaki: On steam heaters, the condensate line is checked for traces of oil (internal heater leak); if fuel leaks into the steam side, the boiler becomes contaminated. Tests and checks are recorded together with heater maintenance.
Buharlaşan su kondenserde yoğuşarak tatl: The evaporated water condenses in the condenser to give fresh water. The brine is discharged continuously.
Bulaşma belirtisi tespit edilirse aşçı d: If signs of infestation are detected, the cook immediately informs the Master and destroys the affected products; the source of the infestation (hole, crack, open container) is identified and sealed. Widespread infestation requires professional fumigation/ULV treatment, which is coordinated with the port health authority. The detailed pest control procedure is covered in a separate task; store organization is the preventive side of this work.
Bulaşıcı hastalık şüphesi olan veya kan/: Laundry from a suspected infectious case, or contaminated with blood/body fluids, is collected and processed separately without being mixed with other laundry. These textiles are handled with gloves, kept in a separate bag and washed at high temperature (above 60°C where possible) so that they are disinfected. Shaking them out is prohibited; shaking spreads microorganisms into the air. Afterwards, hands are washed and the equipment used is disinfected.
Bulaşıcı hastalık şüphesinde IHR 2005 ka: If an infectious disease is suspected, isolation, hygiene measures and notification to the port health authority are required under IHR 2005. The Second Officer supports the Master and the health authority with patient isolation, contact tracing and hygiene measures.
Bulaşıcı hastalık şüphesinde kamarot, ar: If an infectious disease is suspected, the steward applies enhanced disinfection protocols: frequent and intensive disinfection, particularly of toilets, shared surfaces and the patient's room. The steward uses suitable PPE (gloves, mask), collects contaminated waste separately and works in a way that prevents cross-contamination.
Bulaşık alanı her vardiya sonunda temizl: The dishwashing area is cleaned at the end of each working period; the sink, worktop and floor are sanitized. Food waste is separated in accordance with MARPOL Annex V and emptied without delay. Cooking oil and grease are collected separately and are not poured down the drain. A tidy dishwashing area is the measure of the galley's overall hygiene.
Bulaşık makinesi varsa, doğru kullanım k: Where a dishwasher is fitted, correct use is critical: plates are first roughly scraped and loaded correctly (the water jets must reach every surface), the correct detergent and rinse-aid dosage is ensured and the machine's wash/rinse temperature is checked. In industrial machines, the rinse water should be about 82-85°C; this temperature provides sanitization.
Bulaşık ve mutfak desteği görünürde sıra: Dishwashing and galley support may look ordinary, but they are in fact the cornerstone of food safety on board. A correctly washed plate, a correctly separated cutting board and a clean galley quietly prevent an outbreak. Doing this task meticulously protects both the health of the crew and the ship's uninterrupted voyage.
Bulgu açılırsa, denetçinin gerekçesi anl: If a finding is raised, the inspector's reasoning is understood and, where possible, the finding is corrected on the spot (on-the-spot correction). For findings that cannot be corrected immediately, an action plan with a timeline is presented.
Bulgular fotoğraflanır ve raporlanır. Gl: Findings are photographed and reported. Glazing (a shiny mirror-like surface) disrupts the oil film and reduces ring conformability; scuffing (longitudinal scratches/burn marks), if it progresses, leads to seizure. At the first signs, the Second Engineer recommends to the Chief Engineer a feed rate adjustment, a running-in procedure or honing of the liner.
Bulgular, derecelendirilmiş (bilgi / izl: Findings are reported to the Chief Engineer in graded form (information / monitor / immediate action). In emergencies (LO pressure drop, oil mist alarm, scavenge fire), the engine is first brought to a safe condition, the bridge is informed, and only then does diagnosis begin.
Bulk Jupiter vakası, liquefaction'ın gem: The Bulk Jupiter casualty showed that liquefaction can capsize a ship.
Bulk Jupiter, nem içeriği fazla olan bau: The Bulk Jupiter capsized after its bauxite cargo, which had too high a moisture content, lost its stability (18 dead). The container ship MOL Comfort broke in two because of hull strength problems. Two lessons: the shipper's declaration is questioned; strength limits are a line that is never compromised.
Bulk carrier'larda ana risk liquefaction: On bulk carriers the main risks are liquefaction, structural overstress and hold flooding. On tankers, fire and explosion, static electricity, inadequate inert gas and pollution stand out. On container ships the basic hazards are lashing failure, mis-declared DG and parametric rolling. The Master knows the risk profile of the ship type and concentrates supervision accordingly.
Bulk gemilerde hold yıkama suları (cargo: On bulk carriers, hold washing water (containing cargo residues) is subject to HME (Harmful to the Marine Environment) classification according to the type of cargo. If the cargo is HME, the washing water must not be discharged into the sea and is delivered to a reception facility. The Chief Officer determines, from the IMSBC/shipper information, whether the cargo is HME and records this in GRB Part II.
Bulk gemilerinde \"alternate hold loadin: If "alternate hold loading" is to be used on a bulk carrier, the combinations approved in the class-approved Loading Manual are followed strictly. The loss of the container ship MOL Comfort (2013), which broke in two, is a well-known example of how a hull girder loaded beyond its real capacity can lead to the loss of a ship.
Bulk gemilerinde BLU Code, ship-shore ch: On bulk carriers the BLU Code requires the ship-shore checklist and the loading/unloading plan to be agreed and signed with the terminal. High loading rates can create overstress in a short time; if the terminal speeds up outside the plan, the Master uses the authority to slow down or stop the operation.
Bulk gemilerinde kapalı alan ölümleri ya: Deaths in enclosed spaces are common on bulk carriers; enclosed space drills are never neglected.
Bulk ve genel kargo gemilerinde hatch co: On bulk carriers and general cargo ships, the hatch covers are the primary defense against water ingress. The Chief Officer verifies that all hatch covers are fully closed, the cleats are secured and the cross-joint/peripheral seals (rubber gaskets) are intact. A damaged or crushed seal leads to hold flooding in heavy weather.
Bulk ve genel kargoda BLU Code (Code of: For bulk and general cargo, agreement is reached with the terminal on the loading plan, sequence and rate within the framework of the BLU Code (Code of Practice for the Safe Loading and Unloading of Bulk Carriers). An excessive loading rate or a wrong sequence by the terminal carries a risk of exceeding strength limits; the Master and the Chief Officer agree the authority to stop with the terminal from the outset.
Bulker ve genel kargo tarafında RightShi: On the bulk carrier and general cargo side, RightShip inspections are common; the ship's age, past PSC record, casualty history and physical condition produce a risk score. The Chief Officer keeps deck/hold maintenance, the condition of lashing equipment and the documentation ready against these criteria.
Bunker Delivery Note (BDN), alınan yakıt: The Bunker Delivery Note (BDN) documents the quantity, type and sulfur content of the fuel received; it is kept on board as required by MARPOL Annex VI. The ORB Part I records all oil operations. Tank levels, quantities received/transferred and discharge records must be consistent with each other; in an inspection, a contradiction is regarded as a "suspicious record".
Bunker analiz raporu (CCAI, density, sül: The bunker analysis report (CCAI, density, sulfur, water, ash, cat fines/Al+Si) is evaluated. High cat fines (aluminum+silicon) cause abrasive wear of liners and injection equipment; settling/service tank and purifier performance are therefore critical.
Bunker barç/terminal ile pre-transfer to: A pre-transfer meeting is held with the bunker barge/terminal: starting/maximum pumping rate, topping-up rate, communication method (VHF channel + hand signals), emergency stop signal, hose connection point and maximum allowable pressure. The Second Engineer and the barge representative sign the Bunkering Safety Checklist (based on ISGOTT) together.
Bunker başlarken düşük debiyle (slow rat: Bunkering starts at a slow rate; the rate is increased after the tightness of the connections and flow to the correct tank have been verified. The Oiler stands at the manifold and continuously watches the flange, hose and valve connections, reporting even the slightest weeping/leak. A separate person monitors the tank levels (sounding/ullage or level gauge).
Bunker boyunca sürekli akıştan (drip/con: Throughout bunkering, the MARPOL sample is taken from the continuous flow (drip/continuous drip sampler); this sample is sealed, labeled and retained on board for at least 12 months (or as required by the rules). In addition, a fuel quality sample is taken for laboratory testing and sent promptly for the ISO 8217 parameters (density, viscosity, water, sulfur, ash, CCAI, catalytic fines Al+Si, flash point).
Bunker nomination şirket/charterer taraf: The bunker nomination is given by the company/charterer: fuel type (e.g. VLSFO ≤0.50% S or MGO), quantity, supplier and port. The Second Engineer verifies the current ROB (by tank soundings), distributes the quantity to be received among the tank capacities and calculates the 95–98% filling limit and the allowance for thermal expansion (temperature expansion). The plan makes clear which tank is to be filled in which order, the valve line-up and the high alarm levels for preventing overflow.
Bunker operasyonunda Baş Mühendis bizzat: During bunkering, the Chief Engineer personally supervises the process: the BDN (Bunker Delivery Note), continuous drip sampling (4-way sampler), the pre-bunker checklist (SOLAS + MARPOL Annex VI), communication with the barge, the vapor line (if any), the ship's tank levels and the ROB (Remaining On Board) records.
Bunker spill durumunda SOPEP derhal devr: In the event of a bunker spill, the SOPEP is activated immediately: the discharge is stopped, the source is shut off, absorbent/booms are deployed, and the port authority and the company DPA are informed at once. Fast and honest reporting is the most important factor in reducing penalties.
Bunker sırasında sürekli izleme yapılır:: During bunkering, continuous monitoring is carried out: tank levels, flow rate (loading rate), overflow tank condition and line leaks. The emergency stop signal is agreed in advance. By following the bunkering operation under supervision, the cadet learns both the technical and the safety aspects; however, valve/pump control rests with authorized personnel.
Bunker sırasında, MARPOL Annex VI ve şir: During bunkering, a representative fuel sample is taken (usually with a continuous drip sampler at the manifold) as required by MARPOL Annex VI and company procedure. This sealed sample (MARPOL sample) is kept and, if necessary, sent for laboratory analysis in the event of a dispute. It is recorded together with the Bunker Delivery Note (BDN).
Bunker tanklarından alınan yakıt ilk ola: Fuel taken from the bunker tanks is first transferred to the settling tank. There, water and heavy particles settle to the bottom under gravity.
Bunker tesliminde Bunker Delivery Note (: On bunker delivery, the Bunker Delivery Note (BDN) documents the quantity, density, sulfur content and delivery details of the fuel; under MARPOL Annex VI it is retained for a set period. During delivery, the MARPOL sample (representative sample) is taken and sealed; in a dispute or a PSC inspection, this sample is analyzed.
Bunker öncesi Baş Mühendis bir pre-trans: Before bunkering, the Chief Engineer applies a pre-transfer checklist (based on ISGOTT/SMS): all valve line-ups must be verified, the overflow tank empty, save-all trays and scuppers plugged (closed), SOPEP equipment ready, fire extinguishers in place, the emergency stop signal agreed and communication with the barge (VHF/radio) tested. Duties are assigned to all deck personnel.
Bunker öncesi kapsamlı hazırlık yapılır:: Thorough preparation is made before bunkering: the bunker plan (how much into which tank, sequence), verification of tank levels and available capacity (ullage), checking that the air vent pipes are clear, checking the manifold connections, plugging the scuppers, placing drip trays and having the SOPEP material ready. The Ship-Shore (or ship-barge) Safety Checklist is completed and the communication/emergency stop signal is agreed.
Bunker öncesi tank planı, kapasite hesab: Before bunkering, the tank plan, capacity calculation, communications and emergency stop method are agreed with the other party. The deck scuppers are plugged, the drip trays are emptied and the SOPEP equipment is kept ready.
Bunker öncesi tüm güverte scupper'ları (: Before bunkering, all deck scuppers are plugged/blanked so that any spill cannot reach the sea. Drip trays are placed under the manifold and hose connection, with absorbent inside. SOPEP equipment (absorbent pads, rags, shovels, drums, sprayer) is kept ready and accessible. The location of the spill kit is made known to the whole team.
Bunker, dahili transfer, separatör sludg: Bunkering, internal transfers, separator sludge, settling tank draining and the other relevant fuel operations are entered in the Oil Record Book Part I. Entries are made completely and on time, with date, tank, quantity and operation code. The Second Engineer oversees the accuracy of the entries together with the Chief Engineer; ORB inconsistencies are among the most common PSC/USCG findings.
Bunker, transfer ve bilge operasyonları: Bunkering, transfer and bilge operations involve oily liquids and are therefore the jobs with the highest risk of marine pollution. MARPOL Annex I prohibits oil pollution from the engine room under strict rules; the oil content of bilge water that may be discharged into the sea must not exceed 15 ppm (parts per million), and such discharge is only possible through an approved separator + 15 ppm alarm.
Bunker, transfer ve sintine operasyonlar: Bunkering, transfer and bilge operations are jobs in which attention must not slacken even for a moment. Correct preparation, a constant watch, honest records and the discipline of "zero pollution" protect both the ship from heavy fines and the sea from pollution. A good Oiler is someone who does not forget the scupper plugs, does not take their eyes off the manifold when topping off and never bypasses an alarm. There is no hiding anything here; there is only doing it right and recording it right.
Bunkering, gemiye yakıt alınması operasy: Bunkering is the operation of taking fuel on board and carries a high risk of pollution/fire. Before the operation, the bunker plan is prepared, tank capacities and ullages are calculated, the line is checked, the valve alignment is verified, SOPEP equipment is kept ready and the scuppers (deck drain holes) are plugged. The ship-shore checklist is completed and communication is established.
Bunkering, güvertede en yüksek yağ kirli: Bunkering is the operation with the highest risk of oil pollution on deck. The Chief Officer (or the designated officer) applies the pre-bunkering checklist: scupper plugs, drip trays, manifold gasket check, ESD/communication confirmation, and monitoring of the maximum loading rate and tank capacity. Overflow is prevented by continuous ullaging/sounding; when a tank is 90% full, the rate is reduced for topping off.
Bunların yanında capacity plan (tank yer: In addition, there are the capacity plan (tank layout), the fire control plan and OEM equipment drawings (sectional views, assembly drawings). The cadet learns which question each drawing answers: "where does the fluid go?" is answered in the piping diagram, "where does the power come from?" in the electrical diagram and "where is the equipment?" in the GA.
Buz birikimi (icing) hem hacmi azaltır h: Ice build-up (icing) both reduces capacity and lowers cooling efficiency; periodic defrosting is planned. During defrosting, products are moved temporarily to another freezer/chiller so that the cold chain is not broken. The door seal and the temperature alarm are checked regularly.
Buz makinesi (ice machine) sık ihmal edi: The ice machine is a frequently neglected source of contamination; if it is not cleaned regularly, it breeds bacteria/mold. Ice is taken with a clean scoop, never directly by hand or with a glass.
Buz seyri, hazırlığın seyir emniyetini e: Ice navigation is one of the areas in which preparation most directly determines navigational safety. The Second Officer's meticulous ice monitoring, realistic route revision and cold-weather preparation make the ship resilient to the unpredictable conditions of ice.
Buz seyrinde radar (ice detection ayarla: In ice navigation, radar (ice detection settings), searchlight, binoculars and careful visual lookout are used together. Small but dangerous pieces of ice such as growlers and bergy bits give weak radar echoes; visual lookout and low speed are therefore critical.
Buz verisine göre passage plan; en az bu: Based on the ice data, the passage plan is revised to give the least ice-covered and safest transit. Open-water leads, icebreaker escort points and escape/refuge areas are identified. The plan is dynamic; the route is updated as the ice moves.
Buz; gövdeye, dümene ve pervaneye hasar: Ice can damage the hull, rudder and propeller, restricts maneuvering, reduces speed and creates the risk of besetment. Low temperatures freeze equipment, visibility drops and rescue resources are far away. For this reason, entering ice-covered waters requires a separate risk assessment and preparation.
Buzdolabı sıcaklığı (0-5°C) ve dondurucu: Refrigerator (0-5°C) and freezer (≤ -18°C) temperatures are checked regularly; doors are not left open for long. Products that are past their expiry date or spoiled are set aside and reported to the cook. A well-organized cold store prevents both safety problems and waste of stock.
Buzdolabı ve dondurucu düzeni gıda güven: The organization of refrigerators and freezers is fundamental to food safety. Raw food is always stored on the bottom shelf (so that drips do not contaminate cooked food), and cooked/ready-to-eat food on the top shelf. Storage follows the "FIFO" (first in, first out) principle: what arrives first is used first, and older stock is moved to the front. Opened food is transferred to a covered container and labeled (with the date).
Buzkıran refakatinde belirlenen mesafe v: Under icebreaker escort, the specified distance and speed are maintained; communications and signals with the icebreaker are agreed in advance. A safe following distance is kept against the risk of a sudden stop. The Second Officer enters the escort plan and communications in the passage plan.
By-pass hattındaki separatör, sistemden: The separator on the bypass line continuously draws a small flow from the system and removes water and solids. This continuous cleaning directly determines the life of the oil and the safety of the bearings.
Bölüm I: Enerji verimliliği iyileştirme: Part I: energy efficiency improvement measures (speed optimisation, trim optimisation, maintenance planning, etc.).
Bölüm II: Yakıt tüketimi veri toplama ve: Part II: the plan for collecting and reporting fuel consumption data.
Bölüm III: CII hedefi ve iyileştirme pla: Part III: CII target and improvement plan (corrective action plan mandatory for ships rated D for 3 consecutive years or rated E).
Bütçe baskısı altında protein dengesi, p: Under budget pressure, protein balance can be maintained with economical but good-quality sources such as eggs, pulses, dairy products and seafood in rotation, instead of expensive meat. Saturated fatty acids, frying and simple sugars are limited; baking/grilling/steaming are used in rotation. This looks after both health and the budget.
Bütçe sınırlıdır; Birinci Zabit, emniyet: The budget is limited; the Chief Officer puts safety-critical and survey-critical items ahead of cosmetic work. Decisions to postpone work are shared, with the reasons, with the Master and, if necessary, with the technical department.
Bütçe yönetimi bir kısıt değil bir disip: Budget management is not a constraint but a discipline: ordering correctly (not buying too much or too little), reducing waste with FIFO, making smart use of seasonal/cheap but nutritious ingredients (pulses, eggs, seasonal vegetables) and taking advantage of prices at provisioning ports all protect the budget. The aim is not the lowest cost but the highest nutritional quality within the budget.
Bütçenin en büyük sızıntısı israftır. Aş: The biggest leak in the budget is waste. The cook reduces waste at its source through FIFO rotation, correct portioning, staging fresh produce according to shelf life and using safe leftovers (with proper cooling/reheating) at the next meal. Using meat/vegetable trimmings for soup/sauce/stock (the nose-to-tail / root-to-stem approach) reduces both cost and waste.
Bütün düzenek, IMPA/SOLAS posterindeki ş: The whole arrangement must be rigged according to the diagram on the IMPA/SOLAS poster; if the pilot sees an unsafe arrangement, they may refuse the transfer, which delays the ship and/or leads to a report. The AB aims for rigging that matches the diagram exactly, not one that is "roughly right".
Büyük bir geminin durma mesafesi (stoppi: The stopping distance and turning circle of a large ship can be measured in kilometers; a VLCC may run more than a mile when stopping from full speed. Safe speed must be a speed at which the officer, knowing these maneuvering characteristics, can stop or turn away in time on seeing a danger.
Büyük bulk gemisinin durma mesafesi uzun: A large bulk carrier has a long stopping distance; decisions must be taken early.
Büyük flanş ve ana yatak gibi kritik bağ: On critical joints such as large flanges and main bearings, stepwise and cross-pattern tightening is essential; in some cases a hydraulic tensioner or the angle-tightening method is used. The cadet learns why these methods differ.
Büyük iki zamanlı makinelerde silindir y: On large two-stroke engines, cylinder lubrication is carried out in proportion to load by electronically controlled lubricators (alpha lubricator); the feed rate (g/kWh) is monitored. The Oiler verifies that the lubricator pumps are running, that the oil tank is full and that there is no no-flow alarm.
Büyük iki zamanlı makinelerde sistem yağ: In large two-stroke engines, the system oil is generally not changed completely; it is cleaned continuously by the purifier and refreshed by topping up. The oil properties (TBN, viscosity, water) are monitored by analysis; if they go outside the limits, a partial or complete change is planned. In four-stroke auxiliary engines, however, the oil is changed completely more often (according to PMS running hours).
