Büyük iki zamanlı motorlarda piston gene: On large two-stroke engines the piston usually consists of two parts: a heat-resistant steel crown and a lighter skirt. Cooling oil or water circulates inside the crown.
Büyük iki zamanlı motorlarla direkt tahr: It is widely used on ships with direct drive from large two-stroke engines.
Büyük iki-zamanlı dizel makinelerde iki: Large two-stroke diesel engines have two separate oils: system oil (crankcase lubrication, cooling) and cylinder oil (lubrication of the cylinder liner wall, dosed by the lubricators). Cylinder oil is selected with a BN (Base Number) suited to the sulfur content of the fuel; the correct BN and feed rate are critical for neutralization of the sulfur.
Büyük konteyner gemileri 1000+ reefer pr: Large container ships can carry 1000+ reefer sockets. This directly affects the generator capacity. Reefer load planning is critical for electrical load balancing.
Büyük konteyner gemileri, LNG taşıyıcıla: On ships with high power requirements, such as large container ships, LNG carriers, cruise ships and FPSOs, a 6.6 kV or 11 kV distribution system is used. A higher voltage means a lower current for the same power and therefore thinner cables.
Büyük konteyner gemilerinde WHRS, ana ma: On large container ships a WHRS can produce additional electrical power equal to about 8–11% of the main engine power.
Büyük overhaul'larda (enjektör, pompa el: In major overhauls (injectors, pump elements, bearing renewal), the maker's clearance and torque tables are the reference. Measurements are taken with calibrated tools; rubber seals are treated as single-use and renewed. The Second Engineer records the "as found / as left" values (found on dismantling / left on reassembly); this shows the rate of wear.
Büyük ticari gemilerin çoğu, doğrudan pe: Most large merchant ships use two-stroke, low-speed, crosshead-type diesel engines directly coupled to the propeller. The cadet learns the scavenging, compression, combustion (expansion) and exhaust phases, the principle of uniflow scavenging and how the crosshead keeps the side thrust off the piston.
Büyük uç yatağı ikiye bölünmüştür ve yat: The big-end bearing is split in two and the bearing clearance is set precisely.
Büyük yüklerin ani bağlanması (yük kabul: Sudden connection (load acceptance) or loss (load rejection) of large loads significantly affects the frequency. Under the IACS UR M3 class requirement, when the maximum electrical step load is switched on or off, the transient frequency variation must not exceed ±10% of the rated frequency and the frequency must return to within a 1% band within 5 seconds; on 100% load rejection, a transient variation of more than 10% may be acceptable provided it does not cause the overspeed device to operate.
Bıçak emniyeti, gemi mutfağında en sık i: Knife handling is one of the most frequent sources of occupational accidents in the ship's galley. A blunt knife is more dangerous than a sharp one because it needs more pressure and slips. Knives are kept sharp and clean and are stored correctly (knife block/magnetic strip); they are never left in the sink under the suds — a hand reaching in blindly gets a serious cut.
Bıçaklar keskin tutulur (kör bıçak daha: Knives are kept sharp (a blunt knife is more dangerous because it slips) and stored safely (magnetic strip/block). Gloves are used for hot surfaces, non-slip shoes are worn and the floor is kept dry. Ship motion increases all of these risks; this is why equipment safety and sea fastening (see the galley organization task) are considered together.
C sınıfı (gazlar): kuru kimyasal — önce: Class C (gases): dry chemical — the gas flow must be shut off first.
C-tipi Bourdon: 0-60 bar arası, Heliks B: C-type Bourdon: 0–60 bar; helical Bourdon: 60–1000 bar; spiral Bourdon: low-pressure applications.
C: reduce the load and check the cylinder.
CAMO, kritik faaliyette (dalış, ağır kal: CAMO imposes the most conservative configuration in order to keep full redundancy during critical activities (diving, heavy lifting, drilling). TAM allows operation with less equipment when the result of the WCF is acceptable for the task; but this is always based on an approved table and a risk-based decision.
CATZOC, ECDIS'te ZOC sembolleriyle (yıld: CATZOC can be displayed in ECDIS with ZOC symbols (number of stars). Querying this layer creates awareness of the risk that "the chart looks right, but the data may be old"; this is vital especially in rarely navigated waters with old surveys.
CATZOC/quality of bathymetric data ve so: CATZOC/quality of bathymetric data and the source diagram describe the survey quality and uncertainty of the depth information; safe water is not as certain as the "blue-white colour". In UKC and route decisions this quality is assessed together with squat, tide and the ship's motion.
CCAI, yakıtın yoğunluğu ve viskozitesind: The CCAI is a dimensionless number calculated from the density and viscosity of the fuel and indicates its ignition quality. A low CCAI value indicates good ignition quality.
CDI (Chemical Distribution Institute), k: CDI (Chemical Distribution Institute) is a vetting and inspection regime for chemical and gas tankers similar to that of OCIMF; the CDI-Marine report is decisive in chemical cargo owners' ship acceptance decisions. SIRE for oil tankers, CDI for chemicals and gas, RightShip for dry bulk — the Master must master the inspection logic and reporting cycle of the programme of the segment in which the ship trades.
CDI questionnaire güncel tutulur; P&A Ma: The CDI questionnaire is kept up to date; the P&A Manual, coating list and compatibility tables must be accessible. The records of the last three cargoes and of tank cleaning are checked.
CDI; kargo uyumluluğu, coating dayanımı,: A CDI inspection focuses on cargo compatibility, coating resistance, segregation and chemical safety procedures. The IBC Code and the ship-specific P&A Manual are the reference documents.
CFC'lerin 1996'da, HCFC'lerin 2030'a kad: It provides for the phase-out of CFCs in 1996 and of HCFCs by 2030 (2020 in developed countries).
CIC döneminde ilgili alandaki ekipman, k: During a CIC, the equipment, records and personnel competence in the relevant area are questioned in detail; proactive preparation directly affects the inspection result.
CIC'in incelikli yanı, normalde detentio: The subtle side of a CIC is that a finding that would not normally be a reason for detention can turn into a deficiency when an item in the CIC questionnaire is answered "No". For example, in a ballast water CIC the failure to keep the approved operating record of the BWMS, or in a fire safety CIC missing maintenance records of the fixed CO2 system, are examined throughout the campaign far more closely than usual.
CII (Carbon Intensity Indicator) ise ope: CII (Carbon Intensity Indicator), on the other hand, is an operational indicator: it is based on the ship's actual annual fuel consumption and the distance traveled. EEXI answers the question "how efficiently was the ship designed?" and CII the question "how efficiently is the ship operated in practice?".
CII = (Yıllık toplam CO₂ emisyonu) / (Ka: CII = (total annual CO₂ emissions) / (capacity × total distance travelled)
CII = Yıllık CO₂ emisyonu / (DWT × Mesaf: The CII is calculated with the formula: annual CO₂ emissions / (DWT × distance). The CO₂ emissions are obtained from fuel consumption and the carbon conversion factor.
The CII is calculated as annual CO₂ emissions / (DWT × distance). The result is compared with the reference value and rated from A (best) to E (worst).
CII hesaplaması yıllık toplam CO₂ emisyo: The CII calculation is based on relating the total annual CO₂ emissions to the transport work. Therefore not only fuel consumption but also the voyage profile, the cargo carried, the proportion of ballast voyages, waiting times and route quality affect the result.
CII iyileştirmesi için hız optimizasyonu: To improve the CII, speed optimisation, trim management, weather routing, reduced waiting in port, hull and propeller cleaning and optimisation of auxiliary engine load should be assessed together. A "just slow down" approach on its own may not be sustainable because of its commercial and safety effects.
CII rating (A-E) yıllık hesaplanır; SEEM: The CII rating (A-E) is calculated annually; the SEEMP Part III improvement plan is followed. A D rating for three consecutive years, or an E rating, requires a corrective plan.
CII yönetimi, tek departman işi değildir: CII management is not the job of a single department; it is a joint control loop of the bridge, the engine room, operations planning and the company office.
CII: Operasyonel karbon yoğunluğu izleme: CII: monitoring of operational carbon intensity.
CIP (cleaning in place) periyodik yapılı: CIP (cleaning in place) is carried out periodically; on plate heat exchangers the plates are inspected for wear and cracks. Suitable PPE is essential for CIP chemicals.
CIP kimyasalları aşındırıcıdır; SDS'e gö: CIP chemicals are corrosive; PPE and ventilation are provided according to the SDS.
CMS geminin kendi mühendisleri tarafında: Under CMS, the ship's own engineers can carry out the surveys (owner's survey) and the class surveyor confirms the results. This system reduces the workload during dry-docking periods.
CMS sistemi, ana ve yardımcı makinelerin: The CMS (continuous machinery survey) system allows the components of the main and auxiliary machinery to be surveyed progressively over a five-year period. Certain components are surveyed each year and the cycle is completed in five years.
CMS sörveyinde surveyor, kredi alınan ka: In the CMS survey, the surveyor asks for the job records, measured values and trends of the credited items. The Chief Engineer keeps the crank deflection measurements, exhaust valve/piston overhaul reports, T/C overhaul records and safety device (overspeed trip, low LO pressure trip) test records filed and accessible. Incomplete or inconsistent records lead to the item being transferred to physical survey.
CO2 boğulma riski taşır; release yalnız: CO2 can suffocate; it is released only after evacuation and a head count.
CO2 deşarjı boğulma riski taşır; release: A CO2 release can suffocate; it is made only after the space has been completely evacuated and a head count taken. The lock-out system prevents an accidental release.
CO2 sistemi yıllık serbest olmayan testl: The CO2 system is checked by annual non-release tests (blow-through of the discharge lines, alarm test, time-delay test); cylinder weighing (weight/level check) and hydrostatic testing of the hoses are periodic. The system is kept in a locked room (CO2 room) to protect it against unintended manual or erroneous release.
CO2 sistemi, makine dairesini tamamen ka: The CO2 system fills the whole engine room and smothers the fire by cutting off oxygen (usually a target concentration of 34%+). Before release: personnel out of the space (head count!), ventilation stopped, quick-closing valves closed, machinery stopped in sequence and doors/dampers closed. CO2 release is designed in two stages (pilot + main) and with a deliberate delay (pre-discharge alarm).
CO2/foam sistemi yıllık ve 5 yıllık test: The CO2 and foam systems are subject to annual and five-yearly tests; portable equipment, quick-closing valves, fire dampers and emergency stops are tested. Before a CO2 release the space is evacuated and the lock-out is applied.
CO2/foam yıllık/5 yıllık testlere tabidi: CO2 and foam systems are subject to annual and five-yearly tests; the quick-closing valves, dampers, fuel trips and emergency stops are tested. Before a CO2 release, the space is evacuated and a head count is taken.
CO2/foam/water-mist yıllık/5 yıllık test: CO2, foam and water-mist systems are subject to annual and five-yearly tests; the quick-closing valves, dampers, fuel trips and emergency stops are tested. Before a CO2 release, the space is evacuated and a head count is taken.
COLREG Kural 10, IMO tarafından kabul ed: COLREG Rule 10 requires a ship in an IMO-adopted traffic separation scheme (TSS) to proceed in the appropriate traffic lane in the general direction of traffic flow and to keep as far as practicable clear of the separation line/zone. A lane is joined or left at its termination where possible; when joining from the side is unavoidable, it is done at as small an angle to the direction of traffic flow as practicable.
COLREG Kural 19, kısıtlı görüş (restrict: COLREG Rule 19 applies to ships navigating in or near an area of restricted visibility; in this case the ship must proceed at a safe speed, keep her engines ready for maneuvering (engines ready for immediate manoeuvre) and, if radar is fitted, make systematic observations. Under Rule 19 conditions there is no "stand-on / give-way" distinction; every ship carries her own responsibility for maneuvering.
COLREG Kural 20-31, gemilerin gece göste: COLREG Rules 20-31 define the navigation lights ships show at night and the shapes they show by day. The officer of the watch must be able to read from the other ship's lights her type, size, aspect (view from ahead/astern/abeam) and intention: the combination of green-red sidelights and masthead lights shows which way the ship is heading, two red lights in a vertical line indicate NUC, and red-white-red indicates RAM.
COLREG Kural 5, her geminin her zaman gö: COLREG Rule 5 requires every ship at all times to maintain a proper and continuous lookout by sight and hearing as well as by all available appropriate means (including radar, ARPA and AIS). Lookout is not just looking ahead; it covers scanning ahead, astern, both quarters and 360 degrees around the ship, listening for sound signals and continuously assessing the instrument data.
COLREG Kural 6, her geminin çatışmayı ön: COLREG Rule 6 requires every ship to proceed at all times at a safe speed so that she can avoid collision and be stopped within a distance appropriate to the prevailing conditions. Safe speed is not a fixed value; it is determined by factors such as the state of visibility, traffic density, the ship's maneuverability, stopping distance, background lights at night, wind/sea/current and depth of water.
COLREG Kural 7, çatışma riskinin var olu: COLREG Rule 7 requires all available means to be used to determine whether risk of collision exists. The basic principle: if the compass bearing of another ship does not change appreciably, risk of collision is deemed to exist. This "constant bearing, decreasing range" (CBDR) situation is the classic indicator of collision.
COLREG Kural 8, çatışmadan kaçınma manev: COLREG Rule 8 requires action to avoid collision to be taken early (in ample time), to be substantial (readily apparent) and, if necessary, to include a change of speed. The Second Officer teaches junior officers the most common mistake: small, gradual course alterations (e.g. 2-3 degrees) are not noticed on the other ship's radar and leave the intention unclear. Instead, a clear alteration of at least 20-30 degrees is made.
COLREG Kural 8, çatışmayı önleyici manev: COLREG Rule 8 requires action to avoid collision to be taken in ample time, to be positive and to be made with due regard to good seamanship. The action must be large enough to be readily apparent to the other ship, even by radar; a succession of small alterations of course/speed is avoided, because it can lead the other ship to misinterpret the situation.
COLREG Kural 9, dar bir kanal veya su yo: COLREG Rule 9 requires a ship proceeding along a narrow channel or fairway to keep as near to the outer limit of the channel on her starboard side as is safe and practicable. Ships of less than 20 meters in length, sailing vessels and fishing vessels must not impede the passage of a ship that can navigate only within the channel.
COLREG Rule 19 ve sınırlı görüş hükümler: COLREG Rule 19 and the provisions on restricted visibility are among the root causes of most collisions. After a collision the Master has legal obligations: to assist the other ship and the persons on board, to exchange the ship's name, port of registry and ports of departure and destination, and to record the event. SOLAS V/33 and international custom require assistance to be given to the other ship as far as this can be done without endangering one's own ship.
COLREG Rule 7 (çatışma riski) ve Rule 8: Although decisions under COLREG Rule 7 (risk of collision) and Rule 8 (action to avoid collision) belong to the OOW, the accurate and timely lookout information provided by the AB is the basis for these decisions. If observations such as a steady bearing, a light coming closer or a new target appearing are reported at once, the OOW can remove the risk with an early maneuver that is large enough to be readily apparent.
COLREG kurallarını ezbere bilmek yetmez;: Knowing the COLREG rules by heart is not enough; the ability to make fast and correct decisions on a real bridge is needed. The Second Officer sets up scenarios using radar/ECDIS simulation or real traffic situations: head-on (Rule 14), crossing (Rule 15), overtaking (Rule 13) and restricted visibility (Rule 19) situations are worked through separately. In each scenario the questions are: "stand-on or give-way, which maneuver, when, and under which COLREG rule".
COP değerinin 1'den büyük olması termodi: A COP greater than 1 does not contradict thermodynamics, because the device does not "produce" heat; it takes it from a low temperature and moves it to a high temperature.
COVID, norovirus gibi bulaşıcı hastalık: During periods of infectious disease risk such as COVID or norovirus, the frequency and intensity of cleaning are increased; high-touch surfaces are disinfected more often and, if there is isolation, the areas concerned are cleaned under a separate protocol. The steward applies these enhanced protocols meticulously; in an outbreak, hygiene is the first line of defense.
COW Manual'a göre tank washing makineler: According to the COW Manual, a single-stage or multi-stage washing pattern is chosen for the tank washing machines; the machine angles (top/bottom wash) and times are set for each tank. The bottom wash directs the sediment on the tank bottom towards the stripping suction.
COW boyunca oksijen seviyesi, IGS basınc: Throughout COW, the oxygen level, IGS pressure, line pressure and leaks are monitored continuously. If the oxygen rises, the IGS fails, there are signs of a leak or fire, or air ingress is suspected, the operation is stopped IMMEDIATELY. When the AB notices an abnormality (pressure drop, smell, noise), they report it without waiting; seconds matter.
COW pompası ham petrolü 8–12 bar basınçl: The COW pump supplies crude oil to the machines at 8–12 bar.
COW sonrası tank tortusu azalmış olur; a: After COW, the sediment in the tank is reduced; however, the tank is still inert and contains hydrocarbons, and it cannot be entered. A separate gas-freeing and testing process is required before tank entry. The AB does not consider a tank "clean/safe" just because COW has finished.
COW yalnız tank O2'si %8'in altında iken: COW is carried out only while the tank O2 is below 8%. COW with high O2 can lead to an explosion caused by a static spark.
COW yalnızca tank atmosferi inert (≤%8 O: COW may only be done while the tank atmosphere is inert (O₂ ≤ 8%); otherwise the static electricity created by the crude oil jets and the hydrocarbon vapour can cause an explosion. The IGS must run continuously, O₂ must be monitored and washing must be stopped if the limit is exceeded.
COW'da sabit veya taşınabilir yıkama mak: In COW, fixed or portable washing machines spray pressurized crude oil onto the tank surfaces to dissolve the sediment (clingage) and make it pumpable; this both improves discharge efficiency and reduces the quantity of slops (waste) (as required by MARPOL Annex I). COW is carried out only when the tank is inert (low oxygen) and the IGS is working properly.
COW, doğru yapıldığında çevresel ve tica: Done correctly, COW brings environmental and commercial gains; but an inert atmosphere is a precondition without exception.
COW; clingage (duvara yapışan yağ) mikta: COW increases the outturn (quantity discharged) by reducing clingage (oil sticking to the tank walls), and reduces the need for water washing and therefore the amount of slops. MARPOL makes COW mandatory for crude oil tankers above a certain tonnage.
CO₂ boğulma riski taşır; release yalnız: CO₂ can suffocate; it is released only after evacuation and a head count, under the lock-out procedure.
CO₂ insanı boğarak öldürür. Bu yüzden de: CO₂ kills people by suffocation. Therefore, before discharge: the space is evacuated; when the release cabinet is opened, an automatic audible and visual alarm sounds and the fans, fuel supply and ventilation stop (interlock); a time delay gives people time to get out, and only then is the gas released. Discharge does not take place until a head count (muster) has been made.
CO₂ salımı iki kademeli güvenlik kontrol: CO₂ release requires a two-stage safety control (first alarm/time delay, then release); the authorized person (usually with the approval of the Chief Engineer/Master) gives the order. After release, the engine room is kept closed for a certain time (to prevent re-ignition) and is entered only with SCBA and after a gas test.
CO₂ sistemi devreye alınmadan önce: tüm: Before the CO₂ system is released: all personnel must be outside, all doors and ventilation closed, and the warning alarm given.
CO₂ yanmayı, ortamdaki oksijeni yanmayı: CO₂ extinguishes a fire by reducing the oxygen in the space to a level that cannot sustain combustion (generally below about 15%); it also gives some cooling. It does not interrupt the flammable vapour chemically but only dilutes the oxygen, so the space must be closed (sealed).
CO₂, havadaki oksijen konsantrasyonunu %: CO₂ smothers the fire by reducing the oxygen concentration in the air from 21% to below 15%. A quantity of CO₂ equal to about 40% of the engine room volume is required.
CO₂/foam sistemi yıllık/5 yıllık testler: The CO₂ and foam systems are subject to annual and five-yearly tests; the quick-closing valves, fire dampers, fuel trips and emergency stops are tested. Before a CO₂ release the space is evacuated and a head count is taken.
CO₂/köpük deşarjı öncesi havalandırma fa: Before a CO₂ or foam discharge, the ventilation fans must be stopped and the fire dampers closed; otherwise the extinguishing gas escapes and oxygen comes in from outside. The dampers can usually be closed remotely from outside the space.
CSM gemiye özeldir; başka geminin manual: The CSM is ship-specific; another ship's manual cannot be used. The Chief Officer makes sure that the CSM is up to date, approved and on board; if equipment is changed, the manual is revised. Failure to comply with the CSM results both in a PSC finding and, in the event of an accident, in legal liability.
CSS Code Annex 13, \"Methods to assess t: CSS Code Annex 13 provides a practical calculation method in its chapter "Methods to assess the efficiency of securing arrangements for non-standardised cargoes". It shows mathematically that the transverse, longitudinal and vertical forces in Beaufort 9 conditions can be taken by the lashings.
CSS Code Annex 13, standart olmayan yükl: CSS Code Annex 13 provides a practical calculation method for non-standardized cargoes: the transverse, longitudinal and vertical acceleration forces acting on the cargo are calculated according to the ship's size and the sea conditions. It is shown mathematically that these forces are taken by the lashing arrangement (friction + lashing CS).
Can salları yılda bir kez (bazı tiplerde: Liferafts are opened and inspected once a year (for some types, every 30 months with an extended-interval approval) at a servicing station approved by the Administration. The Safety Officer tracks the service due date of each raft on board; a raft past its due date cannot be used and is a deficiency in itself. The raft must be securely placed in its cradle, and the painter must be made fast to a fixed point.
Can salları yıllık olarak (bazı tiplerde: Liferafts are opened, inspected and repacked annually (at an extended interval for some types) at an approved service station. The HRU (hydrostatic release) provides automatic release at a depth of not more than 4 m; the HRU expiry date (generally 2 years) is tracked, and the lashing/weak link must be correctly attached.
Can salları, can filikası, MOB botu, yan: Access to liferafts, the lifeboat, the MOB boat, fire hose boxes, foam monitors, portable fire extinguishers and EEBDs must always be kept clear. The Bosun ensures that nothing is ever stowed around this equipment and that the signage remains visible.
Can salları, hydrostatic release unit'le: Liferafts, hydrostatic release units (HRUs), inflatable lifejackets, EPIRBs, SARTs and fixed fire-extinguishing systems are subject to periodic servicing at manufacturer-approved service stations. By tracking service dates (next due date), the Chief Officer prevents the ship from sailing with out-of-date (expired) equipment; expired LSA/FFE is a ground for PSC detention.
Can salı (liferaft) genelde hidrostatik: The liferaft is normally released automatically by the hydrostatic release unit (HRU) and inflates as the ship sinks; the AB must know manual launching (throwing overboard and pulling the painter) and how the HRU works. The lifeboat is lowered by davits; during drills the AB learns about the davit brake, the falls, the embarkation ladder and starting the engine.
Can salına/bota geçtikten sonra hayatta: Once in the liferaft or boat, survival management begins: a head count, conserving heat (rafts are tied together, openings are closed), rationing water and provisions, hydration (seawater is not drunk), managing seasickness, and morale. The Master or a senior officer continues to lead in the raft; position and visibility (flares, SART, signalling mirror) are managed. Cold is the greatest threat; hypothermia takes more lives than drowning.
Can simitleri gemi boyutuna göre belirli: Lifebuoys are provided in a specified number according to the size of the ship and are distributed evenly on the bridge wings and decks. At least half are fitted with self-igniting lights, some with self-activating smoke signals, some with buoyant lifelines, and at least two with a quick-release MOB (man-overboard) marker arrangement.
Can yelekleri (yetişkin/çocuk/ekstra), i: Lifejackets (adult/child/extra), immersion suits (on cargo ships, one for every person on board) and lifebuoys (with light, self-igniting, smoke signal, buoyant lifeline) are counted in the inventory and their condition is checked. Light and battery expiry dates and the presence of retro-reflective tape and whistles are checked.
Can yeleği (lifejacket) doğru giyilmeli,: The lifejacket must be donned correctly, with the straps tightened, and its light and whistle must work. The AB must know the lifejacket well enough to don it correctly even with eyes closed; a lifejacket worn incorrectly can turn the wearer face down in the water. On inflatable lifejackets, the automatic/manual inflation mechanism and the CO₂ cartridge are checked.
Capacity plan ise tankların yerleşimini: The capacity plan shows the arrangement and volumes of the tanks; it is used in sounding and stability calculations. The fire control plan shows the fire zones, fixed systems, extinguisher locations and release points, and is an important part of PSC inspections.
Capstan dikey eksende döner; halat tambu: A capstan turns about a vertical axis; the rope is wound a few turns around the barrel and held by friction (the capstan effect). The operator controls the friction by pulling on the slack end (tail) of the rope: pulling heaves it in, letting go lets it slip. This gives a controlled pull without winding the rope on permanently.
Capstan tamburuna sarılan halattaki sürt: The friction force in a rope wound around the capstan barrel is calculated with Euler's formula.
Capstan, windlass'tan farklı olarak yaln: Unlike a windlass, a capstan is used only for heaving on ropes; it has no chain-holding function. The rope is wound a few turns around the vertical barrel and heaved by friction.
Capsule (Hardened/Float-free): yangın/su: Capsule (hardened/float-free): resistant to fire, water and depth; indicates its location with a pinger.
Captain mode aracı, birden fazla kaptan: The Captain mode tool allows the personal preferences of several masters to be stored for specific phases such as transit, berthing and DP operations. Checking that the correct profile is loaded for the correct phase should be part of the watch routine.
Cargo Securing Manual, kâğıt üzerinde de: The Cargo Securing Manual is a discipline applied on site, not on paper. The Chief Officer's success lies in inspecting the equipment meticulously, applying lashings with the correct calculation and the correct pattern, monitoring them throughout the voyage and recording everything. Inadequate lashing leads to cargo losses worth millions of dollars and to loss of life; correct lashing is an invisible but life-saving achievement.
Cargo Transport Unit (CTU) packing certi: The Cargo Transport Unit (CTU) packing certificate documents that the stowage and securing inside the container have been carried out correctly. The Chief Officer checks that DG containers are correctly labeled/placarded and undamaged, and that there is no leakage or odor.
Cargo crane periyodik load test (yıllık: Cargo cranes require periodic load tests (annual + 5-yearly at 1.25× SWL) under class survey. The Bosun carries out daily checks: oil level, hydraulic leaks, brake test, operation of the limit switches, wire rope condition, hook safety latch.
Cargo hold preparation liderliği, Reisin: Leading cargo hold preparation is an operation in which the Bosun uses technical knowledge, team management and safety awareness together. The correct cleanliness standard, attention to detail points and safe working ensure that the hold is handed over fit to carry the cargo safely and that costly cargo disputes are avoided.
Cargo hold, bir enclosed space'tir. Reis: A cargo hold is an enclosed space. Before anyone enters a hold, the Bosun ensures that the requirements for an enclosed space entry permit, atmosphere testing (O2, LEL, H2S, CO), ventilation and a standby person are met. The hold ladder, lighting and escape route are checked.
Cargo manifest, custom ve liman otoritel: The cargo manifest is the official document required by customs and port authorities. The Chief Officer checks that the manifest agrees with the actual cargo. The NOR (Notice of Readiness) is tendered to the charterer when the ship is ready for cargo; laytime commences after the notice time stated in the C/P has expired (e.g. 6 hours after NOR).
Cargo manifest, liman ve gümrük otoritel: The cargo manifest is the official list of the cargo for port and customs authorities. The Chief Officer checks that the manifest agrees with the cargo actually loaded/discharged; inconsistency leads to customs problems and fines. The Dangerous Goods manifest is kept separately and held on the bridge.
Cargo surveyor, draft surveyor, bunker s: Every joint measurement or signature with the cargo surveyor, draft surveyor, bunker surveyor and P&I surveyor can bind the company. On a measurement or statement he or she does not agree with, the Master adds the remark "for receipt only" / "under protest" and issues a Letter of Protest. Oral admissions made to a surveyor can later become evidence against the ship.
Cargo sweat/ship sweat kaynaklı ıslanmad: Where wetting is caused by cargo sweat or ship sweat, the ventilation records are important for the defence.
Cargo wire, mooring wire ve crane wire i: Periodic greasing (OEM lubricant), broken wire counts and diameter measurements are carried out on cargo wires, mooring wires and crane wires. According to ISO 4309 and the company standard, >10% broken wires within a lay length, kinks, severe wear or visible bulging are reasons for retirement.

For cargo wires, mooring wires and crane wires, the store holds spare wire reels, OEM wire lubricant, wire clips, thimbles and sockets. The Bosun protects the wire reels from moisture; rusted wire loses its strength and flexibility. Spare wire certificates are kept in the same file as the rope certificates.
Cargo/bunker hose bağlantısı, doğru flan: The cargo/bunker hose connection is made with the correct flange, gasket and number of bolts; hoses are lifted with a crane/derrick of known SWL. The Chief Officer ensures that the hoses are continuously monitored for tension and chafing and that drip trays and SOPEP gear are ready. During the transfer, the ESD must be tested and functional.
Carriage ban (Reg. 14.1) gereği, scrubbe: Under the carriage ban (Reg. 14.1), ships without a scrubber may not even carry fuel above 0.50% on board. PSC takes samples from the main engine and the service tank (in-use and onboard samples) and compares them with the MARPOL bottle.
Cat fines (alüminyum-silikon katalizör k: Cat fines (aluminium-silicon catalyst residues) are hard, abrasive particles in HFO; they rapidly wear liners, piston rings and fuel injection equipment. ISO 8217 sets an Al+Si limit for bunkers, but the value at the engine inlet must be much lower. Separator efficiency is the main way of reducing cat fines.
Cat fines özellikle tehlikelidir; enjeks: Cat fines are particularly dangerous; they wear the surfaces of the injection pump and nozzle like sandpaper. If the Al+Si value in the bunker specification is close to the ISO 8217 limit (60 mg/kg), purifier and filter maintenance is carried out more frequently. If shiny, sand-like particles are seen in the filter contents, the engineer must always be informed.
Catalytic fines (alüminyum + silikon oks: Catalytic fines (aluminum + silicon oxide particles) are hard, abrasive particles that come from the refinery FCC process. They cause dramatic wear in the fuel injection system and especially at the liner-piston ring contact surface. The ISO 8217 limit is 60 mg/kg, but it is recommended to reduce them to below 15 mg/kg at the engine inlet (after the purifier).
Catfines yönetimi: settling tank residen: Catfines management means settling tank residence time, running two purifiers in series (purifier + clarifier), correct gravity disc selection and an optimum separation temperature of 98°C. If high catfines are detected, the feed rate is reduced to increase separation efficiency.
Centrifugal separator HFO/VLSFO için opt: The centrifugal separator is operated at an optimum 95-98°C for HFO/VLSFO. With modern high-density fuels, control of the interface (water-oil boundary) becomes difficult; this is why most ships use "self-cleaning + density independent" type separators without a gravity disc (Alfa Laval S-separator, GEA). Feed rate directly affects separation quality; low feed = high separation efficiency.
Ch 13: bridge-to-bridge gemi manevra hab: Ch 13: bridge-to-bridge communications for ship manoeuvring (156.650 MHz).
Ch 16: tehlike, acil ve çağrı kanalı (15: Ch 16: distress, urgency and calling channel (156.800 MHz).
Ch 70: DSC tehlike kanalı (156.525 MHz): Ch 70: DSC distress channel (156.525 MHz) — voice use prohibited.
Chain block (zincir palanga), makine dai: The chain block is the most widely used lifting device in the engine room. Inspection looks for: wear/elongation/cracks in the load chain, smooth operation of the hand chain, the brake mechanism (load holding — the block must not slip when it takes the load), the hook and safety latch, and deformation of the housing. The SWL plate must be legible.
Chain of custody (CoC), örneğin alınması: The chain of custody (CoC) is the chain in which every point of contact, from taking the sample to the laboratory result, is recorded, and it is the basis of the legal validity of the test. The sample is collected in the presence of the person tested; for a urine sample a temperature check (32–38 °C) is made to prevent substitution and dilution. The sample is sealed, the person and a witness sign the seal, and the CoC form travels with the sample.
Challenge and response; bir ekip üyesini: Challenge and response is a culture in which any team member can question anyone's decision, including a superior's, in the interest of safety. The Second Officer teaches junior officers and helmsmen that "the courage to say what you see is wrong" is a duty; a bridge silenced by the authority gradient is dangerous. Even with a pilot on board, the pilot's advice must be questioned against the plan.
Changeover gerçek anlamda, fuel sistemin: In real terms, the changeover is completed when all the high-sulfur fuel in the fuel system (service tank, supply/booster line, fuel pumps, injectors) has been replaced by low-sulfur fuel. Until the HFO remaining in the system has been "purged" by the new fuel, the emission limit is exceeded.
Changeover, ECA sınırına ulaşmadan ÖNCE: The changeover must be completed BEFORE reaching the ECA boundary. The Chief Engineer starts the changeover early enough, allowing for the ship's speed, the volume of HFO/VLSFO in the system and the purging time. Typically it is started hours before the ECA boundary.
Changeover, makineyi durdurmadan yapılan: Changeover is a critical operation carried out without stopping the engine. First, the side that is not to be cleaned (the new side) is vented to remove air and slowly equalized with the line; then the changeover lever is turned to direct the flow to the new side. The dirty side is isolated, its pressure is drained and the cover is opened.
Channel 70 (DSC kanalı) sürekli dinleme: Channel 70 (the DSC channel) must be in continuous watch mode; this channel is not for voice communication but only for DSC alerting. CH16 is monitored as the voice distress and calling channel.
Charge air cooler (hava soğutucu): Turbo: Charge air cooler: cools the intake air compressed by the turbocharger; it increases the charge density (and the power).
Chart correction log (NP133A veya elektr: The chart correction log (NP133A or electronic equivalent) is the official record showing up to which NtM each chart has been corrected. Each entry contains the chart number, the notice number applied, the date and the signature/initials of the person who made the correction. In a PSC inspection, this log is the primary evidence that the charts are up to date.
Chart correction log, güncelliğin kanıtı: The chart correction log is the proof that the charts are up to date and may be asked for by PSC.
Chart correction log, harita güncelliğin: The chart correction log is the proof that the charts are up to date; PSC may ask for this record and for the number of the last NtM applied.
Charter party'de \"WIPON, WIBON, WIFPON,: The "WIPON, WIBON, WIFPON, WCCON" (whether in port / in berth / in free pratique / customs cleared or not) clauses in the charter party determine when the NOR may be tendered. The Master must know these clauses and tender the NOR in writing at the right time and to the right party (usually the charterer and the agent). The time of tender (date and time) is very important.
Charterer'in voyage instructions'ı (rota: The charterer's voyage instructions (route, speed, ECO speed, weather routing service, bunker port) are commercially binding; but no instruction that endangers safety is binding. When the Master faces an unsafe instruction, he or she asks for the instruction in writing, gives a reasoned refusal in writing, proposes an alternative and informs the DPA. Saying "no" protects the Master when it is done professionally and with documents; done argumentatively and orally, it leaves the Master on his or her own.
Checklist, gemiye katılım tarihiyle birl: The checklist is kept, together with the date of joining, in the personnel file and the SMS records. The date must show that the person received familiarization before taking up duties or within 24 hours; late or incomplete records generate a PSC/ISM finding.
Chiller ve hava işleme üniteleri bakıma: Chillers and air handling units are maintained; filters are cleaned or replaced. Cooling towers and humidifiers are disinfected because of the Legionella risk.
Chiller: R134a/R407C/R513A soğutucu akış: Chiller: produces chilled water (7 °C) with R134a/R407C/R513A refrigerant.
Chipping hammer, needle scaler, angle gr: Chipping hammers, needle scalers, angle grinders, disc sanders, hand scrapers, wire brushes, paint brushes, rollers and airless spray guns are part of the store inventory. The Bosun tracks the number and condition of these tools and their spare consumables (grinding discs, scaler needles, brushes). Electric tools undergo periodic electrical safety checks (megger/insulation test); the hoses and connections of pneumatic tools are checked.
Chipping/grinding göz/solunum riski, boy: Chipping/grinding carries eye/respiratory risks, and paint carries solvent vapor and fire risks. Suitable PPE (goggles, respirator, gloves), ventilation and distance from ignition sources are essential. Painting in an enclosed space is subject to the enclosed space and atmosphere rules.
Ciddi kazada (çatışma, oturma, yangın, k: In a serious accident (collision, grounding, fire, pollution, loss of life, piracy), the order of communication must have been memorised in advance: first the safety of life and the MRCC/MAYDAY, then the DPA, then the flag state and P&I, then the charterer and the agent. The company's Emergency Response Plan (ERP) typically defines an Emergency Response Team (ERT) and a 24/7 hotline. The Master's task is to pass on the reality on site quickly, accurately and without exaggeration, and not to speculate.
Citadel, mürettebatın saldırı anında çek: The citadel is a protected area, impossible to enter from outside and with means of communication, to which the crew withdraw during an attack. The citadel principle is that no military rescue can be launched unless the whole crew is inside and accounted for and secure communication with the outside has been established. Carrying privately contracted armed security personnel (PCASP) depends on flag and port state permission, company policy and strict rules for the use of force; the Master is the person who applies this framework on board.
Clarifier: Yalnızca katı partikülleri ay: Clarifier: separates only solid particles. It has no gravity disc. It is usually used as the second stage.
Clarifier: separates only solid particles; there is no water outlet.
Class 1 sistem mimarisi tümüyle dağıtık: The Class 1 system architecture is based entirely on a distributed concept. A DP 1 system has a single control computer, a single operator station and separate IO units interfacing the sensors, the position reference system, the power supply and the thrusters.
Class 1'de tek hata pozisyon kaybına yol: In Class 1 a single fault may lead to loss of position; in Class 2 the failure of a single active component must not lead to loss of position; in Class 3 the loss of a single compartment through fire or flooding is also tolerated. The task determines which class it needs through its own level of risk.
Class A (çift uçlu) loop'larda bir nokta: In Class A (dual-ended) loops, even if the line breaks at one point, the panel keeps the detectors working by feeding from both ends. Loop isolator modules isolate a segment when there is a short circuit in it and protect the rest of the loop. The ETO verifies that the isolators are located at the correct intervals and are working; a failed isolator can cause the whole loop to drop out on a short circuit.
Class A taşıma zorunluluğu 'tüm SOLAS ge: The Class A carriage requirement cannot be generalised as "all SOLAS ships"; it is verified against the ship type, type of voyage and GT thresholds in SOLAS V/19 and the Record of Equipment. Class A makes higher-priority reports based on SOTDMA.
Class B, ilgili ulusal kurallar veya gön: Class B may be found on small commercial ships and craft under the relevant national rules or as voluntary equipment. The power, access method and reporting interval vary with the sub-class of the equipment.
Closed gauging'de tank atmosferi dışarı: In closed gauging, measurements are taken without opening the tank atmosphere, with a permanently installed system (CTS – Closed Tape System, CPAS – Cargo Pressure/level Automation System, or a radar level gauge). In restricted gauging, measurements are taken through a small opening via a vapour-lock valve. Open gauging (ullage hatch fully open) is prohibited because of toxic and flammable vapours.
Closed-loop (kapalı çevrim) iletişim; bi: Closed-loop communication is completed by giving an order, the receiver repeating it (read-back) and confirmation that the order has been carried out (e.g. the helmsman saying "Midships, rudder amidships"). This loop prevents a misunderstood helm order from turning into an accident. In training, helm and engine orders are always practiced using closed-loop communication.
Closed-loop communication (kapalı döngü: Closed-loop communication is essential: when an order is given, the receiver repeats it (read-back) and the sender confirms. The order "Put No. 2 generator on standby" is confirmed as "No. 2 generator on standby, understood". This prevents accidents caused by misunderstanding.
CoC'deki bir kopukluk (mühürsüz örnek, e: A break in the CoC (an unsealed sample, a missing signature, storage that cannot be traced) makes a positive result legally indefensible. For this reason the Master takes the sample with an impartial witness and fills in every field of the form completely. If samples have to be held on board, they are kept locked and under suitable temperature conditions, and sent by courier to the laboratory at the first suitable port.
Coal boşaltması sonrası grain yükleme iç: After discharging coal, the hold is prepared for grain loading by sweeping, seawater washing, freshwater rinsing, drying and checking for odor/stains. The Bosun ensures that each hold is entered in line with enclosed space discipline and is ready for the NCB or surveyor inspection.
Coating hasarları onarılır; katodik koru: Coating damage is repaired and cathodic protection measurements are taken. Corrosion threatens structural integrity over time.
Cofferdam drain'de hidrolik yağ tespiti: Hydraulic oil found at the cofferdam drain is an early sign of seal failure; ignoring it leads to cargo claims.
Combination arrangement'ta pilot ladder,: In a combination arrangement, the pilot ladder is combined with the lower platform of the accommodation ladder; the pilot first climbs the pilot ladder and then steps onto the platform. The transfer point is the most critical area: the platform must be horizontal, fitted with guardrails and level with the pilot ladder, with no gap or difference in height at the transfer. The AB rigs this combination in accordance with the rules.
Common-rail, elektronik-hidrolik veya ka: Common-rail, electronic-hydraulic or cam-driven mechanical injection may be used. Rail/servo and injection pressures vary with the load point and engine design; alarm/trip and maintenance limits are taken only from the maker's manual and shop trial data.
Compass → True dönüşümünde sapma ve deği: In converting from compass to true, deviation and variation are applied in turn. The rule for adding or subtracting easterly (E) errors must be memorised; the classic mnemonic "CADET — Compass ADd East (to get True)" is used. The compass error is measured regularly by the azimuth of celestial bodies (sun or stars) or by a transit of two objects.
Condition of Class (CoC) açılırsa, belir: If a Condition of Class (CoC) is imposed, it must be dealt with within the specified period; otherwise the certificate is suspended. The Chief Officer follows up deck-related CoCs.
Conta (rubber packing), panel çevresinde: The rubber packing sits in a channel around the panel and is compressed by the compression bar. Water collecting between the packing and the coaming is drained through a drain channel and a non-return valve. A blocked drain valve lets water leak into the hold.
Conta kanalında biriken su, drenaj kanal: Water collecting in the packing channel is drained overboard through a drain channel and a non-return valve. If the non-return valve is blocked or fitted the wrong way round, water gets into the hold. Coaming integrity and corrosion control are the basis of tightness.
Conta ve oturma yüzeyi sızdırmazlık test: Tightness tests of the packing and the contact surfaces (chalk test, hose test or ultrasonic tightness measurement) are carried out. Damaged packing and worn contact surfaces lead to water ingress and cargo damage; they are frequently checked by PSC and in surveys.
Conta, flanş yüzeyine birebir uyacak şek: The gasket is cut to match the flange face exactly; the bolt holes, inside diameter and outside diameter are marked accurately. Gasket cutting tools (gasket cutter, punch set) and templates are used. The inside diameter of the gasket must not be smaller than the inside diameter of the pipe and must not restrict the flow.
Conta, o-ring, filtre, kayış, yağ, gres,: The use of consumables such as gaskets, O-rings, filters, belts, oil, grease and chemicals is recorded and the stock is updated. This record shows the rate of consumption, identifies items that fall below the minimum stock (ROB – Remaining On Board) and prevents unnecessary over-ordering.
Container gemilerinde parametric rolling: If there is a risk of parametric rolling on container ships, lashing forces increase greatly; in that case a change of speed/course is the only safe solution. Major container losses such as ONE Apus (2020) and Maersk Essen (2021) resulted from a combination of heavy weather + inadequate lashing/securing.
Container gemilerinde twist lock + lashi: On container ships the combination of twistlocks, lashing rods and turnbuckles, the tier limits and the rules for stowage on hatch covers are observed. Lashing failure is a leading cause of container losses (ONE Apus 2020, Maersk Essen 2021).
Container içi ünitede kompresör, kondens: The unit in the container contains a compressor, condenser, evaporator and fan.
Container, ro-ro, project cargo ve deck: Container, ro-ro, project cargo and deck cargo lashing is reassessed with CSM/CSS Code calculations against the expected heavy weather accelerations. If necessary, additional lashings are fitted and the tightness of the existing lashings is checked; slack turnbuckles are tightened. Going on deck to check lashings once heavy seas have set in is extremely dangerous, so preparations are completed in advance.
Continuous Machinery Survey (CMS) kapsam: Opening-up/measurement records of equipment covered by the Continuous Machinery Survey (CMS) are essential for the class surveyor to give survey credit. Proper PMS records make the survey easier and avoid unnecessary repeat opening-up.
Controllable Pitch Propeller (CPP) veya: On Controllable Pitch Propellers (CPP) and some fixed pitch systems, an injection/monitoring system is fitted to protect the oil inside the propeller hub/boss cap against seawater pressure. This system prevents and monitors seawater ingress into the hub oil (sea water leak).
Conventional sistemlerde dedektörler zon: In conventional systems, detectors are grouped by zone; the panel shows only which zone is in alarm and cannot tell which individual detector has been triggered. In addressable systems, each detector has a unique address; the panel reports exactly which cabin or corridor has an alarm/fault. On modern large ships, a loop-based addressable system is standard and makes fault finding much easier.
Coriolis debimetresi, titreşen tüplerden: A Coriolis flow meter is based on the principle that a fluid flowing through vibrating tubes creates a Coriolis force. It measures the mass flow and density directly; no volumetric conversion is needed.
Correspondent ile çalışırken kaptan, olg: When working with the correspondent, the Master is factual and transparent; however, the legal strategy and the assessment of liability are directed by the correspondent and the club's lawyers. The Master meets the correspondent's requests (documents, statements, access) in coordination with the company. This cooperation keeps the process both quick and legally protected.
Costa Concordia'da (2012) muster drill h: On the Costa Concordia (2012) the accident happened before the muster drill had been held; holding the drill early is therefore a critical lesson learned.
Costa Concordia, onaylı rotadan plansız: The Costa Concordia showed that an unplanned deviation from the approved route can lead to disaster; deviations must be controlled and documented.
Crankcase explosion; hot spot (yatak ove: A crankcase explosion occurs through the chain hot spot (bearing overheating) → atomized oil + air mixture → ignition. The oil mist detector (Schaller, Visatron) and bearing temperature sensors give early warning. On alarm: engine load to zero, stop immediately, opening the crankcase doors is prohibited (controlled opening after 15-30 min of cooling down), boundary cooling.
Crankcase inspection ve oil mist takibi,: Crankcase inspection and oil mist monitoring is the task in which the Second Engineer both protects the most critical parts of the main engine and observes the most serious safety rule. Respecting the oil mist alarm, strictly following the cooling-down rule and careful bearing inspection prevent both crankcase explosion and catastrophic bearing damage, protecting life and machinery safety together.
Crankcase inspection'da; main bearing, c: During crankcase inspection, the condition of the main bearings, crank pin (bottom end) bearings and crosshead bearings, white metal smear (smeared white metal — a sign of overheating), tie bolt looseness and the general condition of the oil film are checked. White metal smear or discoloration shows that a bearing has overheated and needs attention.
Crankcase relief valve (patlama kapağı): There are also mechanical protections such as crankcase relief valves (explosion doors) and the turning gear interlock (which prevents starting while the turning gear is engaged). The cadet learns that these devices must never be bypassed.
Crankcase, motorun ana hareketli parçala: The crankcase houses the engine's main moving parts; bearing damage or a loose tie bolt can lead to catastrophic failure. Through regular inspection, the Second Engineer monitors the condition of these parts and catches problems early. At the same time, because of the explosion risk, the crankcase is the area approached with the greatest care.
Crew List, gemideki tüm mürettebatın kim: The Crew List is the official document containing the identity, rank, nationality and certificate details of all the crew on board; immigration and the port authority ask for it on entering port. Under MLC 2006 Standard A2.1, every seafarer's signed SEA must be on board; the Master checks that the SEAs are complete and up to date.
Crew matrix, eğitim kayıtları, sertifika: The crew matrix, training records, certificates and evidence of familiarisation are prepared. Deck and manifold cleanliness, labelling, SOPEP equipment and safety equipment are checked.
Cross girder (çapraz kiriş) ve longitudi: Cross girders and longitudinal girders provide structural integrity. The main bearing seats (bearing pockets) have precisely machined surfaces.
Cross-check: SFOC × güç × süre hesabı il: Cross-check: the calculation SFOC × power × time is compared with the measured consumption.
Crosshead motorlarda biyel kolu crosshea: In crosshead engines the connecting rod is connected from the crosshead pin to the crankpin. In trunk piston engines it is connected directly to the piston pin (gudgeon pin).
Crosshead motorlarda piston yağ soğutmal: In crosshead engines the piston is oil-cooled, the oil being supplied through a telescopic pipe or a swinging link. The piston cooling oil outlet temperature is an indicator of performance. A high temperature points to a blocked cooling passage or burning of the crown.
Crosshead yapısı sayesinde piston kolu v: With the crosshead design, the piston rod and the connecting rod are joined at the crosshead pin; the piston moves only vertically. As a result, cylinder lubrication and crankcase lubrication are separate.
Cruise gemisinde black-out hem propulsio: On a cruise ship a blackout affects both propulsion and the hotel load; redundancy and fast recovery are critical.
Cupronickel (Cu-Ni 90/10, 70/30): Mükemm: Cupronickel (Cu-Ni 90/10, 70/30): excellent resistance to seawater. Condenser tubes, piping.
Cut-off değerleri madde başına farklıdır: Cut-off values differ for each substance and are based on SAMHSA and international standards as a reference. For example, roughly: amphetamines ~500 ng/mL (confirmation 250), cocaine metabolite ~150 ng/mL (confirmation 100), opiates ~2000 ng/mL, cannabis (THC-COOH) ~50 ng/mL (confirmation 15), phencyclidine ~25 ng/mL. These values are set to distinguish between environmental or passive exposure and real use; for this reason, "I was exposed by accident" defences are generally refuted by the cut-off logic.
CyScan, deniz aracı kontrol uygulamaları: CyScan is a high-performance local position reference sensor designed specifically for marine vessel control applications. It works as a primary or back-up sensor and is compatible with all Marine Technologies DP systems.
Cylinder drain oil analizi (scrape-down: Cylinder drain oil analysis (scrape-down analysis) is a separate and valuable technique, especially on 2-stroke main engines, for monitoring liner/ring wear and cylinder oil performance.
Cylinder lub feed rate (g/kWh), yakıt sü: The cylinder lube feed rate (g/kWh) is adjusted according to the fuel sulfur content and load; with low-sulfur fuel a high-BN oil causes excessive deposits, while with high-sulfur fuel a low-BN oil causes corrosion. This adjustment is generally made together with scrape-down analysis (see the relevant task section). The Second Engineer maintains the balance between feed rate and fuel quality.
Cylinder lubrication ve scrape-down anal: Cylinder lubrication and scrape-down analysis are among the most technical tasks through which the Second Engineer protects the heart of the main engine. The correct feed rate, data-driven monitoring and early diagnosis of scuffing prevent costly liner/piston damage and secure the reliability and service life of the main engine.
Cylinder oil TBN'i (Base Number) yakıt s: Cylinder oil TBN (Base Number) is selected according to fuel sulfur content. 70-100 TBN is suitable for high-sulfur HSFO (scrubber ship), 40-70 TBN for VLSFO and 25-40 TBN for low-sulfur MGO/ULSFO. Choosing the wrong (too low) TBN leads to cold corrosion (sulfuric acid corrosion); too high a TBN leads to calcium deposits and bore polishing.
Cylinder oil feed rate (g/kWh) ve system: Cylinder oil feed rate (g/kWh) and system oil consumption are reported. An abnormal increase in cylinder oil consumption points to an over-lubrication setting, ring blow-by or liner wear. An increase in the system oil top-up quantity is an indicator of water/fuel ingress or leakage.
Cylinder oil, yakıt sülfür içeriğine gör: Cylinder oil is selected according to the sulfur content of the fuel. Oils of 70-100 TBN (Base Number) are suitable for high-sulfur HFO, and oils of 25-40 TBN for low-sulfur VLSFO/MGO. Choosing the wrong TBN leads to cold corrosion or deposit problems.
Cylinder-oil feed rate and oil selection: Cylinder-oil feed rate and oil selection must follow the engine maker’s guidance for the fuel, engine condition and load. Interpret scrape-down oil base number (BN or TBN) with iron results, sampling consistency and inspection findings. Low residual alkalinity and high wear require investigation; high BN alone does not justify reducing feed rate. Use trends and maker action limits, not a universal BN target.
Cıvata sıkıldığında oluşan ön gerilme (p: The pretension (preload) created when a bolt is tightened prevents the joint from separating under load and the bolt from fatiguing. The preload obtained from the applied torque is related to it by a coefficient that depends on friction.
Cıvataların doğru torkla sıkılması, hem: Tightening bolts to the correct torque is critical both for tightness and for structural integrity. Insufficient torque leads to leaks and loosening, while excessive torque leads to bolt failure and flange distortion. The cadet learns the correct use of the torque wrench and how to read the OEM torque table.
D (Türev): Hatanın değişim hızına göre t: D (derivative): responds to the rate of change of the error. It reduces overshoot and is sensitive to noise.
D (Türev): Hatanın değişim hızına göre ç: D (derivative): produces an output according to the rate of change of the error. It responds quickly to sudden changes and reduces overshoot.

D&A politikası yalnızca alkolü değil; ba: The D&A policy covers not only alcohol but also, in particular, cannabis (THC), cocaine, amphetamines/methamphetamine, opiates (morphine, codeine, heroin), benzodiazepines and synthetic substances (NPS — new psychoactive substances). Prescription medicines are not excluded: personnel using prescription medicines that may affect performance, alertness or judgement must declare this to the Master and the ship's doctor or the company's medical department. The declaration is recorded and, if necessary, duty restrictions are applied.
D&A politikasının uygulanmasında kaptanı: The Master's success in applying the D&A policy is not that "there are never any positives" but that the programme runs consistently, impartially, with documents and with respect for human dignity. Zero tolerance is a strong deterrent; but its strength comes from the legal soundness of its application and from the crew's trust in this framework. A well-managed D&A programme is the invisible line of defence that will one day prevent an accident; a badly managed programme leaves both safety and the company legally exposed.
D&A test sonuçları hassas kişisel ve tıb: D&A test results are sensitive personal and medical data; the principle of confidentiality is followed. Results are not shared beyond those who "need to know" (the Master, the person concerned, the company official); gossip and stigmatisation on board are prevented. The Master is responsible for the process being run impartially and with respect for human dignity; behaving otherwise is contrary both to the MLC's expectation of "fair treatment" and creates legal risk.
D&A test yönetimi, emniyetin en hassas a: D&A test management is one of the most sensitive but most necessary areas of safety; it requires impartial application, confidentiality and a sound chain of custody. The Third Officer's regular and fair program is a deterrent shield that prevents one person under the influence from endangering the whole ship.
D-1 (Değişim standardı): Açık denizde (k: D-1 (exchange standard): ballast water exchange in the open sea (200 nautical miles from land, depth over 200 m). At least 95% volumetric exchange is required.
D-1 (ballast water exchange) açık denizd: D-1 (ballast water exchange) requires the water to be exchanged in the open sea; D-2 (performance standard) requires the number of viable organisms in the discharged water to be brought below set limits. Once the transition period is over, all ships must meet D-2 (i.e. have an approved BWMS).
D-1 exchange üç yöntemle yapılır: sequen: D-1 exchange is carried out by three methods: sequential (empty and refill), flow-through (pumping through three times the tank volume) and dilution. In the sequential method, stability, strength and the risk of slamming/sloshing while tanks are being emptied are coordinated with the bridge; with some tanks empty, the ship may approach its strength limits.
D-2 (Performans standardı): Balast su ar: D-2 (Performance standard): Specified organism limits must be met by means of a ballast water treatment system. Since 8 September 2024, all ships covered by the Convention must comply with D-2.

D: Motor yükü %75'ten %50'ye düşürüldü,: D: the engine load was reduced from 75% to 50% and the injector was checked.
DC motor hızı üç yöntemle kontrol edilir: The speed of a DC motor is controlled in three ways: changing the armature voltage (reducing speed), changing the field current (increasing speed) and adding series resistance (an inefficient method).
DCS, yerel kontrol istasyonları (I/O kab: A DCS consists of local control stations (I/O cabinets), central operator stations (HMI), an engineering station and a redundant communication network. Each local station runs the control in its own area independently; the central system provides monitoring and higher-level coordination.
DG araçlar beyan edilir, segregation tab: Vehicles carrying dangerous goods are declared and stowed in compliance with the segregation table; ventilation, fire-fighting access and EmS readiness are ensured. Vehicle engines are switched off after stowage.
DG manifest, packing certificate ve stow: The DG manifest, packing certificates and stowage positions are checked; incompatible classes are kept apart according to the segregation table. The EmS (emergency response) information must be ready.
DG operasyonunda özel PPE, hazır yangın: DG operations require special PPE, fire hoses ready for use, a cordoned-off area and an authorized supervisor. In the event of a leak or fire, the response follows the EmS guide. The Chief Officer ensures that the crew is prepared for the relevant scenarios and that DG drills are carried out.
DG'ler paralele alınırken frekans, volta: When generators are paralleled, frequency, voltage and phase sequence are matched; faulty synchronisation causes mechanical damage through a sudden torque. Load sharing must be balanced.
DGPS (Differential GPS), konumu bilinen: DGPS (Differential GPS) works by a shore reference station at a known position broadcasting the error it measures; by applying this correction, the ship improves the accuracy from a few metres to sub-metre level. IALA radio beacons and SBAS (e.g. EGNOS/WAAS) provide this correction.
DOC (Document of Compliance) şirkete, SM: The DOC (Document of Compliance) is issued to the company and the SMC (Safety Management Certificate) to the ship.
DOC 5 yıl geçerlidir ve yıllık doğrulama: The DOC is valid for 5 years and is subject to annual verification (±3-month window). The SMC is also valid for 5 years, but its intermediate verification takes place between the 2nd and 3rd anniversary dates of the SMC. The Master keeps track of these windows; a delayed certificate verification is a ground for detention in a PSC (Port State Control) inspection. Interim certificates (Interim DOC/SMC) are issued in cases such as delivery of a new ship or a change of company; an Interim DOC is valid for up to 12 months, and an Interim SMC for 6 months (extendable by a further 6 months in special cases).
DOP (Dilution of Precision), uyduların g: DOP (Dilution of Precision) is the effect of the distribution of the satellites in the sky on accuracy. If the satellites are close together (poor geometry), HDOP rises and the position error grows. The receiver usually gives a warning when HDOP is high.
DP 1'den DP 2'ye yükseltme kolay bir sür: Upgrading from DP 1 to DP 2 is straightforward, because both types of system use the same hardware modules and only the number of units differs. Similarly, a DP 0 system can be upgraded to a higher class by adding more of the same hardware components for increased redundancy.
DP 2 kurulumunda tipik olarak iki, DP 3': A DP 2 installation typically has two operator stations, and a DP 3 installation at least three. At the start of each watch it must be clearly confirmed which station is in command and how control is transferred. Verbal confirmation and a log entry during the transfer are decisive in any later incident investigation.
DP 2 sistemi, DP 1 ile aynı modüllerden: A DP 2 system consists of the same modules as DP 1, but the number of modules is increased for redundancy in order to comply with the Class 2 rules. A DP 2 system uses three control computers and typically two operator stations.
DP 3 hedefleniyorsa iş yalnızca elektrik: If DP 3 is the aim, the work is not only electrical and automation work. To meet the Class 3 requirements, a physically separate, fire-resistant compartment is needed in which one control computer, one operator station and one sensor IO unit will be installed. The layout changes for the third operator station and the third IO set must be engineered early.
DP 3 sistemi ayrıca, Class 3 gereklerini: To meet the Class 3 requirements, a DP 3 system also needs a physically separate, fire-resistant compartment in which one control computer, one operator station and one sensor IO unit must be installed.
DP 3 sistemi, DP 2'ye kıyasla genişletil: A DP 3 system has an extended hardware configuration compared with DP 2. The triple-redundant DP controller is still used and at least three operator stations are required. Unlike the dual sensor sets typically used in a DP 2 configuration, there are three IO units for interfacing the components.
DP bilgisayarları, operatör istasyonları: Uninterrupted and mutually independent control power supplies must be verified for the DP computers, operator stations, position reference systems and sensors. In the Bridge Mate architecture, the power supply of each IO unit is taken from the single-line diagram and matched with the redundancy groups.
DP loguna DP'ye giriş/çıkış zamanı, göre: The DP log records the times of entering and leaving DP, the task, position, heading, online equipment, PRS, environment, alarms and changes of status. Maintenance, bypass, defect, test and drill records are linked to the relevant technical file.
DP vardiya devir teslimi, gemi ve sistem: The DP watch handover covers the state of the ship and the system as well as the task and the environment. With Bridge Mate, the station configuration and the active profile are also handed over.
DP'nin demanded ve delivered thrust değe: The demanded and delivered thrust values of the DP are trended; a low response despite a high command is investigated. Settings are not changed without MOC and the approval of the Master, the DPO and the Chief Engineer.
DP, crane, rigging veya hava limiti aşıl: If a DP, crane, rigging or weather limit is exceeded, the load is moved to the designated safe position.
DPA (Designated Person Ashore), ISM madd: Under ISM section 4, the DPA (Designated Person Ashore) is a direct link between the Master and the highest level of the company's management. When there is a safety or environmental concern, the Master can bypass the hierarchy and go directly to the DPA; this access can never be blocked. Similarly, the CSO is the Master's counterpart ashore on security matters. The Master ensures that these two channels work openly, quickly and with records.
DPA, gemi ile şirketin en üst yönetimi a: The DPA is the direct link between the ship and the highest level of company management and plays ISM's "bridge" role between ship and shore. The Safety Officer reports safety performance, open actions and resource needs to the DPA. Access to the DPA must not be restricted by any obstacle; this is a fundamental safeguard of ISM.
DSC (Digital Selective Calling), tehlike: DSC (Digital Selective Calling) sends a distress alert digitally (with the ship's identity (MMSI), position and nature of distress) at the touch of a button; coast stations and ships receive the alert automatically and give an alarm. This removes the need for a continuous aural watch, and the call is not missed.
DSC distress alert'in en kritik verisi p: The most critical item of data in a DSC distress alert is the position. If the equipment is not connected to a GNSS (GPS) receiver or the connection is lost, the position must be entered manually and updated regularly; otherwise the distress alert will transmit an old/wrong position. The Second Officer checks that the GNSS interface is working and that the position time stamp is current.
DSC distress butonu (korumalı kapak altı: The DSC distress button (under a protective cover) sends the MMSI, the position (if a GPS is connected) and the nature of distress on channel 70 with a single action. When the alert is received, the stations concerned give an automatic alarm and voice follow-up takes place on channel 16. The alert is sent by holding the button down for 4–5 seconds.
DSC günlük/haftalık test edilir; EPIRB/S: DSC is tested daily and weekly; the EPIRB and SART are checked periodically (battery and HRU expiry dates). The accuracy of the AIS static and dynamic data is checked.
DSC is tested daily and weekly; the EPIRB and SART are checked periodically. The accuracy of the AIS data is checked.
DSC is tested daily and weekly; the EPIRB and SART are checked periodically. Battery and HRU expiry dates are followed.
DSC ile çağrı kurulduktan sonra sesli (R: Once a call has been set up by DSC, the content is passed by voice (RT) or by NBDP (Narrow Band Direct Printing/telex). NBDP transmits text reliably in the noisy HF environment. After a distress alert the coast station mostly follows up by voice.
DSC, her geminin benzersiz 9 haneli MMSI: DSC is a digital calling system in which every ship is identified by its unique 9-digit MMSI (Maritime Mobile Service Identity). There are distress, urgency, safety and routine call types. A distress alert is sent with a single button (the red distress button under a protective cover); the ship's position, the MMSI and, if possible, the nature of distress (fire, sinking, collision, etc.) are transmitted automatically.
Daha basit yapı, daha düşük maliyet ve d: It has a simpler structure, lower cost and needs less maintenance. To go astern, the engine must turn in the opposite direction.
Daha da önemlisi: içeride biri baygın gö: More importantly: if someone is seen unconscious inside, the cadet first raises the alarm and calls for help; the cadet does not rush into an unsupervised and unequipped rescue. The statistics of enclosed space accidents are painful: a significant proportion of those who die are rescuers who ran to save the first victim and were asphyxiated in the same atmosphere.
Dairesel kesitli bir mile tork uygulandı: When a torque is applied to a shaft of circular section, shear stress develops.
Dalgıç su altındayken; ana pervane, bow/: While a diver is under water, the main propeller, bow/stern thrusters, side thrusters and sea suction valves must on no account be operated. These systems are isolated under LOTO, locked and tagged; the bridge and the engine room are informed. Accidental start-up of a thruster is fatal for a diver.
Dalgıç video/fotoğrafları, ölçümler (ano: Diver video/photographs, measurements (anodes, thickness), surveyor findings and work done are recorded and reported to class/the company. These records form the basis for planning the next drydock and for class compliance.
Damage Control Plan ve booklet, her su g: The Damage Control Plan and booklet show the floodability of each watertight compartment. In the event of damage, the Chief Officer makes cross-flooding and counter-ballasting decisions on the basis of this document.
Damlacık boyutu enjeksiyon basıncı, deli: The droplet size depends on the injection pressure, the nozzle hole diameter and the fuel viscosity. Fine droplets evaporate faster and give better mixing.
Dangerous Goods Manifest, geminin taşıdı: The Dangerous Goods Manifest lists all DG on board and their stowage positions; the MFAG gives medical first aid guidance and the EmS gives emergency response procedures. These documents must be kept on the bridge, quickly accessible in an emergency. The Chief Officer ensures they are up to date and complete.
Dar boğaz yaklaşmasında makine dairesi,: While approaching a narrow passage, the engine room received a jacket cooling water low-pressure alarm at the same time as it was carrying out successive "half ahead – slow ahead" orders from the bridge. Because the duty officer was focused on the manoeuvre, the alarm was assessed late and starting the standby pump was delayed by 90 seconds.
Dar kanal limanlarında geçen geminin yar: In ports with narrow channels, the suction/surge caused by a passing ship can subject a berthed ship to sudden tension and line parting. In such ports, the Chief Officer monitors the additional lines and the tension monitoring system (if fitted). On ships without automatic tension monitoring, periodic manual checks are made.
Dar sularda veya akıntılı yanaşmada pilo: In confined waters or when berthing in a current, the pilot may use an anchor to hold the ship's head ("dredging anchor"). The Bosun keeps the windlass ready on the fo'c'sle, handles the chain stopper and brake, and pays out the cable under control on the bridge's order (e.g. "walk back two shackles"). Details of the anchoring equipment are covered in a separate section (task 8).
Dar/kapalı alanda (bilge, tank top altı): If cleaning is to be done in a confined/enclosed space (bilge, below the tank top), the enclosed space procedure is applied — no entry without gas measurement, a permit and standby personnel. The Wiper knows the limits of their authority and consults the engineer when in doubt.
Davit fren testi, wire/fall yenileme (ge: Critical items are the davit brake test, renewal of wires/falls (generally every 5 years or according to condition) and the check of the limit switches. For free-fall lifeboats, a simulated release test and a check of the rail system are also carried out.
Davit-launched ve free-fall filikalarda: On davit-launched and free-fall lifeboats, releasing the safety pins, gripes and brakes in the correct order is critical; the wrong order causes premature release accidents. If the AB is in the lifeboat crew, they must clearly know their own duty (painter, brake, helm, engine) and follow the chain of command.
Davit: Gravity (gravity-roller veya luff: Davit: gravity (gravity-roller or luffing arm) or free-fall ramp.
Davit: tek nokta veya çift nokta; hızlı: Davit: single-point or two-point; a single-fall davit is common for fast launching.
Davlumbaz (galley range hood) ve yağ fil: The galley range hood and grease filters are cleaned regularly; accumulated grease is the most common cause of galley fires. A greasy filter can catch fire and carry the fire into the ventilation duct. This cleaning is done weekly/on a schedule and is never neglected.
Davlumbaz (range hood) ve egzoz kanalınd: Grease that builds up in the range hood and exhaust duct is the main fuel of ship galley fires. The filter is degreased weekly and the duct periodically. This cleaning is not just hygiene but a direct fire safety measure (see the galley fire safety task). The cook also keeps his or her knowledge of the hood fan and damper up to date.
Davlumbaz filtresi haftalık, kanal dönem: The hood filter is degreased weekly and the duct periodically. The cables/plugs of electrical equipment are checked for integrity and sockets are not overloaded. On gas systems, leak checks are carried out and the main valve is closed after use. These routines are simple, but they are the measures that do most to reduce fire statistics.
Dayroom genellikle mürettebatın dinlendi: As the dayroom is usually where the crew relax, cleaning is planned with respect for rest hours. Under the MLC, providing recreational space is the employer's obligation; by keeping this space usable and hygienic, the steward is the one who fulfills this obligation in practice.
Dağıtık mimari, arıza analizinde soruyu: A distributed architecture changes the question asked in fault analysis.
