Instead of "Which card has failed?", the question becomes "Which IO unit has dropped out and what was it feeding?". For this reason, the thruster, reference system, power supply and sensor group served by each IO unit must have been identified in advance.
Dağıtık mimarinin en somut çıktılarından: One of the most tangible results of the distributed architecture is the reduction in the number of conductors run to each thruster. In the conventional approach, separate cables are run for each thruster to the DP, TCS, back-up TCS, VDR, autopilot, conning, independent joystick and automation systems. In the Bridge Mate arrangement this is reduced markedly through shared paths.
Dağıtık operatör istasyonları ve DP kont: In addition to the distributed operator stations and DP control computers, the Bridge Mate system includes distributed thruster and sensor interface units based on a stand-alone IO unit designed specifically for use on DP ships. Each interface unit can be placed near the thrusters, reference systems and sensors to be interfaced.
Dead ship; hiçbir güç olmadan, depolanmı: Dead ship means being able to restart the ship with no power available, using stored energy (starting air, emergency battery). IACS UR M requires the ability to recover from the dead ship condition without external assistance. The emergency air compressor (usually independently driven) is the key to this capability.
Deaerator: feed water'dan O₂ ve CO₂ uzak: Deaerator: removes O₂ and CO₂ from the feed water.
Debi (flow rate) düşük tutuldukça ayrım: The lower the flow rate, the longer the separation time and the higher the efficiency; better separation is therefore achieved by running the separator below its nominal capacity (e.g. at the rate recommended by the manufacturer). The Oiler monitors the feed temperature and the flow rate; a low temperature or a high flow rate means poor separation.
Debi ayarı kritiktir; yüksek debi ayrışm: Setting the throughput is critical; a high throughput reduces the separation quality. The maker's recommended throughput must not be exceeded.
Debrief'te belirlenen aksiyonlar bir tak: Actions identified in the debrief are entered in a follow-up list and tracked until they are closed. Clear assignments are made, such as "Rescue boat battery to be replaced — responsible: 2/E — date X". An action that has not been closed is carried over to the agenda of the next Safety Committee meeting.
Deck Log Book, vardiya zabitlerince saat: The Deck Log Book is the operational log of the voyage, kept hour by hour by the officers of the watch. Position, course, speed, weather (wind, sea state, barometer, visibility), engine telegraph changes, anchoring and weighing anchor, pilot embarkation and disembarkation, draughts, ballast operations and important communications are entered. Each watch is signed by the officer taking over.
Deck crane: 360° döner, hidrolik tahrikl: Deck crane: slews through 360°, hydraulically driven; 25–60 t SWL on bulk carriers and general cargo ships.
Deck dayanımı (decking strength) ve lash: Deck strength (decking strength) and lashing point density are verified against the CSM. Overloading or insufficient lashing points cause vehicles to shift and deck damage in heavy weather.
Deck log ile VDR/ECDIS kayıtları arasınd: Consistency between the deck log and the VDR/ECDIS records is critical. In a dispute, the first documents the parties ask for are the VDR download, the ECDIS playback and the deck log. After a critical event the Master must ensure that the VDR data is preserved (save/lock) without being overwritten; otherwise evidence is lost.
Deck log, ORB, GMDSS log ve diğer kayıtl: The time stamps of the deck log, ORB, GMDSS log and other records must be consistent both within each record and with each other. The Second Officer makes sure that the time reference used (UTC/ship's time) is clear and consistent in the logs. This consistency is the basis of trust in PSC inspections and incident investigations.
Deck log, çatışma, karaya oturma veya ağ: After a collision, a grounding or heavy weather damage, the deck log is the basic source for the sea protest and the P&I process. For this reason, during and after an incident the log entries must be kept in as much detail as possible, and helm orders and engine orders must be recorded with time stamps. A log entry that contradicts the VDR (Voyage Data Recorder) data damages credibility in a case.
Deck water seal ve non-return valf, hidr: The deck water seal and the non-return valve prevent hydrocarbons from escaping back to the engine room.
Declaration of Security (DoS), gemi ile: A Declaration of Security (DoS) is a document confirming in writing how security responsibilities are shared between the ship and a port facility (or another ship). A DoS is requested especially when the security levels differ, when the ship is at a facility that does not apply the ISPS Code, during a high-risk operation (e.g. STS — ship-to-ship transfer) or after a security incident. The SSO or the Master has the authority to request a DoS when necessary.
Dedektörler bölge (zone) bazlı köprüüstü: The detectors are connected zone by zone to the fire alarm panel on the bridge. In an alarm the zone and location are shown. On UMS ships the alarm is extended to the accommodation.
Dedicated seawater ballast tank'larda (v: PSPC (Performance Standard for Protective Coatings, SOLAS II-1/3-2) applies to dedicated seawater ballast tanks (and to double-side skin spaces of bulk carriers of 150 m and above); coating condition is rated GOOD/FAIR/POOR and records are requested at survey.
Defect raporlama ve work order takibi, Ü: Defect reporting and work order tracking are how the Third Officer keeps safety equipment actually working, not just working "on paper". Honest reporting, compensating measures and disciplined follow-up ensure that the equipment works the first time in an emergency.
Defect/breakdown durumunda ayrı bir arız: In the event of a defect/breakdown, a separate defect report is opened; the root cause analysis (5-Why) and the corrective action are recorded. Recurring failures are escalated to the company's technical department.
Deflection gauge (dial indicator), her s: The deflection gauge (dial indicator) is fitted between the crank webs of each cylinder. The crankshaft is turned through 360° with the turning gear and readings are taken at 5 positions (either side of BDC, port, TDC and starboard); no reading is taken exactly at BDC because the connecting rod is in the way.
Defleksiyon değeri, krank milinin o sili: The deflection value shows the bending of the crankshaft at that cylinder. A high positive or negative value indicates that an adjacent main bearing is worn (low) or high.
Defleksiyon ölçümü, krank mili krank kol: Deflection is measured with a dial gauge fitted between the crank webs. The changes in the gauge readings are recorded as the crankshaft is turned through 360°. Measurement points: TDC, BDC, port, starboard and symmetrical intermediate points.
Defrost: sıcak gaz veya elektrikli rezis: Defrost: periodic de-icing with hot gas or electric heating elements.
Dekarbonizasyon yolunda LNG (düşük CO2,: On the path to decarbonization, the options assessed are LNG (low CO2, risk of methane slip), methanol (ease of storage), biofuel (drop-in, limited supply) and ammonia/hydrogen (zero carbon, high technical difficulty). Each has a different emissions, storage and safety profile.
Demir atarken/alırken zincirin yönü (lea: When anchoring/weighing anchor, the lead and tension of the cable are reported to the bridge ("cable leading ahead, moderate strain"). This information is critical for the Master's assessment of the maneuver and of whether the anchor is holding.
Demir atma (let go) ve toplama (heave up: During letting go and heaving up (weighing) the anchor, the cadet learns at the forward station to report to the bridge the direction of the cable (which way is the cable leading), its tension (up and down, brought up) and the number of shackles. The cadet understands the significance for the maneuver of terms such as "anchor aweigh" (anchor has broken out of the seabed) and "anchor home/clear".
Demir atmadan önce ırgat çalıştırılır, k: Before anchoring, the windlass is started, the clutch is engaged and the anchor is walked back under control to the water. When the bridge gives the order "Let go", the clutch is disengaged, the band brake is released and the anchor falls freely. The speed of the chain is controlled by the band brake; excessive speed damages the chain and the gypsy.
Demir operasyonlarında ekip liderliği, R: Leading the team in anchor operations is the peak of the Bosun's command on deck; in an intense, noisy and risky environment, the Bosun keeps the team safe while putting the bridge's intentions into effect. Clear communication, safe positioning and the ability to "read" the cable make the anchor operation controlled and safe.
Demir operasyonunda Reis, baş kasara güv: In anchor operations, the Bosun leads the team on the forecastle deck and is the link between the bridge and the station. The Bosun carries out the orders, keeps the team in safe positions, watches the condition of the cable/anchor and reports it to the bridge. In these intense moments, clear communication and composure are vital.
Demir tarama (dragging) veya acil demirl: When the anchor is dragging, or during emergency anchoring, the Bosun is the most critical person on the station; keeping the team safe, the Bosun coordinates a quick and correct response. Any sudden jerk, unexpected load or sign of slipping in the cable is reported to the bridge immediately.
Demir tarama belirtileri; pozisyonun rüz: Signs of a dragging anchor are the position starting to shift in the direction of the wind/current, the cable alternately coming taut for long periods and then slackening (jerking), and the ship swinging differently from what is expected. The AB recognizes these signs and informs the bridge immediately; delay has irreversible consequences.
Demir yeri derinlik, dip cinsi, akıntı v: The anchorage position is chosen according to depth, nature of the bottom, current and traffic; the scope is typically planned as 5–7 times the depth in chain. Brought up is confirmed.
Demir ırgadının üç ana görevi vardır: de: The anchor windlass has three main tasks: letting go the anchor, heaving in the anchor and chain, and holding the ship at anchor. Each task loads a different subsystem of the windlass: when letting go, the band brake and free rotation are decisive; when heaving in, the drive motor and gearbox; and when holding, the chain stopper and the gypsy brake.
Demirde veya rıhtımda gemi \"park edilmi: At anchor or alongside, the ship may look "parked", but the anchor may drag, a line may part or the surrounding conditions may change suddenly. An anchor/mooring watch is an active watch kept to catch these silent dangers early. The AB knows how serious this watch is.
Demirde yatarken stajyer, anchor watch (: While at anchor, the cadet learns how dragging is monitored during the anchor watch: GPS anchor alarm, ECDIS anchor watch, visual transit bearings and observation of the cable tension. When the weather deteriorates, the engine is put on standby and, if necessary, the second anchor is used or more cable is paid out.
Denetim bulguları üç kategoriye ayrılır:: Audit findings fall into three categories: observation, non-conformity (NC) and major non-conformity (major NC). For each finding a root cause analysis is made (e.g. 5 Whys, fishbone diagram) and corrective and preventive actions are defined. Superficial close-outs such as "personnel were warned" are rejected by the auditor.
Denetim günü Birinci Zabit, denetçiye gü: On the day of the inspection, the Chief Officer accompanies the inspector in the deck areas and shows a professional, open and non-defensive attitude. Questions are answered honestly; on an unfamiliar subject, saying "I will check and come back to you" is better than giving wrong information. An approach of cooperation, not argument, reduces the number of findings.
Denetim hazırlığı, son dakika telaşıyla: Inspection readiness is achieved not through a last-minute rush but through discipline maintained every day. The Chief Officer's success comes from keeping the ship "audit-ready" at all times with honest real-time records, well-maintained equipment and a team that knows its duties. A clean inspection history directly protects the ship's commercial value and the company's reputation.
Denetim raporundaki tüm bulgular kayıt a: All findings in the inspection report are recorded, corrective action is planned and evidence of closure is submitted to the company/inspector. The Chief Officer follows up carefully so that unclosed findings are not raised again at the next inspection.
Denetim öncesi panik temizliği yerine sü: The aim is a continuous standard rather than a panic clean-up before an inspection; even so, a preliminary check round is made to clear critical findings such as oily insulation, blocked escape routes and unlabeled chemicals.
Denetim/toplantı öncesi kamarot, toplant: Before an inspection/meeting, the steward prepares the meeting room/saloon: cleanliness, tidiness, the necessary items (water, coffee, seating) and general comfort. A ready, tidy room helps the meeting run efficiently and the ship appear professional.
Denetimde (MLC inspection) mess düzeni,: During an MLC inspection, the order of the mess, hygiene of service, food temperature, cleanliness of drinking water and menu variety are checked. A dirty mess or a breach of hygiene results directly in a finding.
Denetimde (MLC inspection, PSC, vetting): In inspections (MLC inspection, PSC, vetting), the accommodation is the most visible reflection of the ship's operating standards. The inspector checks cabin cleanliness, toilet/shower hygiene, the order of the messhall, garbage management, ventilation and general tidiness. A poor impression leads the inspector to view the whole ship with suspicion, whereas well-kept accommodation builds confidence.
Denetimde bulgu çıkarsa, düzeltici aksiy: If a finding is raised during the inspection, a corrective action plan is prepared and the finding is closed within the deadline. The Third Officer contributes to the follow-up of safety-related findings and supports a permanent solution that prevents the same finding from recurring.
Denetimlerde en sık rastlanan bulgular;: The most common findings in inspections are the set not being returned to automatic mode after a test, a faulty battery charger, the space being used as a store and the fuel tank level being left low.
Denetçi gemiye geldiğinde kaptan veya gö: When the inspector arrives on board, the Master or a senior officer designated by the Master meets him or her, gives a safety briefing (PPE, restricted areas, emergencies) and provides a suitable escort throughout the inspection. The inspector is never left alone; in each area the person in charge of that department (the chief officer on deck, the chief engineer in the engine room) is present. The escort is not there to "watch" the inspector but to direct questions to the right person and put a finding in context at once.
Denetçi sıklıkla bir crew üyesine \"Show: The inspector often says to a crew member, "Show me how you start the emergency fire pump" or "Don this SCBA". FFE competence is therefore measured not only by the equipment but also by training; familiarization records must be ready.
Denetçi tipik olarak: ekipmanın yerini b: The inspector typically expects you to know where the equipment is, to be able to operate it, to show the logbook/records and to know the expiry and service dates, and expects the crew to be trained. The Third Officer keeps these competences ready, both for themselves and for the team.
Denetçi, rastgele bir mürettebata \"must: The inspector may ask a random crew member: "Where is your muster station, how do you use this equipment?" Through regular drills and familiarization, the Third Officer ensures that the team can answer these questions with confidence. Safety is the sum of individual competences.
Denetçiler güvertede; temizlik, korkuluk: On deck, inspectors look at cleanliness, the integrity of railings, clear escape routes, access to equipment, markings, drainage and the general state of maintenance. The Bosun follows a regular self-inspection routine "through the inspector's eyes"; deficiencies found are reported to the Chief Officer and rectified.
Denetçinin en sevdiği teknik, farklı kay: The inspector's favourite technique is cross-checking different records. A transfer in the Oil Record Book must be consistent with the engine room logs, the sounding records and the bunker delivery notes (BDN). The deck log, the GMDSS log, the ECDIS route history and the passage plan must not contradict each other. One record contradicting another raises the inspector's suspicion that "something is being hidden here" and pulls the inspection into a forensic depth.
Deneyimli bir mühendis, makineyi gözle (: An experienced engineer "listens" to the machinery with the eyes (leaks, color, smoke), the ears (knocking, rubbing), the hands (vibration, temperature) and the nose (burning, smell of fuel). This "human sensor" scan catches changes that even the most expensive monitoring system may miss.
Dengesizlik kalıcı ise neden enjektör, y: If the imbalance persists, the cause may be an injector, wear of the fuel pump plunger/barrel or a suction/puncture valve fault. The Second Engineer enters the measurement results in the PMS, opens a work order to overhaul the fuel valve concerned if necessary and verifies the result with a new diagram.
Deniz bölgeleri, kıyı istasyonlarının ka: Sea areas are defined according to the coverage range of coast stations and satellite access. A1 is the area within continuous alerting coverage of at least one VHF DSC coast station (about 20-30 NM); A2 is MF DSC coverage (about 100-150 NM); A3 is Inmarsat geostationary satellite coverage (about 70°N-70°S); A4 is the entire area outside these, including the polar regions (HF DSC mandatory).
Deniz hareketine karşı her ağır kalem la: Every heavy item is secured against the ship's motion with lashings or shelf barriers. Wire reels that could roll are chocked, and paint tins are boxed to stop them toppling over. No heavy object is left loose in the store; it is a risk of both injury and damage.
Deniz hizmet belgesi ve sertifika süreci: The sea service certificate and the certification process are the administrative basis on which the deck cadet turns what has been learned into a career. Requesting documents correctly, keeping them complete and tracking the service period secure the cadet's progress toward becoming an officer.
Deniz hizmeti birden fazla belgeyle izle: Sea service is tracked by more than one document. The seafarer's book (seafarer's discharge book / service record book) officially records each signing on and signing off. The Seafarer's Employment Agreement (SEA — the employment contract required by MLC 2006) documents employment. The Sea Service Certificate confirms the summary of a given period with the Master's signature.
Deniz hizmeti, TRB ve eğitim tamamlandığ: When sea service, the TRB and training are complete, the cadet applies to the flag State/Administration for a certificate of competency (CoC). The sea service documents, the TRB and the training certificates are the basis of this application. Complete, orderly paperwork speeds up the process.
Deniz hizmeti, katılış ve ayrılış tarihl: Sea service is calculated as the number of days between the dates of joining and leaving; however, each Administration's acceptance rules differ. Some Administrations count watchkeeping days specifically, others count shipyard/lay-up periods partly or not at all. The cadet should learn, at the start of the voyage, the rules of their flag and of the Administration to which they will apply.
Deniz kazalarının büyük çoğunluğu tek bi: Most marine casualties result not from a single error but from small overlapping omissions (error chain). Safety procedures are designed to break this chain at specific points: LOTO isolates energy, the PTW assesses the risk in advance and atmosphere testing reveals invisible hazards. Every procedure is a lesson from fatal accidents of the past.
Deniz ortamı çeliği hızla korozyona uğra: The marine environment corrodes steel quickly; paint is the primary barrier against this corrosion. A well-managed coating extends the life of hull and deck steel by decades, whereas neglected corrosion leads to structural weakness and expensive steel renewal. The Bosun is the on-site leader of this fight.
Deniz protestu, krizin sıcak anında gele: A sea protest is a quiet measure that, in the heat of a crisis, secures the legal position for the future. The Master's timely protest, consistent with the records, and fast coordination with the P&I Club protect the ship and crew against unjust liabilities.
Deniz suyu (SW) yalnızca merkezi (centra: Seawater (SW) goes only to the central cooler; the machinery is cooled by a low-salinity fresh water (LT/HT FW) circuit.
Deniz suyu korozyonu ve deniz canlısı ki: Seawater corrosion and marine growth fouling are confined to the central cooler and a short SW line. Because the internal FW circuit stays clean and controlled, the machinery coolers last longer, maintenance intervals are extended and temperature control is more stable.
Deniz suyu pompaları genellikle çift olu: There are usually two seawater pumps, one of them on standby; automatic changeover is triggered by a drop in pressure.
Deniz suyu serpintisi güvertede ve ekipm: Sea spray deposits salt on the deck and equipment; this salt accelerates corrosion and damages paint. Regular fresh water washing removes these deposits. Because washing makes surfaces more slippery, it requires careful walking and suitable footwear; hose pressure and slippery surfaces carry a risk of injury.
Deniz suyu, yüksek ve alçak deniz sandık: Seawater is taken from the high and low sea chests. In shallow, muddy or icy waters, choosing the right sea chest determines the risk of blockage and of drawing in air.
Deniz suyuyla temas eden yağlama noktala: The use of environmentally acceptable lubricants (EAL) at lubrication points in contact with seawater is verified against the rules applicable in the ship's trading area. In water-lubricated stern tube arrangements, the bearing material and the water flow are monitored.
Deniz yüzeyinden (sea clutter) ve yağmur: Echoes from the sea surface (sea clutter) and rain (rain clutter) can mask real targets. The sea clutter (STC/anti-clutter sea) and rain clutter (FTC/anti-clutter rain) controls suppress this noise; but excessive suppression can also remove small real targets.
Denizcilik alüminyum alaşımları: 5083, 5: Marine aluminium alloys: 5083 and 5086 (alloyed with Mg) have high corrosion resistance.
Denizcilik emniyet bilgisi (MSI) — seyir: Maritime safety information (MSI) — navigational warnings, weather reports, SAR information — is received automatically. NAVTEX (518 kHz) provides MSI in coastal waters, and Inmarsat SafetyNET on the open sea (A3). These broadcasts are recorded continuously and automatically.
Denizcilik sektöründe MARPOL Annex VI Re: In the maritime sector, under MARPOL Annex VI Reg. 12, new installations containing R-12 have been prohibited since 19 May 2005, and new installations containing R-22 since 1 January 2020.
Denizcilikte sözlü iletişim kanıt değild: At sea, oral communication is not evidence. The Master's basic principle: "if you said it, write it down; if you did not write it, it counts as not said." Every critical communication is recorded by e-mail, in the log book, in the SOF (Statement of Facts), in a Letter of Protest or by telex. Telephone conversations are confirmed at once by e-mail as a summary ("as per our telcon at 0930 LT...").
Denizde aylarca aileden ve karadan uzak: For crew members who live at sea for months, away from family and land, mealtime is the most anticipated social moment of the day. A good meal is a ritual that eases homesickness, brings the team together in the mess and ends the day on a positive note. The cook's small touches (the smell of fresh bread, a home-style dessert, an unexpected favorite dish) have a disproportionately large effect on morale.
Denizde bakım, ekipmanın seyir emniyetin: Maintenance at sea is done provided that it does not affect navigational safety (e.g. maintenance of a standby generator or the second air compressor). Jobs that will immobilize the main engine (general overhaul of injectors, scavenge space entry) are done only under safe anchorage/port conditions and with the bridge's approval. Before immobilization, the Second Engineer coordinates notification to the bridge, the telegraph/UMS mode and the time needed to return the engine to service.
Denizde hiçbir gevşek malzeme güvertede: At sea, no loose material is left on deck; even a single drum of paint can be thrown about by rolling and cause injury or be lost overboard. "Sea-fastening" is an integral part of finishing any job.
Denize verilemeyen veya teslim bekleyen: Waste that cannot be discharged into the sea or is awaiting delivery is stored on board; this storage must be hygienic. Food waste is kept in lidded, leak-proof containers and, where possible, refrigerated (long voyages, hot climates) so that odor and decay do not attract pests. The cook integrates the galley waste flow into the galley layout; the garbage station is located apart from the clean area, where it does not interfere with service (see the galley organization task).
Denize yağlı su deşarjı çok katı kuralla: Discharge of oily water to sea is subject to very strict rules, and violations are punished most severely. The Second Engineer knows that no shortcut is acceptable in this area; bypasses such as a "magic pipe" are both a crime and an act that destroys the reputation of the ship and the company.
Denizle temas eden hidrolik düzenlerde (: For hydraulic arrangements in contact with the sea (steering gear, windlass, cranes, hatch covers), the use of environmentally acceptable oils and leak records are verified against the rules applicable in the ship's trading area.
Density numune üzerinden hidrometre (are: The density is determined from a sample with a hydrometer or by laboratory methods; often the shore certificate of quality is used as the reference. The temperature at which it was measured is recorded, because density depends on temperature.
Departure öncesi (12 saat içinde) main s: The main steering gear is tested before departure (within 12 hours); the emergency steering is verified by emergency steering drills held at least once every three months (SOLAS V/26.4). The cleanliness of the hydraulic oil is monitored.
Depo havalandırılmış, gıdadan ve ısı kay: The store is kept ventilated and away from food and heat sources. In the event of a spill, the response instructions in the SDS are followed. The steward must know the dilution ratio, contact time and incompatibilities of every chemical used.
Depo içinde aşçı, buzdolabı ve dondurucu: In the stores, the cook measures refrigerator and freezer temperatures at least twice a day and records them in the cold chain log. If a temperature goes outside the limits (e.g. due to a compressor failure), corrective action is taken: the products are moved to another cold store, the fault is reported to the engineer, and the safety of the affected products is assessed.
Depolama tankı (storage tank) → Settling: Storage tank → settling tank (24–48 hours' settling, separation of water and sediment) → purifier/clarifier → service tank (supplying fuel to the engine).
Depolamada çiğ et daima alt rafta, pişmi: In storage, raw meat is always kept on the bottom shelf, below cooked/ready-to-eat products, so that dripping water/blood does not contaminate the shelves above. Products are stored in covered containers. This simple placement rule largely prevents cross-contamination in cold stores.
Derinlik, dip cinsi ve trafiğe göre yer: The anchorage position is chosen according to depth, nature of the bottom and traffic; a scope of typically 5–7 times the depth is planned. Brought up is confirmed; dragging is monitored with an anchor watch.
Derrick (çubuk bumba): Eski tip gemilerd: Derrick: a lifting arrangement seen on older ships that works with a derrick boom and ropes. With the union purchase method, two derricks are worked together for fast operation.
Derrick: tek veya çift halatlı sistem; b: Derrick: single or double rope system; simple, for light loads.
Ders: planlanmamış manevra yapılmaz. Yap: Lesson: unplanned manoeuvres are not made. If one is to be made, a written risk assessment is prepared and approved by the company.
Desludge aralığı, yakıt kirliliğine ve y: The desludge interval is set according to fuel contamination and load: frequent for very dirty fuel, less frequent for clean fuel. If the interval is too long, the bowl clogs and separation deteriorates; if it is too short, there is unnecessary loss of fuel/oil and consumption of operating water. The Oiler verifies that the desludge takes place completely and properly (sound, vibration, observation of the discharge).
Desludge düzgün olmazsa (partial dischar: If the desludge does not take place properly (partial discharge / no discharge), sludge accumulates in the bowl; this leads to imbalance (vibration), loss of separation and eventually clogging of the bowl. Signs: increasing vibration, the housing getting hot, a drop in the quantity of water/sludge separated and a loss of quality at the clean fuel outlet. The Oiler recognizes these signs and reports them to the engineer.
Detektörler fire detection panel'e (gene: Detectors are connected to the fire detection panel (usually with repeater indication on the bridge and in the ECR). Managing false alarms is important: repeated false alarms make personnel insensitive to the alarm (alarm fatigue). Dirty detectors, steam/oil mist and vibration cause false alarms; regular cleaning and calibration are carried out.
Detention gemiyi durdurur; hazırlık titi: A detention stops the ship; preparation must be thorough and evidence-based.
Detention'lar genellikle \"emniyeti, çev: Detentions usually arise from findings that "directly threaten safety, the environment or life": lifeboat launching appliances or davits that do not work, a defective emergency fire pump, an oily water separator discharging overboard with the 15 ppm control bypassed, an invalid or missing main certificate, a back-up steering gear system that does not work, open or obstructed watertight integrity, a serious breach of rest hours and a crew unable to demonstrate their basic emergency duties.
Deterjan dozajı, su sertliği ve çamaşır: Detergent dosage is adjusted according to water hardness and the amount of laundry. Too much detergent is not fully removed in rinsing; it leaves residues in textiles, irritates the skin and damages the machine. Too little detergent weakens cleaning and disinfection. The steward follows the dosage instructions on the product label and the machine capacity; measured use, rather than "guesswork", is essential.
Deterjan/durulama yardımcısı (rinse aid): The detergent and rinse aid dosing pumps are checked; too little detergent leaves dishes dirty, while too much leaves residue. If the machine does not reach sanitizing temperature, the cook switches to hand washing + chemical sanitizing and reports the fault.
Deviation, gemi büyük tamir/kuru havuz s: Deviation is redetermined by an authorized compass adjuster by "swinging" the ship after major repairs/dry-docking, when the cargo distribution has changed permanently, or when the reliability of the deviation card is in doubt. The Second Officer records the date of the swing and the new card.
Devir tamamlandığında engine room logboo: When the handover is complete, the time of handover and the names of the outgoing and relieving engineers are entered in the engine room logbook. From that moment, responsibility for the safety of the engine room passes to the relieving engineer. If there is any doubt or uncertainty, the relieving engineer delays taking over and informs the Second Engineer.
Devir teslimlerde 'kritik beklenen komut: A list of "critical expected orders" should be mandatory at handovers; a test call on the bridge–engine room voice line should be an item on the pre-manoeuvre checklist.
Devir-teslim Engine Log Book'a kayıt edi: The handover is recorded in the Engine Log Book.
Devir-teslimde standby jeneratör durumu,: At the handover, the status of the standby generator, the separators in operation, boiler pressure, bilge and sludge tank levels, ongoing bunkering/transfer operations and the jobs to be done during that watch under the PMS (Planned Maintenance System) are made clear. The oiler includes this information in their own rounds plan.
Devralan DPO sistemi anlayıp kabul ettik: The checklist is signed by both DPOs once the relieving DPO has understood and accepted the system.
Devralan lookout; mevcut trafik durumunu: The relieving lookout takes over the current traffic situation, the targets being watched, the weather/visibility conditions and points requiring special attention (e.g., "group of fishing boats on the starboard bow"). STCW A-VIII/2 provides that relieving personnel are not considered fully on duty until their eyes have fully adjusted to the light conditions.
Devralan mühendis; manuel/UMS modu, deva: The relieving engineer is briefed on the manual/UMS mode, ongoing maintenance work, isolated equipment (under LOTO), pending work orders and requests from the bridge (e.g. an upcoming maneuver, a request for main engine stand-by). The watch is not taken over until this information has been verified.
Devralan vardiyacı, round atarak ana mak: The engineer taking over the watch makes a round and checks the main engine, auxiliary machinery, boilers, tank levels and the general condition of the engine room.
Devredeki jeneratörlerin yükü, exhaust s: The load, exhaust temperatures, LO pressure, jacket water temperature and fuel consumption of the generators on line are monitored. With generators running in parallel, load sharing must be balanced; one set taking noticeably more load than the other points to a governor/AVR setting problem.
Devreden vardiyacı, tüm çalışan ekipmanl: The engineer handing over the watch passes on the status of all running equipment, maintenance work in progress, the alarm history and pending tasks.
Dezavantajı: GWP değeri yüksektir (3220): Disadvantage: its GWP is high (3220); it is being restricted progressively under the Kigali Amendment.
Dezenfektanlar etiketteki temas süresi (: Disinfectants are not effective unless they are applied for the contact time stated on the label (the surface generally has to stay wet); a "spray it, wipe it" approach is not disinfection. Chemicals are stored in their original labeled containers, in a ventilated locker away from food.
Dezenfekte edilen içme suyunda serbest k: In disinfected drinking water, the free residual chlorine is the practical indicator that the water remains safe throughout distribution. The WHO Guide to Ship Sanitation generally recommends a free residual chlorine of at least ~0.2 mg/L in the distribution system; this level is a buffer against possible contamination between the tank and the tap. The cook/responsible personnel regularly measure chlorine at taps with a DPD test kit and record the results.
Değerlendirmenin değeri, dürüstlüğüyle d: The value of the assessment is in direct proportion to its honesty. A Master who gives "everyone high marks" both blocks the development of that person and misleads the company about the real risk. Conversely, an assessment that only points out weaknesses damages morale. A good assessment is a balanced tool that records strengths and links each area for development to a concrete action.
Değişiklikler bir bloğun ötesine geçtiği: When the changes go beyond a block, the UKHO publishes a "New Edition" of the chart; the old edition becomes invalid, and the chart cannot be corrected until the new edition has been obtained. The Second Officer reports this to the Master and starts a folio renewal request.
Değişken deplasmanlı pompalar, talep olm: Variable displacement pumps reduce the flow when there is no demand, which reduces heating and energy consumption. In fixed displacement arrangements the excess flow returns through the relief valve and the oil temperature rises quickly.
Değişken hatveli pervanede (CPP) motor d: With a controllable pitch propeller (CPP) the engine speed does not change; the propeller blade angle is reversed to give astern thrust. This gives a faster changeover.
Deşarj için havalandırma fanları durmalı: For discharge, the ventilation fans must be stopped, the fuel valves closed and the dampers closed; otherwise the gas escapes and the concentration falls. After extinguishing, the space is ventilated thoroughly and the gas is measured before anyone re-enters.
Deşarjın yasak olduğu bölgelerde sewage: In areas where discharge is prohibited, sewage is collected in the holding tank and delivered to a reception facility at a suitable port. The Chief Officer monitors the holding tank capacity and plans according to the length of the port stay; an overflowing tank is both a hygiene and a pollution problem.
Diesel generator'lar düşük yükte (örn. <: Diesel generators run inefficiently at low load (e.g. <40%) and suffer from incomplete combustion and fouling (soot). The ETO sets the PMS so that a single engine runs at high load; keeping two engines in parallel at low load is undesirable both because it wastes fuel and for the health of the engines.
Diesel çevrimi dört süreçten oluşur: (1-: The Diesel cycle consists of four processes: (1-2) adiabatic compression; (2-3) heat addition at constant pressure (fuel injection and combustion); (3-4) adiabatic expansion; (4-1) heat rejection at constant volume.
Diesel çevrimi verimi, sıkıştırma oranı: The efficiency of the Diesel cycle depends on the compression ratio (r) and the cut-off ratio (ρ).
Diesel-electric ve azipod tahrikli gemil: On ships with diesel-electric and azipod propulsion, the harmonic load is very high; active front-end drives and 12/18-pulse rectifiers are used to reduce harmonics. The ETO periodically checks the filter capacitors and fuses of these systems.
Differential GPS, kıyı istasyonlarından: Differential GPS improves accuracy with correction data received from shore stations. It is important in port approaches and coastal navigation.
Dijital raporlama platformları (vessel p: If digital reporting platforms (vessel performance, fleet management software) are used, data entry is done in a disciplined and timely manner.
Dikey dönen silindirik yapıdır. Magnus e: A vertical rotating cylinder. It produces thrust from the wind through the Magnus effect. The motor-driven rotor produces a force at right angles to the wind.
Dikey tip (vertical shaft) windlass, zin: In the vertical shaft windlass, the cable lifter (wildcat/gypsy) is on deck and the drive mechanism is in a compartment below deck. It saves space on the forecastle.
Dil bariyeri, emniyet brifinglerinde ve: A language barrier is a serious risk in safety briefings and in an emergency; the Master confirms that critical instructions are understood by everyone and, if necessary, uses visual or multilingual material. Welfare and safety feed each other in a multinational team: a crew that feels valued works more safely.
Dilimleyici (slicer), kıyma makinesi ve: The slicer, mincer and planetary mixer are the galley equipment with the highest risk of cuts and of limbs being caught. Cleaning and blade changes are done only with the machine switched off and unplugged (de-energized); a rotating part is never touched by hand. The manufacturer's guards are never removed or bypassed.
Dinamik risk değerlendirmesi (dynamic ri: Dynamic risk assessment is the immediate re-assessment of a job when conditions on site change (the weather worsens, equipment fails, the team becomes tired). The toolbox talk (a short briefing before the job) is the practical tool for this. The Master builds a just culture that clearly establishes that every crew member has stop-work authority and that anyone who uses it will not be penalised.
Dinlenme saati kayıtları (IMO/ILO format: Rest-hour records (Records of Rest in the IMO/ILO format) are kept in ship's time. On days with a clock change, the record form must state clearly that the day had 23 or 25 hours instead of 24; otherwise the rest totals will look inconsistent at an inspection. For the day of the change, the Second Officer enters the direction and amount of the clock change as a footnote on the record form.
Direct-on-line (DOL) yol verme en basiti: Direct-on-line (DOL) starting is the simplest, but it draws a starting current of 6-8 times the motor rated current; it is therefore used on small motors (usually <15-22 kW). Star-delta starting reduces the starting current to about 1/3 and is common on medium-power motors; however, a torque and current surge occurs at the changeover from star to delta.
Direk veya baca yakınında çalışırken rad: When working near the mast or the funnel, the energy to the radar antenna, radio transmitters, whistle and electrical equipment is switched off, locked out and tagged (lock-out/tag-out). A rotating radar antenna can strike a person, a transmitter emits radiation and a whistle sounding suddenly can cause shock. The AB does not start work until the isolation has been confirmed by the bridge.
Direk, baca, vinç bomu veya yüksek güver: Work on a mast, funnel, crane boom or high deck equipment requires a full body harness, a double lanyard (100% tie-off) and an independent lifeline. The area below the work is cordoned off; a dropped hand tool can be fatal, so tools are tethered to the wrist with a lanyard.
Disc'ler çalışma saatine göre temizlenir: The discs are cleaned according to running hours; the correct gravity disc is selected; the filter ΔP is monitored.
Discharge nozülleri korunan hacme dağıtı: Discharge nozzles are distributed through the protected space; the CO₂ quantity, discharge time and distribution are approved according to the FSS Code design calculation and the net/gross volume definition of the space.
Discharge rate terminal kabul limitini a: The discharge rate does not exceed the terminal's acceptance limit. As the tank level falls, the pump suction conditions become more difficult; cavitation (vapour bubbles caused by vacuum) destroys the pump. The rate is therefore reduced in the final stage and stripping is started.
Disiplin, ceza değil, paylaşılan standar: Discipline is not punishment but the upholding of shared standards. The company SMS and the employment agreements (SEA/CBA) provide a fair procedure for disciplinary action (warning, investigation, the right of defence, records); the Master applies this procedure consistently and without arbitrariness. Reacting differently to different people for the same breach is what destroys authority fastest.
Disiplin, cezalandırmadan çok güvenli ve: Discipline aims to create a safe and fair working environment rather than to punish. The Chief Officer earns the team's trust by acting consistently and without bias; discrimination, harassment and bullying are dealt with under the MLC with zero tolerance.
Disiplinin amacı, bir kişiyi cezalandırm: The purpose of discipline is less to punish one person than to remind the whole team of how seriously the standard is taken. In serious cases (violence, drunkenness, desertion, a positive D&A test) the Master coordinates with the company at once; but most everyday matters are resolved with an early, private and fair conversation, without the need for a formal procedure. A good Master uses formal discipline as a last resort.
Disiplinli bir AB; yüzeyi hak ettiği gib: A disciplined AB prepares the surface properly, paints in the right weather with the right coats, wears full PPE, uses chemicals according to the SDS and collects waste in accordance with MARPOL. This way of working keeps the ship's defense against corrosion strong and protects the safety of the AB and the team. Maintenance is valuable not because it is "visible" but because it "extends the ship's life and ensures safety".
Disk yığını (disc stack) yüzey alanını a: The disc stack increases the surface area and raises the separation efficiency.
Distance log (cumulative) makine perform: The distance log (cumulative) is also used for engine performance and fuel monitoring; for this reason, jumps or freezes are reported immediately. The calibration certificate and verification notes are kept in the log book.
Distilat yakıtlar başlıca DMX, DMA, DMZ,: Distillate fuels are mainly classified as DMX, DMA, DMZ and DMB, and residual fuels as RMA, RMB, RMD, RME, RMG and RMK.
Distile yakıtlar: DMX, DMA (MGO), DMZ, D: Distillate fuels: DMX, DMA (MGO), DMZ, DMB – low-viscosity, clean fuels.
Distress aldıktan sonra koordinasyonu MR: After a distress alert is received, the MRCC (Maritime Rescue Coordination Centre) takes over coordination. The MRCC may designate an OSC (On-Scene Coordinator); this role is taken by the first ship to arrive or the most capable one, which directs the search pattern (expanding square, sector search, parallel track) in accordance with the IAMSAR Manual. The Master must know the IAMSAR procedures both when calling for help and when going to the assistance of another ship; SOLAS V/33 makes it a legal obligation to assist persons in distress.
Distress alert alındığında doğru eylem z: When a distress alert is received, the correct chain of actions is critical: the alert is confirmed, coordination is made with the MRCC and, if necessary, a distress relay is sent. A wrong procedure can cause loss of life; for this reason the bridge team carries out periodic GMDSS drills.
Distress alert: tek tuş ile gemi MMSI, p: Distress alert: sent to the RCC at the touch of a button with the ship's MMSI, position, nature of distress and UTC.
Distress mesajı önce DSC (Digital Select: The distress message is first sent by DSC (Digital Selective Calling) (VHF Ch 70, MF/HF distress frequencies), followed by a spoken MAYDAY call by radiotelephone (VHF Ch 16, MF 2182 kHz): MAYDAY ×3, the ship's name and call sign, position, nature of the distress, assistance required, number of persons on board and other information. Several channels are used: satellite (Inmarsat/Iridium) and, if necessary, the EPIRB. An accurate and up-to-date position determines how quickly rescue arrives.
Dive control ile green light, dalgıç/çan: Green light status, the state of the divers and the bell, the working depth and the recovery time are shared continuously with dive control. Any change of heading or position is reported to dive control in advance; the ship does not move without explicit agreement.
Diyabet, hipertansiyon, alerji veya geçi: The cook provides suitable alternatives for crew members with diabetes, hypertension, allergies or temporary health conditions (stomach upsets etc.). This attentiveness protects physical health and also contributes to morale by making the person feel "seen/valued". Serious cases are coordinated with the person in charge of medical care on board/telemedicine.
Diyagramdan Pmax, Pcomp, mean indicated: Pmax, Pcomp, mean indicated pressure (Pi), indicated power and the combustion angle (timing) are derived from the diagram. The Pmax-Pcomp difference is an indicator of fuel injection timing; late injection lowers Pmax and raises the exhaust temperature, while early injection raises Pmax dangerously and causes mechanical overload.
Diyot, yalnızca bir yönde akım geçiren i: A diode is a two-terminal semiconductor device that conducts current in one direction only. It consists of a P-N junction. It conducts when forward-biased (anode +, cathode −) and blocks in the reverse direction.
Dizel motorlarda sıkıştırma oranı 12:1 i: In diesel engines the compression ratio is between 12:1 and 24:1. At the end of compression the air reaches 600–900 °C, which is far above the ignition temperature of diesel fuel (250–350 °C).
Diğer hatalar; yıllık yayınların (ATT) e: Other errors are using an old edition of the annual publications (ATT), not having a chart of adequate scale in the folio for a critical area, trying to correct a chart for which a New Edition has been published, and not keeping the chart correction log at the same time as the corrections are made.
Diğer riskler: kapalı alan (boş tank, ka: Other risks: oxygen deficiency or toxic gas (H2S, CO) inside enclosed spaces (empty tanks, boilers, crankcases), arcing/fire in electrical switchboards, mechanical entanglement in rotating equipment, and high noise/temperature. The Chief Engineer puts layered barriers (prevention, detection, containment, response) in place against each of these risks.
Diğer sık hata, çalışma alanının dağınık: Another common error is an untidy or slippery work area that makes escape impossible. Coils of line laid out underfoot, pools of oil or water and an overcrowded station make an accident worse.
Dişli (gear) ve vidalı (screw) pompalar,: Gear and screw pumps carry the volumes formed between the rotating elements from the suction side to the discharge side. The flow is proportional to the speed and changes very little as the pressure rises. For this reason the pressure rises dangerously when the discharge line is closed.
Dişli kutusu ve hatve mekanizması yağla: The gearbox and pitch mechanism work in oil; the oil tank is located above the waterline, so that in a leak a fall in level is seen rather than seawater entering the oil. The level and pressure alarms are the first indication of a seal failure.
Do not release, pay out or heave a moori: Do not release, pay out or heave a mooring line without an understood instruction, except for the agreed immediate stop response to danger. During single-up, identify which lines remain loaded before changing the arrangement. Repeat back orders and report completion so the bridge can coordinate the manoeuvre.
DoS; her tarafın hangi güvenlik önlemini: The DoS states which security measures each party undertakes (access control, cargo checks, patrols and so on), its period of validity and the signatories. At a facility that does not apply, or only weakly applies, the ISPS Code, the Master clarifies the limits of responsibility with a DoS and takes additional measures on the ship's side. DoS records are among the security records the ship must keep for a minimum period.
Document of Compliance (DOC) şirkete ver: The Document of Compliance (DOC) is issued to the company and covers the types of ship it operates (bulk carrier, oil tanker, chemical tanker, gas carrier, container ship, passenger ship and so on). The Safety Management Certificate (SMC) is issued to the ship and shows that the ship is operated in accordance with the company's SMS. The ship must carry a copy of the DOC, because the SMC rests on a valid DOC. The Master always verifies that the ship's type is listed on the DOC; otherwise the SMC may be considered invalid.
Doktorsuz bir gemide tıbbi bakım; eğitim: On a ship without a doctor, medical care rests on a triangle of a trained officer (usually the Second Officer), the medical guides and the ship's medical chest, and radio medical advice from ashore (TMAS). The Second Officer must hold the "medical care" competence under STCW A-VI/4 and carry this role seriously.
Dokunmatik ekran, fiziksel butona kıyasl: A touch screen carries a greater risk of a wrong touch than a physical button, especially when the ship is moving. For this reason, making critical mode changes with a confirmation step, and the operator reading the target value before executing the command, are part of good DP practice.
Dolaylı görsel muayene: Endoskop (boresc: Indirect visual inspection: inaccessible areas are inspected with an endoscope (borescope). The inside of cylinders, boiler tubes and the crankcase are checked by this method.
Domuz eti taşıyan/servis eden gemilerde: On ships that carry/serve pork, separate preparation and storage (to prevent cross-contact) are required; separate knives and serving dishes are used for crew members who observe halal. An alternative to beef is planned for Hindu crew members, and seafood-only/vegetarian alternatives for some other crew members. These adaptations are built into the menu cycle from the start and are not left to last-minute improvisation.
Donanım: outboard veya inboard motor, fe: Equipment: outboard or inboard engine, fender, painter, paddles, first aid kit, light and sea anchor.
Donanımın bakımı genelde elektro-teknik: Although maintenance of the equipment is usually carried out by the electro-technical officer (ETO) or a service company, monitoring of operational accuracy (error, deviation, calibration records) on the bridge is the Second Officer's responsibility. These records are among the first documents requested in PSC and flag State inspections.
Dondurucu hedefi -18°C ve altıdır; ürünl: The freezer target is -18°C or below; products are separated by category and packed airtight to prevent freezer burn. The cook arranges the freezer in order of use: items to be used soon within easy reach, items that will stay a long time at the back. Each package is labeled with its contents and freezing date; thawed products are not refrozen.
Dondurulmuş ürün, en güvenli şekilde buz: Frozen products are most safely thawed under control in the refrigerator (≤5°C); this is slow but the safest method bacteriologically. In an emergency, they can be thawed under cold running water or in a microwave (if they are to be cooked immediately). Thawing at room temperature is not done; while the surface warms up, the inside stays frozen and bacteria can grow on the surface.
Door'ların yanındaki uyarı levhaları, ka: The warning signs next to the doors, the risk of trapping fingers or limbs while a door is closing, and the correct way to pass through are taught. It is stressed that these doors are critical barriers protecting the integrity of the ship (fire/flooding containment).
Dormancy period 3–12 dakika arasında seç: The dormant period is set between 3 and 12 minutes; at the end of it a visual indication starts on the bridge.
Doğrama sırasında \"köprü tutuş\" ve doğ: When chopping, the "bridge hold" and correct cutting technique are used, and fingers are kept clear of the blade. In heavy weather, chopping is postponed or reduced where possible; knife control becomes difficult when the ship is rolling. In the event of a cut, the food is contaminated and first aid is given.
Doğru atık yönetimi, tüm mürettebatın ka: Proper waste management requires the participation of the whole crew. The Chief Officer trains the crew on segregation rules, discharge prohibitions and the importance of the GRB, and includes these in familiarization. The Garbage Management Plan is kept where everyone can access it, and responsibilities are clearly defined.
Doğru conta seçimi, sızdırmazlığın temel: Choosing the correct gasket is the basis of tightness. The type of fluid (oil, fuel, water, steam, exhaust), its temperature and its pressure determine the material and thickness. A wrong gasket — for example, a low-temperature gasket on a steam line — soon deforms and leaks. Non-asbestos materials are standard; asbestos is prohibited.
Doğru gözlem, hem küresel tahmin modelle: Accurate observations both feed global forecast models and improve the ship's own short-term forecast. A wrongly calibrated barometer can mislead the pressure tendency analysis and delay recognition of a TRS.
Doğru lashing açısı kritiktir: çok dik v: The correct lashing angle is critical: lashings that are too steep or too flat reduce the effectiveness of the equipment. Because turnbuckles can slacken as the cargo settles, they are re-tightened at the start of the voyage and as necessary (re-lashing). During the voyage, the AB checks the lashings according to the Bosun's schedule and tightens any that have slackened.
Doğru pratik şudur: günlük ve somut kayı: Correct practice is: daily and concrete entries, a weekly signing rhythm, a monthly gap analysis, a balanced spread of competences, repeated familiarization on every new ship and physical safety of the book. A cadet who adopts these disciplines will be ready for the examination file at the end of the voyage with a complete and strong TRB.
Doğru sipariş, fazla alıp bozulmayı ve e: Ordering correctly prevents both spoilage from over-ordering and menu disruption from under-ordering; this is closely tied to stock management (see the related task). A well-planned order + low waste means higher quality within the budget.
Doğrudan görsel muayene: Çıplak gözle ve: Direct visual inspection: done with the naked eye or a magnifying glass. It requires adequate lighting (at least 500 lux), a clean surface and a suitable distance.
Doğrulama süreci IAPP/IEEC sertifikasyon: The verification process is tied to IAPP/IEEC certification; but for sustainable compliance the operating procedures (override conditions, recording discipline) must be clearly defined.
Doğrulama süreci, verinin izlenebilir ve: The verification process requires the data to be traceable and consistent; missing evidence delays the SoC. This in turn can affect the ship's certification status.
Doğrulanmış pozitif sonuçta kaptanın ilk: With a confirmed positive result, the Master's first priority is safety: the person concerned is removed at once from safety-critical duties (watchkeeping, manoeuvring, cargo operations). The company (DPA / crewing or HR department) is then notified at once; most SMSs classify a positive result as a "non-conformity / reportable event". The decision process is not left to the Master alone; the company's disciplinary procedure and legal department come in.
Doğuya seyirde saatler ileri, batıya sey: When steaming east the clocks are advanced, and when steaming west they are retarded. The Second Officer plans the zone changes in advance according to the progress in longitude and usually spreads them evenly over the night watches. A sudden or large single clock change disrupts the crew's rest hours and alertness.
Draft survey ve yükleme/boşaltma kontrol: For draft surveys and loading/discharging checks, the forward, aft and midship draft marks are read. The AB reads the draft marks at the mean water level between waves and surges, from a boat or the pilot ladder if possible, in a safe position. Readings are taken in meters (m) or feet, according to the arrangement of the marks.
Draft survey, draft okumaları ve hidrost: A draft survey calculates the quantity of cargo loaded/discharged from draft readings and hydrostatic data. The cadet learns draft reading, the water density correction and the logic of the calculation by observing. This is an important skill from both a commercial and a stability point of view.
Drill bir \"kutu işaretleme\" değildir;: A drill is not "box-ticking"; every drill is evaluated, weaknesses are recorded and lessons are drawn for the next one. Scenarios must not become routine; night drills, different fire locations and "missing person" variations test real readiness.
Drill bittiğinde mutlaka debrief yapılır: When the drill is over, a debrief is always held: what went well, what went badly, which equipment was missing or defective, which procedure was slow. A debrief is a learning session, not a blame session; the question is not "who made the mistake?" but "where is the system weak?". Every finding is tied to a concrete action.
Drill genel alarm (yedi kısa + bir uzun): The drill starts with the general alarm (seven short + one long) or a signal suited to the scenario. The crew come to the muster station with lifejackets/immersion suits; each station leader takes a head count and reports to the bridge. Anyone missing must be identified at once; in a real emergency, the answer to "who is missing?" must be clear within minutes.
The quality of a drill bears the Master's signature. An effective drill includes a realistic scenario, an unexpected complication (e.g. "this liferaft is defective, use the alternative"), timing, and a debrief afterwards. "What went well / what to improve" is written in the drill records and deficiencies are turned into corrective actions. Beyond seeing the record, a PSC inspector can test real competence by saying "show me".
Drill kaydı ile mürettebatın gerçek bilg: The drill record and the crew's actual knowledge must be consistent. If the record shows a monthly enclosed space drill, a random crew member must be able to explain the permit to work and atmosphere testing. The Safety Officer maintains this consistency by actually holding the drills and ensuring participation by rotation.
Drill öncesi kullanılacak ekipman çalışı: Before the drill, the equipment to be used must be in working order: full SCBA cylinders, fire pump pressure, fire hoses and nozzles, the rescue boat engine, the davit and the release gear. The Safety Officer plans which equipment will actually be operated during the drill; it is made clear whether the drill will be dry (tabletop) or physical.
Drill'de helm order iletişimi, pompa cha: In the drill, helm order communication, pump changeover time and rudder response are measured. In a real failure, this rehearsal prevents loss.
Drill'in başarısı, hiçbir gerçek acil ya: The success of drills stays invisible as long as no real emergency occurs. In a real fire or abandonment, however, the crew's reflexes depend on exactly this disciplined, realistic and recorded drill routine. Saying "the drill was held" is the start; being able to say "the team knows, the equipment works, the gaps are closed and the record reflects reality" means the job is done.
The drill itself is the biggest accident risk. In accordance with MSC.1/Circ.1206/Rev.1, in lifeboat launching drills the release gear is tested while no personnel are on the hook, and maintenance pins are managed strictly. Weather and sea state, crew fatigue and the maneuvering area are assessed before the drill; if the risk is high, the drill is postponed.
Drill, sadece \"yapıldı\" damgası için d: A drill is held not just to get a "done" stamp but to find the weak link in the organization. A department that musters late, equipment that cannot be found or a duty that nobody knows must be caught in a drill and corrected before a real emergency.
Drip tray (damlama tepsisi), manifold ve: Drip trays are placed under the manifold and connection points to catch small leaks. The Oiler checks the drip trays regularly and empties their contents into the sludge/waste tank (never into the sea/bilge).
Droop mode: Her jeneratörün frekansı yük: Droop mode: the frequency of each generator falls slightly as the load increases; this gives natural load sharing.
Dry ship politikası uygulayan şirketlerd: In companies with a dry ship policy, bringing alcohol on board, possessing it and consuming it are prohibited; there is no alcohol in the bond store, or it is kept locked and sealed. The Master has the authority defined in the SMS for periodic searches of cabins and common areas; these searches are made with respect for privacy, preferably in the presence of the person concerned and a witness.
Drydock döneminde iş yükü zirve yapar; B: During drydock the workload peaks; the Chief Engineer prioritizes the critical path jobs (shaft survey, tail-shaft draw, main engine overhaul) with a master plan and manages coordination with the shipyard team.
Drydock veya büyük tamirat sonrası sea t: During the sea trial after drydock or a major repair, main engine load tests, gradual load increases, vibration measurements and performance verification are carried out. The Chief Engineer compares the results with the baseline and presents them to the class surveyor.
Ducting, yoğun yağış, sea state, hedef r: Ducting, heavy precipitation, the sea state, the target's radar cross-section and the antenna height change the detection range. A target beyond the radar horizon or with a low RCS not being visible does not mean the target is not there.
Duman dedektörleri (iyonizasyon/optik) e: Smoke detectors (ionisation/optical) detect particles at an early stage; heat detectors work on a fixed temperature or a rapid rise in temperature (rate-of-rise); flame detectors (UV/IR) see the radiation of an open flame. The most suitable detector is chosen for the type of space.
Duman içinde görüş sıfıra iner; AB karan: In smoke, visibility drops to zero; the AB must know how to get through a dark, smoke-filled corridor by following the wall by hand, keeping low and following the escape lighting. In drills, the escape routes are learned by physically walking them; in a real emergency, memory and reflexes show the way.
Duplex (çift) filtrelerde bir taraf çalı: On duplex filters, one side can be taken out for maintenance while the other is in service; the changeover is done carefully so that the supply is not interrupted and no air lock forms. The cadet learns the changeover sequence and the need for venting (air release).
Durdurma kararı her zaman gerekçeli ve y: A decision to stop is always made with reasons and in writing: the log book, a Letter of Protest, an e-mail to the company (DPA) and notification to the charterer through the SOF/NOR. This threefold record protects both the ship and the company in demurrage disputes and legal proceedings.
Durma mesafesi gemi boyunun 5-15 katı ka: The stopping distance is 5–15 times the ship's length and depends on displacement, speed and sea state.
Durum farkındalığı (situational awarenes: Situational awareness has three levels: perception, comprehension and projection of the future. The cadet learns to project mentally how the current traffic situation will develop over the next few minutes. The cadet also recognizes how fatigue, monotony and distraction degrade this awareness.
Durumsal farkındalık (situational awaren: Situational awareness consists of three levels: perceiving the surroundings (perception), making sense of them (comprehension) and anticipating the future (projection). The Second Officer teaches junior officers to keep asking not only "what is happening?" but also "what does this mean?" and "what will happen in 5-10 minutes?". Position, traffic, depth and the weather trend must together form one picture in the mind.
Durumsal farkındalık kaybının tipik nede: Typical causes of loss of situational awareness are excessive workload, distraction (e.g. fixation on a single device — task fixation), fatigue and the assumption that "everything is fine". Training builds the officer's habit of regularly stepping back to the "big picture" throughout the watch and rescanning the horizon and all sensors.
Duty engineer, gece periyodik rounds yap: The duty engineer makes periodic rounds at night and activates the dead-man alarm (engineer's safety) system when working in the engine room. This system alerts the bridge if the engineer does not respond within a set time.
Duty/standby pump auto-start, low pressu: Duty/standby pump auto-start and the low pressure, high temperature and strainer differential alarms are tested. The effect of ventilation, fire dampers and machinery space flooding boundaries on the redundancy groups is checked.
Duyuru özellikle vardiya devri için krit: The announcement is particularly critical for the watch handover; when the clocks are put forward or back, the relieving officer must know the new ship's time and the engine room must update its watch schedule. The Second Officer coordinates the change so that it is applied by all departments at the same time; setting all the clocks on board (bridge, engine room, cabins) at the same time is good practice.
Duş alanlarında küf (mould) ve kireç bir: Mold and limescale build-up are common in shower areas; a damp environment breeds mold. Ventilation is provided after showers, and moldy grout joints are cleaned with a special product. A blocked drain is both a hygiene and an odor problem; hair/soap blockages are cleared regularly, and serious blockages are reported to the engine/deck crew.
Dökme yük gemilerinde hold hazırlığı; bi: On bulk carriers, hold preparation is graded according to the next cargo and the charter terms: load-ready (swept), shovel-clean, grain-clean, hospital-clean. The Bosun obtains the required level from the Chief Officer and directs the team accordingly.
Dökme yük gemilerinde side-rolling (yana: On bulk carriers, side-rolling covers give a wide hatch opening and full clearance for grabs and cargo handling. On container ships, pontoon (lift-away) covers are lifted off by crane and containers are stowed on top of them. Folding covers are common on general cargo ships.
Dökme yük kalıntısı, MARPOL Annex V Appe: If a bulk cargo residue is HME (harmful to the marine environment) according to the criteria in MARPOL Annex V Appendix I, it must not be discharged into the sea; it is retained on board, together with the wash water, and delivered to a reception facility. The shipper declares whether the cargo is HME; the Chief Officer checks this declaration and decides on the discharge of hold washing water accordingly. If there is any doubt about the HME classification, the cargo is treated as harmful.
Dönen tezgahta bol giysi, eldiven, krava: Loose clothing, gloves, ties, necklaces and loose sleeves are prohibited at a rotating machine; if they are caught by the workpiece, they can lead to the loss of an arm or fingers. Swarf is cleared with a brush/hook, never by hand; coolant (cutting fluid) is applied.
Dönen veya enerjili ekipman üzerinde bak: When maintenance is carried out on rotating or energized equipment, the energy source (electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, steam) is physically locked and tagged under LOTO. This prevents unauthorized start-up. Each lock is unique and can be removed only by the person doing the job. Starting air is the most critical LOTO point while the main engine is being turned.
Dönen veya enerjili ekipman üzerinde çal: Before work on rotating or energized equipment, all energy sources (electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic, pressurized fluid, potential/gravity) are safely isolated and prevented from being unexpectedly activated. Lock Out is done with a physical lock, and Tag Out with a warning tag.
Dördüncü ciddi hata, fiilen yapılmamış i: The fourth serious mistake is entering in the TRB work that was not actually done. This is both a disciplinary offense and a risk that will be exposed in the oral examination. The TRB is also a test of the cadet's honesty; an exaggerated book creates distrust in the examination interview.
Dördüncü problem, deniz hizmeti süresini: The fourth problem is sea service being calculated incorrectly under the Administration's rules, so that a period the candidate thought was sufficient turns out to be insufficient on the accepted basis. The fifth is that the validity of mandatory courses has expired at the time of application. Most of these problems are prevented by early planning and checks.
Dört zamanlı motor daha yüksek devirde (: The four-stroke engine runs at a higher speed (about 500–1000 rpm), uses a trunk piston (no crosshead) and is lubricated by a single oil circuit (common to the cylinders and the crankcase). Its power density is high; but for propelling large ships it is usually combined with a gearbox or electric propulsion.
Dört zamanlı motorda emme, sıkıştırma, i: A four-stroke engine has four strokes: intake, compression, power and exhaust. There is one power stroke every two crankshaft revolutions.
Dört zamanlı motorlarda emme ve egzoz su: In four-stroke engines the intake and exhaust valves are driven by the camshaft. The camshaft turns at half the crankshaft speed. Valve timing is critical for engine performance.
Dövme veya döküm yöntemiyle üretilir. Kr: It is made by forging or casting. It consists of the crankpins, the main journals and the crank webs.
Dövme çelikten üretilir. Büyük uç (big e: It is made of forged steel. The big end is connected to the crankpin and the small end to the crosshead pin.
Dümen donanımı arızası, geminin yön kont: A steering gear failure means that the ship loses directional control; in confined waters, in traffic or during maneuvering, this can end in disaster. This is why SOLAS requires redundancy (main + auxiliary power unit), regular testing and an emergency steering arrangement for the steering gear.
Dümen etkisi pervane akımına bağlıdır; p: Rudder effect depends on the propeller wash; when the propeller stops, the rudder loses effect. Manoeuvring parameters such as transverse thrust (the propeller's sideways effect), the pivot point and advance/transfer must be known by the bridge team. As the rudder angle increases, stall (flow separation) and loss of speed occur.
Dümen kontrolü köprüden iki bağımsız sis: It must be possible to control the steering from the bridge through two independent systems; if the main system fails, it must be possible to change over to the auxiliary from the bridge, and local (emergency) control must be available in the steering gear compartment. On tankers, steering capability must be maintained after a single failure (single failure criterion).
Dümen sistemi (steering gear), geminin m: The steering gear is fundamental to the ship's ability to maneuver and avoid collision; for this reason it is designed with redundancy. If the main steering gear fails or power is lost, emergency steering mode is used: the second hydraulic pump is started or local/manual control is applied from the steering gear room. Communication (telephone) between the bridge and the steering gear room, and a rudder angle indicator, are provided.
Dümen sistemi arızası, gemiyi manevra ka: A steering system failure deprives the ship of its ability to maneuver and creates a risk of collision/grounding. SOLAS requires main and auxiliary steering gear and remote/local control. When a failure occurs, an emergency steering order comes from the bridge to the engine room.
Dümen sistemi arızasında emergency steer: In the event of a steering system failure, the emergency steering procedure is applied; steering is controlled from the steering gear room by manual/local control, in coordination with the bridge by telephone/signals. The Oiler knows their duty at this position and the emergency steering drills.
Dümen, dönme ekseni ile yüzey alanının d: Rudders are classified according to the position of the axis of rotation relative to the distribution of the surface area: balanced (spade/balanced), semi-balanced and unbalanced. In a balanced rudder, the axis divides the surface, so the turning moment (torque) is reduced. The flap/Becker rudder provides additional lift at large rudder angles by means of a trailing flap (high maneuverability).
Dümenci hem gyro repeater hem manyetik p: The helmsman uses both the gyro repeater and the magnetic compass. The gyrocompass gives the true heading; the magnetic compass is critical as a backup (in case of gyro failure). The difference between the gyro and the magnetic compass is checked periodically; if the error increases, the OOW is informed. At the change of watch, the course and the status of the compasses are handed over.
Dümenci, pusula başını (compass heading): The helmsman uses the compass heading as the reference but does not keep moving the helm; when the ship's head swings, the helmsman meets the swing with small, well-timed helm movements ("meeting the swing" technique). Over-steering makes the ship snake along an uneven track and wastes fuel; under-steering lets the ship wander off course. A good helmsman keeps a steady course with minimum helm.
Dümeni çeviren güç hidroliktir. Ram tipi: The power that turns the rudder is hydraulic. In the ram type, cylinders push the tiller; in the rotary vane type, vanes attached to the rudder stock turn under pressure. The pumps (usually two, variable delivery) drive the rudder to the ordered angle.
Dünya genelinde mooring snap-back kaynak: Worldwide, deaths caused by mooring snap-back are regularly reported by the MAIB and other authorities. The common factors are: crew standing in the path of a taut line, fatigue, poor lighting and rushed operations. Lesson: no port schedule is more important than the safe positioning of a single crew member.
Dünya, Greenwich'i (0° boylam) merkez al: The world is divided into 24 standard time zones centered on Greenwich (0° longitude); each zone is 15° wide and differs from UTC by a whole hour. The Zone Description (ZD) shows the sign and value that must be applied to ship's time in that zone to obtain UTC. In east longitude the ZD is negative (e.g. ZD −5), in west longitude it is positive (e.g. ZD +5); the rule is: "in east longitude, zone time is ahead of UTC".
Dünya, MSI yayını için 21 NAVAREA/METARE: For MSI broadcasts, the world is divided into 21 NAVAREAs/METAREAs; each area has a responsible coordinator country. On ocean passages, once outside NAVTEX range, MSI is received via Inmarsat-C SafetyNET (EGC). The cadet learns which method is used to receive warnings in which area and how the receiver is set up for the areas being transited.
Dünya, World-Wide Navigational Warning S: Under the World-Wide Navigational Warning Service (WWNWS), the world is divided into NAVAREAs; a coordinator for each area issues the NAVAREA warnings. Below this level come national coastal warnings and local warnings at port/VTS level. Throughout the voyage, the Second Officer follows the warnings for the NAVAREAs the ship passes through.
Düzeltici (corrective) aksiyon mevcut so: A corrective action eliminates the existing problem; a preventive action stops a similar one from occurring. Each action is defined in SMART terms (responsible person, date, measurable outcome). The Safety Officer follows up open actions; an action that is not closed creates a repeat finding at audit.
Düzeltici aksiyon döngüsü PDCA (Plan-Do-: The corrective action cycle works on PDCA (Plan-Do-Check-Act) logic: the event is reported, the root cause found, the action defined and implemented, and its effectiveness verified (effectiveness check). If the effectiveness check is skipped, the same event recurs. The Master is the person who follows whether the closed actions have really solved the problem; this tracking log is examined in audits.
Düzeltme rutini sabit bir güne bağlanır: The correction routine is tied to a fixed day (e.g. every Friday) and kept up without interruption; the incoming edition is processed in the same week. The log is signed at the same time as each correction; after an ECDIS update has been loaded, the 100% status and the cell list are verified.
Düzeltme tamamlandığında haritanın sol a: When the correction is complete, the year and number of the notice (e.g. "2026-1542") are added to the correction line in the bottom left-hand corner of the chart. This line is the official record showing up to which correction the chart is up to date, and it is the first place looked at during a PSC check.
Düzeltme, kronolojik sırayla ve hiçbir h: Corrections are made in chronological order without skipping any week, because a later correction may build on an earlier one. The Second Officer first scans the incoming weekly edition through Section II "Charts", identifies the folio charts affected and enters each one in the chart correction log.
Düzen aynı zamanda acil durum hazırlığın: Order is also a precondition for emergency preparedness. Being unable to reach the foam monitor when a fire breaks out, a blocked route to the muster station at the moment of abandon ship, or stowed material blocking access to a liferaft all turn into disaster at moments when seconds save lives.
