Düzen aynı zamanda acil duruma hazırlık: Order also means emergency preparedness: in a fire, flooding or when evacuating, an unobstructed deck allows fast and safe movement. An untidy deck both causes accidents in routine work and hinders escape and response in a crisis. This is why housekeeping is not a "cleaning job" but a continuous safety discipline.
Düzen kendi yakıt tankı, soğutma, yağlam: The arrangement must be independent of the main system, with its own fuel tank, cooling, lubrication and starting source. The flash point of the fuel and its fluidity in cold weather are assessed together with space heating and the block heater.
Düzen, makinenin serbest ucundan (front-: The arrangement uses a machine fitted at the free end of the engine (front-end PTO), on the gearbox or directly on the shaft. The same electrical machine can work both as a generator and as a motor.
Düzenli \"engine room walk-round\" sıras: During the regular "engine room walk-round", findings are recorded, photographed and followed up until closed. Housekeeping is managed not as a one-off clean-up but as a routine that is continuously improved.
Düzenli atölye güvenli atölyedir. Yağ/ta: A tidy workshop is a safe workshop. Oil/swarf is not allowed to build up on the floor (slip/fire risk), gas cylinders are secured with chains, electrical cables do not create trip hazards and heavy parts are stowed securely. Lighting must be adequate and ventilation (for welding fumes) must be in working order.
Düzenli bir depo, kumanya stok yönetimin: A well-organized store directly supports provisions stock management (see the related task): visibility increases, losses decrease and order accuracy improves. A disorganized store, on the other hand, leads to waste and to nonconformities during inspections.
Düzenli bir galley, atık ayrımını da kol: A well-organized galley also makes waste segregation easier. Food waste, plastics, glass/metal and cooking oil are collected separately; this both reduces the attraction of pests and ensures MARPOL Annex V compliance (detailed disposal is covered in a separate task). Garbage bins must have lids, be leak-proof and be emptied regularly; accumulated waste means both odor and insects.
Blackout drills should be held regularly.
Düzenli fire drill'ler aşçının refleksin: Regular fire drills keep the cook's reflexes sharp: extinguisher locations, the pull station, closing the dampers, using the fire blanket. The cook acts in the knowledge that his or her own space (the galley) is the highest-risk point; a galley scenario is rehearsed separately during drills. Training and preparedness are the only things that turn panic into action in a real fire.
Düzenli rounds ile sızıntı, ısınma ve an: Leaks, overheating and abnormal noise or vibration are checked on regular rounds; in UMS mode the dead-man alarm and the transfer of alarms to the bridge and cabins must work. The handover is made clearly.
Düzenli sounding, sızıntı ve transfer ha: Regular soundings allow leaks and transfer errors to be detected early.
Düzenli tatbikatlar (engine room fire, b: Regular drills (engine room fire, blackout, flooding, enclosed space rescue) are planned so that they do not clash with the watch arrangement, and personnel from every watch take part. After each drill, the Second Engineer feeds the lessons learned back into the watchkeeping procedures.
Düzgün purifikasyon, çoğu zaman yağ deği: Proper purification often delays an oil change or makes it unnecessary; this reduces costs and the volume of waste oil (sludge).
Düşme kazalarının ana nedenleri: harness: The main causes of fall accidents: not wearing a harness at all or wearing it loosely, using a single lanyard and unclipping from time to time instead of using a twin lanyard, choosing a weak or unsuitable anchor point, and working with a waist belt instead of a full body harness. Each of these errors means death or serious injury in the event of a fall.
Düşük GM, uzun ve yavaş yalpa periyodu v: A low GM gives a long, slow rolling period; although it may seem comfortable, a small off-center weight or the wind causes a permanent list, and resonance with the wave period can produce dangerous roll angles. A tender ship is very vulnerable to a sudden increase in free surface (e.g. tank rupture, hold flooding).
Düşük IR ölçülen motorlar space heater d: Motors with a low IR reading are dried by switching on the space heater or with external hot air. The ETO verifies that the space heaters of standby motors are working; the windings of a stopped motor absorb moisture. During drying, IR is measured periodically and drying continues until the value stabilizes.
Düşük besleme sıcaklığı ayrımı bozar; pr: A low feed temperature impairs separation; a preheater or thermostat fault is a typical cause. High vibration is always taken seriously and the separator is stopped. The Oiler carries out simple checks (temperature, pressure, operating water) and passes on to the engineer whatever cannot be solved.
Düşük devirli motorlar en yüksek verimi: Low-speed engines give the highest efficiency and the lowest SFOC. They are preferred on large container ships, tankers and bulk carriers.
Düşük karbonlu çelik (< %0.25 C): Kaynak: Low-carbon steel (< 0.25% C): weldable, structural use. Medium-carbon steel (0.25–0.60% C): shafts, gears, bolts. High-carbon steel (> 0.60% C): springs, cutting tools.
Düşük su seviyesinde kazan çalıştırılmas: Firing a boiler with a low water level can cause tubes to burst. This is one of the main causes of the most serious boiler accidents.
Düşük sülfürlü yakıt kullanımında, yükse: When using low-sulfur fuel, continuing to use high-TBN cylinder oil leads to deposit (ash build-up) problems. The Chief Engineer plans a cylinder oil with a TBN suited to the fuel sulfur content (~25-40 TBN for low sulfur) and the feed rate setting.
Düşük sürtünmeli (anti-fouling / foul-re: The choice of low-friction (anti-fouling / foul-release) paint also affects long-term efficiency; this is evaluated in drydock planning. Hull performance monitoring (ISO 19030) makes these decisions objective.
Düşük sıcaklıkta donabilecek hatlar izol: Lines that could freeze at low temperatures are insulated, or heated/drained: BWMS, fire main, deck wash, bilge, ballast vents and external lines. The Second Officer checks this preparation in coordination with the engine and deck crews; a frozen fire main is useless in an emergency.
Düşük yağ basıncı, makinenin en kritik k: Low lubricating oil pressure is one of the most critical engine protections; the alarm and automatic shutdown chain is never disabled for operating convenience.
Düşük yük/yavaş seyirde kurum birikmesi: At low load and slow steaming, soot build-up and the risk of a soot fire must be monitored.
Dışarıda kalan fin, yanaşmada rıhtım/tek: A fin left extended creates a risk of collision with the quay or other craft during berthing.
E: Limit 500°C; neden enjektör arızası,: E: the limit is 500 °C; the cause may be an injector fault, ring blow-by or a valve problem.
E: Sıcaklık 440°C'ye indi; enjektör deği: E: the temperature fell to 440 °C; an injector change has been planned.
EBL/VRM ile ölçülen bearing/range; curso: Bearings and ranges measured with the EBL/VRM give quantitative evidence for decisions, rather than the cursor or an estimate by eye on the screen. If relative bearings are used, gyro/heading error and the own ship's heading reference are dealt with separately.
ECA bölgelerine girişte MGO'ya geçiş yap: On entering an ECA, the ship changes over to MGO. Some of the auxiliary diesel generators are run on MGO. The emergency generator usually runs on MDO or MGO.
ECA giriş/çıkışında HFO↔MGO/VLSFO change: On entering/leaving an ECA, the HFO↔MGO/VLSFO changeover is carried out slowly and under control (to prevent thermal shock and loss of viscosity). During the changeover, the Second Engineer monitors fuel pump and injector leakage; with low-viscosity fuel, internal pump leakage increases and the fuel index rises.
ECA yakıt geçişi, mevzuat uyumu ile maki: The ECA fuel changeover is a sensitive operation where regulatory compliance and machinery safety intersect. Correct timing, an accurate purging calculation, viscosity control and meticulous records protect against both penalties and loss of power. The modern Chief Engineer manages this changeover not as a routine but as a technical process that is carefully planned every time.
ECA'ya girişte uyumlu yakıta geçiş zaman: On entering an ECA the changeover to compliant fuel must be made on time and recorded.
ECA'ya girişten önce sistemin tamamen dü: Before entering an ECA, the system must have been completely changed over to low-sulfur fuel. The changeover is started sufficiently in advance, depending on the fuel system volume (service tank + booster + supply line + injection) and the dilution rate. The Changeover Calculator records the start and finish times, the position and the sulfur value of the changeover.
ECDIS (Electronic Chart Display and Info: ECDIS (Electronic Chart Display and Information System) is the approved electronic navigation system that replaces the paper chart. The cadet learns what the safety contour, safety depth, shallow/deep contour and safety frame (look-ahead) settings mean and how they are determined. A wrongly set safety contour can cause the shallow water warning to come too late; these settings are therefore made according to the ship's draft and the UKC (Under Keel Clearance) policy.
ECDIS ancak resmî Hydrographic Office ye: An ECDIS provides the legal chart function only when it is used with up-to-date ENCs/ENDS issued under the authority of an official Hydrographic Office and in an approved operating mode. An ECS, a web chart, a pilot application or an unofficial chart does not meet the SOLAS chart carriage requirement, even if it appears on the ECDIS screen.
ECDIS carriage requirement tüm SOLAS gem: The ECDIS carriage requirement is not the same for all SOLAS ships; the ship type, GT, date of build and applicable transitional provisions are verified from the Record of Equipment. The carriage requirement and the back-up arrangement are also separate matters: a second independent ECDIS, an up-to-date paper folio or another adequate arrangement accepted by the Administration is defined in the ship's approved documentation.
ECDIS failure; black screen kadar positi: An ECDIS failure is not only a black screen; it can also be a loss of the position or heading source, frozen data, a corrupted SENC, a permit or update failure, a wrong time, network lag, unsafe settings, or the back-up unit being exposed to the same common-mode failure.
ECDIS güncelliği, görünmeyen ama hayati: Keeping ECDIS up to date is an invisible but vital discipline; a single out-of-date cell or an unapplied T&P can hide a real danger behind a screen that looks correct. The Second Officer's regular update cycle is the foundation of reliable electronic navigation.
ECDIS kullanan gemilerde ENC (Electronic: On ships using ECDIS, ENC (Electronic Navigational Chart) updates are applied from the weekly update CD/DVD or an online service (e.g. AVCS). The cadet observes the ENC update loading process, base/permit management and how the update status (chart status) is verified. Although electronic updating is faster than manual correction, confirmation that the update has loaded successfully must not be skipped.
ECDIS tarafında bu kanıt; güncelleme dur: On the ECDIS side, this evidence is the update status report, the license/permit list and the date of the last update. The Second Officer ensures that both the paper and the digital records are consistent and complete and that no corrections are outstanding.
ECDIS tek arıza noktası olmamalıdır. SOL: The ECDIS must not be a single point of failure. SOLAS requires a second ECDIS with an independent power supply (back-up ECDIS) or an appropriate folio of paper charts. The back-up system must be able to continue navigation without interruption if the main unit fails.
ECDIS'in birincil seyir aracı olduğu gem: On ships where ECDIS is the primary means of navigation, continuous and correct operation of the system is vital. The Second Officer regularly verifies ENC currency, the safety contour/depth settings, the sensor inputs (GNSS, gyro, log) and alarm management. The system software version must be approved (compliant with IHO S-52/S-57/S-63).
ECDIS'in birincil sistem arızasına karşı: ECDIS must have a suitable backup against failure of the primary system: a second, independent (separate power/data) approved ECDIS or a suitable paper chart backup. The Second Officer ensures that the backup is operational and up to date; otherwise a single failure leaves the ship without charts.
ECDIS'in en kritik ayarı safety contour': The most critical ECDIS setting is the safety contour. The Second Officer must teach the officer the anti-grounding function of the safety contour, that if the required value is not available in the ENC the system rounds up to the next deeper contour, and that the actual value must therefore be verified.
ECDIS'in over-reliance riski MAIB tarafı: The risk of over-reliance on ECDIS has been reported many times by the MAIB (CFL Performer 2008, Ovit 2013). The Master requires the ECDIS to be used not on its own but cross-checked with radar parallel indexing, visual bearings and GPS.
ECDIS'te ENC sembolleri IHO S-52 standar: In ECDIS, ENC symbols are displayed in accordance with the IHO S-52 standard; the cadet learns the difference between the base/standard/all display modes and that the SCAMIN (Scale Minimum) attribute can hide some objects at certain scales. A suitable display setting is critical so that important objects are not missed because of the scale selected.
ECDIS'te ENC'yi kendi derleme ölçeğinin: Enlarging an ENC in ECDIS beyond its own compilation scale (over-zoom / over-scale) is misleading; the data does not become visibly more detailed, only the symbols get larger, and detail that is missing is taken as not existing. ECDIS indicates this with an "over-scale" warning.
ECDIS, IHO S-57 standardında üretilen ve: ECDIS works with ENC cells produced to the IHO S-57 standard and encrypted with S-63. Updates arrive through weekly ENC update services (such as the Admiralty Vessel ENC Service / AVCS) on CD-DVD or online (e-mail, broadband), and the update files for each cell (.001, .002 ...) are loaded in sequence.
ECDIS, cross-track error, anchor watch,: ECDIS generates many alarms, such as cross-track error, anchor watch, safety contour crossing and dangerous target. The cadet learns that none of these alarms should be muted or routinely "acknowledged"; every alarm has a reason. Accidents caused by over-reliance on ECDIS hold an important place in maritime history.
ECDIS, kağıt haritanın yerini alan onayl: ECDIS is the approved system that replaces the paper chart; the ETO is responsible for the technical health of the hardware (workstation, display, backup power supply), the software version and the chart/update infrastructure. ENC (Electronic Navigational Chart) updates and the IHO presentation library/software version are kept up to date; an incompatible version creates navigational safety and PSC problems.
ECDIS, kâğıt haritanın yerini almıştır a: The ECDIS has replaced the paper chart, but it is also a potential single point of failure. The Master confirms that all officers have received type-specific training for the make and model of ECDIS on board. ENC updates (weekly), the match between the official chart catalogue and the ENCs for the voyage, and the safety contour, safety depth, shallow contour and deep contour settings are reviewed before the voyage.
ECDIS, rota planlandıktan sonra otomatik: After the route has been planned, ECDIS runs an automatic "route check" and lists the points where the route crosses the safety contour, passes through a no-go area or enters navigational warnings. The Second Officer reviews this list item by item; each warning is either cleared by changing the route or documented with its justification (e.g. acceptable within a channel).
ECDIS-only gemilerde yedek, genelde ikin: On ECDIS-only ships, the backup is usually a second, independent ECDIS (separate power supply, separate position input). On ships with a paper backup, the critical charts are kept up to date. The Second Officer verifies that the backup system actually works and is up to date; otherwise, if the primary system fails, the ship is left without a means of navigation.
ECDIS; GNSS (konum), gyro (heading), log: The ECDIS receives data from the GNSS (position), gyro (heading), log (speed), radar/ARPA (targets), AIS, echo sounder (depth) and the track-steering system. The accuracy of the position source (e.g. a GPS failure) directly affects navigational safety; an alarm is given when sensors are inconsistent.
EEBD (Emergency Escape Breathing Device): The EEBD (Emergency Escape Breathing Device) is intended for escape, not for fighting fire or smoke; it is single-use, supplies air for a short time (usually ~10-15 min) and is used to escape from a smoke-filled area. The AB knows where the EEBD is, how to put it on quickly (hood type) and that it is for escape only (NOT for firefighting).
EEBD minimum 10 dakikalık hava sağlar, s: An EEBD supplies air for a minimum of 10 minutes and is for escape only; it is not used for fire-fighting.
EEBD yalnızca kaçış içindir, yangınla mü: An EEBD is for escape only, not for firefighting, and supplies air for a limited time (e.g. ~10-15 min). The cadet knows this limit; no one enters a fire with an EEBD, it is used only to escape to a safe area.
EEBD'ler; makine dairesi, yaşam mahalli: EEBDs are kept in sufficient numbers in visible, marked positions in the engine room, the accommodation and along escape routes. Their number and locations are shown on the fire control plan. In training every crew member practises putting one on.
EEBD'nin yangın/duman içinde sadece kaçı: It is explained that the EEBD is used in fire/smoke only for escape (not for firefighting), that its typical duration is 10-15 minutes, and how to don it. The Safety Officer repeats the demonstration until sure that the new crew member can find the escape route in darkness or smoke.
EEBD, dumanlı/oksijensiz bir mahalden gü: An EEBD is an escape hood that supplies air or oxygen for a short time (typically 10 minutes or more) for escaping from a smoke-filled or oxygen-deficient space to a safe area. It is NOT used for fire-fighting or for entering a dangerous space; it is only for getting out. It is simple to use and quick to put on.
EEBD, yangın/duman durumunda kaçış için: An EEBD is a single-use escape device that provides ~10-15 minutes of air for escape in a fire/smoke situation; unlike an SCBA, it is not used for fire-fighting. EEBDs are located on the accommodation and engine room escape routes, in the numbers marked on the fire control plan. SOLAS II-2/13 sets the minimum numbers.
EEDI (Energy Efficiency Design Index) ye: EEDI (Energy Efficiency Design Index) is a design index applied to newbuildings; it measures the energy efficiency of the ship's design in g CO2/tonne-mile. EEXI is an equivalent index applied to existing ships; it assesses the ship's technical/design efficiency and requires one-time compliance.
EEDI = (Güç × SFOC × CF) / (Kapasite × H: In simplified form, EEDI = (power × SFOC × CF) / (capacity × speed). The real calculation is much more complex and the IMO MEPC guidelines must be followed.
EEDI doğrudan günlük bir operasyon KPI'ı: The EEDI is not a direct day-to-day operational KPI; but design decisions such as hull form, propeller selection, WHRS, air lubrication or energy-saving devices set the baseline of daily bunker consumption.
EEDI, ana ve yardımcı makine kaynaklı CO: The EEDI is based on the principle of relating the CO₂ emission contributions from the main and auxiliary engines to the ship's reference transport work (capacity × reference speed). Engine SFOC, the carbon factor of the fuel type, the shaft generator/auxiliary load balance and efficiency technologies all affect the result together.
EEDI, motorların yakıt tüketiminden kayn: The EEDI is the ratio of the CO₂ emissions from the engines' fuel consumption to the transport capacity and the reference speed.
EEDI/EEXI/CII karbon performans yönetimi: EEDI/EEXI/CII carbon performance management is the fastest-growing area of responsibility for the modern Chief Engineer. Technical optimization (speed, trim, hull, WHRS), accurate data collection and knowledge of the regulations must be pursued together. Carbon performance is no longer just a compliance matter; it is a strategic parameter that determines the ship's commercial competitiveness and the future of the fleet.
EEXI (Energy Efficiency Existing Ship In: EEXI (Energy Efficiency Existing Ship Index) is a one-time technical index; it measures the ship's design efficiency, and compliance is achieved through measures such as EPL (Engine Power Limitation). CII (Carbon Intensity Indicator), on the other hand, is operational and annual; it measures the ship's emissions per unit of carrying capacity and distance sailed (gCO2/dwt·nm) and gives a rating from A to E.
EEXI hesabında geminin MCR değeri, olası: The EEXI calculation uses the ship's MCR, any EPL/ShaPoLi settings, the engine SFOC parameters and the reference transport capacity. Compliance is often achieved through power limitation.
EEXI hesaplaması EEDI formülüne benzer a: The EEXI calculation is similar to the EEDI formula, but the actual engine power and performance data of the existing ship are used.
EEXI uyumu tek başına teknik bir onay de: EEXI compliance is not just a technical approval; it is also building a culture of "safe operation at lower power".
EEXI uyumu, gemi inşa edildiğinden bağım: EEXI compliance is a one-time requirement imposed on the existing fleet, regardless of when the ship was built. If compliance cannot be achieved, technical measures are taken.
EEXI; ana ve yardımcı makine gücüne, SFC: EEXI is calculated with a formula based on main and auxiliary engine power, SFC (specific fuel consumption), the fuel carbon factor, the ship's DWT/capacity and the reference speed. The attained EEXI must be below the required EEXI determined by ship type/size.
EGC (Enhanced Group Call) üzerinden Safe: Through EGC (Enhanced Group Call), the SafetyNET service delivers navigational warnings, weather forecasts and SAR information to the ship automatically in the open sea (A3); FleetNET is for commercial group messages. These MSI broadcasts are received and recorded automatically; they are the open-sea complement to NAVTEX.
EGC FleetNET: armatör veya ticari grup m: EGC FleetNET: messages from the owner or a commercial group.
EGC SafetyNET: NAVAREA uyarısı, SAR mesa: EGC SafetyNET: NAVAREA warnings, SAR messages and weather reports, automatically.
EGR (Exhaust Gas Recirculation): Egzoz g: EGR (Exhaust Gas Recirculation): part of the exhaust gas is mixed into the intake air to lower the combustion temperature.
EIAPP sertifikası ve onboard NOx verific: The EIAPP certificate and the onboard NOx verification procedure prove that the engine is in its certified condition. On the engine, the Chief Engineer uses only the components and settings permitted by the NOx Technical File.
ENC (Electronic Navigational Chart), vek: An ENC (Electronic Navigational Chart) is an official, vector-based, layered and "intelligent" chart; its objects can be queried and can generate alarms. An RNC (Raster Navigational Chart) is a scanned image of a paper chart; it has no intelligence and is used only in RCDS mode with an appropriate folio of paper charts. Full ECDIS compliance requires ENCs.
ENC (vektör) veri, ECDIS'in alarm/uyarı: ENC (vector) data makes full use of the alarm/warning capabilities of ECDIS (safety contour, anti-grounding). The Second Officer verifies that ENC coverage at suitable scales (folio) is complete along the route; a missing cell means that the safety functions will not work in that area.
ENC güncellenir; safety contour/depth de: The ENCs are updated; the safety contour and safety depth are set from the deep draft plus the UKC margin. As the UKC margin of a ship loaded with ore can be small, the tidal window is planned.
ENC güncellenir; safety parametreleri ay: The ENCs are updated and the safety settings adjusted. A deviation from the approved plan (for example a sail-past close to the shore) is made only after a risk assessment and with the Master's approval.
ENC güncellenir; safety parametreleri dr: The ENCs are updated and the safety settings are adjusted to the draft. On routes with a tight schedule, contingencies are defined for heavy traffic and narrow passages.
ENC kataloğu S-63 lisansına göre güncell: The ENC catalogue is updated under the S-63 licence (including the AIO and T&P notices). The safety contour, safety depth and shallow contour are set from the ship's draft plus the UKC margin; these values directly determine how the ECDIS highlights dangers.
ENC kataloğu güncellenir (NtM, T&P), saf: The ENC catalogue is updated (NtM, T&P), and the safety contour, safety depth and shallow contour are set from the ship's draft plus the UKC. With check route, warnings for no-go areas, shoals and prohibited areas are assessed one by one.
ENC lisansları süreli ve hücre/folio baz: ENC licenses are time-limited and based on cells/folios. The Second Officer checks in advance that the cells required for the voyage plan are licensed; expired or missing licenses are renewed/added in time, otherwise "no permit" gaps appear along the route.
ENC'ler S-63 standardıyla şifrelenir; ge: ENCs are encrypted with the S-63 standard; the ship receives cell permits and weekly updates through a subscription. Loading the updates regularly is mandatory for legal and safety reasons; an out-of-date chart creates liability for a navigational accident.
ENC'lerde derinlik verisinin güvenilirli: In ENCs, the reliability of depth data is expressed by CATZOC (Category of Zone of Confidence); it is classified from A1 (most reliable) to D and U (unassessed). A low CATZOC indicates that the depths are based on old/inadequate surveys and that the water may in reality be shallower.
EPIRB (Emergency Position Indicating Rad: The EPIRB (Emergency Position Indicating Radio Beacon) is activated automatically (hydrostatic release) when the ship sinks, or manually; it sends the ship's identity and GPS position to the Cospas-Sarsat satellites on 406 MHz. The SART (Search and Rescue Transponder) is a radar transponder used in the survival craft; it appears as a distinctive line of dots on the radar display of a searching ship. The Master writes into the muster procedure that the EPIRB and the SART are taken along when abandoning ship.

The EPIRB (Emergency Position Indicating Radio Beacon) is a life-saving device that floats free automatically (with a hydrostatic release) when the ship sinks and transmits a distress signal and a coded identity (Hex ID) on 406 MHz to the Cospas-Sarsat satellites. The Second Officer checks the monthly self-test, the hydrostatic release expiry date, the EPIRB battery expiry and the bracket mounting.
EPIRB Hex ID, ülke SAR otoritesinin veri: The EPIRB Hex ID must be registered in the database of the national SAR authority (e.g. the national beacon registry), and the ship's details (name, MMSI, contact) must be kept up to date. If the registration is not up to date, the SAR response is delayed.
EPIRB battery ve HRU expiry tarihleri il: EPIRB battery and HRU expiry dates and the annual shore-based service date are tracked in the PMS. A monthly self-test is carried out and recorded. The SART (Search and Rescue Transponder) battery expiry and mounting position are checked. These devices must also have current registration.
EPL ile uyumlu gemilerde operasyon başar: On ships complying through EPL, operational success is the sum of the quality of technical maintenance and the discipline of bridge planning.
EPL uygulanan bir gemide hız/ETA planlam: On a ship with EPL, speed and ETA planning cannot be made with the old power assumptions. The Master and the Chief Engineer should model the risk of falling below a safe speed in heavy weather windows at the route planning stage.
EPL/ShaPoLi'de, acil durumda (kötü hava,: With EPL/ShaPoLi, an override facility is provided so that the limit can be exceeded in an emergency (heavy weather, safety of maneuvering); however, any override must be recorded and justified. The Chief Engineer is responsible for the correct operation of this system and for override discipline.
ERM yetkinliği, onaylı eğitim programlar: ERM competence is verified through approved training programmes and simulator-based assessment. Some flag states require a separate ERM certificate.
ERM, STCW 2010 Manila Değişiklikleri ile: With the 2010 Manila amendments to STCW, ERM became a mandatory competence for engineer officers. The particular challenges of the engine room environment (noise, heat, limited personnel) distinguish ERM from BRM.
ERM, köprüüstündeki Bridge Resource Mana: ERM is the Bridge Resource Management (BRM) concept adapted to the engine room. It has been made mandatory by the STCW Convention in order to reduce human error, strengthen team coordination and develop the safety culture.
ERM, makine dairesinin kendine özgü zorl: ERM takes into account the particular challenges of the engine room: high noise, limited visibility, complex equipment, extreme temperatures and physical fatigue.
ERM, teknik bilgi ve becerinin ötesinde: Beyond technical knowledge and skills, ERM covers "non-technical skills" such as communication, leadership, decision-making and stress management.
ERRM, köprüüstündeki BRM'in (Bridge Reso: ERRM is the engine room counterpart of BRM (Bridge Resource Management) on the bridge. It is based on the principles of open communication, task sharing, situational awareness and breaking the error chain. The cadet is the most junior member of the team but an important part of the "speak up" culture.
ESB, makine dairesinin üzerinde, en üst: The ESB is located above the engine room, on or above the uppermost continuous deck.
ESD link, gemi ve terminalin acil durdur: The ESD link allows the ship and the terminal to share emergency stop signals; on activation the pumps stop and the valves close in a safe sequence. Because rapid closure can cause a pressure surge, the closing time must be within the maker's specification.
ETA (Estimated Time of Arrival), liman,: The ETA (Estimated Time of Arrival) is binding information for the port, the agent, VTS and the charterer, and the time reference in which it is given must always be stated. The Second Officer usually calculates the ETA in UTC (from distance/speed) and then converts it to the legal time of the arrival port when reporting it. To avoid confusion, a dual presentation in reports such as "ETA pilot station 0600 LT (0030 UTC)" is good practice.
ETO uhdesindeki birçok cihaz periyodik k: Many instruments in the ETO's charge require periodic calibration: gas detectors (oxygen, LEL, H2S, CO), pressure/temperature/level transmitters, tachometers, tank radar/gauging, draft sensors, multimeters and test instruments, the oily water separator 15 ppm bilge alarm and emissions monitoring equipment. Each has a different calibration interval.
ETO'nun doğru ve güvenilir ölçüm aletler: Having accurate and reliable measuring instruments is fundamental to the ETO's work: a digital multimeter, clamp meter, megger (insulation tester), voltage detector, thermal camera, cable/continuity tester and, where necessary, a secondary injection test set. The accuracy of these instruments is critical for both safety and fault diagnosis.
ETO'nun güç sistemi yönetimindeki başarı: The ETO's success in managing the power system is measured by the ability to make the right decision within seconds during a blackout, by protection systems that work quietly but reliably, and by catching faults before they grow through disciplined daily monitoring. The power system is the heart of the ship; the ETO is responsible for keeping this heart beating flawlessly.
ETO, IMD'nin alarm setpoint'ini (tipik o: The ETO regularly checks the IMD alarm setpoint (typically in the range of a few hundred kΩ to a few kΩ, depending on system voltage) and its test function. Some modern IMDs can locate the faulty circuit automatically (EDS - insulation fault location), which greatly shortens fault-finding time.
ETO, Li-ion sistemde hücre sıcaklık sens: In a Li-ion system, the ETO periodically checks the cell temperature sensors, the cooling system and the BMS isolation contactors. A cell that swells, leaks or heats abnormally is isolated immediately. Li-ion maintenance requires vendor-approved training and procedures; haphazard intervention is dangerous.
ETO, Ni-Cd bankının kapasitesini periyod: The ETO verifies the capacity of the Ni-Cd bank with periodic discharge tests and monitors the balance of cell voltages. Weak cells reduce the performance of the whole bank; if necessary, cells are replaced. Test results are recorded and the trend is followed.
ETO, OT/IT sistemlerinde rol bazlı erişi: The ETO applies role-based access control on OT/IT systems: each user has only the privileges their duties require (least privilege). Shared/default logins and factory passwords are among the biggest weaknesses; the ETO changes or disables them and enforces strong, unique passwords.
ETO, UMS moduna geçmeden önce günlük UMS: Before switching to UMS mode, the ETO verifies the daily UMS readiness checklist: all critical alarms active, no critical alarm inhibited, automatic pumps (bilge, transfer) working, fire detection panel normal, main engine slowdown/shutdown systems in service.
ETO, VFD fault log'unu düzenli inceler:: The ETO reviews the VFD fault log regularly: overcurrent, overvoltage (DC bus), undervoltage, overtemperature, ground fault and motor overload trips are valuable for root cause analysis. A recurring fault code is an early sign of a developing hardware problem.
ETO, batarya değişim tarihini ve seri öm: The ETO keeps track of the battery replacement date and the service life of the string (typically 4-7 years for VRLA). High temperature (battery room/UPS cabinet) seriously shortens life: every 8-10°C above 25°C halves the service life. Cooling and ventilation are therefore critical.
ETO, dedektör tipini bölgenin risk profi: The ETO selects the detector type according to the risk profile of the area: optical smoke detectors for cabins and corridors, and heat or multi-criteria (combined) detectors for places with a high risk of false alarms, such as the galley and the engine room. Choosing the wrong detector causes either late detection or chronic false alarms.
ETO, emergency generator'ı her hafta tes: The ETO tests the emergency generator every week. The standard test verifies the engine's starting reliability and its ability to run on load. In the monthly test (or more often if class requires), a blackout is simulated: the supply to the main busbar is cut off (or the sensing cable is opened), and the test is timed to confirm that the generator starts automatically within 45 seconds and supplies the emergency busbar.
ETO, emergency generator'ın start güveni: The ETO is responsible for ensuring the starting reliability of the emergency generator: the state of charge of the starting batteries, the starting air (if fitted), the fuel level and the health of the automatic start panel are verified by a weekly test. If the automatic start attempt fails, manual starting and manual energizing of the busbar are kept ready as a backup.
ETO, emergency switchboard içindeki koru: The ETO periodically checks the protective devices (MCCBs, fuses), busbar connections and indicating instruments inside the emergency switchboard. A thermal camera scan for loose connections and insulation measurements ensure the reliability of the switchboard.
ETO, emergency switchboard'a bağlı olmas: The ETO physically verifies that every consumer that must be connected to the emergency switchboard is actually supplied from it: navigation lights, emergency lighting, GMDSS, emergency fire pump, steering gear (at least one unit), general alarm, watertight door controls and bilge alarms. The connection layout is compared with the class-approved list.
ETO, evaporatör fan motorlarının çalışma: The ETO verifies that the evaporator fan motors are working and that the defrost termination thermostat ends the defrost correctly. Too long or incomplete defrosting causes excessive icing, water overflow or unnecessary energy consumption.
ETO, gemideki tüm OT varlıklarını ve bun: The ETO inventories all OT assets on board and their network connections (asset inventory). A system cannot be protected without knowing which network segment it is on and how it comes into contact with the outside world (satellite, USB, service laptop). This inventory is the basis of the risk assessment.
ETO, gemiye gelen tüm taşınabilir medyan: The ETO ensures that all portable media brought on board are checked at a scanning station separate from the network (scanning kiosk). In some ports, coordination with port USB scanner systems is required. Unused USB ports on OT systems are disabled physically or by software; this is one of the simplest and most effective controls.
ETO, hangi sistemin hangi yazılım/firmwa: The ETO keeps a record of which software/firmware version each system is running (configuration management). When a new vulnerability is announced, this inventory makes it possible to identify quickly which ship systems are affected. For legacy systems that cannot be patched, compensating controls (additional segmentation, monitoring) are applied.
ETO, heat dedektörlerinin sıcaklık eşiği: The ETO verifies that the temperature threshold of heat detectors suits the ambient conditions. For example, if a detector on the engine room deckhead above a running engine is not of a high rating (e.g. 90°C), it will give false alarms at normal operating temperature.
ETO, her UPS'in beslediği yükü, batarya: The ETO must know the load fed by each UPS, the battery autonomy time (usually 30 min, or longer where required by class) and the bypass capability. For critical navigation/communication equipment, class requires a minimum autonomy time and periodic testing of UPS condition.
ETO, her bankın nominal voltajını, kapas: The ETO must know each bank's nominal voltage, capacity (Ah), application and chemistry; the maintenance regime and safety precautions differ by chemistry. Vented (flooded) lead-acid and Ni-Cd batteries require regular topping up with water and ventilation, whereas VRLA and Li-ion batteries require different maintenance approaches.
ETO, her çalışmada gerilim seviyesini, m: For every job, the ETO assesses the voltage level, the prospective short-circuit current and the conditions in the space. On high-energy switchboards (main switchboard, HV switchgear), arc flash is the most serious hazard; no live work is done without appropriate PPE and safe distance.
ETO, hücreler arası SG farkını izler; bü: The ETO monitors the SG difference between cells; a large difference (e.g. >0.030) points to a weak or short-circuited cell. In VRLA batteries the electrolyte cannot be reached, so SG cannot be measured; instead, terminal voltage, internal resistance (impedance) and temperature are monitored.
ETO, kW ve kVAr metrelerini izleyerek de: The ETO detects uneven sharing by watching the kW and kVAr meters. An active power imbalance is corrected through the governor characteristic or the load sharing line connection, and a reactive imbalance through the AVR droop setting. A reactive imbalance causes excessive stator current and overheating in one engine.
ETO, kamera lenslerinin temizliğini, gec: The ETO periodically checks camera lens cleanliness, night vision (IR) operation, the recorder's disk health and the network connections. Cameras in explosive atmosphere zones (tanker deck) must be Ex-approved (intrinsically safe / Ex d).
ETO, kompresör motorunun yalıtım direnci: The ETO periodically measures the insulation resistance of the compressor motor (megger); in hermetic compressors, breakdown of the winding insulation, which is in contact with the refrigerant, leads to acid formation and contamination of the system. The motor protection relays (overload, phase loss, motor temperature thermistor) are correctly set.
ETO, kritik OT yazılımlarının sürüm enva: The ETO tracks the version inventory of critical OT software and known vulnerabilities. On type-approved systems such as ECDIS, updates are made with the manufacturer's approved packages; random patching can compromise type approval and security.
ETO, kritik sistemlerin yedeklerini (kon: The ETO regularly backs up critical systems (configurations, ECDIS charts, automation parameters); up-to-date backups are the key to rapid recovery after a cyber incident or failure. Backups are kept off the network (offline) so that they are not affected by ransomware.
ETO, link sağlığını anahtar metriklerle: The ETO monitors link health with key metrics: signal strength, SNR/Es/No (signal-to-noise ratio), Tx/Rx data rate and packet loss. A falling SNR indicates antenna pointing drift, weather (rain fade), blockage or a hub problem. These metrics are followed on the modem web interface and the service provider's portal.
ETO, loop direncini ve EOL değerini mult: The ETO measures the loop resistance and the EOL value with a multimeter and checks whether any loop isolators have opened. Moisture and corrosion in cable junction boxes are the most frequent cause of open-circuit/earth faults on ships. Connections are cleaned and, if necessary, treated with contact cleaner and retightened.
ETO, magnetron değişiminde yüksek gerili: When replacing a magnetron, the ETO follows the safety rules for high voltage (kV) and microwave exposure; work is done with the antenna stopped and the transmitter off. Tuning, gain, sea/rain clutter and performance monitor values are recorded.
ETO, müdahale sonrası kök neden analizi: After the response, the ETO carries out a root cause analysis and feeds the lessons into the SMS. Regular cyber drills (e.g. a loss-of-ECDIS scenario) ensure that the team shows the right reflexes in a real incident. Recovery relies on up-to-date backups kept off the network (offline).
ETO, periyodik fiziksel stok sayımı yapa: The ETO verifies that the system agrees with the physical stock by carrying out periodic physical stock counts; discrepancies (parts used but not deducted, or stored in the wrong place) are corrected. Part storage codes (shelf/cabinet numbers) are critical for quick access in an emergency.
ETO, port USB scanner sistemleri, liman: The ETO coordinates with port USB scanner systems, port information systems and the company IT/SOC (Security Operations Center). Ship–company coordination is critical during an incident and for updates or configuration changes. As the shipboard technical point of contact, the ETO handles this communication.
ETO, recurring fault analiz sonuçlarını: The ETO records the results of recurring fault analysis in the engine logbook and the PMS and, if necessary, reports them to the company's technical department and the vendor. These records build fleet-wide "lessons learned" and help prevent similar failures on sister ships.
ETO, reefer plug'lardaki bağlantı bütünl: The ETO checks the reefer plugs for connection integrity and corrosion; in the marine environment, a loose/corroded socket causes faults and heating. The total electrical demand of the reefer load is included in the PMS power balance; a large number of reefers significantly increases the generator load.
ETO, segmentler arası firewall kuralları: The ETO configures the firewall rules between segments on the "default deny" principle; only necessary and justified traffic is allowed. Access from the crew welfare network to OT is blocked. This architecture limits the spread of an incident from one segment to others (lateral movement).
ETO, sigorta ve koruma elemanlarının asl: The ETO applies the principle that fuses and protective devices are never "bridged with a higher rating"; when the correct spare is not available, temporary bridging can cause fire and equipment damage. For connectors, keeping spares is particularly important because of corrosion in the marine environment.
ETO, single-line diagram (tek hat şeması: The ETO must be able to model the whole network mentally from the single-line diagram: which busbar is fed from which generator, whether the bus-tie breaker is open or closed, and which consumer is in which preferential trip stage. Correct isolation and restoration in the event of a fault are possible only with a thorough command of this diagram.
ETO, single-line diagram üzerinden hangi: From the single-line diagram, the ETO must know which consumers are connected to the emergency switchboard (navigation lights, emergency lighting, GMDSS, fire pump, steering gear, watertight door controls, general alarm) and which are bridged by the transitional battery. This overview is critical for correct prioritization in the event of a failure.
ETO, sistemin emme (suction) ve basma (d: The ETO monitors the system's suction and discharge pressures; these give information on the state of charge and the health of the system. Low suction pressure indicates a low charge or a restriction; high discharge pressure indicates a condenser problem. Bubbles in the sight glass are a sign of a low charge or moisture (saturated drier).
ETO, sistemin sınıf ve bayrak gereklilik: For PSC and surveys, the ETO documents the system's compliance with class and flag requirements: detector layout plans, test records and fault/repair logs are kept up to date. It is also mandatory for the system to be monitored from the repeater panel on the bridge and, where possible, from the machinery control room.
ETO, sistemin tek hat şemasını (loop dia: The ETO must know the system's single-line diagram (loop diagram) and the detector address list in full: how many detectors each loop carries, where the end-of-line resistor is and at which points the loop isolators are located. Without this information, neither fast fault diagnosis nor correct placement of spares is possible.
ETO, slow-down ve shutdown fonksiyonları: The ETO tests the slowdown and shutdown functions by simulating real conditions (e.g. by lowering the pressure at a pressure switch in a controlled way) and verifies that the trip occurs within the expected time and with the correct action. Before the test, coordination with the engine team and the necessary isolation are arranged.
ETO, sınıf gerekliliklerine uygun spare: The ETO keeps the stock of spare detectors, MCPs, loop cards and panel modules up to date in line with class requirements. Spare detectors must be of the correct type and addressing capability and must be stored protected against electrostatic discharge, ESD (antistatic bags). The critical spares list (class-approved) must be kept on board, and every part used must be deducted from stock and reordered.
ETO, test edilen her cihazı, sonucu ve t: The ETO records each device tested, the result and the date; faulty detectors are replaced. During testing, it is vital that the fixed gas discharge (CO2/FM-200) interlocks have definitely been made safe; otherwise the test can cause an unwanted gas release.
ETO, tüm kalibrasyon gerektiren cihazlar: The ETO keeps an inventory of all instruments requiring calibration, with their last/next calibration dates, in the PMS. The system automatically warns of upcoming calibrations; the ETO plans calibrations allowing for the ship's itinerary and the availability of service providers. An overdue calibration results in a finding at inspections and calls the validity of the measurements into question.
ETO, şebeke güç kalitesini sürekli izler: The ETO continuously monitors the power quality of the network: voltage tolerance +6%/-10% continuous / ±20% transient, frequency tolerance ±5% continuous / ±10% transient (IACS UR E5). A low power factor (cosφ < 0.8) indicates excessive reactive load; it increases the alternator current unnecessarily and causes heating. The ETO corrects the power factor with capacitor banks or reactive load management.
EU Port Reception Facilities Directive u: Under the EU Port Reception Facilities Directive, all ships must deliver their waste in EU ports.
Echo sounder (derinlik) ve speed log (hı: The echo sounder (depth) and speed log (speed) transducers are in the ship's bottom; the ETO checks the insulation of the transducer cables, the tightness of the sea valves and the calibration of the electronic unit. A Doppler log is affected by underwater fouling; the transducer faces are cleaned during drydocking.
Echo sounder derinliği transducer'dan öl: The echo sounder measures depth from the transducer. The value shown on the display can be set with an offset to refer to the transducer, the bottom of the keel or the water surface. For assessing UKC, the reference must be clearly known.
Echo sounder, transducer altındaki su de: The echo sounder measures the depth of water below the transducer and is the last independent line of defense for UKC monitoring and the prevention of grounding. The Second Officer verifies that the draft/transducer offset setting is correct, that the gain and range settings are appropriate and that the shallow water alarm is set.
Eductor (jet pump): yıkama suyunu vakum: Eductor (jet pump): draws the washing water by vacuum and transfers it to the slop tank; it has no mechanical parts.
Eductor veya stripper pompası ile tank d: The tank bottoms and lines are swept a final time with the eductor or stripping pump. At the end of discharge, the quantity remaining in each tank (ROB) is measured and reported; a high ROB means a commercial loss and is a reason for cargo claims.
Eductor, hareketli parçası olmayan bir j: An eductor is a jet pump with no moving parts: a high-speed driving flow (cargo or water) passing through a nozzle creates low pressure by the venturi effect and draws in the liquid at the tank bottom. It is ideal for stripping and draining and resists blockage and wear, but it depends on the driving flow rate.
Egzoz gazları yüksek hızda türbin kanatl: The exhaust gases strike the turbine blades at high velocity and turn the rotor. The compressor wheel on the same shaft compresses the intake air.
Egzoz gazı ekonomizeri: Egzoz gazı ısısı: Exhaust gas economiser: produces steam with the heat of the exhaust gas. Steam turbine: drives an electric generator with the steam produced. Power turbine: the exhaust gas turns the turbine directly (turbocompound).
Egzoz gazı ekonomizerinden üretilen buha: The steam produced by the exhaust gas economiser is used both for heating and for generating electricity in a turbine-driven generator. This dual use is called cogeneration.
Egzoz gazı turboşarjı çevirir; kompresör: The exhaust gas drives the turbocharger; the compressor delivers the scavenge air, the air cooler cools and densifies the compressed air, and it is fed to the cylinders through the scavenge air receiver. At low load the auxiliary blowers start to provide enough air.
Egzoz sıcaklığı, silindir kapağı sıcaklı: It is preferred for measuring exhaust, cylinder cover and boiler temperatures.
Egzozla çevrilen turboşarj, emme havasın: The exhaust-driven turbocharger compresses the intake air; the intercooler (charge air cooler) cools the air, increasing its density and reducing NOx. Charge air temperature and pressure are direct indicators of performance.
Ek tehlikeler: çalışılan ekipmanın enerj: Additional hazards: energy from the equipment being worked on (rotating radar antenna, hot funnel gases, electricity), dropped tools or materials striking people below, fatigue, and weather and sea conditions. The AB assesses all these risks before starting work and never goes aloft or overside until suitable precautions have been taken.
Ekip baret, eldiven, çelik burunlu ayakk: The team wears hard hats, gloves, steel-toed shoes and eye protection; goggles are important because of the dust/particles around the cable. Radio communication with the bridge is clear and confirmed. In a noisy environment, hand signals are also agreed in advance.
Ekip disiplini, Reis'in adil ve tutarlı: Team discipline comes from the Bosun being fair and consistent. The same rule is applied equally to everyone; favoritism is what destroys team morale fastest. The Bosun criticizes in private and praises in public; this simple principle protects the team's health for years.
Ekipman envanteri CSM'e göre tam olmalıd: The equipment inventory must be complete in accordance with the CSM; the ship does not sail with missing/insufficient lashing gear. The Chief Officer checks the spare equipment stock and the storage arrangement (lashing bins).
Ekipman gereksinimi kümülatiftir: A3 gem: The equipment requirement is cumulative: an A3 ship also carries the A1 and A2 equipment. Every ship also carries an EPIRB, a SART and portable VHF radios (for survival craft). The equipment is chosen according to the ship's farthest operating area.
Ekipman üreticisinin belirlediği kaldırm: The lifting points specified by the equipment manufacturer (lifting points / pad-eyes) are used; lifting is never done from a random pipe or a weak flange. The Oiler checks the lifting diagram in the equipment manual.
Ekipmanın titreşim, sıcaklık, basınç, ya: Equipment parameters such as vibration, temperature, pressure and oil quality are measured regularly. These measurements are followed as trends, and maintenance is planned when the set thresholds are exceeded.
Ekipmanın çalışması yeterli değildir; ek: It is not enough for the equipment to work; the team must be able to use it quickly and correctly. The Safety Officer shows newly joined personnel SCBA donning, EEBD activation, laying out hoses and the fire alarm points, observes these skills during fire drills and turns any gaps into training.
Eklerin çoğu belirli kayıt defterleri zo: Most annexes require specific record books: the Oil Record Book (ORB Part I/II) and the Garbage Record Book (Part I/II). These books are among the documents most frequently examined in PSC inspections, and errors lead to a "deficiency" or even detention of the ship.
Ekonomizer yangını en kritik risktir. Is: An economiser fire is the most critical risk. Soot build-up and running at low load increase the fire risk.
Eksik bir sayım, geride kalmış bir müret: An incomplete head count means a crew member left behind. The Safety Officer verifies against the muster list that everyone is present; if anyone is missing, a search is organized. This verification is the most critical step of abandon ship.
Eksik görülen alanlar için kişiye özel g: For areas found to be weak, an individual development plan (training need analysis) is drawn up. Strong performance is managed with a recommendation for promotion, weak performance with constructive feedback.
Eksik handover, yeni gelen Baş Mühendis': An incomplete handover leaves the incoming Chief Engineer starting out with blind spots and lets preventable problems grow. The handover is made face to face, on board and in writing.
Eksik veya geçersiz tüp anında yedekle d: A missing or invalid extinguisher is replaced with a spare at once; a discharged extinguisher is sent for refilling. All checks are recorded via the checklist and the PMS.
Eksiklik önleme, taze meyve/sebze stokun: Deficiency prevention starts with planning the stock of fresh fruit/vegetables according to the length of the voyage (see the stock management task): fresh produce is staged from the most perishable to the most durable, and as it runs out, frozen/canned products/supplements bridge the gap. This foresight prevents the fatigue and health problems that can appear toward the end of a long voyage.
El Faro (2015): kasırga gelişimini yeter: El Faro (2015): inadequate monitoring of the hurricane's development, old data and a late decision → loss of the ship. Lesson: keep the weather data continuously updated and act early on the worst-case scenario.
El dümenine geçiş/çıkış zamanları, steer: The times of changing to and from hand steering, steering gear tests and changes of helmsman are recorded in the bridge logbook; the AB also contributes to the accuracy of these records. Under SOLAS V/26, the steering gear is tested within 12 hours before departure; the AB contributes to this test by moving the helm in response to orders.
El yıkama, gıda güvenliğinin en etkili t: Handwashing is the single most effective food safety measure. The cook washes his or her hands with soap for at least 20 seconds when starting work, after handling raw meat, after using the toilet, after handling waste/cleaning and when changing tasks. Clean work clothes, a hair covering (cap/hat) and, when necessary, gloves are worn; gloves do not replace handwashing and are changed frequently.
Elastik bölgede σ = E × ε bağıntısı geçe: In the elastic region σ = E × ε applies. E (Young's modulus, or the modulus of elasticity) is a measure of the stiffness of the material.
Elastik sınır içinde gerilme, birim uzam: Within the elastic limit, stress is directly proportional to strain.
Elde yıkamada genellikle üç gözlü evye (: For washing by hand, a three-compartment sink (wash–rinse–sanitize) is generally used. Sanitizing is done either with very hot water (≈82°C) or with an approved chemical sanitizer. When sanitizing with hot water, gloves are worn because of the risk of burns. Air-drying is preferred to drying with a tea towel; a dirty cloth recontaminates.
Electrochlorination ünitelerinde açığa ç: In electrochlorination units, the hydrogen released creates a flammable atmosphere if there is no proper ventilation; venting and gas monitoring are critical.
Electrochlorination'da H2 birikimi venti: In electrochlorination systems, hydrogen that builds up without ventilation can explode; gas monitoring and venting are critical.
In electrochlorination systems, hydrogen that builds up without ventilation can explode; gas monitoring is critical.
Elektrik (eski E): CO₂ veya kuru kimyasa: Electrical (formerly E): CO₂ or dry chemical — water is never used.
Elektrik güvenliği, ETO'nun pazarlık kon: Electrical safety is the ETO's non-negotiable first priority. The discipline of isolate, lock, tag, test and, where necessary, earth is the simple but life-saving chain that prevents an error from turning into a fatal outcome. The ETO's success is measured by a ship operating with zero electrical accidents and by instilling this discipline in the whole crew.
Elektrik güvenliği, prosedürler kadar kü: Electrical safety depends as much on culture as on procedures. The ETO encourages near-miss reporting without hesitation, shares electrical risks in toolbox talks and teaches LOTO discipline to junior crew members. Safety is achieved in an environment where even the most competent person does not take shortcuts.
Elektrik motoru ile tahrik edilen hidrol: A hydraulic pump driven by an electric motor sends pressurised oil to the steering cylinders. Rapson slide or rotary vane type actuators are used.
Elektrik tahrikli düzenlerde motor gücü: In electrically driven arrangements the motor power loads the main switchboard directly; enough generator capacity is therefore brought on line before the thruster is used. The starting current and sudden load changes are the main sources of blackout risk.
Elektrik tahrikli windlass: AC veya DC m: Electrically driven windlass: works with an AC or DC motor. Speed control is easy. It is used on most modern ships.
Elektrik veya hidrolik tahriklidir. Baş: It is electrically or hydraulically driven and located on the forecastle and poop deck. It is used for heaving mooring lines and for warping.
Elektrik yükü artığında jeneratöre binen: When the electrical load increases, the torque on the generator increases and the prime mover tends to slow down. The governor responds by increasing the fuel quantity and restores the speed.
Elektrik çarpması, akımın vücuttan geçme: Electric shock occurs when current passes through the human body; the moisture and metal structure of the shipboard environment increase contact with earth and so raise the risk. An AC current of 50 mA can cause cardiac fibrillation; touch voltage limits (usually 50 V AC) are therefore critical. Arc flash is the plasma and pressure wave created by a short-circuit arc, which reaches 19,000°C in a fraction of a second.
Elektrik şeması, izolasyonun nereden yap: The electrical diagram shows where the isolation is to be made. If maintenance is to be done on a motor, the relevant breaker is located, opened and locked (LOTO), and zero energy is verified by measuring the voltage. The cadet learns that saying "we switched off the breaker" is not enough; confirmation by measurement is essential.
Elektrik, hidrolik, basınçlı hava ve buh: Hazardous energy sources such as electricity, hydraulics, compressed air and steam are isolated, locked (lock-out) and tagged (tag-out) before work on them begins. The key to the lock stays with the person doing the job; nobody else can re-energize the system. If several people are working, a multi-lock hasp is used.
Elektrikli rezistans ve termostat arızal: Faults in electric heating elements and thermostats cause temperature deviations; the cook periodically verifies the oven temperature with a thermometer (calibration). Abnormal smells, sparks, hot cables or a heater that does not work are reported immediately, and the equipment is not used until authorized personnel have dealt with it.
Elektrikli süpürge filtresi düzenli temi: The vacuum cleaner filter is cleaned regularly; a clogged filter both reduces performance and blows dust and allergens back out. Buckets and brushes are disinfected weekly. Equipment is kept tidy and labeled in the cleaning locker; this locker is one of the areas checked during inspections.
Elektrikli veya gazlı ocak/fırın, her ku: Electric or gas ranges/ovens are cleaned of grease and spills after each use; accumulated grease is both a hygiene and a fire risk. On gas systems, burner ports are checked for blockage, the flame color is observed (yellow = incomplete combustion/CO risk, blue = healthy) and connections are checked for gas leaks with a soap (bubble) test. The oven door seal affects heat loss and efficiency; a damaged seal is replaced.
Elektrikli ırgatlarda kademeli (pole-cha: Electric windlasses use pole-changing or frequency converter (VFD) controlled motors. Overload protection is provided by thermal relays and current limiting. Electric systems are easy to maintain, but the motor is strained by a sudden overload; a torque limiter or slip clutch may therefore be added.
Elektro-hidrolik windlass, elektrik moto: An electro-hydraulic windlass works with a hydraulic motor or cylinder supplied by a hydraulic pump driven by an electric motor.
Elektrolitik DC bus kapasitörleri, VFD'n: Electrolytic DC bus capacitors are the component of a VFD with the most limited life (typically 5-10 years, depending on temperature). Aging shows as an increase in ESR (Equivalent Series Resistance) and a drop in capacitance; bulging, leakage or an opened pressure vent are physical signs of failure. The ETO knows how to re-form the capacitors (reforming) of VFDs that have been in storage for a long time.
Elektrolitik: deniz suyu elektrolizle hi: Electrolytic: seawater produces hypochlorite by electrolysis; it disinfects chemically directly.
Elektroliz (elektro-klorinasyon): Deniz: Electrolysis (electro-chlorination): Produces active chlorine (hypochlorite) from seawater.
Elektronik kayıt sistemleri (e-logbook,: Electronic record systems (e-logbook, PMS software) are now common; however, backups and inspector access must be prepared in advance. Records must be legible, dated, signed and consistent.
Elektronik kontrollü motorlarda (ME tipi: On electronically controlled engines (ME type) valve timing is optimised according to the load.
Elektrot ile iş parçası arasında oluşan: The electric arc formed between the electrode and the workpiece melts the metals. The electrode coating produces gas and slag that protect the weld pool from the atmosphere.
Element 10.3 ayrıca \"kritik ekipman\" (: Element 10.3 also introduces the concept of "critical equipment"; for equipment whose sudden failure could lead to a hazardous situation, additional protective measures, redundancy and functional tests are mandatory. The Chief Engineer keeps the list of critical equipment in the engine room up to date and tracks the tests of this equipment on a separate schedule.
Elle yapılan düzeltmeler ECDIS'te kayıt: Corrections made by hand are recorded in ECDIS, and which notice has been entered is tracked. At an inspection, this record is the evidence that the charts have really been kept up to date.
Embarkation deck (binme güvertesi) özel: The embarkation deck is particularly important: the area in front of the lifeboats and liferafts must be clear, the davit area free of stores, the embarkation ladder ready and the deck safe against slipping. Using these areas as storage leads to fatal delays in a real emergency.
Embarkation/debarkation ile manifest ger: The manifest is updated in real time with embarkation and disembarkation; PRM and special needs are flagged. Consistency with the authorised copy ashore is ensured.
Emergency Shutdown (ESD) link ve dry-bre: The Emergency Shutdown (ESD) link and the dry-break (emergency release) coupling are checked, and it is verified that the line will separate safely and without spillage in an emergency release. The ESD activation time must be within the maker's specification.
Emergency bilge suction valve, en büyük: The emergency bilge suction valve connects the largest-capacity pump directly to the engine room bilge so that water can be pumped out quickly. The Chief Engineer teaches the team where this valve is and how it works, and tests it periodically.
Emergency fire pump da haftalık/aylık ça: The emergency fire pump is also run weekly/monthly to verify that it can work independently of the main pump. The test pressure, flow observation and station numbers are recorded.
Emergency fire pump, ana pompadan bağıms: The emergency fire pump is located in a space separate from the main pump and runs on a separate power source; a weekly/monthly running test is carried out and the pressure is verified. The international shore connection (water connection from ship to ship/shore) is kept accessible near the bridge.
Emergency fire pump, ana yangın pompalar: The emergency fire pump supplies firefighting water when the main fire pumps cannot operate (for example when an engine room fire has put the main pumps out of action). For this reason, it is located outside the engine room, in a separate compartment, and has its own independent power source (a motor supplied from the emergency generator, or an independent diesel).
Emergency fire pump, makine dairesi yang: In an engine room fire (the main fire pump may be out of action), the emergency fire pump runs from an independent power source (emergency generator or separate diesel) and pressurizes the fire main. It is located outside the engine room and has an independent sea suction. It is tested weekly; priming, pressure and flow rate are verified.
Emergency generator genellikle elektrik: The emergency generator is usually equipped with electric (battery) start and/or compressed air start; a dual system provides reliability. The ETO regularly checks the terminal voltage of the starting batteries, the electrolyte level (vented type), the state of charge and the output of the battery charger. A weak starting battery is the most frequent cause of a failure to start during a blackout.
Emergency generator haftalık çalıştırma: The emergency generator is given a weekly running test (usually on load) and a monthly black-out simulation; the fuel tank is kept full, the batteries charged and the starting air/system ready. Test records are evidence for PSC and class.
Emergency generator otomatik başlatma (b: The emergency generator is tested by automatic starting (blackout simulation), and it is verified that it supplies the critical loads within the required time. The UPS batteries and their autonomy are checked.
Emergency generator testi, hem manuel st: The emergency generator test includes both a manual start (weekly trial) and an auto-start (simulated loss of power). During the test, starting success, achieving the required running time, voltage/frequency stability, load transfer to the emergency switchboard and the fuel/oil condition are observed. After the test, the system is returned to standby mode.
Emergency generator'ın blackout anında s: Failure of the emergency generator to start during a blackout is the most critical scenario. Causes: a weak/flat starting battery, fuel shortage or air in the fuel system, a cold engine, a start panel fault or a sticking solenoid. The ETO must know the manual start and manual busbar energizing procedure and must eliminate the root cause. Regular weekly testing greatly reduces this risk.
Emergency generator, ana güç (main gener: When main power (main generators) is lost, the emergency generator cuts in automatically and supplies the critical loads through the emergency switchboard: emergency lighting, navigation lights, steering gear, communications (GMDSS), fire detection, watertight doors and the emergency fire pump. It is usually located above the main deck, with its own fuel tank and starting system.
Emergency generator, ana güç kaybında (b: On loss of main power (black-out), the emergency generator starts automatically under SOLAS II-1 Reg. 43 and supplies vital services (emergency lighting, navigation, GMDSS, steering, fire pump, watertight doors) via the emergency switchboard. Automatic starting must be completed within 45 seconds.
Emergency generator, ana güç kaybından s: The emergency generator must start automatically after loss of main power and supply the emergency busbar within 45 seconds at the latest. During this changeover, the transitional source of emergency power (accumulator battery) supplies the mandatory loads without interruption. The supply duration is 36 hours on passenger ships and 18 hours on cargo ships.
Emergency generator, en üst sürekli güve: The emergency generator is located in a separate compartment above the uppermost continuous deck and outside the fire boundaries of the main engine room. With its own fuel tank, cooling and starting system, it is completely independent of main power. Under normal conditions, the emergency switchboard is fed from the main busbar through the bus-tie breaker; in a blackout, this connection opens and the emergency generator comes on line.
Emergency stop butonları, makine dairesi: Emergency stop buttons stop fuel pumps, separators, fans and other critical equipment remotely from outside the engine room. In a fire, this stops the supply of fuel/oil and the circulation of air to the space and so makes firefighting possible. Ventilation flaps are closed remotely to cut off the entry of air (oxygen) into the engine room.
Emergency switchboard'un kalbi, ana bara: The heart of the emergency switchboard is the interlock logic between the bus-tie breaker connected to the main busbar and the emergency generator breaker. When a blackout is detected, the bus-tie opens, the generator starts and the generator breaker closes. By testing this transfer sequence, the ETO verifies that the interlock prevents both breakers from being closed at the same time (risk of back-feed).
Emergency switchboard, normal şartlarda: Under normal conditions, the emergency switchboard is fed from the main busbar through a bus-tie. On loss of main power (blackout) this connection opens, the emergency generator starts automatically and supplies the emergency busbar within 45 seconds, as required by SOLAS. The ETO carries out the weekly auto-start test of the emergency generator and verifies that the mandatory consumers connected to the emergency switchboard (navigation lights, emergency lighting, GMDSS, fire pump, steering gear) are correctly supplied.
Emici pad ve granül stoğu erişilebilir t: A stock of absorbent pads and granules is kept accessible; however, contaminated absorbent material, as oily waste (oily rag), carries a risk of spontaneous combustion, so it is collected in a metal container with a lid and disposed of properly. Oily rags left lying in the open are a cause of fire in themselves.
Emisyon Kontrol Alanlarına (ECA) girişte: On entering Emission Control Areas (ECA), the ship changes over to low-sulfur fuel (MGO or ULSFO; max. 0.10% sulfur). Since MGO is cleaner and has a lower viscosity, the load on the filters decreases; however, its lubricating properties are poor, and a lubricity additive may be needed for pumps/injectors. During the fuel changeover, thermal shock and the drop in viscosity can cause pump seizure.
Emniyet Komitesi, mürettebatın emniyet k: The Safety Committee is a platform where the crew talk openly about safety matters and share problems and suggestions. The aim is to turn safety into a culture that "everyone owns" rather than one "imposed by management". The Third Officer makes this meeting participatory and productive.
Emniyet ekipmanları ve tatbikatlar, \"hi: Safety equipment and drills are duties that "we hope will never be needed, but which save lives when they are". The AB's value lies in knowing the equipment and internalizing the procedures well enough to respond correctly without thinking in a crisis. Sweat shed in drills means lives saved in a real emergency; this is why no drill is rushed through, no check is skipped and no defect is hidden.
Emniyet ekipmanı işaretleri (levha, fosf: Safety equipment signs (plates, photoluminescent direction arrows) are kept visible and clean; they are not covered with paint or dirt. During deck painting and cleaning jobs, the AB takes care not to damage these signs and the equipment, protecting them by masking if necessary.
Emniyet ekipmanı yönetiminde başarı, hiç: Success in safety equipment management is not a voyage in which the equipment is never used; it is every item working fully when it is needed. The Chief Officer's disciplined inventory, service tracking and realistic drills directly determine the crew's chances of survival in an emergency.
Emniyet ekipmanı önünün malzeme ile kapa: Blocking access to safety equipment with materials, covering signs with paint or dirt and leaving escape lighting defective cause vital delays in a real emergency. During cleaning and painting work, the AB must protect safety equipment and signs and always keep access clear.
Emniyet ekipmanındaki bir kusur gizlendi: When a defect in safety equipment is concealed, the equipment will not work in a real emergency and the result can be fatal. The Third Officer knows that reporting a defect honestly is both a legal and an ethical obligation; hiding a fault "so that it is not seen in the inspection" is the most dangerous decision.
Emniyet gerilmesi, malzeme akma (veya ko: The allowable stress is found by dividing the yield (or ultimate/fatigue) strength of the material by the safety factor. The SF is chosen according to the type of load (static/dynamic), the ductility of the material, the seriousness of the consequences and class rules.
Emniyet hataları daha ağır sonuç doğurur: Safety errors have more serious consequences: skipping PPE (eye, hand and respiratory injuries), doing spark-producing work near flammables, using paint or solvent in an enclosed space without ventilation, and moving carelessly on a slippery wet deck. Each of these is the first link in a serious accident chain.
Emniyet performansı; LTIF (Lost Time Inj: Safety performance is monitored with indicators such as LTIF (Lost Time Injury Frequency), TRCF (Total Recordable Case Frequency), the number of near-miss reports/observations, the drill completion rate and the number of open actions. The Safety Officer analyzes the trends and presents them at the safety committee.
Emniyet prosedürlerini öğrenmek, makine: Learning safety procedures is the engine cadet's most vital task at sea. LOTO, PTW, enclosed spaces, hot work and PPE are each lessons drawn from past deaths, and none of them is a "formality that can be shortened". The cadet must internalize that following procedures is the mark of professionalism and that stopping and speaking up in an unsafe situation is a right. The safety discipline learned under supervision today is the most valuable legacy of the engineer who will lead a team tomorrow.
Emniyet sistemi testleri, \"her şey yolu: Safety system tests are the one layer that "seems unnecessary when everything is fine" but one day saves the engine, the ship and the crew. For the Third/Fourth Engineer, the measure is not having done the test, but having proved and recorded that the device actually works at the correct setpoint and at the correct level (alarm/slowdown/trip). A silenced alarm is an invitation to a future crankcase explosion or bearing seizure.
Emniyet stok ve tarih takibi, \"küçük am: Tracking safety stock and dates is a typical example of "small but vital" work. The Third Officer's disciplined schedule and timely replenishment ensure that every liferaft, every flare and every battery works the first time in a real emergency.
Emniyet tatbikatlarına katılım, güverte: Taking part in safety drills lays the life-safety foundation of the deck cadet's seagoing career. Taking drills seriously, being able to use basic equipment by reflex and knowing the escape routes protect the lives of both the cadet and the crew in a real emergency.
Emniyet testleri PMS'te calendar job ola: Safety tests are defined in the PMS as calendar jobs (weekly/monthly/quarterly). Before a test, the bridge is informed (for trip tests), and the necessary isolation and duty engineer preparations are made. The test result (setpoint, measured value, response time, pass/fail) is entered in the safety test log and the PMS; a faulty device is reported immediately and temporary protective measures are taken.
Emniyet valfi: Kazan basıncı ayar değeri: Safety valve: opens automatically when the boiler pressure exceeds the set value. There must be at least two.
Emniyet valfleri (safety valve), kazanın: Safety valves are the boiler's last protection against overpressure; the set pressure and the lifting (lift/easing gear) test are verified during survey. Unauthorized tampering with these valves is strictly prohibited.
Emniyet ve acil durum görevleri, kamarot: Safety and emergency duties are among the steward's most important responsibilities on board; beyond the service role, the steward contributes to saving lives as a crew member. Knowing one's duty, following fire door/escape route discipline and the reflex to raise the alarm early make the difference in a real emergency.
Emniyet/kirlilik/security olayları emniy: Safety, pollution and security events go through the safety line (DPA); commercial matters (laytime, bunkers, ETA, speed) go through the operations/chartering line. The Master's most frequent mistake is to put a safety event into the commercial line, or a commercial matter into the safety line. This confusion causes both delays in response and a broken chain of legal evidence.
En az iki kompresör ve iki hava şişesi y: At least two compressors and two air receivers provide redundancy; safety valves protect each pressure zone. The starting air line has a flame arrester and a bursting disc (against a starting air explosion). The air receivers are subject to class survey.
