A high/medium/low color matrix shows which controls are mandatory.
Her kalem için minimum (reorder point) v: A minimum (reorder point) and a maximum stock level are defined for each item. The minimum level is calculated allowing for the consumption rate, the lead time and the safety stock. The reorder point is determined by the formula: reorder point = (average daily consumption × lead time) + safety stock.
Her kap ve raf, içerik ve açılış/son kul: Each container and shelf is labeled with its contents and opening/expiry date. By keeping the store readable at a glance, the cook makes both fast preparation and stock counting easier. High-turnover products are kept at an accessible height, heavy products on the lower shelves (lifting safety) and rarely used ones on the upper shelves.
Her kapalı alan girişinde dışarıda bir s: For every enclosed space entry, there is a standby person outside who keeps in continuous communication with the person inside, tends the lifeline and, in an emergency, raises the alarm and starts the rescue. The rescue plan is prepared in advance: rescue equipment (tripod, winch, harness, SCBA) is ready and the rescue route is kept clear.
Her kapatılan iş emri bir veri noktasıdı: Every closed work order is a data point. Bearing clearances, exhaust temperature distribution, vibration and oil analysis results form trends over time. By monitoring these trends, the Second Engineer proposes interval optimization; for example, if a purifier's seal life is shorter than expected, the interval is shortened or the root cause (feed temperature, quality) is investigated.
Her katman bir ısıl dirence karşılık gel: Each layer corresponds to a thermal resistance. The total thermal resistance is the sum of the resistances, as with resistances in series.
Her kaza, yaralanma ve ramak kala (near-: Every accident, injury and near-miss is reported. A near-miss is an "it almost happened" situation and a free warning of a future accident. The Oiler reports without fear any dangerous situation seen or near-miss experienced; the aim is a learning culture, not a blame culture.
Her kimyasalın Güvenlik Bilgi Formu (MSD: The Safety Data Sheet (MSDS/SDS) for every chemical must be accessible on board. The Bosun ensures that the labels of the chemicals in the store are legible and undamaged; unlabeled containers are not accepted. Incompatible substances, such as acids and alkalis, or oxidizers and flammables, are kept apart.
Her konteyner kendi kompresörü, kondense: Each container has its own compressor, condenser, evaporator and control unit. It is supplied from the ship's sockets at 440 V / 60 Hz (or 380 V / 50 Hz).
Her lashing elemanının MSL'i (Maximum Se: Every lashing element has an MSL (Maximum Securing Load); the working load is limited by a safety factor. The ship's approved Cargo Securing Manual (CSM) defines which gear is to be used and how, the stowage arrangement and the calculation; securing must follow the CSM.
Her leg için XTD (Cross-Track Distance /: For each leg, the XTD (Cross-Track Distance / cross-track limit) is the limit of how far the ship may stray from the planned track; ECDIS gives an alarm when this limit is exceeded. The cadet learns that XTD is kept small in narrow waters (e.g. 0.1 NM) and wider in the open sea. XTD defines a safe corridor around the track, clear of no-go areas.
Her makine sistemi bir girdi alır, dönüş: Every machinery system takes an input, converts it and gives an output. The main engine converts fuel energy into shaft power; the fuel system supplies it, the lubrication system reduces friction, the cooling system removes heat and the air system enables combustion. By making these connections, the cadet understands the engine room as a whole.
Her manevra sonrası mooring düzeni, kull: After each maneuver, the mooring arrangement, the number of lines used, tug details and any near-miss/incident are entered in the deck log. Mooring equipment inspections (lines, winch brakes, fairleads) are recorded under the MSMP. These records are examined in PSC and vetting inspections.
Her mod geçişi; komuttaki istasyon, saat: Every mode change is entered in the DP log together with the station in command, the time and the type of change. Having a second person monitor the changeover breaks a one-person error chain.
Her muster station; aydınlatmalı, IMO se: Each muster station must be lit, marked with IMO symbols, freely accessible and large enough. On routine safety rounds, the Safety Officer checks that the escape routes to the muster station are not blocked or obstructed, that the emergency lighting and photoluminescent signs work, and that spare lifejackets are kept at the station.
Her mürettebat üyesi için bir adet can y: There must be one lifejacket for each crew member (in the cabin + spares at the muster station + spares for the bridge/engine room watchkeepers). The Safety Officer checks the light (automatic/manual), whistle, retro-reflective tape, body strap and gas capsule condition. Inflatable lifejackets are subject to periodic servicing.
Her near-miss veya bulgu için kök neden: For each near-miss or finding, the root cause is investigated and corrective and preventive actions are defined. Each action is assigned a responsible person and a deadline and is followed up until it is completed. The Third Officer prevents open actions from being forgotten and left unclosed.
Her numunenin alma tarihi, ekipman çalış: For each sample, the date taken, the equipment running hours and the oil's hours in service are recorded. This information is needed to interpret the result correctly and to enter it into the PMS.
Her operasyon ilgili kodla işlenir; giri: Each operation is entered with the relevant code; entries are made on time and every page is signed by the Master. The entries must agree with the actual situation (soundings, tank contents).
Her personel için günlük çalışma/dinlenm: Daily hours of work and rest are recorded for each person (rest hours record). The Chief Officer checks that these records are kept accurately and that they do not breach STCW/MLC limits. Software-based systems (e.g. rest hours planning modules) flag violations automatically. These records are among the first documents requested in PSC and MLC inspections.
Her personelin STCW sertifikaları, sağlı: The validity dates of each person's STCW certificates, medical fitness certificate and documents such as GMDSS/tanker endorsements are tracked. The Chief Officer follows the validity of the department's documents in a matrix and notifies the Master and the company in advance of documents about to expire; personnel with expired certificates cannot remain on duty, and this leads to PSC detention.
Her plan, beklenmedik durumlar (makine a: Every plan must include contingency options for unexpected situations (engine failure, sudden deterioration of the weather, traffic congestion). The Second Officer notes in the plan suitable anchorages (holding ground, depth, swinging room), emergency anchorage positions and alternative route options.
Her planlı bakım, PMS yazılımında açılan: Every planned maintenance job starts with a work order opened in the PMS software. The work order contains the job to be done, the spare parts and tools required, the estimated duration and the OEM procedure reference. By reading the work order, the cadet understands the scope of the job, its critical steps and its safety requirements in advance.
Her reefer'ın set-point'i shipper talima: The set-point of each reefer is verified against the shipper's instructions; the control variable is the supply air temperature for chilled cargo and the return air temperature for frozen cargo. A reefer log is kept daily (usually twice a day); alarms are investigated immediately.
Her sabah Reis, ekibe günün işini, riskl: Every morning, the Bosun holds a toolbox meeting explaining to the team the day's work, the risks, the equipment to be used and the PPE. For important jobs, a job-specific risk assessment (JSA) is completed and the participants sign it. After an accident, this record is evidence of "due diligence".
Her sefer öncesi Birinci Zabit, lashing: Before every voyage, the Chief Officer checks the lashing equipment (twistlocks, lashing rods, turnbuckles, bottle screws, D-rings, wire/chain, shackles) item by item for wear, cracks, deformation, corrosion and thread damage. SWL markings must be legible; unmarked or damaged equipment is withdrawn from use. A worn twistlock can fail to hold a container stack and cause its loss.
Her silindir için bağımsız enjeksiyon ko: Independent injection control is possible for each cylinder. Pilot injection, main injection and post-injection can be made.
Her silindir için exhaust gas temperatur: For each cylinder, the exhaust gas temperature, peak pressure (Pmax) and compression pressure are monitored. The difference in exhaust temperature between cylinders is normally expected to stay within the limit specified by the engine maker. An excessively high cylinder may indicate excess fuel/late combustion, while a low cylinder may indicate an injector fault or a sticking fuel valve.
Her silindirin Fe/BN trendi ve inspectio: The Fe/BN trend and the inspection findings for each cylinder are recorded. A trend is far more informative than a single measurement; rising Fe or falling BN is an early sign of a problem. By following this trend, the Second Engineer prevents major failures.
Her silindirin egzoz sıcaklığı, o silind: The exhaust temperature of each cylinder is a direct indicator of that cylinder's share of the load. The deviation between all cylinders is generally kept within ±5% (approximately ±15-20°C). A high reading on one cylinder may mean late combustion, a leaking exhaust valve or fuel index imbalance; a low reading may mean low compression, a misfiring injector or a fuel pump leak.
Her soğutma mahalli, set sıcaklığını kor: Each refrigerated space is controlled by a thermostat (mechanical or electronic) that maintains the set temperature. The ETO checks the thermostat's accuracy against a calibrated reference thermometer; a drifting thermostat causes either unnecessary cooling (wasted energy) or insufficient cooling (spoiled food). On electronic controllers, the sensors (PT100/NTC) and parameter settings are checked.
Her starting air receiver üzerinde fusib: Each starting air receiver is fitted with a fusible plug and a relief valve; these are the last safeguards against overpressure and overheating and are covered by survey.
Her sıcak çalışma öncesinde bir risk değ: Before every hot work job, a Risk Assessment or Job Safety Analysis is carried out. The hazards are listed one by one and rated on a likelihood/severity matrix, and a control measure is defined for each hazard. The Third/Fourth Engineer personally helps to complete the form and confirms that it matches the reality on site.
Her sıcak çalışmada, işi yapan kişiden a: For every hot work job, there is a fire watch separate from the person doing the work. The fire watch's task is to keep continuous watch on the area where sparks fall, on hidden voids and on adjacent compartments, and to keep the first-response equipment at hand. The fire watch continues for at least 30-60 minutes (according to company procedure) after the job is finished, because smoldering material can burst into flame later.
Her sınıf için viskozite, yoğunluk, flas: For each grade, limit values are set for parameters such as viscosity, density, flash point, water, sulphur, Al+Si and vanadium.
Her sınıf için viskozite, yoğunluk, kükü: Limits for viscosity, density, sulphur, water, ash, CCAI and Al+Si are set for each grade.
Her tamamlanan görev, eğitmen zabit (tra: Each completed task is signed and assessed by the training officer. This approval confirms that the entry is genuine and that the competence has been acquired. The cadet meets the training officer regularly to obtain feedback and to close any gaps.
Her tatbikat sonrası debrief (değerlendi: After each drill, a debrief is held; points that fell short, late mustering, equipment failures and proposals for improvement are discussed and recorded. The AB reports any problem noticed during the drill (e.g., a blocked escape route, a light that does not work). These records are audited under the ISM Code.
Her tatbikat tarih, katılımcılar, senary: Each drill is recorded with the date, participants, scenario, observations and lessons learned. As required by the ISM Code, this record is entered in the company safety management system (SMS) and presented at internal/external audits. Recurring deficiencies (e.g. the team hesitates to reduce speed in restricted visibility) become the focus of the next drill.
Her tatbikatın asıl değeri debrief'tedir: The real value of every drill lies in the debrief: what went well, where time was lost, which equipment did not work as expected, which role remained unclear. The Master runs the debrief not as an "assessment exam" but as an open, no-blame learning session; junior crew must be able to share an error rather than hide it. The lessons learned shape the scenario of the next drill.
Her tayfanın yetkinliği, sertifikası ve: Each rating's competence, certification and experience differ. The Bosun matches qualified (AB - Able Seaman), general (OS - Ordinary Seaman) and novice (deck cadet/trainee) personnel to jobs according to the risk. High-risk work (working aloft, overside, enclosed space, hot work) is given only to trained personnel under supervision.
Her temizlik görevi bir kayıt çizelgesin: Every cleaning task is entered in a record sheet (cleaning schedule/log); this record is presented during MLC and port health inspections (Ship Sanitation). Cleaning is done with the right chemical at the right dilution; food-safe sanitizer is used on food-contact surfaces and is rinsed off if the product requires rinsing.
Her temizlik kimyasalının bir Safety Dat: Every cleaning chemical has Safety Data Sheet (SDS) information, and the steward must know the dilution ratio, contact time and incompatibilities of each product used. The most critical rule: never mix bleach (sodium hypochlorite) with acid-based descaler; this mixture releases toxic chlorine gas and is life-threatening in confined areas such as a closed bathroom.
Her test bir PMS job'ına bağlanır; yapıl: Each test is linked to a PMS job; when it is done, the job is closed by entering the date, the result and the person responsible. A skipped or delayed test appears as "overdue" in the system and goes onto the Safety Officer's follow-up list.
Her teşhis, somut bir aksiyona bağlanır:: Every diagnosis is linked to a concrete action: filter check, cooler test, water leak investigation, additional sample or planned opening-up. The result is filed and entered in the PMS.
Her thruster ve ana pervane manuel kontr: Each thruster and main propeller is proved in both directions in manual control; the command, the feedback and the physical response are compared. It is checked that the gyros, MRU/VRS, wind sensors and the selected PRS are healthy and correctly weighted.
Her tıbbi olay, tedavi ve ilaç kullanımı: Every medical incident, treatment and use of medicine is entered in the medical log book. The Second Officer also organizes first-aid and medical emergency drills; skills such as CPR, bleeding control, fracture immobilization and stretcher carrying are refreshed regularly.
Her vardiya katılımı, Training Record Bo: Each watch participation is entered under the relevant competence area of the Training Record Book (TRB): "engineering watch keeping", "monitor machinery performance", "maintain safe engineering watch". The cadet records every task performed under supervision (keeping the log, rounds, transfers, observing alarm response) in the TRB and has it signed by the training engineer.
Her vardiya sonunda 'açık risk listesi': At the end of each watch the "open risk list" should be updated, and three items of data must always be handed over: the current value, the trend over the last 4 hours and the next action expected.
Her vardiya, bir önceki vardiyadan resmi: Every watch begins with a formal handover from the previous watch. When taking over, the oiler receives verbally and in writing the condition of the machinery, work in progress, the alarm history, expected maneuvers/operations and especially the "points requiring attention". Under STCW A-VIII/2 the handover must be complete; in a doubtful situation, the relieving person does not accept the watch without personally checking the machinery.
Her vardiya/operasyon öncesi Reis, ekibe: Before each watch/operation, the Bosun holds a toolbox meeting explaining the steps of the job, the risks, the equipment and the emergency procedure. Junior ratings are taught lashing technique, hatch operations and hold safety in practice; this training is recorded in the deck training book.
Her vardiya; ana makine devri, yük, egzo: Each watch enters in the engine log the main engine rpm, load, exhaust temperatures, pressures, fuel consumption, auxiliary machinery status, alarms/events and the actions taken. The Second Engineer reviews the daily logs, reports abnormalities to the Chief Engineer and has missing/inconsistent entries corrected.
Her waypoint'te course, distance, planne: For each waypoint, the course, distance, planned speed, ETA and wheel-over point (the point at which the turn starts) are determined. The wheel-over is calculated from the ship's advance and transfer maneuvering characteristics; otherwise the ship will go beyond the safe water limit in the turn.
Her yakıt için BDN (Bunker Delivery Note: For each fuel, the BDN (Bunker Delivery Note) and the representative sample are kept for a set period as required by MARPOL (BDN 3 years, sample 12 months). PSC inspections ask for the BDN of the fuel in use and, if required, its sample.
Her yardımcı makine için PMS yazılımında: For each item of auxiliary machinery, a job is defined in the PMS software (AMOS, TM Master, ShipManager); the job is opened when triggered by running hours or by the calendar. The Third/Fourth Engineer allocates open work orders according to the watch schedule, confirms the required spare parts and consumables with a ROB (remaining on board) check and, when the job is finished, closes it in the system with the counter reading + a description of the work done.
Her yağ işlemi (bilge transfer, OWS deşa: Every oil operation (bilge transfer, OWS discharge, sludge incineration/delivery, internal transfer) is entered in ORB Part I correctly, on time and in a way that reflects what actually happened. The Second Engineer ensures that the ORB is consistent with the physical operations (tank levels, meter readings). ORB inconsistencies are among the most frequent causes of penalties/detention at PSC.
Her yedek parça için minimum ve maksimum: A minimum and maximum stock level is set for each spare part. When the stock falls below the minimum level, an order is triggered (re-order point). The order quantity is calculated to bring the stock up to the maximum level.
Her yedek parça, PMS/envanter sisteminde: Every spare part is identified in the PMS/inventory system by a code (part number / IMPA or OEM code). This code is critical for ordering the correct part; two parts that look similar may have different codes, and ordering the wrong part causes delay and cost. The part code is usually found in the OEM maintenance manual and the equipment drawing.
Her yedek parça, ekipmanın kritikliğine: Every spare part is classified according to the criticality of the equipment. A "critical spare" is a part whose failure would take the ship out of service (off-hire) or endanger safety: for example, main engine exhaust valves, fuel injectors, fuel pump plungers, T/C shaft bearings and generator crank bearings. These parts are always kept on board in at least the specified quantity.
Her yeni gemiye çıkışta TRB'nin familiar: On joining each new ship, the familiarization section of the TRB is completed as a priority. This section covers the locations of safety equipment, escape routes, the muster station, lifejacket/immersion suit locations, emergency alarm signals, engine room emergency stop buttons and enclosed space entry points. The ISM Code requires every person joining the ship to receive familiarization before taking up duties.
Her yük operasyonu öncesi tool-box talk: Before every cargo operation, a toolbox talk (on-site briefing) is held; the deck officer explains the cargo plan, the sequence, the holds to be opened, the lashing requirements and the hazards. In this briefing, the AB learns clearly their own duty, the equipment to be used and what to do in an emergency. Operations do not start without a briefing.
Her yükleme adımı loadicator'da SF/BM ve: Every loading step is checked in the loading computer for SF/BM and GM; values above 85% of the permissible limits are a sign that the plan needs revising. The printouts are kept.
Her yükleme adımında SF/BM ve torsion %1: At every loading step SF/BM and torsion are kept below 100% of the limits; above 85% is the alarm band and the sequence is revised.
Her yüksek riskli iş öncesi toolbox meet: A toolbox meeting (on-site briefing) is held before every high-risk job; the steps of the job, the hazards, the precautions, the allocation of tasks and the emergency plan are discussed with the participants. The risk assessment form documents the hazards and controls in writing; the question "what can go wrong, and how do I prevent it?" is answered systematically.
Her yükün IMSBC schedule'ı bağlayıcıdır;: The IMSBC Code schedule of each cargo is binding; its ventilation and monitoring instructions are followed to the letter.
Her yıl Paris ve Tokyo MOU, belirli bir: Every year the Paris and Tokyo MOUs run a Concentrated Inspection Campaign (CIC) focusing on a particular theme: in the past, themes such as STCW rest hours, MARPOL Annex VI, fire safety, ISM, crew familiarisation and ballast water management have been chosen. During the CIC period a CIC questionnaire is applied to every ship in addition to the standard inspection. The Master must find out that year's CIC theme in advance and prepare the related files, records and equipment tests specifically.
Her ölçülen büyüklük için alarm setpoint: For each measured variable, alarm setpoints are set according to vendor/class recommendations: high/high-high and low/low-low layers, pre-warning (alert) and trip (shutdown) levels. The ETO makes sure that these setpoints are correct, consistent with the engine manufacturer's limits and set so that they do not create nuisance alarms.
Herhangi bir anormallik (yeni sızıntı, s: Any abnormality (a new leak, a change in sound, vibration, a loose connection, spilled oil) is reported immediately to the engineer on watch. The Oiler does not intervene on their own and knows the limits of their authority. However, if the Oiler sees an immediate danger (a fire starting, a high-pressure steam/oil spray), they first ensure safety and raise the alarm.
Herhangi bir unsurun kaldırılması yangın: Removing any one element extinguishes the fire: cooling (removing heat), smothering (cutting off oxygen), starving (separating the fuel). Breaking the chain reaction (dry chemical powder) is the fourth extinguishing mechanism.
Hersey-Blanchard modeline göre lider, ek: According to the Hersey-Blanchard model, the leader changes style according to the maturity of the team member. The same leader may approach different people in different styles.
Hesap, onaylı grain loading booklet ile: The calculation is made with the approved grain loading booklet; some ports require an NCB inspection. Grain is not loaded unless the criteria are met.
Hesaplanan EEXI değeri, gerekli EEXI değ: The attained EEXI value must be equal to or below the required EEXI (the reference line value reduced by the reduction factor for the ship type). Otherwise, a technical correction must be made.
Hibrit düzenlerde şaft makinesi batarya: In hybrid arrangements the shaft machine is combined with batteries or fuel cells and used for load levelling (peak shaving) and for reducing emissions during manoeuvring.
Hidrasyon da performansın görünmez ayağı: Hydration is also an invisible part of performance; water and electrolyte losses are high, especially in hot climates and in the engine room. The cook supports hydration by keeping the drinks station (water, tea, coffee and, if necessary, electrolyte drinks) accessible.
Hidrofor pompası: santrifüj, tipik 4–6 b: Hydrophore pump: centrifugal, typically 4–6 bar discharge.
Hidrofor, içinde hava yastığı (air cushi: The hydrophore is a pressure tank with an air cushion inside; the pump pushes water into the tank, the air is compressed and creates pressure. When a tap is opened, the compressed air pushes the water out; when the pressure falls to the lower limit, the pump starts automatically (pressure switch). In this way pressure is maintained without the pump running continuously.
Hidrolik arızalarının büyük bölümü kirli: Most hydraulic failures are caused by contamination. The target cleanliness class is set by the maker; the water content and particle count are followed periodically. If the tank breather filter is neglected, the system is open to moisture and dust.
Hidrolik açma/kapama sistemlerinde yağ s: In hydraulic opening/closing systems, the oil level, leaks, hose aging and cylinder packings are monitored. Rollers, hinges and wheel tracks are greased; corrosion is chipped and painted. On mechanical (folding) covers, maintenance of chains/wires and rollers has priority.
Hidrolik silindir/pompa veya elektrik mo: Hydraulic cylinders and pumps, or electric motors and contactors, are maintained; wire ropes and brakes are inspected according to the PMS. The overload protection is verified.
Hidrolik tahrikli windlass: Hidrolik pom: Hydraulically driven windlass: works with a hydraulic pump and motor. High torque capacity, compact size and overload protection are its advantages. It is common on tankers and bulk carriers.
Hidrolik veya frekans kontrollü elektrik: They work with a hydraulic or frequency-controlled electric motor. A tension sensor (load cell) measures the line force continuously.
Hidrolik yağ analiz edilir; seal sızıntı: The hydraulic oil is analysed and seal leakage (cofferdam drain) is monitored, because hydraulic oil getting into the cargo causes contamination. The motor insulation is measured periodically.
Hidrolik ırgatlar, makine dairesi veya g: Hydraulic windlasses are supplied from a hydraulic power unit (HPU) in the engine room or below deck. A variable-displacement pump sends pressurised oil to the windlass motor; speed and torque are adjusted through pressure and flow. The hydraulic system gives natural protection against overload: as the load increases, the pressure rises and the relief valve opens and stops the windlass ("stall"), preventing mechanical damage.
Hidrolik/pnömatik uzaktan kumandalı valf: With hydraulically/pneumatically remote-controlled valves, the mimic panel indication may not match the actual valve position (limit switch fault, hydraulic leak). In case of doubt, the valve is checked manually/locally. A wrong valve position leads to a serious list/trim incident through the wrong tank being pumped or through backflow; therefore, during critical operations, the valve position is physically verified.
High-expansion foam (genleşme oranı 200–: High-expansion foam (expansion ratio 200–1000) fills enclosed spaces quickly.
High-voltage (1 kV üstü) sistemler için: Under STCW, special training is mandatory for high-voltage (above 1 kV) systems. As new technologies (scrubber, LNG dual-fuel, methanol) come on board, training needs are updated.
Hijyen ve sağlık standartlarının korunma: Maintaining hygiene and health standards is the steward's direct contribution to the health of the crew. Regular cleaning, correct disinfection, garbage management and outbreak protocols are the most effective defense for preventing illness in a closed environment and keeping the accommodation healthy.
Hijyen, haşere (hamamböceği, kemirgen) k: Hygiene is the basis of pest control (cockroaches, rodents); food scraps and dirt attract pests. The steward prevents pests through cleaning and reports any signs seen (droppings, tracks, live pests). The steward supports the pest management program (traps, bait).
Hiyerarşi, emniyet-kritik bilginin yukar: Hierarchy must not prevent safety-critical information from reaching the top. Many machinery accidents have arisen from situations in which a junior officer kept silent out of concern about "not disturbing" anyone.
Hiyerarşik kontrol uygulanır: önce işi o: The hierarchy of controls is applied: first eliminate the work (e.g. by taking the part to the workshop/deck and working on it there) or substitute it; if that is not possible, engineering controls (screens, ventilation), administrative controls (permit, fire watch) and finally PPE come into play.
Hiçbir bakım, ekipman enerji altındayken: No maintenance starts while the equipment is energized. With Lockout-Tagout (LOTO), electrical, pressure, thermal and kinetic energy are isolated; the isolated valve/breaker is tagged and locked. The cadet learns to verify that the equipment to be worked on is actually isolated (zero energy state).
Hiçbir bakım, ekipman enerjisi izole edi: No maintenance starts until the equipment's energy has been isolated. For a pump/compressor driven by an electric motor, the breaker is set "OFF + LOTO (Lock Out Tag Out)"; in a pressurized system, the suction/discharge valves are closed and the pressure is released by draining. For work involving hot oil or steam lines (boiler, FO purifier heater), the work waits until the system has cooled down.
Hiçbir mekanik iş, ekipman emniyetli hal: No mechanical job starts until the equipment has been made safe. With LOTO (Lock-Out / Tag-Out), the electrical supply is isolated, locked and tagged; pressurized systems are isolated and depressurized (de-pressurize); hot systems are allowed to cool down; rotating equipment is verified to be stopped. If these steps are skipped, an unexpected release of energy can be fatal.
Hiçbir sıcak çalışma, geçerli bir Hot Wo: No hot work may start without a valid Hot Work Permit. The permit records the job, its location, the time window, the precautions taken and the approving officer (usually the Chief Engineer and/or the Master). The Third/Fourth Engineer verifies that the permit conditions are actually met on site.
Hiçbir ürün doğrudan zemine konmaz; en a: No product is placed directly on the floor; the bottom shelf is at least 15 cm above the floor (protection against pests and moisture). Cleaning chemicals are kept away from food in a closed, labeled area; food and chemicals must never share the same shelf. Opened packages are transferred to labeled containers with lids.
Hold bilge sounding'i, hold içine su gir: Hold bilge soundings give early warning of water entering the hold. If regular bilge soundings during operations and on passage show an increase, the Chief Officer and the bridge are warned immediately; this is the early alarm for a hatch seal problem or a hull leak.
Hold hazırlığı; previous cargo'ya, sonra: Hold preparation is defined at 4 levels according to the previous cargo, the next cargo and the charter party terms: load-ready (sweepup), shovel-clean, grain-clean, hospital-clean. Grain charters require an NCB (National Cargo Bureau) inspection.
Hold hazırlığı; sweeping, washing (sea w: Hold preparation covers sweeping, washing (sea water + fresh water rinse), drying, paint touch-up, smell removal, bilge well cleaning and checking the hatch cover seals. The Chief Officer carries out the hold inspection personally and keeps a photo/video record.
Hold inspection bizzat yapılır ve foto/v: The hold inspection is done in person and documented with photos or video; for grain, acceptance by the NCB or the surveyor is obtained. A rejected hold is cleaned again.
Hold temizliği; süpürme, deniz suyu yıka: Hold cleaning includes sweeping, seawater washing, freshwater rinsing, drying, deodorizing, paint touch-up and cleaning of the bilge wells. Residues of the previous cargo (taint) can contaminate the next cargo; therefore, the cleaning standard is strict.
Hold, tank ve kofferdam gibi kapalı alan: Entry into enclosed spaces such as holds, tanks and cofferdams is made with an enclosed space entry permit. O2, LEL, H2S and CO are measured continuously; standby personnel and a rescue plan are mandatory. Under SOLAS III/19.3.3, enclosed space entry and rescue drills are held at least every two months. The Master checks that the permit system works.
Horn dümen: Alt yatak desteği vardır, ya: Horn rudder: has a lower bearing support and is structurally stronger.
Hortum testi (kapalı kapağa basınçlı su): The hose test (water under pressure on the closed cover) is the classic method; with cargo on board, the ultrasonic test (a transmitter inside, a receiver scanning outside) is preferred. The test finds leak points along the line of the packing.
Hortumlar kargo cinsine ve basınca uygun: Hoses must be suitable for the cargo and the pressure, certified and within their test date. If a loading arm (Chiksan) is used, it is verified that it stays within its operating envelope and that its drift and limit alarms work.
Hose test su jeti ile sızıntı arar (yük: The hose test looks for leaks with a water jet (risky with cargo on board); the chalk test shows the contact of the rubber packing; the ultrasonic test measures leaks with the hold closed, using the PFU value. The results are documented.
Hose test: Onaylı test düzenine göre dış: Hose test: water is applied from outside according to the approved test arrangement and ingress is watched for from inside; the water pressure, nozzle distance and rate of travel are not chosen at random.
Hot well tank: kondensi toplar, sıcaklığ: Hot well tank: collects the condensate and controls its temperature (for oxygen removal).
Hot work (kaynak, kesme, taşlama, açık a: Hot work (welding, cutting, grinding, open flame) is done under standard controls in designated areas such as the workshop. In a non-designated area (particularly near tanks, holds or the fuel oil area) a much stricter permit is required; a gas-free certificate, atmosphere checks of the surrounding tanks and a fire watch are mandatory.
Hot work (kaynak, taşlama, kesme, açık a: Hot work (welding, grinding, cutting, open flame) significantly increases the risk of fire and explosion on board. Fuel vapor, oily surfaces and combustible materials can be ignited by a spark. For this reason, hot work requires a separate permit and the atmosphere is verified as "gas-free".
Housekeeping bulguları ve kapanışları ka: Housekeeping findings and their close-outs are recorded; during an inspection these records are the ship's evidence of "due diligence". At the watch handover, the Second Engineer passes on open housekeeping jobs, leaks being monitored and temporary arrangements in writing.
Housekeeping kusurları PSC'de sık çıkan: Housekeeping defects are frequent PSC findings and create an impression of the ship's general safety culture. A ship that is consistently in good order also inspires confidence during inspections. The Third Officer maintains this order every day.
Housekeeping; tek başına bir tutuklama (: Although housekeeping alone is not a reason for detention, a poor general impression puts the inspector into "look deeper" mode and opens the way to other findings. Good housekeeping, on the other hand, sets a positive tone for the inspection.
Housekeeping; toolbox meeting'lerin sabi: Housekeeping is a standing agenda item at toolbox meetings. The Bosun praises good examples and treats deficiencies as system issues, not personal ones. When a deckhand reports a hazard (e.g. a loose railing), the report must be welcomed; a reporting culture is the guarantee of order and safety.
Hull biofouling, hem CII performansını h: Hull biofouling affects both CII performance and the risk of invasive species; some jurisdictions (New Zealand, California) require a biofouling management record. The Master finds out in advance the regional environmental rules of the area the ship is going to (ECA, the EU Emissions Trading System, regional speed limits) and plans compliance.
Hırsızlık, sabotaj, izinsiz giriş, bomb: Security incidents such as theft, sabotage, unauthorised entry, a bomb threat or a suspicious situation are managed in accordance with the SSP and reported to the company, the PFSO and the authorities. The SSAS provides a covert alarm when life or the ship is threatened. The Master carries out the recording and corrective action after the incident.
Hız, CII üzerinde en güçlü operasyonel k: Speed is the strongest operational lever on CII; since consumption varies roughly with the cube of speed, a small reduction in speed gives a large reduction in emissions. Slow steaming is planned together with the Master within the limits of the charter party and ETA constraints.
Hızlı derinleşen alçak basınç (bomb cycl: A rapidly deepening low (bomb cyclogenesis — a fall of ≥24 hPa in 24 hours) is very dangerous; it produces sudden, violent wind and sea. The Second Officer checks whether the forecasts are coming true by continuously monitoring the pressure tendency with the barometer/barograph.
Hızlı yüklemede ballast yetişemezse muka: If deballasting cannot keep up with fast loading, the strength limits can quickly be exceeded.

I (İntegral): Hatanın zamanla birikimini: I (integral): integrates the error over time and removes the steady-state error. Too much integral action can cause oscillation.

I: Gösterge musluğundan kontrol, yakıt p: I: check at the indicator cock, check the fuel pump.
IACS Unified Requirements (UR A1/A2), he: The IACS Unified Requirements (UR A1/A2) set the anchor mass and the chain diameter and length according to each ship's equipment number (EN). The windlass must be able to heave this chain at a given speed. A typical class requirement: the windlass must be able to heave in three shackles (about 82.5 m) of chain hanging in the water, together with the anchor, at an average speed of at least 9 m/min.
IBS ayrıca güç yönetim sistemi, otomasyo: The IBS can also be integrated with ship systems such as the power management system, automation, the alarm system, navigation lights and searchlights, the horn and the wipers.
IBS'in alarm sistemiyle entegrasyonunda,: When the IBS is integrated with the alarm system, it must be verified that DP-related alarms are not suppressed on the bridge. Every suppressed or disabled alarm is recorded and passed on at the handover.
IEC 60945 (A.694(17)), tüm köprüüstü cih: IEC 60945 (A.694(17)) sets the environmental and EMC durability requirements for all bridge equipment. Retesting equipment after servicing and recording the result is part of a traceable maintenance chain.
IEC 62443 yaklaşımıyla OT ağı, güvenlik: Following the IEC 62443 approach, the OT network is divided into security zones, and communication between zones passes through controlled conduits (conduits/firewalls). The ETO keeps bridge OT (ECDIS, radar), machinery OT (IAS, propulsion), cargo control, administrative IT and the crew welfare network in separate segments. Critical OT is not connected directly to the internet; the necessary data flows are restricted by strict rules.
IEC/ISO/IEEE 80005-1 standardı yüksek ge: The IEC/ISO/IEEE 80005-1 standard defines the requirements for high-voltage shore connection (HVSC).
IG iki şekilde üretilir: kazan baca gazı: Inert gas is produced in two ways: from boiler flue gas (which contains little O₂) or from an independent inert gas generator (by burning fuel). On product tankers a generator or nitrogen may be preferred for high purity. The gas produced is hot, contains sulphur and is laden with soot; it must be conditioned before use.
IGS arızası kargo operasyonunu durdurma: An IGS failure is a reason to stop cargo operations; no loading or discharge takes place unless the system is working safely.
IGS düzgün çalışmadan kargo operasyonu y: No cargo operation can take place unless the IGS is working properly; the maintenance plan is coordinated with the cargo programme.
IGS otomatik basınç kontrolü kalibre edi: The automatic pressure control of the IGS is calibrated; the tanks are always kept at positive pressure. A sensor or actuator failure must be signalled by an alarm.
IGS startup; scrubber su akışı, deck sea: The IGS is started up with a checklist covering scrubber water flow, deck seal level, O2 analyser calibration and starting the blowers. Before inert gas is delivered to the tanks, the outlet O2 value (below 5%) is verified.
IGS, COW boyunca tank atmosferini ≤%8 O₂: During COW the IGS keeps the tank atmosphere at 8% O₂ or less and at positive pressure; the inert gas delivered to the deck main must have 5% O₂ or less. The analyser reading is verified by proper sampling and calibration.
IGS; oksijen analizörü, basınç göstergel: The IGS is fitted with an oxygen analyzer, pressure gauges, a deck water seal (to prevent backflow) and alarms. The AB helps to monitor the IGS indicators on deck; if the oxygen rises, the pressure drops or an alarm sounds, the operation is stopped and the officer is informed. An IGS failure means a risk of a flammable atmosphere forming; COW/washing is stopped immediately.
IHP = (Pmean × L × A × N) / (60 × 75) kl: IHP is calculated with the classic formula IHP = (Pmean × L × A × N) / (60 × 75). SFOC = (fuel consumption [g/h]) / (IHP × 0.7355) — on modern engines it should be in the range 165-175 g/kWh. If SFOC keeps rising, loss of compression, injector wear or fuel quality is suspected.
IHR 2005 kapsamında her gemi, geçerli bi: Under IHR 2005, every ship must carry a valid Ship Sanitation Control Exemption Certificate (SSCEC — no risk found/measures adequate) or Ship Sanitation Control Certificate (SSCC — control measures applied); these have replaced the historical "Deratting Certificate". The certificates are typically valid for 6 months and are renewed at authorized ports. The cook contributes to the smooth renewal of this certificate by keeping the galley/food area ready for inspection and recording pest findings.
IHR 2005, hastalıkların uluslararası yay: IHR 2005 aims to prevent the international spread of disease without unnecessarily restricting travel and trade. Ships are at the centre of this regime: port health authorities ask the ship for a health declaration and, when necessary, carry out inspections and apply measures. The Master is responsible for the ship's compliance with this framework.
IMD sürekli izleme yapsa da, ETO devre/e: Although the IMD monitors continuously, the ETO trends gradual insulation deterioration through periodic megger measurements on each circuit/item of equipment. Measurements are corrected for temperature and recorded; a falling trend gives early warning of a developing problem that has not yet raised an alarm.
IMDG Code 9 ana sınıf + alt sınıf kullan: The IMDG Code uses 9 main classes + subclasses (1 explosives, 2 gases, 3 flammable liquids, 4 flammable solids, 5 oxidizing substances, 6 toxic substances, 7 radioactive material, 8 corrosives, 9 miscellaneous). The segregation table governs which classes may be stowed side by side, on top of each other or in adjacent holds.
IMDG Code 9 ana sınıf kullanır (1 patlay: The IMDG Code uses 9 main classes (1 explosives … 9 miscellaneous). The segregation table regulates which classes may be next to each other, above each other or in adjacent holds. The Master checks the DG manifest, the packing certificate, the EmS (Emergency Schedules) and that the stowage positions comply with the segregation rules. Mis-declared DG is a hazard across the industry; the CINS circulars are followed.
IMDG Code paketli tehlikeli yükleri (kon: The IMDG Code regulates packaged dangerous goods (containers, drums, IBCs), while the IMSBC Code regulates solid bulk cargoes (ore, coal). The Chief Officer knows both regimes and applies the correct rules for the type of cargo. Incorrect classification or declaration is among the causes of the most serious marine casualties.
IMDG yük için Dangerous Goods Declaratio: For IMDG cargo, the Dangerous Goods Declaration (DGD), the Container/Vehicle Packing Certificate and correct stowage and segregation documents are mandatory. For bulk cargo, the cargo declaration from the shipper under the IMSBC Code (including the TML/MC information) and, where necessary, a Trimming Certificate are required. Missing documents are a reason for refusing to load.
IMDG, yükleri 9 ana sınıfa ayırır (patla: The IMDG Code divides goods into 9 main classes (explosives, gases, flammable liquids, flammable solids, oxidizing substances, toxic substances, radioactive material, corrosives, miscellaneous). Each class has its own handling, stowage and emergency response requirements.
IMO 2020 global sülfür cap'i, gemi yakıt: The IMO 2020 global sulfur cap limits the sulfur content of ship fuel to 0.50% m/m. In ECAs (Baltic, North Sea, North America, the US Caribbean and, from 1 May 2025, the Mediterranean ECA) the limit is much stricter: 0.10% m/m. There are two ways to meet these limits: using compliant low-sulfur fuel, or using high-sulfur fuel with an approved scrubber (EGCS).
IMO DCS'den farklı olarak AB limanlı sef: Unlike the IMO DCS, it requires detailed reporting on a per-voyage basis for voyages involving EU ports.
IMO Data Collection System (DCS) ve EU M: The IMO Data Collection System (DCS) and EU MRV (Monitoring, Reporting, Verification) require verified reporting of annual fuel consumption and CO2 emission data. The Chief Engineer ensures that consumption data are collected in line with the approved monitoring plan.
IMO FAL Convention (Convention on Facili: The IMO FAL Convention (Convention on Facilitation of International Maritime Traffic) defines the standard documents: the General Declaration, Cargo Declaration, Ship's Stores Declaration, Crew's Effects Declaration, Crew List, Passenger List, Dangerous Goods and the Maritime Declaration of Health. The Master is responsible for the accuracy of these documents; a missing or false declaration leads to customs fines and delays. Since 2024 many ports require electronic declarations through a Maritime Single Window.
IMO MSC.428(98) kararı uyarınca gemi sib: Under IMO Resolution MSC.428(98), cyber risk management on ships must be addressed within the ISM Code. Remote access must be protected by authorisation, firewalls and network segmentation.
IMO Resolution MSC.428(98) ile geminin G: Under IMO Resolution MSC.428(98), the ship's Safety Management System (SMS) must address cyber risk management; MSC-FAL.1/Circ.3 recommends the identify-protect-detect-respond-recover framework. The ETO implements the technical cyber controls on board: access control, update management, monitoring and incident response.
IMO Resolution MSC.428(98), geminin Güve: IMO Resolution MSC.428(98) requires the ship's Safety Management System (under the ISM Code) to include cyber risk management. MSC-FAL.1/Circ.3 recommends five functions in parallel with the NIST framework: identify, protect, detect, respond, recover. The ETO implements and documents the technical controls of this framework.
IMO tarafından belirlenen özel değişim b: Special exchange areas designated by IMO may also be used.
IMPA (International Marine Purchasing As: The IMPA (International Marine Purchasing Association) catalog is the common language of ship supply. Using IMPA codes prevents the supplier from sending the wrong part. The Bosun knows these codes for frequently used items or has access to the catalog.
IMPA/IMO posterindeki uyarılara rağmen \: Despite the warnings on the IMPA/IMO poster, non-compliant practices such as "securing the steps with shackles", "unsuitable combination arrangements" and "securing with magnetic chocks" have led to accidents. The AB must correct any non-compliance they see or report it to the officer; the pilot has the right to refuse.
IMSBC, dökme yükleri sıvılaşabilir (Grou: The IMSBC Code divides bulk cargoes into cargoes that may liquefy (Group A), cargoes with chemical hazards (Group B) and low-risk cargoes (Group C). With Group A cargoes (nickel ore, iron ore fines, bauxite fines), if the moisture content is above the TML (Transportable Moisture Limit), the cargo may liquefy and capsize the ship. The Chief Officer questions the TML/moisture declaration; if in doubt, loading is refused.
IOPP (Annex I), ISPP (Annex IV), IAPP ve: The IOPP (Annex I), ISPP (Annex IV), IAPP and IEEC (Annex VI) and EIAPP (for engines) certificates are subject to the cycle of initial, annual, intermediate and renewal surveys. The Master makes sure that the certificates are valid at a PSC inspection and that the supplements (equipment lists) match the equipment on board.
IPM, sürekli izlemeye dayanır: düzenli g: IPM is based on continuous monitoring: signs of pests are detected early through regular visual inspection. The signs looked for are droppings, gnaw marks, greasy rub marks (rodent runs), egg cases/larvae, dead insects, odor and consumption of traps/bait. The cook checks the galley and stores weekly (more often if necessary) and records the findings. Early detection deals with a small presence before it becomes an established infestation.
IS Code yolcu gemileri için passenger cr: For passenger ships, the IS Code contains heeling moment criteria for passenger crowding (passengers gathering on one side) and for turning. The weight of passengers and their luggage is taken into account on standard assumptions.
ISM (safety) ve ISPS (security) SOLAS'ın: Although ISM (safety) and ISPS (security) derive from different chapters of SOLAS (Chapters IX and XI-2), they should be operated on board as a single integrated management system. The risk assessment methodology, document control, audit logic, corrective action cycle and record-keeping discipline are the same in both. Many companies combine these two systems (sometimes together with MLC and ISO 14001 environmental management) under a single integrated management manual. The Master ensures that these systems work not as separate silos but as a single discipline.
ISM Code 16 madde üzerine kuruludur; bun: The ISM Code is built on 16 sections, covering subjects such as the company policy (section 2), company responsibilities (section 3), the Designated Person Ashore — DPA (section 4), the Master's responsibility and authority (section 5), resources and personnel (section 6), development of plans for shipboard operations (section 7), emergency preparedness (section 8), reporting of non-conformities, accidents and hazardous occurrences (section 9), maintenance (section 10), documentation (section 11) and company verification, review and evaluation (section 12). For the Master, section 5 (Master's Responsibility and Authority) and section 9 (reporting) are the backbone of daily practice.
ISM Code Eleman 8, gemilerin olası acil: ISM Code Element 8 requires ships to identify potential emergencies, establish response procedures and hold regular drills. For machinery-related scenarios, the Chief Engineer ensures that these procedures are up to date, realistic and known by the team.
ISM Code Element 10, şirketin gemi ve ek: ISM Code Element 10 requires the company to keep the ship and its equipment in a condition that complies with the approved rules and company procedures. This includes regular inspection of critical equipment, back-up arrangements in case of sudden failure, and record keeping. PMS software (AMOS, ShipManager, BASSnet, TM Master, etc.) digitizes this requirement through a job/component hierarchy.
ISM Code gereği her geminin kritik ekipm: Under the ISM Code every ship must have a list of critical equipment. This list is prepared on the basis of a risk assessment.
ISM Code madde 11, SMS kapsamındaki tüm: ISM Code section 11 requires all documents within the SMS to be current, valid and checked by authorised persons. The removal of invalid or superseded documents, the controlled document list and the tracking of revisions are run under the Master's supervision. Document control discipline is a main focus area in internal and external ISM audits.
ISM Code madde 4, her şirketin bir veya: ISM Code section 4 requires every company to designate one or more Designated Persons Ashore (DPA). The DPA has two critical features: direct access to the highest level of management, and the task of monitoring the safety and pollution prevention aspects of the ship's operation. The DPA builds a bridge between the Master and the highest level of the company's management; it is a safety line independent of the commercial line (operations, chartering). This independence is designed to stop commercial pressure from overriding safety decisions.
ISM Code madde 6, şirketin geminin \"uyg: ISM Code section 6 requires the company to ensure that the ship is manned with "qualified, certificated and medically fit" seafarers. The person who applies this section on board is the Master: it is the Master's responsibility to verify that every crew member is competent for his or her duties, holds the required certificates and has been properly familiarised before starting work.
ISM Code ve SOLAS gereği düzenli tatbika: Regular drills required by the ISM Code and SOLAS: fire drill (monthly), abandon ship, enclosed space entry & rescue (every 2 months), black-out / emergency generator (monthly), steering gear failure and oil spill (SOPEP). The Chief Engineer ensures that engine room scenarios are realistic and varied; after each drill, a debrief is held and improvements are recorded.
ISM Code ve şirketin SMS (Safety Managem: The environmental procedures within the ISM Code and the company's SMS (Safety Management System) add company standards on top of MARPOL. Companies with a "no discharge" policy prohibit the discharge of certain wastes into the sea even where it is legally permitted. The Chief Officer passes these policies on to the crew and enforces them.
ISM Code'un 10. maddesi, şirketten gemin: Section 10 of the ISM Code requires the company to establish procedures to ensure that the ship and its equipment are maintained in conformity with the relevant rules and regulations and with any additional requirements established by the company. The PMS is the practical application of this section. Within the SMS (Safety Management System), it is defined which equipment is to be maintained, at what interval, with which procedure and by whom.
ISM Code'un 5. maddesi, şirket SMS'inde: Section 5 of the ISM Code requires the company's SMS to define the Master's duties clearly, to give the Master the authority to implement the SMS on board and report deviations to the company, and to confirm the "overriding authority" in writing. Every Master joining a ship carries the company's Master's Standing Orders and Master's Review procedures on board, signed; these documents are checked in internal audits.
ISM Code, gemi işletmecisinin (Company): The ISM Code requires the ship operator (the Company) and the ship to establish and maintain a safety management system (SMS).
ISM Code, şirketin bir Safety Management: The ISM Code requires the company to establish a Safety Management System (SMS) and implement it on board. The main actors of the system in the field are the Master (the highest shipboard authority under ISM), the Designated Person Ashore (DPA) and the shipboard Safety Officer. The Safety Officer is usually the Chief Officer and is the person who keeps the safety system "alive".
ISM Code, şirketin personelin görevlerin: The ISM Code requires the Company to ensure that personnel are familiarized so that they can perform their duties safely. The Safety Officer carries out this responsibility on board: meets the new joiner, shows the critical information, confirms that it has been understood and keeps a signed record. The principle is not "I told them" but "I showed them and confirmed it".
ISM Code, şirketten emniyetli işletim iç: The ISM Code requires the company to establish "safe practices" and a "safe working environment" for safe operation (section 1.2.2). A person under the influence of drugs or alcohol is a direct danger both to himself or herself and to the ship; for this reason almost every company's SMS contains a separate drug and alcohol policy. The Master is the "person in charge" responsible for actually applying this policy on board; under ISM section 5 the Master is required to implement the SMS on board and report deviations to the DPA.
ISM iç denetimleri, şirketin SMS'inin ge: ISM internal audits verify that the company's SMS is implemented on board. The Chief Officer demonstrates that deck procedures (cargo, mooring, PTW, drills, environment) are carried out in accordance with the SMS. Findings are recorded as a non-conformity (NC) or an observation.
ISM kapsamında \"critical equipment\" li: Under ISM, a "critical equipment" list is defined: main engine, steering gear, generators, emergency generator, fire/bilge pumps, IGS, maneuvering equipment. Maintenance of this equipment cannot be postponed; alternative/standby arrangements (standby pump, second supply line) must have been tested for use in the event of failure. The Second Engineer marks the work orders for critical items as "high priority".
ISM madde 12, şirketin SMS'i en az yılda: ISM section 12 requires the company to verify the SMS by internal audit at least once a year. These audits are carried out by (trained) internal auditors independent of the area being audited. On the ship's side, the Master ensures that records are ready for the audit, procedures have been applied and the team can answer questions. The internal audit should be positioned as a tool for "improvement", not "punishment"; otherwise findings are hidden and the system goes blind.
ISM madde 8, şirketin olası acil durumla: ISM section 8 requires the company to identify potential emergencies (fire, collision, grounding, flooding, pollution, man overboard, abandon ship, security incident, etc.) and to prepare a response plan for each. These plans are on board as the Emergency Response / Contingency Manual and are documents to which the Master has daily access and which the Master knows by heart. Each plan must clearly set out the command structure, roles, communication flow and initial response steps.
ISM rejiminde iki belge vardır: şirkete: The ISM regime has two documents: the company's Document of Compliance (DOC) and the ship's Safety Management Certificate (SMC). The SMC on board is valid only as long as the company holds a valid DOC; the Master must verify that a certified copy of the DOC is on board and that the ship type is listed in the scope of the DOC (e.g. if it says "bulk carrier", the ship cannot trade as a tanker).
ISM uygulama eksikleri, LSA/FFA kondisyo: Gaps in ISM implementation, the condition of LSA and FFA, and ECDIS and navigation records are frequent findings; they are corrected beforehand through internal audits.
ISM ve ISPS, denetimde \"kağıt göstermek: ISM and ISPS do not exist for "showing paper" in an inspection; they live as a system that protects the crew, the ship and the environment when an accident or a security incident happens on board. The strength of this system comes from the Master owning it not as a bureaucratic burden but as a discipline and a just culture that support his or her decisions. Certificates may hang on the wall; but what really makes ISM/ISPS work is the honest reporting, document discipline and the culture that rewards the courage to "stop work", which the Master builds every day.
ISM ve güvenlik prosedürlerini öğrenmek,: Learning ISM and safety procedures turns the deck cadet into a seafarer who does not merely "apply the rules" but "understands why they are applied". Risk-based thinking, permit discipline and an open reporting culture lay the foundation for the cadet to become a safe officer in the future.
ISO 8217 standardı Al+Si toplamını maksi: The ISO 8217 standard limits the Al+Si total to a maximum of 60 ppm. Engine makers aim for below 15 ppm in the fuel entering the engine.
ISPS Code iki bölümden oluşur: Part A zo: The ISPS Code has two parts: Part A contains the mandatory requirements and Part B the recommendatory guidance (although many flag states also make Part B mandatory). The key players are the CSO (Company Security Officer, ashore), the SSO (Ship Security Officer, usually a deck officer) and the PFSO (Port Facility Security Officer). The Master is the SSO's superior and has overall responsibility for the security of the ship.
ISPS Code kapsamında gemi güvenlik siste: Under the ISPS Code, the ship's security systems (Ship Security Alert System — SSAS, door access control, intrusion alarm) are also within the ETO's technical remit. When activated covertly, the SSAS sends a silent alert to the company and the competent authorities; the ETO tests the battery and the communication path of this system, but coordinates tests with the authorities (a false alert has serious consequences).
ISPS Code kapsamında gemi, güvenlik sevi: Under the ISPS Code the ship applies the Ship Security Plan (SSP) according to the security level (1-2-3). The Master and the SSO arrange access control, monitoring of restricted areas, the security of cargo and stores, and the management of visitors. Changes of security level are recorded.
ISPS Code çerçevesinde gemide Ship Secur: Under the ISPS Code there is a Ship Security Officer (SSO) on board and a Company Security Officer (CSO) ashore. The Master coordinates with the SSO and CSO on security matters; but the ISPS Code (and SOLAS XI-2/8) makes clear that no one may constrain the decisions the Master considers necessary for the safety and security of the ship. The Security Level (1/2/3) is set by the flag or coastal state; a change of level is passed to the ship at once and the appropriate measures (access control, patrols, restricted areas) are stepped up.
ISPS üç güvenlik seviyesi tanımlar. Sevi: The ISPS Code defines three security levels. Level 1 (normal): minimum appropriate protective measures are maintained at all times. Level 2 (heightened): additional protective measures are maintained for a period of time because of a heightened risk. Level 3 (exceptional): further specific protective measures are maintained for a limited period when a security incident is probable or imminent. The security level is set by the flag state or the port state authorities; the ship applies the higher of the level of the port it is in and the level set by its own flag.
ISSC için de benzer mantık geçerlidir: g: A similar logic applies to the ISSC: an approved ship security plan (SSP) and working CSO/PFSO coordination are the foundation of the ISSC. When an inspector at PSC sees the SMC, he or she tests the question "is the SMS really working on board?" with the near-miss records, the drill records and the closure rates of corrective actions. What is inspected is not the certificate hanging on the wall but whether the system behind it is alive.
IT (Information Technology) sistemleri v: IT (Information Technology) systems manage data: e-mail, administrative software, reporting. OT (Operational Technology) systems control physical processes: ECDIS, IAS/AMS (automation/alarm), propulsion control, steering, cargo control, ballast. An IT breach causes data loss, whereas an OT breach directly threatens navigational and machinery safety; this is why OT security is a matter of safety of life.
IT (izole nötr) sistemde tek toprak kaça: In an IT (isolated neutral) system, a single earth fault gives an alarm and a second fault causes a trip.
IT sistemde jeneratör nötr noktası gemi: In an IT system the generator neutral point is not connected directly to the ship's hull (earth). In this way a single phase-to-earth fault does not complete the circuit and the system keeps working. However, if a second fault occurs, a two-phase short circuit results.
IT sistemde tek faz toprak kaçağında dev: In an IT system, a single phase-to-earth fault does not complete the circuit, so no current flows and the system keeps working. The insulation monitoring device (IMD) detects the falling insulation resistance and gives an alarm. If a fault occurs on a second phase, a short circuit between the two phases results.
Immersion suit (su geçirmez kurtarma elb: An immersion suit delays hypothermia in cold water. It is subject to a seam air pressure test at intervals not exceeding 3 years (more often for suits over 10 years old) and to regular visual inspection; the zipper is waxed with paraffin and the neoprene is checked for cracks. As a rule, SOLAS requires an immersion suit for every person on board cargo ships.
In-water survey, klas onayıyla bazı sörv: With class approval, an in-water survey allows some surveys to be carried out while the ship is afloat and can extend the drydock interval. Propeller polishing and hull cleaning reduce friction and save fuel. The Chief Engineer coordinates both the technical and the safety aspects of these operations.
Incinerator (IMO type-approved), sludge: The incinerator (IMO type-approved) burns sludge and solid waste. Its use is restricted in special areas and inside ports, and also under certain distance rules. The correct operating temperature (combustion chamber usually 850°C+), the difficulty of burning sludge with a high water content, and flue gas quality are managed. Incinerator running hours and the quantity burned are recorded.
Incinerator flame failure trip arızalıys: If the incinerator flame failure trip is faulty, unburnt fuel can accumulate and explode.
Incinerator kullanımı Annex VI ve Annex: Use of the incinerator falls under both Annex VI and Annex V; incineration of certain wastes (e.g. PVC, cargo residues) is prohibited, and operation of the incinerator may be restricted in ports and Special Areas. The Chief Officer coordinates the incineration records with the GRB.
Incinerator çalışırken flame failure tri: While the incinerator is running, the flame failure trip and the emission limits (MARPOL Annex VI) are monitored.
Incompatible yakıt comingling, asphalten: Commingling incompatible fuels forms heavy sludge through asphaltene flocculation; it clogs the purifiers and filters and causes a blackout through fuel starvation. A compatibility spot test and keeping new batches in a separate tank are the basic protection.
Independent overfill alarm (IOA): yüksek: Independent overfill alarm (IOA): gives an alarm at high level independently of the main system.
Indicator diagram (PV diyagramı), silind: The indicator diagram (PV diagram) shows how cylinder pressure varies with cylinder volume (piston position) and is the most accurate evidence of combustion quality. Instead of the traditional mechanical indicator, electronic PMI (Pressure Measurement Indicator) systems or permanently fitted cylinder pressure sensors are used today. The Second Engineer takes these measurements at set intervals (generally weekly/fortnightly).
Inert (oksijensiz, HC'li) bir tank doğru: If an inerted tank (no oxygen, containing hydrocarbons) is ventilated directly with air, the hydrocarbon concentration passes through the flammable range (the critical dilution line) on its way from rich to lean, and because oxygen is also entering, a flammable atmosphere forms. To prevent this, the tank is first purged with inert gas until the hydrocarbon content is well below the flammable limit (e.g. less than 2% by volume); only then is air introduced.
Inmarsat terminalinin (FleetBroadband vb: Commissioning of the Inmarsat terminal (FleetBroadband, etc.), its subscription status and the distress priority test are also items the Second Officer must monitor. The procedure for sending a distress alert via Inmarsat must be clearly accessible from the terminal menu.
Inmarsat-C gerçek zamanlı ses taşımaz; m: Inmarsat-C does not carry real-time voice; it packages messages and sends and receives them by the store-and-forward method. A low data rate is sufficient because it is designed for distress alerts and telex/email-type text. The antenna is small and omnidirectional (it needs no pointing).
Inmarsat-C, jeostatik (GEO) uydular üzer: Inmarsat-C works through geostationary (GEO) satellites; the ship terminal connects to the satellite and the satellite to a land earth station (LES). The NCS (Network Coordination Station) manages network traffic. GEO satellites cover the area between about 70°N and 70°S (A3); the poles (A4) are outside coverage.
Inspect ropes for abrasion, cuts, intern: Inspect ropes for abrasion, cuts, internal damage, heat or friction damage, chemical exposure and deterioration. Assess findings against the maker’s criteria and service history; identify and withdraw suspect equipment as required. Store ropes clean and protected from damaging surfaces, contamination and unsuitable environmental conditions.
Inspection bulguları (yatak durumu, ölçü: Inspection findings (bearing condition, measurements, photographs) are recorded and the trend is followed. Recurring heating of a bearing or increasing particles require a root cause investigation and planned intervention. These records are the basis for making decisions before a major failure.
Inspection, motor durdurulmuş, soğutulmu: The inspection is carried out with the engine stopped, cooled down and isolated by LOTO, and with the turning gear engaged/locked. Entry into the crankcase is subject to the enclosed space and hot surface rules. Naked flames/sources of sparks are kept away. The Second Engineer verifies all of these steps.
Insulation Monitoring Device (IMD), izol: The Insulation Monitoring Device (IMD) continuously measures the phase-to-earth insulation resistance of an insulated network and gives an alarm when it falls below the set threshold. The ETO never ignores an IMD alarm; it may be the first and only warning of a developing earth fault. After the alarm, the faulty consumer is isolated by the branch-by-branch method.
Insulation monitoring device (IMD) bara-: The insulation monitoring device (IMD) continuously measures the insulation resistance between the busbar and the hull. It gives an alarm when the value falls below the threshold.
Insulation monitoring device (IMD) sürek: The insulation monitoring device (IMD) continuously measures the insulation resistance between the lines and the hull. Low insulation gives an alarm.
Intact stabilite, GZ (righting arm) eğri: Intact stability is verified by the GZ (righting arm) curve meeting the IS Code 2008 criteria: GZ ≥ 0.20 m at 30°, angle of maximum GZ ≥ 25° (preferably 30°), area from 0-30° ≥ 0.055 m·rad, area from 0-40° ≥ 0.090 m·rad and initial GM ≥ 0.15 m. The weather criterion (severe wind and rolling) measures the ship's resistance to capsizing under wind and rolling.
Integrated Automation System (IAS), tüm: The Integrated Automation System (IAS) brings all machinery and auxiliary systems together on a single monitoring/control platform. The Alarm and Monitoring System (AMS) collects data from sensors, compares it with the alarm setpoints and gives the operator visual/audible alarms. The ETO must know the network topology, redundancy architecture and I/O distribution of these systems.
Interface/bridging document ile prosedür: Differences in procedures and SMS are closed through an interface (bridging) document. Communication channels, call signs, alert words, the action on loss of communication and joint emergencies are agreed.
Internal ramp: güverteler arası araç har: Internal ramp: fixed or movable ramps for vehicle movement between decks.
Internal test cihazın iç devrelerini kon: The internal test checks the internal circuits of the equipment; a weekly DSC test call is made to verify the actual transmit and receive chain. The MF/HF DSC sends a routine test call to a coast station and waits for an automatic acknowledgement (ACK). Receiving the ACK proves that the whole chain, including the antenna, is working.
Inventory güncellemesi; kullanılan, boşa: The inventory update brings the count of used, emptied or replaced items up to date and adds missing items to the replenishment list. This list forms the basis for port call and service planning.
Irgat bakımı; dişli kutusu yağ seviyesi/: Windlass maintenance covers the gearbox oil level and analysis, the thickness of the band brake lining, hydraulic pressure tests, greasing of the clutch and shaft bearings and checking the wear of the gypsy. A weekly running test and an annual detailed inspection are defined in the PMS (Planned Maintenance System).
Isochronous mode: Frekans sabit tutulur;: Isochronous mode: the frequency is kept constant; the load is shared equally by the load sharing controller.
Isı, yüksek sıcaklıktan düşük sıcaklığa: Heat is conducted from high temperature to low temperature. For one-dimensional steady conduction:
Isıl işlem (tavlama, sertleştirme, menev: Heat treatment (annealing, hardening, tempering) is planned according to these critical temperatures.
Isıtma serpantininde delik olursa yakıt/: If a heating coil is holed, fuel or cargo leaks into the condensate and carries oil to the boiler (oil contamination); this causes foaming and carryover in the boiler and is dangerous. Oil traces are watched for in the condensate observation tank; contaminated condensate is not taken into the boiler but dumped.
Izgara ve salamander yüzeyleri yağ birik: Grill and salamander surfaces are prone to grease build-up; they are scraped and cleaned after each service. In bain-maries and hot-holding units, the water level and the thermostat are checked; running dry burns out the heating element. As the surfaces of all this equipment are in contact with food, they are cleaned with food-safe products and rinsed if necessary.
JX ve DP 0 sistemleri, DP 1, DP 2 ve DP: The JX and DP 0 systems are based on the same distributed architecture as the DP 1, DP 2 and DP 3 systems. This arrangement allows the hardware components to be placed in practical locations: each interface unit (IO hardware) is placed near the thrusters, rudders, engines and sensors to which it is connected, reducing cabling and installation costs.
JX ve DP 0 sistemlerinde de aynı düzen g: The same arrangement applies to the JX and DP 0 systems: the IO hardware is placed near the thrusters, rudders, engines and sensors it interfaces, reducing cabling and installation costs.
Jacket cooling water düşüşü kompresyon r: A drop in jacket cooling water creates severe thermal shock in the compression rings and the liner. Immediate action: reduce load gradually, look for the cause (pump trip, expansion tank dry, tube leak), stop if necessary. Re-cooling must be done slowly; otherwise the liner will crack.
Jacket cooling water, piston cooling oil: Jacket cooling water, piston cooling oil and the cylinder lube oil dosage (feed rate) are monitored. On modern engines, the cylinder oil feed rate is adjusted to the sulfur content of the fuel; overdosing high-BN oil on low-sulfur fuel leaves deposits, while underdosing on high-sulfur fuel leads to corrosion.
Jacket water sıcaklığı yeterli olduğunda: The evaporator is started when the jacket water temperature is high enough (e.g. above 50°C); salinity is monitored with the salinometer (e.g. below 10 ppm). Production is stopped in port and near the coast because of contamination.
Jeneratör kapasitesinin aşılması durumun: If the generator capacity is exceeded, non-essential consumers are disconnected in stages. Order of priority: air-conditioning compressors → deck cranes → provision refrigeration → galley equipment. Consumers required by SOLAS, such as the navigation lights, steering gear and bilge pumps, are never cut off.
Jeneratör motorlarında sabit devir (frek: Generator engines need a constant speed (frequency); the governor therefore keeps the speed constant by adjusting the fuel as the load changes. On propulsion engines the governor sets the speed according to the operator's command. With generators in parallel, load sharing is managed through the governor droop setting.
Jeneratör nötr noktası gövdeye doğrudan: The generator neutral point is not connected directly to the hull. With a single-phase earth fault the circuit is not completed, so no current flows and the system keeps working.
Jeneratör tahrik ederek gemi elektrik ih: It drives a generator to meet the ship's electrical demand. These are four-stroke medium- or high-speed engines. A ship usually has 3–4 of them; 1–2 are run at sea and 2–3 in port.
Jeneratör verimi çıkış gücünün giriş güc: Generator efficiency is the ratio of output power to input power. The losses consist of copper losses, iron losses, mechanical losses and windage losses.
Jeneratör yükü belirli bir eşiği (tipik: When the generator load exceeds a set threshold (typically 90–110%), the PMS starts the preferential tripping sequence. The lowest-priority consumers are cut off first; if the load is still high, the next stage follows.
Jeneratör yükü, kazan buhar basıncı, hav: Generator load, boiler steam pressure, air receiver pressure, cooling water temperatures and the sea water cooling system differential pressure (an indicator of filter clogging) are read regularly. On modern ships, the Alarm and Monitoring System (AMS) logs these values continuously; the cadet learns to read the trend displays.
Jeneratör; reverse power, over-current,: The generator has reverse power, over-current, over/under-voltage and over/under-frequency protection. The cadet learns how these protections safeguard the electrical system and the generator. In addition, cooling water, oil pressure and exhaust temperature alarms protect the engine side.
Jib (bom) vinçler: Döner kol üzerinde ha: Jib cranes: a rope system moving on a slewing jib. Common on general cargo ships.
Jiroskopik prensiple çalışan pusula, dün: A compass working on the gyroscopic principle aligns itself with the earth's axis of rotation and points to true north. Its error (gyro error) is small and can be corrected.
Junior bir zabit için sınırlar daha dar: For a junior officer, the limits are kept narrower and the principle "when in doubt, hold and call" is emphasized. Greater independence is given to an experienced Second/Third Engineer. The orders must clearly reflect this difference.
Just-in-time arrival (limanda demir bekl: Just-in-time arrival (arriving at optimum speed instead of waiting at anchor off the port) saves both fuel and emissions. The Chief Engineer adapts the main engine's low-load efficiency (de-rating, tuning) to this profile.
Kablo kesiti belirlenirken akım taşıma k: When choosing the cable cross-section, current-carrying capacity, voltage drop and short-circuit withstand are taken into account.
Kademeli geçiş, her adımda geminin tepki: A gradual changeover makes it possible to observe the ship's response at each step and to verify it before moving on to the next. Changing over directly to fully automatic mode means that a faulty thruster response or a wrong reference is noticed only after the position has started to drift.
Kademeli geçiş: 2024'te %40, 2025'te %70: Phase-in: surrender of allowances for 40% of emissions in 2024, 70% in 2025 and 100% in 2026.
Kadet eğitimi ayrı bir sorumluluktur: Tr: Cadet training is a separate responsibility: Training Record Book (TRB) tasks are signed off according to a plan, and the cadet takes part in real operations under supervision. The Chief Officer monitors both the theoretical and the practical development of the cadet.
