Kemirgen izleme/mücadelesi için bait sta: For rodent monitoring/control, bait stations and mechanical/sticky traps are placed along rodent runs (along the base of walls, in corners, at store entrances) according to a designated layout plan. The stations are numbered and checked regularly; consumption/catches are recorded. Toxic bait is not used on food preparation surfaces; stations are placed at safe points away from food and out of reach.
Kemirgenlerin gemiye en yaygın giriş yol: The most common way for rodents to get on board is via the mooring lines and the ramp/gangway in port. Therefore, when the ship is moored in port, rat guards (cone- or disc-shaped barriers) are correctly fitted on all mooring lines; the guard must be positioned and oriented so as to stop rodents climbing along the line. In addition, the gangway is lit at night, holds/doors are closed and no open food is left on the ramp.
Kendi sigortacı/kulüp surveyor'larıyla t: Full cooperation is given to the surveyors of the ship's own insurer and club. Reasonable access is given to the other party's surveyor, but statements and documents are shared under the direction of the company and the P&I club; giving uncontrolled statements to the other party's surveyor can create evidence against the ship. The Master records every surveyor visit: whom the surveyor represents, what was examined and what was documented.
Kestirimci bakım, büyük veri analizi, ma: Predictive maintenance models the behaviour of equipment and detects anomalies using big data analysis, machine learning algorithms and digital twin technologies.
Kimyasal dozajlı sistemler: peraset asit: Chemical dosing systems: work by dosing peracetic acid or chlorine dioxide; a reserve of chemicals is stocked.
Kimyasal elleçlerken kamarot uygun KKD (: When handling chemicals, the steward uses suitable PPE (gloves and, if necessary, goggles) and ensures ventilation. A spill is cleaned up in accordance with the SDS. Concentrated chemicals are diluted in the correct ratio; incorrect use causes both skin/respiratory harm and surface damage.
Kimyasal göz/cilt temasında derhal bol s: In case of chemical contact with the eyes/skin, the area is washed immediately with plenty of water (eye wash/shower), the first-aid instructions in the MSDS are followed and the person in charge of medical care is informed. In a serious injury, the scene is first made safe (energy isolation) and only then is the casualty attended to; a second victim must not be created.
Kimyasal seçimi gelişigüzel yapılmaz; ba: Chemicals are not chosen at random; some oxygen scavengers have health and environmental restrictions. They are dosed only according to the approved treatment programme and the SDS.
Kimyasal tankerlerde NLS, X/Y/Z/OS kateg: On chemical tankers, NLS are divided into categories X, Y, Z and OS. The discharge of tank washing residues is managed with the P&A (Procedures and Arrangements) Manual and the Cargo Record Book. For cargoes requiring a prewash, the operation is carried out in the presence of a surveyor. The Master checks the accuracy of the Cargo Record Book entries.
Kimyasalların depolanması güvenlik kural: The storage of chemicals is subject to safety rules; flammable solvents are kept in a ventilated place away from heat/sparks. Incompatible chemicals are stored separately. Empty containers are disposed of properly.
Kirlenme (fouling) U değerini düşürür; p: Fouling reduces the U value; a fall in performance is noticed by a rise in the outlet temperature.
Kirli veya yetersiz yıkanmış tabak-çatal: Dirty or inadequately washed plates and cutlery are a direct route of contamination to the mouth. A cutting board washed incorrectly can carry pathogens from raw meat to cooked food. Dishwashing is therefore not just "removing dirt" but a food safety process, and it must be done by the correct method (wash → rinse → sanitize).
Kirlilik düzeyi ayrıştırmanın kritik boy: The degree of soiling is a critical aspect of sorting. Laundry from sick crew members, textiles contaminated with blood/body fluids and oily clothes from the galley/deck are collected separately and processed separately. This separation prevents cross-contamination and the spread of infection. Pockets are checked before items go into the washing machine; a forgotten lighter, pen or metal object can ruin both the laundry and the machine.
Kirlilik olayında SOPEP/SMPEP devreye gi: In a pollution incident the SOPEP/SMPEP comes into effect; the coastal state, the port authority and P&I are informed at once. In US waters, under OPA 90, notifying the QI (Qualified Individual) and the OSRO is time-critical; delay multiplies the penalty. In the first report the Master uses the framework "estimated quantity, source, measures taken, assistance needed".
Kite: Geminin pruvasından uçurulan büyük: Kite: a large kite flown from the ship's bow. It catches the strong winds at high altitude. There is a commercial application by Airseas (Seawing).
Kişisel hijyen kritiktir: el yıkama (öze: Personal hygiene is critical: hand washing (especially after using the toilet and before service), short clean nails, removal of jewelry, a hairnet and a clean uniform. A steward who is ill or has symptoms of infection (diarrhea, vomiting) must not serve food and must report the condition; a foodborne outbreak can paralyze the ship.
Klas continuous survey, PSC ve vetting (: PMS records are examined at class continuous surveys, PSC inspections and vetting (SIRE/CDI) inspections. Inconsistent dates, "completed" entries without evidence, accumulated overdue jobs and unrecorded bypasses are typical findings. Before an inspection, the Second Engineer reviews the PMS together with the Chief Engineer and closes any gaps.
Klas kuruluşları (DNV, Lloyd's, Bureau V: Classification societies (DNV, Lloyd's Register, Bureau Veritas) accept RCM-based maintenance plans. Applying RCM makes it possible to move from traditional calendar-based maintenance to condition-based maintenance, which reduces unnecessary dismantling and costs.
Klas kuruluşları belirli kritik ekipmanl: Classification societies require a minimum stock of spare parts for certain critical equipment. These are called "mandatory spares" and are checked in class surveys.
Klas kuruluşları kritik ekipman için con: Classification societies may require condition monitoring or enhanced preventive maintenance for critical equipment.
Klas onaylı PMS-CM (Planned Maintenance: In class-approved PMS-CM (Planned Maintenance and Condition Monitoring) systems, the survey items (continuous machinery survey) are linked directly to the PMS. Maintenance of an item is carried out under the supervision of the authorized engineer (the Chief Engineer), and the record is submitted to the class surveyor for acceptance. The Second Engineer ensures that the evidence for these items (photographs, measurements, clearance values) is collected in full.
Klas survey öncesi, zorunlu (mandatory): Before a class survey, the mandatory spares list is verified by a physical count, and urgent replenishment is started for any missing items. Spare parts to be used during the survey (e.g. a new spindle/seat for an exhaust valve to be overhauled) are brought on board in advance; otherwise the survey is postponed and cost/off-hire increase.
Klas, reversible ana makineler için hava: For reversible main engines, class requires the air receivers to provide a certain number (typically 12) of consecutive starts without being recharged. Usually there are two independent compressors and two air receivers; if one fails, the other maintains the starting capability.
Klas; annual, intermediate, special (5 y: Class verifies the ship's structural integrity and equipment through annual, intermediate, special (5-yearly) and drydock surveys. On the deck side, hatch cover ultrasonic tests, structural examination of holds, mooring equipment, crane/derrick load tests and anchor/chain measurements come up. Before the survey, the Chief Officer prepares the relevant areas so that they are accessible and clean.
Klasik bir baş gemi (forecastle) bakım p: A classic forecastle maintenance program: days 1-2 chipping (removing existing rust + flaking paint), days 3-4 finish surface preparation with ST 3 power tools, day 5 primer, day 6 intermediate coat, days 7-8 topcoat. Application is staged according to the weather and the likelihood of sea spray.
Klasik derik sistemi (union purchase/yum: The classic derrick system (union purchase) works by two derrick booms in fixed positions carrying the load with ropes; it is cheap but slow and limited. Modern ship cranes are slewing hydraulic jib or knuckle-boom cranes that give fast and precise cargo handling with a single operator.
Klasik mekanik indicator card (PVT cihaz: The Pmax, Pcomp, Pexp, MIP (Mean Indicated Pressure) and IHP of each cylinder are measured with a conventional mechanical indicator card (PVT device) or a modern electronic PMI (Pressure Measurement Indicator). At least two measurements per voyage (loaded and ballast) are recommended.
Klasik weathertight testi, kapalı kapağa: The classic weathertightness test is to spray water at the closed cover at a given pressure and distance and see whether it leaks inside. However, it is difficult to apply with the hold full of cargo or in cold weather.
Klasik yaklaşımda tüm sinyaller köprüüst: In the classic approach, all signals are brought to a central cabinet on the bridge. In Bridge Mate, the thruster and sensor interface units are distributed as well as the operator stations and DP control computers. These units are built on a stand-alone IO unit designed specifically for use on DP ships.
Klavye, baş seçici (heading selector) ve: Operator devices such as a keyboard, a heading selector and a joystick are available as appropriate for operating the system. Any workstation can be selected for any application at any time.
Klor çok düşükse dezenfeksiyon güvencesi: If chlorine is too low, the assurance of disinfection is lost (super-chlorination/dosage adjustment is required); if it is too high, there are taste/odor problems. Measuring points should also cover the farthest/least favorable points from the tank; looking only at the source is misleading. In the event of a deviation, the dosage is corrected in coordination with the technical team.
Klorür değerinde ani artış, cooler'da bi: A sudden rise in the chloride value indicates a seawater leak in a cooler and is investigated. A seawater leak both accelerates corrosion and reduces cooling efficiency; early detection prevents major damage.
Klorür trendi condenser/deniz suyu kaçağ: A chloride trend can show a condenser or seawater leak; the acceptance and blowdown limits are the values of the water treatment supplier and the maker's manual.
Koaksiyel konnektörlerde (PL259, N-tipi,: Corrosion and moisture are the most common causes of failure in coaxial connectors (PL259, N-type, TNC). The ETO waterproofs external connectors with self-amalgamating tape, replaces cables that have taken in moisture and keeps terminal panels clean and tight. Most signal quality problems come from bad connectors, not from the equipment.
Koku, çoğu zaman bir düzen/temizlik prob: Odor is often the first sign of a housekeeping/cleaning problem: garbage left standing, a blocked bilge/sink or spoiled products. The cook uses odor as a diagnostic tool, finding and eliminating the source. Regular emptying, lidded containers and daily floor cleaning keep both odor and pests under control.
Kombine sistem (ST + PT) toplam motorun: A combined system (ST + PT) can recover 8–11% of the engine's total fuel energy.
Kombine sistem: Hem buhar türbini hem gü: Combined system: a steam turbine and a power turbine are used together.
Kombine windlass/mooring winch, hem zinc: A combined windlass/mooring winch has both the chain wheel and a rope drum on the same shaft. It saves space and cost.
Kompozit kazan, ateş borulu bölüm (oil-f: A composite boiler consists of two sections: a fire-tube section (oil-fired) and an economiser section (exhaust gas). Both sections share a common steam space and water space.
Kompresör haritası basınç oranı-debi gra: The compressor map is a graph of pressure ratio against flow. It contains the surge line (on the left), the choke line (on the right) and the efficiency islands.
Kompresör kademeleri arasında ara soğutm: Intercooling between the compressor stages and aftercooling are provided. There is an automatic drain (auto-drain) at the outlet of each stage.
Kompresör kapasitesi, hava dağıtım borul: Compressor capacity, air distribution piping, the control system and energy consumption must be taken into account. The energy consumed by the compressors must be deducted from the net saving.
Kompresör sonrası soğutucu (after-cooler: The aftercooler after the compressor separates the condensed water; a dryer (refrigerated or desiccant) then removes the moisture by lowering the dew point. Oil and particle filters (coalescing) clean the control air. Automatic condensate drains (auto-drains) remove the water from the air receivers.
Kompresör, yüksek basınç (HP) ve düşük b: The compressor is protected by high-pressure (HP) and low-pressure (LP) pressure switches. The HP cut-out stops the compressor on excessive pressure caused by a fouled condenser or insufficient cooling water; the LP cut-out prevents operation with a low charge or a clogged filter. The ETO periodically tests the setpoints of these pressure switches and that they trip correctly.
Kompresör: Düşük basınçlı buharı sıkıştı: Compressor: compresses the low-pressure vapour; it is the main power consumer of the cycle.
Kompresör: Düşük basınçlı soğutucu akışk: Compressor: compresses the low-pressure refrigerant gas to high pressure. Mechanical energy is transferred to the refrigerant in the vapour phase.
Komut verildiğinde dümenci komutu birebi: When an order is given, the helmsman repeats it exactly (e.g., OOW: "Starboard ten" — Helmsman: "Starboard ten"), applies the helm and reports when the rudder reaches the ordered angle ("Ten of starboard wheel on"). When the ship is to be steadied on a course, the OOW gives the new course ("Steady on one-two-zero"); once the helmsman has the ship steady on that course by the compass, they confirm "Steady on one-two-zero". This discipline prevents misunderstandings caused by noise, accents or fatigue.
Kondenser kirlenmesi, hava/gaz varlığı v: Condenser fouling, the presence of air or gas and insufficient seawater flow raise the condenser pressure; the compressor work increases and the COP falls.
Kondenser vakumunun korunması, tüp kirle: Maintaining the condenser vacuum, controlling tube fouling and removing non-condensable gases have a direct effect on cycle efficiency.
Kondenser, deniz suyu (shell&tube) veya: The condenser is cooled by seawater (shell&tube) or by air (fan). The ETO checks that the fan motors of air-cooled condensers are working and, in seawater-cooled systems, the condition of the cooling water circulating pump and of the flow monitoring. Insufficient cooling leads to high discharge pressure and HP trips.
Kondenser: Akışkan ısı vererek yoğuşur;: Condenser: the refrigerant condenses as it gives up heat; seawater-cooled condensers are common on ships.
Kondenser: Türbin çıkış buharı yoğuşturu: Condenser: the turbine exhaust steam is condensed and the cycle is closed; a low condenser pressure increases the cycle efficiency but depends on the cooling water conditions.
Kondenser: Yüksek basınçlı ve sıcak gaz,: Condenser: the hot, high-pressure gas is cooled with seawater and liquefied. The refrigerant gives up its heat to the seawater.
Konfigürasyon değiştiğinde ASOG statüsü: When the configuration changes, the ASOG status and the result of the WCF are re-assessed. CAMO/TAM is not changed uncontrolled while the task is in progress; a change is made only through MOC and with authorised approval.
Konfor koşulları için bağıl nem %40-60 a: For comfort, the relative humidity should be kept between 40% and 60%.
Konsantre (concentrate) ve ince taneli y: Concentrates and fine-grained cargoes also carry a risk of shifting and liquefaction; the IMSBC Code Group A rules apply. The trimming (leveling) of the cargo surface and the filling level of the hold determine the shifting risk.
Kontaktör bobini (coil) gerilimi ve çekm: The contactor coil voltage and pick-up/drop-out behavior are checked; a chattering contactor is a sign of low control voltage or dirty contacts. The ETO tests the soundness of the mechanical interlocks (especially the interlock that prevents two contactors from pulling in at the same time in reversing and star-delta applications).
Kontaktör, motoru şebekeye bağlayan elek: A contactor is the electromechanical switch that connects the motor to the supply; every opening and closing causes arcing and wear on the contacts. The ETO checks the contact surfaces for signs of wear, pitting and overheating. Burnt or welded contacts are replaced immediately, as they can cause the motor to run uncontrolled.
Konteyner gemilerinde DG kaynaklı yangın: On container ships, fire scenarios involving dangerous goods should also be included in the drills.
Konteyner gemilerinde güvertedeki ve amb: Fires in container stacks on deck and in the holds (especially those caused by mis-declared DG) are very difficult: access to the stacks is limited, water may not be enough and there is a structural risk. Cases such as the Maersk Honam (2018) show that the Master sometimes cannot fully extinguish the fire and that withdrawing the team and waiting for outside help (salvage, escort) may be the right course. The Master's task is not to beat the fire at the cost of losing the team, but to protect people.
Konteyner gemilerinde pontoon kapakları: On container ships, containers are stowed on the pontoon covers; the cover must be strong enough to carry the container stack load. Twistlocks and lashing gear secure the containers to the cover and to each other; the cover fittings must be undamaged.
Konteyner gemilerinde twist-lock'un tam: On container ships, failing to notice that a twistlock was not fully locked has led to container stacks collapsing in bad weather. The AB must physically confirm that every twistlock has engaged and avoid the assumption that "it is probably locked".
Konteyner gemisinde yüksek basınçlı yakı: On a container ship, fuel leaking from a high-pressure fuel pipe came into contact with the turbocharger casing (500 °C) and ignited. The fire spread quickly and the CO₂ system was released.
Konteyner istif emniyeti, stack weight (: Container stowage safety depends on the limits for the total weight of containers stowed one above another at each row position and on corner casting load limits. The CSM and the lashing software (e.g. lashing computer) show the maximum permissible load for each bay-row-tier. Putting a heavy container in a high tier overloads the corner castings and lashings below it. The Chief Officer verifies that the plan complies with these limits.
Konteynerler köşe kutularından twistlock: Containers are locked to each other and to the ship at their corner castings with twistlocks; the lower tiers are tensioned to the lashing bridge or the deck with lashing rods and turnbuckles. As the stack height increases, the load on the upper containers and the risk of the stack tipping increase; heavy containers are therefore stowed at the bottom.
Kontrat bazlı alımlar genellikle spot pi: Purchases under contract are usually more economical than purchases on the spot market.
Kontrol devresindeki yardımcı röleler ve: Auxiliary relays and timer relays in the control circuit (especially for star-delta changeover timing) ensure that the start sequence works correctly. The ETO verifies that the timer relay setting is correct (star-delta changeover typically 5-15 s) and that the relay contacts are clean. Wrong timing causes an excessive current surge at changeover.
Kontrol havası (control air) ve start ha: The control air and starting air systems have air dryers and filters, which remove moisture and oil vapor. Damp control air leads to valve and actuator failures, and to corrosion in the starting air bottles. The air bottles are drained daily to remove condensate.
Kontrol havası (instrument air): 5-7 bar: Control air (instrument air): dried and filtered air at 5–7 bar. It is used for pneumatic control valves and automation systems.
Kontrol hiyerarşisi (hierarchy of contro: The hierarchy of controls is applied: first elimination (make the job unnecessary), then substitution, engineering controls, administrative controls and, last of all, PPE. PPE is never the first defense; it is regarded as the "last line". The Chief Officer does not sign the permit without verifying that the team has reduced the risk to an "acceptable" level.
Kontrol katmanı genelde dağıtık PLC'ler: The control layer is usually implemented with distributed PLCs; each PLC manages a subsystem (jacket water, fuel oil, bilge, ballast) and reports to the central server. Field communication is via Modbus, Profibus/Profinet, CAN or a proprietary fieldbus.
Kontrollü doğrultucularda kullanılır: Te: It is used in controlled rectifiers: the output voltage is adjusted by changing the firing angle.
Konum hatasına iyonosferik/troposferik g: Ionospheric and tropospheric delay, satellite orbit and clock errors, multipath (reflection from structures or the water surface) and receiver noise contribute to the position error. The total of these errors is of the order of a few metres for standard GPS.
Konvansiyonel sistemde dedektörler bölge: In a conventional system the detectors are monitored by zone; the panel shows which zone has the fire. In an addressable system each detector has a unique address; the panel shows the exact detector and its status (fire, fault, contamination), which makes maintenance easier.
Konvektif ısı transferi, yüzey alanı, sı: Convective heat transfer depends on the surface area, the temperature difference and the convection coefficient.
Konvertörlü düzenler, ana makine devrini: Arrangements with converters allow the main engine speed to be freed and therefore the fuel consumption to be optimised; on the other hand, harmonic filtering, cooling and converter redundancy are separate design items.
Koordinasyonun anahtarı, tek bir \"casua: The key to coordination is a single "casualty file" and a single set of facts: telling different stories to different parties is a disaster. The Master records all correspondence and tracks who asked for what and what was shared. This discipline both speeds up insurance recovery and removes the risk of contradictions in legal proceedings.
Kopan halat snap-back yapar; eğitim ve f: A parting line snaps back; training and awareness prevent fatal accidents.
Kopan halat snap-back yapar; personel sn: A parting line snaps back; no one stands in a snap-back zone. Mixed moorings (lines of different materials) add risk.
Korozif aşınma: Yakıttaki kükürt yanma s: Corrosive wear: the sulphur in the fuel oxidises to SO₃ during combustion and combines with water vapour to form sulphuric acid (H₂SO₄). Corrosion starts when the liner temperature falls below the acid dew point (140–170 °C).
Korozif ortamda (deniz suyu) yorulma sın: In a corrosive environment (seawater) the fatigue limit falls considerably.
Korozyon yönetimi, güverte bakımının en: Corrosion management is the largest single item of deck maintenance. The correct sequence is: mechanical chipping/needle gun → wire brush → solvent cleaning → primer → intermediate coat → top coat. The humidity, surface temperature (at least 3°C above the dew point) and film thickness (DFT) requirements in the paint manufacturer's data sheet must be followed; otherwise the paint will not adhere.
Korozyonun tipleri farklıdır: uniform co: There are different types of corrosion: uniform corrosion (a thin layer over wide surfaces), pitting (localized deep pits — particularly in ballast tanks and in the middle of holds), galvanic corrosion (at joints between dissimilar metals), crevice corrosion (at tight intersections) and stress corrosion cracking (in fatigued areas). Each type requires different measures.
Korsan saldırısı anında iletişim sırası:: Order of communication during a pirate attack: UKMTO/MSCHOA, the navy, the CSO/DPA, the flag state. The Master's decision to withdraw to the citadel is the most effective way of protecting the crew's lives; but the citadel's communication and endurance criteria must be tested in advance.
Korsanlık/armed robbery riski olan bölge: In areas with a risk of piracy/armed robbery (Gulf of Aden, Gulf of Guinea, approaches to the Singapore Strait, etc.), BMP (Best Management Practices) is applied. Preparation includes registration/reporting with UKMTO and MSCHOA, maximizing speed and freeboard, physical hardening (barbed wire, water curtains, closing off access), enhanced lookout arrangements and preparation of a citadel. Before entering the area, the Master updates the risk assessment and briefs the team.
Korumalı distress butonu, GPS konumu ve: The protected distress button sends the distress alert, with the GPS position and the ship's identity, through the selected LES to the relevant MRCC (Maritime Rescue Coordination Centre). Because the alert includes the nature of distress and the position, SAR can be started quickly.
Krank mili hizalaması deflection ölçümüy: Crankshaft alignment is checked by deflection measurement. Bearing wear or hull deformation upsets the alignment.
Krank mili saptırması (deflection) ölçüm: Crankshaft deflection measurement is the most important indicator of bearing wear and shaft alignment.
Krank mili → İtme yatağı (thrust bearing: Crankshaft → Thrust bearing → Intermediate shaft → Propeller shaft → Propeller.
Krank mili, motorun en ağır ve en pahalı: The crankshaft is the heaviest and most expensive part of the engine. It is made of forged steel or as a semi-built shaft. It consists of the crankpins, the main journals and the webs.
Kritik alarm ertelemesi için zabit onayı: Deferring a critical alarm should require the officer's approval, a written justification and a re-assessment time (e.g. 15 min / 30 min). When the time expires, the alarm should automatically return to critical status.
Kritik bir prensip: ISPS, kaptanın emniy: A critical principle: the ISPS Code confirms the Master's overriding authority in safety and security decisions. SOLAS XI-2/8 states clearly that if safety and security requirements conflict, the Master has the authority to give priority to safety. In other words, if a security request (e.g. carrying out a particular search) would endanger the safety of the ship, the Master may refuse it.
Kritik ekipman bakımı öncelikli olarak p: Maintenance of critical equipment is planned as a priority and spare parts are stocked. Emergency repair procedures must be defined in advance in case of failure.
Kritik ekipman overdue'ları ISM uygunsuz: Overdue jobs on critical equipment create an ISM non-conformity (NC); class surveys rely on the PMS records.
Kritik ekipmanın taşınması isim isim ata: Carrying critical equipment is assigned by name: the person who will take the EPIRB and SART from their brackets, the person who will bring the portable GMDSS VHFs, and the person who will bring extra pyrotechnics, water and rations are known in advance. In a real abandonment, the answer to "Who took the EPIRB?" must already have been given.
Kritik görevler (örneğin exhaust valve o: Critical tasks (for example exhaust valve overhaul) are given to experienced officers and routine tasks to juniors; however, to give them a chance to learn, juniors are included in demanding tasks under the supervision of an experienced colleague.
Kritik güvenlik ekipmanı overdue'su hem: Overdue maintenance on critical safety equipment is both an ISM non-conformity and a risk to life.
Kritik kategoriler (A, B, D, L) reddedil: The critical categories (A, B, D, L) are non-rejectable; they cannot be switched off. The Second Officer makes sure that the bridge team sees the NAVTEX printer/display output and that important warnings are reflected in the passage plan.
Kritik komutlarda kapalı döngü iletişim: Closed-loop communication (order – read-back – confirmation) should be mandatory for critical orders; ECR records should be reviewed as case studies at the weekly ERM meeting.
Kritik mesajlarda yazılı iletişim (not d: For critical messages, written communication (notebook, message board) is used in support.
Kritik parçaların (örn. krank yatağı, ex: Batch/serial number traceability is kept for critical parts (e.g. crank bearings, exhaust valves); this is needed for a maker recall or for the analysis of a recurring failure. The fitting date and running hours of the spare fitted and the condition of the part removed are recorded in the PMS work order.
Kriz atlatıldıktan sonra mürettebatın fi: Once the crisis is over, the physical and psychological care of the crew comes first. The injured are treated and a MEDEVAC is arranged if necessary. Post-traumatic stress (losing a crew member, having been in danger of death) can leave serious effects; the Master arranges a debriefing and, if necessary, professional support (psychological first aid, counselling ashore). People are at the centre of the crisis and remain so after the event is over.
Kriz kararları çoğu zaman eksik bilgi ve: Crisis decisions are usually taken with incomplete information and under time pressure. An effective approach is the OODA loop of military origin (Observe–Orient–Decide–Act), or the GRADE model taken over from aviation: Gather (collect information), Review (review the information and the risks), Analyse (analyse the options), Decide (take the decision), Evaluate (assess the outcome). Rather than freezing while waiting for perfect information, the Master takes a "good enough" decision early and updates it as conditions change; because in a crisis the most expensive decision is no decision at all.
Krizde kaptan, içeride komutayı sürdürür: In a crisis the Master must keep command on board while managing accurate and timely communication with the outside. The company's Emergency Response Team (ERT) comes into action; the Master coordinates with the DPA/CSO and the company crisis line. The flow of communication is defined in advance: who calls, what information is given, who speaks to the media (generally the company, not the Master). Early, honest and regular information speeds up outside support and prevents misinformation.
Kullanılan temizlik malzemesi (degreaser: The cleaning agent (degreaser) is chosen correctly; some aggressive chemicals damage paint/seals/metal surfaces and pose a respiratory hazard. When chemicals are used, the MSDS is read, gloves and eye protection are worn and ventilation is provided.
Kullanılmış yağ/yakıt filtre kartuşları: Used oil/fuel filter cartridges are oil-soaked waste and must not be thrown into the garbage at random. The oil is drained off (into the sludge tank), and the cartridge is suitably packaged and landed ashore under garbage/oily rag management. Oily rags and gloves are also kept in a closed metal container — there is a risk of spontaneous combustion.
Kullanılmış yemeklik (kızartma) yağ kesi: Used cooking (frying) oil is never discharged into the sea or poured into drains/sinks; it is collected in a separate, closed, labeled container. Oil getting into the water/drainage system is both a MARPOL violation and a cause of pipe blockages and pest problems. When changing the fryer oil, the cook transfers the old oil directly into this collection container and stores the container safely and leak-tight.
Kullanılmış yemeklik yağ ayrı, kapalı ka: Used cooking oil is collected separately in a closed container and delivered to the approved system/shore reception facility. The cook integrates the waste flow into the station layout; the garbage station is located apart from the clean area, where it does not interfere with service.
Kullanım: Üst yapılar, sürat tekneleri,: Uses: superstructures, fast craft, helicopter decks.
Kullanımda PASS yöntemi uygulanır: Pull: The PASS method is applied in use: Pull (pull the pin), Aim (aim at the base of the flame), Squeeze (squeeze the lever), Sweep (apply with a sweeping motion). The operator must always keep the exit behind them, and the escape route must be kept clear.
Kumanya depoları ve soğuk depolar yetkis: Provision stores and cold stores are kept closed to unauthorized access; the keys/access are held by the cook and the chief steward. This is for both stock security (loss/wastage) and food safety (uncontrolled opening and closing, breaking the cold chain). Entering and leaving the stores follows a set discipline; the cold store door is not kept open for long.
Kumanya stok yönetimi, görünmediğinde ba: Provisions stock management is a discipline that succeeds when it goes unseen: the right quantity at the right time, of good quality and within budget. FIFO/FEFO rotation, ordering on a person-day basis, quality control on delivery and a safety buffer are the quiet infrastructure for feeding the crew without either running out of supplies or wasting them in mid-voyage.
Kural 13 (overtaking / geçme), bir gemin: Rule 13 (overtaking) defines a ship coming up with another from a direction more than 22.5 degrees abaft her beam; the overtaking vessel is always obliged to keep out of the way of the vessel being overtaken, and even if the bearing later changes, the situation does not become a crossing and this obligation does not change. Rule 14 (head-on) requires two power-driven vessels meeting on reciprocal or nearly reciprocal courses each to alter course to starboard.
Kural 15 (crossing / kesişme), iki makin: Rule 15 (crossing) states that when two power-driven vessels are crossing, the vessel which has the other on her own starboard side is the give-way vessel and shall, if possible, avoid crossing ahead of the other. The give-way vessel takes early and substantial action; the stand-on vessel keeps her course and speed in accordance with Rule 17.
Kural 17, yol hakkı olan (stand-on) gemi: Rule 17 states that the stand-on vessel must keep her course and speed, but that she may take action if the give-way vessel is not taking the required action (Rule 17(a)(ii)), and that she must take action when collision cannot be avoided by the action of the give-way vessel alone (17(b)). In a crossing situation, a power-driven stand-on vessel should, if the circumstances admit, not alter course to port for a vessel on her own port side (17(c)).
Kural 18, gemiler arası öncelik hiyerarş: Rule 18 defines the hierarchy of priority between ships: it determines who gives way to whom among power-driven vessels, sailing vessels, vessels engaged in fishing, vessels restricted in their ability to maneuver (RAM), vessels not under command (NUC) and vessels constrained by their draft (CBD). The officer applies the Rule 18 priority by correctly identifying the type of the other ship from her lights/shapes.
Kural 35, kısıtlı görüşte verilecek ses: Rule 35 governs the sound signals to be given in restricted visibility. A power-driven vessel making way sounds one prolonged blast every two minutes; a vessel that is stopped and making no way (stopped, no way) sounds two prolonged blasts every two minutes. Vessels restricted in their ability to maneuver (RAM), NUC, CBD, sailing vessels, fishing vessels and vessels engaged in towing sound one prolonged blast followed by two short blasts (one prolonged + two short).
Kurban temiz havaya alındığında derhal i: Once the casualty is in fresh air, first aid/CPR is given immediately, oxygen is administered and medical assistance (radio medical advice/MEDEVAC) is requested. The AB must know basic first aid and CPR. In H₂S/CO poisoning, the casualty is kept under observation even if they appear "recovered"; there may be delayed effects.
Kurtarma botu, her ay denize indirilip m: The rescue boat is tested every month by launching it and maneuvering it in the water (weather permitting). The engine, steering, integrity of the inflatable boat and the davit/launching system are checked. Fast rescue boats need more frequent testing. These tests verify the MOB (Man Overboard) response capability.
Kurtarma botu/rescue boat hazırlanır, MO: The rescue boat is prepared and launched with the procedure practised in MOB drills. Water temperature is a critical factor: in cold water hypothermia begins within minutes, so speed is vital. The Master also looks after the safety of the rescue team; to avoid further casualties, the rescue boat crew are sent with lifejackets and the necessary equipment.
Kurtarma ekibi geldiğinde: havalandırma: When the rescue team arrives: ventilation is increased to the maximum, the rescuer dons SCBA, has their own standby outside, is attached by lifeline/harness and reaches the casualty. The casualty is lifted out through the vertical/narrow opening using a rescue harness or a tripod/winch arrangement. The recovery plan must have been thought out before entry; getting an unconscious person out through a narrow manhole is very difficult.
Kurtarma gelene kadar düzen ve umut koru: Order and hope must be kept until rescue arrives. The Master also practises this psychological dimension in drills (managing panic, allocating tasks), because how people behave in a crisis is as decisive as the equipment. A well-drilled crew stays orderly even in bad conditions.
Kurtarılan kişiye hipotermi ve boğulma p: The rescued person is treated according to the hypothermia and drowning protocol; the ship's medical equipment and personnel competent in first aid come in. In serious cases a shore doctor is consulted by telemedicine (e.g. TMAS — Telemedical Maritime Assistance Service) and, if necessary, a MEDEVAC (evacuation by helicopter) is requested through the MRCC. The Master runs this chain (including a PAN-PAN urgency call) quickly.
Kuru erzak deposu (dry store) serin, kur: The dry store should be cool, dry and well ventilated; the ideal temperature is 10-21°C and humidity around 50-60%. Products are grouped by category (cereals/flour, canned goods, spices, beverages and cleaning materials kept separately) and arranged by expiry date using FIFO (First In, First Out): new arrivals at the back, older stock at the front. The cook applies this rotation with every delivery; otherwise out-of-date products accumulate on the back shelves.
Kuru havuz: Tam tekne temizliği ve boya: Dry dock: full hull cleaning and repainting (usually at the five-yearly special survey or an intermediate dry-docking).
Kuru iklimlerde hava nemlendirme gerekeb: In dry climates humidification may be needed. Steam injection or ultrasonic humidifiers are used.
Kuru veya yaş (sıvı içinde süspansiyon): Dry or wet (suspended in a liquid) particles can be applied. Fluorescent particles give more sensitive results under UV light.
Kuru yük tarafında RightShip değerlendir: On the dry cargo side, the RightShip assessment acts as a similar gatekeeper. The Master's daily discipline (records kept up to date, equipment in working order, a competent team) is reflected directly in these external inspections in the fleet's commercial competitiveness. In other words, ISM/ISPS is not only a legal matter but a matter of commercial survival.
Kurulum sorumlu zabit gözetiminde checkl: The rigging is checked against a checklist under the supervision of the responsible officer; a crew member meets the pilot.
Kurulum öncesi AB; düşme, ezilme, sıkışm: Before rigging, the AB assesses the risks of falling, crushing, trapping, a tensioned line parting and falling overboard. If the job involves work at height or overside, a safety harness, a lifebuoy with lifeline on standby and suitable weather and sea conditions are required. PPE (safety helmet, gloves, non-slip boots and, where required, a lifejacket) is used in full.
Kurum birikimi soot fire riski yaratır;: Soot build-up creates a risk of a soot fire; the safety valve test is the last protection against overpressure.
Soot build-up creates a risk of a soot fire; soot blowing is done regularly.
Kurutucu (tumble dryer), çamaşırı hızlı: The tumble dryer dries laundry quickly, but incorrect use puts both the textiles and the machine at risk. Excessive heat shrinks delicate fabrics and damages the fibers; an overfilled dryer dries unevenly and wastes energy. The temperature is selected according to the fabric type, and delicate textiles are dried at low heat or hung up.
Kurutucu lint filtresi her çevrimde, egz: The dryer lint filter is cleaned after every cycle and the exhaust duct periodically. If abnormal noise, vibration, a water leak or overheating is noticed in the engines, they are not operated, and this is reported to the engine crew/the person responsible for technical matters. The steward is responsible for basic cleaning and filter maintenance; electrical/mechanical faults are left to the authorized team.
Kurutucu ve çamaşır makinesinde biriken: Lint (fabric fluff) that builds up in the dryer and washing machine is a combustible material, and a clogged filter leads to heat build-up and fire. The steward cleans the lint filters after every drying cycle. This simple maintenance removes the most common cause of laundry fires.
Kurutucudan çıkan çamaşır tamamen kuruma: Laundry from the dryer is not folded and put in lockers until it is completely dry; damp textiles produce mold and odors. The steward checks that laundry is dry before folding it and processes again any items that are still damp.
Kurşun-asit ve Ni-Cd bataryalar şarj sır: Lead-acid and Ni-Cd batteries produce hydrogen (H₂) gas during charging; H₂ forms an explosive mixture with air in the 4–75% range (lower explosive limit, LEL, 4%). The battery room must have adequate ventilation (generally natural or forced, from the top) so that this gas cannot accumulate. The ETO verifies that the ventilation fans are running and that the vents are not blocked.
Kusur, PMS/defect sisteminde açılır: eki: The defect is opened in the PMS/defect system: the equipment, a description of the defect, the date it was found and a risk assessment are recorded. If the equipment cannot be used safely, it is marked "out of service" and physically tagged so that nobody relies on it by mistake.
Kuvvetli tide ve eddy için hız-yön trend: In strong tides and eddies, the speed and direction trend, the thrust margin and reference deviations are monitored. In an area with a risk of solitons, radar and current indications and the possibility of a sudden surge are followed; as the environmental limit approaches, the task equipment is recovered safely.
Kuzey yarımkürede rüzgar, alçak basınç e: In the Northern Hemisphere, the wind blows counterclockwise and inward around low pressure, and clockwise and outward around high pressure (the reverse in the Southern Hemisphere). Buys Ballot's law: in the Northern Hemisphere, with your back to the wind, low pressure is on your left. This is the basic tool for finding the direction of a storm center.
Kâğıt haritalar standart yöntemle tashih: Paper charts are corrected by the standard method; ENC updates are applied in the ECDIS. T&P notices are followed and a chart correction log is kept.
Paper charts are corrected by the standard method; ENC updates are applied in the ECDIS. T&P notices are followed and a correction log is kept.
Kâğıt haritalarda düzeltmeler standart y: Corrections to paper charts are made by the standard method (in violet ink); ENC updates are applied in the ECDIS. T&P (temporary and preliminary) notices are also followed.
Kök neden: Silindir yağlama dozajının ay: Root cause: a maladjusted cylinder lubrication feed rate and neglect of scavenge drain cleaning.
Kök neden: Yakıt boru bağlantı noktasını: Root cause: the fuel pipe connection had not been tightened to the correct torque and periodic checks had not been carried out.
Kömür, DRI gibi Group B yükler kendiliği: Group B cargoes such as coal and DRI can self-heat, deplete oxygen and give off hazardous gases (methane/CO from coal, hydrogen from DRI). The Chief Officer implements hold temperature monitoring, oxygen/gas measurement and the ventilation plan. Readings are recorded.
Köprü ile sürekli iletişim kritiktir; Ka: Continuous communication with the bridge is critical; the Master's navigational decision (stopping, anchoring, moving away from the coast) and the Chief Engineer's technical response must be synchronized. The flow of information is two-way, not one-way.
Köprü ve makine dairesi arasında \"Unman: Even on ships with an "Unmanned Machinery Space (UMS)" notation, the daily noon report between the bridge and the engine room and 4-hourly log entries are standard. The Second Engineer reviews the manual logs taken by the watchkeeping engineers (exhaust gas temperature of each cylinder, scavenge air pressure, jacket cooling water inlet/outlet, LO inlet temp/press, fuel rack/index, turbocharger rpm) and cross-checks them with the data from the automatic data logger (alarm monitoring system).
Köprüdeki dümen komutu, telemotor (eski: The helm order on the bridge is transmitted to the steering gear compartment by the telemotor (older hydraulic or modern electric). In follow-up mode the rudder stops at the ordered angle; in non-follow-up mode it moves for as long as the button is held. The autopilot corrects the rudder automatically according to the course error.
Köprüüstü ekibinin seyir eğitimi, İkinci: Navigation training of the bridge team is the Second Officer's most lasting contribution; a passage plan makes one voyage safe, whereas a well-trained team makes hundreds of voyages safe. A Second Officer who does not reduce familiarization to a formality, who applies COLREG to real scenarios and who instills the BRM culture and the courage to challenge in the team ensures that the error chain is broken at its very first link. As automation increases, the human responsibility for monitoring and questioning does not decrease; on the contrary, the value of training becomes more critical every year.
Köprüüstü genelinde uyumlaştırılmış (har: A harmonised HMI throughout the bridge means that the same operation is carried out in the same way at every station. This is an important human-factors advantage that lowers the error rate at watch changes and under stress. Central dimming protects night vision from a single point.
Köprüüstü kaynak yönetiminin başarısız o: In many accidents where bridge resource management failed (Royal Majesty 1995, Sea Empress 1996, Costa Concordia 2012), the common theme is this: the officer of the watch or the pilot had doubts but did not speak up because of the Master's authority. While using their hierarchical power, the modern Master must also build a bridge culture that encourages challenge.
Köprüüstü vardiyası, gemideki en yüksek: The bridge watch is one of the duties carrying the highest responsibility on board; on this watch, as the Master's representative, the Second Officer carries the safety of hundreds of lives and of cargo worth millions of dollars. Complying with the letter and spirit of COLREG, maintaining a safe speed, keeping a continuous lookout and calling the Master the moment there is any doubt ("if in doubt") are the disciplines that prevent, from the outset, the collisions and groundings that keep recurring in the statistics. An officer of the watch who knows the particular risks of the dawn and dusk transitions, relies on judgment rather than on equipment and has internalized the BRM culture is the ship's strongest safety defense.
Köprüüstü vardiyasına eğitim amaçlı katı: Taking part in the bridge watch for training is the most critical stage at which the deck cadet turns into a future officer of the watch. Here the cadet acquires technical skill, regulatory knowledge and, most importantly, professional discipline together. Having no authority for independent decisions is not a restriction but a privilege: learning free from the pressure of mistakes and responsibility. Making the best use of this privilege through constant observation, asking questions and careful record-keeping is the cadet's own responsibility.
Köprüüstü vardiyasında kazanılan her bec: Every skill gained on bridge watch is entered against the relevant STCW competence item in the Training Record Book: taking fixes, radar plotting, applying COLREG, using ECDIS, keeping the log, etc. After each task, the cadet obtains the signature and assessment of the training officer. These records are the main evidence for a future application for the OICNW certificate of competency.
Köprüüstü, makine, GMDSS ve VDR saatleri: The bridge, engine room, GMDSS and VDR clocks must be kept consistent (usually referenced to UTC or ship's time). The time source of the VDR must be correct; otherwise the event record will not match real time. The Second Officer checks clock synchronization periodically.
Köprüüstündeki saatlerden en az biri (ma: At least one of the clocks on the bridge (master clock or GMDSS console clock) must be kept set to show UTC at all times; the other clocks show zone time. NAVTEX and SafetyNET messages from the EGC receiver are time-stamped in UTC; assessing them against UTC rather than ship's time is necessary for interpreting the validity windows of navigational warnings correctly.
Köprüüstündeki verici (transmitter) düme: The transmitter on the bridge, a piston pump turned by the steering wheel, sends pressurised oil through pipes to the receiver at the steering gear.
Köprüüstünden tam yol ileri → stop komut: The order full ahead → stop is given from the bridge. The engine's fuel is cut off and a braking effect is created. The ship slows down through its own resistance.
Köpük konsantresi su ile doğru oranda (t: The foam concentrate must be mixed with water in the correct proportion (typically 1%, 3% or 6%); mixing is done with an inductor (venturi), balanced pressure proportioner or bladder tank. A wrong proportion produces weak foam or none at all.
Köpük, yanan sıvı üzerinde sürekli bir b: Foam forms a continuous blanket over the burning liquid: it cuts the fuel surface off from the air (oxygen isolation), suppresses the release of flammable vapour and cools with the water it contains. The covering must be continuous; if the foam blanket breaks down, the fire re-ignites.
Kötü bakımlı HVAC, hava kalitesi sorunla: Poorly maintained HVAC creates air quality problems and a risk of a Legionella outbreak; disinfection is never neglected.
Kötü bakımlı basamak, yanlış sabitleme v: A poorly maintained step, wrong securing or missing lighting can kill. A crew member stands by when the pilot embarks and disembarks.
Kötü hava beklentisinde rota/hız ayarı (: When bad weather is expected, course and speed are adjusted (weather routing), lashings are checked additionally and excessive rolling is avoided. An excessive GM (a stiff ship) causes violent, rapid rolling that strains the lashings; a very low GM gives a dangerous rolling period. Lashings are checked periodically throughout the voyage.
Kötü hava koşullarında değişim erteleneb: In bad weather the exchange may be postponed; the Master's decision prevails.
Kültürel duyarlılık ve adil davranış, ek: Cultural sensitivity and fair treatment directly affect team cohesion and therefore operational safety. A language barrier can prevent critical information from being passed on and lead to an accident.
Küresel Uyumlaştırılmış Sistem (GHS) ile: Under the Globally Harmonised System (GHS), all hazardous chemicals are labelled with standard symbols: flame, explosion, corrosion, toxicity, exclamation mark, environmental hazard and so on.
Küresel kükürt sınırı %0,50 m/m; ECA (ör: The global sulphur limit is 0.50% m/m; in ECAs (e.g. the Baltic, the North Sea, North America) it is 0.10% m/m. Compliance can be achieved in three ways: (1) using compliant low-sulphur fuel (VLSFO/MGO); (2) using high-sulphur fuel with an exhaust gas cleaning system (scrubber/EGCS) as an equivalent measure; (3) alternative fuels such as LNG. The Bunker Delivery Note (BDN) and fuel sample are kept on board.
Kütle dengesi: ROB (başlangıç) + alınan: Mass balance: ROB (start) + fuel received − consumption − ROB (end) must equal zero (within tolerance).
Küçük tencere/tava yağ yangınında fire b: For a small oil fire in a pot or pan, the fire blanket is the fastest and safest response: holding the blanket so that it protects the hands, it is laid over the fire to cut off oxygen. The blanket is NOT thrown onto the fire; it is laid over it gently and the heat source (range) is switched off; the blanket is not removed until the flames are completely out and the surface has cooled (at least several minutes). Removing it early leads to re-ignition.
Küçük trim değişiklikleri bile, uzun sef: Even small trim changes give meaningful savings on long voyages. This is a zero-investment efficiency measure and should be applied regularly.
Kısa devre akımı, jeneratör subtransient: The short-circuit current is determined by the generator's subtransient reactance and the system impedance.
Kısa pulse yakın hedef ayrımını, uzun pu: A short pulse supports the discrimination of close targets, a long pulse / suitable processing supports the energy returned from distant targets. Pulse compression and auto modes on solid-state equipment are specific to the maker; the user must know from the display which automatic function is active.
Kısmen dolu (slack) tanklar serbest yüze: Partially filled (slack) tanks create a free surface effect and reduce the ship's effective GM. In ballast operations, tanks are kept either full (pressed up) or empty as far as possible; having many slack tanks at the same time weakens stability. The engine room manages this risk in coordination with the bridge.
Kısmen dolu (slack) tanklardaki sıvının: The free surface of liquid in partially filled (slack) tanks moves the center of gravity as the ship rolls and virtually reduces GM. The free surface effect is proportional to the cube of the tank breadth; wide tanks are therefore the most dangerous. Wherever possible, the Chief Officer keeps tanks either full or empty ("pressed up" or "empty") to minimize the number of slack tanks.
Kısmen dolu bir tanktaki sıvının hareket: The movement of liquid in a partly filled tank (free surface effect) reduces stability by lowering the effective GM. The cadet therefore learns that tanks are kept completely full ("press up") or empty as far as possible and that the number of slack tanks is limited.
Kısmi veya tam blackout sırasında DP kon: Keeping the DP control layer up during a partial or total blackout is the precondition for a controlled recovery. If the control system loses power, the ship stays blind for as long as the system takes to restart once power returns, and the loss of position grows.
Kısıtlı görüşte AB, radar/AIS değerlendi: In restricted visibility, the AB knows that radar/AIS assessment is the OOW's job, but keeps up their own aural and limited visual lookout. Every fog signal heard is reported with an estimated bearing ("fog signal, fine on the port bow").
Kısıtlı görüşte Rule 19 uygulanır. Radar: In restricted visibility Rule 19 applies. Whether a radar target is forward of or abaft the beam, the risk of a close-quarters situation and the direction of the course alteration are considered together; a COLREG manoeuvre is not based only on an AIS name or a VHF agreement.
Kısıtlı sularda echo sounder sürekli çal: In restricted waters the echo sounder is run continuously and a depth recorder/log is kept (mandatory in some waters). The shallow water alarm is set according to the planned minimum UKC, and its audible alarm is tested.
Kıyıdan en az 200 deniz mili uzakta ve s: It must be carried out at least 200 nautical miles from the nearest land and in water at least 200 metres deep.
Kış ve kutup operasyonlarında halatlar/g: In winter and polar operations, lines and decks ice up, synthetic lines stiffen and decks become more slippery. The Bosun manages the risk by removing ice, providing extra grip (anti-slip) and operating more slowly. A frozen line makes both hand grip and winch control more difficult.
LMTD yönteminin alternatifi olan ε-NTU y: The ε-NTU method, an alternative to the LMTD method, is used when the outlet temperatures are not known.
LNG tankından buharlaştırıcıya (vaporize: Gas is supplied from the LNG tank to the vaporiser and then through a pressure regulator to the engine. A gas pressure of 5–8 bar is used in low-pressure systems and about 300 bar in high-pressure systems.
LNG yakıt: Düşük yanma sıcaklığı doğal o: LNG fuel: the low combustion temperature naturally gives low NOx.
LNG, ağırlıklı olarak metan (CH₄, %85-95: LNG contains mainly methane (CH₄, 85–95%). Its boiling point is −162 °C and it is stored as a liquid at atmospheric pressure. Its volumetric energy density is about 60% of that of HFO, so it needs larger fuel tanks.
LO ana hat basıncı, ana yatak ve crosshe: LO main line pressure is the guarantee of main bearing and crosshead lubrication; a sudden drop triggers an alarm and, if necessary, a slowdown/shutdown. The Second Engineer determines the root cause of low-pressure alarms (clogged filter, pump wear, a bypass left open) and produces a permanent solution rather than a temporary fix.
LO analizi; viskozite, su içeriği, BN, a: LO analysis shows the condition of the oil in terms of viscosity, water content, BN, wear metals (Fe, Cu, Cr) and deposits. Increasing wear metals may be an early sign of a bearing/liner problem. By observing, the cadet learns sampling discipline and what the analysis results reveal.
LO basınç düşüşü; tıkalı filtre (yüksek: A drop in LO pressure may be caused by a clogged filter (high ΔP), pump wear, a line leak or air on the suction side (low sump). When a real alarm occurs after the test, the cause is quickly narrowed down by checking the filter ΔP, the sump level and the condition of the pump. The LO low-pressure trip is never disabled for being a "nuisance".
LO da benzer şekilde sürekli purifier'da: Similarly, LO is kept clean by passing it continuously through the purifier. The cadet learns the purifier's separator (water separation) and clarifier (solids separation) modes and the importance of selecting the gravity disc.
LO kartuş değişiminde changeover yapılır: When an LO cartridge is changed, a changeover is made and the old cartridge is examined. Particles of bearing metal (white metal/babbitt, bronze, steel) are a sign of early bearing wear and are cross-checked against the OMD/oil analysis. The Oiler photographs the finding and passes it on to the engineer.
LO, FO ve hava filtreleri düzenli temizl: LO, FO and air filters are cleaned/changed regularly. A clogged filter shows itself by an increase in differential pressure; when this difference exceeds a set limit, an alarm is given or the bypass opens. The cadet learns why filters must be changed on time (insufficient supply, damage to equipment).
LO/FO/SW devrelerindeki dubleks (duplex): Duplex filters in LO/FO/SW circuits are cleaned according to the ΔP (pressure drop) gauge. When ΔP rises, the filter is changed over to the clean side and the dirty element is removed and cleaned; on auto-backflush filters, the solenoid and the differential switch are checked.
LOP, ilgili tarafa (terminal, charterer,: The LOP is presented to the party concerned (terminal, charterer, surveyor); if they refuse to sign, it is recorded with the note "received but refused to sign". A protest not made in time weakens a claim raised later; it is therefore important to write the LOP at the time of the event.
LOP, sea protest'ten farklıdır: sea prot: An LOP is different from a sea protest: a sea protest is a formal declaration made before a notary; an LOP is a commercial means of objection between the parties. The two complement each other.
LOTO, bir ekipman üzerinde çalışılırken: LOTO prevents equipment from starting unexpectedly, or stored energy (electrical, pressure, steam, hydraulic, mechanical) from being released, while work is being done on it. Before maintenance on a pump, fan, compressor or electric motor, the energy source is isolated, locked (lock) and tagged (tag).
LOTO, bir ekipmanın enerjisinin güvenli: LOTO means safely disconnecting the energy supply to equipment and preventing it from being accidentally re-energized. The ETO applies the standard sequence: plan and announce the work, identify the relevant power sources, open the switches/breaker, fit a physical lock, hang a warning tag, discharge stored energy (capacitors, motor inertia) and finally test for absence of voltage.
LSA ekipmanları; personal (bireysel), su: LSA equipment is grouped as personal, survival craft, launching appliances and distress/locating equipment. The personal group includes lifejackets, immersion suits, anti-exposure suits, thermal protective aids (TPA) and lifebuoys; the survival craft group includes lifeboats and liferafts; the launching group includes davits, winches and release gear; and the distress group includes pyrotechnics, EPIRB, SART, line-throwing apparatus and two-way VHFs.
LSA ekipmanının \"yerinde olması\" yetme: It is not enough for LSA equipment to be "in place"; in a real emergency it must be freely accessible and ready for use. The embarkation deck is kept clean, the area in front of the lifeboat is kept clear and no material is stowed in the davit area. The Safety Officer checks this access during routine safety rounds.
LSA ve yangın ekipmanı haftalık/aylık/yı: LSA and fire-fighting equipment are checked at weekly, monthly and annual intervals; the AB assists with these checks. Weekly, the lifeboat engine is run and the alarms are tested; monthly, a visual check of the LSA and fire extinguishers is made. Annual and five-yearly services are carried out by an authorized company (renewal of lifeboat falls, liferaft service, SCBA hydrostatic test).
LSA/FFE sertifikaları, liferaft/lifeboat: LSA/FFE certificates, liferaft/lifeboat/fire extinguisher service reports, drill records and the maintenance log are kept ready for inspection. The Third Officer monitors validity periods and plans renewals; an expired service directly produces a finding.
LT (düşük sıcaklık) devresi yağ soğutucu: The LT (low-temperature) circuit serves the lubricating oil cooler, the charge air cooler, auxiliary machinery and compressors; the temperature at the central cooler inlet is usually held constant by an automatic valve.
Lab raporu gelene kadar yeni alınan yakı: Until the lab report arrives, newly bunkered fuel is not used if possible. If it must be used urgently, the decision is recorded by the Chief Engineer. Laboratories such as FOBAS/VPS give results within 48-72 hours; if the fuel is "off-spec", a Letter of Protest is sent to the supplier immediately.
Laboratuvar analizi ISO 8217 limitlerini: When the laboratory analysis exceeds the ISO 8217 limits, the supplier is notified and an off-spec claim is opened. Engine safety has priority, especially with high cat fines, excessive water, a low flash point or high sulphur.
Laboratuvar analizi: viskozite, yoğunluk: Laboratory analysis: viscosity, density, sulphur, water, sediment, ash, Al+Si (cat fines), vanadium, CCAI, flash point, pour point.
Laboratuvar raporunda viskozite, su, TBN: The laboratory report gives viscosity, water, TBN, insolubles and wear metals. The trend matters more than a single value; for example, an Fe value that keeps rising from sample to sample is a forewarning of wear that has not yet triggered an alarm. The Oiler catches the change by comparing the results with previous reports.
Laboratuvar sonucu beklenirken, gemide b: While waiting for the laboratory result, simple test kits on board (water detection — crackle test/hot plate, TBN/TAN test kit, viscosity comparison) provide a preliminary assessment. This is valuable for quick decisions in an emergency.
Laboratuvar sonucu spec dışı (yüksek su,: If the laboratory result is off-spec (high water, cat fines, low flash point, stability problem), the Second Engineer informs the Chief Engineer immediately; if possible, the fuel is quarantined (not used), a Letter of Protest/claim is raised with the supplier and the company's technical department becomes involved. If the fuel has to be used, separation is intensified and the equipment is closely monitored.
Lagging indicators (kaza sonrası) tek ba: Lagging indicators (after the accident) are not enough on their own; leading indicators (near-misses, observations, training) give forward-looking early warning. A good system monitors and balances both.
Lanyard mümkün olduğunca bel hizası veya: The lanyard is attached, as far as possible, to a fixed point (anchor point) at or above waist level; if the attachment is low, the fall distance increases and a higher impact results. A shock-absorbing lanyard reduces the fall impact to a level that is safe for the body. The AB confirms that the anchor point can really take the load; railings and weak pipes cannot be relied on as anchor points.
Lapping işleminde uygun grit (kaba→ince): Lapping is done with lapping compound of suitable grit (coarse→fine) using circular/figure-of-eight movements, and continues until the surface is even with a uniform matte-bright finish. Afterwards, all compound is carefully cleaned off — abrasive left in the system will damage the valve again. New gland packing is cut to the correct size and inserted ring by ring, with the joints staggered.
Lashing donanımı; çatlak, deformasyon, k: Lashing gear is inspected regularly for cracks, deformation, corrosion and wear. Twistlock function, turnbuckle threads and the straightness of lashing rods are checked. A damaged item is taken out of service at once.
Lashing ekipmanı düzenli bakım gerektiri: Lashing equipment needs regular maintenance: greasing (turnbuckle threads), removing corrosion and replacing damaged parts. Replacement criteria (e.g. a certain number of broken wires in wire lashings, cuts/UV damage in web lashings) are applied in accordance with the CSM/maker's instructions. The Chief Officer keeps the maintenance records integrated with the PMS.
Lashing gerginliği seyir sırasında kontr: Lashing tension is checked during the voyage; slack lashings are tightened again. Additional lashings are applied when heavy weather is expected.
Lashing işi, sırt-bel yaralanmaları, par: Lashing work carries a risk of back injuries, crushed fingers and falls from height. The Bosun supervises correct lifting technique, the use of harnesses on lashing bridges, teamwork when carrying heavy lashing rods and the use of the right hand tools. Fall protection is mandatory when working on a lashing cage/platform.
Lashing planı, software çıktısı, ekipman: The lashing plan, software output, equipment inspection records and tightness checks are documented. These records are requested in PSC inspections, vetting and accident investigations. In the event of container loss or cargo damage, records showing that the CSM was correctly applied are the company's only defense.
Lashing rod: container köşesinden güvert: Lashing rod: a steel rod running from a container corner to a deck D-ring; it is tensioned with a turnbuckle.
Lashing zamanla gevşeyebilir (settling,: Lashings can slacken over time (settling, vibration, temperature changes). The Chief Officer plans lashing tightness checks and re-tightening in safe conditions. Before heavy weather the lashings are reassessed and tightened; working on deck once heavy seas have set in is dangerous, so the checks are completed in advance.
Lashing'te lashing rod, turnbuckle (germ: Lashing uses lashing rods, turnbuckles, chains, lashing belts/webbing, shackles, twistlocks and cones (on containers). The AB secures the cargo without exceeding the MSL (Maximum Securing Load) and SWL (Safe Working Load) of the equipment, at the correct angle and symmetrically. Worn, cracked or deformed equipment is not used; it is removed.
Lavabo, bulaşık makinesi ve buz makinesi: Water connections to sinks, the dishwasher and the ice machine are monitored for leaks; blocked drains create hygiene and pest problems. Potable water connections for equipment used in food preparation must be certified and fitted with backflow protection (details in the drinking water task). Leaks/blockages are reported and rectified.
Lağım suyu şu koşullarla deşarj edilebil: Sewage may be discharged as follows: comminuted and disinfected by an approved system, more than 3 NM from the nearest land; untreated sewage (from a holding tank) more than 12 NM from the nearest land, with the ship en route at not less than 4 knots and at a moderate rate; effluent from an approved sewage treatment plant without a distance limit, provided it leaves no visible floating solids or discoloration. Stricter rules apply to passenger ships in special areas such as the Baltic. The Master checks that the STP is in working order and that the discharge records are kept properly.
Lead time (teslim süresi), denizde sipar: The lead time, the possibility of ordering at sea and the next port plan directly affect stock management.
Legacy ECDIS'te resmî vektör ENC esas ol: On legacy ECDIS, official vector ENCs are distributed mainly in the IHO S-57 transfer standard; they are loaded through the S-63 data protection/permit mechanism and converted losslessly into the maker's internal SENC format. The symbols, colours and display categories on the screen follow the IHO S-52 Presentation Library and the equipment performance standard.
Letter of Protest, gemi adına bir durumu: A Letter of Protest is the formal protest/recording of a situation on behalf of the ship. The Chief Officer issues an LOP in situations such as slow loading/discharge rate, equipment breakdown, cargo quantity discrepancy (ship figure vs shore figure), contaminated/damaged cargo, a claim of poor hold preparation or unjustified delay. The LOP forms evidence in any future claim.
Letter of Protest, kaptanın karşı tarafa: A Letter of Protest is the document by which the Master notifies the other party (terminal, charterer, shipper, surveyor) that he or she formally objects to a situation and reserves rights. Typical subjects: cargo damage, a draft survey discrepancy, slow loading or discharging rates, delay due to bad weather, terminal equipment failure, contaminated fuel (bunker dispute). The LOP is given in writing and, if possible, signed by the other party; even if it is refused, the note "presented and refused" is added.
Li-ion bataryalar yüksek enerji yoğunluğ: Li-ion batteries offer high energy density but carry a risk of thermal runaway (uncontrolled heat/fire) from overcharging, overdischarging, physical damage or excessive temperature. Li-ion banks must therefore operate with a Battery Management System (BMS); the BMS monitors and balances cell voltage, temperature and current, and isolates the bank when limits are exceeded. The ETO closely follows BMS alarms and health.
Li-ion yangınları geleneksel söndürmeye: Li-ion fires resist conventional extinguishing, call for large amounts of cooling (water) and carry a risk of re-ignition. Li-ion energy storage systems on board are fitted with special fire detection (gas/heat), extinguishing and ventilation arrangements. The ETO ensures that these systems are in good health and that the response procedure is known by the team.
Lifeboat drill'lerinde on-load release g: Accidents involving on-load release gear during lifeboat drills have caused deaths in the past; attention is paid to the maker's procedure and to the use of fall preventer devices.
Lifeboat gemiyi terk etmek (çok kişiyi u: A lifeboat is for abandoning ship (taking many people away); a rescue boat is for active rescue — reaching a person in the water and marshalling liferafts. A rescue boat must therefore be fast, highly manoeuvrable and easy and quick to launch. On some ships a lifeboat is also approved as the rescue boat.
Lifeboat içinde özel bracket veya raftak: It is kept in a special bracket in the lifeboat or in the container in the liferaft.
Lifeboat ve life raft indirme/launch, mu: Lowering and launching of lifeboats and liferafts, mustering and passenger guidance are drilled; the davits, brakes and release gear are tested. The evacuation time is followed.
Lifeboat/davit, life raft (servis tarihi: Lifeboats and davits, liferafts (service dates), lifejackets and the MES are subject to periodic testing and maintenance; release gear is maintained following the maker's procedure. It is verified that the capacity is sufficient for the number of passengers.
Liferaft, içindeki SOLAS donanım paketiy: The liferaft comes with a SOLAS equipment pack inside (A or B pack: pyrotechnics, water, food, first aid, paddles, lifeline, sponges, repair kit). The capacity (number of persons) is marked on the canister; the total capacity of the rafts and lifeboats on board must cover everyone on board.
Liferaft, yetkili servis istasyonunda pe: The liferaft is opened, inflated, pressure-tested, re-equipped and repacked periodically (generally annually, extended for some systems) at an approved service station. The HRU expiry date (generally 2 years) is followed and the HRU replaced on time.
Liman acentesi, gemiyi limanda temsil ed: The port agent is the party who represents the ship in port, arranges the pilot and tugs, handles customs and immigration formalities, and coordinates supplies (provisions, bunkers, fresh water), waste collection, crew changes and the flow of documents. The agent is sometimes appointed by the shipowner (owner's agent) and sometimes by the charterer (charterer's agent); this distinction matters where interests clash. Since the charterer's agent is commercially tied to the charterer, the Master must not relax record discipline in protecting the interests of the ship and the shipowner.
Procedure for delivery to port reception facilities.
Liman ayrılışında köprüüstü 'stand by en: When leaving port, the bridge gave the order "Stand by engine" and the engine room interpreted it as preparation for "Dead slow ahead". Because the order was not repeated back, the shaft speed rose earlier than expected, creating a risk during the mooring operation.
Liman bağlamasında halatlara rat guard (: When the ship is moored in port, rat guards are fitted on the mooring lines; sticky traps and bait stations are placed at designated points in the holds, stores and galley. Provision boxes arriving on board are checked for insects/larvae before they enter the stores; cardboard packaging is not kept in the stores for long (cockroach nests).
Liman manevrası, dar su geçişi, ağır hav: During port maneuvering, narrow water transits, heavy weather and critical operations, the engine room goes to "stand-by engine" status; the engine room is fully manned on watch, the main engine is taken from UMS to manual control and the duty engineer stands by at the engine controls. The Second Engineer coordinates these changes with the bridge program and adjusts the watch schedule to suit the maneuvering requirements.
Liman tamiratı, servis ekibi attendance': Port repairs, service team attendance, spare parts logistics and drydock planning are a joint task of the Chief Engineer and the Superintendent. The Chief Engineer manages the reality on site; the Superintendent manages the budget and logistics resources.
Liman, denetimlerin (PSC, vetting, klas,: Port is where inspections (PSC, vetting, class, terminal) are most frequent. Before arrival, the Bosun makes the deck ready for inspection: order on the mooring deck, cleanliness of open areas, visibility of markings and access to equipment. After dusty/noisy work in port (chipping, grinding), the area is tidied up immediately.
Liman, haliç ve kıyıya yakın kirli/sığ s: The FWG must not be run in ports, estuaries or polluted shallow waters near the coast; these waters contain bacterial and chemical pollution (bilge water, sewage). Production takes place at sea, in clean water. Drinking water also goes through UV treatment or chlorination and, if necessary, remineralisation.
Limanda ana makine durur ancak jeneratör: In port, the main engine is stopped, but generator, boiler, cooling, bunkering and cargo (pumps on tankers) operations continue. During bunkering, the engineer monitors tank levels, leaks and the overflow alarm; SOPEP equipment is kept ready against marine pollution.
Limanda bağlı iken usta gemici halatları: When moored in port, the AB monitors the tension of the lines; the tide and swell can over-tension the lines or let them go slack. Over-tensioned lines are eased/adjusted safely, staying clear of the snap-back zone. Slack lines can allow the ship to move off the berth.
Limanda bunker, store alımı, survey ve t: In port, bunkering, storing, surveys and repairs take place at the same time. The Chief Engineer prevents clashes between tasks, assigns a responsible person to each job and keeps safety as the priority. A separate permit and supervision are planned for high-risk work (hot work, enclosed space entry).
Limanda emisyonu azaltmak için gemi, kar: To reduce emissions in port, the ship can be supplied from the shore grid (shore power / cold ironing). The ETO prepares the shore connection panel, checks that the incoming voltage/frequency is compatible with the ship's network (whether the shore supply is 60 Hz or 50 Hz, and the voltage level) and checks the phase sequence with a phase sequence indicator. A wrong phase sequence makes motors run in reverse.
Limanda gelen surveyor, PSC/vetting insp: In port, service to visiting surveyors, PSC/vetting inspectors or guests creates the first impression of the ship. The meeting room/saloon is prepared, and refreshments are served neatly and hygienically. The standard of the mess and service offered to inspectors gives an impression of the ship's general discipline.
Limanda gürültülü ve toz yapan işler (ch: In port, noisy and dusty jobs (chipping, grinding, painting) take priority, because at sea a large part of the team is keeping watches. Roughly, 30% of port time is allocated to operations, 50% to maintenance and 20% to rest + documentation.
Limanda kullanılmış yağ ve diğer ayrıştı: In port, used oil and other segregated waste (plastics, glass, metal, food waste) are delivered to an approved port reception facility. MARPOL requires ports to provide adequate reception facilities. During delivery, the type and quantity of waste are documented; this document is matched with the ship's waste records. The cook makes the process easier by keeping the waste tidy, labeled and segregated, ready for delivery.
Limanda yük operasyonu, bunkering, store: In port, cargo operations, bunkering, taking stores and maintenance may all run at the same time. The Bosun ensures that these jobs do not endanger each other — for example, no painting is done underneath a cargo crane while it is working, and no hot work is done during bunkering. Managing overlapping operations is one of the on-site leader's most critical skills.
Limandan ayrılmadan önce (12 saat içinde: The main steering gear is tested before leaving port (within 12 hours); the emergency steering and its communications are verified by emergency steering drills held at least once every three months (SOLAS V/26.4). The cleanliness of the hydraulic oil (ISO 4406) is monitored.

The main steering gear is tested before leaving port (within 12 hours); the emergency steering and its communications are verified by emergency steering drills held at least once every three months (SOLAS V/26.4). The cleanliness of the hydraulic oil is monitored.
Line tipleri sırayla verilir; halat kond: The lines are sent out in order; line condition, SWL and the balance of tensions are checked. No one stands in snap-back zones.
