Bypassing the OWS is a criminal offence with heavy penalties; the records must agree with what actually happened. Large fines have been imposed in the cruise industry in the past.
OWS deşarjları, 15 ppm alarm olayları ve: Records of OWS discharges, 15 ppm alarm events and OCM calibration are kept; PSC inspects this system closely. The operability of the OWS, the alarm being active, the correct functioning of the three-way valve and tightness are checked. Signs of a bypass (hidden hose/flange) are the main finding looked for.
OWS iki aşamayla çalışır: birinci kademe: The OWS works in two stages: in the first stage large oil droplets collect at the top by gravity (difference in density); in the second stage coalescer elements make small oil droplets grow and separate. The separated oil goes to the sludge or oil tank and the cleaned water to the 15 ppm monitor.
OWS ile denize basma, bilge transferi, s: Pumping overboard through the OWS, bilge transfers, sludge burning (incinerator) and deliveries to shore reception are entered in ORB Part I with the operation codes, correctly and on time. Entries carry the signature of the crew member concerned and the Master's approval. An inconsistency in the ORB (e.g. the sludge produced not matching the quantity disposed of) is a main red flag in a PSC inspection.
OWS işletimi öncesi OCM kalibrasyonu, ze: Before the OWS is operated, the OCM calibration, zero/span check and condition of the coalescer element are verified. A cloudy emulsion (bilge water mixed with detergent/chemicals) upsets the OWS and causes constant alarms; for this reason, unnecessary use of detergents in the engine room is avoided.
OWS çıkışı OCM ile izlenir; 15 ppm aşılı: The OWS discharge is monitored by the OCM; if 15 ppm is exceeded, the automatic three-way valve returns the bilge water to the tank. Discharge takes place only with the ship en route and under the MARPOL conditions (it is prohibited in the Antarctic area).
OWS'i bypass eden herhangi bir düzenek (: If any arrangement that bypasses the OWS (a magic pipe) is found, heavy fines and imprisonment follow; the ORB Part I entries must agree with what actually happened.
OWS'in düzgün çalışması coalescer eleman: Proper OWS operation depends on cleaning the coalescer elements, calibrating the oil monitor and correctly managing emulsions. Detergents/cleaning chemicals create emulsions in bilge water; these emulsions reduce the separating efficiency of the OWS and keep triggering the alarm. For this reason, the use of detergents in the engine room is kept under control.
OWS, bilge suyundaki yağı ayırarak yalnı: The OWS separates the oil from the bilge water so that only water below 15 ppm is discharged to sea (under permitted conditions). If the limit is exceeded, the 15 ppm oil content meter automatically stops the discharge and returns the water to the bilge tank (three-way valve). The Second Engineer ensures that the OWS and the alarm work correctly and without any bypass.
OWS, yer çekimi/coalescer prensibiyle bi: The OWS separates oil from bilge water on the gravity/coalescer principle; the oil content at the outlet is measured continuously by the Oil Content Meter (OCM/15 ppm monitor). If the oil content exceeds 15 ppm, the three-way valve automatically diverts the water back to the bilge tank (recirculation), and it cannot be pumped overboard. This automatic stopping device is a MARPOL requirement and must not be disabled.
Off-spec yakıt kullanılmak zorunda kalın: If off-spec fuel has to be used: reduce the purifier throughput, increase filtration and monitor the engine parameters closely.
Official Log Book (ÖLB), bayrak devletin: The Official Log Book (OLB) is an official book kept in the format of the flag State. Its content varies by flag but typically includes: records of crew joining/leaving, births/deaths, disciplinary incidents, flag Administration instructions, drill records, results of official inspections and important events. Every entry must be dated, timed and signed by the officer concerned/the Master.
Offshore tesise yaklaşımda DP genellikle: When approaching an offshore installation, DP is usually set up outside the zone and the system is allowed to stabilise; in the final approach phase a second independent reference is brought in. Local references such as RadaScan and CyScan are decisive at this stage for the accuracy of the position relative to the target.
Oil Discharge Monitoring and Control Sys: The Oil Discharge Monitoring and Control System (ODMCS) is mandatory on oil tankers of 150 GT and above. It continuously records the discharge rate, oil content, ship's speed and position.
Oil Mist Detector (OMD) alarmı, krank ka: An Oil Mist Detector (OMD) alarm indicates that a bearing inside the crankcase has overheated and is producing oil mist; this is a precursor of a crankcase explosion. On this alarm the crankcase doors must never be opened; wait until the engine has cooled down (usually 20-30 min). The cadet must know this lethal risk.
Oil Mist Detector, crankcase içindeki ya: The Oil Mist Detector monitors the oil mist concentration in the crankcase; when a bearing overheats and vaporizes oil, the mist increases and the OMD gives an alarm. This alarm is the early warning of impending bearing damage and a potential explosion. The Second Engineer ensures that the OMD is working and calibrated.
Oil Record Book (ORB Part I — machinery: The Oil Record Book (ORB Part I — machinery space) is the legal record of sludge and bilge management. The Chief Engineer ensures that ORB entries are correct, timely and consistent with operations.
Oil Record Book (Part I) kapsamına giren: Operations covered by the Oil Record Book (Part I) (bilge transfer, OWS discharge, sludge transfer, fuel transfer) are also entered in the ORB. These records serve as evidence for PSC and in court.
Oil mist alarmı veya sıcak yatak sonrası: Opening the crankcase after an oil mist alarm or a hot bearing carries a special risk: a sudden inflow of air (oxygen), a hot surface and atomized oil vapor can trigger a crankcase explosion. For this reason, after the engine is stopped, a cooling-down period of at least 15-30 minutes is allowed, the crankcase doors are opened slowly and from the side, and no one stands in line with a door being opened.
Oil mist alarmında motor yavaşlatılır/du: On an oil mist alarm, the engine is slowed down/stopped and, because of the crankcase explosion risk, a strict waiting period is applied to let the bearings cool (generally at least ~30 minutes); the crankcase doors are NOT OPENED until bearing temperatures have stabilized. Admitting fresh air into a hot crankcase can trigger a secondary explosion.
Oil-fired kazanda brülör (burner) yakıtı: In an oil-fired boiler the burner atomises the fuel, a fan supplies the air and firing is switched on and off according to the steam pressure (on/off or modulating). The air/fuel ratio is optimised for efficiency and emissions; too little air causes soot and smoke, too much air causes a loss of efficiency.
Oil-lubricated sistemlerde, çevre düzenl: Because of environmental regulations (in particular the US VGP), EAL (Environmentally Acceptable Lubricant) oils are increasingly used in oil-lubricated systems. The Chief Engineer applies oil and seal management suited to the system type.
Oil-lubricated stern tube sisteminde, ya: In an oil-lubricated stern tube system, the oil pressure is set by the gravity (header) tank so as to balance the seawater pressure at the aft seal. Depending on the draft, the tank height keeps the stern tube pressure slightly above sea pressure; in this way seawater cannot enter and the oil stays under control.
Oil-lubricated stern tube ve onaylı seal: On ships with an oil-lubricated stern tube and an approved seal system, class requires regular oil analysis for extending the tail-shaft survey interval (Extended Tail Shaft Survey). Analysis results must be within the acceptance criteria and the trend must not deteriorate.
Oksijen eksikliği: çelik paslanması (oks: Oxygen deficiency: rusting of steel (consumes oxygen), cargo oxidation/off-gassing (e.g. steel, coal, agricultural products), inert gas and microbial activity. Toxic gases: H₂S (decaying organic matter, slops), CO (incomplete combustion, self-heating cargo), cargo vapors (VOC). Flammable gases: hydrocarbon vapor (tankers), methane. From the previous use of the space, the Chief Officer anticipates which hazard is likely.
Okunan değerlerden maksimum ve minimum f: The difference between the maximum and minimum readings is calculated. This difference must be below the limits set by the maker.
Okyanus geçişlerinde great circle (büyük: On ocean passages, the great circle gives the shortest distance; however, because of high-latitude risks (ice, storms), a composite great circle or a rhumb line may be preferred. The Second Officer determines the route leg by leg, balancing distance, fuel, weather and safety, and places each waypoint at a safe distance from dangers.
Olay sonrası P&I Club (sorumluluk sigort: After an incident the P&I Club (liability insurer) and, where necessary, the H&M underwriters are informed as soon as possible. The Club gives guidance on appointing a surveyor, legal representation and the protest strategy. The Master acts in coordination with the Club's correspondent.
Olay sonrası kök neden analizi ve düzelt: Post-incident root cause analysis and corrective action prevent the same emergency from recurring. Open and honest reporting is the foundation of a learning organization.
Olay, ISM madde 9 kapsamında raporlanır: The event is reported under ISM section 9 and a root cause analysis is carried out. The VDR (Voyage Data Recorder) data is preserved (the recording is saved or backed up so that it is not overwritten), and the logs, ECDIS replay and statements are archived. The Master gives honest and complete information to the flag state's casualty investigation (Casualty Investigation Code), to the P&I/H&M process and, if necessary, to judicial proceedings.
Olayda ekipman arızası yoktur; hata tama: There was no equipment failure; the error came entirely from a breakdown in communication about the meaning, timing and confirmation of the order.
Oluklu (chevron/herringbone) desen türbü: The corrugated (chevron/herringbone) pattern creates turbulent flow and increases the heat transfer coefficient. The U value can be 3–5 times that of shell-and-tube heat exchangers.
Olumsuz değerlendirmeler somut örneklerl: Negative assessments must be backed by specific examples and must not be made personal. Feedback is given as soon as possible after the event, wherever possible.
On a man-overboard (MOB) alarm, raise th: On a man-overboard (MOB) alarm, raise the alarm, mark the position and maintain visual contact with dedicated lookouts. The bridge selects a recovery manoeuvre appropriate to when the casualty was seen, sea room, traffic and ship response. Prepare the approved recovery equipment and coordinate communications; a named turn is not automatically suitable for every situation.
On a steam-turbine LNG carrier, boil-off: On a steam-turbine LNG carrier, boil-off gas (BOG) from the LNG cargo can supply the boilers. The boiler, turbine, condenser and feed pump form the basic Rankine-cycle loop. Other LNG carriers use different propulsion arrangements; identify the actual installation before applying operating instructions.
On the order to stand by for mooring or: On the order to stand by for mooring or unmooring, the Bosun briefs the station team and prepares the planned lines and leads. Inspect fairleads, rollers and equipment, test winches under the approved procedure, confirm communication and lighting, and wear the required protective equipment. Keep personnel clear of bights and potential line recoil paths.
On-deck reefer container'ların plug bağl: The plug connections, air circulation and access routes of on-deck reefer containers are checked. Deck cargo must not obstruct escape routes or access to equipment; this is both a safety issue and an inspection issue.
Onarılan ekipman devreye alınmadan önce: Repaired equipment is tested before it is put back into service: pumps undergo tightness and pressure tests, valves a tightness test, and welded/flanged lines a hydrostatic test. On first start-up (commissioning), vibration, noise, temperature and leaks are watched; the equipment is stopped immediately if there is any abnormality. Commissioning is carried out under the supervision of an engineer.
Onay sadece bir imza atma işlemi değildi: Approval is not just a matter of signing; the trainer makes an assessment by observing the cadet's competence. The trainer looks for answers to the questions "Can the cadet do it, has the cadet understood it, is the cadet working safely?". For this reason, the cadet should submit entries for signature at regular intervals (e.g. weekly) and not leave them until the end of the voyage.
Onay sürecinde stajyer proaktif olmalı,: In the approval process, the cadet should be proactive and obtain signatures regularly without waiting for the end of the voyage. Trying to get hundreds of pages accumulated by the end of the voyage signed at the last minute is risky and also lowers the quality of the assessment.
Onaylı CAMO/TAM tablosundan güç üretimi,: The status of power generation, bus-ties, thrusters, PRS, sensors, UPS, cooling and auxiliary systems is taken from the approved CAMO/TAM table. Each item of equipment is lined up according to the table and cross-checked by an independent person.
Onaylı Chief Engineer Survey (CHE) yetki: Where approved Chief Engineer Survey (CHE) authority exists, certain CMS items may be opened up, examined and reported on by the Chief Engineer; the surveyor confirms this. This authority is an important tool for survey economy.
Onaylı PMS scheme'i altında, makine bakı: Under an approved PMS scheme, machinery maintenance is accepted as evidence for class surveys. The Chief Engineer ensures that PMS records (work order, date, measurements, remarks, spare parts used) are complete and consistent with the actual situation on site.
Onaylı cargo plan, loadicator çıktıları,: The approved cargo plan, loading computer printouts, ullage reports and change records are filed. These records are evidence for internal audits as well as for SIRE, CDI and PSC inspections.
Onboard hızlı test kitleri (su tespiti i: Onboard quick test kits (crackle test/hot plate for detecting water, a titration kit for TBN, a Karl Fischer-type kit for water) allow an immediate assessment, while laboratory analysis gives the definitive result. The two are used together.
Onboard training, drill'lerle sınırlı de: Onboard training is not limited to drills: junior personnel are developed continuously with toolbox talks, short training videos, CBT (computer-based training) modules, hands-on lessons on equipment and the "shadow watch" (a supervised watch). The Master ties training to a schedule and records it, because PSC and vetting examine training records as evidence that the system is alive.
Operasyon başlamadan Reis; PPE kontrolü: Before the operation starts, the Bosun reviews PPE (hard hat, safety shoes, gloves, high-visibility vest), lighting, escape routes, the working order of equipment and the points where the crew and stevedores interact. In cargo operations, coordination between the crew and shore workers (stevedores) is a significant factor in accidents.
Operasyon bitince pilot ladder dikkatlic: When the operation is over, the pilot ladder is recovered carefully and stored in a dry, ventilated place, without tension or crushing; storing it wet or twisted rots the ropes. While recovering the ladder, the AB checks it for damage (broken fibers, cracked steps) and reports any defect found. The gangway/accommodation ladder is brought to its stowed position and secured.
Operasyon boyunca sürekli gözetim, seviy: Continuous supervision, level monitoring and staged tank changes are applied throughout the operation. The moments of highest overflow risk are tank changes and the final topping-up.
Operasyon süresince Birinci Zabit (veya: Throughout the operation, the Chief Officer (or cargo officer) takes draft, list and trim readings at each stage; loading rate, ballast rate and ullage measurements are recorded. If a deviation is noticed, the operation is slowed down or stopped. Drips, spillage and hose/pipe leaks are monitored continuously; any marine pollution is reported immediately.
Operasyon sırasında parsel değişikliği,: If there is a change of parcel, a rate restriction or a suspicion of contamination during the operation, the plan is revised, the loading computer is run again and the revised plan is approved again. Every revision is recorded with the date and time.
Operasyon öncesi alan gevşek eşyalardan: Before the operation the area is cleared of loose items; the fire team and the FFA (foam) are kept ready. The wind (relative wind) and communications are coordinated with the pilot.
Operasyon öncesi pre-bunker toplantısı y: Before the operation a pre-bunkering meeting is held; the tank sequence, rate and emergency stop are agreed. Pumping starts slowly and topping-up is controlled by hand. Scupper plugs and bonding are in place.
Operasyon, permit-to-work ile başlatılır: The operation is started under a permit to work; all isolations are verified, the responsible persons sign, and the isolation is maintained until the job is finished. At a watch change, the incoming team confirms the isolation.
Operasyon, yetkin (IMCA standartlarına u: The operation is carried out by a competent dive team (meeting IMCA standards) under an approved dive plan. The plan covers the task, depth, duration, communications, emergency and decompression aspects. The Chief Engineer ensures that, on the ship's part, the machinery systems are prepared in accordance with the plan.
Operasyon; süpürme, deniz suyu yıkama, t: The operation consists of sweeping, washing with seawater, rinsing with fresh water (especially for salt/odor), drying and, if necessary, paint touch-up. The Bosun directs the team, sets the sequence and confirms that each stage has been completed. Dryness is critical, especially for grain/steel cargoes.
Operasyonda yüksek sea margin (hedef hız: A high sea margin in operation (an increased power requirement for the target speed) shows a deviation from the design assumptions. This deviation usually comes from fouling, propeller damage, wrong trim or a loss of machinery efficiency, and makes the practical effect of the EEDI visible.
Operasyonel hazırlık; ekipmanın hem çalı: Operational readiness means that the equipment both works and can be used by the personnel. The Safety Officer periodically tests the integrated operation of the davit motor, winch brake, limit switches, embarkation ladder, emergency lighting and general alarm. Whether a lifeboat can be launched depends not only on its engine running but on the whole davit-brake-falls chain.
Operasyonlar doğru kodla, zamanında işle: Operations are entered on time with the correct code; every page is signed by the Master. The entries must agree with what actually happened.
Operating water (kumanda suyu), separatö: Operating water drives the hydraulic mechanism of the separator: it opens and closes the sliding bowl bottom (desludge) and holds the bowl in the closed position. Clean fresh water (at the appropriate pressure and flow) is generally used; dirty operating water or operating water at insufficient pressure leads to incomplete desludging or to the bowl not closing properly.
Operatör seviyesinde (HMI level) grafik: At operator level (HMI level), graphic displays, trend displays and alarm management are provided.
Optik smoke dedektörleri zamanla toz, is: Over time, optical smoke detectors lose sensitivity or give false alarms because of dust, soot and insect buildup. The ETO cleans the detectors periodically in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions (compressed air, a soft brush or a special cleaner). In addressable systems, the panel reports the contamination level of each detector; when the threshold is exceeded, it gives a "compensation limit" warning and the detector needs cleaning or replacement.
Optimum trim, gövde direncini azaltarak: Optimum trim reduces hull resistance and lowers fuel consumption. Trim optimization software recommends the most efficient trim for the cargo/draft condition. The Chief Engineer helps the ship get close to this optimum through ballast management and cargo distribution.
Orantısal Kazanç (Kp): Düşük Kp → yavaş: Proportional gain (Kp): low Kp → slow response, large offset. High Kp → fast response, oscillation. Very high Kp → unstable system.
Organizasyonel açıdan, ertelenen aksiyon: Organisationally, because the close-out of deferred actions was not followed up, open risks were carried over from watch to watch.
Orifis plakası, boru içine yerleştirilen: An orifice plate is a disk with a hole, fitted in the pipe, which restricts the fluid and creates a pressure difference. This difference is proportional to the square of the flow rate. It is cheap and simple, but it causes a permanent pressure loss.
Orta devirli motorlar MDO/MGO ile çalışa: Medium-speed engines can run on MDO/MGO and can also burn HFO with heating and viscosity control. Generator engines can change over to light fuel (MGO) during manoeuvring and in port. Heating the fuel to the correct viscosity (about 10–15 cSt at injection) is critical for atomisation and efficiency.
Orta devirli motorlar esneklik ve kompak: Medium-speed engines offer the advantages of flexibility and compactness. They are connected to the propeller through a reduction gear or electric propulsion.
Ortak bir terminoloji ve iletişim disipl: A common terminology and communication discipline prevent misunderstanding at a critical moment. Radio/telephone communication is carried out by the closed-loop (repeat back and confirm) method.
Ortak sıhhi alanlar (common heads / show: Common sanitary areas (common heads/showers) are the areas with the highest infection risk and are disinfected at least twice a day. The inside of the toilet bowl is cleaned with red-coded equipment, and washbasin and shower surfaces with yellow-coded equipment. Particular attention is paid to toilets, shower trays, taps and door handles. The disinfectant is left on the surface for the contact time stated on the label.
Ortak çalışma dili olarak İngilizce stan: Standard English terminology is used as the common working language. Junior personnel are encouraged to ask questions and to challenge (assertiveness). Cultural awareness training is part of the ERM programme.
Otel + propulsion yüküne göre DG sayısı: The number of generators on line is adjusted by the PMS to the hotel and propulsion load; synchronisation and balanced load sharing are ensured. The blackout recovery test is carried out.
Otomasyon ağındaki iletişim arızaları (k: Communication faults in the automation network (cable, terminal or node failure) lead to loss of I/O and spurious alarms. Using fieldbus diagnostic tools, the ETO checks node status, the telegram error rate and the termination resistors. In a redundant ring topology, it is verified that when one cable breaks, the network continues to be supplied via the other path.
Otomasyon sisteminin doğruluğu sensörler: The accuracy of the automation system depends on the accuracy of its sensors. The ETO calibrates PT100/PT1000 temperature sensors against a reference thermometer, pressure transmitters with a dead-weight tester or a calibrated reference gauge, and level sensors (capacitive, ultrasonic, float) against known reference levels. On transmitters with a 4–20 mA output, the zero and span are adjusted.
Otomasyon ve alarm sistemleri, geminin \: Automation and alarm systems are the ship's "nervous system"; by making sure this system works quietly but reliably, the ETO safeguards both the unattended safety of the engine room and the safety of the whole ship's operation. A good ETO reads the trend before the alarm comes and intervenes before the failure grows.
Otomatik desludge'a rağmen bowl ve disc: Despite automatic desludging, the bowl and disc stack become coated over time with sticky sludge, asphaltenes and scale; periodically (according to the PMS interval), the separator is stopped and the bowl is dismantled and cleaned by hand. Before dismantling, the separator is stopped and allowed to cool down, and LOTO/energy isolation is applied; the high-speed bowl is not opened until it has come to a complete stop.
Otomatik devreye girme süresi ve besleme: The automatic connection time and the supply duration are verified from the applicable SOLAS II-1 provisions for the ship type, tonnage and date of build; the requirements for cargo ships and passenger ships are not the same.
Otomatik drain, intercooler temizliği ve: Automatic drains, intercooler cleaning and the safety valve test are carried out regularly; the air receivers are subject to periodic internal inspection. Oil carry-over creates a risk of fire and explosion.
Automatic drains, intercooler cleaning and the safety valve test are carried out; the air receivers are subject to periodic internal inspection. Oil carry-over creates a risk of fire and explosion.
Automatic drains, intercooler cleaning and the safety valve test are carried out; the air receivers are subject to periodic inspection.
Automatic drains, intercooler cleaning and the safety valve test are carried out; the air receivers are subject to periodic inspection. The risk of oil carry-over is monitored.
Otomatik dümen (autopilot) kullanılırken: Even when the autopilot is in use, the officer must ensure that it is possible to change over to manual steering immediately when there is a risk of collision or a maneuver is required. SOLAS V/24 and V/26 require prompt changeover to manual control and regular testing of the steering systems.
Otomatik gergili (auto-tension) vinçler: Auto-tension winches try to keep the line at a preset tension: they heave in if the tension falls and pay out (render) if it rises. However, with tide and draft changes, continuous rendering can compromise the ship's safety; many terminals therefore prohibit auto-tension while the ship is moored.
Otomatik gerilim özellikli vinçler, hala: Winches with automatic tensioning keep the line tension at the set value. They compensate for the effects of tide, changes in loading and wind.
Otomatik güncellemelerin yetişmediği aci: For urgent situations that the automatic updates do not cover in time (e.g. a new NAVAREA warning, a danger not yet included in the ENC), points, lines, areas and text can be added with the ECDIS manual update function. The Second Officer records these manual entries with their date and source and deletes the temporary ones when they expire.
Otomatik pilot devredeyken dümenci dümen: While the autopilot is engaged, the helmsman may leave the helm, but stays in the "stand by the wheel" position if the OOW so orders. In the event of a steering gear failure, an alarm sounds; the helmsman is immediately ready to change over to an alternative steering mode/emergency steering and alerts the OOW.
Otomatik senkronizasyon sistemleri freka: Automatic synchronising systems adjust the frequency and voltage difference automatically and close the breaker at the right moment.
Otomatik senkronizer, gerilim, frekans v: An automatic synchroniser checks the voltage, frequency and phase angle conditions automatically and closes the breaker at the right moment.
Otomatik seviye vericiler: radar (mikrod: Automatic level transmitters are of the radar (microwave, non-contact, accurate), float (mechanical), capacitance and hydrostatic pressure types. The data goes to the display in the cargo control room and to the stability computer, and is cross-checked with the manual UTI.
Otomatik sistem (radar/CPAS) ile manuel: Readings from the automatic system (radar/CPAS) are compared periodically with manual (CTS) readings; if they differ, the calibration of the system is questioned. Custody transfer measurements are usually taken together with the shore surveyor.
Otomatik suppression sistemi tetiklendiğ: When the automatic suppression system is triggered, it typically brings the fan and dampers to a safe position; however, the cook must also know how to do this manually. During a fire, stopping the fan and closing the dampers are the basic steps for containing the fire within the galley.
Otomatik ters yıkamalı filtre ve fark ba: An automatic back-flushing filter and its differential pressure alarm are the first indication of an increase in solid contaminants. A rapid increase in the filter differential pressure usually signals a drop in separator performance.
Otopilot (autopilot) entegrasyonu elektr: Autopilot integration is easier with an electric telemotor.
Otopilot (heading control), gyro ve düme: The autopilot (heading control) depends on the gyro and the rudder feedback system; the ETO checks the electrical health of the autopilot–gyro–steering chain and the reliability of manual/automatic changeover. The rudder angle indicator and the RPM indicators must be correctly calibrated.
Otto çevriminde ısı ekleme ve atma süreç: In the Otto cycle the heat addition and heat rejection processes are modelled as isochoric.
Over-reliance yalnız pencereden dışarı b: Over-reliance is not only failing to look out of the window: accepting the automatic route check as absolute, believing two screens fed from the same source are independent, thinking that zooming in on the chart increases accuracy and reading a predicted position as a measured fix are also examples of over-reliance.
Over-speed koruması, governor (devir reg: Overspeed protection is integrated with the governor (speed regulator). A governor fault causes either hunting (speed oscillation) or overspeed through loss of control. On generators, load sharing and frequency control depend on the governor; governor maintenance and the overspeed test are therefore planned together.
Overload rölesi NC kontağı seri bağlanır: The NC contact of the overload relay is connected in series; it breaks the circuit on overload.
Overriding authority, kaptanın emniyet,: Overriding authority is the Master's authority to take any decision he or she considers necessary for safety, security and the protection of the marine environment, regardless of the instructions of the company or the charterer. ISM Code 5.2 requires the company to confirm this authority in writing in its SMS. This makes the Master not "the company's order-taker" but the ultimate decision-maker on safety.
Overriding authority; charterer'in fast: The overriding authority is used in situations such as a charterer's request for fast steaming, cost pressure from the company, a terminal operator pressing for haste, a charterer's order to an unsafe port, a faulty pilot manoeuvre, or pressure to sail with deficient equipment. The decision is justified as "professional judgement" and reported to the company in writing.
Overscale, underscale, no data, better-s: The overscale, underscale, no data, better-scale ENC available and datum shift indications are read for what they mean. Zooming in does not create new detail; when the source/compilation scale is exceeded, positions and object geometry can give a false sense of precision.
Overside work, working aloft, enclosed s: In high-risk work such as overside work, working aloft, enclosed spaces and mooring, inexperienced personnel are never allowed to work alone. The Bosun pairs them with an experienced team member and supervises them directly. Supervision continues until competence has been proven.
Overside çalışmada, ışıklı can simidi +: During overside work, a lifebuoy with light and line is kept ready right next to the work position; the rescue boat/MOB boat crew is also kept ready. If a person falls into the sea, the lookout immediately throws the lifebuoy, shouts "man overboard", keeps the person in sight and informs the bridge. Overside work is generally not done while the ship is under way; at anchor, in port or other stationary conditions are preferred.
P (Oransal): Anlık hataya orantılı çıkış: P (proportional): output proportional to the instantaneous error. It responds quickly but leaves a steady-state error (offset).
P (Oransal): Hata büyüklüğüyle orantılı: P (proportional): produces an output proportional to the size of the error. It gives a fast response but leaves a steady-state error.
P (Oransal): Hatanın büyüklüğüyle orantı: P (proportional): produces an output proportional to the size of the error. It leaves a steady-state error (offset).
P (Orantısal): Hatanın büyüklüğüyle oran: P (proportional): produces an output proportional to the size of the error. It responds quickly but leaves a steady-state error (offset).
P&I kulüp kuralları ve H&M poliçeleri, s: P&I club rules and H&M policies require the assured to report an incident "without undue delay". Late notification can weaken cover to the extent that the club or the insurer suffers prejudice. As soon as an incident occurs, the Master informs the company (DPA / operations); the company in turn formally notifies the H&M and P&I insurers. Many companies keep an emergency contact list from which the Master can call the P&I correspondent directly.
P&I, geminin üçüncü taraflara karşı soru: P&I is a system of mutual insurance covering the ship's third-party liabilities; it works through clubs formed by shipowners. P&I cover typically includes: liability for cargo damage or loss, injury or death of crew and third parties, pollution (oil pollution) liability, wreck removal, the 1/4 collision liability not covered by H&M, port and dock damage, fines, and expenses such as stowaways and repatriation.
P&ID (Piping and Instrumentation Diagram: A P&ID (Piping and Instrumentation Diagram) shows a system's valves, pumps, tanks, sensors and line connections with standard symbols. The cadet learns to read valve types, pump symbols, flow direction and instrument tags (PI, TI, LI, PT). The diagram simplifies the complexity of the plant in the mind.
P-F eğrisi, ekipmanın potansiyel arıza (: The P-F curve shows the process of deterioration of equipment between the potential failure (point P) and the functional failure (point F). The aim of CBM is to detect point P and carry out maintenance before point F is reached. The longer the P-F interval, the easier it is to plan maintenance.
P/V (pressure/vacuum) valfleri tankı aşı: P/V (pressure/vacuum) valves protect the tank against overpressure and vacuum; their flame screens are kept clean. The low pressure, high O2 and deck seal alarms must be active and tested.
P/V kırıcı (pressure/vacuum breaker) tan: The P/V breaker (pressure/vacuum breaker) is the last item of safety equipment protecting the tank pressure.
P/V valf setpoint'i (yay gerginliği) per: The P/V valve set points (spring tension) are tested periodically and the flame screens are cleaned. A P/V valve stuck closed leads to a tank rupture when pressure builds up.
PCB'ler ESD (elektrostatik deşarj) ve ne: PCBs are sensitive to ESD (electrostatic discharge) and moisture; they are therefore kept in antistatic bags in a dry, cool place. The ETO periodically checks the condition of critical boards in the store and watches for the risk of aging on boards with electrolytic capacitors that have been in storage for a long time.
PCC gemisi, ballast/yük dağılımı kaynakl: A PCC capsized during a turning manoeuvre because of insufficient stability caused by the ballast and cargo distribution. Lesson: on vehicle carriers the GM margin and the ballast calculation are under the Master's direct supervision; the software printout is signed and kept before the voyage.
PD pompa kapalı vanaya karşı çalışırsa b: If a PD pump runs against a closed valve, it raises the pressure without limit and bursts the line or the pump. A relief (safety/bypass) valve is therefore mandatory in every PD pump line. Unlike a centrifugal pump, a PD pump is never throttled against a closed discharge.
PLC bakımı; CPU/I/O modül LED durum kont: PLC maintenance covers checking CPU/I/O module status LEDs, tracking the battery life of battery-backed RAM, cleaning cooling fans and filters, checking the tightness of terminal connections, and controlling dust and humidity. The ETO monitors the temperature and humidity of PLC cabinets; excessive temperature shortens module life and leads to faulty I/O readings.
PLC firmware veya logic değişiklikleri k: PLC firmware or logic changes must be made in a controlled way. Before any change, the ETO backs up the existing program, implements the change with vendor approval under the management of change (MOC) procedure, and then carries out a function test. Unplanned "quick fixes" can lead to hidden faults and certification violations.
PLC programını sürekli tekrarlayan bir d: A PLC runs its program in a continuously repeating cycle: 1) read all inputs → 2) run the program → 3) update all outputs → 4) communication and housekeeping. The typical scan time is 1–50 ms.
PMS iş emirleri üç tetikleyiciyle üretil: PMS work orders are generated by three triggers: calendar-based (e.g. testing of generator safety devices every 3 months), running-hour-based (e.g. separator overhaul at 6000 hours) and condition-based (according to vibration, oil analysis or thermography results). The Second Engineer pulls the upcoming work orders from the PMS screen weekly (look-ahead list) and prioritizes them.
PMS kayıtları yalnızca şirket için değil: PMS records are evidence not only for the company but also for class and PSC (Port State Control) inspections. For equipment under CMS (Continuous Machinery Survey), open-up work carried out by the engineers can be reported to class as a "crew survey"; for this reason, photographs, measurements and clearance values before/after the work are recorded.
PMS kayıtlarının \"kâğıt üstünde\" tutul: If PMS records are kept "on paper" while the work is not done on site and this is found at a survey, it leads to cancellation of the system's approval and serious consequences. Consistency between records and actual work on site is checked.
PMS statik değildir; her arıza, her yakı: The PMS is not static; every failure, every near-miss and every recurring problem is input for revising job cards and intervals. The Chief Engineer regularly sends improvement proposals (interval changes, procedure updates, new jobs) from the ship to the office. Similar equipment failures across the fleet are passed on to all ships by the office.
PMS yazılımları (AMOS, ShipManager/StarI: PMS software (AMOS, ShipManager/StarIPS, BASSnet, Kaiko, TM Master, Mastery) models equipment as a hierarchical tree: ship → system (e.g. propulsion) → main equipment (main engine) → component (fuel injector, exhaust valve) → job (overhaul). Each job card contains the interval (hour-based, calendar-based or condition-based), the required spare parts, manpower, procedure reference and safety warnings.
PMS yazılımı iş emirleri oluşturur, bakı: The PMS software creates work orders, records the maintenance history and gives reminders of upcoming maintenance.
PMS yönetiminde Baş Mühendis'in başarısı: The Chief Engineer's success in PMS management is not just a matter of filling in software; it is ensuring that maintenance is actually done, correctly recorded and keeps the equipment reliable. A well-managed PMS minimizes unplanned failures, survey surprises and the risk of detention; it is an invisible but decisive discipline that protects the ship's technical reputation and the company's inspection performance.
PMS'te bakım türleri tanımlanır: önleyic: Maintenance types are defined in the PMS: preventive (planned, periodic), condition-based (according to measurements) and corrective/breakdown (after failure). Preventive maintenance is done as planned, before any failure; condition-based maintenance is triggered by indicators such as vibration/oil analysis.
PMS, gemideki tüm ekipmanların bakım per: The PMS is software that digitally manages the maintenance intervals, procedures and history of all equipment on board (examples: AMOS, TM Master, ShipManager, BASSnet). Maintenance intervals (running-hour or calendar based) are defined for each piece of equipment; the PMS generates the maintenance that falls due as a work order.
PMS, her ekipman için üreticinin önerdiğ: The PMS turns the maintenance intervals recommended by the manufacturer for each item of equipment (based on running hours or the calendar) into work orders. When maintenance is done, the work order is closed with the work done, the parts used, the values measured (clearance, pressure) and the running hours. The Third/Fourth Engineer enters the records of the jobs under their responsibility on time and completely.
PMS, klasın Annual, Intermediate ve Spec: The PMS is aligned with the class Annual, Intermediate and Special (5-yearly) survey cycle. Some companies, under a class-approved "Planned Maintenance Scheme for Machinery" (PMS class notation), gain the right to have part of the machinery surveys carried out on board by their own engineers. On the deck side, records such as hatch cover ultrasonic tests, mooring equipment records and LOLER-type crane records are requested at survey.
PMS, spare parça modülüyle entegredir. H: The PMS is integrated with the spare parts module. Minimum and maximum stock levels are defined for each critical part; when the ROB falls to the minimum, the system automatically proposes a requisition. Through "forward planning", the Chief Engineer brings forward the spares needs of jobs due in the next 3-6 months and reduces logistics costs with a single consolidated order.
PMS, şebeke yükünü sürekli izler; yük be: The PMS continuously monitors the network load; when the load exceeds a set threshold, it auto-starts the standby generator, parallels it and shares the load, and when the load drops, it auto-stops a machine. From the PMS HMI, the ETO checks the auto start/stop setpoints (e.g. start at 75%, stop at 30%), the start delays and the heavy consumer interlocks (confirmation that sufficient power is available before the bow thruster or mooring winches start).
PMS/ERP yazılımı (AMOS, ShipManager, Sta: PMS/ERP software (AMOS, ShipManager, Star IPS, TM Master) monitors these levels automatically and generates warnings for items that fall below the minimum. The Chief Engineer reviews these warnings weekly and turns them into requisitions.
PPE ancak doğru kullanıldığında korur. Y: PPE protects only when used correctly. Incorrectly fitted ear protection, a leaking mask or cracked goggles give a false sense of safety. The cadet must check their PPE before every use, replace it if damaged and learn to put it on and take it off correctly.
PPE bireysel sorumluluktur ama aynı zama: PPE is an individual responsibility, but it is also a visible sign of safety culture. A cadet who uses the full PPE both protects themselves and sets the right example for the team. The excuse "it's only a one-minute job" is the most frequent cause of injury.
PPE doğru seçilmeli, doğru takılmalı ve: PPE must be correctly selected, correctly worn and in good condition. Worn-out PPE, or PPE of the wrong size or class, gives no protection. The Oiler checks PPE before use (cracked goggles, torn gloves or a defective mask are not used) and selects the correct type.
PPE işe göre seçilir: chipping/grinding': PPE is selected according to the job: eye/face protection and a dust mask for chipping/grinding; ear protection for noisy pneumatic tools; suitable gloves and goggles for chemical work; a solvent mask for painting; a safety harness for work at height. A safety helmet, steel-toe shoes and coveralls are the basic outfit on deck.
PPE, doğru takıldığında ve sağlam olduğu: PPE protects only when it is worn correctly and is in good condition. The AB checks their PPE before use (cracked goggles, a worn harness or a clogged filter are not used) and replaces anything damaged. PPE is not an excuse but the last line of defense; the job is first planned to be safe, and PPE is the final layer.
PPE, işin riskine göre seçilir ve durumu: PPE is selected according to the risk of the job, and its condition is checked: hard hat, safety shoes, gloves (chemical/mechanical), eye protection, ear protection, respiratory protection, harness. Damaged PPE is not used; harnesses are subject to periodic inspection and have an expiry date.
PPE, riskin kaynakta giderilemediği duru: PPE is the last line of defense where the risk cannot be eliminated at source. Basic PPE in the engine room is safety shoes (steel toe cap), a boiler suit, ear protection (mandatory in zones above 90 dB), a hard hat, safety glasses and, depending on the situation, gloves (heat/chemical), a respirator and a face shield. Selecting PPE suitable for the work being done is critical.
PRM tahliyesi önceden planlanmazsa genel: If the evacuation of PRM passengers is not planned in advance, it also slows down the general evacuation.
PRM yolcular embarkation'da işaretlenir;: Passengers with reduced mobility (PRM) are flagged at embarkation; an assigned crew member, an evacuation chair and a refuge area are planned for each of them. As the lifts cannot be used, evacuation by the stairs is practised.
PSC (Port State Control) ve şirket denet: During PSC (Port State Control) and company inspections, whether the crew are familiar with the ship is questioned. The signed familiarization record in the TRB is the document showing that the cadet has received this training. A missing familiarization record is both an inspection finding and a lethal risk in a real emergency.
PSC denetiminde makine tarafında en sık: The most common engine-side findings in PSC inspections: ORB kept incorrectly/incompletely, OWS 15 ppm alarm failure, emergency generator not working, fire damper/quick-closing valve failure, bilge alarm disabled, and emergency fire pump starting problems.
PSC denetiminde sıkça sorulanlar: ORB do: Questions frequently asked during PSC inspections: is the ORB kept correctly, OWS 15 ppm alarm test, is the sewage system compliant with MARPOL Annex IV, garbage management plan, emergency generator weekly test, bilge alarm test. Vetting (especially on tankers) queries the TMSA elements covering engine room operations and energy management.
PSC denetimleri (Paris MoU, Tokyo MoU, U: During PSC inspections (Paris MoU, Tokyo MoU, USCG, etc.) the Master is the inspector's only official counterpart. Open, honest and documented communication is essential; hiding documents or misleading the inspector makes a detention worse. Every deficiency on Form A/B issued at the end of the inspection is recorded with a code; code "30 — detainable" means the ship is detained. The Master reports the findings at once to the DPA and the technical department and coordinates the corrective action plan with the company.
PSC denetimleri Paris MoU, Tokyo MoU gib: PSC inspections are carried out under regional agreements such as the Paris MoU and the Tokyo MoU, and ships are targeted according to their risk profile (Ship Risk Profile); high-risk ships are inspected more often and in more detail. The initial PSC inspection is a general check; if "clear grounds" (concrete grounds for suspicion) are found, it becomes a more detailed inspection. The Chief Officer aims for a clean inspection history to keep the ship's risk profile low.
PSC denetçisi MLC açısından 16 başlığı k: For the MLC, the PSC inspector checks 16 areas: minimum age, medical certification, qualifications of seafarers, SEA, use of licensed recruitment services, hours of work/rest, manning levels, accommodation, recreational facilities, food/catering, health and safety and accident prevention, on-board medical care, the on-board complaint procedure, payment of wages, financial security for repatriation and financial security for shipowners' liability. If there are "clear grounds" (a seafarer's complaint, a visible violation, an invalid document), a more detailed inspection is carried out.
PSC denetçisi PMS üzerinden emergency ve: The PSC inspector looks at the test records of emergency and safety equipment through the PMS; the SIRE 2.0 / TMSA inspector questions the integrity of the system, overdue critical jobs and whether the records match the situation on site. The Chief Engineer defends the ship in these inspections by keeping the PMS transparent and honest; behind every closed job there must always be real work and measurable evidence.
PSC inspector; changeover kaydını, BDN'l: The PSC inspector checks the changeover record, the BDNs, the in-use fuel sample and, if necessary, a spot sample taken from the system. These inspections intensify during sulfur CICs (Concentrated Inspection Campaigns).
PSC raporunda kaptan, deficiency'lerin a: In the PSC report the Master must read carefully the action codes of the deficiencies, the rectification periods and the notes on the ship. In the case of a code 30 (detention), the Master at once informs the company, the DPA, the flag state, class and the P&I/H&M side, and coordinates the survey and re-inspection process needed to lift the detention. Where justified, a formal appeal or review of the detention can be requested within the time limits set by national law and the MOU.
PSC ve ISM denetiminde denetçi, familiar: In PSC and ISM inspections, the inspector asks for the familiarization records and then goes out on deck, asking a new crew member: "Where is your muster station, where is your lifejacket, where is the fire alarm button?" If the records are complete but the person does not know, it is clear that familiarization was done "on paper" and a finding is raised.
PSC ve flag/class survey'de LSA denetimi: In PSC and flag/class surveys, LSA inspection stands on three legs: the physical condition of the equipment, the consistency of the records and the crew's competence in using it. The inspector often picks out an item (e.g. an immersion suit), asks for its expiry/test date and then compares it with the record in the logbook.
PSC ve flag/class survey'de denetçi, mus: In PSC inspections and flag/class surveys, the inspector checks that the muster list is up to date, correctly posted and consistent with the crew on board, then goes out on deck and asks a random crew member: "Where is your muster station, what is your duty, how is the rescue boat engine operated?" If the paperwork is perfect but the people do not know, there will be a finding.
PSC ve klas surveyor, bu zorunlu yedekle: PSC and class surveyors check the physical presence of these mandatory spares and that they match their certificates. A missing mandatory spare is grounds for a "deficiency" and, in serious cases, for detention. The Chief Engineer manages this list in the inventory with a separate "do-not-use without replenishment" tag.
PSC ve vetting denetiminde LSA/FFE en sı: LSA/FFE are among the areas most frequently checked in PSC and vetting inspections: expired pyrotechnics, expired immersion suit lights, an emergency fire pump that does not work and low SCBA pressure are typical findings. By ensuring that records match the actual condition on board, the Chief Officer reduces the risk of detention.
PSC ve vetting denetimlerinde çevre odak: Environmental focus points in PSC and vetting inspections: ORB/GRB/BWRB accuracy, 15 ppm alarm test, OWS function, sludge balance, incinerator records, scrubber washwater monitoring and sulfur compliance. Missing or inconsistent records are enough to get the ship detained and to damage the company's record. The Chief Engineer ensures that these records are always ready for inspection.
PSC ve vetting, ENC güncelliğini, lisans: PSC and vetting inspections check ENC status, the license situation, T&P handling and the backup arrangement. The Second Officer keeps the update records, cell status reports and manual correction records in order and ready to present. Missing chart updates are a frequent PSC finding.
PSC ve özellikle vetting denetimlerinde: In PSC inspections and especially in vetting inspections (SIRE 2.0, CDI), the condition of the engine room is an item that is scored directly and sets the overall impression. Oil-soaked insulation, dirty bilges, unlabeled chemical drums and obstructed escape routes are frequently seen non-conformity headings.
PSC, ORB ile fiziksel kanıtı karşılaştır: PSC compares the ORB with the physical evidence; a discrepancy is a reason for detention and prosecution.
PSC, bir liman devletinin (Paris/Tokyo M: PSC is a legal enforcement mechanism through which a port state (Paris/Tokyo MOU, USCG, AMSA, Black Sea MOU, etc.) inspects foreign-flagged ships in its waters for compliance with international standards. PSC has sanctions: deficiency, detention, banning. The aim is safety and the environment; the outcome is public and visible on platforms such as Equasis.
PSC, drill kaydını okumaktan çok crew'ı: PSC tests the crew rather than just reading the drill record: "Where is your muster station? What is your duty in this fire? How do you start the rescue boat engine? How do you use the EEBD?" If the answers are fluent and correct, the drill regime is real; if they are hesitant or wrong, training is inadequate whatever the record says, and a deficiency is raised.
PSC, vetting (SIRE/CDI) ve klas denetiml: In PSC, vetting (SIRE/CDI) and class inspections, PMS logs, the overdue list, function test records of critical equipment and paint/corrosion condition reports are requested. The Chief Officer ensures that records are up to date, traceable and realistic; "complete on paper but deficient on site" is the most serious finding.
PSC/klas denetiminde, açık ve telafi ted: In a PSC/class inspection, an open defect with a compensating measure is received much better than a concealed fault. Transparent defect management shows that the ship's safety culture is healthy. The Third Officer keeps the defect and work order records ready for inspection.
PTW sistemi bir kağıt egzersizi değil, ö: The PTW system is not a paper exercise; it is a ring of discipline that keeps lethal energy under control. The rigor the Chief Officer shows here makes the difference between "an accident-free voyage" and "an investigation file". No job is more urgent than a human life.
PTW süreci risk değerlendirmesini (risk: The PTW process makes a risk assessment mandatory: what hazards there are, who may be affected, what controls will be applied. When the job is finished, the permit is closed and the area returns to normal. Work cannot continue on an expired permit until it is renewed.
PTW, yüksek riskli işlerin başlamadan ön: The PTW is a formal permit system documenting that high-risk work has been systematically assessed and the necessary precautions taken before it starts. Work such as hot work, enclosed space entry, aloft work (working at height), electrical isolation and diving usually requires a separate permit. The permit defines the job, the risks, the precautions taken, the responsible person and the period of validity.
PWM (Pulse Width Modulation) tekniği ile: A sinusoidal waveform is produced with the PWM (Pulse Width Modulation) technique.
Paint locker ve kimyasal depolama MSDS'l: The paint locker and chemical storage are managed in accordance with the MSDS; leaks, spreading to the sea or deck, and fire risk are controlled. Empty chemical/paint drums are stored as operational waste and are not thrown into the sea. Antifouling paints must be compliant (AFS Convention — TBT ban).
Painter (bağlama halatı) belirli uzunluk: When the painter is pulled out to a certain length, it opens the valve of the gas cylinder; the CO₂/nitrogen mixture inflates the raft within seconds and the canister splits in two. If the raft inflates upside down, one person can right it with the righting strap. After inflation the painter stays attached to the ship; once the raft is boarded it is cut or released.
Painter line: konteyner içindeki ipin uc: Painter line: the end of the line inside the container is attached to the ship; when the ship sinks it becomes taut and the raft inflates.
Painter, gemiye bir weak link (zayıf bağ: The painter is attached to the ship through a weak link. If the ship continues to sink after the raft has inflated and is floating, the weak link breaks at a certain load and saves the raft from being dragged down with the sinking ship. The weak link must be strong enough for the raft to stay attached to the ship and inflate, but weak enough not to follow the sinking ship.
Paket halinde tehlikeli madde (IMDG kaps: The difference between dangerous goods in packaged form (within the scope of IMDG) and deck consumable chemicals is important; however, the storage logic is the same: segregation, labeling, ventilation and spill control. Waste chemicals and empty paint tins are collected separately in accordance with MARPOL Annex V.
Paralel generator'lar arasında aktif güç: Between generators in parallel, active power (kW) is shared through the governor (fuel) and reactive power (kVAr) through the AVR (excitation). The speed droop method is common: each engine lowers its frequency slightly as load increases, which shares the load proportionally. In modern PMSs, isochronous load sharing equalizes the load while keeping the frequency constant.
Paralel jeneratörlerde aktif yük (kW) go: With generators in parallel, the active load (kW) is shared through the governors and the reactive load (kVAr) through the AVRs. Unbalanced sharing overloads one set. A modern PMS (Power Management System) manages load sharing, automatic start/stop and the connection of the standby set.
Paralel çalışan jeneratörler arasında ak: Between generators in parallel, active power (kW) is shared through the governor setting and reactive power (kVAR) through the AVR (Automatic Voltage Regulator) setting.
Paralel çalışmada bir makinenin governor: In parallel operation, if one machine's governor responds slowly, a reverse power trip can occur. An incorrect AVR droop setting, on the other hand, leads to reactive power oscillation (hunting) and voltage fluctuation. The ETO eliminates these oscillations by fine-tuning the governor and AVR settings through on-site testing.
Paralele alırken frekans/voltaj/faz eşit: When paralleling, frequency, voltage and phase are matched; the load sharing must be balanced. The blackout recovery test is carried out.
When paralleling, frequency, voltage and phase are matched; enough generators are kept on line for sudden loads such as the ramp and thrusters. The blackout test is carried out.
Parallel index, sabit bir radar objesini: Parallel indexing shows the cross-track situation by following the movement of a fixed radar object against a planned PI line; it is not a copy of the electronic route line. The PI is prepared with a suitable radar-conspicuous object, the correct range and bearing, and clearing distances calculated in the passage plan.
Parallel indexing (PI), radar üzerinde s: Parallel indexing (PI) is the technique of keeping the ship on her course by drawing a parallel index line on the radar relative to a fixed reference object. For restricted waters, the Second Officer adds PI lines and clearing bearings/distances to the plan; this gives an independent position check in the event of a GPS failure.
Parametric rolling (özellikle container: The main dangers are parametric rolling (especially in container ships, in head/following seas), synchronous rolling (in beam seas, when the roll period coincides with the wave period) and broaching (loss of steering control in following seas). IMO MSC.1/Circ.1228 recommends changes of speed and heading to avoid these situations.
Parametric rolling, baş/kıç dalgalarda g: Parametric rolling occurs in head or following waves when the change in the ship's waterline form periodically varies the roll restoring moment; it builds up rapidly, especially in head/following seas, when the wave period approaches half the roll period. On container ships it can cause sudden roll angles of 30-40° and the loss of many containers.
Parametric rolling, container yükünü kat: Parametric rolling is the most dangerous condition, multiplying the loads on containers. Major losses such as ONE Apus (2020, 1816 containers lost) and Maersk Essen (2021) resulted from a combination of lashing tightness problems, inadequate patterns and neglect of weather routing.
Paris MOU New Inspection Regime, her gem: The Paris MOU New Inspection Regime assigns every ship a Ship Risk Profile (SRP): Low Risk Ship (LRS), Standard Risk Ship (SRS) or High Risk Ship (HRS). The profile is calculated from the ship type and age, flag performance (black/grey/white list), class/RO performance, the company's previous record of deficiencies and detentions, and the findings of recent inspections. LRS ships are inspected every 24–36 months, HRS ships every 5–6 months.
Paris MOU ve diğer MOU rejimlerinde D&A: Under the Paris MOU and the other MOU regimes, D&A is not a separate inspection area as such, but it is assessed indirectly under fitness for duty, rest hours and ISM implementation. The PSC officer wants to see a D&A policy in force on board, familiarisation records and test records. If "clear grounds" arise, a more detailed inspection can be carried out.
Paris ve Tokyo MoU'lar her yıl belirli b: The Paris and Tokyo MoUs run a concentrated inspection campaign (CIC) on a specific theme every year: for example MARPOL Annex VI, fire safety or stability. The Chief Engineer follows the annual CIC theme and prepares the ship specially in that area.
Part I: Enerji verimliliği tedbirleri pl: Part I: the plan of energy efficiency measures (all ships of 400 GT and above). It covers operational measures such as speed optimisation, trim optimisation, maintenance and route planning.
Part II: Yakıt tüketimi veri toplama ve: Part II: the plan for collecting and reporting fuel consumption data — IMO DCS (Data Collection System), ships of 5000 GT and above.
Part III (MEPC.346(78)): CII uygulama pl: Part III (MEPC.346(78)): the CII implementation plan — ships of 5000 GT and above. It contains the measures to be applied to achieve the target annual CII rating; a corrective action plan is mandatory for ships rated D for three consecutive years or E in one year.
Partially Enclosed: yolcu gemilerinde, d: Partially enclosed: on passenger ships, for faster boarding.
Parça manyetik alan ile mıknatıslanır. Y: The part is magnetised with a magnetic field. If there is a crack at or near the surface, the magnetic field lines leak out at the crack (flux leakage). Fine iron powder particles sprinkled on this area are attracted by the leakage flux and make the crack visible.
Parça manyetize edilir (elektromıknatıs,: The part is magnetised (with an electromagnet, a yoke or by current flow). Magnetic flux leakage occurs at a crack, and magnetic particles (iron powder) sprinkled on the area collect at the leakage and make the crack visible.
Pass a suitable heaving line to the shor: Pass a suitable heaving line to the shore team only when the receiving area is clear. A monkey’s fist must contain rope only: do not add metal, sand or other weights. Use any alternative throwing aid only if approved. After the mooring line is received and secured as ordered, check its lead and report the line status.
Passage appraisal, kalkıştan varışa ve c: The passage appraisal checks, from departure to arrival and to the contingency and abort ports, the official ENC coverage, the appropriate usage band and compilation scale, the permits, the latest updates, services such as the T&P/AVCS information overlay, and the required nautical publications.
Patojen bakteriler yaklaşık 5°C ile 63°C: Pathogenic bacteria multiply rapidly between about 5°C and 63°C (the danger zone); growth is fastest at around 37°C. The cook's basic rule is to keep food in this range for the shortest possible time. Hot food is kept above 63°C and cold food below 5°C; the total time spent in the danger zone is limited.
Paçavra ve solvent emmiş bezler; self-ig: Rags and cloths soaked with solvent are collected in metal bins with lids because of the risk of self-ignition (spontaneous combustion) and are disposed of regularly. This is a simple but vital housekeeping rule.
Pedestal roller: Halat yönlendirme makar: Pedestal roller: a roller for leading a line. It reduces friction.
Pek çok elektrik kazasının kök nedeni ek: The root cause of many electrical accidents is incomplete or unverified isolation: opening the wrong breaker, not testing for absence of voltage, or overlooking multiple supplies (e.g. a UPS, another busbar). The ETO ensures that the isolation list covers all supply sources and that absence of voltage is physically measured.
Pek çok gemi Voluntary Observing Ship (V: Many ships contribute to the Voluntary Observing Ship (VOS) scheme; observations of pressure, wind, temperature, sea state and visibility are reported in a standard format. The Second Officer monitors the calibration of the observation instruments (barometer, anemometer, thermometer) and the accuracy of the readings.
Pek çok gemide envanter, gemi yönetim ya: On many ships, the inventory is kept in the ship management software (PMS/inventory module). The Bosun keeps the physical count reconciled with the digital record; a difference between the record and the shelf points to "unrecorded consumption", theft or a recording error, and is investigated.
Performance dispute durumunda, doğru kay: In a performance dispute, correctly recorded weather data and engine parameters protect the ship from unjustified claims. The data are therefore kept complete and realistic.
Performance monitor/BITE sonucu, sea ret: The performance monitor/BITE result, the sea return and the appearance of known radar-conspicuous objects are the daily evidence of operational performance. On magnetron systems the warm-up and tuning behaviour, and on solid-state systems the self-test and module status, are followed according to the maker's manual.
Performans göstergeleri: SFOC artışı, hı: Performance indicators: an increase in SFOC, a loss of speed (at constant power) or an increase in power (at constant speed).
Performans parametreleri günlük olarak k: Performance parameters are recorded daily and compared with reference values. A gradual deviation shows fouling or wear; a sudden deviation shows a fault.
Performans testi (LES üzerinden), anten: The performance test (via an LES), checks of the antenna line of sight and cabling, the GPS input, verification of EGC reception and a test of the reserve battery are carried out. It is monitored that EGC messages are received without interruption.
Performans verileri referans koşullara (: Performance data are corrected to reference (ISO) conditions for comparison. Gradual deterioration drives maintenance planning; a sudden change triggers fault diagnosis.
Periyodik olarak numuneler shore laborat: Samples are sent periodically to a shore laboratory (spectrometric element analysis, BN, viscosity, water, contamination). The results are entered in a trend table. A sudden jump in the Fe trend triggers a scavenge port inspection of the cylinder concerned and, if necessary, an increase in the cylinder oil feed rate.
Periyodik sintine temizliği planlanır; s: Periodic bilge cleaning is planned; the oil removed is transferred to the appropriate sludge/bilge holding tank. Work in the bilges often carries an enclosed/confined space risk (low O2, hydrocarbon vapor); gas testing, ventilation and, where necessary, a permit are applied.
Periyodik yağ numune analizi (viskozite,: Periodic oil sample analysis (viscosity, water, metal particles, TBN) reveals internal wear before it shows from the outside. An increase in metals indicates bearing/piston ring wear, and water/glycol indicates a cooling water leak. The Third/Fourth Engineer assists with taking samples and following up the results.
Permit süreli ve şart bağlıdır; iş bitin: The permit is time-limited and conditional; it is canceled when the job is finished or when conditions change (weather deteriorating, sea getting up). The AB does not start work without a permit or without its conditions being met; the permit is not "paperwork" but confirmation of everyone's safety. In the toolbox talk before the job, everyone learns their role and the emergency arrangements.
Permit to Work (PTW), yüksek riskli işle: Permit to Work (PTW) is a formal system that ensures high-risk work is carried out in a controlled and authorized manner. Separate permits are issued for hot work, enclosed space entry, electrical isolation, working at height and overside work. The permit documents the hazards, the precautions taken, the persons responsible and the period of validity.
Permit to Work, yüksek riskli işin tüm ö: The Permit to Work is a written control system that ensures high-risk work does not start until all precautions have been taken. The permit for work aloft/overside contains the job description, location, risks, precautions taken (harness, fall arrest, MOB preparation), energy isolation (switching off radar/antennas, isolating the electrical supply), the appointment of a lookout, the duration and the approving officer.
Permit öncesi, işe özgü risk assessment: Before the permit is issued, a job-specific risk assessment is carried out: the previous use of the space, possible hazards, the equipment required and the emergency scenario are assessed. In a toolbox meeting, the entry team and standby personnel review their duties, the hazards and the emergency plan. The Chief Officer leads this briefing and makes sure everyone understands the "enclosed space rule".
Permit-to-Work (PTW) sistemi; enclosed s: A permit-to-work (PTW) system is mandatory for high-risk work such as enclosed space entry, hot work (welding/grinding), work aloft, work overboard and electrical isolation (LOTO — lock out, tag out). The permit carries the signatures of the person authorising the work (usually the Master or an officer appointed by him or her), the person doing it and the person verifying it; it is valid for a limited time and is closed when the work is finished.
Personelin PPE'si (kask, eldiven, çelik: Personnel PPE (helmet, gloves, steel-toe boots, lifejacket if required) is checked. Fatigue management is critical; STCW rest hours must not be violated during long maneuvers. The Chief Officer makes sure that the team is physically ready.
Personelin asgari dinlenme saatleri yasa: The minimum rest hours of personnel are protected by law: at least 10 hours of rest in any 24-hour period and at least 77 hours in any 7-day period; rest may be divided into no more than two periods, one of which must be at least 6 hours uninterrupted, and the interval between consecutive periods of rest must not exceed 14 hours. The Second Engineer draws up the watch and maintenance plan so as not to breach these limits.
Pervane (CPP ise pitch kontrolü), yağlam: The propeller (pitch control if a CPP), lubrication and seals are inspected; the propulsion motor and its insulation and the controls are tested. A function test is run before manoeuvring.
Pervane (CPP ise pitch), yağlama ve seal: The propeller (pitch if a CPP), lubrication and seals are inspected; the propulsion motor and its insulation and the controls are tested. A function test is run before manoeuvring.
Pervane cavitation, kanat yüzeyinde pitt: Propeller cavitation causes pitting (erosion) on the blade surface, noise and loss of efficiency. Excessive cavitation leads to blade damage and vibration. Regular propeller polishing and correct pitch/load management limit cavitation.
Pervane fouling ve erozyon verimi düşürd: Since propeller fouling and erosion reduce efficiency, the condition of the propeller is assessed during the in-water survey and polishing is planned. This is important for both efficiency and CII.
Pervane itkisi (ileri/geri) şaft üzerind: The propeller thrust (ahead or astern) is transmitted through the shaft to the thrust block, which transfers this axial force to the hull (seating) and moves the ship ahead or astern. Tilting-pad thrust bearings run on an oil film; their temperature and oil flow are monitored.
Pervane kanat yüzeyinde yerel basıncın s: Cavitation is the collapse of vapour bubbles formed when the local pressure on the propeller blade surface falls below the vapour pressure of the water. It causes erosion, noise, vibration and a loss of efficiency.
Pervane parlatma yüzey pürüzlülüğünü aza: Propeller polishing reduces surface roughness and increases efficiency; hull cleaning removes biofouling (accumulated marine growth). The Chief Engineer monitors the performance gain after cleaning. When removing biofouling, port environmental rules (invasive species/biocide) are observed.
Pervane verimi düşük devirde ve büyük ça: Propeller efficiency is high at low speed and large diameter. The two-stroke engine runs directly at this speed, eliminating gearbox losses. A large stroke/bore ratio (ultra-long stroke) raises the thermal efficiency above 50%.
Pervane verimi; sefer süresince fouling: Propeller efficiency falls over time in service due to fouling, erosion and cavitation pitting. Hull & propeller polishing is carried out periodically (typically every 6-12 months); this can give 3-5% fuel savings.
Pervane yükü tahmininde \"propeller law\: The "propeller law" is used to estimate the propeller load: torque ~ speed², power ~ speed³. Increasing speed a little therefore increases the power demand by the cube. A fouled hull or heavy weather makes the propeller heavy; the engine reaches the same speed with more fuel (heavy running).
Pervaneyi çevirerek gemiye itme kuvveti: It turns the propeller and gives the ship its thrust. It may be a low-speed two-stroke engine (large ships) or a medium-speed four-stroke engine (medium-sized ships). The power range is 5000–80,000 kW.
Perçinli bağlantılar kalıcıdır; kayma ve: Riveted joints are permanent and are designed for shear and bearing stresses. Today they have largely been replaced by welding and high-strength bolts, but they are still used in some applications.
Pest control, aşçının halk sağlığı ve gı: Pest control is an integral part of the cook's public health and food safety responsibility. Prevention (cleaning, cutting off access, rat guards), monitoring (traps/bait, visual inspection) and, when necessary, safe professional intervention (ULV/fumigation) form a whole; completing this with valid Ship Sanitation certificates and transparent reporting protects the ship from both an outbreak and heavy sanctions after inspections. On a well-managed ship, pests are noticed and dealt with before they become established.
Petrol/kimyasal tankerlerde OCIMF SIRE 2: For oil and chemical tankers the OCIMF SIRE 2.0 inspection, and for dry cargo the RightShip inspection, are decisive for the ship's commercial survival. The Master communicates with the vetting inspector professionally and well prepared; he or she meets observations not with defence but with explanation and corrective action. Negative observations in the vetting report can lead to the charterer rejecting the ship (vetting rejection); this directly affects the company's income.
Petrol/kimyasal tankerlerde tank atmosfe: On oil and chemical tankers, gauging without opening the tank atmosphere (closed gauging) is mandatory; otherwise gas is released and there is a risk of a flammable atmosphere. Fixed (radar/float) systems provide closed gauging; the UTI provides restricted gauging through a vapour lock valve.
Pick-up, slew, transfer ve landing safha: During the pick-up, slew, transfer and landing phases, the position, heading, thrust, list and hook load trends are monitored. The DPO is warned before a load is suddenly taken up or released; setpoint and gain changes are made only as planned.
Piezoelektrik kristal (kuvartz), basınç: A piezoelectric crystal (quartz) is a sensor that produces an electric charge when pressure is applied. Because of its very fast response it is used for cylinder pressure measurement (indicator diagrams) and dynamic pressure measurements.
Piggyback: iki panel arka arkaya kayar,: Piggyback: two panels slide one behind the other and stack on top of each other.
Pilot biniş/inişi, SOLAS V/23 ve ilgili: The pilot embarks and disembarks by a pilot ladder or combination ladder complying with SOLAS V/23 and the related regulations. The Master verifies that the equipment is rigged correctly and that lighting, a lifebuoy, a heaving line and an attending crew member are ready. Incorrectly rigged pilot ladders are a real and persistent cause of pilot deaths.
Pilot biniş/inişinde AB; ladder bölgesin: During pilot embarkation/disembarkation, the AB stands at the ladder area, watches the pilot's climb, helps if necessary with the man-ropes and the line for the pilot's bag, and keeps an eye on the safety equipment (lifebuoy, light). Full attention is maintained until the pilot is fully on deck or has climbed down into the pilot boat. The person meeting the pilot escorts them to the bridge by a safe route.
Pilot geldiğinde Master ile manevra plan: When the pilot boards, the manoeuvring plan (number of tugs, approach angle, speed, mooring order, manifold target) is shared with the Master. Tug lines are made fast securely through the Panama chocks and on the bitts.
Pilot her yıl ladder kaynaklı kazalarda: Every year pilots are injured or killed in ladder-related accidents; the main causes are incorrect securing, missing or broken steps, wrong height, missing combination arrangements and defective or worn ladders. Most of these accidents could have been prevented if the rigging rules had been followed exactly.
Pilot köprüüstüne geldiğinde MPX kartı d: When the pilot arrives on the bridge, the MPX card is completed: the passage plan, the speed profile, the expected manoeuvres, the use of tugs, berth or anchorage information, the UKC, weather and current, and the emergency/abort plan are shared. The Master gives the pilot the ship's manoeuvring data (turning circle, stopping distance, draught, propeller and rudder characteristics).
Pilot köprüüstüne çıkar çıkmaz Master-Pi: As soon as the pilot reaches the bridge, the Master-Pilot Exchange card is completed: the pilot's route, speed profile, number and arrangement of tugs, tug positions, expected UKC, weather and current, the contingency plan and communication channels are confirmed. This card is not just a bureaucratic form; it is the written evidence of shared situational awareness.
Pilot ladder düzenli görsel ve periyodik: The pilot ladder undergoes regular visual checks and periodic inspections; a worn ladder is taken out of service. The AB helps to keep the ladder clean, unpainted and labeled (manufacture/service information). A poorly maintained pilot ladder is a leading cause of fatal accidents.
Pilot ladder hazırlığı SOLAS V/23 ve IMO: Rigging of the pilot ladder is governed by SOLAS V/23 and IMO Res. A.1045(27). The number of steps, rope size, manropes, securing to strong points on deck (not with magnets), the intermediate platform, lighting, a lifebuoy with a self-igniting light and a responsible officer (usually the Third or Fourth Officer) are the essential elements of the preparation. Faulty pilot ladders are a leading cause of pilot deaths and a reason for detention (deficiency code 30) in PSC inspections.
Pilot ladder'ın su seviyesinden istenen: The pilot ladder must be adjusted to the required height above the water (usually level with the pilot boat's deck); a ladder that is too long or too short is dangerous. If a climb of more than 9 meters is required, a combination arrangement (accommodation ladder + pilot ladder) is mandatory.
