After rigging, the AB checks the ladder visually; if a step is missing, a rope is broken or a fastening is loose, it is not used.
Pilot ladder, accommodation ladder ve ga: Pilot ladders, accommodation ladders and gangways carry people every day; a defect can lead directly to a fall and death. The Bosun knows that this equipment must actually be safe, not just "look good", and manages its maintenance seriously.
Pilot ladder; basamak çatlağı/eksikliği,: The pilot ladder is checked before every use for cracked/missing steps, worn/rotten ropes, the condition of the spreaders and its overall integrity. It must be certified, undamaged and rigged at the correct height. The Bosun verifies that the combination arrangement (accommodation + pilot ladder) is safe.
Pilot ladder; sağlam yan halatlar (side: The pilot ladder consists of strong side ropes, non-slip steps that remain horizontal and, at set intervals, longer steps that prevent the ladder from twisting (spreader steps). The steps must be equally spaced, free of cracks and unpainted (paint hides cracks). The ladder is rigged securely on the ship's side; man-ropes are rigged when requested.
Pilot silindir, master valfi ve manifold: The pilot cylinder provides the control gas that opens the master valve and the manifold valves.
Pilot/accommodation ladder ve gangway iç: The pilot/accommodation ladder and the gangway are taken in and secured; otherwise they are smashed by the waves and damage the ship's hull. The crane jib is brought to a safe position and secured.
Pilotaj, uzmanlık ile nihai sorumluluğun: Pilotage is a delicate process in which expertise and ultimate responsibility work hand in hand. The Master's MPX discipline, active monitoring on the bridge and decisive intervention when needed turn the pilot's local knowledge into a safe passage.
Pilotaj/manevra öncesi steering gear tes: Before pilotage or manoeuvring, the steering gear test, the engine being ready for manoeuvring, the anchor stations being ready, the tug-making-fast team and communications are verified. The Master confirms that the bridge team and the forward and aft stations know their duties and are rested.
Pilotun gemiye çıkması, kaptanın sorumlu: The pilot coming on board does not remove the Master's responsibility. The pilot provides local expertise; but the ship's manoeuvring characteristics, her condition and her ultimate safety lie within the Master's knowledge and authority. If the Master considers that a recommendation of the pilot endangers the ship, he or she intervenes.
Pilotun planı ile geminin passage plan'ı: If there is a significant difference between the pilot's plan and the ship's passage plan, it is clarified before the manoeuvre begins. "Starting without talking" is a recurring error pattern in investigations of bridge accidents.
Piping diagram (P&ID benzeri boru devre: A piping diagram (a P&ID-type piping circuit diagram) shows the pipes, valves, pumps and instruments of a fluid system (fuel, oil, cooling water, ballast, bilge). An electrical diagram (single line diagram / wiring diagram) shows power distribution, the switchboard, breakers and motor supply lines. The general arrangement (GA) gives the general layout of the ship/engine room.
Piping diagram standart semboller kullan: A piping diagram uses standard symbols: different valve types (gate, globe, ball, butterfly, non-return/check, relief), pumps, filters, heat exchangers, tanks and instruments (pressure/temperature gauges). Lines are usually colored or labeled according to the type of fluid (FO, DO, LO, SW, FW, steam, air).
Pirinç (Cu-Zn): Korozyon direnci, işlene: Brass (Cu-Zn): corrosion resistance, machinability. Valve bodies, pipe fittings.
Piston doğrudan biyel koluna bağlıdır. P: The piston is connected directly to the connecting rod. The piston also carries the side forces.
Piston ile biyel kolu arasında crosshead: There is a crosshead mechanism between the piston and the connecting rod. The piston rod is rigidly connected to the crosshead.
Piston rod, silindir alanı ile karter (c: The piston rod passes between the cylinder space and the crankcase through the stuffing box. This prevents the dirty cylinder oil from mixing with the clean crankcase oil. The cylinder oil (high BN, a separate system) and the system/crankcase oil are independent.
Piston tacı yoğun soğutma gerektirir. So: The piston crown needs intensive cooling. Cooling medium: lubricating oil, or water (on older engines).
Piston, liner, yatak ve fuel injection e: Pistons, liners, bearings and fuel injection equipment are overhauled according to running hours; clearance and wear measurements are recorded. Cleaning and balancing the turbocharger maintains performance.
Piston/liner/yatak/fuel injection runnin: Pistons, liners, bearings and fuel injection equipment are overhauled according to running hours; clearance measurements are recorded. Cleaning and balancing the turbocharger maintains performance.
Pitch (hatve), pervanenin bir tam dönüşt: Pitch is the distance the propeller should theoretically advance in one full revolution. The diameter, number of blades and blade area ratio (BAR) determine thrust and efficiency. A large diameter and low speed increase efficiency; the number of blades affects vibration and cavitation.
Pişirme yağı yangını özellikle tehlikeli: A cooking oil fire is especially dangerous because the oil burns at a very high temperature (above its ignition point), and merely putting out the flame is not enough; to prevent the oil from re-igniting, the temperature of the surface must also be brought down. This is exactly why wet chemical systems are accepted as the standard for galleys: through saponification (oil + alkali → soapy blanket), they both extinguish the fire and prevent re-ignition.
Pişirme, patojenleri öldürmenin temel CC: Cooking is the main CCP for killing pathogens. The cook measures the core temperature at the thickest point of the food with a probe thermometer. Poultry, minced meat and stuffed products require the highest temperature; whole cuts of meat can tolerate lower ones. The thermometer is cleaned and disinfected after each measurement.
Pişmiş yemek tekrar kullanılacaksa hızlı: If cooked food is to be used again, it is cooled quickly: brought down from 60°C to 10°C within 2 hours if possible, then placed in the refrigerator. When reheating, the food is brought to ≥75°C in one go; lukewarm heating creates an ideal environment for bacteria. A dish is reheated only once, not repeatedly.
Plakalı (plate): İnce oluklu paslanmaz/t: Plate type: thin corrugated stainless steel or titanium plates; high efficiency, small volume, easy cleaning. Common for the central cooler and the L.O. cooler.
Plakalı tip, ince oluklu (chevron desenl: The plate type consists of thin corrugated (chevron pattern) stainless steel or titanium plates clamped together with gaskets. The hot and cold fluids flow in opposite directions through adjacent channels; the corrugations create turbulence and increase heat transfer. It gives a very large transfer surface in a compact volume, and the plates can be taken apart for mechanical or chemical cleaning.
Plan realistic ship-specific fire, SOPEP: Plan realistic ship-specific fire, SOPEP spill-response and man-overboard (MOB) exercises under the applicable drill schedule. Include communication and equipment checks. Debrief each exercise, assign corrective actions and verify that weaknesses have been addressed.
Plan stowage yazılımına yüklenir; GM, SF: The plan is loaded into the stowage software and the GM, SF/BM, torsion and list are checked. If a limit is exceeded, the plan is revised and sent to the terminal after the Chief Officer has approved it.
Plan, IMO Resolution A.893(21) \"Guideli: The plan is set out in detail according to IMO Resolution A.893(21) "Guidelines for Voyage Planning". These guidelines define four stages: appraisal, planning, execution and monitoring. The Second Officer prepares the first two stages; the last two are the responsibility of the whole bridge team.
Plan, hem dijital hem fiziksel ortamda t: The plan must be consistent in both digital and physical form; the waypoint list, abort points and contingency points must be the same in both.
Plan, mevcut çevre kuvvetlerine (rüzgar,: The plan assesses whether the number of lines is sufficient for the prevailing environmental forces (wind, current, swell, passing ship effect). MEG4 requires the MBL (Minimum Breaking Load) of each line and the distribution of forces relative to the SDMBL (Ship Design MBL) to be documented. The plan must be consistent with the mooring line management plan (MLMP).
Plan, terminal temsilcisi ile pre-transf: The plan is reviewed jointly with the terminal representative at the pre-transfer meeting; rate limits, the ESD procedure, communication channels and emergency stop criteria are agreed. The Master gives the final approval and all cargo officers are briefed on the plan. Everyone who attends the briefing signs.
Plan-Do-Check-Act (PDCA) döngüsü izlenir: The Plan-Do-Check-Act (PDCA) cycle is followed: setting targets, implementation, monitoring/measurement and improvement.
Planlama, liman/sefer ritmiyle uyumlanır: Planning is matched to the port/voyage rhythm: noisy or hazardous work is done outside port, painting in suitable weather and humidity conditions, and crane maintenance in a window with no cargo operations.
Planlanan rota, ECDIS'in otomatik rota k: The planned route is scanned against the safety settings with the ECDIS's automatic route check function; legs that cross the contour, contain a dangerous object or go outside the XTD are flagged. This check must also be verified visually on the bridge.
Planlı iç denetimlerde uygunsuzluklar te: Non-conformities are identified in planned internal audits and closed out with a root cause analysis and corrective and preventive action (CAPA). The records must be traceable.
Planlı switching için risk değerlendirme: For planned switching, a risk assessment is made, permission is obtained from the DPO and the Master, and the critical activity is stopped if possible. After switching, the PMS/DP mimic, load sharing, consequence analysis and alarm status are cross-checked.
Planning aşamasında waypoint'ler belirle: At the planning stage the waypoints are set, and the course alteration points, parallel index lines, contour-following lines and XTD (cross-track distance) limits are defined. There are three critical points the Master must pay particular attention to: the abort point, the contingency anchorage and the point of no return.
Plansız (arıza kaynaklı) işlerde de aynı: The same discipline applies to unplanned (breakdown) jobs: first, an effort is made to understand the root cause of the failure, and unnecessary replacement of parts is avoided. Before the job, the manual of the machine/system (the manufacturer's technical manual) is studied; in particular, torque values, tolerance ranges and the assembly sequence are taken from it.
Plansız arıza (breakdown) durumunda İkin: In an unplanned breakdown, the Second Engineer makes the situation safe (isolation, fire/leak control), informs the Chief Engineer, decides together with the Chief Engineer on a temporary/permanent repair and, if necessary, calls in company/maker technical support. Temporary repairs are recorded and a permanent solution is planned.
Plastik HER ZAMAN denize atılması yasakt: Discharge of plastics into the sea is ALWAYS prohibited; they are retained on board and delivered to a shore reception facility. Food waste may be discharged at specified distances, depending on the distance from land and on whether it has been comminuted (outside Special Areas, generally >12 nm; comminuted >3 nm). The Chief Officer makes the discharge decision in accordance with the regulations.
Plate tipi veya shell-tube tipi ısı eşan: A plate or shell-and-tube heat exchanger is used. The vapour is condensed with cooling water in the condenser to obtain fresh water.
Plate ve shell-and-tube tipi ısı değişti: Plate and shell-and-tube heat exchangers are used. The cadet learns that cooling efficiency drops because of fouling (clogging/deposits), and that the time for cleaning is determined by monitoring the differential pressure and the temperature difference.
Platinin elektrik direncinin sıcaklıkla: It is based on the electrical resistance of platinum changing linearly with temperature. The Pt100 (100 Ω at 0 °C) is the most commonly used type. It gives high accuracy (±0.1 °C), but its response time is slower than that of a thermocouple.
Plug ve soketler ısınma/oksitlenme açısı: Plugs and sockets are inspected for heating and oxidation (with a thermal camera if necessary); a loose connection creates a risk of arcing and fire. The load distribution is monitored.
Plug çalışmalarında uygun izolasyon/LOTO: Proper isolation and LOTO are applied when working on plugs; refrigerant leak detection is carried out.
Pmax dengesizliği; injector arızası, fue: Pmax imbalance points to causes such as injector faults, fuel cam timing drift, a leaking exhaust valve seat, T/C imbalance or ring blow-by. The Chief Engineer inspects the unbalanced cylinder as a priority and opens a PMS work order.
Pneumatic chipping hammer, needle scaler: Pneumatic chipping hammers, needle scalers, angle grinders and disc sanders are the most common tools. The Bosun checks the appropriate PPE (goggles, ear protection, mask, gloves, chaps), the daily check of electric/pneumatic tools, hose connections and grounding. Use of a grinder that requires a hot work permit (especially on a tanker deck) needs the approval of the Chief Officer + Master + Chief Engineer.
Pnömatik ve elektrikli aletler (needle g: Pneumatic and electric tools (needle gun, disc grinder, sandblasting) produce high noise, vibration and flying particles. The AB carries out the pre-use check of the tool (air hose, disc condition, guard), wears the correct PPE and isolates the work area from its surroundings. Disc grinding produces sparks; keep away from flammable materials and paint thinner.
Pod seal arızası su girişi ve büyük onar: A pod seal failure means water ingress and a major repair; multiple pods give redundancy that supports safe manoeuvring.
Pod seal/yatak izlenir (seal sızıntısı k: Pod seals and bearings are monitored (seal leakage is critical), the insulation and cooling of the electric motor are checked, and azimuth control and feedback are calibrated.
Point of no return (PNR), yakıt/zaman aç: The point of no return (PNR) is the point beyond which turning back is no longer possible in terms of fuel/time; it is critical especially on long ocean passages and in ice navigation.
Polarization Index (PI = 10 dakika IR /: The Polarization Index (PI = 10-minute IR / 1-minute IR) shows how clean and dry the insulation is; PI < 1 indicates wet/contaminated insulation and PI > 2 indicates healthy insulation. The ETO corrects the measurement for temperature (40°C reference) and keeps a trend record. Low values require drying with the space heater.
Politika tipik olarak \"zero tolerance\": The policy is typically built on the principle of zero tolerance: possessing or using drugs on board, or working under their influence, is strictly prohibited and usually results in summary dismissal. For alcohol, most modern companies apply a "dry ship" policy (completely dry, 0.00 BAC) or an upper limit in line with OCIMF recommendations. The Master confirms that every new crew member joining the ship has read and signed the policy (familiarisation).
Politikanın kapsamı tüm mürettebat, kapt: The policy covers the whole crew, every rank including the Master, and also contractors, repair technicians and riding squads who come on board. The Master is not exempt from the zero-tolerance policy; the principle of leading by example requires the Master to be both the person who enforces the policy and the person who complies with it.
Pompa dairesi, boya deposu ve akü odası: Hazardous spaces such as the pump room, paint store and battery room are swept continuously by mechanical (explosion-proof) ventilation to prevent the build-up of flammable gas. Fire dampers close the ducts in a fire, isolating flames and smoke and making the space tight for fire extinguishing.
Pompa emişindeki mevcut net pozitif emme: If the net positive suction head available at the pump suction (NPSHa) falls below the value the pump requires (NPSHr), the liquid vaporises and cavitation occurs; this causes impeller erosion, noise, vibration and loss of flow. The risk rises with hot or volatile liquids, a blocked strainer or a high suction lift.
Pompa motoru ile pompa arasındaki coupli: The coupling alignment between the pump motor and the pump is checked with a dial gauge or laser; misalignment seriously shortens bearing and seal life. The measurement is interpreted allowing for the difference between the cold and hot (operating) conditions.
Pompa sistemleri yedekli (duty/standby): Pump systems are designed with redundancy (duty/standby); if one pump fails, the standby pump cuts in automatically or manually. The cadet learns the auto-start logic and why critical services have redundancy.
Pompa start/stop kontrolü: START butonu: Pump start/stop control: when the START button (NO) is pressed, the pump contactor is energised. When the STOP button (NC) is pressed, the circuit is broken. The seal-in (holding) contact is an auxiliary contact of the pump contactor itself and keeps the circuit made after START is released.
Pompa ve fanların güç tüketimi hızın küp: The power consumption of pumps and fans is proportional to the cube of the speed: P ∝ N³. Reducing the speed by 20% reduces the power consumption by 49%.
Pompa, fan veya kompresör gibi harici bi: An external device such as a pump, fan or compressor moves the fluid. The heat transfer coefficient is much higher than in natural convection.
Pompa: Kondenser çıkışındaki doymuş/sübs: Pump: raises the saturated or subcooled water from the condenser outlet to boiler pressure. Although the pump work is relatively small, it should not be neglected in high-pressure cycles.
Pompalar, T/C, jeneratörler, separator v: Periodic vibration measurements (ISO 10816 standard) on pumps, T/Cs, generators, separators and shaft bearings are recorded. A rising trend indicates a bearing or alignment problem. Thermography cameras detect hot spots in electrical switchboards, bearings and steam piping.
Pompalar, fanlar, kompresörler ve separa: Pumps, fans, compressors and separators have a steady sound and vibration signature. A change in this signature (a new hum, knocking, a screeching sound) is a sign of bearing wear, imbalance, cavitation or a loose connection. Through experience, the Oiler knows "what normal sounds like" and catches deviations early.
Pompanın bağımsız konumu kritiktir: maki: The independent location of the pump is critical: in an engine room fire, the main pumps may be inaccessible; in this scenario, the emergency fire pump continues to supply pressure to the fire main. SOLAS specifies the pump's capacity and requires a minimum pressure at specified fire hydrants.
Pontoon tip: tek parça paneller vinçle k: Pontoon type: single-piece panels are lifted by crane; common on container ships.
Porsiyon disiplini hem yeterli enerji ve: Portion discipline ensures both that enough energy is provided and that waste/excessive cost is avoided. The cook calibrates portions by observing consumption: constant leftovers indicate overproduction, and pots that are emptied indicate too little. It is important that crew members doing physical work get enough calories; budget discipline must not turn into underfeeding.
Porsiyon disiplini, hem bütçe hem de gıd: Portion discipline matters both for the budget and for food waste (food waste under MARPOL Annex V). By observing consumption data, the cook calibrates the quantity cooked; constant leftovers indicate overproduction, while pots that are emptied indicate too little. If leftover food is safe, it is used appropriately at the next meal; if not, it is disposed of in accordance with the Annex V rules.
Port State Control (Paris MOU, Tokyo MOU: A Port State Control inspector (Paris MOU, Tokyo MOU, USCG and others) tests the ship's ISM and ISPS compliance both through documents and on site. For ISM: the validity of certificates, drill records, equipment maintenance records and whether there are open NCs; for ISPS: the validity of the ISSC (International Ship Security Certificate), the gangway watch and access control, the security records and the presence of the CSR are examined. If there are "clear grounds", a more detailed inspection is opened.
Port State Control ve bayrak devleti den: Port State Control and flag State inspectors examine galley hygiene, temperature records, the arrangement of the stores and the cook's competence under the MLC. If a deficiency is found, rectification is required; serious hygiene defects can lead as far as detention of the ship. Regular internal inspection is the way to be ready for a surprise external inspection.
Portable sülfür analizörü ile hızlı tara: A quick screening can be carried out with a portable sulfur analyzer; in a suspicious case, laboratory analysis is requested. The Chief Engineer keeps the records and the sample chain ready for inspection.
Portable yangın söndürücüler (foam, dry: Portable fire extinguishers (foam, dry powder, CO2) are checked for position, pressure gauge, seal, expiry and service date; they undergo annual inspection and periodic hydrostatic testing (generally every 10 years). The presence of fire hydrants, hoses, nozzles and the international shore connection is checked, and the fire pump and emergency fire pump are function tested.
Post-incident (serious marine incident s: Post-incident testing (after a serious marine incident) is applied to the persons involved after events such as a collision, grounding, fire, serious injury or death, or significant pollution. In USCG waters, under 46 CFR 4.06, after a serious marine incident the alcohol test must be carried out within 2 hours and the drug test within 32 hours; missing these time windows is a separate violation. The Master plans the logistics of post-incident testing (test kits, witnesses, records) in advance as part of emergency management.
Potable su için dezenfeksiyon (klorlama/: Potable water is disinfected (chlorination/UV) and mineralised; periodic bacteriological tests are carried out.
Potable water tankları yalnızca içme suy: Potable water tanks are reserved for drinking water only; they are not used for any other purpose (ballast, technical use) and no cross-connections are made. The tanks are cleaned and disinfected periodically and backflow protection is provided. This system is generally operated by the technical team; the cook plays a part on the quality and records side.
Power management system (PMS): toplam re: Power management system (PMS): balances the total reefer load against the generator capacity.
Pozisyon tek bir kaynağa (GPS) güveniler: The position is not taken on trust from a single source (GPS); it is cross-checked by independent methods: radar range/bearing, visual bearing, parallel indexing, confirmation of the depth with the echo sounder. Because cases of GPS spoofing/jamming are increasing, independent verification is vital.
Pozitif bakteriyolojik sonuç ciddi bir b: A positive bacteriological result is a serious finding: the water source is isolated, super-chlorination/tank disinfection is carried out, the water is retested and alternative safe water is used until it is clear. All these steps are recorded and reported to the Master.
Pozitif bir sonuç, gizlilikle ve doğruda: A positive result is reported confidentially and directly to the Master, and then to the company. The process is carried out in a way that protects the person's dignity and does not give rise to gossip. Under company policy, a positive result usually leads to removal from duty and further action.
Pozitif deplasmanlı pompaların basma tar: Positive displacement pumps MUST have a relief/bypass valve on the discharge side; otherwise, when running against a closed valve, the pressure can burst the pipe or the pump. This is the most basic difference from centrifugal pumps.
Pozitif sonuç, for-cause test kararı vey: A positive result, a decision to carry out a for-cause test or a breach of the policy is reported to the DPA on time under the ISM. The report contains a summary of the event, the immediate measure taken (removal from duty), the test details and the recommended action. The DPA and the company's HR and legal departments coordinate the logistics of sign-off and repatriation, the provision of a relief and the legal steps.
Pratik koruma yöntemi, tüm belgelerin yü: A practical method of protection is to make high-resolution digital copies (scans/photos) of all documents and keep them in secure cloud/backup storage. If the original is lost, the digital copy provides a reference for reissue; however, official validity always lies with the original bearing wet-ink signatures.
Pratik yöntem, aylık bir öz-değerlendirm: The practical method is a monthly self-assessment: which STCW function has been sufficiently evidenced, and which has fallen behind? For the area that has fallen behind, the cadet asks the training engineer for opportunities ("may I take part in the electrical switchboard job in the coming maintenance plan?"). This proactive approach avoids being left with large gaps at the end of the voyage.
Pratikte Yağcı, bir işe başlamadan \"bu: In practice, before starting a job the Oiler asks: "how can I control this hazard at the highest level?" For example, isolating and cooling down a hot line (engineering) is always better than relying on PPE. PPE covers the risk that remains after the higher controls have been applied.
Pratikte bir olay hem emniyet hem güvenl: In practice an incident can have both a safety and a security dimension: for example, an unauthorised person entering the engine room is both a security breach and a safety risk. The Master manages the reporting flow and the response from both points of view. The annual management review assesses the performance indicators of both systems together (KPIs: number of NCs, drill quality, near-miss rate, number of security incidents).
Pratikte bu süreç çok yavaş gerçekleştir: In practice the process must take place very slowly so that the system stays in thermal equilibrium with its surroundings. In ship systems, isothermal compression is approximated in multi-stage compressors with intercooling.
Pratikte bu, kaptanın her join eden müre: In practice this means that the Master checks, physically or electronically, the STCW certificates of every crew member who joins (CoC — Certificate of Competency, CoP — Certificate of Proficiency, GMDSS, tanker endorsement, advanced fire fighting, medical first aid, etc.). If a missing certificate or one about to expire is found, the company is notified at once; employing a person without a certificate in a duty that requires one is both a breach of STCW and a serious insurance risk.
Pratikte en sağlıklı yaklaşım aylık proj: In practice the soundest approach is to follow a projected CII monthly. Instead of waiting for the end of the year, the trio "actual – target – year-end projection" should be followed every month and action taken before the deviation grows.
Pratikte en sık çatışma \"unsafe port /: In practice the most frequent clashes arise over "unsafe port / unsafe berth", "keeping the ETA with excessive speed" and "continuing the voyage with deficient equipment". In these situations the Master puts safety first; the commercial consequence (off-hire, demurrage) is settled between the company's lawyers and the charterer, but the loss of life or of the ship cannot be undone.
Pratikte hat 180° boylamını birebir izle: In practice the line does not follow the 180° meridian exactly; it zigzags because of the administrative choices of countries (e.g. there are deviations for Kiribati and some Pacific islands). On Pacific crossings, the Second Officer confirms from ALRS and the almanac exactly where the line crosses the ship's route, because the date change is a separate, additional step from the clock change.
Pratikte: Önce P ayarlanır, sonra I ekle: In practice: P is set first, then I is added, and finally D (if necessary).
Pre-DP checklistte mevcut konfigürasyonu: The pre-DP checklist checks that the current configuration matches the CAMO/TAM and the ASOG. Permission to commence operations is not given without the approval of the Master and the Chief Engineer.
Pre-arrival 72/24/12 saat öncesinden hol: In pre-arrival messages 72/24/12 hours before arrival, the hold/tank condition, the planned loading sequence, the number of cranes to be used, the ballast plan and bunkering requirements are passed to the terminal. Under ISGOTT, the Ship-Shore Safety Checklist must be completed on tankers after berthing and confirmed every watch.
Pre-arrival güvenlik bilgisi PFSO ile pa: Pre-arrival security information is shared with the PFSO; when the security levels differ or in special circumstances, a Declaration of Security is completed. Access control is coordinated.
Pre-arrival/departure checklist (steerin: The pre-arrival and pre-departure checklists (steering gear test, ECDIS, equipment, reports) are completed; NAVTEX and port notices are followed.
Pre-bunker meeting yapılır; scupper plug: A pre-bunkering meeting is held; scupper plugs are in place and the SOPEP equipment is ready. Pumping starts at a slow rate and topping-up is controlled by hand. The tank ullages are monitored.
A pre-bunkering meeting is held; scupper plugs are in place and the SOPEP equipment is ready. Pumping starts at a slow rate and topping-up is done by hand. The ullages are monitored.

A pre-bunkering meeting is held; scupper plugs are in place and the SOPEP equipment is ready. Pumping starts slowly and topping-up is done by hand. Additional safety and communication measures are applied while passengers are on board.
A pre-bunkering meeting is held; scupper plugs, drip trays and the SOPEP equipment are ready. Pumping starts at a slow rate and topping-up is controlled by hand. The tank ullages are followed.
Pre-employment test, personel gemiye kat: The pre-employment test is carried out before the person joins the ship (usually by the manning agency or a clinic), and a negative result is a condition of signing on. The sign-on (joining) test is carried out when joining or shortly after, and provides a "clean start". The Master verifies that every new crew member arrives with a valid, negative D&A test certificate; if there is no certificate or it is doubtful, a test is carried out on board.
Pre-flow testi sonrası TRO (total residu: After the pre-flow test, the TRO (total residual oxidant) level or UV dose is monitored; the system runs during ballasting and deballasting. The operation is recorded in the BWRB.
Pre-flow testi sonrası TRO/UV doz izleni: After the pre-flow test, the TRO level or UV dose is monitored; the system runs during ballasting and deballasting and is recorded in the BWRB.

After the pre-flow test, the TRO level or UV dose is monitored; the system runs during ballasting and deballasting and is recorded in the BWRB. With high ballast flow rates the system capacity is critical.
Pre-flow testi sonrası TRO/UV dozu izlen: After the pre-flow test, the TRO level or UV dose is monitored; the system runs during ballasting and deballasting and is recorded in the BWRB.
Pre-stowage plan, stabilite/mukavemet ya: The pre-stowage plan is entered into the stability and strength software (e.g. LoadMaster, CargoMax). The Master reviews that at every stage of loading the GM, the forward, aft and midship draughts, the list, the bending moment, the shear force and, on container ships, the torsion values are within limits. Stages exceeding 85% of a limit are revised.
Preferential trip sistemi kritik olmayan: The preferential trip system cuts off non-essential loads automatically.
Presostat (pressure switch): genellikle: Pressure switch: generally starts at 3 bar and stops at 5 bar.
Pressure gauge (hidrostatik): tank dibi: Pressure gauge (hydrostatic): calculates the level by measuring the pressure at the tank bottom; common for ballast and double-bottom tanks.
Preventive bakım, ekipman üreticisinin ö: Preventive maintenance is carried out at the maintenance intervals recommended by the equipment manufacturer (running hours, calendar period). It covers jobs such as oil changes, filter changes, gasket replacement and adjustment checks.
Primary GNSS position, mümkün olan bağım: The primary GNSS position is cross-checked with a second independent PNT source where possible and with radar, visual or terrestrial fixes. Two ECDIS units using the same GNSS, gyro and log are not two independent checks. The radar overlay also often shares the same heading and position input.
Prob, malzeme yüzeyine ultrasonik darbe: The probe sends an ultrasonic pulse into the surface of the material. The sound wave is reflected from the back surface and returns. The thickness is calculated from the round-trip time and the speed of sound in the material.
Product tankerlerde \"compatibility tabl: On product tankers, a "compatibility table" check is made; if there is a previous cargo that could spoil the quality of the oil cargo, a wall-wash test is carried out. For MARPOL Annex II (NLS), the P&A (Procedures and Arrangements) Manual is the guide.
Profesyonel bulaşık, üç aşamalı sistemle: Professional dishwashing is done with a three-stage system: (1) pre-scraping and washing in hot water with detergent (grease and residue are dissolved), (2) rinsing in clean hot water (detergent residue is removed), (3) sanitizing (killing germs with high-temperature water or a chemical sanitizer). A single-stage "wipe with detergent and leave" is not hygienic dishwashing.
Profesyonel galley düzeni \"kirli alanda: A professional galley layout is based on the principle of one-way flow "from the dirty area to the clean area": receiving and sorting → cold preparation → cooking → service → dishwashing. Cross flow (for example, raw chicken passing over a serving plate) creates a risk of cross-contamination; for this reason, the cook fixes the preparation worktops and stations so that this direction is not disrupted. As a ship's galley is small, every square meter must serve the logic of the flow.
Profesyonel gemi temizliğinde renk kodlu: In professional shipboard cleaning, color-coded cleaning is the standard method of preventing cross-contamination. A cloth used for the toilet is never used on a galley worktop or a dining table. This separation is the primary barrier against the spread of norovirus and other fecal-oral pathogens.
Profesyonel mutfak prensibi olan \"mise: The professional kitchen principle of "mise en place" (everything in its place) is also fundamental in the ship's galley. Before meal service, the cook cleans, chops and weighs all ingredients and prepares the stations. This is the key to a one- or two-person galley team being able to serve three meals on time within limited hours.
Profesyonel weather routing şirketleri,: Professional weather routing companies recommend the optimum route using a performance model of the ship and meteorological forecast data. Coastal safety, traffic separation schemes and emission control areas are also taken into account.
Program; ana makine system oil (crankcas: The program covers the main engine system oil (crankcase), generator crankcase oils, T/C oil, steering gear hydraulic oil, deck machinery (cranes/winches) and, if necessary, cylinder drain oil. Different parameters and limits apply to each item of equipment.
Programlı dönen tank washing makineleri: Programmable rotating tank washing machines (Butterworth, Toftejorg) work at set angles and speeds at the top and bottom of the tank.
Proje, müşteri veya uzun bakım sonrası m: After a project, a new client or a long maintenance period, the mobilisation checklist is completed; the task equipment installed, PRS additions and software changes are recorded.
Prosedür: Acil jeneratör → neden tespiti: Procedure: emergency generator → identify the cause → start a generator → take on the critical loads in order → start the main engine.
Protest metni, log ve diğer kayıtlarla b: The text of the protest must match the log and other records exactly. A contradiction damages the credibility of both the protest and the ship in general. The declaration is therefore prepared carefully on the basis of the records.
Protest, deck/official log book kayıtlar: The protest is based on the deck and official log book entries, weather data (barometer, wind, sea state), navigation records and, where necessary, witness statements. The Master documents clearly the timeline of the event, the measures taken and the conditions.
Protest, genellikle limana varıştan sonr: The protest is usually made before the competent authority or a notary as soon as possible after arrival in port (often within 24 hours). Delay weakens the value of the declaration. Where necessary, a protest can be noted before the full extent of the damage is known, with the words "with reservation to extend", and extended later.
Provizyon odalarının doğru sıcaklıkta tu: Keeping the provision rooms at the correct temperature is essential for food safety and crew health. Temperature deviations are monitored in coordination with the cook/steward; if a room fails, quick action (alternative cooling, priority of consumption) is taken to save the food.
Provizyon tesisi genelde tek/çok odalı d: The provision plant is usually a single/multi-room direct-expansion system; each room is kept at the required temperature by a thermostat (e.g. meat −18°C, vegetables +4°C). The HVAC system air-conditions the accommodation. The reefer cargo plant (if fitted) has a much higher capacity and is critical for the integrity of the cargo.
Pruva/kıç istasyonları ile net haberleşm: Clear communication is established with the forward and aft stations; line tensions and snap-back zones are managed. The bell book is kept.
Purge aşamasında inert gaz ile HC seyrel: In the purging stage the hydrocarbons are diluted with inert gas; then, by ventilating with air, the O2 is brought up to 21% and the hydrocarbons down below the LFL (1% LFL). At every stage gas is measured continuously at several points (O2, HC/LEL, and H2S and benzene where needed).
Purging süresi; sistem hacmine ve yakıt: The purging time depends on the system volume and the fuel flow rate. Using the total volume of the system (piping + heater + filter + pumps) and the consumption rate, the Chief Engineer calculates the required changeover time and adds a safety margin.
Purifier (santrifüj separatör), filtrede: The purifier (centrifugal separator) is the main cleaning stage that comes before the filter; it separates water and solid particles from the fuel/oil by centrifugal force. Filters catch the remaining dirt that the purifier misses. If purifier efficiency falls, the load on the filter increases and the DP rises quickly; the two are therefore assessed together.
Purifier (separator), yakıt ve yağdan su: The purifier (separator) separates water and solid sediment from fuel and oil by centrifugal force. Opening the bowl, cleaning the disc stack, selecting the gravity disc and renewing O-rings are parts of the maintenance. The cadet experiences that learning the order and fitting direction of the discs is critical (incorrect assembly impairs separation efficiency).
Purifier alarmı, yakıt viskozitesi, sıca: The purifier alarm, fuel viscosity, temperature and injector performance should be monitored together on a single performance display; when a threshold is exceeded, the bridge should be told "there may be an effect on speed".
Purifier disc'leri belirli çalışma saati: The purifier discs are cleaned at set running hours; automatic back-flushing and ΔP are monitored on the filters. Working with hot HFO carries a risk of splashes and burns.
Purifier disc'leri çalışma saatine göre: The purifier discs are cleaned according to running hours; the gravity disc is selected for the fuel density. The filter ΔP is monitored and the automatic back-flushing is verified.
Purifier modunda her desludge sonrası, a: In purifier mode, after each desludge and before separation starts, a set amount of sealing water is fed into the bowl to establish the water seal. This water is the barrier that prevents the fuel from escaping through the water outlet. If the seal is not established properly, fuel escapes through the water outlet (broken seal / oil loss).
Purifier modunda su fazı vardır ve su sü: In purifier mode there is a water phase and water is discharged continuously; the water/fuel interface is set with the gravity disc. In clarifier mode there is no water and only solids are separated; as there is no water outlet, a blind disc is used instead of a gravity disc. A purifier followed by a clarifier in series gives the best cleaning.
Purifier modunda, su ile yakıt arasındak: In purifier mode, keeping the dividing line between water and fuel (interface) in the correct position depends on the diameter of the gravity disc (dam ring / regulating ring). The higher the density of the fuel, the smaller the diameter of the gravity disc selected. Selecting the wrong disc results in the interface shifting, the water seal breaking and either fuel mixing into the water or water mixing into the fuel.
Purifier çıkışından gelen arıtılmış yakı: The cleaned fuel from the purifier outlet is transferred to the service tank. The engine fuel system is supplied from there.
Purifier'da gravity disc (dam ring) çapı: In a purifier, the diameter of the gravity disc (dam ring) is chosen for the density and temperature of the fuel; a wrong disc upsets the water/fuel interface (fuel escapes with the water, or water with the fuel). The maker's nomogram and the fuel density and temperature are used to choose correctly.
Purifier: separates both water and solids. The position of the interface is controlled by the gravity disc (dam ring).
Purifier: Hem su hem katı partikülleri a: Purifier: separates both water and solid particles. The separation boundary is set with the gravity disc.
Pyrotechnics; rocket parachute flare (en: Pyrotechnics consist of rocket parachute flares (at least 12 on the bridge), hand flares and buoyant smoke signals; lifeboats and liferafts also have their own sets. All have an expiry date printed on them (usually manufacture + 3-4 years); expired pyrotechnics cannot be used and produce a PSC finding directly.
Quantity dispute'ı önlemek için bunkerin: To avoid a quantity dispute, both parties take tank measurements before and after bunkering (joint measurement). The barge tank table figures are converted to metric tons by applying trim/list correction and temperature-density correction (VCF — Volume Correction Factor). Watch out for artificial inflation of volume by aerated fuel (cappuccino effect).
Quick closing valfler kapandıktan sonra: After the quick-closing valves have closed, they are reset one by one by hand (locally); accidental tripping stops the machinery. The trip points are therefore protected and marked. Regular testing verifies that the valves actually close.
Quick closing valve, yakıt/yağ tankların: A quick-closing valve is fitted at the outlet of fuel and oil tanks (settling, service, lubricating oil, HFO storage) and can be closed remotely with a single action. In a fire they are all tripped together from a point outside the engine room (usually a wire, pneumatic or hydraulic cabinet), cutting off the flow of fuel to the fire.

Quick-closing valves are valves fitted at the outlets of fuel/oil tanks that can be closed remotely (usually from outside the engine room, from a control station). In an engine room fire, these valves are closed remotely to cut off the fuel supply to the fire; this is one of the most critical steps in preventing the fire from spreading.
Quick closing valves (QCV) makine daires: Quick-closing valves (QCV) are tripped from a panel outside the engine room; they close the valves on the fuel tanks, lubricating oil tanks and service tanks.
RACON, seyir işaretlerine (fener, şamand: A RACON is a transponder fitted on aids to navigation (lights, buoys) that produces a Morse code signal on the radar; observing it is useful for verifying the radar.
RAM yedek bataryası biterse program ve a: If the RAM backup battery runs down, the program and settings may be lost. The ETO takes the low battery alarm seriously, replaces the battery without cutting the power (depending on the module) and is ready to restore the program from backup. An up-to-date offline backup of all PLC programs is kept.
RCA'nın çıktısı, bir düzeltici aksiyon (: The output of the RCA is a plan of corrective action (removing the present problem) and preventive action (preventing recurrence). While the corrective action is "repair the pump", the preventive action may be "add this test to the PMS every 3 months, train the personnel concerned, tie the spare part to a minimum stock level". Each action is assigned to a responsible person, a deadline and evidence of closure (photo, test report, training record).
RCM analizi sonucunda her arıza modu içi: As a result of the RCM analysis, the most suitable maintenance strategy is chosen for each failure mode: condition monitoring (CBM), scheduled restoration, scheduled replacement, failure finding (hidden failures), design change or run-to-failure.
RNC'nin bulunduğu RCDS modunda ECDIS'in: In RCDS mode, where RNCs are used, the vector alarm and query capabilities of the ECDIS are reduced. RCDS use is managed together with the required up-to-date paper charts and the procedure for the flag and route concerned; opening a raster chart on the screen does not automatically give legal equivalence.
RO sistemi motor ısısına bağlı değildir;: The RO plant does not depend on engine heat, so it can also run when the main engine is stopped. The membrane life is 3–5 years; chemical cleaning (CIP) must be carried out regularly.
RTD, metalin elektrik direncinin sıcaklı: An RTD is based on the principle that the electrical resistance of a metal changes in proportion to temperature. The Pt100 (100 Ω at 0 °C) is the most common type. An RTD is more accurate, repeatable and linear than a thermocouple, but its response time is slower.
RadaScan, dinamik konumlandırma ve diğer: RadaScan is an advanced position reference sensor that uses radar technology for dynamic positioning and other ship control applications. It works with high accuracy over a range of 10 m to 1000 m, complements GPS in close-range operations and can replace conventional laser systems.
Radar SART, 9 GHz X-band sorgulamasını a: The radar SART detects interrogation by a 9 GHz X-band radar and produces sweeping responses across the band; 12 blips about 0.64 NM apart are seen on the radar screen, which may turn into arcs or circles at close range.
Radar arızasında gemiyi 'onarım yaparak': In the event of radar failure, the first duty of the officer of the watch is not to make the ship safe 'by carrying out repairs', but first to make it operationally safe by means of safe speed, an additional lookout, an alternative radar/navigation sensor and, if necessary, a change of course/area.
Radar eğitimi, cihazın doğru ayarlanması: Radar training starts with setting up the equipment correctly: gain, sea clutter (STC), rain clutter (FTC), tuning, pulse length and range selection. The Second Officer demonstrates hands-on to the cadet that a wrong clutter setting can suppress real targets (e.g. small craft, growlers) and that excessive gain fills the screen with noise. Correct setting-up is not a static procedure but a skill that is continuously optimized for the conditions (sea state, precipitation).
Radar gauge: tank tepesinden mikrodalga: Radar gauge: measures the ullage with a microwave signal from the top of the tank; standard on crude oil and product tankers.
Radar kullanan gemiler için Kural 6 ek f: For ships using radar, Rule 6 lists additional factors: the range and limitations of the radar, the range scale in use, the effect of sea/rain clutter, the possibility that small craft/ice will not be detected by radar, and the number and position of the targets detected by radar. If the officer relies on the radar and keeps up speed in poor visibility, Rule 6 is violated.
Radar performance monitor (PM), radarın: The radar performance monitor (PM) is a built-in test arrangement that shows whether the radar's transmitted power and receiver sensitivity are normal. At the start of each watch and before entering critical waters, the Second Officer runs the PM to verify that radar performance has not deteriorated, and records the result.
Radar plotting bir defalık CPA okuması d: Radar plotting is not a single reading of the CPA. The target is acquired, the solution is allowed to settle, the bearing, range and vector trends are followed, and the effect of any manoeuvre made is checked again after a sufficient time.
Radar plotting, hedefin gerçek rotasını: Radar plotting is carried out to determine the target's true course and speed and its CPA (Closest Point of Approach) and TCPA (Time to CPA). In manual plotting, the target's true motion is resolved with the OAW triangle (WO: own ship, OA: relative motion, WA: true motion); ARPA does this automatically, but the officer must question the accuracy of the ARPA data (tracking stability, risk of target swap).
Radar tuning (gain, sea clutter, rain cl: Radar tuning (gain, sea clutter, rain clutter), antenna height, blind sectors and sector checks are under the Master's supervision. ARPA target acquisition quality (true motion vs relative motion), CPA/TCPA limits and the use of trial manoeuvres are handled by the officer of the watch; the Master ensures this through training and supervision.
Radar varsa, riski erken belirlemek için: If radar is fitted, long-range scanning is carried out to get early warning of risk, and the targets detected are systematically plotted or tracked with ARPA. Rule 7 explicitly prohibits assumptions based on scanty information, especially scanty radar information; CPA/TCPA values must not be assessed on their own but only after the trend has been confirmed.
Radar, anten üzerinden çok kısa süreli y: The radar transmits very short, high-power microwave pulses through the antenna. A pulse strikes a target and returns; the range is calculated from the round-trip time (R = c·t/2) and the bearing from the direction of the antenna. On the screen the own ship is at the centre and targets are shown against the range rings.
Radar-SART, 9 GHz (X-band) arama radarın: When a radar SART receives the pulse of a 9 GHz (X-band) search radar, it sends a series of response pulses on the same frequency; on the radar screen this appears as a line of 12 dots (blips) extending outwards from the SART. As the distance closes, the dots become arcs. This pattern clearly shows the position of the SART.
Radar/ECDIS image: installation standard: Radar/ECDIS image: the display source(s) recorded according to the installation standard and the available interface.
Radar/ECDIS/AIS fonksiyon testleri ve ka: Radar, ECDIS and AIS function tests and calibration are carried out; the sensor inputs (gyro, GPS, log) are verified. The back-up equipment is kept in working order.
Radar/anten enerjisinin kilitlenmemesi,: Failure to lock out the radar/antenna energy, dropped tools injuring people below and MOB equipment not being ready during overside work are among the causes of reported serious accidents. The AB must confirm energy isolation, tie on tools and check MOB preparations before starting work.
Radarın operasyonel değeri yalnız ekoyu: The operational value of the radar is not only that it shows echoes: the correct choice of presentation and motion, a suitable range scale, EBL/VRM measurement, parallel indexing, trails and ARPA target tracking are different layers of evidence in the same picture.
Radyal türbin: Kompakt, küçük turboşarje: Radial turbine: compact, used in small turbochargers. The gas flows from the outside inwards.
Radyo/radar antenleri yakınında çalışıla: If work is to be done near radio/radar antennas, the transmitters are switched off and a "DO NOT TRANSMIT — MEN ALOFT" tag is posted; otherwise there is a risk of RF burns and high-frequency hazards. When working near the funnel, the exhaust gas risk (CO, SO2, heat) is assessed.
Ramp süresi (tipik olarak 5-30 saniye) a: The ramp time (typically 5–30 seconds) is adjustable. The starting voltage is chosen between 30% and 70%.
Rampa hidrolik ile maker prosedürüne gör: The ramp is opened and closed hydraulically following the maker's procedure; on closing, all locking pins and cleats are engaged and the "secured/closed" status is verified on the indicator panel. The bow visor/door interlock system is checked.
Rampa kilitleri tam kapanmazsa sızdırmaz: If the ramp locks do not close fully, watertightness and the safety of the ship are compromised; hydraulic maintenance is an integral part of door watertightness.
Rampa, ağır araç yükünü yapısal olarak t: The ramp must be strong enough to carry heavy vehicle loads structurally; axle load limits must not be exceeded. Vehicle traffic on the ramp is controlled and speed-limited.
Rampa, rıhtım link-span ile hizalanacak: The ship berths so that the ramp lines up with the shore link-span, using the bow thruster and, if necessary, tugs. Mooring safety is maintained even during quick turnarounds.
Rampa/kapı çevresinde conta (rubber seal: Rubber seals around the ramp or door prevent seawater from entering; water collecting in the gaps is drained overboard through drains and non-return valves. A crushed or torn seal leaks. The second barrier (inner door) between the bow visor and the inner ramp gives additional protection.
Random test \"unannounced\" (habersiz) o: A random test must be unannounced; the person selected must not be given a long time between notification and giving the sample (generally sampling starts immediately). The Master records the test date and the selection method; evidence of the random programme (records, selection method, results) may be asked for in PSC or vetting inspections.
Random testing, programın caydırıcılığın: Random testing is the heart of the programme's deterrent effect, because no one can know in advance when they will be tested. The company SMS usually sets an annual target rate (e.g. at least 25% of the crew randomly tested once a year; some tanker companies require a higher rate). The Master ensures that the selection process is truly random and unbiased — for example a numbered list and random numbers, drawing sealed capsules, or selection by the company's central software.
Rapor formatı kerteriz (bearing) + cisim: The report format is bearing + object + range/status. The bearing is given as a "clock" bearing (one o'clock, dead ahead) or as "port/starboard ... degrees". Example reports: "Light dead ahead!", "Vessel two points on the starboard bow!", "Object red one-zero!" (port 10°). If a danger is detected, it is reported immediately, loudly and clearly.
Raporların değeri, verinin doğruluğuyla: The value of reports is proportional to the accuracy of the data. Manipulated or "corrected" consumption data cause performance disputes, vetting problems and loss of trust. The Chief Engineer stays true to the raw data and reports anomalies with an explanation.
Raporun netliği, karadaki kararın hızını: The clarity of the report determines how quickly a decision is made ashore. Instead of vague reports such as "engine defective", specific reports backed by measurements and photographs bring effective support.
Rastgele test programı, testlerin öncede: A random testing program requires tests to be carried out at unpredictable intervals and with impartial selection. Targeting particular people or a predictable schedule undermines the deterrent effect and the fairness of the program. The Third Officer handles these logistics impartially and keeps records.
Rat guard halatlara takılır; yemleme ist: Rat guards are fitted on the lines; bait stations and hygiene measures are in place. The Ship Sanitation Certificate is kept valid.
Re ve ε/D bilindiğinde f, Moody diyagram: When Re and ε/D are known, f is read from the Moody diagram. At high Re and high roughness f becomes constant (the "fully turbulent" region). The diagram is a basic tool for pump head and pipe diameter selection.
Readiness'ın insan ayağı, her mürettebat: The human side of readiness is that every crew member knows their own station and duty. The Safety Officer keeps this knowledge fresh by asking random people during drills and in daily contact: "Where is your muster station, what is your duty, which lifeboat do you board?" For the head count, an up-to-date crew list and passenger list (if any) are kept at each muster station.
Receiver ve signal processor çok zayıf e: The receiver and signal processor amplify very weak echoes while trying to suppress sea clutter, rain clutter and interference. Excessive use of the gain or clutter controls can remove not only the noise but also real targets such as a small craft, a buoy, a low coastline or a target between the waves.
Recip stripper'da valve clearance ayarla: On reciprocating strippers the valve clearances are adjusted; on eductors the nozzles are checked for wear. A worn nozzle reduces the suction efficiency.
Recovery sırası: emergency generator → e: Recovery sequence: emergency generator → filling the main air receiver with the emergency air compressor → starting the first generator → energizing the main busbar → cooling/lubricating pumps → main engine restart. The Chief Engineer and the team must know this sequence by heart.
Recovery sırasında start havası tüplerin: During recovery, the adequacy of the starting air bottles is critical; repeated start attempts use up starting air. The Oiler monitors the air compressors and the air pressure. During recovery, each action is taken in sequence and on the engineer's order.
Recovery'nin ilk adımı nedeni hızlıca te: The first step in recovery is to diagnose the cause quickly: which generator tripped, and why? Then a generator is started manually/automatically, connected to the main switchboard and loaded in stages (critical consumers first, then heavy consumers). Rushing to take all the load at once may lead to a new trip (cascade blackout).
Reducing valve: 30 bar → 7 bar control/w: Reducing valve: 30 bar → 7 bar for control and working air.
Reefer (refrigerated) konteynerler, gemi: Reefer (refrigerated) containers are supplied from the ship's network (usually 440 V 60 Hz) through reefer sockets, and each has its own refrigeration unit. The ETO ensures the condition of the reefer socket panels, the reliability of the supply and that the set/actual temperature of each container is monitored from the central monitoring system. A temperature deviation alarm on sensitive cargo requires immediate action.
Reefer kargo taşıyan gemilerde soğutma a: On ships carrying reefer cargo, a refrigeration failure means direct loss of cargo and large claims. Set temperatures, alarm limits and recording systems are monitored continuously; any deviation is reported immediately. For reefer containers, plug/power and temperature monitoring are carried out in coordination with the deck department.
Reefer kompartmanı (provision room) ayrı: The provision rooms are kept between −20 °C and +5 °C with a separate expansion circuit.
Reefer monitoring system (RMS): set sıca: Reefer monitoring system (RMS): monitors the set temperature, return air, supply air and alarm status.
Reefer plug socket: 32 A / 4 pin / 440 V: Reefer plug socket: 32 A / 4-pin / 440 V CEE form; for the power connection of each container.
Reefer sayısına göre devreye alınan DG s: The number of generators on line is adjusted to the number of reefers; when paralleling, frequency, voltage and phase are matched. The power management system (PMS) handles standby starts and load sharing.
Reefer soketleri ıslak güverte ortamında: Reefer sockets work in a wet deck environment; earthing, insulation monitoring and circuit breaker protection are essential. Plugs must be connected with the power off; damaged cables or sockets must not be used.
Reefer ünitesi standart soğutma çevrimiy: A reefer unit works on the standard refrigeration cycle: the compressor compresses the refrigerant gas, the (air-cooled) condenser rejects the heat outside, the expansion valve lowers the pressure and the evaporator draws heat from inside the container to cool the cargo. The set temperature (e.g. −18 °C frozen, +2 °C chilled) is maintained by a microcontroller.
Reefer'lar düzenli olarak fiziksel veya: Reefers are monitored regularly, physically or remotely; the set temperature, actual temperature, alarms and power supply status are recorded (reefer monitoring). Before loading, the PTI (Pre-Trip Inspection) confirms that the unit is sound. The temperature record is evidence in cargo claims.
Refrigerant ilavesi, geri kazanım ve dev: Adding refrigerant, recovering it and opening the circuit usually require expertise and special equipment; the Third/Fourth Engineer detects and reports signs of leaks/faults and carries out any intervention under the supervision of the Chief Engineer. Ignoring a leak brings both loss of food/cargo and legal risk.
Refrigerant kaçağı hem performans kaybı: A refrigerant leak means both a loss of performance and an environmental/legal problem. The ETO finds leak points with an electronic leak detector or a soap bubble test and keeps the leak/charging records as required by regulations. Charging and repairs are carried out by a licensed technician with recovery equipment; refrigerant is not released to the atmosphere.
Regulation 19, taşınacak seyir cihazları: Regulation 19 defines the navigational equipment to be carried and the ECDIS requirement. ECDIS can replace paper charts when it is supplied with approved ENCs and used together with an appropriate back-up arrangement. The Second Officer must know clearly whether the ship operates "ECDIS-only" or "paper-backed" and how this affects the correction workflow.
Regulation 31/32 ise gemi kaptanına, tro: Regulations 31/32 place on the Master the obligation to report dangers such as tropical storms, dangerous ice, sub-freezing air temperatures and winds of Beaufort 10 or above to ships in the vicinity and to the authorities (danger message). The Second Officer prepares the necessary observations and reports.
Reis aynı zamanda tayfanın \"abisi\"dir;: The Bosun is also the "big brother" of the ratings, passing on technical knowledge, shipboard etiquette and safety culture. A good Bosun leads by example rather than by giving orders; the Bosun personally demonstrates the hardest job and stands at the front at the riskiest point. Team discipline comes not from fear but from this trust.
Reis emri yorumlarken sahanın gerçeğini: When interpreting the order, the Bosun brings in the reality on the ground: weather, sea state, the ship's port/sea schedule, the team's current fatigue and operations running at the same time. A plan that is perfect on paper cannot be carried out on deck in a storm; the Bosun sees this difference and gives feedback to the officer.
Reis genelde baş (forward) istasyonunu,: The Bosun usually runs the forward station and the Second Officer the aft station; or, depending on the arrangement, the Bosun is aft. At the station, the Bosun clearly assigns who will tend which line, who will operate the winch and who will act as lookout. The Bosun communicates with the bridge by radio and confirms every order by read-back.
Reis her ana kalem için bir asgari stok: For each main item, the Bosun sets a minimum stock (min) and maximum stock (max) threshold. When stock approaches the min threshold, a requisition is triggered; the max prevents unnecessary overstocking and clogging of the store. A stock-take is usually done at the end of each month and at the start/end of the voyage; the results are reported to the Chief Officer.
Reis sabah toolbox toplantısından sonra: After the morning toolbox meeting, the Bosun reviews the work orders with the Chief Officer. The work order contains the equipment, the work to be done, the materials list, the PPE required, the risk assessment reference, the estimated duration and the evidence of completion (photo, measurement). When allocating this order to the team, the Bosun combines job competence, team size, weather conditions and the port/at-sea situation.
Reis sadece denetçi değil, eğitici rolün: The Bosun is not only a supervisor but also a trainer. The Bosun demonstrates in practice basic skills to young ratings, such as preparing ropes, tying knots, rope splicing, chipping and painting, hot work safety and enclosed space discipline. This training is recorded in the "deck training book"; it is an important part of the STCW familiarization requirements.
Reis ve güverte ekibi, ballast/freshwate: The Bosun and the deck team assist with ballast/fresh water/void space soundings and hold bilge measurements. It is important that the sounding pipe heads are clean and open, that the correct sounding tape is used and that the readings are recorded correctly. A wrong sounding corrupts the stability and strength calculations.
Reis'in günlük yönetimdeki başarısı, \"k: The Bosun's success in daily management lies hidden in trouble-free days that "nobody notices". Well-allocated work, well-supervised safety and a well-motivated team keep the ship both productive and accident-free. As the on-site leader of the deck, the Bosun re-establishes this balance every day.
Reis, Birinci Zabit'in saha temsilcisidi: The Bosun is the Chief Officer's representative on deck: the Bosun allocates the jobs given at the morning toolbox meeting to the ratings, obtains equipment and materials and checks the quality of the work. The Chief Officer, in turn, prepares the weekly work plan, sets priorities and closes out the PMS (Planned Maintenance System) deck items on time.
Reis, bakım programını ve stok durumunu: By considering the maintenance program and the stock situation together, the Bosun prepares a requisition for the next supply port. A good requisition includes the item name, technical description (brand/specification/IMPA code), quantity, unit and urgency. Instead of a vague "some paint", it says "brand X epoxy primer, gray, 20 L, 4 units".
Reis, denetimden önce değil, sürekli den: The Bosun keeps the store ready for inspection at all times, not just before an inspection. The "always ready" philosophy removes the last-minute rush and its risks.
Reis, ekibi tanır: kimin yüksekte rahat: The Bosun knows the team: who works comfortably at height, who is meticulous with paint, who is quick with ropework. Putting the right person on the right job increases both safety and productivity; a wrong match means unfinished work or injury.
Reis, ekibin baret, emniyet ayakkabısı,: The Bosun checks that the team is wearing a hard hat, safety shoes, boiler suit, gloves, goggles, ear protection and job-specific equipment (harness, face shield, dust mask, lifejacket), complete and in good condition. Damaged PPE is replaced immediately. PPE is the last line of defense; it remains indispensable even after the risk has been eliminated at source.
Reis, güverte bölümünün en kıdemli tayfa: The Bosun is the most senior rating in the deck department and works directly under the Chief Officer. The Bosun's authority is limited to interpreting the work order, allocating the team, ensuring safety on site and checking the quality of the work. Authority for planning and prioritization remains with the Chief Officer; the Bosun turns this plan into work on site. Knowing this distinction prevents taking unnecessary initiative and stepping outside safe limits.
Reis, güvertede kayma/takılma riski yara: The Bosun has anything that creates a slip/trip hazard on deck (oil, heaps of line, tools) cleared away. The snap-back zones are reviewed and the radio/communications are tested. The whole team knows what to do; the report "stations ready forward/aft" is given to the bridge.
Reis, güverteyi sorumluluk bölgelerine a: The Bosun divides the deck into areas of responsibility and makes each deckhand responsible for keeping a particular area in order ("zone ownership"). This solves the problem of untidiness being "everybody's job, so nobody's job". A sense of ownership is the foundation of lasting order.
Reis, haftalık güverte tur kayıtlarını (: The Bosun keeps records of the weekly deck rounds; housekeeping deficiencies found are documented together with the measures taken and photographs showing completion. Under ISM, these records are evidence of "continuous improvement" and show the discipline of the ship's management during inspections.
Reis, hava durumu, liman programı ve mev: The Bosun allocates the daily jobs according to the weather, the port schedule and the current state of corrosion: one group chips on the forecastle while another washes the deck and another greases wire ropes. The AB knows their own job but must also understand the maintenance logic of the whole deck; for example, no painting is done when rain is expected, and nobody walks on fresh paint.
Reis, hava elverdiğinde ve güvenliyse gü: When the weather permits and it is safe to do so, the Bosun periodically checks the lashings of the deck cargo. Going out on deck in bad weather is dangerous; therefore, the checks are made within a weather window, under supervision and with harnesses. Slackened lashings or shifted cargo are reported immediately.
Reis, işin ilerlemesini takip eder ve ge: The Bosun follows the progress of the work and informs the Chief Officer in good time when a delay or obstacle arises (shortage of materials, change in the weather, equipment failure). Passing a problem on site to the officer late means a loss of productivity for the whole day.
Reis, kapanan hatch çevresinde rubber co: The Bosun checks the rubber compression marks around the closed hatch; if the compression is not even, the gasket or compression bar must be replaced. For the hydraulic system, checking the oil level and hoses and testing the lift/close function are routine.
Reis, masaya oturup işi izlemez; sahada: The Bosun does not sit at a desk watching the work; the Bosun moves around the site and personally steps in on the technique and safety of the work. On seeing a job start wrongly, the Bosun stops it and shows the correct method. If more than one job is under way at the same time, the Bosun gives the most time to the riskiest one.
Reis, sahada sürekli dolaşır; permit kap: The Bosun moves around the site continuously and immediately warns personnel who step outside the scope of the permit, work without PPE or take dangerous shortcuts. A small violation that is tolerated becomes normal and prepares the ground for a major accident. The principle "unsafe behavior that is ignored is unsafe behavior that is approved" applies.
Reis, sahadan köprüüstüne geri bildirim: The Bosun reports back from the station to the bridge: "forward spring made fast", "one line ashore", "all fast forward", "all gone aft, clear of propeller". The "clear of propeller/thruster" report is especially critical; if a line has fallen into the water, there is a risk of it fouling the propeller, and the engine is not used until the bridge has been warned.
Reis, seyir öncesi demir zincirini kontr: Before sailing, the Bosun checks the anchor cable: link wear, cracks, deformation and the legibility of the markings. If abnormal load, vibration or noise is noticed, the bridge is warned. A weakness in the cable can lead to loss of the anchor or an accident during the operation.
Reis, store'daki yedek halatları \"first: The Bosun rotates the spare lines in the store on a "first in, first out" (FIFO) basis; synthetic rope that sits on a shelf for years ages even without use. The date of manufacture of the spares is kept visible on the label. When a mooring line reaches its retirement criteria (outer fiber damage exceeds the company threshold, or core damage is seen), a new one is taken from the store, and the old line is tagged and either downgraded for use as a utility rope or put on the disposal list.
Reis, store'u bir maliyet kalemi değil,: The Bosun sees the store not as a cost item but as a managed asset. A well-kept store reduces waste, makes resupply predictable and becomes one of the most visible signs of the ship's professional maintenance culture.
Reis, ucuz atlatılan olayları (near-miss: The Bosun reports near-misses and unsafe conditions with an encouraging attitude. A near-miss culture is the strongest early warning system against major accidents. An instructive rather than punitive approach encourages the team to report.
Reis, yeni personeli ekibe katar; görev: The Bosun brings new personnel into the team, introducing them to the distribution of duties, communication within the team and the culture of the ship. A well-integrated deckhand feels safe, shares problems and works more safely. Personnel who are excluded or left on their own become both unhappy and a risk.
Reis, yük operasyonu öncesi Birinci Zabi: Before a cargo operation, the Bosun receives instructions from the Chief Officer: the loading/discharging sequence, which hold/hatch is to be opened and when, the lashing plan, the required level of hold preparation and the safety restrictions. The Bosun passes these instructions to the team at a toolbox meeting and keeps radio contact with the duty officer throughout the operation.
Reis; boya stoğunu, karışım oranlarını (: The Bosun monitors the paint stock, mixing ratios (two-component paints) and batch number records. The coat applied, area, DFT and conditions are recorded. These records are valuable both for warranty/compliance and for planning the next maintenance.
Reis; dikkat dağınıklığı, yavaşlama, sin: The Bosun spots signs of fatigue early, such as lack of concentration, slowing down, irritability and increasing errors. In such a case, the pace of work is changed, the team is rotated or the job is postponed. The most valuable quality of an on-site leader is the ability to "read" the team.
Reis; halat işleri, raspa-boya, ekipman: The Bosun teaches rope work, chipping and painting, the use of equipment and deck routines by demonstration. The "watch first, then do it under supervision, then on your own" approach is the most reliable way of building safe competence. New personnel are encouraged to ask questions.
Reis; istasyondaki tüm tayfaların güvenl: The Bosun ensures that all ratings at the station stand in safe positions, use the correct technique and carry out the bridge's orders in full. The more routine an operation is, the more dangerous it is, because attention drops. The Bosun's task is to keep attention alive.
Reis; rubber gasket'lerin temiz, esnek v: The Bosun ensures that the rubber gaskets are clean, flexible and undamaged, that the compression bars bear evenly on the gaskets and that the drain channels (water drainage channels) are kept open. A blocked drain lets water leak inside; a crushed/permanently deformed gasket impairs tightness.
Reisin hazırladığı liste Birinci Zabit t: The list prepared by the Bosun is reviewed by the Chief Officer, combined with the budget and priorities, and sent to the company purchasing department. The Bosun separates recurring needs (paint, consumables) from one-off needs (special equipment that has broken or been used up), so that the approval chain does not get blocked.
Relative vector, mevcut hareketler sürer: The relative vector shows the path the target will follow relative to the own ship if present movements continue; the true vector shows its actual direction and speed relative to the selected ground or water speed reference. Looking only at the tip of the arrow without reading the vector mode and time leads to a wrong interpretation of a manoeuvre.
Renk kodlu temizlik mantığı çamaşırhaney: The color-coded cleaning principle extends to the laundry as well: equipment used for contaminated textiles is not mixed with clean items. Laundry bags and trolleys are disinfected regularly; this equipment is an unseen but critical link in the hygiene chain.
Repeat-back yapılmaması, komut yönünün k: Not repeating back, confusing the direction of the order (port/starboard) and believing that the autopilot has been switched to manual (when it is in fact still in automatic mode) are classic helmsman errors. At every change-over, confirming by the rudder angle indicator and the ship's response that the mode really is correct saves lives.
Requisition, parçanın tam tanımıyla hazı: A requisition is prepared with a full description of the part: maker, type/model, part number (drawing/position no.), quantity, justification and urgency code. A vague description ("gasket for pump") leads to wrong supply and delay; always use the maker's catalog position number.
Rescue boat/FRB ekibi düzenli eğitim ve: The rescue boat/FRB crew trains and drills regularly; SOLAS requires a specially trained crew for the FRB and periodic launching and manoeuvring drills. Protective clothing for cold water (immersion/exposure suits) is provided for the crew.
Rescue boat: rigid (RIB) veya inflatable: Rescue boat: rigid (RIB) or inflatable; with a capacity of 5 or more persons.
Rescue planı; SCBA (Self-Contained Breat: The rescue plan covers SCBA (Self-Contained Breathing Apparatus), rescue harness, lifting system (tripod/winch), resuscitation equipment and first aid. This equipment is kept ready at the entrance. SOLAS III/19 makes regular (at least every two months, depending on the ship) enclosed space entry and rescue drills mandatory; the Chief Officer organizes these drills, runs them with realistic scenarios and records them.
Reset, köprüdeki reset butonu veya harek: The reset is made with the reset button on the bridge or with motion detectors; the officer's physical presence on the bridge is detected. The reset cannot be made from outside the bridge; this prevents anyone silencing it remotely.
Resmi ENC güncellemeleri (weekly update): Official ENC updates (weekly update) are received online or on media and loaded into ECDIS. The Second Officer verifies that the update has been applied successfully, that the cell status is "up to date" and that the digital certificates/licenses remain valid. The update dates are recorded.
Resmi yazışmalar (port authority, flag s: Official correspondence (port authority, flag state, class, customs) usually goes through the agent or directly over the Master's signature. Every statement made to third parties (terminal, the charterer's surveyor, an inspector) must be measured and documented, because it can bind the company legally.
Resmi yevmiye (Official Log Book), deck: The Official Log Book, deck log, bell book, GMDSS log, oil record book, garbage record book and rest hour records are the written backbone of the Master's communication discipline. These records are the "single source of truth" between the ship and the outside world and can be asked for at any time by PSC, vetting or insurers. The VDR (Voyage Data Recorder), for its part, is the most reliable evidence after an accident; in an accident, preserving the VDR data (save/preserve) is among the Master's first tasks.
Rest hours kayıtları özellikle hassastır: Rest hour records are particularly sensitive: meeting the STCW A-VIII/1 and MLC limits (≥10 hours in 24 hours, ≥77 hours in 7 days) "on paper" while breaching them in reality comes to light when the inspector cross-checks them against the port log, the gangway watch and the cargo operation records.
