Santrifüj separatör, yoğunluk farkıyla y: A centrifugal separator separates water and solid residues from the fuel by the difference in density. For efficient separation, the feed temperature must be correct (typically 98°C for HFO), the throughput low (lower still if the density is high) and the gravity disc correctly selected (automatic water discharge on modern clarifiers). The Second Engineer monitors separation quality (water/sludge removed and clarity of the outlet).
Sapanlamada açı kontrol edilir, bacak yü: When slinging, the angle is checked, the leg loads are balanced and correct seating on the hook is ensured. The lift starts slowly and under control; as soon as the load leaves the ground (a few cm), the lift is stopped to check the balance and the seating of the slings, and only then continued.
Saplama somunları üretici tarafından bel: Stud nuts must be tightened to the torque or hydraulic tensioning pressure specified by the maker and in the specified order. New O-rings and gaskets must be fitted. A pressure test of the cooling system and a leak test of the fuel system must be carried out after assembly.
Sarf malzeme stok takibi, kamarotun yaşa: Tracking consumable stock is the unseen logistics that allows the steward to maintain hygiene in the accommodation without interruption. Knowing consumption, requesting in time and storing chemicals safely together protect hygiene, crew comfort and safety.
Sarf malzeme, hijyenin görünmeyen lojist: Consumables are the unseen logistics of hygiene. By ensuring that supplies are replenished before they run out, the steward guarantees that the accommodation stays clean and comfortable at all times. An item that is not requested in time may be unavailable for the whole voyage.
Sarf malzemesi tüketimi (yağ, gres, kimy: Consumption of consumables (oil, grease, chemicals, filters) is monitored as a trend. An abnormal increase in consumption is a sign either of a hidden fault (e.g. an oil leak) or of undisciplined use. By reviewing the consumption log, the Chief Engineer both controls cost and catches hidden technical problems early.
Savunmaya geçme, dinle ve anla. Açıklama: Do not become defensive; listen and understand. Ask for clarification. Say thank you. Make an improvement plan.
Sağ doyma eğrisinin sağında: Kızgın (sup: To the right of the right-hand saturation curve: the superheated vapour region.
Sağlam bir yağı erken atmak israftır; bo: Discarding a sound oil early is wasteful; continuing to use a degraded oil damages the machinery. Analysis strikes this balance with objective data.
Sağlık katkısı, lezzetten ödün vermeden: The health contribution goes further by offering healthier options without compromising on flavor: limiting frying and doing more baking/grilling/steaming, using salt and sugar in moderation, keeping fresh vegetables/fruit at every meal and offering wholegrain options. By always having a balanced "lighter" alternative on the menu, the cook also serves crew members who watch their health.
Sağlık serbestisi (free pratique) alınan: Until free pratique is granted, the "Q" flag is hoisted when required — the ship declares that it is healthy and requests free pratique. Without the approval of the health authority (radio pratique or face-to-face pratique), persons boarding and leaving are restricted where required. The Master applies this signalling and the procedure correctly.
Sağlıklı bir güverte departmanında near-: In a healthy deck department, near-miss reporting is encouraged; the aim is learning, not punishment. The Chief Officer analyzes reported events, finds the root cause and builds the corrective measures into the work plan. Suppressing a near-miss prepares the ground for the next real accident.
Scavenge air cooler (charge air cooler): Scavenge air cooler (charge air cooler) performance is monitored by the air inlet/outlet temperatures and the water-side differential pressure. Air-side fouling lowers the boost; water-side fouling impairs cooling. A clogged water mist catcher after the cooler, or a condensate drain that is not kept open, leads to water entering the cylinders.
Scavenge air pressure (boost pressure),: Scavenge air pressure (boost pressure) shows the engine's "breathing" capacity; a drop indicates air cooler fouling, a T/C fault or a clogged air intake filter. Pmax (maximum combustion pressure) and Pcomp (compression pressure) are measured with an indicator/PMI instrument, and balance is achieved when these two values are equal in all cylinders.
Scavenge air pressure, turbocharger rpm: Scavenge air pressure, turbocharger rpm and scavenge temperature show the health of the turbocharger and the air system. A sudden rise in scavenge box temperature is a forerunner of a scavenge fire (ignition of oil deposits) and requires immediate action.
Scavenge box içinde biriken yanmamış yak: Unburnt fuel and oil accumulating in the scavenge box can be ignited by hot blow-by gas and cause a scavenge fire. Signs include a rise in the exhaust/scavenge temperature of the cylinder concerned, T/C surging, blistering paint and a drop in load. The Second Engineer manages this risk through regular cleaning of the scavenge drains and maintenance of the under-piston space.
Scavenge box'ta biriken yağ/karbon, blow: Oil/carbon accumulating in the scavenge box can be ignited by hot blow-by gas (scavenge fire). Signs: a rise in scavenge temperature at the unit concerned, a temperature alarm, a drop in power and sometimes local heating on the casing. When detected, the load is reduced immediately, the lubrication of the cylinder concerned is adjusted, the scavenge port is closed and extinguishing (fixed system/CO2) is applied.
Scavenge drain (cylinder drain oil) numu: A scavenge drain (cylinder drain oil) sample is the most practical tool for showing the condition of the cylinder liner and the piston ring zone. The Second Engineer organizes the taking of a separate sample from each cylinder and has an on-board quick test carried out for Fe content (e.g. magnetic chip / colorimetric kit).
Scavenge fire ise scavenge boşluğunda bi: A scavenge fire is the ignition of oil accumulated in the scavenge space; the exhaust temperature rises, the load is reduced and the fixed smothering system (steam/CO2) is kept ready. These events are critical safety lessons on which the cadet must base the answer to the question "why do we wait on a crankcase alarm?"
Scavenge fire tespitinde yük derhal düşü: When a scavenge fire is detected, the load is reduced immediately, fuel to the cylinder concerned is cut off, the scavenge drains are closed and the fixed smothering system (CO2/steam) is kept ready. Extra care is needed so that the fire does not lead to a crankcase explosion through the connection with the crankcase (piston rod stuffing box).
Scavenge fire'ı önlemenin yolu; scavenge: The way to prevent scavenge fire is to keep the scavenge box clean of oil/carbon deposits, to monitor ring condition (to reduce blow-by) and to set the cylinder lubrication correctly. Keeping the drains open allows accumulated oil to drain away.
Scavenge inspection, motor durdurulmuş,: Scavenge inspection is carried out with the engine stopped, cooled down and isolated by LOTO; the turning gear must be engaged and locked. Appropriate PPE and care are needed against the risks of hot surfaces and confined spaces. Nothing is opened until the isolation has been verified.
Scavenge port'tan yapılan inspection ile: Inspection through the scavenge ports shows the condition of the piston rings (broken, sticking, worn), ring zone deposits and the liner surface (glazing, scuffing). If early signs of scuffing are not caught and acted upon, a risk of seizure arises.
Scavenge port'tan yapılan inspection, mo: Inspection through the scavenge ports is the most practical way of seeing the internal condition without dismantling the engine. The condition of pistons, rings and liners, deposit build-up and possible traces of scavenge fire are observed here. With this regular check, the Second Engineer catches major failures early.
Scavenge space (süpürme havası bölgesi): A fire in the scavenge space (scavenge air space) is a hidden but dangerous event in large two-stroke engines; it shows itself through a local temperature rise and smoke. By monitoring the deposits and the temperature at the scavenge drains, the Oiler can catch the early signs.
Scavenge ve under-piston inspection, İki: Scavenge and under-piston inspection is a valuable diagnostic tool with which the Second Engineer observes the internal condition of the main engine without dismantling it. Regular inspection, cleaning of the scavenge box and rapid response to signs of scavenge fire protect the main engine from both fire and major wear damage.
Scrubber (yıkayıcı), gazı deniz suyuyla: The scrubber washes the gas with seawater, removing most of the SOx and soot and cooling it. A demister/dryer then removes the moisture. Gas that has not been cleaned causes corrosion in the tanks and contaminates the cargo.
Scrubber arızasında kısa sürede uyumlu y: A plan for changing over to compliant fuel at short notice must be ready in case the scrubber fails.
Scrubber temizliği, deck seal su seviyes: Scrubber cleaning, the deck seal water level and O2 analyser calibration are dealt with regularly. Blower bearings and vibration are monitored.
Scrubber wash water izlenir veya uyumlu: The scrubber wash water is monitored, or compliant fuel is used; ECA and port rules are complied with. The annual CII is calculated and the SEEMP measures are applied.
Scrubber'lı gemilerde wash water pH/PAH/: On ships with scrubbers, the pH, PAH and turbidity of the wash water are monitored; ships without scrubbers use compliant fuel (e.g. 0.5% sulphur). In areas where open-loop operation is restricted, the appropriate mode is selected.
Scrubber'sız gemiler ECA'ya girmeden önc: Ships without scrubbers must change over to 0.10% compliant fuel (LSMGO/MGO or a very low sulfur distillate) before entering the ECA. The Chief Engineer designs the procedure according to the ship's compliance strategy (changeover or scrubber).
Scupper'lar (güverte tahliye delikleri): Scuppers (deck drain holes) and drain channels (waterways/gutterways) allow rain, seawater and wash water on deck to drain quickly overboard or to the bilge. The AB clears these channels of leaves, rust, paint residue, ropes and debris. A blocked scupper leads to water collecting on deck and a risk of freezing and slipping.
Sea Protest (Note of Protest), kaptanın: A Sea Protest (Note of Protest) is a declaration by which the Master formally records, after an unusual event (heavy weather, grounding, risk of cargo damage, collision), that he or she and the ship were not at fault and that the damage was caused by external factors. It is made before a notary or a consul at the first suitable port, generally within a reasonable time after arrival (often within 24 hours). A Sea Protest strengthens the ship's position against later cargo claims and GA proceedings.
Sea Service Certificate \"ne kadar süre: The Sea Service Certificate answers the question "how long did you spend at sea", and the TRB the question "what did you learn in that time and what is your evidence". The Administration requires both together with the examination application. Sea service time alone is not sufficient; completion of structured training during that time must be proven by the TRB.
Sea Service belgeleri, cüzdan ve TRB; yı: Sea Service certificates, the seafarer's book and the TRB are evidence accumulated over years and very difficult to reproduce. Their loss, theft or damage (getting wet, fire) may result in the training period not being recognized. The cadet should keep these documents in a waterproof, secure place and protect them carefully when traveling.
Sea Service belgesi kaptan onayı, TRB is: The Sea Service certificate requires the Master's approval and the TRB the approval of the training engineer (usually the Chief Engineer). The cadet must complete both approvals at the end of each period. A missing approval — for example unsigned TRB pages or an unstamped Sea Service certificate — may invalidate the application.
Sea Service belgesi ve sertifika süreci,: The Sea Service certificate and the certification process are the point at which the valuable months the engine cadet has spent at sea become legal evidence. Complete certificates, consistent dates, a completed TRB and valid courses are the load-bearing pillars of the file leading to the OOW certificate. Obtaining certificates on time and correctly, keeping dates consistent and storing everything securely are the cadet's most basic responsibilities towards their own career. A poorly managed document process can leave even the most successful training period without evidence and invalid.
Sea protest, geminin uğradığı veya yol a: A sea protest is a formal declaration that, in damage suffered or possibly caused by the ship, the circumstances (e.g. a storm, force majeure) were beyond the control of the ship and crew. It provides an early basis of evidence against compensation claims that may be made later and protects the ship's position.
Sea protest, noter/makam huzurunda yapıl: A sea protest is a formal declaration made before a notary or an authority. A Letter of Protest (LOP) is a letter given to the terminal, charterer or other party objecting to a particular situation (slow loading, damaged cargo, a dispute over measurements). The Master does not confuse the two and uses each of them in the right place and at the right time.
Sea trial hız-güç eğrisi, gemi yaşam dön: The speed-power curve from the sea trials should be kept as the performance benchmark throughout the ship's life. Without this reference, the cause of a deterioration in the CII cannot be properly separated (design, operation or maintenance).
Sea valve / overboard valve gibi su altı: Underwater valves such as sea valves/overboard valves are regarded as "critical"; their opening/closing tests and tightness are carefully recorded. If the work is below the ship's waterline, it may require divers or dry-dock conditions.
Sea water inlet basıncı ve coolerların g: Sea water inlet pressure and the inlet/outlet temperature difference across the coolers are monitored; a blocked sea chest or an MGPS fault reduces the efficiency of the central cooler. In a central fresh water cooling system, the expansion tank level and system pressure are checked; a fall indicates a leak, and a rise indicates gas/steam ingress.
Sea water tarafı kaçaklarda ilgili sea v: For leaks on the sea water side, the relevant sea valve is closed and the affected system is bypassed. If the water ingress exceeds the capacity of the pumps, the emergency bilge suction (usually connected to the main circulating pump, large diameter) is brought into use.
Seal ve bearing PMS'e göre yenilenir; ka: Seals and bearings are renewed according to the PMS; performance is verified with a capacity test. The line segregation is maintained so that the segregated ballast never mixes with oil.
Seal/bearing PMS'e göre yenilenir; kapas: Seals and bearings are renewed according to the PMS; performance is verified with a capacity test. A high deballasting capacity is needed for the BLU sequence.
Second-stage remote audible başladıktan: If there is no reset 90 seconds after the second-stage remote audible alarm starts, a third-stage alarm alerting other crew members able to take action comes into operation; on a cargo ship an approved combined arrangement may exist, and the total escalation time must not exceed the performance standard.
Secure a mooring line on the designated: Secure a mooring line on the designated bitts using the approved arrangement for that line and fitting. Confirm the lead, load and required ability to release or adjust it. Do not add an improvised locking turn that prevents controlled release. Keep clear of loaded turns and follow the station leader’s instructions.
Sefer bazlı karar seti oluşturulmalıdır:: A set of voyage-based decisions should be built: economical speed if the ETA is flexible, route revision if the weather worsens, just-in-time arrival if the port is congested, trim and auxiliary load optimisation on ballast voyages.
Sefer boyunca biriken saat değişimleri E: The clock changes accumulated during the voyage have no indirect effect on the ETA, because the ETA is calculated on a UTC basis; however, if the ship's zone time has not yet been synchronized with port time as the ship approaches the port, time discrepancies can arise in onboard planning. For this reason, the clock change plan must be completed so that ship's time is brought to port time before arrival.
Sefer boyunca lashing rutin olarak kontr: Lashings are checked routinely throughout the voyage; a "lashing inspection" is carried out especially before and after bad weather. Slack lashings are retightened. The Bosun keeps records of these checks and reports to the Chief Officer.
Sefer sonu veya periyodik appraisal form: End-of-voyage or periodic appraisal forms are entered into the company SMS and feed the promotion/re-employment decisions of the crewing department ashore. The Chief Engineer's fair, specific and development-oriented assessment directly affects team motivation.
Sefer öncesi, passage plan ile folio çap: Before the voyage, the passage plan and the folio are cross-checked; for each leg, the chart of the correct scale, up to date and corrected, is confirmed. CATZOC and over-scale conditions are noted in the passage plan. This discipline cuts the risk of chart-related grounding right at the start.
Sefere ilişkin bir uyarı alındığında İki: When a warning relevant to the voyage is received, the Second Officer assesses its position, period of validity and nature and, if necessary, enters it on the paper chart in pencil and in ECDIS as a manual update or with reference to the AIO. When a cancellation is received, the mark is erased.
Segman ağız boşluğu: Yeni segmanda üreti: Piston ring butt gap: a new ring has the nominal value set by the maker. The gap increases with wear; if the limit is exceeded, the ring is replaced with a new one.
Segman boşluk (gap) ölçümü: butt gap ve: Ring clearance measurements: butt gap and side clearance. Worn rings cause increased oil consumption, loss of compression and more exhaust smoke.
Segman yüzey durumu: Çizikler, karbonlan: Ring surface condition: scratches, carbon deposits and breakage are checked. The radial clearance in the ring groove must also be measured.
Segregasyon tablosu, hangi sınıfların ya: The segregation table specifies which classes may be side by side, one on top of the other, or in adjacent compartments. The Chief Officer ensures that incompatible goods (e.g. oxidizing + flammable) are separated by a safe distance. On container ships, the bay-row-tier plan is checked against these rules.
Sekstant rasadında gök cisminin yüksekli: When the altitude of a celestial body is measured in a sextant sight, the exact second is noted, because the calculated position depends on this time. The Second Officer keeps celestial navigation skills and the discipline of taking accurate time alive, in case of a GPS failure scenario.
Self-heating kargo (kömür, DRI) bulunan: In holds/voids containing self-heating cargo (coal, DRI), O₂ is depleted and CO/methane accumulates. From the cargo declaration, the Chief Officer anticipates the hazard these spaces present and always takes measurements before entry. Even a hold that "looks empty" can have a lethal atmosphere because of the previous cargo.
Senaryo, her ay farklı olmalıdır; aynı \: The scenario should be different every month; if the same "lower the lifeboat" routine is repeated, the team memorizes it but does not think. Targeting different skills in turn, such as boundary cooling, re-flash watch, enclosed space rescue and casualty handling, makes the team competent across the whole range of emergencies.
Senaryo: Egzoz sıcaklığı 3 numaralı sili: Scenario: the exhaust temperature is rising on cylinder number 3.
Senkron jeneratörde rotor, DC uyarma akı: In a synchronous generator the rotor produces a magnetic field with DC excitation current. When the rotor turns, this magnetic field cuts the stator windings and an EMF (electromotive force) is induced according to Faraday's law of electromagnetic induction.
Senkroskop, gelen jeneratör ile baranın: The synchroscope is an instrument that shows the phase difference between the voltages of the incoming generator and the busbar. If the pointer turns slowly clockwise, the incoming generator is slightly faster than the busbar (fast). The breaker is closed as the pointer approaches the 12 o'clock position.
Sensör fark alarmında hatalı kaynak tren: On a sensor difference alarm, the faulty source is diagnosed from the trend, the voting and independent observation. When a sensor is disabled, the consequence analysis and the ASOG status are checked again.
Sensörler kalibre edilir; alarm noktalar: Sensors are calibrated; alarm points and the dead-man alarm are tested. In UMS mode the transfer of alarms to the bridge and cabins is verified.
Sensörler periyodik kalibre edilir; alar: Sensors are calibrated periodically; alarm points and the dead-man alarm are tested. In UMS mode the transfer of alarms to the bridge and cabins is verified.
Sensörler → veri toplama üniteleri → mer: Sensors → data acquisition units → central processing unit → operator interface (HMI).
Sensörlerin ömrü sınırlıdır (özellikle e: Sensors have a limited life (especially electrochemical H₂S/CO sensors); expired sensors are replaced. A spare instrument and spare batteries are kept ready.
Sentetik halat esnerken enerji depolar;: A synthetic line stores energy as it stretches; when it parts, this energy is released as snap-back. The modern view is that "the whole deck is a potential snap-back zone", because the danger zone changes as the direction of the line changes. The Bosun teaches the crew to stand out of the line's path and, wherever possible, behind the winch/bitt.
Sentetik halatlar tel halatlardan çok da: Synthetic ropes store much more energy than wire ropes and are much more dangerous when they part. Snap-back is the leading cause of deaths in mooring operations.
Separator bowl temizliği, sludge boşaltm: Separator bowl cleaning, sludge discharge frequency and heater performance are monitored regularly. In separators operating with water (purifier mode), if the seal water is not set correctly, breakthrough (fuel escaping to the water side) occurs. In clarifier mode (no water seal), only particles are separated.
Separatör (purifier) sludge'ı, drip tray: Separator (purifier) sludge, drip tray deposits, filter oil and oil from the oily bilge are collected in the sludge/waste oil tank. The Wiper directs these flows to the correct tank and helps monitor the tank levels. When the tank is full, the engineer is informed; delivery ashore or burning in the ship's incinerator is planned.
Separatör (purifier): En etkili yöntemdi: Separator (purifier): the most effective method; running at 98 °C and at a low throughput increases the efficiency of cat fines removal.
Separatör (purifier/clarifier), yüksek h: The separator (purifier/clarifier) separates water and solid particles from fuel/oil by high-speed centrifugal force. In purifier mode, water and oil are separated (the water is discharged); in clarifier mode, only solids are separated. Separation, which is based on the difference in density, is balanced by gravity disc selection (in conventional separators) or by automatic water detection (in modern separators).
Separatör bakımı ve desludge'dan çıkan t: All oily waste from separator maintenance and desludging goes to the sludge tank; fuel/oil spilled during maintenance is collected and is not mixed into the bilge. Sludge transfers and disposal are entered in the ORB. By directing maintenance waste correctly, the Oiler maintains MARPOL compliance.
Separatör bakımı, makineyi cat fines ve: Separator maintenance is an invisible shield that protects the engine from cat fines and water. The correct temperature, the correct gravity disc, a sound water seal, proper desludging and meticulous periodic cleaning both prevent fuel/oil loss and protect the injection equipment and the bearings. A good Oiler/Fitter is someone who checks the separator's water and clean outlets every watch, takes vibration seriously and touches the bowl only when it has come to a complete stop. Clean fuel means a sound engine.
Separatör bowl'u (kovan) çok yüksek devi: The separator bowl rotates at a very high speed (usually around 6000-10000 rpm); this rotation forces the denser water and solid particles outward and the less dense clean fuel/oil inward. The disc stack makes the liquid flow in thin layers, which increases the separation surface and the efficiency. Clean fuel/oil leaves at the top, while water and sludge collect at the outside.
Separatör hem çok sıcaktır (~98°C beslem: The separator is both very hot (~98°C feed, heater, hot fuel) and a mass rotating at very high speed; both carry a risk of serious injury. Contact with hot surfaces, leaking hot fuel and the rotating bowl are the main hazards. Maintenance is done only on equipment that has been stopped, has cooled down and has been energy-isolated.
Separatör iki modda çalışabilir: purifie: A separator can operate in two modes: purifier (separating water + solids, with a water seal) and clarifier (separating solids only, if there is no water ingress). For HFO, purifier mode is generally used because both water and cat fines must be removed. The Oiler knows which mode the separator is in and why it is in that mode.
Separatör overhaul'da bowl, conta ve O-r: In a separator overhaul, the bowl, gasket and O-ring sets are renewed; the bowl assembly sequence and balance are critical (incorrect assembly causes vibration and accidents). Loss of the water seal (broken water seal) causes fuel to escape through the water outlet to the sludge tank, while poor separation lets water/solids reach the main engine. The Second Engineer monitors separator vibration and leakage daily.
Separatör performansı sürekli izlenir: b: Separator performance is monitored continuously: the feed temperature, the quality of the clean fuel/oil outlet, the water drainage and the sludge discharge are observed. A dark sludge discharge is normal; however, clean fuel/oil escaping into the water (oil loss) or fuel appearing at the water outlet indicates a seal/disc problem. The Oiler makes these observations every watch.
Separatör çalıştıkça dış çeperde (bowl p: As the separator runs, sludge and water accumulate at the outer wall (bowl periphery); at set intervals this accumulation is discharged (desludge / sludge discharge). In modern separators this is done automatically by a timer; the moving part at the bottom of the bowl (sliding bowl bottom) moves down by means of the operating water, opening the sludge ports so that the sludge is thrown out by centrifugal force, and then closes again.
Separatör, filtreden önceki ana temizlem: The separator is the main cleaning stage before the filter; if its efficiency falls, the load on the filter increases and the DP rises quickly. Cat fines (Al+Si) are a particular target of the separator; a well-functioning purifier removes most of the cat fines. If the Oiler sees sand-like particles in the filter contents, they question the separator's efficiency.
Separatör, yüksek devirde dönen bowl (ka: A separator spins the liquid in a bowl rotating at high speed; because of the difference in density, the heavy phase (water, solids) collects at the outside and the light phase (clean fuel or oil) towards the centre. The disc stack enlarges the separating surface and speeds up settling. Sludge is discharged periodically or automatically.
Separatörde water seal (su contası) doğr: If the water seal in the separator is not established correctly, fuel/oil escapes through the water outlet (oil loss) or water passes to the fuel side. The Oiler checks that the sludge discharge has the correct color (dark sludge) and that no clean fuel/oil is being lost, and reports any deviation to the engineer.
Sequence of events ile initiating event,: The sequence of events is used to separate the initiating event, hidden failures, human factors and barrier failures. Corrective and preventive actions are assigned with owners and deadlines; the FMEA, ASOG, procedures and training needs are updated.
Seri bağlamada debi tüm borularda aynıdı: In series connection the flow is the same in all pipes and the total loss is the sum of the losses of each segment. In parallel connection the pressure loss across each branch is the same and the total flow is the sum of the flows in the branches (the branch with lower resistance carries more flow).
Seri düzende ilk aşamada purifier (su +: In a series arrangement a purifier (separating water + solids) works in the first stage and a clarifier (separating solids only) in the second. In a parallel arrangement two purifiers work at the same time and the total capacity is increased.
Sert plastik konteyner (canister) veya y: Packed in a rigid plastic container (canister) or in a soft valise: CO₂/N₂ cylinder, buoyancy tubes + canopy, painter line.
Sertifikalar geçerli; LSA/FFA ve seyir e: Certificates must be valid, and LSA, FFA and navigation equipment must be in working order. Findings from previous PSC and internal inspections are closed out with evidence. Areas specific to bulk carriers (hatch covers, holds) are in focus.
Sertifikalar geçerli; LSA/FFA, evacuatio: Certificates must be valid; LSA and FFA, the evacuation arrangements, sanitation and previous findings are checked. Passenger ship inspections are comprehensive.
Sertifikalar geçerli; rampa/kapı sızdırm: Certificates must be valid; the watertightness of the ramps and doors, LSA and FFA and the evacuation arrangements are checked. Previous findings are closed out.
Sertifikaların geçerliliği, güverte emni: The validity of certificates, deck safety equipment, life-saving/fire-fighting systems, MARPOL records and the crew's knowledge of their duties are the focus of PSC. Defects found are recorded as "deficiencies"; serious ones lead to detention.
Sertifikalı ladder, manrope, life-buoy v: The pilot ladder is rigged with a certified ladder, manropes, a lifebuoy and lighting; where required, the combination ladder is set at the correct angle. The rigging is checked against a checklist under the supervision of the responsible officer.

The pilot ladder is rigged with a certified ladder, manropes, a lifebuoy and lighting; where required, the combination ladder is set at the correct angle. The rigging is checked against a checklist under the supervision of the responsible officer.
The pilot ladder is rigged with a certified ladder, manropes, a lifebuoy and lighting, and checked against a checklist under the supervision of the responsible officer.
Sertifikalı pilot ladder, manrope, stanc: The pilot ladder is rigged with a certified ladder, manropes, stanchions, a lifebuoy and lighting; if required, a combination ladder (accommodation ladder + pilot ladder) is arranged. The rigging is done under the supervision of the responsible officer and checked against a checklist.
Sertifikalı teçhizat (halat, tel, kaldır: For certified equipment (rope, wire, lifting gear, LSA), there must be an immediate answer to the question "what is where, and with which certificate". The Bosun matches the physical tag to the digital record. In an investigation after an accident, traceability is also evidence that the ship exercised "due diligence".
Sertlik ve besi suyu kontaminasyonu scal: Hardness and feed water contamination create a risk of scale and overheating; the measurement method and the corrective step are recorded according to the test kit procedure.
Service air (kontrol/iş havası) genelde: Service air (control/working air) is usually reduced to 7–8 bar and, for control air, passed through an air dryer; humid air damages control valves and pneumatic equipment. Automatic drain valves (auto-drain) are tested regularly; a blocked drain lets water collect inside the receiver and causes corrosion.
The flow of service must be orderly and courteous. In a buffet (self-service) layout, dishes are arranged in a logical order: plates → main course → side dishes → salad → bread → dessert → drinks. Personnel must be able to move along without crowding. In messes with table service (usually the officers' mess), attention is paid to the left/right serving rule and to quiet professionalism.
Servis bittiğinde toplama düzenli yapılı: When service is over, clearing is done in an orderly way: first, food leftovers are separated according to the MARPOL Annex V categories (food waste separately), dirty plates are taken to the dishwashing area and the tables are cleared. Because of the risk of odors and pests, food waste is dealt with without delay. Serving dishes are emptied and taken for washing.
Servis havası (general service air): Güv: Service air (general service air): for deck work, tank cleaning and general use. It is reduced to 5–7 bar by a pressure regulator after the air dryer.
Servis kapları (chafing dish, bain-marie: Serving equipment (chafing dish, bain-marie, cold counter) is prepared according to the type of meal. For hot dishes, the bain-marie/chafing dish is preheated; cold dishes and salads are kept on the cold line. Having this equipment at the correct temperature is the basis for avoiding the "danger zone" (Section 4).
Servis kaşıkları, maşalar ve servis araç: Serving spoons, tongs and other serving utensils are kept separate for each dish; using the same spoon in different containers causes cross-contamination (particularly regarding allergens and the separation of raw and cooked food). Working in coordination with the cook, the steward plans the order and layout in which dishes are served.
Servis kaşıkları, maşalar ve özel servis: Serving spoons, tongs and special serving utensils are cleaned and kept separate. Broken/cracked plates and glasses are removed from use; a cracked surface carries the risk of both injury and harboring bacteria.
Servis raporları, kalibrasyon sertifikal: Service reports, calibration certificates and type approval documents are filed. A traceable chain of records is essential from both a safety and an inspection point of view.
Servis sırasında buffet sürekli izlenir:: During service, the buffet is monitored continuously: dishes running low are replenished, spills are cleaned up and water/drinks are topped up. An empty dish or bread that has run out is a failure of service. The steward stays in constant contact with the galley and warns the cook in advance when food is running low.
Servis tankı drenajı her vardiyada alını: The service tank is drained every watch; accumulated water and sediment are the most common cause of combustion problems. Tank heating is kept in a range that maintains the fluidity of the fuel without losing the light fractions through overheating.
Servis tankı genellikle 8-24 saatlik yak: The service tank usually holds 8–24 hours' supply of fuel and gives an uninterrupted supply to the engine.
Servis ve hazırlık sonrası tüm çalışma y: After service and preparation, all work surfaces (worktops, cutting area), the area around the range, the sink and touch points are cleaned and sanitized. Food-contact surfaces are cleaned with green-coded equipment. Grease build-up is removed; accumulated grease is both a hygiene and a fire risk.
Servisten önce mess \"mise en place\" ma: Before service, the mess is prepared on the "mise en place" principle: everything in its place and nothing missing. Tables are disinfected and covered with a clean tablecloth or placemats; cutlery, plates, glasses, napkins, condiments (salt and pepper), water jugs and bread baskets are laid out neatly. The jugs are filled with fresh water. The hot drinks (tea/coffee) station is checked and replenished.
Settling tank, su ve katı kalıntının çök: The settling tank allows water and solid residues to settle out; the water/sludge at the bottom is removed by regular draining. The service tank is the clean fuel tank that feeds the engine directly; it is fed continuously by the purifier and its level is kept high. The Second Engineer routinely checks the draining and temperature of both tanks.
Settling tankında ısıtma mantarı ile sıc: In the settling tank the temperature is kept constant with a heating coil; water and sediment collecting at the bottom are drained regularly.
Settling: 24-48 saat bekleme ile büyük p: Settling: with 24–48 hours of settling, large particles sink to the bottom.
Seviye 1 – Algılama: Çevredeki bilgileri: Level 1 – Perception: being aware of the information around you. Noticing engine parameters, alarms and sounds.
Seviye 2 – Kavrama: Algılanan bilgilerin: Level 2 – Comprehension: understanding what the perceived information means. Knowing that a rise in exhaust temperature points to an injector fault.
Seviye 3 – Öngörü: Mevcut durumun gelece: Level 3 – Projection: predicting what the present situation will lead to. Foreseeing that the engine will be damaged if the temperature keeps rising.
Seviye yükseldiğinde kaptan ve SSO, SSP': When the level is raised, the Master and the SSO put into effect the measures defined in the SSP for that level: reducing the number of access points, tightening identity checks, increasing searches of baggage and stores, more frequent patrols and more intensive watch on the seaward side (anti-piracy/anti-stowaway watch). Changes of level and the measures applied are recorded; these records are reported to the port authority and the company.
Seyir boyunca XTD (cross-track distance): XTD (cross-track distance), wheel-over points and UKC are monitored throughout the passage, and deviations are corrected early. The plan is approved by the Master.
Seyir cihazlarının bakımı genelde gemini: Maintenance of navigational equipment is usually tracked as jobs defined in the ship's Planned Maintenance System (PMS). The Second Officer ensures that the test and calibration records for the bridge equipment (gyro error book, deviation book, radar PM log, magnetic compass swing, SART/EPIRB tests) are kept up to date and complete.
Seyir cihazlarının düzenli bakım ve kali: Regular follow-up of the maintenance and calibration of navigational equipment is the invisible foundation of an accurate position and safe maneuvering. The Second Officer's task is not only to operate the equipment but to cross-check its readings, record discrepancies and catch silent failures early. A disciplined routine of records and verification both breaks the accident chain right at the start and ensures that the ship is found ready at every inspection.
Seyir emniyetinin nihai sorumluluğu, kap: The ultimate responsibility for the safety of navigation gives the Master both great authority and a great burden. This authority is not a "privilege of rank"; it is a professional position earned anew every day with every decision. SOLAS V/34, ISM 5.2 and STCW define this authority not to protect the Master but to protect safety at sea. A sensible Master builds a bridge culture in which he or she never has to "use" this authority; but uses it without hesitation the moment it is needed.
Seyir fenerleri SOLAS zorunlu tüketicile: Navigation lights are consumers required by SOLAS and their power is never cut off. They are supplied from the emergency switchboard (ESB). The navigation light failure monitoring panel shows the status of each light and gives an audible and visual alarm on failure.
Seyir fenerleri acil dağıtım panosundan: The navigation lights are supplied from the emergency switchboard (ESB). If power is lost, the battery system cuts in automatically.
Seyir jurnali, geminin resmi ve hukuki k: The deck logbook is the ship's official and legal record; it has evidential value in court. The cadet learns what information is entered in the deck logbook: positions, course and speed changes, weather and sea state, visibility, significant points passed, engine orders, drills and unusual events. The bell book (course and engine movement book), kept during maneuvering and pilotage, contains a record of all helm and engine orders accurate to the second.
Seyir planlamasına destek, güverte stajy: Supporting passage planning is one of the most valuable areas of training on the deck cadet's way to becoming a future navigating officer. Here the cadet learns not only to correct charts or calculate waypoints, but to think holistically "berth to berth", to foresee danger and to document with discipline. The plan produced at the end of this process is the written guarantee of the ship's safe navigation; the cadet's contribution to building this guarantee is a sign of both technical and professional maturity.
Seyir sırasında ana makinenin durması (e: A main engine stop (engine stop/trip) while under way is a serious emergency; it is especially critical in a narrow channel, in traffic or in bad weather. The Chief Engineer informs the bridge immediately and determines the cause of the trip (overspeed, low LO pressure, jacket water high temp, scavenge fire).
Seyir ve haberleşme elektroniği, geminin: Navigation and communication electronics are the ship's "eyes, ears and voice"; by keeping these systems working at all times, the ETO safeguards both navigational safety and the ability to reach the outside world in an emergency. A single silent fault in this equipment can be a matter of life and death at a critical moment.
Seyirde ana makine yeterli yükte çalışır: At sea, while the main engine runs at sufficient load, the economiser section meets the steam demand and the oil-fired section is switched off automatically. In port or at low load the oil-fired section comes into operation.
Seyirde havaya bağlı işler yapılamaz; bu: At sea, weather-dependent jobs cannot be done; instead, maintenance inside equipment (crane servicing, hatch hydraulics, workshop jobs), inventory taking and training activities come to the fore. If the weather permits, jobs such as touch-up paint, lashing inspection and lifeboat exterior maintenance are scheduled.
Seyirde tayfalar zabitlerle birlikte 4-s: At sea, ratings stand 4-hour watches together with the officers (e.g. 4-on/8-off); a lookout is mandatory under STCW at night and in restricted visibility. In port, a gangway watch, cargo watch and security watch (ISPS) system is set up. The Chief Officer prepares the watch schedule without violating the rest regime and ensures that the handover is complete at every change of duty.
Seyirde öncelik, denizde gevşek malzeme: At sea, the priority is to leave no loose material on deck and to sea-fasten everything. When bad weather is expected, the Bosun carries out a "secure for sea" check over the whole open deck: lashings, store doors, hose reels, gas cylinders and deck equipment. An object thrown about by rolling causes injury, loss overboard and damage.
Shackle (D veya bow tipi), sapan ile yük: A shackle (D or bow type) connects the sling to the load/lifting point. Inspection looks for: SWL marking on the shackle and its pin, deformation (opening/bending), wear, cracks and the condition of the pin thread. The pin must be fully seated, and the correct shackle pin must be used (a wrong/improvised pin is lethal). The pin is not rigged in a position where it can turn/work loose under load.
Shackle (kilit), turnbuckle (liftin), pa: Cargo securing gear such as shackles, turnbuckles, pad eyes, chains, lashing bars, twist locks, bottle screws and hooks is stamped with its SWL (Safe Working Load). The Bosun keeps these items in separate boxes according to SWL and size; a mixed box of shackles leads to a part with the wrong SWL being selected during maneuvering, and to accidents.
Shackle'ın gövdesine yan (transverse) yü: No side (transverse) load is applied to a shackle; it is loaded only along the axis for which it was designed. A shackle with an unsuitable item such as a screw/nail fitted in place of its pin must never be used. A shackle without an SWL marking, or one that is deformed, is out of service.
Shadow/blind sector; mast, baca, crane v: A shadow or blind sector is where targets on certain bearings are weakened or lost because of masts, funnels, cranes or cargo. These sectors are managed with the bridge poster and inspection information and with the other radar and a visual lookout.
Shallow ve deep contour esas olarak renk: The shallow and deep contours mainly arrange the colour bands and situational awareness. The XTD is the route corridor; it may differ on each leg according to channel width, traffic, positioning accuracy, bank and turning effects and the abort area. The look-ahead (time or distance sector) depends on the maker's interface and is set according to the ship's actual stopping and turning needs.
Ship Sanitation Control Exemption Certif: The Ship Sanitation Control Exemption Certificate (SSCEC) or Ship Sanitation Control Certificate (SSCC) documents the ship's sanitary conditions and its pest and rodent control; it is generally valid for 6 months and is renewed at authorised ports. The Master follows the validity of the certificate and plans the port of renewal; an expired certificate causes problems in port.
Ship Security Alert System (SSAS) tetikl: When the Ship Security Alert System (SSAS) is activated, the signal goes silently to the CSO and the flag state; no alarm sounds on the bridge (so that pirates do not notice). The Master knows the SSAS test and activation procedure, the conditions for issuing a declaration of security (DoS) and the reporting for high risk area (HRA) transits (UKMTO, MSCHOA).
Ship Security Alert System (SSAS), SOLAS: The Ship Security Alert System (SSAS) is mandatory on certain ships under SOLAS XI-2/6. When there is a security threat (piracy, terrorism, hijacking), the SSAS sends a silent alert directly to the company security contact and/or the flag state authority, without sounding an alarm on board and without alerting nearby ships. There are at least two activation points, one on the bridge and the other in a concealed location. The activation points are protected to prevent false alerts.
Ship Security Plan (SSP), her gemi için: The Ship Security Plan (SSP) is a document prepared for each ship on the basis of the Ship Security Assessment (SSA) and approved by the flag state (or an authorised RSO). The SSP defines access control, restricted areas, security equipment, the measures to be taken at each security level, the SSAS procedure and the response to security incidents. The SSP is a confidential document; even a PSC inspector may not see certain parts of it (only certain operational items may be shown).
Shipper, yük hakkında doğru bilgi (IMSBC: The shipper is obliged to provide correct information about the cargo (IMSBC group, IMDG class, MSDS, stowage factor). The Chief Officer checks that this information is complete and agrees with the manifest; missing/wrong information stops the loading.
Shore power bağlantısı için gemi gerilim: For a shore power connection, the ship's voltage and frequency must be compatible with the shore grid. Different countries have 50 Hz or 60 Hz grids at different voltage levels. Transformers and frequency converters are used where needed.
Shore power bağlantısında protective ear: In a shore power connection, the protective earth (PE) connection is made first and removed last. Before inserting the shore plug, the ETO confirms with a voltage detector that it is dead, and checks that the mechanical/electrical interlock prevents the ship's generator breaker and the shore breaker from being closed at the same time.
Shore power kullanımı limandaki egzoz em: Using shore power brings the exhaust emissions (SOx, NOx, PM) in port down to zero. Under the EU Alternative Fuels Infrastructure Regulation (AFIR), shore power will be mandatory for certain ports and ships from 2030.
Shore reception facility'ye yapılan her: For every delivery to a shore reception facility, the receipt obtained (garbage disposal receipt) is kept with the quantity and category and is cross-checked against the GRB. A mismatch between the receipt and the GRB leads to a serious finding at inspection. The Chief Officer estimates the amount of waste before delivery and verifies it against the receipt.
Shore-based routing servisi öneri sağlas: Although a shore-based routing service provides recommendations, the final decision rests with the ship's team; the service does not know the ship-specific sensitivities or the real-time loading condition. The Second Officer confirms the service's recommendation with an independent analysis or rejects it with justification.
Shutdown ve slow-down fonksiyonları (örn: Shutdown and slowdown functions (e.g. main engine oil pressure low → slowdown, very low → shutdown) are safety-critical; the ETO verifies these setpoints and the actuator chain (sensor → logic → trip valve) by on-site testing. Override functions are recorded and supervised.
Siber güvenlik fiziksel güvenlikle bütün: Cybersecurity is integrated with physical security: physical access to control panels, server cabinets and network equipment is restricted to authorized persons. The ETO immediately disables the logins of personnel who leave the ship and carries out periodic access reviews; inactive or unnecessary logins are closed.
Siber güvenlik, ETO'nun en yeni ama hızl: Cybersecurity is the ETO's newest responsibility, but one that is fast becoming the most critical, because a breach of an ECDIS or a propulsion control system is now as real a threat to navigational safety as a fire or flooding. The ETO's success is measured by robust segmentation, disciplined media/update/access control and the readiness to switch the ship safely to manual mode during an incident. This invisible layer of defense keeps the ship resilient against the risks of the digital age.
Side ramp: gemi yan tarafından açılır, t: Side ramp: opens from the ship's side; used depending on the terminal layout.
Side-lobe, multiple echo, indirect echo,: Side-lobe echoes, multiple echoes, indirect echoes, second-trace echoes and interference can look like real targets. They are distinguished by their movement relative to fixed objects, their behaviour when the range is changed, and by checking with another radar and visually.
Side-rolling tip: panel raylar üzerinde: Side-rolling type: the panels roll sideways on rails; suitable for large hatch openings, common on bulk carriers.
Sigara yalnızca izin verilen alanlarda i: Smoking is permitted only in designated areas; the steward checks the cleanliness of these areas and the correct use of ashtrays (ones that fully extinguish embers). If the steward notices signs/smell of smoking in a bunk or in an unauthorized area, the steward reports it. Smoking is one of the main causes of accommodation fires.
Sigorta ve hukuki muhataplıkta kaptanın: In insurance and legal matters, the Master's strength comes not from taking decisions alone but from bringing in the right party at the right moment and documenting the facts flawlessly. In a marine incident, what determines the financial outcome is often not the incident itself but the quality of the evidence collected in the first hours after it and the timing of the notifications. A well-managed casualty process ensures that the ship receives the cover it deserves in full; a badly managed process can leave even a ship that was in the right uninsured and legally exposed.
Sigortalar (fuse) doğru tip, akım ve kes: Fuses must be stocked with the correct type, current rating and breaking capacity; a wrong fuse both fails to protect and creates a safety risk. The ETO keeps sufficient spares of every fuse type in use (fast/time-delay, HRC, semiconductor fuse). Relays, sensors (pressure, temperature, level, current transformer) and connectors are also stocked according to criticality.
Silici'nin işi rütbece mütevazı olsa da: Although the Wiper's job is modest in rank, it is critical for safety; a clean and tidy engine room directly reduces the risk of fire and accidents, allows faults to be noticed early and is the first indicator of the ship's professionalism during inspections. A good Wiper is someone who sees cleaning as a safety duty.
Silici, temizlik malzemelerinin (degreas: The Wiper keeps track of the stock of cleaning materials (degreaser, detergent, rags, absorbent pads, brushes, gloves, garbage bags) and informs the engineer when stocks run low, so that nothing is missing from the port supply order (requisition). Chemicals are stored in their original/labeled containers, with their MSDSs kept accessible.
Silici, temizlik yaparken güvenlik ayakk: When cleaning, the Wiper wears safety shoes, gloves, goggles and, where necessary, ear protection (engine room noise). The Wiper keeps clear of hot surfaces, moving/rotating equipment and electrical systems; cleaning these points may require the equipment to be stopped or isolated.
Silici; zeminler (floor plates), ekipman: The Wiper is responsible for a wide area covering floors (floor plates), equipment surfaces, handrails, ladders, platforms, drip trays, save-all trays and bilge wells. The Wiper also keeps track of the stock of cleaning materials and helps with waste oil/sludge management.
Silikon (Si) genelde dış kaynaklı kum/to: Silicon (Si) generally indicates ingress of sand/dust from outside (an air filter problem) and accelerates abrasive wear. Sodium (Na) suggests seawater ingress. Each metal points to a particular component like a fingerprint.
Silindir altına (scavenge/piston rod stu: A sample of the used oil that drains down below the cylinders (scrape-down; scavenge space/piston rod stuffing box area) is taken and analyzed: the Fe content shows wear, and the remaining BN shows the acid neutralization reserve. High Fe means excessive wear/scuffing; low BN means insufficient neutralization. The Second Engineer adjusts the feed rate according to these data.
Silindir başına egzoz sıcaklığı, maksimu: The exhaust temperature of each cylinder, the maximum combustion pressure (Pmax), the scavenge air pressure and temperature, the turbocharger speed and the bearing temperatures are monitored continuously. An imbalance (one cylinder deviating) points to a problem with an injector, a valve or the load distribution.
Silindir gömleği yüksek mukavemetli perl: The cylinder liner is made of high-strength pearlitic cast iron. The inner surface is honed to create the optimum oil-retaining pattern.
Silindir kapağı üzerinde egzoz valfi, ya: The cylinder cover carries the exhaust valve, the fuel injectors, the safety valve, the indicator cock and the cooling water passages.
Silindir soğutma suyu ısısı → tatlı su ü: Cylinder cooling water heat → fresh water production (evaporator).
Silindir ve hortumlar sızıntı açısından: Cylinders and hoses are inspected for leaks; the full closing and opening sequence of the locking actuators is tested. The hydraulic oil is kept clean and a pressure test is carried out.
Silindir yağı gömlek yüzeyine ölçülü doz: Cylinder oil is fed to the liner surface in metered doses. The feed rate is set according to the engine load and the minimum set by the maker; too low a feed rate leads to wear and scuffing marks, too high a feed rate to deposits and unnecessary cost.
Silindir yağı iki iş yapar: liner-ring a: Cylinder oil does two jobs: it reduces wear by providing an oil film between the liner and the rings, and it neutralizes the sulfuric acids formed by combustion with the alkaline components in the oil (BN — Base Number). The Second Engineer manages this balance; too little oil/BN causes corrosive wear and scuffing, while too much oil causes deposits and waste.
Silindir yağı, gömleğe ölçülü dozlarla (: Cylinder oil is fed to the liner in metered doses (cylinder lubricators / Alpha lubrication); the base number (BN) of the oil is selected according to the fuel sulfur content in order to neutralize the sulfur in the fuel. Under MARPOL Annex VI, EGR or SCR is used for NOx in the NOx ECAs where Tier III applies, and low-sulfur fuel or a scrubber is used to meet the SOx limits (0.50% globally, 0.10% in SECAs).
Silindirler arası güç dengesi (power bal: Power balancing between cylinders is done by adjusting the fuel index/VIT (Variable Injection Timing). On electronically controlled ME/RT-flex engines the ECU maintains this balance automatically, while on mechanical MC engines the Second Engineer corrects it manually by fuel pump rack adjustment and shims.
Silindirler ve hortumlar sızıntı açısınd: Cylinders and hoses are inspected for leaks; the hydraulic oil is kept clean and a pressure test is carried out. Correct operation together with the compression bars and rubber packing is verified.
Simpleks kanalda aynı frekansta sırayla: On a simplex channel the parties speak in turn on the same frequency (ship-to-ship); a duplex channel uses two frequencies (telephone connection). The output power can be set to high (25 W) or low (1 W); low power is preferred for short-range communication and to avoid unnecessary interference.
Sinekler hem rahatsızlık hem de patojen: Flies are both a nuisance and a carrier of pathogens; they contaminate food surfaces by landing on them. Control consists of not leaving food/garbage uncovered, fly screens on doors/ventilation openings, electric fly killers (insect-o-cutor) and regular emptying of garbage. Galley windows/doors are kept closed and screened as far as possible.
Sinoptik yüzey haritasında izobarlar (eş: On a synoptic surface chart, isobars (lines of equal pressure) show the pressure systems and the wind distribution. Closely spaced isobars (an increased pressure gradient) mean strong winds. The Second Officer distinguishes low-pressure (depression/low) centers, high-pressure (anticyclone/high) ridges, warm/cold fronts and occlusions.
Sintine içeriğinin yağ oranı önemlidir;: The oil content of the bilge water matters; excessively oily bilge water clogs the OWS and makes it harder to achieve 15 ppm. For this reason, housekeeping (preventing oil leaks at the source) is also a precondition for environmental compliance.
Sintine kuyuları (bilge wells), makine d: Bilge wells are the places at the lowest point of the engine room where leaking water, oil and dirt collect. If they are not cleaned regularly, an oil-water mixture builds up, causes odors and makes the bilge alarms/sensors malfunction. The Wiper cleans the well strainers and collects the deposits properly.
Sintine kuyuları, holding/bilge tankına: The contents of the bilge wells are transferred to the holding/bilge tank; from there they are processed by the OWS or delivered to a shore facility. Sludge (purifier sludge, waste oil) is collected in a separate tank and burned in the incinerator or delivered to a shore reception facility. Every transfer is entered in the ORB; tank levels must be consistent.
Sintine kuyularında yüksek seviye alarmı: The bilge wells have high-level alarms; when the engine room is unmanned (UMS), this alarm is the basic early warning of flooding. If the well strainers and suction lines are blocked, the water cannot be pumped out even if the alarm comes.
Sintine kuyusu, tank, kofferdam, çift di: Entry into enclosed spaces such as bilge wells, tanks, cofferdams, double bottoms, boilers and the main engine crankcase requires a separate enclosed space entry permit. The atmosphere is tested before and during entry: oxygen (target 20.9%), flammable gas (LEL 0%), toxic gases (H2S, CO). The Third/Fourth Engineer verifies that the gas detector is calibrated and assists with the measurements.
Sintine kuyusu, çift dip tank, kofferdam: Bilge wells, double bottom tanks, cofferdams, sludge tanks, boilers and similar enclosed spaces may be deficient in oxygen or accumulate toxic gases (H₂S, CO) and flammable gas. These spaces are entered only after the atmosphere has been tested with a calibrated instrument and an entry permit has been issued.
Sintine suyu, onaylı 15 ppm ekipmanından: Bilge water may not be discharged into the sea without passing through the approved 15 ppm equipment. The non-return valves and blank flanges that prevent cross-connection between the bilge and ballast lines are examined particularly closely in inspections.
Sintine suyunun aktarımı, denize verilme: The transfer of bilge water, its discharge into the sea or its delivery to a shore facility is entered in the Oil Record Book. Ballast operations come under the ballast water management plan and record book.
Sintine yüksek seviye alarmı ve high-lev: The bilge high-level alarm and the high-level floater switches are tested, because they are the first to report water ingress during an unmanned period. A bilge alarm that does not work can turn into a serious danger through undetected water ingress.
Sintinedeki yüzen yağ, sintine pompası ç: Oil floating in the bilge risks getting into the sea when the bilge pump runs; oily bilge contents must therefore first be passed through the oil separator (OWS — Oily Water Separator) or transferred to the sludge tank. The Wiper collects leaks at their source so that excess oil is not carried into the bilge.
Sinyali duyan AB önce kendi can güvenliğ: An AB who hears the signal first ensures their own safety (lifejacket, suitable clothing, head covering), then goes to the assigned muster station. Any fire or injured person seen on the way is reported at the muster. The principle is quick, orderly movement in accordance with the procedure, not panic.
Sipariş miktarı, \"kişi sayısı x gün say: The order quantity is calculated with the formula "number of persons x number of days x consumption per person". From previous voyage data, the cook knows the consumption per person per day of each basic item (e.g. daily meat, rice, bread and milk per person). Multiplying by the number of days until the next provisioning and by the number of crew gives the required quantity; a safety buffer is added on top.
Sipariş, geminin sefer planına göre uygu: The order is routed to a suitable delivery port according to the ship's voyage plan. Spares are delivered through the ship's agent or by a forwarder; customs procedures (in-transit/under bond) and the delivery window must be synchronized with the voyage plan. A badly timed delivery means the part does not reach the ship in time.
Sis, yoğun yağmur veya kar gibi kısıtlı: In restricted visibility, such as fog, heavy rain or snow, a visual lookout is not enough and the aural lookout comes to the fore. Under COLREG Rule 35, the fog signals of other ships (prolonged blasts, short-short blasts, the bell/gong of a ship at anchor) are listened for. Listening in the open air on the bridge wing, away from engine/generator noise, is more effective.
Sistem basittir ve hatırlaması kolaydır:: The system is simple and easy to remember: each area is assigned a color, and the cloths, buckets and gloves for it are kept in that color. The system stays consistent even when personnel change. The steward applies this discipline without exception.
Sistem dört katmandan oluşur: passive pr: The system consists of four layers: passive protection (A/B class divisions, fire doors), detection (smoke/heat/flame detectors), containment (fire dampers, watertight/fire doors, ventilation shutdown) and extinction (portable + fixed systems). The Safety Officer monitors the readiness of each layer.
Sistem otomatik (ısı algılayıcı fuse/lin: The system can be triggered automatically (when a heat-sensing fusible link melts) or manually (pull station). When triggered, it typically also cuts off the gas/electric supply automatically (interlock) and brings the hood fan/damper configuration to a safe state. The cook must know the location of the manual release point (pull station) and how to pull it.
Sistem seviyesinde kök neden, 'tek alarm: At system level the root cause was the "one alarm – one action" approach. Fuel system events involve many parameters; purifier DP, viscosity, temperature, injector leak-off and the exhaust trend should be monitored together.
Sistem tıkanması veya viskozite sorunu n: Loss of power due to system clogging or a viscosity problem is critical inside an ECA for both safety and compliance. Therefore extra monitoring and readiness to respond (spare filter, fallback plan) are required during the changeover.
Sistem yağı periyodik analiz edilir (vis: System oil is analyzed periodically (viscosity, BN/TBN, water, wear metals). Water or fuel contamination is a sign of a cooler leak or poor combustion; the main engine LO separator (purifier) is kept running continuously to remove water/residues.
Sistem çalışma basıncı normal aralıkta o: The system working pressure must be within the normal range; if the relief valve opens early or the pressure fluctuates, there may be a pump/valve problem. The filter differential pressure (ΔP) is monitored; a rising ΔP indicates clogging. Dirty hydraulic oil is the most common cause of valve and pump wear.
Sistem, basınçlı su tankı (pressure tank: The system provides the first water immediately from a pressure tank (with an air cushion); then the automatic sprinkler pump starts and keeps up the supply. The tank starts with fresh water; the pump draws seawater to keep the supply going. The sections are monitored separately.
Sistem; yüksek basınçlı CO₂ tüpleri bata: The system consists of a battery of high-pressure CO₂ cylinders (or a low-pressure bulk tank), a manifold, pilot cylinders, a master valve, distribution pipes and nozzles. Discharge is started from the release cabinet in the CO₂ room (with pilot CO₂); the pilot gas both opens the master valve and directs the gas to the space concerned.
Sistemin ana bileşenleri: yakıt sistemi: The main components of the system are the fuel system (booster, viscotherm, common rail / camshaft), the lubrication system (cylinder lube oil + system oil), the cooling system (jacket water + piston cooling + LT/HT FW), the turbocharger group (T/C + air cooler + scavenge air receiver), the exhaust system (uniflow scavenging ports + exhaust valve), the crankshaft/shafting and the propeller.
Skylight, fire damper ve ventilation kap: The skylight, fire damper and ventilation closing arrangements are there to limit smoke/air in the event of fire. Regular greasing and function testing ensure that these mechanical arrangements work without rusting up or seizing.
Skylight, jaluzi ve havalandırma kanalı: Skylights, louvres and ventilation duct closures can be closed manually or pneumatically.
Slack (yarı dolu) tanklar serbest yüzey: Slack (partly filled) tanks reduce GM through the free surface effect (FSC). The plan is built to keep the number of slack tanks as low as possible and not to leave several tanks slack at the same time.
Slack hold'larda tahıl yüzeyi kayarak he: In slack holds the grain surface shifts and produces a heeling moment; this moment is compared with the grain stability criteria (area under the GZ curve, angle of heel). Trimming and securing reduce the shift.
Sling'lerde efektif SWL, kullanım açısın: For slings, the effective SWL decreases with the sling angle; as the slings move away from the vertical (as the angle increases), the load in each leg increases. In multi-leg slinging, the Oiler allows for the angle factor; a wide angle (>120°) is very dangerous. If the SWL label cannot be read, the equipment is not used.
Slip (apparent slip), pervane ile gemi h: Slip (apparent slip) is the theoretical difference between the propeller's advance and the ship's actual movement; excessive positive slip indicates hull/propeller fouling or heavy weather, while negative slip is the effect of current or an external push. Using trend graphs, technical justification is presented to the Chief Engineer for hull cleaning and propeller polishing decisions.
Slip, teorik ilerleme (pitch × devir) il: Slip is the difference between the theoretical advance (pitch × revolutions) and the actual advance. Apparent slip is calculated with the GPS speed, real slip with the actual speed through the water. Slip rising above normal points to hull fouling, weather or current, or propeller damage.
Slip/trip/fall kazalarının çoğu önlenebi: Most slip, trip and fall accidents could have been prevented: cleaning up spilled oil immediately, coiling up a loose rope and marking a wet floor would have been enough. The AB acts in the knowledge that disorder that looks "small" can turn into a real injury.
Slop tankı, yıkama suyunu ve yağlı atığı: The slop tank holds the washing water and oily waste for a time so that they separate (decanting).
Slow-down ve shut-down sistemleri (auto: Slow-down and shut-down systems (auto slowdown) cut in to protect the ship. The Chief Engineer distinguishes whether the automatic protection is responding to a real hazard or to a sensor fault; if necessary, the override procedure is applied in a controlled way.
Slowdown veya shutdown gibi otomatik kor: If an automatic protection (safety trip) such as slowdown or shutdown is activated, the Oiler observes on site and passes real-time information to the engineer. The locations of the emergency shutdown buttons and the quick-closing valves are known by heart.
Sludge kaynakları; separatör boşaltmalar: Sources of sludge are separator discharges, filter cleaning, tank drains, fuel and oil leaks and the oil phase of the bilge tank. The quantity produced is directly related to the fuel quality used and the separator settings.
Sludge sounding alınır; bertaraf inciner: Sludge tank soundings are taken; sludge is disposed of in the incinerator or to shore reception facilities. The incinerator flame failure trip must work correctly.
Sludge sounding düzenli alınır; bertaraf: Sludge tank soundings are taken regularly; sludge is disposed of in the incinerator or to shore reception facilities. The incinerator flame failure trip must work correctly.
Sludge tank seviyesi ve sludge pompası,: The sludge tank level and the sludge pump are monitored for the transfer of sludge to the incinerator or to shore reception. All sludge transfers are recorded in the Oil Record Book (ORB) Part I; this record is central to MARPOL inspections.
Sludge tank sounding düzenli alınır; ber: Sludge tank soundings are taken regularly; sludge is disposed of in the incinerator or to a shore reception facility. The incinerator flame failure trip must work properly.
Sludge tankı seviyesi, üretim ve bertara: Consistency between the sludge tank level and the quantities produced and disposed of (the mass balance) is critical for both operation and inspection. Records that do not match the actual levels are on their own a serious finding.
Sludge ve atık yağ tankı seviyeleri MARP: Sludge and waste oil tank levels are critical under MARPOL Annex I; when a tank becomes full, the Oiler informs the engineer, and discharge ashore (shore disposal) or incineration is planned. Tank levels must never be falsified; PSC inspections and ORB (Oil Record Book) checks examine whether the levels are consistent.
Sludge ve yağ toplama tankı (slop/sludge: Sludge and oil collecting tank (slop/sludge tank) and overboard line.
Sludge ölçümü (sounding) düzenli yapılır: Sludge is sounded regularly and entered in the ORB under Code C/D. An imbalance between generation and disposal (e.g. very little shore disposal but a low tank level) raises suspicion of a "magic pipe" during inspections; the sludge balance must therefore be consistent and traceable.
Sludge ön ısıtması/viskozitesi burner ve: Sludge preheating and viscosity are set to the atomisation range in the burner and dosing pump manuals; a fixed 90 °C is not safe for every sludge composition.
Sludge; purifier deşarjı, fuel/oil arıtm: Sludge is the oily waste from purifier discharges, fuel/oil treatment residues and drains. The generation rate is estimated at approximately 1-1.5% of fuel consumption (IMO sludge generation formula). The balance between sludge tank capacity and daily generation is monitored; sludge is burned in the incinerator or delivered to a shore reception facility.
Smoke ve heat dedektörleri ile sample ex: Smoke and heat detectors and the sample extraction (cargo hold) systems are tested periodically; it is verified that the correct zone is shown on the alarm panel.
Smoke, heat ve flame dedektörleri zone b: Smoke, heat and flame detectors are monitored by zone; alarms and faults are shown on the bridge panel. The Safety Officer periodically tests selected detectors with test smoke/heat, and operates the manual call points (MCP) and the general alarm. Zones that are disabled (isolated) are entered in the logbook and followed up.
Smoke/heat dedektörleri, sprinkler ve A-: Smoke and heat detectors, sprinklers and A-class boundary and fire door systems are tested; the zone display on the alarm panel is verified. Coverage must be complete in the passenger spaces.
Snap-back bölgesi sadece halatın doğrult: The snap-back zone is not only along the lead of the line: at every point where the line is bent around a bollard, fairlead or pedestal roller, the direction of recoil can change. MEG4 takes the approach that "the whole deck is a potential snap-back zone when lines are under tension"; the old "painted snap-back zone line" alone is not considered safe.
SoF'tan türetilen time sheet, laytime'ın: The time sheet derived from the SoF shows how laytime was used up: which periods counted as laytime and which were excluded as exceptions (excepted periods — e.g. weather, equipment breakdown). The Chief Officer makes sure that stoppages that should count as laytime (caused by the charterer/terminal) are recorded correctly; this protects demurrage income.
Soft starter, her fazda ters paralel bağ: A soft starter uses two thyristors connected in anti-parallel (anti-parallel SCRs) in each phase. During starting, the firing angle of the SCRs is reduced gradually, raising the voltage applied to the motor from a low value to the rated value.
Soft starter, tristör (SCR) ile gerilimi: A soft starter gives a smooth start by raising the voltage gradually with thyristors (SCR) and reduces mechanical shock. A VFD (Variable Frequency Drive) varies frequency and voltage together, giving both a smooth start and speed control; on pumps and fans it gives significant energy savings because of the affinity laws. The ETO verifies that the correct starter type has been selected and that each one is maintained.
Sol doyma eğrisinin solunda: Alt soğutul: To the left of the left-hand saturation curve: the subcooled liquid region.
Solenoid valf, oda termostatına göre eva: The solenoid valve opens and closes the refrigerant flow to the evaporator according to the room thermostat.
Solenoid valfler, refrigerant akışını el: Solenoid valves open and close the refrigerant flow electrically; the liquid line solenoid closes when the thermostat is satisfied, and the system stops the compressor safely by pump-down. The ETO checks the condition of the solenoid coils, the sound of the valve opening/closing and its tightness. A stuck solenoid leads to loss of control and compressor short cycling.
Son kademe çıkışındaki hava 200-250°C ol: The air at the outlet of the last stage may be at 200–250 °C. The aftercooler lowers this temperature to a value close to ambient.
Sonuç ekran değeri olarak kaydedilir ve: The result is recorded as the displayed value and shown to the person tested. The Master keeps a form containing the serial number of the device, the calibration date, the time of the measurement and the result. Since breathalyser results are instant evidence that cannot be repeated later, the maintenance of the device and the stock of spare (single-use) mouthpieces are the Master's responsibility.
Sonuç, A (çok iyi) ile E (kötü) arasında: The result is converted into a rating from A (very good) to E (poor). Because the reduction factor tightens every year, the rating can drop over time even with the same performance; this makes continuous improvement mandatory.
Sonuçlar BDN ve ISO 8217 limitleriyle ka: The results are compared with the BDN and the ISO 8217 limits. If a result exceeds a MARPOL limit (e.g. sulfur), the flag State is notified; other off-spec results are handled as a commercial claim with the supplier.
Sonuçlar operasyon planı, task risk asse: The results are written into the operations plan, the task risk assessment and the ASOG inputs, so that the bridge team sees the accepted limits and the response plan before starting the task.
Sonuçların trendi, ani bir sapmadan (kaç: The trend of the results gives more information than a single sudden deviation (leak, dosing error). By following how the parameters develop over time, the Second Engineer catches problems early. Regular records form the basis both for maintenance decisions and for inspections.
Sonuçta gemideki insan kaynağı, en pahal: In the end, the human resource on board is a more critical resource than the most expensive equipment: even the most advanced ship is unsafe with a crew that is not competent, rested and in good spirits. The Master's skill in managing manning and training is measured by a crew that works quietly, does not fall apart in a crisis and keeps improving.
Soot blowing düzenli yapılır; düşük yükt: Soot blowing is done regularly; long periods at low load increase soot build-up. The water chemistry and circulation are maintained.
Soot blowing periyodik olarak yapılmalıd: Soot blowing must be done periodically. Monitoring the exhaust gas temperature is critical.
Soot fire, sirkülasyon kesilince hızla i: A soot fire can quickly turn into an iron fire if the circulation stops; temperature and circulation are monitored.
Sorumluluk, sadece \"damga vurmak\" deği: The responsibility is not just "stamping". This role also has to ensure that each correction is entered on the right chart, at the right position and with the right symbol, that the ENC database contains all the cells for the voyage concerned, and that the update status is 100%.
Sounding sonuçları, kalibrasyon tablosu: Sounding results are converted into volume using the calibration table (tank calibration/ullage table), and trim/list corrections are applied. The results are entered in the tank sounding log and feed into bunker/FW/ballast management.
Sounding sırasında tank kapağı/ölçüm boş: When a tank cover or sounding pipe is opened for sounding, there is a risk of flash/gas (especially with fuel and on tankers) and of falling; the AB follows the rules on earthing, anti-static measures and PPE. The measured values are passed to the officer and confirm the accuracy of bilge/ballast operations. A wrong sounding can lead to an overflow or pollution.
Sounding, tank dibinden sıvı yüzeyine ol: Sounding is the distance from the tank bottom to the liquid surface; ullage is the space from the top of the tank (the reference point) to the liquid surface. In tanker operations the ullage is usually measured and converted to volume with the tank calibration table; with the temperature correction the standard volume (m³/bbl) is obtained.
Sounding, tank içindeki sıvı yüksekliğin: Sounding measures the height of liquid in a tank (ballast, fuel, fresh water); ullage measures the empty space from the tank top to the liquid surface (common on tankers). The AB takes measurements with a sounding tape (measuring tape + weight) or an electronic gauge, checks the water/fuel interface with "water finding paste" and records the value.
Soğuk bölgelerde güverte üstü buzlanma (: In cold regions, icing on deck and superstructure (superstructure icing) raises the center of gravity and seriously threatens stability. The Chief Officer monitors ice accumulation, coordinates de-icing measures and prevents the freeing ports from becoming blocked with ice.
