The Second Engineer ensures that the keys are held in one place and that a multi-lock hasp is used if more than one team is working on the same panel.
Stowaway maliyeti (repatriasyon, fines,: Stowaway costs (repatriation, fines, detention) are generally covered by P&I; early and complete notification is therefore essential for the insurance to respond. Incomplete documentation puts the cover at risk.
Stripping pompaları: pozitif deplasmanlı: Stripping pumps: positive displacement type (screw or piston); used to draw the last ~5–20 m³ of cargo from the tank bottom.
Stülcken derrick: iki direk arasında ağı: Stülcken derrick: can handle heavy loads (200+ t) between two posts.
Su (A için iyi, B/elektrikte tehlikeli),: Water (good for A, dangerous for B and electrical fires), foam (A/B), dry chemical powder (A/B/C, versatile but leaves residue), CO₂ (B and electrical, leaves no residue but is a risk in an enclosed space), wet chemical (class F cooking oil). For fires in electrical equipment, CO₂ or dry powder is preferred.
Su alma durumunda kaptan ve Birinci Zabi: In a flooding situation the Master and the Chief Officer use the damage stability information (the ship's damage stability booklet, subdivision plans) to assess which compartments are flooded, the ship's tendency to sink or capsize, and whether counter-flooding is needed. Closing the watertight doors, managing the bilge and ballast pumps and controlling the list are vital. Progressive flooding is the silent killer behind the sinking of many ships.
Su alma, geminin stabilitesini ve trim'i: Flooding affects the ship's stability and trim; the Chief Engineer reports the situation to the bridge immediately. If flooding cannot be brought under control, decisions including abandoning ship are taken together with the Master.
Su altı gövdesi ve ballast tanklarında s: Consumption of sacrificial anodes (zinc/aluminum) on the underwater hull and in ballast tanks is monitored; on ships with an ICCP (Impressed Current Cathodic Protection) system, current/potential readings are recorded. Anode depletion is assessed at the drydock survey.
Su altı tekne temizliği: Dalış ekibi vey: Underwater hull cleaning: periodic brushing by divers or an ROV.
Su altındaki yağ dolu bölmelerden kaynak: Leaks from oil-filled compartments under water can cause a pollution incident. The use of environmentally acceptable lubricants (EAL) at lubrication points in contact with seawater is verified against the rules applicable in the ship's trading area.
Su basması (flooding) ise hull/boru hasa: Flooding may result from hull/pipe damage or failure of the sea water system. The bilge pumps, emergency bilge suction and damage control are brought into action. The cadet learns the bilge alarm system, the capacities of the bilge pumps and the early signs of flooding (rising bilge level).
Su basması hem makine kaybı hem stabilit: Flooding is a risk of both loss of machinery and loss of stability; the free surface reduces GM and can capsize the ship. Flooding is therefore managed at the same time as a technical matter (pumping out water) and as a stability matter (coordination with the bridge). The Oiler continuously reports the water level and the pumping rate to the engineer.
Su boruların içinden, sıcak gazlar dışın: The water passes through the tubes and the hot gases outside them. It is suitable for high pressure (60+ bar) and large capacity. Because of the small water volume it raises steam quickly and its explosion energy is low; but water quality (oxygen, hardness, pH) is critical.
Su geçirmezlik kontrolünde tebeşir testi: For the weathertightness check, a chalk test, hose test or ultrasonic test is used; the AB assists with these tests and keeps the rubber and bar surfaces clean. Any defects found are reported to the Bosun/officer and recorded.
Su geçirmezlik, coaming üzerindeki compr: Weathertightness is achieved by the compression bar on the coaming pressing continuously and evenly into the rubber packing around the cover (set-down). Cleats and quick-acting cleats press the panel down onto the coaming. The set-down mark must be continuous; crushed or oily packing leaks.
Su geçirmezlik; hose test, chalk test ve: Weathertightness is verified by a hose test, a chalk test or an ultrasonic tightness test. The ultrasonic test is the most reliable method for holds that cannot be drained and is preferred before surveys.
Su girişi, white metal aft bearing'i cid: Water ingress severely wears the white metal aft bearing and accelerates weardown. Early detection can prevent an expensive tail-shaft draw repair.
Su seviye alarmı: Düşük su seviyesi (low: Water level alarm: the low water level alarm and the low-low water level trip.
Su seviyesi kontrolü buhar kazanlarında: Water level control is vital in steam boilers: a low water level can lead to boiler damage and explosion. The cadet learns to read the gauge glass and learns the water level alarm and automatic feed water control.
Su tarafında ise gauge glass, scum/blowd: On the water side, the gauge glass, scum/blowdown valves and water level alarms (low/low-low water level) are tested. Automatic burner shut-off at low water level (flame failure + low water cut-off) is a vital safety function.
Sualtı bakım koordinasyonu, teknik kazan: Underwater maintenance coordination is an area where technical gains have value only together with absolute safety. The Chief Engineer's rigorous LOTO discipline, verified isolation and careful record-keeping safeguard both the diver's life and the integrity of the ship's hull.
Submerged (deepwell) pompalar: kimyasal: Submerged (deepwell) pumps: hydraulically driven pumps fitted at the bottom of each tank on chemical tankers, one per tank; they eliminate the risk of cross-contamination.
Suda ses hızı sıcaklık, tuzluluk ve bası: The speed of sound in water varies with temperature, salinity and pressure. Standard calibration assumes 1500 m/s, but the actual value may vary between 1450 and 1540 m/s.
Supap disk üst yüzeyi ile silindir kapağ: The distance between the top surface of the valve disc and the reference surface of the cylinder cover is measured. As the valve wears, this distance increases (the valve sinks). When the sinking limit is exceeded, the valve or the seat insert must be renewed.
Supap oturma yüzeyi (seat face) ve supap: The valve seat face and the seat insert wear over time through erosion and corrosion by combustion gases. Both surfaces are made to match again by grinding.
Supaplar tam olarak ÜÖN veya AÖN'de açıl: The valves do not open and close exactly at TDC or BDC. They are opened early and closed late.
Surging (compressor durağan akım kaybı): Surging (loss of stable flow in the compressor) is a very serious warning; it causes major damage to the T/C shaft bearings. If a surge alarm occurs, the engine load is reduced and the cause is investigated (exhaust valve leakage, scavenge air leak etc.).
Survey ve PSC hazırlığı, Üçüncü Zabit iç: For the Third Officer, survey and PSC preparation is not an "exam day" but the natural result of everyday safety discipline. Equipment that is always ready, up-to-date records and a trained crew turn the inspection from a threat into a confirmation of the ship's safety.
Survival craft'ta erişilebilir, can fili: It is kept accessible for survival craft and in a form that allows it to be mounted high in the lifeboat; its range depends on its height. During testing, a short, controlled self-test is carried out so as not to mislead real SAR units in the vicinity.
Susturulan küçük hatalar, büyük kazaları: Small errors that are hushed up are the forerunners of major accidents. Most human-factor machinery accidents result from an accumulation of small abnormalities that were not reported in time.
Swell varlığında mooring line'lar dinami: When there is swell, mooring lines carry dynamic (ranging) loads; surging and fender working increase. In these conditions, lines are checked frequently, tension is adjusted when necessary and the operation may be suspended.
Swell yönü ve periyodu, geminin rezonans: The swell direction and period determine whether the ship will go into resonance. Long-period swell (e.g. 12-16 s) coinciding with the ship's roll period can produce dangerous rolling even at a relatively low wave height.
Switchboard içindeki gevşek bara bağlant: Loose busbar connections and terminals inside the switchboard can lead to increased resistance, heating and eventually arc flash. The ETO scans the switchboard under load for hotspots with a thermal camera; a difference of 10–20°C above normal is a sign of looseness or overload. Busbar bolts are tightened with a calibrated torque wrench.
Sworn statement (yeminli ifade), affidav: A sworn statement, an affidavit or statements in an investigation directly affect the legal outcome of an incident. The Master takes legal advice before giving a statement; the statement must be based on facts, consistent and in line with the ship's records. Relying on the records instead of saying "I don't recall", not contradicting oneself and avoiding speculation are the basic principles.
Synchroscope veya synchronizing lamps il: The phase match is checked with the synchroscope or synchronising lamps. The breaker is closed as the synchroscope pointer approaches the 12 o'clock position.
System lubricating oil serves the consum: System lubricating oil serves the consumers specified for the engine. Crosshead engines may have separate cylinder lubrication, and a turbocharger may have a separate or common supply. Use the maker-approved oil grade and sampling programme. Investigate water, fuel dilution, abnormal viscosity and wear-metal trends against operating conditions and maker limits.
System oil aylık/üç-aylık spectroanalysi: System oil is monitored by monthly/quarterly spectroanalysis (spectro metals, FT-IR oxidation, water, TBN, viscosity). A trend graph is far more valuable than a single measurement. If water ingress rises above 0.2%, a jacket cooler or stuffing box leak is suspected; fuel ingress (fuel dilution) lowers viscosity and creates a flashpoint risk.
System oil ve generator yağında purifier: In system oil and generator oil, the purifier (centrifuge) and fine filtration extend oil life by removing water and particles. The Chief Engineer ensures that the purifier setting (gravity disc, temperature) and filter condition are managed in line with the analysis results.
Söndürücüler; her mahalde yangın riskine: Extinguishers are placed in each space in the type and number suited to the fire risk, in visible and easily accessible positions close to the exits. There are separate requirements for the engine room, galley and accommodation areas. Their positions are marked on the fire control plan.
Söndürücülerin basınç göstergesi, mühür: The pressure gauge, seal and accessibility of the extinguishers are checked regularly; access to them is not obstructed. Choosing the wrong extinguisher (e.g. a water-based one on oil, or water on electrical equipment) makes the fire worse; this is why the choice is critical.
Survey preparation is a joint ship-shore task. The Chief Engineer coordinates the survey schedule, the required spare parts/service team and attendance planning with the Superintendent. Surveyor attendance is synchronized with the port call.
Sörvey hazırlığı, Baş Mühendis'in planla: Survey preparation is a test of the Chief Engineer's planning discipline and culture of honest record-keeping. Proactive, documented preparation coordinated between ship and shore keeps the ship certified, clean in inspections and fit for charter. A survey should not be a last-minute rush but a discipline maintained continuously.
Sörvey ve trial öncesi Baş Mühendis bir: Before a survey or trial, the Chief Engineer prepares a test program: main engine safety trip tests, generator black-out/auto-start, emergency generator load test, steering gear changeover and fire pump remote start. The result of each test is recorded.
Sözleşme, büyük tanker kazalarının (Torr: The Convention was strengthened following major tanker accidents (Torrey Canyon 1967; the accidents of 1976-77).
Sülfür uyumu kritiktir: ECA bölgesinde %: Sulfur compliance is critical: 0.10% S in an ECA and a global limit of 0.50% S. The Second Engineer assesses whether the fuel received suits the voyage profile and whether mixing it with the fuel already on board (commingling) will cause incompatibility (sludging/stability problems).
Sülfür uyumu şüphesinde, gemide saklanan: If sulfur compliance is in doubt, analysis of the sample retained on board (MARPOL sample) and of the in-use/onboard sample is decisive. The sample chain of custody is carefully preserved.
Süpürme bölgesinde biriken yağlama yağı: Lubricating oil and carbon residues that had accumulated in the scavenge space ignited as the temperature rose. A fire developed in the scavenge drain and manifold areas.
Sürekli insülasyon izleme cihazı (IMD) t: The continuous insulation monitoring device (IMD) measures the insulation resistance to earth of all phases. When the value falls below a set threshold, it gives an alarm. The faulty phase is identified with a megger.
Sürekli look-out yapılır; risk radar/ARP: A continuous lookout is kept; risk is assessed by radar/ARPA and by sight, and action is taken early and is substantial. On busy ferry routes, traffic separation is complied with.
Sürekli look-out yapılır; çatışma riski: A continuous lookout is kept; risk of collision is assessed by radar/ARPA and visually. Action is taken early and is substantial; on a large ship the effect of a manoeuvre comes late.
Sürekli titreşim monitoring (varsa) tren: Continuous vibration monitoring (where fitted) provides a trend; periodic hand-held measurements are also valuable. A rising trend triggers a planned inspection and intervention.
Sürekli veri toplama (IoT sensörleri) il: Real-time monitoring is carried out through continuous data collection (IoT sensors). The algorithm detects deviations from the model of normal behaviour and estimates the remaining useful life (RUL).
Süreklilik denklemi gereği, kararlı hald: By the continuity equation, the mass flow rate entering an open system in steady state equals the mass flow rate leaving it.
Süresi dolan bir işaret fişeği tutuşmaya: An expired distress flare may not ignite, a liferaft whose service is overdue may not inflate correctly, and a flat battery may give no signal. This is why tracking dates is about the equipment "being in working order" as much as "being there". The Third Officer treats this tracking as a priority.
Süresi dolmuş bir servis sertifikası (ör: An expired service certificate (e.g. CO2 system service, lifting gear test) is both a PSC deficiency and a safety risk. Service windows are planned in advance according to the voyage plan and the ports where a suitable service provider is available.
Süresi dolmuş medikal veya eksik STCW se: An expired medical certificate or a missing STCW certificate is a violation of both the MLC and STCW and a reason for PSC detention. The Master follows certificate expiry dates in crew change planning; if a seafarer's certificate will expire during the voyage, renewal or replacement is coordinated in advance.
Süresi geçen bir CoC, sertifikanın askıy: An overdue CoC can lead to suspension of the certificate. CoC management is therefore a critical part of survey preparation and is carried out in coordination with the technical office ashore.
Süresi yaklaşan ekipman, uygun limanda y: Equipment approaching its expiry date is renewed at a suitable port or sent for service. The Third Officer reports missing or soon-to-expire items to the Chief Officer and the Master and prepares the requisition. Old pyrotechnics are also disposed of in accordance with the rules (usually ashore).
Sürtünme katsayısı (yük-güverte arası, ö: The coefficient of friction (between cargo and deck, e.g. steel-timber 0.3, steel-steel 0.1) affects the calculation; a wet or oily surface reduces friction. The Chief Officer verifies that the "balance of forces" and "balance of moments" criteria are met; otherwise lashings are added.
Sürtünme kaybı, sürtünme katsayısı, boru: Friction loss is proportional to the friction factor, the pipe length/diameter and the square of the velocity. In laminar flow (Re < 2300) f depends only on Re; in turbulent flow the relative roughness (ε/D) becomes decisive (Colebrook equation / Moody diagram).
Sürtünmeli (friction) kavramalar (çok pl: Friction clutches (multi-plate, with hydraulic or pneumatic actuators) allow gradual engagement under load. Positive (toothed/dog) clutches engage only when stationary or at low speed but transmit full torque without slipping. SSS/freewheel clutches engage automatically in one direction.
Sürtünmesiz, sıkıştırılamaz, kararlı akı: For frictionless, incompressible, steady flow, the total energy along a streamline is constant.
Sürtünmeyi artırmak için anti-slip mat (: To increase friction, anti-slip mats (rubber pads) and suitable dunnage (timber) are used; this can reduce the number of lashings required. The Chief Officer checks that the right material is placed between cargo and deck. The calculation assumes that friction alone is not sufficient; lashing is always essential.
Süzgeç (strainer) fark basıncı, tıkanman: The strainer differential pressure is the most reliable indicator of blockage. The sea chest steam/air blowing line is used in case of icing or blockage; an MGPS (anodes or electrolysis) may be fitted against marine growth.
Sıcak HFO açığa çıkarsa ciddi yanık yapa: Hot HFO released into the open causes serious burns; isolation and PPE are provided before maintenance.
Sıcak HFO sıçraması yanık yapar; izolasy: Hot HFO splashes cause burns; lagging and PPE are provided.
Sıcak gazlar boruların içinden, su borul: The hot gases pass through the tubes and the water is outside the tubes. Thanks to the large volume of water, it can meet sudden load changes and keeps the steam pressure steady. Its advantages are a simple construction, easy maintenance and tolerance of poorer water quality.
Sıcak iş (kaynak, taşlama, kesme) yangın: Hot work (welding, grinding, cutting) carries a risk of fire and explosion; it requires a gas-free certificate, a fire watch and a PTW. For work at height and overside work, the safety harness, lifeline, stage/basket safety and the risk of falling tools are managed. The cadet takes part in this work only under supervision and with suitable equipment; no overside work is done while the ship is at sea.
Sıcak iş veya kapalı alan gerektiren bak: For maintenance requiring hot work or enclosed space entry, the relevant permit (Permit to Work) is obtained. The cadet internalizes the principle "no work without a permit". Before any equipment is dismantled, it is confirmed that the system pressure has been released, the temperature has dropped and rotating parts have stopped.
Sıcak kargolarda (fuel oil, asfalt) ölçü: With hot cargoes (fuel oil, asphalt) there is a risk of splashes and burns during gauging; suitable PPE is essential. The results are entered in the cargo measurement report.
Sıcak su, calorifier'da (elektrik veya b: Hot water is heated in the calorifier (electrically or with steam or jacket water) and distributed through a circulation line. For Legionella control the hot water temperature is kept above a set level (generally storage at 60 °C or more); cold water is kept cool.
Sıcak yemekler servise yakın bitecek şek: Hot dishes are timed to be ready close to service; keeping food hot for a long time both lowers quality and creates a safety risk (the danger temperature zone). Until service, hot food is kept above 63°C and cold preparations below 5°C. By finishing the main dish and the side dishes as close to service as possible, the cook ensures both flavor and safety.
Sıcak yüzeyler (egzoz manifoldu, türbin: Hot surfaces (exhaust manifold, turbine casing, steam line) exceed 200°C; in contact with a flammable liquid, they become the source of engine room fires (the most frequent type of fire). Noise in most engine rooms is in the range of 85-110 dB(A) and carries a risk of permanent hearing loss. The Oiler keeps this layout in mind and assesses the relevant hazards before starting any job.
Sıcak yüzeylere (egzoz manifoldu, buhar: Bare contact with hot surfaces (exhaust manifold, steam line), standing near a rotating shaft/coupling and careless movement on an oily floor are causes of accidents. The cadet learns to use ladders with "three points of contact", the correct lifting technique and the locations of the emergency stop buttons.
Sıcak çalışma bittikten sonra gözetim he: Monitoring does not stop as soon as the hot work is finished; the area continues to be watched for half an hour to several hours (depending on the risk), because heat can remain hidden and cause delayed ignition. The back face of the welded metal, adjacent compartments and the area under insulation are checked in particular.
Sıcak çalışma; açık alev, kıvılcım veya: Hot work covers any operation that involves an open flame or sparks, or that can raise a surface temperature to ignition point: electric arc welding, oxy-acetylene cutting, grinding, drilling, hot chipping. Because of fuel, oil vapor, hot surfaces and limited ventilation, the engine room is by its nature a hazardous environment for such work.
Sıcak çalışmada standart KKD; kaynak mas: Standard PPE for hot work includes a welding mask/dark-lens face shield, flame-resistant gloves, a leather apron/coverall, steel-toed shoes, ear protection and, when needed, respiratory protection. For grinding, a face shield and dust mask are mandatory. The PPE is checked every time to make sure it is undamaged and suitable for the job.
Sıcaklık HFO için 60-70°C'de tutulur. Be: For HFO the temperature is kept at 60–70 °C. A settling time of at least 24 hours is recommended. Water and sludge are drained periodically through the drain valve at the bottom of the tank.
Sıcaklık ayar aralığı genellikle −30°C i: The temperature setting range is generally between −30 °C and +30 °C. Typical settings are +2 °C for fresh fruit and −18 °C for frozen products.
Sıcaklık dedektörleri (sabit veya ROR –: Heat detectors (fixed temperature or ROR – rate of rise) are preferred in places with high humidity or steam, such as the galley and laundry.
Sıcaklık farkından kaynaklanan yoğunluk: The fluid is moved by the buoyancy force created by differences in density caused by temperature differences. No pump or fan is needed.
Sıcaklık yoğunluğu etkiler: Sıcaklık art: Temperature affects density: as the temperature rises, the density falls.
Sıcaklık, basınç, titreşim, yağ analizi: Temperature, pressure, vibration, oil analysis and performance (load/speed/consumption) are the most commonly monitored indicators. The direction and rate of a deviation point to the problem: a slowly rising bearing temperature may mean lubrication problems/wear; a sudden pressure drop, a leak/blockage; increasing vibration, imbalance/bearing damage.
Sıcaklıkta yükselme, sürekli çalışan kom: A rise in temperature, a compressor that runs continuously, abnormal noise or a water leak are signs of a fault and are reported. If a refrigeration unit fails, the products are moved to another unit while maintaining the cold chain; products at risk of spoilage are assessed or destroyed. A gas (refrigerant) leak is a job for the engine department.
Sıfırıncı yasa, termometre kullanılarak: The zeroth law provides the physical basis for measuring temperature with a thermometer. When a thermometer (body C) reaches thermal equilibrium with the system to be measured (body A), the value shown by the thermometer is the temperature of the system.
Sıhhi alanlarda tuvalet kâğıdı, kâğıt ha: In sanitary areas, toilet paper, paper towels, hand soap and disinfectant are kept stocked at all times; an empty soap dispenser is the weakest link in hygiene because it prevents hand washing. Through stock control, the steward ensures that these consumables never run out.
Sık dokunulan yüzeyler (high-touch surfa: High-touch surfaces are the critical points of hygiene: door handles, washbasin taps, toilet seat lids and light switches. These surfaces are not just wiped; they are disinfected. During outbreaks, the frequency of cleaning these points is increased.
Sık görülen hata, özel alanda yiyecek at: A common mistake is applying the discharge limits for food waste in special areas wrongly. Waste transfers made without recording the GPS position are a serious non-conformity in inspections.
Sık görülen hatalar: cleat/wedge sökülme: Common errors: forcing a cover open without removing the cleats/wedges (hydraulic damage), insufficient or asymmetric lashing, not re-lashing during the voyage, and slack turnbuckles. These errors result in loss of cargo, damage to the ship and detention by port State control (PSC).
Sık görülen kalite hataları: paslı/ıslak: Common quality errors: painting over rusty, wet or salty surfaces, not observing the overcoating interval, painting in the wrong weather conditions and insufficient film thickness. These cause the paint to flake off within months and corrosion to advance unseen; the job has to be redone from the start, wasting both time and material.
Sık hatalar; her gece aynı kopyala-yapış: Common mistakes are writing the same copy-and-paste orders every night, leaving threshold values vague, omitting the call-out criteria and not allowing for the junior officer's level of experience. These mistakes make the orders useless.
Sık manevrada yetersiz starting air ana: With frequent manoeuvring, insufficient starting air means a risk of being unable to start the main engine.
Sık yanlış alarm, mürettebatın alarma du: Frequent false alarms make the crew insensitive to alarms (alarm fatigue) and cause a late response in a real fire. The ETO identifies and corrects the root cause of false alarms (dirty detector, wrong type selected, steam/dust, insects, humidity). The solution may be cleaning the detector, changing to the correct type, a multi-criteria detector or an alarm verification delay.
Sıkışan hava nem ve yağ buharı içerir; a: Compressed air contains moisture and oil vapour; the aftercooler and moisture separator remove the water, and an air dryer also removes moisture from the control air. Wet or oily air clogs instrument valves and creates a risk of explosion in the starting air line; drains are opened regularly.
Sıkışan hava nem ve yağ içerir; after-co: Compressed air contains moisture and oil; the aftercooler and moisture separator remove the water, and for control air an air dryer (adsorption or refrigerated) also lowers the moisture. Wet or oily control air causes failures of valves and positioners, freezing and blocked instruments.
Sıkıştırma segmanları gaz sızdırmazlığı,: Compression rings provide gas tightness, and oil control rings control the oil film on the liner. The ring gap is measured periodically; an excessive increase points to blow-by.
Sıkıştırma sonrası hava sıcaklığı 150-20: After compression the air temperature can be 150–200 °C. The cooler lowers it to 35–50 °C.
Sınav başarısının ardından idare CoC'yi: After the examination has been passed, the Administration issues the CoC and adds the necessary endorsements. The cadet must learn the certificate's period of validity, the revalidation requirements and the tonnage/power limitations; it is a mistake to think a CoC has no expiry date, as it requires periodic revalidation and recent sea service.
Sınav başvurusundan önce stajyer, TRB'yi: Before applying for the examination, the cadet reviews the TRB from beginning to end: have all mandatory competences been evidenced, are all pages signed, are the familiarization sections complete for each ship, are the trainer's and the Master's approvals present? This final check prevents the application from being rejected for missing documents.
Sınıf A AIS, SOLAS gemilerinde zorunludu: Class A AIS is mandatory on SOLAS ships; it transmits more often, at high power (12.5 W) and with SOTDMA access. Class B has lower power, transmits less often and is intended for non-commercial and small craft. Class A sees Class B but has priority.
Sınıf bildirimi yapılmayan majör hasar,: Major damage not reported to class puts certificate validity and the insurance claim at risk. Notification thresholds are therefore defined in the SMS and applied rigorously.
Sınıf doğrulaması bir belge işlemi değil: Verifying the class is not a paperwork exercise but part of the decision to accept the task. If the ship does not meet the requirements of its declared class at that moment, the limitation is entered in the ASOG and the scope of the task is reduced accordingly. Task Appropriate Mode (TAM) may only be used through an approved, risk-based process; it does not by itself make missing redundancy acceptable.
Sınıf kredisi (PMS credit) alınan kaleml: For items with class credit (PMS credit), if the class tolerance (generally the interval +10% or a set number of months) is exceeded, class approval (an extension) must be obtained. Exceeding it without approval may cause that item to be removed from the CMS.
Sınıf kuruluşları (Class), bazı gemiler: For some ships, classification societies (Class) accept an approved PMS under a "Planned Maintenance Scheme" in place of traditional periodic survey. For this reason, the PMS is not just a convenience but a class and ISM requirement. A well-functioning PMS increases equipment reliability and reduces unplanned failures.
Sınıf kuruluşları ve SOLAS, belirli krit: Classification societies and SOLAS require minimum spare parts to be carried for certain critical systems. The ETO ensures that this "required spares" list is always complete; when an item is used, it is reordered immediately. A missing required spare results in a finding (deficiency) at a class survey or PSC inspection.
Sınıf kuruluşları, gemiler için gönüllü/: Classification societies offer voluntary/mandatory cyber secure notations for ships (DNV, LR, ABS, BV, etc.); these require specified maturity levels for asset inventory, segmentation, access control, monitoring and response capability. The ETO meets the technical requirements of the notation held by the ship and provides evidence (policies, logs, test records) for surveys.
Sınıf sertifikası beş yıllık döngüde yen: The class certificate is renewed on a five-year cycle. The cycle includes the Annual Survey (every year, with a ±3-month window), the Intermediate Survey (between the 2nd and 3rd year) and the Special/Renewal Survey (5th year). Flag State certificates (Safety Construction, IOPP, IAPP, MARPOL) are also surveyed on a similar cycle.
Sınır sabit veya hareketli olabilir. Bir: The boundary may be fixed or movable. The top surface of the piston in a cylinder is an example of a movable boundary; the cylinder walls are a fixed boundary.
Sınırlı alkole izin veren şirketlerde (ö: In companies that allow limited alcohol (e.g. on certain days, in controlled amounts), the Master keeps a record of the alcohol stock and may prohibit consumption entirely during critical port and navigation periods (manoeuvring, narrow passages, cargo operations). In every case the basic rule is that alcohol must not affect performance on watch; in case of doubt the Master may require a test (for-cause testing).
Sınırlı görüş anında COLREG Rule 5, 19 v: In restricted visibility, special precautions come into effect under COLREG Rules 5, 19 and 35: safe speed, fog signals, engines ready, additional lookout. The Master is called to the bridge immediately. Radar/ARPA operation, target tracking quality (true vs relative motion), and the sea clutter and rain clutter settings must be under the Master's control.
Sınırından ısı geçişi olmayan ancak iş y: A system with no heat transfer across its boundary but which can do work is defined as adiabatic. A perfectly insulated piston-cylinder arrangement is an example of an adiabatic closed system.
Sıralı (sequential) yöntemde tanklar tek: In the sequential method the tanks are emptied and refilled one at a time. Stability is checked at every stage.
Sıvı hat sight glass'ında kabarcık görül: Bubbles in the liquid line sight glass usually indicate a low refrigerant charge or a restriction in the line. The Third/Fourth Engineer checks this simple indicator regularly and reports to the Chief Engineer if in doubt.
Sıvının türbülanslı akışı, serbest düşüş: Turbulent flow of the liquid, free fall, water droplets and filters generate static charge. Working at a low rate, especially in the first minutes of loading, limits the build-up.
Sızdıran rampa/kapı, araç güvertesine su: A leaking ramp or door lets water onto the vehicle deck and leads to a rapid loss of stability; watertightness is verified before going to sea.
Sızdırmazlık yalnızca makine dairesi tar: A seal is needed only at the engine room end.
Sızdırmazlık; hose test (yüksek basınçlı: Tightness is verified by a hose test (high-pressure water) or an ultrasonic test. The Bosun prepares the covers before the test (gaskets/drains clean, cover correctly seated). The ultrasonic test shows the leak point numerically and provides assurance before loading.
Sızıntı tespiti, Yağcı'nın en kritik gör: Leak detection is one of the Oiler's most critical duties. Flange weeping, pump gland leaks, valve bonnet leaks, pipe cracks and casing cracks are looked for during the round. When a new leak is found, its source, quantity and risk (proximity to hot surfaces) are reported to the engineer.
Sızıntıların toplandığı drip tray ve sav: The drip trays and save-all trays in which leaks collect are emptied regularly and kept clean; accumulated oil creates a slipping hazard and a fire load. By tracing where these accumulations come from, the Oiler identifies hidden/slow leaks. The trays are always emptied into the sludge/waste oil tank and are never mixed into the bilge.
T&P notları; geçici (örn. tatbikat sahas: T&P notices contain temporary information (e.g. a training area, a temporary buoy) or advance information that has not yet become a permanent correction. Although the ENC updates include some of them, those not covered are entered by hand in the ECDIS Manual Update (Manual Correction) layer. The Second Officer assesses the effect of these notices on the route.
T/C devri, scavenge air pressure ve egzo: T/C speed, scavenge air pressure and exhaust back pressure are written in the daily log. Compressor-side fouling (oily air filter, oil deposits) and turbine-side fouling (carbon deposits) lead to a loss of efficiency over time. A periodic cleaning procedure is applied (compressor side: wet wash; turbine side: dry (granule) wash or wet wash).
T/C öncesi (before turbine) ve sonrası (: Exhaust temperatures before the T/C (before turbine) and after it (after turbine) show the turbocharger efficiency. A rise in the after-turbine temperature indicates T/C fouling (nozzle ring/turbine fouling) and may require water washing (turbine/compressor water washing).
TBN (Total Base Number); yağın asit nötr: TBN (Total Base Number) is the oil's acid-neutralizing reserve; it provides protection against sulfurous combustion products. A fall in TBN to a critical level shows loss of protection. An increase in TAN (Total Acid Number), on the other hand, indicates oxidation and acidification.
TCS motor markasından bağımsız çalışsa d: Although the TCS works independently of the engine make, the interface parameters are set separately for each unit. Pitch, rpm and azimuth scale factors, ramp times, barred angles and derating curves are determined and recorded during commissioning. These records are the reference point for every later change.
TCS motor markasından bağımsız çalışır v: The TCS works independently of the engine make and can control every kind of propulsion unit, including tunnel thrusters, Voith propulsion systems, azimuth pods, retractable units and waterjets.
TCS üzerinde yapılacak her müdahale — pa: Any intervention on the TCS — a parameter change, a card replacement, a software update — directly affects the DP capability. Before the work, a joint assessment is made with the bridge, the redundancy group that will be affected is identified and, if necessary, the ASOG status is changed.
TMAS (Telemedical Assistance Service), g: TMAS (Telemedical Assistance Service) are shore-based centers that provide ships with free 24/7 medical advice. The Second Officer passes on the patient data (vital signs, symptoms, history, current medication) clearly and follows the doctor's instructions. A good TMAS consultation decides between correct treatment on board and medevac.
TMSA Element 4 (vessel reliability ve ma: Under TMSA Element 4 (vessel reliability and maintenance), planned purchasing, the use of frame agreements and cost control must be demonstrated. The Chief Engineer documents this competence through the requisition history and budget reports.
TMSA'nın engine room operations ve envir: The TMSA elements covering engine room operations and environmental management directly concern the engine department. The Chief Engineer meets the KPI and best practice requirements of these elements at ship level.
TN sistemde toprak kaçağında devre tamam: In a TN system an earth fault completes the circuit and a high current flows. An RCCB (residual current device) detects the earth fault current and opens the circuit. 30 mA RCCBs are commonly used on 220 V socket circuits on ships.
TRB ayrıca stajyerin kariyer boyu sürece: The TRB is also the first step in a learning habit that will last the cadet's whole career. Systematic recording, sharp observation and self-assessment are the basic professional disciplines of the engineer who will later become an OOW, and then Second/Chief Engineer.
TRB stajyerin sertifika hakkının belgesi: The TRB is the document of the cadet's entitlement to certification; losing it causes problems that are hard to remedy. The cadet keeps the book safe and, where possible, keeps a digital backup/photographs. The cadet preserves its integrity (no missing pages, no erasures), because this book is official evidence.
TRB yönetimi, güverte stajyerinin kariye: Managing the TRB is the deck cadet's most direct investment in their career; every page filled in with discipline today is evidence for an officer's certificate tomorrow. Daily entries, the training officer's approval and careful safekeeping form a solid foundation for the cadet's progress.
TRB yönetimi, makine stajyerinin sertifi: TRB management is the most concrete responsibility in the engine cadet's certification journey. A well-managed book not only secures the right to sit the examination; it also documents the cadet's real competence, honesty and professional discipline. Daily recording discipline, balanced evidence of competence and regular approval are the three cornerstones of a complete TRB. A cadet who neglects this book risks the valuable months spent at sea being left without evidence.
TRB'nin fiziksel güvenliği de süreklilik: The physical safety of the TRB is also critical for continuity. The book must not get wet or be lost, and its pages must not be torn. Many cadets keep a photo/scan backup of completed pages; if the original is lost, a trace of the approved entries remains. Nevertheless, official validity lies with the original bearing wet-ink signatures.
TRB'nin kalbi, STCW Table A-III/1 yetkin: The heart of the TRB is the task record section, which links the STCW Table A-III/1 competence areas to shipboard tasks. Here, the fields "what was done, when, which competence it corresponds to, trainer's assessment" are completed for each task. The familiarization section is completed on first joining the ship and documents the safety, escape route and equipment familiarization.
TRB'nin tamamlanması, OOW (Engine) yeter: Completion of the TRB is a legal prerequisite for sitting the OOW (Engine) certificate of competency examination. The cadet should therefore see watch participation not merely as "filling hours" but as a process of accumulating concrete evidence of competence.
TRB'nin yaygın bir zaafı, bazı yetkinlik: A common weakness of TRBs is that some competences are over-filled while others are under-filled. If the cadet goes on watch every day, the "watchkeeping" record fills up, but "maintenance and repair" or "electrical systems" may remain weak. The cadet should periodically review the gaps in the book and turn to the incomplete areas.
TRB, görev yapıldıkça doldurulmalıdır; a: The TRB must be filled in as tasks are done; entries left until the end of the month or the end of the contract end up incomplete and superficial. Every day, the cadet records the work done and what was learned in concrete terms. This discipline both reinforces learning and keeps the book realistic.
TRB, stajyerin hangi yetkinlikleri ne za: The TRB documents which competences the cadet acquired, when and how. It is structured according to the STCW competence tables and is the main evidence in the certification process. An incomplete or belatedly completed TRB puts the right to sit the examination and career progression at risk.
TRB; eğitim kuruluşu (akademi/MET instit: The TRB is a document that bridges the training institution (academy/MET institution), the company and the ship. It shows that the theoretical knowledge gained at the academy has been put into practice on board, that each competence area has actually been applied and that it has been assessed by an authorized engineer. For this reason, the TRB is also seen as "the contract between the school and the ship".
TRB; seyir, yük işlemleri, gemi operasyo: The TRB covers competence areas such as navigation, cargo handling, controlling the operation of the ship and care for persons on board, safety and environmental protection. In each area, the cadet completes the specified tasks and records evidence of observation/performance. Areas still outstanding are completed according to a plan.
TRS sezildiğinde gözlemler (basınç, rüzg: When a TRS is suspected, the observations (pressure, wind, swell, position) are reported as a danger message and the Master is informed. In areas with a seasonal TRS risk (Indian Ocean, Pacific, Atlantic), monitoring is intensified.
TRS, sıcak tropikal denizler üzerinde ge: A TRS is a violent system with a low-pressure center and closed circulation that develops over warm tropical seas. In the Northern Hemisphere it rotates counterclockwise, in the Southern Hemisphere clockwise. Wind and sea increase rapidly towards the center; the eyewall around the eye is the most destructive zone.
Table A-III/1 dört ana fonksiyon altında: Table A-III/1 defines competences under four main functions: Marine Engineering, Electrical/Electronic and Control Engineering, Maintenance and Repair, and Controlling Operation of the Ship and Care for Persons on Board. TRB tasks are distributed among these functions; the cadet must accumulate sufficient evidence in each function.
Tahliye darboğazları (dar koridor, asans: Evacuation bottlenecks (narrow corridors, lifts) must be identified in advance and removed.
Tahliye sırasında panik değil disiplin e: When evacuating, discipline, not panic, is essential: the space is left by the shortest safe route, it is verified that no one has been left behind (head count) and doors are closed behind. By keeping the escape route free of obstacles (housekeeping) in normal times, the Oiler makes this moment easier in advance.
Tahliye, müster listesine göre düzenli y: The evacuation proceeds in an orderly way according to the muster list: the liferafts and boats are prepared and launched, the EPIRB and SART are taken, the necessary documents and water and provisions are loaded, and a head count is made. The Master leaves last and confirms that every member of the crew has been counted. Cold water, darkness and bad weather make evacuation far more difficult; this is why the equipment must be familiar and practised in drills.
Tahmin yörüngesi belirsizlik taşır; bu y: The forecast track carries uncertainty; for this reason, with approaches such as the "1-2-3 rule", safety radii (e.g. 100/200/300 NM) are added around the 24/48/72-hour forecast positions, and the ship tries to stay outside these "limit lines". This gives a buffer against unexpected turns of the storm.
Tahmindeki dalga yüksekliği, periyot, sw: The forecast wave height, period, swell direction and wind force are assessed together with the ship's loading condition (GM, freeboard). The Chief Officer checks with CSM calculations whether the existing lashing is adequate for the expected conditions.
Tahrik kuvvetinin frekansı sistemin doğa: When the frequency of the exciting force approaches the natural torsional frequency of the system, the vibration amplitude grows (resonance) and can lead to fatigue fracture of the shaft. Continuous running in that speed range is therefore prohibited and the range is passed through quickly. A torsional vibration damper is used to reduce the amplitudes.
Tahıl (grain) yükü serbest yüzey gibi da: Grain cargo behaves like a free surface; when the ship rolls, it shifts (grain shift) and creates a dangerous list. The International Grain Code makes the grain heeling moment calculation and the necessary measures (trimming, bundling, saucers, overstowing, feeders) mandatory. The Chief Officer carries out/checks the grain loading stability calculation and obtains NCB approval.
Tahıl/konsantre hassas ve yüksek temizli: Grain/concentrates are sensitive and require a high level of cleanliness; if ferrous ore is to be loaded after coal, a different standard applies, and "hospital clean" is required for sensitive food cargoes. The Bosun knows which cargo requires which level and directs the team accordingly. Residues of the previous cargo (taint) can contaminate an incompatible next cargo.
Tail shaft, klas tarafından periyodik su: The tail shaft is subject to periodic class survey (withdrawal or an in-place condition monitoring programme). Stern tube oil analysis (water and metal content), seal checks, bearing temperature and shaft position (poker gauge/wear-down) measurements are carried out regularly.
The tail shaft turns in the stern tube bearing. The conventional system is oil-lubricated (white metal bearing, pressure from a gravity tank). The environmentally friendly alternative is a water-lubricated system (composite or lignum vitae bearings); it eliminates the risk of oil leakage, but bearing wear is monitored differently.
Tail-shaft (pervane şaftı) survey'i, yağ: The tail-shaft (propeller shaft) survey is carried out every 5 years or at extended intervals, depending on the lubrication type and seal condition. On ships with an oil-lubricated stern tube and an approved seal system, the survey interval can be extended (Extended Tail Shaft Survey).
Takip eden 6 saat içinde ana makinede yü: Over the following 6 hours the main engine load fluctuated; the bridge had difficulty maintaining the required speed. Although the event looked like a technical failure, at its root lay weaknesses in watch discipline and alarm management.
Takı, saat ve tırnak ojesi gıda hazırlığ: Jewelry, watches and nail polish are removed/not worn during food preparation; they are both a physical contamination hazard and a carrier of bacteria. Nails are kept short and clean.
Talepler Baş Mühendis onayıyla şirket sa: Requisitions are forwarded to company purchasing with the Chief Engineer's approval; long-lead-time parts (e.g. a crankshaft bearing) are ordered early. When a spare is received, the correct part number, absence of damage and the certificate (class-approved if required) are checked, and it is put away in the correct locker (with a location code).
Tam otomatik mevki tutmaya geçildikten s: After changing over to fully automatic position keeping, time is allowed for stabilisation so that the DP mathematical model can learn the environmental forces. During this time the ship settles and the system builds up its estimate of the wind, current and wave forces.
Tamamlanan iş emri, harcanan saat, kulla: A completed work order is closed with the hours spent, the parts used and observations. Jobs left unfinished or postponed are flagged as "overdue" and the reason is recorded; overdue critical jobs are the most frequent cause of findings at inspections. The Chief Officer reports the overdue list to the Master every week.
Tamamlanan passage plan, gemi formatına: The completed passage plan is entered on a form in the ship's format: waypoint list, leg parameters, no-go areas, reporting points (VTS/coast guard), pilot boarding position, anchorage, critical UKC points, abort point and contingency (alternative) plans. The cadet learns that the plan must be complete "berth to berth", with no stage left blank.
Tamamlanan plan kaptana sunulur; kaptan: The completed plan is presented to the Master; the plan cannot be executed until the Master has approved it (SOLAS V/34). At the briefing, the Second Officer summarizes the route, critical points, UKC margins, abort points and weather/traffic risks. The Master's instructions (e.g. criteria for calling the Master, minimum CPA) are added to the plan.
Tank dibinde kalan suyun alınması için e: An eductor (ejector) is used to remove the water remaining at the bottom of a tank; it creates a vacuum with driving water and draws in the low-level water. If the driving pressure needed for the eductor is not provided, there is no suction and the tank cannot be stripped.
Tank dibinde kalan tortu/slop oksijen tü: Sediment or slops remaining on the tank bottom may continue to consume oxygen or release gas; this is why the atmosphere is monitored throughout the entry. If the readings deteriorate during work, the tank is left immediately. The AB does not fall into the trap of thinking "tested once, so it's safe".
Tank dolmaya yaklaştığında \"topping off: As a tank approaches full, the rate is reduced in the "topping off" stage; the risk of overflow is highest at this moment. Fuel spraying from the air vent pipes is a sign of overflow and requires an immediate stop. Filling stops when the tank is 90-95% full (manufacturer/company limit), and the next tank is started.
Tank gas-free ve test edilmiş olsa bile,: Even if the tank is gas-free and tested, entry is an enclosed space entry: an entry permit, atmosphere testing (O₂/LEL/toxic), continuous ventilation, a standby outside (lifeline + communication) and rescue arrangements are mandatory. If the AB is to enter, they carry a personal gas monitor; the standby watches from outside and, in an emergency, applies the 'alarm first, then SCBA + team' protocol.
Tank içi sıcaklık homojen değildir; özel: The temperature in a tank is not uniform; with heated cargoes in particular there is a vertical gradient. Readings are therefore taken at the top, middle and bottom and a weighted average is calculated. A closed-system portable electronic thermometer (MMC type) is preferred.
Tank içine deniz suyu girişi (sounding p: Seawater ingress into a tank (sounding pipe, vent, coil leak) or condensation creates a risk of both corrosion and, in MGO, microbial growth (diesel bug). Microbial contamination causes filter clogging and tank bottom corrosion; it is managed by biocide dosing and regular draining of water.
Tank içine giriş öncesi gas-freeing (hav: Before entry into a tank, gas-freeing (ventilation) brings the hydrocarbon and toxic gas levels to safe values and the oxygen to ~21%; the enclosed space entry procedure, gas measurement and permit are applied. Before an inerted tank is gas-freed with air, it is purged with inert gas until the hydrocarbon content is below 2% by volume, so that the tank atmosphere does not pass through the flammable range.
Tank kapasitesi planlaması kritiktir: sü: Tank capacity planning is critical: fuels of different sulfur content (HSFO on a ship with a scrubber, VLSFO, MGO) are segregated in separate tanks, and the ban on commingling and the 85% maximum filling rule (ullage allowance for thermal expansion) are observed. A wrong tank plan can make the ECA changeover impossible.
Tank seviye göstergeleri, yüksek seviye: Tank level gauges, high-level alarms and the overflow tank are the most important layers of protection during a transfer. A transfer is not an operation to be left unattended while doing something else.
Tank seviyeleri hem otomatik (remote tan: Tank levels are verified both automatically (remote tank gauging) and manually with a sounding tape. If the automatic system and the manual measurement do not agree, a sensor fault or a line leak is suspected. Keeping sounding pipes clear and their self-closing caps in working order is a SOLAS requirement.
Tank seviyelerinin doğru takibi, makinen: Correct monitoring of tank levels ensures an uninterrupted fuel/oil supply to the engine and prevents overflow/spillage. The cadet learns why a service tank level is kept within a certain range (settling time, need for water draining).
Tank seviyesi sürekli izlenir (sounding: The tank level is monitored continuously (sounding + remote gauge). The high and high-high alarms must have been tested. During topping-up the rate is reduced; only one tank is left open to make control easier. Air vent/sounding pipe openings must be clear; a blocked vent causes overpressure and rupture/overflow.
Tank sounding/ullage günlük yapılır; ROB: Tank sounding/ullage is taken daily, and ROB consistency is monitored. Free water (water collected at the tank bottom) is drained regularly. For tank atmosphere/flashpoint safety, the flashpoint ≥60°C rule (SOLAS) is observed; low-flashpoint fuel (e.g. after accidental MGO/HFO commingling) is a serious fire risk.
Tank temizleme; deniz suyu (soğuk/sıcak): Tank cleaning is carried out by seawater washing (cold or hot), crude oil washing (COW) and chemical cleaning for stubborn residues. The method is chosen according to the remaining cargo, the next cargo (compatibility) and the gas-free target. Fixed or portable washing machines cover the whole surface.
Tank temizliği, COW ve giriş işlemleri i: Tank cleaning, COW and entry operations are carried out with the relevant permits (an entry/COW permit even when there is no hot work) and records; the ship-shore safety checklist (at the terminal) and the IG/COW records are kept. The AB knows their own duty within the scope of the permit, keeps in contact with the officer/pump control by radio (Ex-certified) and reports every abnormality.
Tank top seviyesi ve sintine alanları da: The tank top level and the bilge areas can be cramped and hot; when working in these areas, the enclosed space rules are reviewed. Regular cleaning also slows down corrosion in these areas; accumulated salt water corrodes the steel. The Wiper tries to leave every point reached clean and dry.
Tank vent head, sounding pipe head ve ma: Deck openings such as tank vent heads, sounding pipe heads and manhole covers are checked periodically; the float/flame screen of the vent head, the sounding pipe cap and the manhole gaskets/bolts ensure watertightness. A defect in these can lead to water entering a tank/void space.
Tank washing makineleri (portable Butter: Tank washing machines (portable Butterworth or fixed) wash with hot or cold water or chemical solutions.
Tank yıkama suları ve COW kalıntıları sl: Tank washings and COW residues are collected in the slop tank, where oil and water separate over time (settling). The slop level and the oil/water interface are followed.
Tank yıkama suyu ve tortu (slop), petrol: Because tank washings and sediment (slops) contain oil, they cannot be discharged into the sea unless the conditions of MARPOL Annex I Reg. 34 are met; MARPOL Annex I sets out the rules for reducing slops by COW, collecting them in the slop tank, separating oil and water, and appropriate discharge/delivery. The Oil Record Book is the legal document in which all washing, slop transfer and discharge operations are recorded. The AB assists with the physical work of these operations and prevents spills and leaks.
Tank ısıtma serpantinleri yakıtın pompal: Tank heating coils keep the fuel pumpable. A leaking coil both mixes water into the tank and carries oil into the condensate line, causing contamination; the condensate observation tank is therefore checked regularly.
Tank/kapalı alan içinde hot work için ek: Hot work inside a tank/enclosed space requires an additional double permit: hot work + enclosed space. Watch out for sparks and drops of hot metal falling to lower levels (e.g. onto oil in the bilge); the areas below are also cleaned and covered.
Tanka giriş gerekiyorsa (inspeksiyon, on: If tank entry is required (inspection, repair), the tank is first made gas-free: the hydrocarbon vapor is reduced to a safe level by ventilation, the oxygen is brought back to normal (20.9%) and toxic gases (H₂S/benzene) are reduced to safe limits. This transition "from inert to air" is controlled; care is taken that during the intermediate stage (purging), the atmosphere does not pass through the dangerous flammable range. The process is carried out under the officer's control, using fans/eductors.
Tanka indirilen her metal cisim (soundin: Every metal object lowered into a tank (sounding weight, measuring instrument, lamp) is earthed or is of an approved anti-static type; an unearthed conductive object remains "isolated" and becomes a source of static sparks. Mobile phones, cameras, uncertified flashlights and spark-producing tools are prohibited in the hazardous area; only Ex (explosion-proof) certified equipment is used.
Tanker pump room ve kargo tankları, hidr: Tanker pump rooms and cargo tanks are high-risk with regard to hydrocarbon vapor and oxygen deficiency. In a tank filled with inert gas, the oxygen content does not exceed 8% by volume and the atmosphere cannot sustain life; entry is prohibited until a gas-free certificate has been obtained. ISGOTT defines additional procedures for enclosed space entry on tankers (gas-freeing, continuous monitoring). The Chief Officer ensures these conditions in coordination with the cargo officer.
Tanker sektöründe OCIMF SIRE/VIQ denetim: In the tanker sector, OCIMF SIRE/VIQ inspections question the D&A programme in detail: is there a written policy, are limit values defined, is the random testing rate sufficient, are records kept, is the breathalyser calibrated? In vetting, a weak D&A programme directly affects the ship's acceptability for charter; this requires the Master to run the programme rigorously not only for "compliance" but also for commercial sustainability.
Tanker vetting (OCIMF SIRE 2.0) ve TMSA: In tanker vetting (OCIMF SIRE 2.0) and TMSA audits, the availability of critical spare parts, the effectiveness of the stock management system and the consistency of consumption records are questioned. The inspector may ask to see a random critical part physically; a mismatch between the PMS record and the actual stock results in an observation.
Tanker, gas carrier ve yolcu gemilerinde: On tankers, gas carriers and passenger ships, additional drills apply (cargo emergency, enclosed space, mass rescue). The Safety Officer takes the mandatory drills specific to the ship type from the SMS and the additional flag requirements and enters them in the annual plan; a "due date" table is kept so that no interval is missed.
Tankerde tank temizliği ve butterworth o: Tank cleaning and Butterworth operations on tankers are the least error-tolerant work in seafaring, because here one wrong step can destroy not just one person but the whole ship. The AB's value lies in applying the rules on inert atmosphere, earthing, atmosphere monitoring and entry without exception, and in having the discipline to stop the operation at the slightest abnormality. Skill in this work lies not in speed but in unwavering attention that takes every measurement, every earthing connection and every permit condition seriously.
Tankerlerde COW + ballast yönetimi paral: On tankers, COW and ballast management run in parallel; ballast changes between bunkering, loading and discharging operations are planned with a careful scenario. Incorrect ballast management leads to major risks such as listing, exceeding the bending moment limit or hold flooding.
Tankerlerde OCIMF SIRE 2.0 vetting denet: For tankers, OCIMF SIRE 2.0 vetting inspections and the company-level TMSA 3 self-assessment are extensions of ISM/ISPS that have become mandatory in practice in commercial life. A tanker may fail to find cargo because of a bad SIRE report despite valid certificates. The Master masters the SIRE question bank and ensures that the records and practices on board are consistent with the TMSA elements (e.g. MOC, risk management, navigation safety).
Tankerlerde deck foam sistemi ve foam co: On tankers, the deck foam system and foam compound expiry, the fixed foam monitors and the high-expansion foam system (where required) are also checked.
Tankerlerde güverte köpük sistemi; köpük: The deck foam system on tankers consists of a foam tank and proportioner, a main line, monitors (foam cannons) and hydrant applicators. A stock of foam sufficient to cover the whole cargo deck area at a specified rate for a specified time (e.g. at least 20 minutes) is mandatory.
Tankerlerde hot work, hazardous zone dış: On tankers, hot work is done outside the hazardous zone or under conditions where the work area is fully gas-free and adjacent cargo tanks are inerted or gas-freed. The Chief Officer verifies that there are no flammable sources within a 30 m radius of the work point, that the decks below, where sparks may fall, are protected, and that fire-fighting equipment is at hand.
Tankerlerde ve gaz tehlikesi olan mahall: On tankers and in spaces with a gas hazard, electrical equipment must be of the explosion-protected (Ex) type. The ETO maintains the integrity of Ex equipment (flameproof enclosure, gaskets, full set of bolts); opening an Ex fitting or repairing it incorrectly invalidates its protection rating and creates a risk of explosion.
Tanklar asla %100 doldurulmaz; ısınma ka: Tanks are never filled to 100%; an allowance is left for thermal expansion. Typically a 98% filling is aimed for, and the expansion is calculated from the type of cargo, the loading temperature and the temperature rise expected during the voyage. Overfilling creates a risk of overflow and of a MARPOL violation.
Tanklar günlük sounding edilir; beklenme: Tanks are sounded daily; an unexpected change in level points to a leak or a transfer error. The results are recorded in the log.
Tanklara sabit, programlanabilir yıkama: Fixed, programmable tank cleaning machines are installed in the tanks; rotating jets sweep the tank surfaces at different angles. Washing is supplied by the cargo pump pressure and the washing oil is removed by stripping.
Tarih boyunca denizcilerin yaşadığı skor: Scurvy, which seafarers suffered from throughout history, is the classic example of vitamin C deficiency; it shows itself through bleeding gums, weakness and delayed wound healing. The cook prevents it by protecting vitamin C sources (citrus fruit, sauerkraut, frozen vegetables, fruit juice concentrate) in the last weeks of a long voyage. Fe-deficiency anemia, vitamin D deficiency and B12 deficiency are also risks to watch for on long voyages.
Tarih hassasiyeti yüksek ürünlerde (süt,: For date-sensitive products (milk, fresh meat), FEFO (First Expired First Out — the product with the earliest expiry date goes out first) is more appropriate; the cook sets the order of use according to the actual expiry date, not just the order of arrival. Opened products are labeled with the date of opening and used within a short time.
Tarih hattı geçişi GMDSS UTC kaydını etk: Crossing the date line does not affect the GMDSS UTC record, because UTC is continuous; only the ship's date is affected. The Second Officer treats the line crossing as an item separate from the clock change plan; if the date change and a required zone time change fall on the same day, each of them is documented separately in the logbook.
Tarih hattı geçişinde seyir defterine ta: When crossing the date line, the date change is entered clearly in the deck logbook: "Crossed International Date Line, date advanced/retarded by one day". Because skipping or repeating a day can cause confusion in the rest-hour records and in pay/working-day calculations, the records are cross-checked against the UTC axis.
Tatbikat gerçek gibi yürütülür: alarm ve: The drill is conducted as if it were real: the alarm is raised, the crew muster, a head count by name is taken and the teams actually carry out their duties (preparing to lower the lifeboat, running out fire hoses, boundary cooling). The AB does not see the drill as "a waste of time"; this is where they acquire the reflexes that will save lives in a real emergency.
Tatbikatlar (drills), acil durum prosedü: Drills ensure that emergency procedures become ingrained in muscle memory. The cadet takes an active part in abandon ship, fire, enclosed space rescue and man overboard drills. Treating a drill as a "formality" is dangerous; when a real incident occurs, people can only do what they have rehearsed.
Tatbikatlar, gerçek seyri tehlikeye atma: Drills are carried out without endangering actual navigation — in open sea and in suitable conditions. Some scenarios can also be run as simulations/table-top sessions; for example, in a grounding scenario the team is asked to discuss "what would you do?". A debrief is always held after the drill; what went well and what needs improvement are noted.
Tatbikatlar, kurtarmanın hızlı ve doğru: Drills ensure that rescue is carried out quickly and correctly; in a real accident, seconds save lives. Deficiencies found in drills are corrected.
Tatbikatta kurtarma ekipmanının çalıştığ: During the drill, it is confirmed that the rescue equipment works, the SCBA cylinders are full and the recovery arrangement (tripod/winch) functions. After the drill, deficiencies are reported and rectified. A "drill on paper" is useless in a real emergency; the AB takes every drill seriously.
Tatbikatın amacı kayıt doldurmak değil,: The purpose of a drill is not to fill in records but to build muscle memory for a moment of crisis. Good drills are therefore realistic: the scenario is changed (the same monthly "lower the lifeboat" routine becomes rote), difficulty is added (one person counts as "injured", one exit is assumed "blocked") and an honest debrief is held afterwards. El Faro and similar accidents showed that rote and unrealistic drills are of no use in a crisis.
Tatlı su tankı (FWT): soğuk su deposu; e: Fresh water tank (FWT): cold water storage; epoxy-coated or stainless steel.
Taze boyalı alan \"WET PAINT\" işareti v: A freshly painted area is protected with a "WET PAINT" sign and a barrier; nobody steps on it and no equipment is placed on it until it is dry. If the overcoating interval is not observed, solvent entrapment and film breakdown occur. Quality work means correct thickness + clean surface + suitable weather + correct waiting time.
Taze hava girişi: Minimum taze hava mikt: Fresh air intake: The minimum quantity of fresh air is supplied.
Taze meyve/sebze solunum yapar (CO₂/etil: Fresh fruit and vegetables respire (producing CO₂ and ethylene); the fresh air vent setting controls these gases. In controlled atmosphere (CA) reefers the O₂/CO₂ ratio is actively managed to slow down ripening. These settings follow the carrying instructions for the cargo.
Taze sebze/meyvede tazelik, çürük/küf yo: Fresh vegetables/fruit are checked for freshness, absence of rot/mold and degree of ripeness. Meat/fish is assessed for color, smell, texture and temperature. The cook places the accepted delivery in the appropriate store without delay; leaving it standing in the heat on the quay breaks the cold chain.
Taşlama (grinding) işlemlerinde doğru di: For grinding work, the correct disc is used (a cutting disc for cutting, a grinding disc for grinding); a disc is never used for the wrong purpose (side grinding with a cutting disc causes the disc to burst). The expiry date of the disc and any cracks are checked, and the guard is never removed.
Taşlama macunu ile el ile veya taşlama m: Grinding is done by hand with grinding paste or with a grinding machine. Coarse grinding is followed by fine grinding. After grinding, the tightness of the surfaces is checked with a marking blue test.
Taşınabilir medya (USB), gemiye zararlı: Removable media (USB) are the most common route for malware to enter the ship; service technicians' laptops and chart update media are particularly risky. The ETO restricts USB use by policy, applies scanning with a kiosk/scanner and blocks unauthorized media on OT systems. Firmware/software updates are applied in a controlled manner, from a verified source and, where possible, after testing.
Taşınabilir yangın söndürücüler, EEBD (E: Portable fire extinguishers, EEBDs (Emergency Escape Breathing Device), fire stations and quick-closing valve controls are kept clear, marked and accessible. A fire station with materials piled in front of it is as good as no fire station at all.
Tebeşir testi: Contaya tebeşir sürülerek: Chalk test: chalk is applied to the compression bar and the cover is closed; when the cover is opened, the chalk mark on the packing must be evenly distributed.
Tehlike işaretleri, ekipman lokasyon lev: Hazard signs, equipment location signs, mandatory PPE signs and walkway markings are kept legible and visible. Faded, rusted or covered signs are renewed as part of housekeeping. Visible marking is for the safety of both the crew and visitors (pilot, surveyor, stevedores).
Tehlike sinsidir çünkü atmosfer normal g: The danger is insidious because the atmosphere looks normal but is lethal. Oxygen deficiency (due to rusting, cargo off-gassing or inert gas) causes loss of consciousness within seconds. When a victim collapses, the second and third persons who rush in unprepared to rescue also die in the same atmosphere; the "multiple fatality" pattern is the hallmark of such accidents.
Hazards: CO₂ is lethal to humans. Before release, it must be verified that all personnel have been evacuated.
Tehlikeli sıcaklık aralığı (kabaca 5-63°: The danger zone (roughly 5-63°C) is the range in which bacteria multiply rapidly; keeping refrigerated food below this range reduces the risk of foodborne illness. A door left open, overfilling, a damaged seal or a fault raises the temperature; the cook catches these deviations early.
Tehlikeli yük yönetimi, Birinci Zabitin: Dangerous goods management is one of the Chief Officer's duties carrying the highest responsibility; a small oversight can turn into a major disaster. Correct classification, strict segregation, complete documentation and disciplined monitoring protect the ship, the crew and the environment from the risks of dangerous goods.
Tek başına çalışırken kamarot, bir yangı: Working alone, the steward may be the first person to notice signs of fire (smoke, smell, heat). In such a case, the steward raises the alarm immediately and acts according to the procedure. Early detection saves lives in an accommodation fire.
Tek bir ağır aracın yanlış konumu lokal: Placing a single heavy vehicle in the wrong position can cause local deck damage.
Tek bir okuma değil, zaman içindeki eğil: What matters is not a single reading but the trend over time. A slow rise in the exhaust temperature of one cylinder compared with the others points to a fuel valve/injector problem; a gradual rise in jacket cooling water temperature points to a fouled/clogged cooler or a thermostat problem; a slow fall in LO pressure points to a clogged filter or pump wear.
Tek bumbalı jib vinç: En yaygın gemi vin: Single-jib crane: the most common type of ship's crane. It may be electro-hydraulic or all-electric. It has hoisting, luffing and slewing motions.
Tek hat şeması (single line diagram), ge: The single line diagram shows the backbone of the ship's power system: generators, main switchboard (MSB), bus-tie breakers, transformers, emergency switchboard and distribution boards. The cadet learns how power travels from the generator to the consumer and which breaker protects what.
Tek kişi aynı anda hem lookout hem helms: One person cannot be lookout and helmsman at the same time; when steering by hand, the person is focused on the helm and the compass, so a "proper look-out" cannot be kept. For this reason, a separate lookout is posted when hand steering is in use. STCW A-VIII/2 and many accident reports stress that the "sole lookout" arrangement is acceptable only in daylight, in good visibility and low traffic, and after the OOW has assessed all factors.
Tek silindiri devre dışı bırakarak (cut-: In some cases it is possible to proceed at reduced power (limp home) by cutting out one cylinder. This decision is taken in accordance with the manuals and class guidelines, in coordination with the bridge.
Tek yönlü akım geçiren iki terminalli ya: A two-terminal semiconductor device that conducts current in one direction only. It has an anode (+) and a cathode (−).
Teknik bilgi ve sistem öğrenimi, güverte: Technical knowledge and learning the ship's systems are the core that turns the deck cadet into a competent future officer. Truly understanding the ship — logic, not memorization — lays the foundation for the cadet to make the right decisions in breakdowns, emergencies and complex operations in the future.
Teknik dil hem yedek parça siparişinde h: Technical language is critical for ordering spare parts, reading OEM manuals and working with a multinational crew. The cadet learns new terms on every maintenance job and enters them in the TRB notes.
Teknik raporlama, Baş Mühendis'in karada: Technical reporting is the bridge of trust that the Chief Engineer builds with management ashore. Correct, timely and honest data ensure the right maintenance decisions, fair charter settlements and legal compliance. The modern Chief Engineer must be as good a data manager and communicator as an engineer.
Teknik raporlama; günlük (noon report),: Technical reporting consists of daily (noon report), weekly (summary/issues), monthly (detailed technical) and event-based (defect/incident) layers. Each layer feeds a different level of decision-making: daily reports feed operational decisions, weekly reports tactical decisions and monthly reports strategic decisions.
Teknik çizim okuma ve PMS kullanımı, mak: Reading technical drawings and using the PMS are the two basic skills that turn the engine cadet from an observer who "knows the equipment" into an engineer who "manages the system". The drawing shows the logic of the system and the route to safe isolation; the PMS makes maintenance planned, recorded and sustainable. As the cadet develops the discipline of finding on site what is seen on the drawing, confirming on the drawing what is seen on site and recording every maintenance job correctly in the PMS, the cadet becomes a reliable part of the ship's technical memory.
Tekrar eden bir alarm; gevşek bir termin: A recurring alarm can be the forerunner of a loose terminal, a drifting sensor, a marginal setpoint or a developing mechanical failure. Through root cause analysis (RCA), the ETO resolves these signs before they grow and does not fall into the trap of "the alarm came, I acknowledged it, it cleared".
Tekrarlayan arızalar (örn. aynı pompa me: Recurring failures (e.g. the mechanical seal of the same pump failing every 3 months) point to an inadequate PMS interval or procedure. The Chief Engineer carries out a root-cause analysis (RCA — 5 Why, fishbone); the solution is sometimes to shorten the interval, sometimes to upgrade the spare part quality and sometimes to revise the assembly procedure. This lesson is fed back into the PMS job card.
Tekrarlayan bulgular sistemik sorun işar: Recurring findings are a sign of a systemic problem. By analyzing past PSC/vetting/internal audit findings, the Chief Officer prevents recurrence; for example, a repeated "lashing equipment worn" finding calls for a review of the equipment replacement policy. Preventive action is more valuable than reactive correction.
Tekrarlayan defect ve overdue maintenanc: The effect of recurring defects and overdue maintenance on redundancy and on the ASOG is reported to the Master and the DPO. After maintenance, the return-to-service test and independent verification are completed.
Tekrarlayan menü, uzun seferde moral düş: A repetitive menu is one of the main causes of low morale on long voyages. The cook maintains variety by lengthening the cycle, adding theme days (e.g. a national cuisine day) and considering crew feedback. Small touches (the smell of fresh bread, a home-style dessert) have a disproportionately large effect on morale.
Tekrarlayan sahte alarmlar gerçek alarmı: Repeated false alarms lead to a real alarm being missed; the root cause is eliminated and any alarm suppression is recorded.
Repeated false alarms lead to a real alarm being missed; the root cause is eliminated.
Tekrarlayan sahte alarmlar personeli duy: Repeated false alarms make people insensitive to alarms; the root cause (dust, humidity, sensor age) is analysed and eliminated.
Tekstil sling'lerde renk kodu kapasiteyi: On textile slings, the color code indicates capacity (e.g. violet = 1 t, green = 2 t, yellow = 3 t — a standard convention); however, the SWL is always confirmed from the label. If no protection is used at a sharp edge, the sling is cut instantly. A damaged sling is not repaired; it is discarded.
Tekstil/web sling'ler hafif ve yüzeyi ko: Textile/web slings are light and protect the surface of the load, but they are sensitive to cuts, abrasion, chemical damage and UV degradation. Inspection looks for: tears/cuts, worn webbing, chemical burns (oil/acid stains and stiffening), heat damage (melting/glazing), broken stitching and fading. The label (SWL, material, date of manufacture/test) must be legible; a sling without a label is not used.
Tel greasing için kullanılan yağ ve tine: Consumables such as the lubricant and thinner used for wire greasing are classed as hazardous substances; they are kept in the paint/solvent section, in a ventilated and labeled area.
Tel makarası, boya fıçısı, demir teçhiza: Heavy items such as wire reels, paint drums and metal fittings are usually lowered into the store with a crane or the provision crane. During this operation, the Bosun checks the SWL of the lifting gear, the slinging points and that nobody stands under the load. For manual handling, correct lifting technique (legs, not back) and suitable PPE are essential.
Temel unsurlar: güvenlik ve çevre politi: The key elements: a safety and environmental protection policy, defined responsibilities and authority, appointment of a Designated Person Ashore (DPA), emergency preparedness, reporting of accidents and incidents, maintenance procedures, documentation and internal audits.
Temel uygunluk yaklaşımı: Attained EEDI: The basic compliance approach: attained EEDI ≤ required EEDI. The required EEDI is set according to the ship type and the IMO phase reduction factor; the difference in design between two ships of the same class shows up directly in this inequality.
Temiz yatak takımı ve havlu sağlamak, sa: Providing clean bedding and towels is not just a matter of comfort but of health. Textiles that are not changed regularly, are poorly dried or are moldy cause skin infections, allergies and respiratory problems. The steward manages these risks by keeping the laundry cycle running without interruption.
Temiz çamaşır, kirli çamaşırın bulunduğu: Clean laundry is kept covered and separate from the area where dirty laundry is kept.
