Clean laundry is not put next to the dirty laundry trolley; this causes cross-contamination. The linen locker is kept clean, dry and tidy; clean laundry stored in a damp environment goes moldy.
Temiz, kuru çamaşır düzgün katlanır ve s: Clean, dry laundry is folded neatly and returned correctly to its owner/cabin. The labeling or bagging system ensures that laundry does not get mixed up; it is particularly important for privacy and trust that personal laundry reaches the right person. Bedding is distributed to the relevant cabins, and the surplus is stored neatly in the clean linen locker.
Temizlik kimyasalları (deterjan, yağ çöz: When cleaning chemicals (detergents, degreasers) are used, the manufacturer's instructions and the Safety Data Sheet (SDS) are followed; suitable gloves and goggles are worn and chemicals are not discharged into the sea. If wash water contains oil or chemicals, it is collected in accordance with MARPOL. The AB considers environmental rules part of the cleaning routine.
Temizlik kimyasalları, SDS bilgisine uyg: Cleaning chemicals are stored in accordance with the SDS information; incompatible chemicals (acids/alkalis, oxidizers) are kept apart and stored in labeled containers. The steward oversees safe storage and the integrity of labels; incorrect mixing can cause a dangerous reaction.
Temizlik programı bir checklist üzerinde: The cleaning program is recorded by signing it off on a checklist. During an MLC inspection, this record is the evidence for the claim that "cleaning is done regularly". An incomplete or blank form makes even work that has been done appear "not done".
Temizlik solventleri, pas sökücüler ve d: Cleaning solvents, rust removers and degreasers may be flammable and toxic. The cadet learns to read the MSDS, provide adequate ventilation, use gloves/a mask and keep these products away from sources of ignition. Incorrect use of solvents is both a health and a fire hazard.
Temizlik sonrası ambar kuru ve kokusuz o: After cleaning, the hold must be dry and odor-free; the bilge wells are cleaned, the strum boxes are checked and the bilge pumping is verified to work. Protrusions, sharp surfaces and remains of earlier lashings that could damage the cargo are removed. Any structural damage found (holes, dents, corroded areas) is reported to the officer.
Temizlik sonrası sintine kuru tutulur; b: After cleaning, the bilge is kept dry, so that any new leak becomes visible at once. A painted, clean bilge gives early warning to the crew as much as to the inspector.
Temizlik sırasında ilgili zone panelde t: During cleaning, the zone concerned is put into test/isolate mode on the panel, the ship's fire patrol is informed and any interlock with the fixed extinguishing system is temporarily made safe. After cleaning, the detector's function is verified with a test device (test gas/smoke).
Temizlik, görünür kir ve yağı uzaklaştır: Cleaning removes visible dirt and grease; disinfection reduces microorganisms to a safe level. They are separate steps: first wash with detergent (the dirt comes off), then apply the disinfectant. For the disinfectant to be effective, the contact time specified by the manufacturer must be allowed; rinsing immediately reduces its effect.
Temizlik, hiçbir koşulda emniyet bariyer: Cleaning must never, under any circumstances, compromise safety barriers. Fire doors are divisions in the accommodation that delay the spread of fire and smoke; the steward does not hold these doors open with a wedge or chair to make cleaning easier. A fire door left open can have fatal consequences in a real fire.
Temizlik; sweeping, washing (deniz + tat: Hold cleaning covers sweeping, washing (seawater, then a fresh-water rinse), drying, removing odours, cleaning the bilge wells and touching up paint. The standard required depends on the charter party and the next cargo.
Temizlikte kullanılan PPE (kimyasal eldi: The stock of PPE used for cleaning (chemical gloves, goggles, a mask where necessary) is also monitored; worn/damaged PPE is replaced. The right job is done with the right materials — for example, near an electrical panel a dry method is preferred instead of wet cleaning.
Temizlikten doğan atık (yağlı su, kimyas: Waste from cleaning (oily water, chemical residue, oily rags) is never thrown into the sea or onto the open deck; it is segregated in accordance with the ship's waste management plan (Garbage Management Plan, MARPOL Annex V) and the oily waste procedure. Even with a small act, the Wiper can protect or damage the ship's pollution record.
Tender embarkation platformu/gangway güv: The tender embarkation platform and gangway are rigged safely; if the weather or sea limits are exceeded, the operation is stopped. Passengers are counted on every tender and lifejackets are provided.
Tender iniş-binme, özellikle yaşlı/PRM y: Getting on and off tenders is the point where injuries happen most often, especially for elderly and PRM passengers.
Tepsideki birikinti, gizli bir sızıntını: Deposits in a tray are a clue to a hidden leak; their origin is traced and the source is reported to the engineer. A tray that keeps filling up points to a leak that needs to be fixed.
Tercihli açma sırası gemi elektrik proje: The preferential trip sequence is defined in the ship's electrical design and never cuts off consumers required by SOLAS.
Terk gemi (abandon ship) durumunda Yağcı: In an abandon ship situation, the Oiler, according to their role in the muster list, helps with preparing the lifeboats/liferafts, carrying portable equipment or the head count. In a man overboard situation, the engine is kept ready for maneuvering; the Oiler carries out their maneuvering support duty in the engine room.
Termal denge, iki sistem arasında net ıs: Thermal equilibrium is the state in which there is no net heat flow between two systems. If no heat transfer takes place when two systems are brought into contact, they are at the same temperature.
Termik overload rölesi, motoru aşırı akı: The thermal overload relay protects the motor against overcurrent (mechanical jamming, phase loss, overload). The ETO sets the relay current setpoint according to the motor's rated value (FLA - Full Load Ampere), typically 105-115% of FLA. Too low a setting means nuisance trips; too high a setting means a burnt-out motor.
Communication with the terminal is safety-critical. On tankers, under ISGOTT the Ship-Shore Safety Checklist is completed after berthing and confirmed every watch; at the pre-transfer conference the loading rate, the maximum pressure, the ESD (Emergency Shut Down) signal, the communication failure procedure and the authority to stop are agreed. The Master says "no" with overriding authority to an unsafe request from the terminal representative (e.g. starting transfer before the checklist is completed).
Termodinamik sistem, incelenmek üzere se: A thermodynamic system is a quantity of matter or a region of space chosen for study and separated from its surroundings by its boundary. Everything outside the system is called the surroundings, and the surface that separates the system from the surroundings is called the boundary.
Termokuple, iki farklı metalin birleşim: A thermocouple is a sensor based on the Seebeck effect, producing an EMF that depends on the temperature difference at the junction of two different metals. The temperature difference between the measuring point (hot junction) and the reference point (cold junction) determines the EMF.
Termostat ve kontrol: Her bölgedeki sıca: Thermostats and control: the temperature in each zone is controlled individually or centrally.
Termostat ve yüksek sıcaklık emniyet kes: The thermostat and the high-temperature safety cut-out (high-limit cut-off) are the critical safety components of the fryer; if they fail, the oil can overheat and ignite. The cook periodically verifies that these cut-outs work and does not use the equipment if in doubt.
Ters akış veya paralel akış düzenlemesin: For a heat exchanger in a counter-flow or parallel-flow arrangement, the LMTD is calculated from the temperature differences at the inlet and outlet.
Ters güç durumu tahrik motoruna mekanik: A reverse power condition can cause mechanical damage to the prime mover and overload the other generators.
Ters güç durumu, tahrik motorunun (dizel: A reverse power condition arises when the prime mover (diesel engine) cannot produce power because of a fuel cut-off, a governor failure or a mechanical failure. The generator then works as a motor, drawing active power from the busbar and starting to drive the prime mover.
Ters ozmoz, deniz suyunu yüksek basınçla: Reverse osmosis forces seawater at high pressure (50–70 bar) through a semi-permeable membrane; the water passes and the salt ions are held back. It needs no heat source, runs on electricity and gives a high capacity at low temperature. Pre-filtration (sand/cartridge) and membrane chemistry are the critical maintenance issues.
Tersine, sürekli aynı, özensiz veya kali: Conversely, food that is always the same, carelessly prepared or of poor quality is a main source of low morale, tension and complaints. The cook reads the atmosphere in the mess as an indicator; falling morale is often a message that should be reflected in the menu.
Tersinir süreç, sistem ve çevre birlikte: A reversible process is an ideal process in which the system and the surroundings can both be returned to their initial states. In such a process there are no sources of irreversibility such as friction, turbulence, mixing or heat transfer across a finite temperature difference.
Tersinir süreçler doğada mevcut değildir: Reversible processes do not exist in nature, but they are used to set the limits of ideal performance.
Teslim alınan kalemler vakit kaybetmeden: Items received are put in their places in the store without delay, following FIFO (new items at the back, old ones at the front). Certified items (rope, wire, LSA equipment) are recorded together with their certificates.
Teslim alınan ürün, irsaliye/fatura ile: Products received are compared with the delivery note/invoice; short, excess or wrong deliveries are recorded. In case of a quality dispute, the cook informs the Master/company and, if necessary, documents it with photographs. Accurate records are needed both for cost control and for resolving any dispute with the supplier.
Tespit edilen eksiklikler (eksik harita,: Deficiencies found (missing charts, outstanding corrections, expired publications) are reported to the Master and the company DPA, and supply requests are raised. Under the SMS (Safety Management System) this process is documented and followed up until closed.
Tespit edilen gyro error tüm gyro bearin: The gyro error found is applied to all gyro bearings and headings: the true value is obtained with the logic "error east, compass least; error west, compass best". Because ECDIS and radar are fed from the gyro, the error directly affects position and target calculations.
Test call yalnız test/routine amaçlı ve: Test calls are made only for test/routine purposes and in the proper way; any action that could block distress-priority traffic or be mistaken for a distress alert is avoided. The Second Officer confirms that the "test" mode of the equipment has been selected correctly and that the real distress button has not been activated by accident.
Test call'lar ITU prosedürlerine ve kıyı: Test calls are made in accordance with ITU procedures and the test protocol accepted by the coast station (as listed in ALRS). Some coast stations give an automatic ACK while others reply manually; the correct station and frequency are selected using ALRS NP286.
Test cihazları da bakım ve doğrulama ger: Test instruments also need maintenance and verification: multimeter probes and fuses, the megger battery and the prove-test function of the voltage detector are checked regularly. For critical measurements, the ETO increases confidence by cross-checking with two independent instruments (especially when proving absence of voltage).
Test kitleri ve breathalyzer'ın çalışır,: Test kits and the breathalyzer must be in working order, calibrated and within their expiry dates. An expired kit may give a false result. The Third Officer monitors the kit stock and expiry dates and replenishes any shortages.
Test sonucu, setpoint değeri ve tetiklen: The test result is recorded with the setpoint value and the level triggered (alarm/slowdown). If sensor drift (deviation from the actual value) is found, calibration or replacement is planned. A bearing temperature alarm that does not work means that a mechanical failure in the bearing is noticed late.
Test sonucunun CAMO, ASOG, consequence a: The effect of the test result on the CAMO, the ASOG, the consequence analysis and the emergency drills is assessed. After a modification or a recurring fault, the FMEA is updated as a living document.
Test sonuçları (start süresi, gerilim/fr: Test results (start time, voltage/frequency recovery, behavior on load) are recorded in the engine logbook and the PMS log. To assess cold-start capability, the ETO also tests the engine with the jacket water heater (jacket heater) on and off; the start time may be longer when the engine is cold.
Test sonuçları logbook ve PMS'e işlenir;: Test results are entered in the logbook and the PMS; abnormal findings are also raised separately as defect reports. At the end of the month, the Safety Officer prepares a summary report (tests carried out, defects found, open actions) and submits it to the Master. This report serves as evidence for SMS internal audits and PSC.
Test sırasında çıkan her kusur (sızdıran: Every defect found during the test (leaking gland, cracked coupling, blocked nozzle) is immediately turned into a defect report; if necessary, the station is marked "out of service" and a compensating measure is decided. After repair, it is retested and the record is updated.
Test, dahili test fonksiyonu (referans/d: The test is carried out with the built-in test function (reference/dummy chamber, optical signal simulation); the cleanliness of the measuring heads and sampling pipes is verified. A dirty/blocked sampling path gives false readings. It is confirmed that the alarm/slowdown signal reaches the bridge.
Test, kontrollü şekilde (genelde yüksüz,: The test is carried out in a controlled way (usually without load, in coordination with the bridge/Chief Engineer) by raising the speed, or by tripping the mechanism manually/with the test function. The tripping speed (rpm) is measured and compared with the manufacturer's/class value.
Testler sörvey günü değil, öncesinde yap: Tests are carried out before the survey day, not on it, so that any faults found can be rectified in time. An unexpected failure on survey day is a loss of both time and reputation.
Tezgâh ve ekipman, işler arasında temizl: Worktops and equipment are cleaned and disinfected between tasks. Preparing salad on a worktop where raw chicken has been cut is a typical chain of errors. The cook designs the workflow to run in one direction, from raw to cooked; where possible, raw and cooked preparation areas are separated in time or in space.
The Chief Officer checks each liferaft f: The Chief Officer checks each liferaft float-free arrangement against the approved raft and hydrostatic release unit instructions. Connect the painter through the specified weak link to the correct strong point. Do not confuse the retaining lashing with the painter or add lashings that prevent release. Check capacity and distribution against the approved life-saving appliance plan and persons on board.
The Chief Officer leads the forward anch: The Chief Officer leads the forward anchoring station. The Master assesses water depth including tide, hawse-pipe height, available cable, holding ground, weather, current, swinging room and equipment limits. There is no universal formula converting depth directly into a safe number of shackles. Walking back or letting go depends on the approved procedure and windlass capability, not one universal depth threshold.
The able seafarer assists with windlass: The able seafarer assists with windlass operation and cable-length reporting under the station leader. Confirm the anchor, method and cable length before letting go or walking back. Read the ship’s markings rather than assuming a nominal shackle length. Use the brake and chain stopper according to the installation’s approved procedure.
The able seafarer prepares the whistle,: The able seafarer prepares the whistle, day shapes and signalling equipment as directed by the officer of the watch. Give the appropriate manoeuvring, restricted-visibility or anchoring signals under that officer’s control and the applicable rules. Know the equipment location and operation; signal selection is not inferred from an informal deck command.
The cadet learns how a passage plan prov: The cadet learns how a passage plan provides contingency options: abort points before committing to a critical manoeuvre, suitable emergency anchoring areas, boundaries around hazards and responses to propulsion or navigation-system failure. Confirm that the options remain feasible as traffic, weather, tide and equipment status change.
The emergency fire-pump test follows the: The emergency fire-pump test follows the approved procedure: start the pump, establish suction through its priming arrangement where required, pressurise the fire main and verify the specified delivery at the designated hydrants. Priming removes air or establishes the required suction condition; it is not determined by a pump being foreign-made. Record and report any failure.
The engine cadet learns bridge–engine co: The engine cadet learns bridge–engine communication through the telegraph, engineer call and talkback systems. Observe how the team receives and acknowledges a crash-astern demand and applies the installation-specific response. Such a demand is an operational event, not an exercise to initiate without authority.
Three-way thermostatic valve, soğutma ak: A three-way thermostatic valve keeps the engine temperature at the optimum by regulating the cooling flow. Running too cold (especially at low load) is also harmful because of wear and sulfuric acid corrosion. The cadet learns the balance of "warm enough, but not too hot".
Throw-over (atılır) liferaft, kapsül (ca: A throw-over liferaft is stowed on deck in a canister; when thrown into the sea, it inflates when the painter is pulled. A davit-launched liferaft is boarded from the ship and lowered by davit; it reduces the risk of jumping into the water from a high-sided ship. Both work on the same inflation principle.
Ticari e-posta ve uydu hattının ucuzlama: Cheaper commercial e-mail and satellite lines have made communication easier but have also created pressure to "ask about everything instantly". The Master handles routine commercial traffic with economy/store-and-forward systems and urgent safety traffic over a real-time channel; he or she does not mix the two. In terms of cyber security, he or she verifies messages against the risk of e-mail phishing and fake instructions (especially bunker and payment fraud).
Tide Tables (ATT) yıllık bir üründür; ge: The Admiralty Tide Tables (ATT) are an annual publication; the current year's edition must be carried, because tidal predictions are specific to each year. The Tidal Stream Atlases, The Mariner's Handbook (NP100), the Annual Summary of Admiralty Notices to Mariners and the relevant Catalogue of Admiralty Charts (NP131) are also kept up to date.
Time charter'da \"off-hire\" (kira durma: The concept of "off-hire" is critical under a time charter: if the ship cannot perform her service because of a breakdown, a shortage of crew or the Master's fault, the charterer may stop paying hire. This is why the Master's accurate and timely reporting of delays, engine failures, deviations and similar situations directly affects the company's income. The "safe port / safe berth" warranty also lies with the charterer; the Master objects to an order to an unsafe port and issues a Letter of Protest.
Time charter'da (örn. NYPE, SHELLTIME) c: Under a time charter (e.g. NYPE, SHELLTIME) the charterer hires the ship for a certain period and directs her commercial use (employment). Under clause 8 of the NYPE, the Master must follow the charterer's orders "as regards employment, agency or other arrangements"; but this obligation does NOT extend to the safe navigation of the ship, navigation as such, or the Master's overriding authority. The charterer decides the route, port and speed commercially; the Master remains responsible for navigational safety.
Time delay (zaman geciktirici) personeli: The time delay gives a waiting time of 20–60 seconds for the evacuation of personnel.
Tipik aşınma hızı: 0.05-0.10 mm/1000 saa: Typical wear rate: 0.05–0.10 mm per 1000 hours (in good condition).
Tipik bağlama düzeni baş/kıç hat (head/s: A typical mooring pattern consists of head and stern lines, breast lines and spring lines. The springs take the longitudinal forces and the breast lines the transverse forces. Lines of the same material and length are important for sharing the load evenly.
Tipik bir WHRS: egzoz gazı ekonomizeri,: A typical WHRS may consist of an exhaust gas economiser, a power turbine, a steam turbine generator and/or an organic Rankine cycle (ORC) unit.
Tipik bir bakım gününde Reis, ekipten ön: On a typical maintenance day, the Bosun gets up before the team and reviews the weather, the ship's situation (in port/at sea), active work orders and work left over from the previous day. The Bosun holds a short synchronization with the Chief Officer: which job has priority today, which area is closed because of operations, which permit will be needed.
Tipik bir gemide ballast, ayrı bir balla: On a typical ship, ballasting is done with a separate ballast pump (centrifugal) or an eductor (jet pump). The system consists of sea chests (high/low suction), the main ballast line, branch valves and a separate butterfly/remote-controlled valve for each tank. The valves may be hydraulically/pneumatically remote-controlled; their open/closed status is monitored on the mimic panel.
Tipik bir güverte boya sistemi: primer (: A typical deck paint system: primer (zinc rich epoxy, 75 µm DFT) → intermediate coat (epoxy, 125 µm) → topcoat (polyurethane, 50 µm). Total DFT (Dry Film Thickness) 250-300 µm. On exposed areas such as hatch tops, the main deck and the forecastle, a UV-resistant topcoat is essential.
Tipik bir kuru yük gemisinde taşınması g: The main certificates to be carried on a typical dry cargo ship are: Cargo Ship Safety Construction (SafCon), Cargo Ship Safety Equipment (SafEquip), Cargo Ship Safety Radio (SafRadio), IOPP (MARPOL Annex I), IAPP (Annex VI), ISPP (Annex IV — sewage), IEEC (Energy Efficiency), ISSC (ISPS), SMC (ISM), the MLC certificate, IBWMC (Ballast Water), Tonnage, Load Line, the Minimum Safe Manning Document and the Bunker Convention insurance certificate (and, for oil tankers, the CLC certificate). Most are valid for 5 years but are subject to annual, intermediate and renewal surveys and their windows.
Tipik bir ticari gemide makine departman: On a typical merchant ship, the engine department consists of the Chief Engineer (C/E), Second Engineer (2/E), Third Engineer (3/E), Fourth Engineer (4/E), Electro-Technical Officer (ETO/Electrician) and the engine ratings (Fitter, Motorman, Oiler, Wiper). The Chief Engineer reports directly to the Master and, ashore, to the Superintendent; within the department, the Second Engineer runs day-to-day operations.
Tipik boşluk: shaft çapının 0.001-0.002: Typical clearance: 0.001–0.002 times the shaft diameter (main bearings).
Tipik olarak %5-10 sürtünme direnci azal: It typically reduces frictional resistance by 5–10%. It is most effective on flat-bottomed ships (tankers, bulk carriers).
Tipik olarak %5-20 yakıt tasarrufu sağla: It typically gives fuel savings of 5–20% (depending on the route and wind conditions). Norsepower and Anemoi are the main makers.
Tipik olarak 3 kademe tanımlanır: 1. kad: Typically 3 stages are defined: stage 1 (e.g. 110% load, 5 s) comfort loads, stage 2 (e.g. 115%, 3 s) secondary pumps, stage 3 (120%, instantaneous) last resort. The ETO tests these stages annually and verifies that the correct consumers are shed.
Tipik sıra: personel tahliyesi ve sayımı: Typical sequence: evacuation and head count → emergency stop (pumps, fans) → quick-closing valves → closing openings and dampers → verifying that the space is sealed → CO₂/foam discharge. This sequence is critical both for the safety of life and for extinguishing effectiveness.
Tipik tasarruf: %2-5 yakıt, bazı koşulla: Typical savings: 2–5% of fuel, up to 10% in some conditions. Avoiding bad weather also prevents damage to the cargo and the ship.
Tipik yakıt arıtma düzeni: Settling tank: Typical fuel treatment arrangement: settling tank → purifier → clarifier → service tank.
Title 4, denizcilerin karadaki refah ola: Title 4 supports seafarers' access to welfare facilities ashore (seamen's clubs, recreation, communication); shipowners and port States are encouraged to provide welfare facilities. In the modern era, internet/communication access on board (contact with family) has become a basic component of mental health. The Master supports reasonable use of the right to shore leave; preventing shore leave other than because of ISPS/operational restrictions is a welfare violation.
Titreşim ölçümü ve yatak sıcaklığı trend: Vibration measurement and bearing temperature trend monitoring (condition-based maintenance) catch a failure before it causes unplanned downtime. An abnormal value points to an alignment problem, imbalance or insufficient lubrication.
Titreşimli ortamda cıvataların gevşememe: To prevent bolts from loosening in a vibrating environment, split pins, locking wire, lock washers or thread-locker are used. The cadet learns which locking device is used in which application and what kind of failure a forgotten locking wire can cause.
Toksik ve yanıcı olması nedeniyle özel g: Because it is toxic and flammable, it requires special safety precautions. Class rules require it to be located in a separate gastight compartment, apart from the engine room.
Toolbox meeting (toolbox talk), iş başla: The toolbox meeting (toolbox talk) is a short safety briefing held before work starts. The Bosun explains what the job is, its steps, its risks, the precautions to be taken and what to do in an emergency. Participation is two-way; the ratings are asked to point out where they see hazards.
Toolbox meeting, izin imzalandıktan sonr: The toolbox meeting is a short on-site briefing, held after the permit is signed, that gives the team the scope of the job, the hazards, the controls and the emergency escape route. It is confirmed that everyone understands their role, has had the chance to ask questions and has confirmed "understood". If there is a language barrier, the common working language or visual explanations are used.
Toplam deniz durumu; lokal rüzgarın üret: The total sea state is the combination of the "sea" generated by the local wind and the "swell" coming from a distant system. Significant wave height (Hs) is the mean of the highest one third of the waves; a single maximum wave can reach about 1.8-2 times Hs. When interpreting this statistic, the Second Officer does not neglect the possibility of a "rogue wave".
Toplam güç talebi yaklaşık 4 MW'a kadar: On ships with a total power demand of up to about 4 MW, a 440 V, 60 Hz (or 380 V, 50 Hz) distribution system is used. In this system the cables are thicker, but the switchgear and protection devices are simpler and more economical.
Toplam hata = Variation + Deviation. CDM: Total error = variation + deviation. The CDMVT rule: Compass → Deviation → Magnetic → Variation → True.
Toplanan atık, sınıflandırılarak saklama: Collected waste is sorted and taken to the garbage storage area. Plastics and other waste to be delivered ashore are stored in an orderly way, free of odor and leaks; food waste is managed separately for hygiene reasons.
Toplantı tutanağa geçer; her aksiyon içi: The meeting is minuted; a responsible person and a target date are assigned to each action. The minutes are sent to the DPA, and open items are followed up at the next meeting. The meeting is not a formality; it is the channel through which the voice of the people doing the work reaches management.
Toplantı tutanağı; kararlar, atanan aksi: The minutes of the meeting are recorded together with the decisions, the assigned actions and the persons responsible, and are forwarded to the DPA (Designated Person Ashore). This allows shore management to keep a finger on the pulse of safety on board and to give the necessary support.
Toplu iş sözleşmesi (CBA, örn. ITF/IBF k: If there is a collective bargaining agreement (CBA, e.g. under ITF/IBF), the SEA refers to it and the CBA is kept on board. The Master ensures consistency between the SEA and actual practice (wages, position, hours of work); if a seafarer is employed in a different position from the one stated in the SEA or is underpaid, this is a violation of the MLC.
Torna, gemi atölyesinin en kullanışlı ma: The lathe is the most useful machine in the ship's workshop; it is used for machining shaft bearings, making bolts/studs, refacing gasket surfaces and repairing worn parts. The workpiece is centered correctly in the chuck; the chuck key is always removed after use (a key left in the chuck can be thrown out and kill). Cutting speed and feed are selected according to the material and the cutting tool.
Torna, matkap, taşlama tezgahı ve dönen: Loose clothing, gloves (gloves can be caught on a rotating tool), jewelry and long hair are dangerous near lathes, drills, grinders and rotating shafts/couplings; they can get caught and tear off a limb. Guards are never removed; the workpiece is clamped securely.
Torsional vibration (burulma titreşimi):: Torsional vibration: a periodic twisting moment caused by the cylinders of the engine firing at different times. Resonance can occur at critical speeds; a barred speed range is defined.
Total blackout, gemi için en kritik elek: A total blackout is the most critical electrical event for a ship: it means loss of propulsion, steering and navigation. The ETO and the engine team quickly apply the blackout recovery procedure: confirming that the emergency generator is on line, restarting the main generator, bringing essential consumers back on line in stages and identifying the cause (fuel, protection trip, AVR failure). Regular blackout drills keep this reflex sharp.
Totally Enclosed Lifeboat (TEL): tam kap: Totally enclosed lifeboat (TEL): fully covered, engine + air supply + sprinkler (fire-protected for tankers).
Track control ve otomatik rota tutmadan: When changing over from track control and automatic course keeping to DP mode, the point at which control is transferred must be clearly defined. In general DP practice this changeover is made gradually, after the speed has been reduced sufficiently and the ship has become stable.
Traffic Separation Schemes (TSS), COLREG: Traffic Separation Schemes (TSS) are governed by COLREG Rule 10. The basic rules are that the ship proceeds in the general direction of traffic flow, avoids crossing traffic lanes as far as practicable (and, if obliged to cross, does so on a heading as nearly as practicable at right angles to the general direction of traffic flow), and does not use the inshore traffic zone between the coast and the TSS when she can safely use the adjacent traffic lane (except vessels of less than 20 m, sailing vessels, vessels engaged in fishing, vessels en route to or from a place within the zone, or to avoid immediate danger). In busy TSSs such as Dover, Ouessant and the Bosphorus, the Master takes the conn personally.
Trafik Ayrım Düzenlerinde (TSS), kanalla: In Traffic Separation Schemes (TSS), canals and straits, the lookout workload increases: there are many targets, fast-developing situations and frequent helm orders. In these conditions, the OOW usually calls for hand steering; the helmsman concentrates on the orders while a separate lookout scans the surroundings. In this high-tempo environment, the AB must repeat back orders even more clearly and must not let their attention wander.
Trafik şeridini kesmek (crossing) zorunl: If crossing a traffic lane is unavoidable, the ship crosses on a heading as nearly as practicable at right angles to the direction of traffic flow; this shortens the crossing time and makes it easier for other ships to understand her intention. The Second Officer marks the TSS crossing in the passage plan in advance and complies with the VTS reporting requirements.
Training Record Book (TRB), stajyerin ST: The Training Record Book (TRB) is the official record documenting that the cadet has achieved the competences required by STCW. On most ships, as the cadet's shipboard training officer or immediate superior, the Second Officer oversees completion of the TRB tasks, observes the cadet and signs off the tasks in which the cadet is judged competent. The TRB is the link between the maritime school and the ship, and if it is not filled in completely, the cadet cannot progress to the next stage.
Transducer (dönüştürücü), elektrik enerj: The transducer converts electrical energy into a sound pulse; the pulse travels to the seabed, is reflected and returns. The depth is calculated from the round-trip time and the speed of sound in water (≈1500 m/s): D = (c·t)/2. The result is shown on the display and as a recording (echo trace).
Transducer, ses darbesi gönderir ve deni: The transducer sends a sound pulse and receives the echo reflected from the seabed. The depth is calculated from the round-trip time.
Transfer boyunca DPO, gangway operator v: Uninterrupted communication is kept between the DPO, the gangway operator and the installation control room throughout the transfer. As a limit is approached, no new crossings are started; in Yellow or Red status, or on a gangway trip, the planned disconnection and recovery are carried out.
Transfer boyunca tank seviyeleri sürekli: Tank levels are monitored continuously throughout the transfer; the transfer is stopped as the target level is approached. Settling and service tanks generally have high/low-level alarms; action is taken when an alarm sounds. The tank being emptied is not allowed to run completely dry, which would make the pump run dry (draw air).
Transfer durdurma kararı terminal ile ko: The decision to stop the transfer is taken in coordination with the terminal; lightning is the highest risk while venting is under way and the manifold is open.
Transfer edilen ısı, toplam ısı transfer: The heat transferred depends on the overall heat transfer coefficient (U), the area (A) and the logarithmic mean temperature difference (ΔTlm).
Transfer edilen ısı; toplam ısı transfer: The heat transferred depends on the overall heat transfer coefficient (U), the surface area (A) and the logarithmic mean temperature difference (ΔTlm). ΔTlm is the logarithmic mean of the temperature differences between the two fluids at the inlet and outlet, and it is highest in a counter-flow arrangement. Heat exchangers are therefore designed for counter-flow wherever possible.
Transfer pompaları genellikle vidalı vey: Transfer pumps are usually screw or gear-type positive displacement pumps; they give a stable flow with viscous fuel. There is a relief valve on the discharge side, because a positive displacement pump pumping against a closed valve can burst the line.
Transfer süresince her iki gemide rate,: Throughout the transfer, rate, pressure, mooring line tension and the weather are monitored on both ships; if an abort criterion is exceeded, the transfer is stopped safely with the ESD.
Transfer sırasında gemi hızı, rüzgâr ve: During the transfer, the ship's speed, the wind and the sea state are important; the bridge maneuvers to make a lee for the pilot boat. The AB watches to ensure that the ladder does not slam against the ship's side or get caught, and that nobody gets trapped between the boat and the ship, and warns the bridge/officer of any danger.
Transfer öncesi ESD aktivasyonu test edi: ESD activation is tested before the transfer, verifying that the system stops the pumps and closes the valves in the correct order. The result is entered in the ESD test log.
Transfer öncesi scupper'lar tıkanır (plu: Before transfer, the scuppers are plugged and drip trays are put in place; any spill on deck is prevented from reaching the sea. No transfer is carried out until the plugs are fitted.
Transfer öncesi valf line-up doğrulanır;: Before a transfer the valve line-up is verified; tank levels and overflow alarms are monitored. Large transfers are coordinated with the deck because of trim and list.
Transformatör, jeneratör, vinç gövdesi g: For heavy lift/project cargo such as transformers, generators and crane structures, a detailed lashing plan and engineering calculation are made (usually coordinated between the shipper and the Chief Officer). The plan requires the approval of the Master and class. The center of gravity, lashing angles and deck reaction forces are calculated; a wrong calculation endangers both the cargo and the ship.
Transkritik çevrimde çalışır (kritik sıc: It works in a transcritical cycle (critical temperature 31 °C, critical pressure 73.8 bar). Because of the high working pressure (80–130 bar), it requires special equipment.
Trend analizi proaktif bakımın temelidir: Trend analysis is the basis of proactive maintenance: a slowly rising bearing temperature, a gradually falling LO pressure or an increasing differential pressure gives a warning days before a sudden failure. Instead of saying "it is within limits for now", the cadet learns to ask "which way is it going?"
Trend bozulması (örn. SFOC'un sürekli ar: A deteriorating trend (e.g. a steady rise in SFOC) triggers joint diagnosis and intervention planning with experts ashore. This predictive approach prevents sudden failures and voyage disruption.
Trend'in kesintiye uğraması, gelişen bir: An interrupted trend leads to a developing failure being missed. This is why the discipline of the program requires continuity in ship management.
Trial manoeuvre karar desteğidir; gecikm: The trial manoeuvre is a decision aid; it depends on the delay time, the planned course or speed change and the assumption that the targets keep their present tracks. The result does not take over the responsibility under COLREG, the visual lookout or the bridge team's assessment.
Trial verileri, gelecekteki performans i: Trial data form a reference point for future performance monitoring and are also used for EEXI/CII verification.
Trim (baş-kıç farkı) ve list (yatıklık): Trim (the difference between the forward and aft drafts) and list are determined from the draft differences; during loading, the drafts are monitored until the required trim is achieved. The AB reports readings clearly and accurately, giving the actual reading and not an estimate, because a poor reading leads to a wrong cargo quantity calculation and stability errors.
Trim by head durumunda squat baş tarafta: When the ship is trimmed by the head, squat increases at the bow; when trimmed by the stern, it increases at the stern. The plan must anticipate at which point the least clearance will remain by assessing the ship's trim and the trim effect of squat together.
Trim, FP ve AP draftları arasındaki fark: Trim is the difference between the FP and AP drafts. The change of trim caused by adding/shifting a weight is calculated as trimming moment / MCTC (Moment to Change Trim 1 cm). At each loading stage, the Chief Officer predicts the forward/aft draft and compares it with actual observation (draft survey).
Trim, rampa eğimini araç geçişi için uyg: The trim is adjusted to keep the ramp slope suitable for vehicles; an excessive list upsets the balance of vehicles. This is checked with the loading computer; the BWTS is in operation (D-2).
Trim/heeling pompası ile ballast hızlı t: Ballast is transferred quickly with the anti-heeling/trim pump and the list and trim are brought to the target. Pump seals and bearings are maintained according to the PMS.
Tropical revolving storm (TRS), fırtına: A tropical revolving storm (TRS) is a destructive system rotating around the storm center. In the Northern Hemisphere, the right-hand side of the center is the "dangerous semicircle" (the wind pushes the ship towards the center) and the left-hand side is the "navigable semicircle". The Second Officer determines which semicircle the ship is in from the wind direction and how it changes.
Tropik siklon yönetiminin temel kuralı \: The basic rule of tropical cyclone management is summarised in the Bowditch chapter on avoiding the storm: in the northern hemisphere the right-hand half (the dangerous semicircle) is dangerous and the left-hand half (the navigable semicircle) relatively safe; in the southern hemisphere it is the other way round. To locate the centre of the cyclone, the Master uses Buys Ballot's law, the rate of fall of pressure, the direction of the swell and the cloud signature.
Tropik sularda deniz suyu sıcaklığı 32°C: In tropical waters, when the sea water temperature exceeds 32°C the cooling margin narrows; under these conditions the Oiler checks the cooling outlet temperatures more frequently. Clogging of the sea chest strainer (especially in areas with heavy marine growth/weed) causes a sudden temperature rise and requires a changeover between the high and low sea chests.
Tropik ve yüksek nemli bölgelerde küf en: In tropical and highly humid regions, mold is the most common problem; bathroom grout joints, the area behind curtains, corners of lockers and the undersides of mattresses are risk points. As mold is both a cosmetic and a respiratory health problem, it is checked regularly and cleaned with an antifungal product.
Tropikal fırtına kaçınması, denizcilik a: Tropical storm avoidance is maritime analysis in its purest form: reading the data, respecting uncertainty and making early, cautious decisions. The Second Officer's careful monitoring and clear analysis enable the Master to keep the ship away from the destructive core of the storm.
Trunk piston motorlarda karter yağı hem: In trunk piston engines the crankcase oil serves as both the lubricating oil and the cylinder oil, so its treatment is more critical.
Trunk piston tasarımı kullanılır; crossh: A trunk piston design is used; there is no crosshead. The engine is more compact and lighter, but the power per cylinder is lower than that of a two-stroke engine.
Tug operasyonu sırasında gemi ile römork: During tug operations, the line between the ship and the tug can come under sudden tension; this is also a source of snap-back. The AB keeps clear of the lead of the tug line and allows for the tug's pulling direction ("ahead/astern"). Coordination between the bridge and the tug is carried out by the pilot/Master; on deck, the AB is responsible for making fast and letting go safely.
Tug sayısı/pozisyon, yaklaşma açısı ve m: The number and positions of the tugs, the approach angle and the order of the mooring lines are planned; snap-back zones are managed. The bell book is kept.
Tug sayısı/pozisyonu, yaklaşma açısı, rü: The number and positions of the tugs, the approach angle, the effect of wind and current and the mooring order are agreed with the pilot. The large windage area of a container ship is critical in wind.
Tug working area da bir snap-back ve sık: The tug working area also carries a risk of snap-back and of being caught or crushed; personnel stay clear of the tug line while it is under tension. The bridge coordinates with the tug master through the pilot; the Chief Officer manages the timing of making fast and letting go on deck.
Tug, bow/stern thruster ve (varsa) azipo: The ship manoeuvres with tugs, bow and stern thrusters and (if fitted) azipods; the large lateral area of a cruise ship is critical in wind. Mooring is managed safely.
Tune, gain, sea/rain clutter ve gerekirs: Tune, gain, sea/rain clutter and, where necessary, the manual settings are tested. It is checked that the ARPA functions (target acquisition, CPA/TCPA, vector mode) work and that the gyro/log inputs are fed correctly; otherwise the target speeds will be calculated wrongly.
Tur, genellikle yukarıdan aşağıya veya b: The round is usually made in a logical order, from top to bottom or from one system to the next: the main engine and its surroundings, generators, boiler, purifier room, pump platforms, separators/clarifiers, air compressors, cooling systems, steering gear room and bilge wells. During the round, the cadet learns to use four senses: "look, listen, smell, touch" (by sight, by sound, by smell, by temperature).
Turbocharger ile doldurulan hava, interc: The air charged by the turbocharger is cooled in the intercooler and delivered to the intake manifold.
Turbocharger rpm, before/after turbine s: T/C efficiency is monitored by evaluating turbocharger rpm, before/after turbine temperatures and scavenge pressure together. If the compressor side becomes fouled, boost falls and SFOC rises; compressor-side water washing (generally daily/every two days) and turbine-side dry/water washing are therefore scheduled.
Turboşarj sonrası sıkışan (ve ısınan) em: The intake air compressed (and heated) by the turbocharger is cooled in a cooler with a finned tube bundle. Cool air is denser; more oxygen enters the cylinder, so power and combustion efficiency increase. The water side is supplied with seawater or LT fresh water.
Turboşarjer devri 10 000-40 000 rpm aras: Turbocharger speed is between 10,000 and 40,000 rpm. Radial or axial turbines are used.
Turnbuckle: lashing rod'un gerilimini ay: Turnbuckle: a threaded tensioning element that adjusts the tension of a lashing rod.
Tutarlı ve eksiksiz log, bir sorun çıktı: A consistent and complete log is the strongest defence when a problem arises.
Twist lock + lashing rod + turnbuckle ko: The combination of twistlocks, lashing rods and turnbuckles is applied according to the pattern in the CSM; tier limits, stowage on hatch covers and the positions of heavy and reefer containers are checked. Lashing tightness is verified physically.

Twist lock + lashing rod + turnbuckle is the standard combination. Tier limits (usually a single lashing is not enough above tier 4 or 5), stowage on hatch covers, on-deck positions of heavy reefers and hatch cover lashing are under the Chief Officer's supervision. Lashing failure is the main cause of container losses (Maersk Essen 2021, ONE Apus 2020).
Twist lock, lashing rod, turnbuckle, web: Twist locks, lashing rods, turnbuckles, web/chain lashings, dunnage and shoring are selected according to the type of cargo and applied with the correct torque/tension. The Bosun checks lashing tightness and corrects slack lashings immediately.
Twist-lock: container köşelerine geçen,: Twistlock: a lockable fitting that engages the corner castings of containers; there are semi-automatic and fully automatic variants.
Twistlock + lashing rod + turnbuckle kom: Twistlock + lashing rod + turnbuckle is the standard pattern. The lashing software calculates the dynamic forces according to GM, speed and course and shows whether each stack is safe; if it gives an alarm, the stowage is revised. The Chief Officer keeps the software output (PSC/vetting may ask for it) and checks that the actual lashing follows the pattern.
Tüm LSA istasyonları IMO Res. A.760(18): All LSA stations are marked with IMO Res. A.760(18) symbols; the muster station, lifejacket lockers, embarkation points and liferaft positions are shown by illuminated signs. Emergency lighting and photoluminescent escape markings must be in working order.
Tüm analiz sonuçları PMS kayıtlarına işl: All analysis results are entered in the PMS records; sample dates, results, actions taken and oil changes form a traceable history. These records are presented when requested by the class surveyor or the superintendent.
Tüm bu programların ortak paydası şudur:: The common denominator of all these programmes is this: vetting is not a snapshot of a "moment" but a continuous record and performance history. A ship may be rejected because of unclosed observations in her past reports even if she passes an inspection brilliantly. The Master must therefore manage vetting not as an "event" but as a "state" maintained every day.
Tüm hareketli ekipman (mikser, dilimleyi: All movable equipment (mixer, slicer, pots) is locked in its fixed position when not in use. Unbreakable/stainless containers are preferred to glass and ceramic ones. These measures prevent both equipment damage and burn/cut injuries.
Tüm jeneratörler durursa blackout oluşur: If all generators stop, a blackout occurs; the ship is left dark and without propulsion. The emergency generator starts automatically and supplies the essential safety loads. A black start means starting a main generator using emergency power and compressed air and re-establishing the switchboard.
Tüm jeneratörlerin kaybı (black-out) dur: If all generators are lost (blackout), the emergency generator starts automatically; under SOLAS II-1/43 it supplies the essential services within 45 seconds. Starting air is used for dead ship recovery (main air receiver + emergency air compressor; IACS UR M61 required).
Tüm kaldırma ekipmanları bir \"register: All lifting equipment is recorded in a "register of lifting appliances and cargo gear"; the SWL, last test date, certificate and inspection history of each item are kept in this register. Periodic (usually annual) inspection and inspection with load testing by an authorized person/company are mandatory; the validity of certificates is tracked.
Tüm kritik parametreler köprüüstünden iz: All critical parameters must be able to be monitored from the bridge. The automatic alarm and safety systems must work completely. The dead-man alarm requires the duty engineer to respond to the system at regular intervals.
Tüm olaylar, tatbikatlar ve kontroller z: All events, drills and checks are entered on time; statutory entries are complete and signed.
Tüm parçaları aynı miktarda stoklamak ne: Stocking all parts in the same quantity is neither economical nor possible. The ETO classifies parts by criticality and lead time: parts whose failure would stop the ship (e.g. a main switchboard protection relay, a propulsion drive PCB) are always kept in stock; easily obtained, low-criticality parts are kept at a minimum level.
Tüm pompa, filtre ve flanş bölgelerinde: Save-alls (drip trays) are fitted at all pump, filter and flange areas and are drained regularly; a full drip tray overflows and contaminates the bilge. The Second Engineer ensures that the drip trays drain not into the bilge but into the appropriate sludge/oil collecting line.
Tüm raporlar, e-postalar ve onaylar düze: All reports, e-mails and approvals are archived regularly. This archive is the body of evidence that protects the ship in survey, vetting, performance dispute and insurance processes. At a change of Chief Engineer, this archive is part of the handover.
Tüm sertifikalar geçerli; LSA/FFA ekipma: All certificates must be valid, and the LSA and FFA equipment, ECDIS, GMDSS and safety equipment must be in working order. Previous PSC deficiencies must have been closed out with evidence.
Tüm servis/yenileme işlemleri kayıt altı: All service and renewal work is recorded and the certificates are kept. These records are presented during inspections and prove that the equipment is kept up to date. The Third Officer ensures that the records are orderly and accessible.
Tüm seyir/operasyon olayları, tatbikatla: All navigation and operational events, drills and safety checks are entered on time; the Official Log Book contains the statutory entries (drills, inspections and so on).
All navigation and operational events, drills and checks are entered on time; statutory entries must be complete and signed.
Tüm sistemler, İdare (Administration) ta: All systems must be type-approved by the Administration in accordance with the IMO requirements (G8 / BWMS Code); systems that use active substances also require approval by IMO.
Tüm tarihler bir takvim/PMS sisteminde t: All dates are kept in a calendar/PMS system, and items coming due give an advance warning. The Third Officer identifies renewal/service needs before the port supply window; if a liferaft service or a flare replenishment is not planned at a suitable port, the date may expire at sea.
Tüm ticari belgeler (NOR, SoF, time shee: All commercial documents (NOR, SoF, time sheet, MR, B/L copies, LOPs, manifest, draft survey reports) are archived systematically and forwarded to the company. A laytime/demurrage dispute may go to court years later; the documents drawn up on the day are the only line of defense. The Chief Officer ensures that the records are complete, signed and dated.
Tüm watertight kapılar kapatılır, accomm: All watertight doors are closed and accommodation entrances are dogged. The bridge watch is reinforced; decisions on course and speed are reviewed continuously. When preparations are complete, the Chief Officer reports "deck sea-secured" to the bridge.
Tüm weathertight ve watertight açıklıkla: All weathertight and watertight openings (hatches, ventilators, air pipes, manholes, sounding pipe caps) are closed and dogged before heavy weather. Closing the ventilators is especially important; an open ventilator lets water into the hold/store when a wave breaks over it. The Chief Officer checks these closures physically.
Tüm yangın istasyonlarını her hafta test: It is not practical to test all fire stations every week; the Safety Officer sets up a rotation and tests a different group of hydrants/hoses/nozzles each week, so that all stations are covered within the month. The hose at the station being tested is pressurized and the jet/spray function of the nozzle is tried.
Tüm yağ ile ilgili işlemler (bunker alım: All oil-related operations (bunkering, internal transfer, bilge discharge, sludge disposal, incineration) are recorded in the Oil Record Book (ORB) Part I with the standard codes, promptly and correctly. The ORB is the document most frequently examined in PSC and flag State inspections; tank levels, quantities and times must be consistent.
Tüm ölçümler, ayarlar ve müdahaleler PMS: All measurements, settings and interventions are entered in the PMS and the engine log. These records are the ship's evidence of "due diligence" at class surveys and at PSC, flag and P&I inspections. Missing records are interpreted against the ship in insurance and liability cases.
Tünel tipi itici, gövdedeki tünel içinde: A tunnel thruster works in a tunnel in the hull and produces only a transverse force. Retractable and azimuth thrusters produce a force that can be directed through 360°, giving dynamic positioning (DP) and manoeuvring capability.
Tünel ızgarası (grid), deniz canlısı ve: The tunnel grid keeps out marine growth and foreign objects; if it fouls, it both reduces thrust and creates cavitation and vibration. During dry-docking the grid, the propeller blades and the tunnel coating are checked together.
Tüpteki hava süresi, iş yüküne göre deği: The duration of the air in the cylinder depends on the workload; it runs out quickly with heavy effort. The team must keep a sufficient reserve for the return (generally at least as much as was used going in) and head for the exit before the low-pressure whistle sounds. Entry control and communication are mandatory.
Türbin nozzle ring tipi (sabit veya deği: The type of turbine nozzle ring (fixed or variable vanes) affects performance.
Türbin çıkışında nem oranının artması so: An increase in moisture at the turbine exhaust creates a risk of erosion in the last stages; superheating and, where necessary, reheating are therefore used.
Türbin: Buhar entalpisi şaft işine dönüş: Turbine: the enthalpy of the steam is converted into shaft work. The mechanical power obtained is transferred to the generator.
Türboşarjer (T/C) emiş tarafındaki hava: The air filter/silencer (air filter silencer) on the intake side of the turbocharger (T/C) protects the compressor blades from dust and engine room contamination. A dirty filter reduces the air flow; this lowers the scavenge pressure, raises exhaust temperatures and impairs fuel efficiency. The filter panel is washed or replaced periodically.
Türev Zaman (Td): Td = 0 → türev etkisi: Derivative time (Td): Td = 0 → no derivative action. Increasing Td → overshoot decreases, but noise is amplified. Very large Td → oscillation caused by noise.
Tıbbi sandık, bayrak devleti/IMGS listel: The medical chest contains specified medicines and supplies according to flag State/IMGS lists. The Second Officer keeps the inventory up to date, monitors expiry dates, adds used-up items and items nearing expiry to the port supply order, and ensures that controlled drugs (narcotics) are recorded and kept locked.
UKC (Under Keel Clearance), geminin omur: UKC (Under Keel Clearance) is the net distance between the ship's keel and the seabed. The cadet learns the components of the UKC calculation: charted depth, height of tide, the ship's static draft, squat (sinkage due to motion), the effect of heel/list and the wave allowance. The company SMS usually specifies a minimum UKC allowance (e.g. 10% of the draft in the open sea, a specified number of meters in a channel).
UKC (karina altı boşluk), squat, gel-git: UKC (under-keel clearance) changes with squat, tide, waves and salinity. The echo sounder shows the real-time clearance under the keel, which is compared with the planned UKC. It is monitored continuously when navigating in shallow water and the alarm is set appropriately.
UKC; charted depth + height of tide − (s: UKC is calculated with the formula charted depth + height of tide − (static draught + squat + heel allowance + uncertainty/sounding error). The Second Officer assesses each component separately: tidal prediction error, swell effect (swell/heave), density difference and survey reliability (CATZOC on the ENC) cannot be neglected.
UMS (E0) sınıflı gemilerde makine daires: On UMS (E0) class ships, the engine room is unattended at night with no watch kept; the duty engineer is responsible via the call system. In this case the night order covers the duty engineer's rounds discipline, alarm response times and confirmation that the UMS conditions are met.
UMS hazırlığı, \"yokluğunda makineye bir: UMS preparation is a professional assurance that "nothing will happen to the machinery in your absence". This assurance only becomes real through checks carried out in full before every unmanned period; a single skipped step can turn the night into an emergency.
UMS moduna geçmeden önce tüm kritik alar: Before changing over to UMS mode, the transfer of all critical alarms is verified.
UMS modunda dahi günde en az bir kez (ge: Even in UMS mode, a detailed engine room round is made at least once a day (usually in the morning). The dead man alarm system raises an alarm if a person working alone in the engine room does not reset it at set intervals; this saves lives in the event of unconsciousness or an accident.
UMS notasyonu için otomasyon sisteminin: For the UMS notation, the automation system must not put the engine room at risk through a single failure. The ETO periodically tests the redundant power supply (dual supply), the redundant network (ring topology, automatic path switching) and hot-standby PLC/server configurations. It is critical to verify that the standby system actually takes over; a "silent standby failure" is the most dangerous situation.
UMS sınıflandırması, makine dairesinin g: For the engine room to be left unmanned on the night watch, the UMS class notation requires the AMS to meet certain requirements. Alarms must be transferred to the bridge and the engineers' cabins, there must be a dead-man alarm system and all critical parameters must be monitored.
UMS'te \"duty engineer\" rotasyonu kurul: Under UMS, a "duty engineer" rotation is set up; the engineer on duty is always reachable, keeps the alarm panel/pager at hand and checks the engine room on periodic rounds. The validity of UMS depends on all safety alarms and standby systems being in working order.
UMS, \"makineye bakılmıyor\" demek değil: UMS does not mean "nobody is looking after the machinery"; it means "reliable automation + a duty engineer on call, instead of constant manning". The price of this trust is disciplined preparation before every unmanned period.
UMS, makine dairesinin belirli periyotla: UMS means that class and the flag State have approved unattended operation of the engine room for certain periods (especially at night); the class notation is often "E0". Approval requires adequate automatic control, a comprehensive alarm system, automatic fire detection, transfer of alarms to the bridge and a duty engineer who can be reached quickly.
UMS/E0 notasyonu, makine dairesinin gece: The UMS/E0 notation allows the engine room to operate unattended at night or for specified periods. This depends on the high reliability of the automation and alarm system: the bridge alarm transfer, the engineers' call system, the dead-man alarm (watchkeeping engineer function), fire detection and the bilge alarm systems must work flawlessly.
UPS bakımı veya batarya değişimi için yü: For UPS maintenance or battery replacement, the UPS must be transferred to static/manual bypass without interrupting the load. The ETO follows the correct sequence: first transfer the load to static bypass, then close the maintenance (manual) bypass switch and isolate the UPS. A wrong sequence can cause a momentary loss of power to the load.
UPS bataryaları (genellikle VRLA tip) za: UPS batteries (usually VRLA type) lose capacity over time; the ETO verifies the actual autonomy time with a periodic discharge test. The terminal voltage, internal resistance (impedance test) and temperature of the battery blocks are measured; a single weak cell degrades the performance of the whole string. Blocks whose internal resistance rises 25-50% above the reference value are replaced.
UPS inverter'ı, DC bataryayı temiz AC'ye: The UPS inverter converts the DC battery supply into clean AC; the ETO checks the inverter output waveform, the output voltage/frequency and the cooling fans. A blocked fan or dusty cooling ducts cause overheating and loss of capacitor life. DC bus capacitors and filter elements are checked periodically.
USB bellekler ve harici diskler, OT sist: USB sticks and external drives are the most common route by which malware enters OT systems; ECDIS chart update media and service technicians' laptops are particularly risky. The ETO restricts the use of portable media by policy: only approved, scanned media, only on the systems that need it, and with a record kept.
USCG, kendi sularında 46 CFR Part 16 (ch: In its own waters the USCG inspects D&A programmes under 46 CFR Part 16 (chemical testing) and 33 CFR Part 95 (alcohol), and when necessary boards the ship to examine the testing and the programme. On US-flagged ships or ships operating in US waters, the marine employer's programme, its random testing rates and its records can be decisive. In a USCG inspection, gaps in the programme records can result in a serious finding and operational control.
UTC; GNSS alıcılarından, radyo zaman sin: UTC is obtained from GNSS receivers, radio time signals (listed in ALRS Vol. 2) and internet time services. Although GPS is the primary source, the Second Officer keeps up the habit of cross-checking with a backup source; dependence on a single source puts time integrity at risk if that source fails.
UTI cihazı tek ölçümde ullage, sıcaklık: A UTI gives the ullage, temperature and oil/water interface in one measurement; the volume is corrected for temperature and the free water under the cargo is found. An accurate temperature is the basis of the commercial volume calculation (custody transfer).
UV arıtma: Ultraviolet ışınlarla organiz: UV treatment: inactivates organisms with ultraviolet light.
UV sterilizator ve mineral dozaj: içme s: UV steriliser and mineral dosing: for drinking water quality.
Ultrasonic test: Daha güvenilir bir yönt: Ultrasonic test: a more reliable method in which the tightness of the packing is measured with an ultrasonic transmitter inside the hold and a receiver outside.
Ultrasonik (ses) sızdırmazlık testinde a: In the ultrasonic tightness test, a transmitter placed inside the hold emits sound and a receiver outside is moved along the line of the packing. If the sound leakage raises the measured level (% or dB) above a set threshold, there is a tightness defect at that point. It can be applied even with cargo on board.
Uluslararası Tarih Hattı (IDL), yaklaşık: The International Date Line (IDL) roughly follows the 180° meridian and is the date boundary between the eastern and western hemispheres. The time differences that build up going east and west from Greenwich reach exactly 24 hours at 180°; for this reason the date is changed by one day when the line is crossed. When crossing from west to east (sailing eastbound, W to E), the date is put back one day (the same date is lived twice); when crossing from east to west (sailing westbound, E to W), the date is advanced one day (a day is skipped).
Uluslararası kıyı bağlantısı, gemi yangı: The international shore connection is a standard flange that allows the ship's fire main to receive water from the shore or from another ship. Its dimensions are an international standard; every ship carries one and its location is known. If the ship's pumps fail, it allows supply from shore or from another ship.
Uluslararası sözleşme ve kod asgari çerç: International conventions and codes set the minimum framework. The flag State, class, type approval, the approved ship plans, the manufacturer's manual and the company SMS determine the detail to be applied on the actual ship.
Un, pirinç, makarna, baklagil gibi kuru: Grain insects and moths can breed in dry stores such as flour, rice, pasta and pulses; a warm, humid store speeds up this breeding. Prevention consists of cool/dry storage, FIFO rotation, closed/labeled containers and regular inspection. An infested batch (containing live/dead insects, webbing, larvae) is destroyed; to prevent cross-infestation, neighboring products are checked and the store is cleaned.
Underwater hull için anti-fouling sistem: For the underwater hull, the anti-fouling system (usually applied in drydock): anti-corrosion epoxy + tie coat + self-polishing copolymer (SPC) anti-fouling. The exterior of the accommodation is painted with an enamel finish; intumescent (fire-retardant) paint is used in interior spaces.
Uniflow scavenging: Hava alttan girer, e: Uniflow scavenging: the air enters at the bottom and the exhaust leaves through the exhaust valve at the top. It is the standard method on modern two-stroke engines.
Universal Time Coordinated (UTC), modern: Universal Time Coordinated (UTC) is the basis of all international time reference in modern seafaring and in practice is considered equivalent to Greenwich Mean Time (GMT). UTC is based on atomic clocks and is a continuous, fixed reference; wherever the ship is, UTC does not change. When managing clock changes, the Second Officer works on one golden rule: although ship's time (zone time) changes many times during the voyage, the UTC reference never moves.
Usta Gemici'nin köprüüstü vardiyasındaki: The AB's value on the bridge watch comes from disciplined lookout and error-free helmsmanship, which stay invisible "when nothing happens" but are the ship's first line of defense "when a target becomes a danger". A correctly reported bearing, a small helm action taken in time, dark adaptation preserved at night: each of these can prevent a collision. Lookout and helmsman duty may look routine, but it is the most basic safety-of-life duty in seafaring.
Usta gemici belirli aralıklarla pozisyon: At set intervals, the AB checks the position (bridge display/transits/landmarks), the weather and sea state, the surrounding traffic and the tension/lead of the anchor cable, and reports to the bridge. Any abnormality (position shifting, sudden jerking of the cable, an approaching ship) is reported immediately.
Usta gemici, düzenli kontrollerini ve he: The AB reports their regular checks and every abnormality clearly to the bridge. In an emergency (dragging, a parted line, fire, an approaching danger), they raise the alarm. Accurate and timely reporting determines the whole value of the watch.
Uyarılar; söndürülen fenerler, sürüklene: Warnings report temporary/urgent dangers such as extinguished lights, drifting buoys, wrecks, military training areas, seismic survey ships and ice. This information may not yet have been included in the NtM or the ENC updates; for this reason it may need to be entered manually on the chart/ECDIS.
Uydu hub'ı, beam tahsisi veya hesap soru: Problems with the satellite hub, beam allocation or the service subscription are outside the ship's control; in these cases the ETO works in coordination with the service provider. The ETO clearly reports the signal values, logs and the steps taken; this speeds up remote diagnosis. If necessary, the modem configuration is updated together with remote support.
Uygulama sonrası alarm, controller switc: After the work, alarms, controller switchover, PRS and sensor inputs, thruster commands and the consequence analysis are tested. The version, parameters, test results and changed operating limits are documented and the team is given familiarisation.
Uygulama yöntemi fırça, rulo veya airles: The application method may be brush, roller or airless spray. Brushes are used for corners, welds and tight areas, rollers for wide flat surfaces, and spray for large areas and fast application. Spraying carries the risk of overspray and solvent vapor; the wind direction is taken into account and surrounding equipment is protected.
Uygunsuzluk (NC), SMS'in bir gerekliliği: A non-conformity (NC) is an observed situation in which a requirement of the SMS has not been met (e.g. a missing drill record). A major non-conformity is a serious finding that poses a serious threat to safety or the environment, points to a systematic failure, or arises from several minor NCs together (e.g. emergency equipment not working, a critical procedure never being applied). A major NC directly endangers the validity of the DOC or SMC.
Uyum, IAPP sertifikası, BDN kayıtları, y: Compliance is demonstrated by the IAPP certificate, the BDN records, fuel samples and (if a scrubber is used) the monitoring and recording systems. The fuel changeover must be completed and recorded before entering an ECA.
Uyumlu yakıt temin edilemediğinde, gemi: When compliant fuel cannot be obtained, the ship submits a FONAR documenting that it has made its best efforts. A FONAR is not an exemption but a declaration; it is notified to the relevant authority and the flag State and is subject to inspection.
Uyumsuz gemiler motor güç sınırlama (EPL: Ships that do not comply achieve compliance by engine power limitation (EPL/ShaPoLi) or other technical measures.
Uyumsuz yakıtların karışması, asfalten ç: Mixing incompatible fuels can lead to asphaltene precipitation and filter/separator clogging; this creates a risk of loss of power inside the ECA. The Chief Engineer selects compatible fuels where possible and monitors the filter differential pressure during the changeover.
Uyumsuzluk (non-compliance), gemi tutmay: Non-compliance leads to detention of the ship, heavy fines and problems with the charterer. Therefore correct timing and recording of the changeover is a primary duty of the Chief Engineer.
Uyuşturucu testi gemide multi-panel idra: On board, the drug test starts with a multi-panel urine test kit (presumptive screen). The kit shows the presence of substances above certain cut-off values. A sample that gives a presumptive positive is sealed on the split-sample principle and confirmed by GC-MS or LC-MS/MS in an accredited laboratory. Only a result confirmed by the laboratory ("confirmed positive") is accepted as a definite positive.
Uyuşturucu veya alkol etkisindeki bir ki: A person under the influence of drugs or alcohol loses attention, judgment and reflexes and becomes a time bomb in terms of safety. This is why ships generally apply a zero-tolerance D&A policy. As the person who applies this policy in practice, the Third Officer protects safety.
Uzun bakım vardiyaları, gece çalışmaları: Long periods of maintenance work, night work and busy port stays increase fatigue. Most human-factor accidents arise from the four factors of "haste, carelessness, habit blindness and fatigue". Safety culture is the discipline of "doing it right and safely" in the face of pressure to "finish quickly".
Uzun beklemelerde hava değişiminde sürük: During long waits the risk of dragging increases when the weather changes; monitoring is not relaxed.
Uzun bir okyanus geçişinde gemi birden ç: On a long ocean passage the ship crosses several time zones; for example, a ship crossing the Atlantic westbound may build up a total difference of 5–6 hours. Applying this difference all at once seriously disrupts both the watch routine and rest. The Second Officer spreads the total difference over the days of the voyage and plans a change of no more than one hour per day.
Uzun okyanus geçişlerinde taze meyve/seb: On long ocean passages, the intake of vitamin C and other micronutrients falls as fresh fruit/vegetables run out; this is why seafarers historically suffered from scurvy. As fresh produce runs out, the cook conserves the sources of vitamin C: citrus juices, sauerkraut, frozen vegetables and, when necessary, supplements/fruit juice concentrate are brought into use. Red meat, pulses, dairy products and whole grains are kept on the menu as sources of minerals (Fe, calcium) and B-group vitamins.
Uzun okyanus geçişlerinde taze ürün tüke: On long ocean passages, micronutrient intake falls as fresh produce runs out; this is why the cook plans deficiency prevention from the start. Frozen vegetables/fruit (which retain most of their vitamins), citrus juices and, when necessary, supplements are brought in when fresh produce runs out.
Uzun seferde mikro besin sürekliliği (öz: On long voyages, a continuous supply of micronutrients (especially vitamin C) is maintained; as fresh produce runs out, frozen vegetables/fruit, citrus juices and supplements are brought in. This protects general health and prevents the fatigue/weakness that can appear toward the end of a long voyage (details in the nutrition/budget task).
Uzun seferlerde tekrar (menu fatigue) mo: On long voyages, repetition (menu fatigue) lowers morale; the cook keeps variety alive by adding theme days (national cuisine day, barbecue/grill day, a street-food-themed meal). These small variations make the cyclic menu unpredictable and enjoyable. Activities such as a barbecue on deck in good weather refresh both the menu and social life on board.
Uzun şaft hatlarında şaftın kendi ağırlı: On long shaft lines it prevents the shaft from sagging under its own weight and vibrating. White metal plain bearings are used.
V/34-1 maddesi ise kaptanın seyir emniye: Regulation V/34-1 clearly provides that the Master's decisions on safe navigation are based on "professional judgement" and that no company, charterer or third party may act in a way that prevents such decisions. In practice, this provision is referred to as "overriding authority", which is also emphasized in ISM Code section 5.2. ISM internal audits look for concrete evidence that the company does not obstruct the Master's exercise of this authority.
V/f kontrolünde gerilim-frekans oranı sa: In V/f control the voltage-to-frequency ratio is kept constant, giving constant flux (and therefore constant torque) over the whole speed range.
V/f oranı sabit tutularak motor manyetik: By keeping the V/f ratio constant, the motor's magnetic flux and torque characteristic are maintained.
VDR (Voyage Data Recorder), kazaların \": The VDR (Voyage Data Recorder) is the "black box" for accidents; it records bridge audio, radar images, sensor data and radio communications. The ETO verifies that all VDR data channels are being recorded and that the final recording medium (capsule) and the float-free unit are working. The Annual Performance Test (APT) is carried out and certified by an authorized service provider.
VDR son belirli süreyi (kapsülde tipik e: The VDR keeps the most recent period (typically at least 48 hours in the capsule, longer in internal memory under modern standards), continuously overwriting it (loop). After an accident or significant event this loop must be stopped and the data preserved (save/lock); otherwise it is overwritten.
VDR yılda bir APT (Annual Performance Te: The VDR is tested once a year by an authorised service in the APT (Annual Performance Test) and a certificate of compliance is issued. After an accident, the Master must stop the recording to prevent the data being overwritten, preserve the data and hand it over to the authorities.
VDR/S-VDR, kaza sonrası delil için kriti: The VDR/S-VDR is a critical "black box" for evidence after an accident. The Second Officer monitors that the VDR records all channels (bridge audio, VHF, radar image, sensor data), that the APT (Annual Performance Test) certificate is valid and that the capsule battery is in order. After an incident, the recording must be preserved before it is overwritten.
VDR; köprü sesi (mikrofonlar), VHF haber: The VDR records, with time stamps, bridge audio (microphones), VHF communications, the radar/ECDIS picture, position, speed and heading, depth, helm and engine orders, alarms, wind and other sensors. This multi-source record allows the moment of an accident to be reconstructed.
VFD beslemeli motorlarda yüksek frekansl: In VFD-fed motors, high-frequency common-mode voltage creates a parasitic current between shaft and earth (bearing current) and causes fluting damage on the bearing surfaces. On these motors, the ETO checks that a shaft grounding ring or insulated bearings are fitted and in good condition.
VFD üç ana bölümden oluşur: doğrultucu (: A VFD consists of three main parts: the rectifier (AC→DC), the DC link (filter) and the inverter (DC→AC). The inverter uses IGBT switches to produce an AC output at the required frequency and amplitude.
VFD üç ana katmandan oluşur: doğrultucu: A VFD consists of three main stages: the rectifier converts AC to DC, the DC bus capacitor bank smooths/stores this DC, and the inverter (IGBT) produces AC at the required frequency and voltage by PWM. Motor speed is set in proportion to frequency (n = 120f/p). The motor magnetic flux is maintained by keeping the V/f ratio constant.
VFD'ler harmonik akım üretir ve bu, şebe: VFDs generate harmonic currents, which affect the power quality of the network. On large VFDs, the ETO must know the harmonic mitigation measures (line reactor, 12/18-pulse rectifier, active front end) and must check the filter elements. In addition, the high dV/dt at the VFD output can stress the motor insulation and the bearings (bearing current); an output reactor or a dV/dt filter is used.
VFD'ler önemli ölçüde ısı üretir; soğutm: VFDs generate considerable heat; clean cooling fans and heat sinks are critical for service life. The ETO periodically checks that the cooling fans are turning, that the air inlet filters are clean and that there is no dust/salt build-up on the heat sink. Blocked cooling raises IGBT and capacitor temperatures and leads to early failure.
