VFD'ler şebekeye harmonik akımlar üretir: VFDs inject harmonic currents into the network. The 5th, 7th, 11th and 13th harmonics are the most common. Harmonics can cause overheating in transformers, nuisance tripping of circuit breakers and interference in sensitive equipment.
VFD'ler, doğrultucular ve UPS'ler gibi n: Non-linear loads such as VFDs, rectifiers and UPSs generate harmonic currents; these lead to voltage distortion (THD), heating of transformers and cables, overloading of the neutral and nuisance tripping of relays. The ETO measures THD with a power quality analyzer (voltage THD limit typically 5–8%) and, if necessary, recommends a harmonic filter or line reactor.
VFD'nin doğru çalışması, doğru parametre: Correct operation of a VFD depends on the correct parameter set: motor nameplate values (voltage, current, frequency, power), ramp-up/down times, current/torque limits, minimum/maximum frequency and protection settings. The ETO records the parameters at commissioning and backs them up regularly; when a board is replaced after a failure, this backup allows rapid restoration.
VHF DSC controller, her gün dahili self-: The VHF DSC controller is checked every day with the built-in self-test (internal test). This test checks the transmit/receive modules of the equipment without an actual transmission and shows the result on the display/in the log. The Second Officer carries out the test and records the result in the GMDSS Radio Log with the date/time (UTC).
VHF DSC test call ise başka bir gemiye v: A VHF DSC test call can be made to another ship or to a coast station. The Second Officer enters the date/time of the test call, the station called and the result (ACK received/not received) in the GMDSS Radio Log. If no ACK is received, the fault is investigated and reported to the technical service.
VHF deniz bandı belirli kanallara ayrılm: The VHF maritime band is divided into specific channels. Channel 16 (156.8 MHz) is the distress, safety and calling channel; a continuous watch is kept on it. Channel 70 is for DSC (not used for voice). Channel 13 is for bridge-to-bridge (safety of navigation), channel 06 for ship-to-ship, and the other channels for port/VTS and general communications.
VHF görüş hattı (line of sight) ile çalı: VHF works by line of sight; the range depends on the antenna height. A higher antenna gives a longer range. The antenna position is chosen taking into account shadowing and interference with other antennas. A damaged antenna or coaxial cable seriously reduces the range.
VHF communications: audio of the main radio.
VHF/MF/HF DSC günlük/haftalık test edili: VHF/MF/HF DSC is tested daily and weekly; the EPIRB and SART are checked periodically (the EPIRB battery and HRU expiry dates are followed). The accuracy of the AIS static and dynamic data is checked.
VIT (Variable Injection Timing): Yük dur: VIT (Variable Injection Timing): the injection timing is changed according to the load. Early injection at low loads and late injection at high loads give optimum combustion.
VLSFO'lar 2020 sonrası market'e girmiş \: VLSFOs are "blend" fuels that entered the market after 2020; they are more sensitive than conventional HFO in terms of stability (sediment), compatibility (incompatibility/asphaltene precipitation) and cold flow properties (high pour point). Commingling different VLSFO batches can lead to asphaltene precipitation and filter clogging; a compatibility test (spot test ASTM D4740) is therefore recommended.
VLSFO, farklı rafineri ürünlerinin karış: VLSFO is produced by blending different refinery products. Its properties can therefore vary from one producer to another.
VPQ (Vessel Particulars Questionnaire) v: The VPQ (Vessel Particulars Questionnaire) and HVPQ are kept up to date; a self-assessment is made against the SIRE 2.0 chapters. Previous PSC and SIRE findings must have been closed out with evidence.
VR return line, vapour coupling ile bağl: The vapour return line is connected with a vapour coupling, bonding is provided and a flame arrester is fitted in the line. The flame arrester prevents a flashback from shore to ship.
VSAT bir konfor/operasyonel sistem olsa: Although VSAT is a comfort/operational system, GMDSS (safety of life communications) is a separate, mandatory and class-approved system. The ETO ensures that VSAT maintenance does not affect GMDSS; formal maintenance of GMDSS equipment is usually the responsibility of the radio operator/a certified service, but the ETO provides support with the power supply and antenna infrastructure. The boundaries between the two systems are kept clear.
VSAT kesildiğinde, gemi alternatif bağla: When the VSAT link is lost, the ship switches to an alternative link: Inmarsat FleetBroadband (L-band, resistant to rain fade but low speed), GSM/4G in port and MF/HF in an emergency. The ETO manages the automatic failover (least-cost routing) configuration and knows the manual changeover procedure; keeping critical operational traffic uninterrupted is the priority.
VSAT sistemi; stabilize bir anten (ADE -: A VSAT system consists of a stabilized antenna (ADE - Above Deck Equipment), cabling, a modem (BDE - Below Deck Equipment), a router and switches connecting to the ship's network. The satellite link uses Ku-band or Ka-band; Ka-band offers higher speeds but is more susceptible to rain fade. The ETO knows the band in use, the hub/teleport and the service plan.
VSAT ve ağ yönetimi, ETO'nun rolünü gele: VSAT and network management is the area that extends the ETO's role from traditional electrical work to modern IT/cyber security. Success is measured by uninterrupted operational connectivity, a ship network whose confidentiality and integrity are protected, and robust segmentation that limits the impact of a cyber incident. By keeping this invisible infrastructure healthy, the ETO safeguards both the ship's link with the world and the security of critical control systems.
Valf bakımında disc/seat lapping (alıştı: Valve maintenance includes disc/seat lapping, renewal of spindle/gland packing and a tightness test. Lapping is a grinding-in process carried out with lapping paste; it restores the contact surface between the disc and the seat. The cadet learns this manual skill by observing and assisting.
Valfler genelde yay veya pnömatik/hidrol: The valves are usually closed by a spring or pneumatic/hydraulic mechanism, operated by a lever or button at a remote position. The cadet learns which tanks have quick-closing valves, where the remote closing position is and how the fuel supply is cut off after closing. Periodic testing of these valves (do they actually close?) is important.
Vapour line patlayıcı karışım taşır; fla: The vapour line carries a flammable mixture; the flame arrester and pressure management are critical. The rate must not exceed the capacity of the vapour return line.
Vardiya devir tesliminde açık işler, izl: At watch handover, open jobs, abnormalities being monitored and temporary arrangements (temporary repairs) are handed over in writing; this continuity ensures that performance management does not depend on one individual.
Vardiya devri, EOOW'lar arasında yapılan: The watch handover is a formal transfer of information between EOOWs. By following this process closely, the cadet learns which information is critical: the status of running machinery, maintenance work in progress, isolated equipment (under LOTO), tank levels, transfers in progress (fuel, ballast, bilge) and outstanding alarms.
Vardiya devri, devralan zabit durumu tam: The watch handover is not complete until the relieving officer has fully assessed the situation and accepted the duty. The officer being relieved gives clear information on the ship's position, course and speed, the surrounding traffic and plotting status, the critical points ahead in the passage plan, the Master's special instructions, the weather and any maneuvers in progress. An officer does not take over the watch while a maneuver is in progress or before their eyes have adapted to the dark.
Vardiya devrinde devreden zabit, saat de: At the watch handover, the officer being relieved has the relieving officer confirm whether the clock change has been made and what the new ship's time is. A clock change that is missed or applied twice (e.g. two watchkeepers both making the same change) corrupts both the time record and the rest-hour calculation; for this reason, at handover there must be a single, clear verification that the change has been applied.
Vardiya devrinde hava durumu, beklenen d: At the watch handover, the weather situation, expected changes and the criteria for calling the Master are passed on. If weather information stays in one person's head, the risk is missed when that person is not on watch.
Vardiya devrinde plan, mevcut pozisyon,: At the watch handover, the plan, the current position, the critical points ahead and any special instructions are passed on clearly. An incomplete handover can break the monitoring chain and lead to an accident.
Vardiya değişiminde, görevi devralan AB: At the change of watch, the AB taking over comes to the bridge fit for duty (awake, with night vision adapted). The relieving helmsman takes over and confirms the present course, the steering mode (auto/hand), the compass status and the OOW's special instructions. The handover is not carried out while the ship is maneuvering or during a critical passage; it is postponed to a suitable moment.
Vardiya mühendisi olası blackout senaryo: The watch engineer is prepared for a possible blackout: whether the emergency generator starts automatically, whether there is enough starting air for a dead-ship start, and the restart procedure after a main engine emergency stop are all known. During maneuvering or in restricted waters, a second generator is put on line to provide redundancy.
Vardiya sırasında kompresör emiş/basma b: During the watch, compressor suction/discharge pressures, condenser and evaporator temperatures, compressor oil pressure and room temperatures are read and recorded. A deviation from normal is often the first sign of a problem: low suction pressure may mean a shortage of refrigerant/a restriction; high discharge pressure may mean a condenser problem/air in the system.
Vardiya teslimi yapılandırılmış olmalıdı: The watch handover must be structured: the condition of the machinery, equipment running/on standby, ongoing maintenance/bypasses, alarms and temporary arrangements, fuel/oil status, bilge level, expected operations (maneuvering, bunkering) and instructions from the bridge are handed over. The relieving engineer does not take over the watch without physically verifying the condition of the equipment.
Vardiya verileri makine logbook'una (eng: Watch data are recorded in the engine room logbook (engine room log) at regular intervals: main engine rpm/load, generator loads, temperature and pressure readings, fuel/oil consumption, tank levels and notable events. These records are official evidence both for operational monitoring and for PSC/class/insurance inspections.
Vardiya zabiti aynı anda hem seyir sorum: The officer of the watch carries the navigational responsibility and other duties on board (GMDSS listening watch, responding to alarms) at the same time; however, no additional duty may take precedence over the lookout and safe navigation duties. Fatigue management (STCW rest hours) is therefore an integral part of watch safety.
Vardiya zabiti, ağır havada pozisyon doğ: In heavy weather, the officer of the watch verifies the position continuously; set & drift (deviation caused by current and wind) increases and leeway grows. Near land/shoals this deviation can be dangerous.
Vardiya zabiti, gözcülüğü ekran başında: The officer of the watch must keep the lookout without letting their attention be absorbed by the screens. In many accidents, the officer becoming absorbed in the radar or ECDIS display and failing to look out of the window (single-point fixation) has been identified as a root cause. Good lookout means continuously comparing the visual scan outside with the instrument data.
Vardiya zabiti, pilotaj boyunca geminin: During pilotage the officer of the watch independently monitors the ship's position (position, speed, rate of turn, UKC) and reports any deviation from the plan to the Master. Helm and engine orders given by the pilot are repeated back (closed loop) and their execution is confirmed. The team supports the pilot not with "blind trust" but with active monitoring.
Vardiya çizelgesi makine kontrol odası v: The watch bill is posted in the engine control room and in a common area, where everyone can read it. Changes are entered with signature/approval. The Second Engineer makes sure that every person knows their own watch, their responsibilities and their emergency duty (consistent with the muster list).
Vardiyalı düzen nedeniyle herkes aynı an: Because of the watch system, not everyone comes to eat at the same time. For watchkeepers who come late, the steward ensures that food is kept hot/suitable or is plated and stored. The night meal arrangement is decisive for the morale of those working at night.
Vardiyayı devralan Üçüncü/Dördüncü Mühen: The Third/Fourth Engineer taking over the watch does not accept the watch on arrival in the engine control room (ECR) without first making a round. The outgoing engineer verbally hands over the main engine load and speed (rpm), the generators put on or taken off load, the service tank levels, the running pump configuration, the status of standby equipment and the alarms/events of the last 4 hours.
Variation (iğne sapması) coğrafi konuma: Variation depends on the geographical position and is read from the chart. It has an annual change.
Varışta ana makine soğutma süresi beklen: On arrival, the main engine cooling-down time is allowed, the necessary isolations are made, the shore connection is prepared and the harbour generator configuration is set.
Vektör kontrol (FOC) ve Direct Torque Co: Advanced algorithms such as vector control (FOC) and Direct Torque Control (DTC) give more precise speed and torque control.
Vented (sulu) kurşun-asit bataryalarda ş: In vented (flooded) lead-acid batteries, water is electrolyzed during charging and the level drops. The ETO checks the electrolyte level periodically and adds only pure (deionized/distilled) water; acid is never added. Specific gravity (SG) is measured with a hydrometer: a fully charged cell reads ~1.270–1.280 and a discharged cell around ~1.120. SG is a direct indicator of the state of charge.
Veri kalitesi, CII hesabının ve dolayısı: Data quality determines the accuracy of the CII calculation and therefore of the rating. The noon report, bunker records and DCS data must be consistent with each other; inconsistency causes problems at verification.
Veriler bayrak devletine sunulur ve IMO: The data is submitted to the flag state and published in anonymised form in the IMO GISIS database.
Veriler, yangın ve derin basınç/çarpmaya: The data is stored in a protective recording medium (protective capsule) resistant to fire, deep-water pressure and impact. Modern VDRs have both a fixed capsule (recovered if the ship sinks) and a float-free capsule (which floats to the surface and transmits a signal like an EPIRB). The float-free capsule makes it easier to recover data from a sunken ship.
Vetting başarısı charterer'ın gemiyi kab: Successful vetting is critical for the charterer's acceptance of the ship; a failed vetting can leave the ship without charters. This is why vetting preparation is among the highest-priority tasks on tankers.
Vetting ise ticari bir kabul sürecidir;: Vetting, by contrast, is a commercial acceptance process: a charterer or cargo owner (e.g. the major oil companies that are OCIMF members, or RightShip in dry bulk) carries out a risk assessment before chartering the ship. Vetting has no legal enforcement power, but its commercial sanction is very harsh: a negative SIRE report or a low RightShip score can exclude the ship from a whole commercial segment. The practical consequence for the Master: in PSC the aim is "to avoid detention"; in vetting the aim is "to keep the ship charterable at all times".
Vidalı (screw), dişli (gear) ve pistonlu: For screw, gear and piston pumps (fuel, lubrication, hydraulic), clearance and wear checks follow different criteria. In fuel transfer and booster pumps, pressure drops as internal clearances increase; the suction/discharge valves and the safety valve are checked. For bilge pumps, priming capability (removing air from the suction) and check valve tightness are important.
Vinç arızası geared gemide yük operasyon: On a geared ship a crane failure stops cargo operations and causes demurrage.
On a geared ship a crane failure stops cargo operations.
Vinç ve fren bakımı bağlama emniyetinin: Maintenance of the winches and brakes is the foundation of mooring safety.
Vinç ve winch gibi kalemlerde running ho: For items such as cranes and winches, the running hours counter is the maintenance trigger. Condition-based monitoring, on the other hand, is done by counting broken wires in wire ropes, checking fiber ropes for abrasion/UV degradation, analyzing hydraulic oil for contamination and measuring corrosion of hatch cover plating. By entering these observations in the PMS, the Chief Officer enables early action.
Vinç üç temel hareketi yapar: hoisting (: A crane makes three basic movements: hoisting (lifting and lowering), luffing (boom angle) and slewing (rotation). Each movement is driven by a hydraulic cylinder or motor and controlled proportionally with a joystick.
Vinçle indirme/kaldırmada halat, troley: When lowering or hoisting with the winch, it is verified that the hoisting rope, trolley and brakes are working properly; the ladder must never be moved while anyone is on it. When the accommodation ladder and the pilot ladder are used together in a combination arrangement, the safety of the transfer point is particularly important.
Vinçte SWL sabit değildir; yarıçap arttı: A crane's SWL is not fixed; as the radius increases, the permitted load decreases so that the load moment (load × radius) stays constant. The operator must comply with the load chart; an overload is stopped by the overload cut-out.
Vira sırasında ırgat zinciri toplar; köp: While heaving up, the windlass heaves in the chain; communication between the bridge and the forecastle about how the chain is leading and its weight (up and down) is critical. If the anchor starts to drag, the windlass must not be strained; engine assistance should be requested if necessary. When the anchor is aweigh, this is reported, and the anchor is washed down and heaved home into the hawse pipe.
Viscometer periyodik kalibre edilir ve f: The viscometer is calibrated periodically and its filter cleaned; the viscosity control loop is verified together with the fuel heater.
Viscotherm, HFO'da yakıtı ısıtırken; düş: While the viscotherm heats the fuel on HFO, it provides cooling if necessary on low-viscosity distillate. The Chief Engineer manages the viscosity control mode (heating vs. cooling) correctly during the changeover.
Viskometre, yakıt hattındaki viskoziteyi: The viscometer measures the viscosity in the fuel line continuously and controls the heater automatically.
Viskozite (ASTM D445); yağın taşıma kapa: Viscosity (ASTM D445) is an indicator of the oil's load-carrying capacity. An increase generally indicates oxidation, soot or heavy fuel contamination; a decrease indicates distillate/fuel dilution. The maker typically gives a deviation limit of ±10-20% from the initial value.
Viskozite kontrol sistemi (viscotherm) h: The viscosity control system (viscotherm) adjusts the heater according to fuel viscosity; a sensor/control fault causes overheating or insufficient heating. On electric heaters, there is a risk of dry heating at low fuel flow; the low-flow protection is tested.
Viskozite ve density (yoğunluk) ölçümü,: Viscosity and density measurements are key parameters for fuel quality and separator setting. Density affects the separator's density setting (and, in older separators, gravity disc selection); with very high-density fuels, water separation becomes difficult. Viscosity is the basis of heating/atomization control.
Viskozite çok yüksek kalırsa püskürtme k: If the viscosity stays too high, atomisation becomes coarse and late combustion and soot result; if it is too low, the pump elements lose lubrication and leakage increases. With distillate fuels a cooler may be needed to avoid going below the lower viscosity limit.
Voltaj yokluğu, onaylı bir HV voltaj ded: The absence of voltage is verified with an approved HV voltage detector; the detector is tested on a known live source before and after use (prove-test-prove). A busbar that is "apparently dead" is never earthed or touched; it is always verified first.
Voluntary speed reduction, sadece hava d: Voluntary speed reduction is assessed not only for weather but also for structural fatigue (slamming, green water) and fuel efficiency. In the CII/EEXI era, a lower speed can be an advantage for both safety and the environment, but weather safety always comes first.
Voyage abstract ve performans raporları,: Voyage abstracts and performance reports are used to check the charter party speed/consumption warranty. In off-hire or speed claim cases, these records are legal evidence; accuracy is vital.
Voyage charter'da (örn. GENCON) armatör: Under a voyage charter (e.g. GENCON) the shipowner charters the ship to carry a certain cargo from A to B; the commercial management remains largely with the shipowner. Here the Master's main contact with the charterer revolves around the NOR (Notice of Readiness), laytime and demurrage. A validly tendered NOR (the ship ready "in all respects") starts the laytime clock; an early or invalid NOR is a main subject of demurrage claims.
WLAN (kablosuz ağ), kapsama ve güvenlik: A WLAN (wireless network) requires a balance between coverage and security. The ETO applies strong encryption (WPA2/WPA3), strong passwords, hidden/separate SSIDs and guest network isolation. Access point firmware is kept up to date and scans are carried out for unauthorized devices/access points (rogue APs).
WMO egg code, buz haritalarında konsantr: On ice charts, the WMO egg code summarizes concentration, stage of development (thickness) and floe size. By reading this code, the Second Officer interprets the ice severity along the route and reflects it in the planning.
Wages account, allotment kayıtları ve re: Wage statements, allotment records and rest hour records are also kept under the MLC. Common MLC findings at PSC include missing SEAs, inconsistencies in wage records and rest hour violations.
Warping, gemiyi rıhtım boyunca halatlarl: Warping is moving the ship along the quay with lines, done with a capstan or a winch warping head (warping drum/gypsy head). Mooring winches are usually fitted with a warping head; a capstan is found as a separate unit on small craft and special ships.
Wash water pH/PAH/türbidite monitör edil: The pH, PAH and turbidity of the wash water are monitored; in areas where open-loop operation is restricted, the ship changes over to closed-loop mode or to compliant fuel. The EGC Record Book is kept.
Watchkeeping Certificate (Engine) ve nih: For the Watchkeeping Certificate (Engine) and the final OOW certificate, Sea Service is not enough; all competence areas under STCW Table A-III/1 must have been completed in the TRB and approved by the training engineer. Sea Service answers the question "how long", and the TRB the question "what was learned and what is the evidence"; together they make up the examination file.
Water mist / high-pressure water fog sis: Water mist / high-pressure water fog systems are more flexible than CO2 for local machinery fires (boiler front, purifier, ME) and safer for personnel. The Chief Engineer knows which system is used in which scenario.
Water mist, 70–200 bar basınçta 100 µm a: Water mist produces droplets below 100 µm at 70–200 bar; it extinguishes by displacing oxygen and by cooling through evaporation.
Water mist, suyu yüksek basınçla çok inc: Water mist breaks water into very fine droplets (microns) under high pressure; the large surface area gives fast evaporation and strong cooling, and the steam produced dilutes the oxygen locally. It uses little water (little water damage), creates a non-conductive environment and can be a people-safe alternative to CO₂.
Watertight ve fire door'ların serbest ka: Wedges, lashings and stowed items that prevent watertight and fire doors from closing freely are removed. A fire door wedged open "to let the air through" is one of the most common inspection findings and directly endangers the safety of the ship.
Wave encounter period ile geminin natura: Coincidence (resonance) of the wave encounter period with the ship's natural roll period is dangerous. The Second Officer prepares a recommendation by assessing which heading/speed combination avoids resonance for the given swell direction and period.
Waypoint, course, hız ve wheel-over nokt: Waypoints, courses, speeds and wheel-over points are defined; abort and contingency points are marked. XTD and UKC are monitored continuously during the passage.
Weardown sınıf limitine yaklaştığında, a: When weardown approaches the class limit, aft bearing renewal is planned. Accelerating weardown is usually caused by water ingress (poor lubrication) or by high load/misalignment, and the root cause is investigated.
Weather fax (HF radyofaks), sinoptik yüz: Weather fax (HF radiofacsimile) provides synoptic surface analyses, 24/48/72/96-hour forecast charts, wave (wave height/period) charts and ice charts. In addition, modern ships also use commercial weather routing services (shore-based) and GRIB-based numerical forecasts.
Weather routing servisleri (örn. AWT, WN: Weather routing services (e.g. AWT, WNI, StormGeo) provide daily route recommendations. These recommendations are not binding; the Master assesses them and accepts or rejects them. A decision to reject is always entered in the log with the reasons. If the charter party has a "follow weather routing" clause, the deviation is reported to the company and the charterer.
Weather routing servisleri, hava tahminl: Weather routing services use weather forecasts to calculate the route that gives minimum fuel consumption or minimum voyage time.
Weather routing; en kısa mesafe yerine,: Instead of the shortest distance, weather routing selects the fastest (least-time) or least-damage/least-risk route, considering weather and sea conditions. The Second Officer compares alternative routes using the ship's speed loss curve (loss of speed against waves/wind) and the ship-specific constraints.
Wet chemical sistemi periyodik olarak ye: The wet chemical system is checked periodically by an authorized service provider (nozzle blockage, pressure, fusible link integrity, agent quantity). The cook makes sure the nozzles are not blocked with grease/dirt and checks that the fusible links have the correct temperature rating and are not coated with a film of grease. After the system has been triggered, the galley is not used; all surfaces are cleaned, the system is recharged by an authorized party and the interlocks are reset.
When mooring winches operate together, t: When mooring winches operate together, the Chief Officer coordinates the stations and avoids conflicting movements and excessive line loads. Commands identify the line and action, are repeated back and are followed by completion reports. In danger, give the agreed stop command, stop the equipment safely and re-establish communication before restarting.
When using a warping drum, follow the ma: When using a warping drum, follow the manufacturer’s instructions for the rope, number of turns and tail handling. There is no universal three-or-four-turn rule. Keep hands and clothing clear, avoid riding turns and never reach into a loaded or moving line. Stop and make the equipment and line safe before clearing a problem.
When weighing anchor, report cable direc: When weighing anchor, report cable direction and load, up and down when the cable is vertical, and anchor aweigh when it is clear of the bottom. Report excessive strain or windlass difficulty immediately. The bridge coordinates vessel movement; the station must not improvise a response that overloads the gear.
While cable is paid out, report its leng: While cable is paid out, report its length, direction and observed load to the bridge. Brought up means the vessel has come to rest on its cable; it does not guarantee continued holding. The bridge verifies position and movement and maintains a watch for dragging using independent observations.
Whip ve wire antenlerde fiziksel hasar (: If physical damage (a break, a cracked insulator) is found on whip or wire antennas, it is reported and repaired immediately. An antenna fault is usually a silent danger of the "you think the alert has gone out, but it does not get through" type.
White metal (kalay/kurşun) içeriğinin ar: An increase in white metal (tin/lead) content is an early sign that the aft bearing has started to wear seriously, and it is assessed together with the weardown measurement. A simultaneous rise in water and white metal indicates a chain of seal failure + bearing damage.
Winch freni, halatın MBL'sinin altında (: The winch brake must be set to render (slip and shed load) below the MBL of the line (usually around 60% of SDBF), so that the brake slips before the line parts and the energy is released in a controlled way. Brake holding capacity is tested periodically. The Bosun knows that this setting must be correct and monitors how tightly the brake is applied.
Windlass brake holding test (rendering t: The windlass brake holding test (rendering test), hydraulic oil checks and greasing are carried out according to the PMS; the condition of the wire ropes is inspected.
Windlass freninin tutmaması demir operas: If the windlass brake does not hold, control of the anchor is lost and damage results.
Windlass kapasitesi Equipment Number (EN: Windlass capacity is determined by the Equipment Number (EN). The EN value depends on the ship's displacement, breadth, effective height from the summer load waterline to the top of the uppermost deckhouse, and lateral (profile) area.
Windlass ve mooring winch bakımında; bra: In windlass and mooring winch maintenance, brake band wear, gear oil level, the pawl mechanism and brake holding capacity (annual test) are the critical points. Compliance with SOLAS Chapter II-1 and IACS UR A2 is checked.
Windlass çalışırken AB, zincir hareketin: While the windlass is running, the AB stands clear of the moving cable and the gypsy (cable lifter) area; a parting cable, or being caught by the cable, is fatal. Goggles and ear protection are recommended against the dust, sparks and noise generated when the anchor is let go. The ship should not lie at anchor for long without the bow stopper; the whole load must not be left on the windlass brake alone.
Wing sail: Uçak kanadı profilinde rijit: Wing sail: a rigid sail with an aircraft-wing profile. Optimum thrust is obtained with automatic angle adjustment.
Wire rope'ta belirli uzunlukta izin veri: A wire rope is taken out of service when the permitted number of broken wires over a given length is exceeded, or when a kink or birdcage is found. Lubrication (greasing) and correct storage extend its service life.
Wiring/motor starter diagram ise bir mot: The wiring/motor starter diagram details the supply and control circuit of a motor: contactor, overload relay, start/stop buttons, interlocks. The cadet learns to use this diagram when finding out why a pump does not run: has the breaker tripped, has the overload tripped, has an interlock opened the circuit?
Working aloft (yüksekte çalışma) için ha: For working aloft, the requirements are a harness with double lanyard, a secondary attachment point, a cordon on the deck below, no passage permitted and suitable weather conditions. Working overside starts with a liferaft ready, MOB equipment and communication.
Working aloft/overside, permit-to-work v: Working aloft/overside requires a permit to work and a risk assessment; the weather, ship motion and risk of falling are assessed. The Bosun holds a toolbox talk, checks the PPE/harnesses and maintains supervision throughout the work.
Working overside (boya, pas raspalama, f: Working overside (painting, rust chipping, freeboard work) requires the combination harness + life jacket + ready lifebuoy with line. One person continuously watches the water surface and the worker. In port, it is verified that propellers/thrusters are not running and that no other ship is maneuvering; if necessary, "no movement" is coordinated.
Worst Case Failure Design Intent (WCFDI): The Worst Case Failure Design Intent (WCFDI) is the most severe single failure accepted in the ship's design. The thrust and power capacity that the online equipment retains in this scenario is confirmed; if the actual configuration would produce a loss greater than the WCFDI, the task is not started.
X-band (~9 GHz, 3 cm) yüksek çözünürlük: X-band (~9 GHz, 3 cm) gives high resolution and detection of small targets but is affected by rain; SARTs and racons are detected on X-band. S-band (~3 GHz, 10 cm) penetrates rain and fog better and is stable at long range. SOLAS V/19 requires ships of 3000 GT and above to have a second radar in addition to the 9 GHz radar (a 3 GHz/S-band radar or, where the Administration considers it appropriate, a second 9 GHz/X-band radar); the two radars must be able to work independently of each other.
X-band yaklaşık 9 GHz/3 cm dalga boyunda: X-band works at about 9 GHz / 3 cm wavelength; it gives high discrimination of small targets and coastal detail and triggers radar SARTs, but it can be more affected by precipitation. S-band is at about 3 GHz / 10 cm wavelength; it can give a more stable long-range picture in heavy precipitation and some sea conditions, but it does not show the classic radar SART response.
XTD (Cross Track Distance) limitleri her: XTD (Cross Track Distance) limits are set for each leg; if the ship leaves this corridor, ECDIS gives an alarm. T&P notices and temporary dangers are entered in the manual update layer.
Y-Δ yol verme yalnızca düşük yükle başla: Star-delta starting is suitable only for motors started at low load; with a high load the starting torque is insufficient.
Yakıt (FO) ve yağlama yağı (LO) purifier: Fuel oil (FO) and lubricating oil (LO) purifiers are high-speed centrifugal separators (e.g. Alfa Laval, Westfalia/GEA) used to remove water/sludge. During periodic maintenance, the bowl is dismantled, the disc stack is cleaned of sludge, and the main seal ring and operating water valves are checked. The gravity disc is selected according to the fuel density; a wrong gravity disc shifts the oil/water interface: a disc with too large a hole breaks the water seal so that oil escapes through the water outlet, while one with too small a hole impairs separation and lets water into the cleaned oil.
Yakıt 95-98°C'ye ısıtılarak viskozitesi: The fuel is heated to 95–98 °C to lower its viscosity and fed to the purifier. A low throughput increases the separation efficiency; engine makers recommend running at 60–70% of the rated capacity.
Yakıt bunker delivery note (BDN) üzerind: The appropriate disc is chosen from the maker's nomogram using the density on the bunker delivery note (BDN) and the density at the separation temperature.
Yakıt değişimi (changeover) sırasında sı: During a fuel changeover the rate of temperature change is limited; a rapid change causes pump elements to seize and leak. The changeover is completed as planned before entering an emission control area and is recorded.
Yakıt enjeksiyonu ÜÖN'den 10-20° krank a: Fuel injection starts 10–20° of crank angle before TDC. With VIT (Variable Injection Timing), the timing is advanced at low loads to maintain combustion quality.
Yakıt hazırlama sistemi, ana makine ve j: The fuel treatment system directly affects main engine and generator performance. Poorly purified fuel leads to injector clogging, liner wear and exhaust temperature imbalance. The cadet sees concretely that the output of one system determines the health of another.
Yakıt kalitesi kritiktir: spesifikasyon: Fuel quality is critical: off-specification fuel (off-spec — water, solids, cat fines, high sulfur) can cause serious damage to the engine. The cadet observes the logic of sampling, sealing and checking the BDN. Suspect fuel should not be used in the engine before the laboratory analysis (fuel testing) result has been received.
Yakıt operasyonlarında yanıcı buhar biri: Flammable vapor can accumulate during fuel operations. Throughout bunkering, the ban on naked flames/smoking is enforced, no hot work is done and ventilation is provided. Suitable fire extinguishers are kept ready around the manifold.
Yakıt pompası ve purifier emergency stop: The emergency stop buttons for the fuel pumps and purifiers are located outside the fire zone.
Yakıt pompası: Kam mili tahrikli plunger: Fuel pump: cam-driven plunger type. The helix on the plunger controls the quantity of fuel.
Yakıt sistemi, ham bunker yakıtını depol: The fuel system stores, heats and cleans (separator) the raw bunker fuel and delivers it to the engine at the correct viscosity/temperature. The lubrication system lubricates, cools and cleans moving parts and prevents wear. Both must operate continuously, cleanly and to the correct specification; otherwise the engine may stop or suffer serious damage.
Yakıt tanklarının seviyesi, sıcaklığı ve: The levels and temperatures of the fuel tanks and leaks in the heating steam lines are monitored regularly; water passing from a steam coil into a tank both spoils combustion and increases the load on the separators.
Yakıt tasarrufu kaynakları: hull & prope: Sources of fuel savings: hull & propeller cleaning (fouling causes a 3-8% loss), trim optimization (2-5%), slow steaming, weather routing, automatic combustion tuning and waste heat recovery. The Chief Engineer assesses the technical feasibility of these measures and implements them under the SEEMP.
Yakıt tüketimi flowmeter (varsa) ve tank: Fuel consumption is cross-checked using the flowmeter (where fitted) and tank measurements. A persistent difference between the two methods calls for a check of the flowmeter calibration or an investigation into measurement error.
Yakıt tüketimi gemi hızının yaklaşık küp: Fuel consumption is roughly proportional to the cube of the ship's speed (P ∝ V³). Because of this relationship, reducing speed by 10% reduces fuel consumption by about 27%.
Yakıt tüketimi izlemede (bunker yönetimi: It is the most accurate method for monitoring fuel consumption (bunker management). It gives measurements that comply with the IMO DCS and EU MRV.
Yakıt tüketimi ve kat edilen mesafe ile: The annual CII (rating A–E) is calculated from fuel consumption and distance travelled; SEEMP Part III defines the improvement measures (speed optimisation, hull cleaning and so on).
Yakıt tüketimi yaklaşık olarak hızın küp: Fuel consumption is roughly proportional to the cube of the speed. Reducing speed by 10% lowers fuel consumption by about 27%.
Yakıt ve yağ numuneleri düzenli alınır:: Fuel and oil samples are taken regularly: the MARPOL bunker sample, a fuel sample before use and periodic LO samples (used oil analysis). Samples must be representative and taken under clean conditions; a contaminated sample gives a false result. Samples are labeled and either tested quickly on board or sent to a laboratory.
Yakıt ve yağ operasyonları, makine daire: Fuel and oil operations are the most sensitive work of the engine room, both environmentally and technically. Disciplined preparation, continuous supervision and honest records prevent marine pollution and heavy penalties on the one hand, and protect the main engine from the abrasive effects of poor-quality fuel on the other. The Second Engineer's care in this area directly determines both the ship's environmental record and the service life of its machinery.
Yakıt ve yağ sistemlerine kontaminasyon: Contamination enters fuel and oil systems in three ways: from outside (solids/water received during bunkering, air intake), from inside (wear metal, gasket remnants, rust) and from chemical breakdown (oxidation, thermal degradation). If these particles are not caught by filters, they lead to costly failures such as injector nozzle wear, bearing scoring, pump impeller erosion and sticking valves.
Yakıt ve yağ yönetimi, teknik bilgi kada: Fuel and oil management requires disciplined record-keeping and skeptical quality control as much as technical knowledge. For the Chief Engineer, the strongest defense is a provable chain of compliance: the sealed MARPOL sample, a correctly kept BDN and the changeover log. This discipline prevents both machinery damage costing millions of dollars and PSC detentions and fines.
Yakıt ve yağlama sistemleri, geminin kal: The fuel and lubrication systems are the arteries that feed and protect the heart of the ship. Bunkering safety, the tank chain, separator operation and LO circulation are the basis of reliable engine operation. At the same time, under MARPOL, these systems are among the most critical sources of marine pollution; honesty in the ORB and safe operation unite the technical and ethical dimensions of engineering. While learning these systems, the cadet must internalize the question "how are the environment and safety protected?" as much as the question "how is the engine fed and protected?"
Yakıt yönetimi (slow steaming, eco speed: Managing fuel (slow steaming, eco speed), CII performance and the ETA committed to the charterer at the same time is the modern Master's daily arithmetic. If the weather worsens, tactical decisions such as reducing speed, shifting to a safer route or heaving to affect the commercial ETA; but the safety decision always takes priority.
Yakıt ön ısıtmasını sabit 98 °C'ye değil: Set the fuel preheating not at a fixed 98 °C but according to the density and viscosity in the analysis and the separator maker's separation temperature nomogram; do not exceed the flash point and closed-system limits.
Yakıt, depolama tankından (storage/bunke: Fuel flows from the storage tank (storage/bunker tank) to the settling tank and from there to the service tank. In the settling tank, the fuel is heated and allowed to stand; heavy water and sediment sink to the bottom and are drained off (settling). The service tank holds clean fuel that has passed through the separator, ready to be pumped to the engine. This chain cleans the fuel in stages.
Yakıt, sıkıştırma strokunu sonunda yükse: The fuel is injected at high pressure (300–2000 bar) at the end of the compression stroke and ignites spontaneously on contact with the hot air.
Yakıt/mesafe ile yıllık CII hesaplanır (: The annual CII (A–E) is calculated from fuel consumption and distance; SEEMP Part III defines the improvement measures (speed optimisation, hull and propeller cleaning).
The annual CII (A–E) is calculated from fuel consumption and distance; SEEMP Part III defines the improvement measures.
Yakıt/yağ ROB değerleri, günlük tüketim: Fuel/oil ROB figures, daily consumption and bunkers received are recorded regularly. Under MARPOL Annex VI, the Bunker Delivery Note (BDN) and the sample are retained; the accuracy of consumption data has become increasingly critical for IMO DCS/CII reporting.
Yakıt/yağ arıtımından ve kaçaklardan olu: Sludge produced by fuel/lube oil treatment and by leaks is collected in the sludge tank and either burned in an approved incinerator or delivered to a shore reception facility in port. The Second Engineer monitors sludge generation, the tank level and disposal, and ensures that sludge never gets into the sea.
Yakıt/yağ filtre değişimi, separatör bow: Fuel/oil filter changes, separator bowl cleaning, cooler cleaning, valve grinding and gasket renewal are the core jobs of the engine room. In these jobs, cleanliness (foreign object / FOD control), correct torque values and a leak test after assembly are critical. The Second Engineer is personally present at the first start after maintenance.
Yakıt/yağ separatörleri (purifier), su v: Fuel/lube oil separators (purifiers) supply clean fuel/lube oil by separating out water and solid particles. The Second Engineer plans bowl/disc cleaning, gasket replacement and overhaul; correct gravity disc selection and correct operating parameters are critical. The backwash/desludge system is checked regularly.
Yakıt/yağ tankı çıkışlarındaki quick-clo: In a fire, the quick-closing valves on fuel/oil tank outlets are closed remotely to cut off the fire's fuel source. They are tested periodically; the spring/pneumatic trip mechanism and the valve movement are verified. A seized (non-closing) QCV means disaster in a fire.
Yalnız yüksüz çalıştırma gerçek koşullar: Running only without load does not represent real conditions. Long periods of running without load lead to unburnt fuel and soot accumulating on the exhaust side (wet stacking); periodic running under real load is recommended.
Yalıtılmış sistemde ne kütle ne de enerj: In an isolated system neither mass nor energy crosses the boundary. According to the second law of thermodynamics, the entropy of an isolated system never decreases. In practice a perfectly isolated system does not exist, but modelling the universe as an isolated system is common in theoretical analysis.
Yan loblar (side echoes), çok yollu yans: Side lobe echoes, multiple and indirect echoes, shadow sectors and interference (from other radars) lead to misinterpretation. Recognising these artefacts is essential for reading the screen correctly.
Yanaşma/kalkmada römorkörler gemiye iter: When berthing and unberthing, tugs push or pull the ship. When making fast a tug, the tug line sent by the tug with a messenger (light line) is usually taken on board and made fast on a suitable bollard or tug bitt, through a Panama lead. When taking the tug line, the AB learns from the Bosun which fairlead the line will pass through and which bollard it will be made fast on; a wrong lead chafes the line against the ship's structure and cuts it.
Yangın alarmında kaptanın ilk kararları:: The Master's first decisions on a fire alarm: the location and class of the fire are established, the general alarm is sounded, the response team (generally led by the Chief Officer) is sent with equipment (SCBA, fireman's outfit, hoses), ventilation and fire dampers are checked, and the ship is manoeuvred so that the wind does not fan the fire (reducing the relative wind and keeping smoke and flames away from the accommodation and the fire party). Boundary cooling (cooling the adjacent spaces with water from outside) is the basis of preventing the fire from spreading.
Yangın algılama (smoke/heat detector), m: Fire detection (smoke/heat detectors), manual call points, the fire alarm panel and the general alarm are function tested periodically. A contaminated detector causes false alarms or late detection; testing and cleaning are scheduled zone by zone.
Yangın algılama sistemi, çoğu zaman sess: The fire detection system is a safety net that mostly waits silently but saves lives when the moment comes. The ETO's success is measured by making sure that every detector in this system is clean and responsive, every loop intact and every alarm genuine and reliable. Disciplined testing, fast fault finding and careful management of disablements are the cornerstones of this task.
Yangın algılama, otomatik durdurma, uzak: Fire detection, automatic shutdowns, remote control and back-up systems are mandatory for UMS certification.
Yangın algılandığında general alarm soun: When a fire is detected, the general alarm sounders (horns/bells) and visual flashers are activated; in noisy engine rooms, a visual warning in addition to the audible one is mandatory. The ETO tests the continuity of the sounder circuits, the sound level (wake-up level in cabins) and the operation of the flashers. The general alarm may be on a circuit separate from the fire alarm; the integration of the two is verified.
Yangın algılandığında panel sesli/görsel: When a fire is detected, the panel gives an audible and visual warning and shows the zone or detector. The general alarm that warns the crew can be operated separately or may be integrated. The bridge must be continuously manned and the alarms must be recorded.
Yangın bir bölmede kontrol altına alınma: While a fire in one compartment is being brought under control, the boundary bulkheads and decks of the adjacent compartments heat up; this heat can cause the fire to spread and combustible materials in the adjacent space to ignite. Boundary cooling is the task of cooling the surfaces surrounding the compartment on fire by spraying them with water.
Yangın büyükse yangın hortumuyla müdahal: If the fire is large, it is attacked with a fire hose; the fog setting gives both protection and extinguishing. The fire party advances in pairs, the retreat route is kept open and the team withdraws when heat/smoke increases. No one enters a smoke-filled space without SCBA.
Yangın detektörlerinin (duman/ısı) önü k: Fire detectors (smoke/heat) must not be obstructed; a detector that is covered or painted over does not work. The steward makes sure that the detectors in the accommodation remain uncovered and functional; an obstructed detector is reported.
Yangın detektörlerinin (smoke detector): Smoke detectors are not covered during cleaning and must not be coated with paint/dust. Unauthorized electrical appliances or uncontrolled multi-socket adapters found in cabins and common areas are reported.
Yangın drill'inde AB genelde yangın part: In a fire drill, the AB usually serves in the fire party or the support team: duties such as running out the fire hose, holding the nozzle, handling the branch pipe or boundary cooling (cooling the surfaces adjacent to the compartment on fire) are assigned. Boundary cooling prevents the fire from spreading to adjacent spaces and lowers the temperature.
Yangın ekipmanı, kullanılmadığı sürece g: Fire-fighting equipment is an insurance that remains invisible as long as it is not used; but in a real fire, the survival of the ship and the crew depends directly on this equipment working and on the team being able to use it. The Safety Officer's task is to keep this chain, from "being there" to "working and usable", intact every day.
Yangın gözcüsü (fire watch), sıcak çalış: The fire watch is the person who watches the area during and after the hot work. The fire watch's duty is to detect at an early stage any hidden fire caused by sparks/heat, to be ready to use the extinguisher and to raise the alarm if necessary. The fire watch is not occupied with any other work; their only task is to keep watch.
Yangın hattı (fire main) hidrantları ve: The fire main supplies the hydrants and the fixed extinguishing systems; through the ISC (international shore connection), water can be supplied to the fire main from shore or from another ship.
Yangın kapıları, yangın ve dumanın yayıl: Fire doors must be closed (or self-closing) to prevent fire and smoke from spreading. Holding them open with a wedge completely defeats this protection. The Third Officer corrects this common violation firmly.
Yangın müdahale takımı (fireman's outfit: The fire-fighter's outfit includes protective clothing, a helmet, gloves, boots, a lifeline, a torch, an axe and an SCBA. A specified number of complete outfits are kept on board in easily accessible, widely separated positions. Regular checks and training are essential.
Yangın pompaları, en uzak/yüksek hydrant: The fire pumps must have the capacity to give sufficient pressure and jet range even at the farthest and highest hydrant. SOLAS requires two jets to operate simultaneously at a specified pressure (depending on the ship type). The pump capacity is related to the size of the ship and the capacity of the bilge and ballast pumps.
Yangın söndürücü servis/yeniden dolum, S: Fire extinguisher service/recharging, SCBA cylinder hydrostatic testing, fire hose/nozzle checks and fixed system (CO2/foam) service dates are also tracked. Pressure vessels such as SCBA cylinders are subject to a statutory test interval.
Yangın söndürücü, hortum kutusu (fire st: The fronts of fire extinguishers, hose boxes (fire stations), lifebuoys, EEBDs, the first aid cabinet and emergency stop buttons are always kept clear. The AB prevents materials from being stowed in front of these points and removes them if they have been. A piece of safety equipment that cannot be reached is as good as non-existent when it really matters.
Yangın sınıfına göre söndürücü seçilir:: The extinguishing agent is chosen according to the class of fire: class A (solids) water; class B (oil/fuel) foam or CO2; class C (gas) shutting off the source; electrical fires CO2 or clean agent (with the power isolated). In an engine room fire, the fixed CO2 or water mist system is used as a last resort; but before CO2 is released it must be confirmed beyond doubt that the space has been completely evacuated and a head count has been made. The Master personally obtains this "is everyone out?" confirmation.
Yangın çıktığında ilk adımlar: alarmı ve: When a fire breaks out, the first steps are: raise the alarm, report the location of the fire, cut off the fuel source if possible (quick-closing valve, stop the pump) and make a first attack with a portable extinguisher (if trained and if it is safe). If the fire grows, the engine room is evacuated so that the fixed system can be used.
Yangın üçgeninin herhangi bir kenarı kal: If any side of the fire triangle is removed, the fire goes out: the fuel is cut off (quick-closing valves), the oxygen is cut off (CO₂, foam) or the temperature is lowered (water).
Yangın/duman ortamına giriş yapacak ekip: The team that will enter a fire or smoke-filled area wears SCBA (Self-Contained Breathing Apparatus, supplied by compressed-air cylinders); if trained, the AB knows how to don the SCBA, check the cylinder pressure and manage the working time. SCBA allows the fire party to make a protected entry; when the low-pressure alarm sounds, the wearer withdraws immediately.
Yangına müdahale eden ekibin lifeline ve: The team responding to a fire must be equipped with a lifeline and fireproof lifeline, and supported by low-location lighting and communications (intrinsically safe portable VHF). A missing or damaged component makes the whole outfit unusable.
Yangında Safety Officer; ileri yangın ek: In a fire, the Safety Officer may lead the attack fire team (fire party), directs the team wearing SCBA and coordinates boundary cooling, that is, cooling the adjacent surfaces to prevent the fire from spreading to neighboring compartments. Team safety (air time, withdrawal signal) is the priority.
Yangınlar yakıtına göre sınıflandırılır: Fires are classified by their fuel, and each class requires a different extinguishing agent. The most critical in the galley is the cooking oil and tallow/grease fire; this is called Class F in the European standard and Class K in the American standard. In addition, there are risks of solid-fuel fires (Class A — bread, wood, paper), electrical fires (E) and gas fires (Class C/B). The cook must know at reflex level which extinguisher is suitable for which fire.
Yangınlar yanan maddeye göre sınıflandır: Fires are classified by the material burning: A (solids: wood, paper), B (flammable liquids: fuel, oil), C (gases), D (combustible metals), F/K (cooking oil). The extinguisher must be chosen to suit the class of fire; a wrong choice can make the fire bigger or cause an electric shock or explosion.
Yangının en iyi yönetimi çıkmadan önlenm: The best way to manage a fire is to prevent it from starting. The cook never leaves the fryer unattended, checks the oil level and temperature, keeps the area around the range free of grease and keeps combustible materials (paper, plastic, oily rags) away from hot surfaces. When cooking is finished, make sure the range/oven/fryer has been switched off; the galley close-down check at the end of each working period is a routine.
Yangının kontrol edildiği veya yayıldığı: Whether the fire is being controlled or is spreading is assessed continuously. If a boundary bulkhead is too hot to touch by hand, the fire is at risk of spreading to the adjacent space; cooling is intensified or the area is evacuated. The boundary cooling team works in coordination with the main fire team and reports the situation to the command center.
Yanlış AIS verisi (örn. yanlış draft/des: Wrong AIS data (for example a wrong draft or destination) causes both navigational and legal problems.
Yanlış ayarlanmış emniyet parametreleri: Wrongly set safety parameters produce a large number of unnecessary alarms; this "alarm fatigue" causes a real danger to be missed. The parameters are set carefully for the ship's draft and the navigation area, and alarms are not silenced at will.
Yanlış ballast yönetimi; aşırı shear for: Incorrect ballast management can create excessive shear force, a situation resembling hold flooding or a dangerous list. The ballast plan is therefore prepared in writing and shared with the duty officer.
Yanlış beyan edilmiş DG (örn. kalsiyum h: Wrongly declared dangerous goods (for example calcium hypochlorite) can cause a fire; CINS circulars and the indicators of suspicious cargo are followed.
Yanlış declared DG (calcium hypochlorite: Wrongly declared DG (calcium hypochlorite) started a fire in a hold, and 5 crew members died. Lesson: DG declarations are unreliable; CINS circulars must be followed, and mis-declared DG is an industry-wide hazard.
Yanlış draft okuması yük miktarı uyuşmaz: A wrong draft reading leads to cargo quantity discrepancies (cargo claims) and stability errors; inadequate hold cleaning leads to cargo contamination and rejection. The AB must report readings honestly and accurately and fully meet the cleaning standard required for the cargo. "Approximate" readings and the assumption that a hold is "clean enough" have expensive consequences.
Yanlış faz şaft/kuplaj kırabilir; insula: Paralleling out of phase can break the shaft or the coupling; the insulation resistance is measured.
Paralleling out of phase can break the shaft or the coupling; the insulation is measured.
Yanlış kurulum ölümcüldür; her bileşen k: A wrongly rigged ladder can kill; every component is checked.
Yanlış kurulum ölümcüldür; her bileşen t: A wrongly rigged ladder can kill; every component is checked one by one.
Yanlış seçim: Çok büyük disc → yağ su çı: Wrong choice: disc hole too large → oil flows out through the water outlet (oil loss). Disc hole too small → water mixes into the oil outlet (insufficient separation).
Yanlış viskozite enjektör/pompa hasarı y: Wrong viscosity damages the injectors and fuel pumps; calibration is never neglected.
Yanlış yapılandırılmış gecikme veya hass: A wrongly configured delay or sensitivity leads either to dangerously late detection or to chronic false alarms. The ETO makes sensitivity changes only at authorized user level and on record; such changes are subject to survey.
Yanlış yerleştirme hem stabiliteyi bozar: Wrong placement both impairs stability and delays discharge.
Yanlış şaft alignment, belirli yataklard: Incorrect shaft alignment leads to excessive load on certain bearings, hot bearings, vibration and, in the long term, shaft fatigue cracks. Alignment is verified in drydock by gap & sag measurements and bearing reaction (jack-up) tests.
Yanma için yakıt (HC buharı), oksijen ve: Combustion needs fuel (hydrocarbon vapour), oxygen and a source of ignition. The IGS removes one side of the triangle by bringing the oxygen below the critical level. With O2 below 8%, a hydrocarbon/air mixture cannot explode; in practice 5% is aimed for to leave a safety margin.
Yanma için yakıt, oksijen ve tutuşma kay: Combustion needs fuel, oxygen and a source of ignition. In a tanker's tank, hydrocarbon vapour and static electricity or sparks may be unavoidable; the IGS breaks the triangle by controlling the oxygen. When the tank atmosphere is kept at 8% O₂ or less, no explosion can occur whatever the vapour concentration.
Yanma kayıpları: Enjeksiyon optimizasyon: Combustion losses: injection optimisation, excess air control.
Yanma odası ile karter arasında doğrudan: There is a direct connection between the combustion space and the crankcase. The cylinder oil and the crankcase oil are the same system.
The combustion space and the crankcase are completely separate. As a result, cylinder lubrication and crankcase lubrication are independent.
Yanma odası refrakter tuğla ile kaplı, s: It has a combustion chamber lined with refractory brick, a sludge tank, a dosing pump, a burner and an air fan.
Yanıt süresi mikrosaniye mertebesindedir: Its response time is of the order of microseconds; it is not suitable for static pressure measurement (charge leakage).
Yapılan bir overhaul mutlaka yedek parça: An overhaul always consumes spare parts (gaskets, O-rings, bearings, injector nozzles). If a job is "completed" in the PMS but the ROB (Remaining On Board) has not gone down at all, the job has most probably not been done. The Chief Engineer performs this cross-check periodically; vetting and class inspectors use the same method.
Yardımcı dizel jeneratörlerde yük dağılı: On auxiliary diesel generators, exhaust temperatures, jacket water temperature and oil temperature are monitored in relation to load sharing. A generator that is overloaded or insufficiently cooled may drop off line during harbor/sea changeovers; this is a blackout risk.
Yardımcı dizel motor genellikle dört zam: The auxiliary diesel engine is usually of the four-stroke, medium-speed type. It generates electricity running at 720 or 900 rpm for 60 Hz, or at 750 or 1000 rpm for 50 Hz.
Yardımcı kazan, limanda ve düşük yük sey: The auxiliary boiler supplies steam (fuel heating, heating, services) in port and at sea at low engine load. Most maintenance is on the burner unit: the nozzle/tip that determines the quality of atomization is cleaned, the electrodes are adjusted, the glass of the photocell (flame eye) is cleaned, and the air-fuel ratio (combustion) is checked by flue gas analysis. Poor atomization causes soot build-up, uptake fires and loss of efficiency.
Yardımcı sistem hatlarındaki valfler (gl: Valves in auxiliary system lines (globe, gate, butterfly, NRV) are overhauled periodically for tightness and function. On a globe valve, the seat/disc is lapped/ground with grinding paste, the gland packing is renewed and the spindle is checked for straightness. NRVs are tested to confirm that they are fitted in the correct direction and move freely; an NRV fitted the wrong way round has disastrous consequences.
Yardımcı sistemlerde bakım öncesi LOTO u: Before maintenance on auxiliary systems, LOTO is applied, pressure is released and hot surfaces are allowed to cool. Boilers and pressurized systems need special care; no work is started until the isolation has been verified.
Yardımcı yük (auxiliary load) yönetimi d: Auxiliary load management is also important: avoiding unnecessary pump/fan operation, using variable frequency drives (VFD) and running the correct number of generators in parallel lower generator fuel consumption.
Yarı dolu (slack) tanklar serbest yüzey: Slack tanks cause a virtual loss of GM through the free surface effect. Several slack tanks at the same time can cause a critical loss of GM; the plan therefore limits the number of slack tanks.
Yarı dolu tanklardaki serbest yüzey etki: The free surface effect in partially filled tanks reduces the effective GM in heavy weather and impairs stability. The Chief Officer (in coordination with ballast management) ensures that tanks are kept pressed up (completely full) or empty where possible; the number of slack tanks is minimized. This is a frequently neglected but critical part of heavy weather stability.
Yatak arızası, yardımcı makinelerde en s: Bearing failure is the most common cause of unplanned downtime of auxiliary machinery. Noise/vibration is monitored on rolling bearings, and clearance and temperature on plain bearings. Worn bearing clearance is measured with a feeler gauge or lead wire ("bridge gauge"); if it is outside the manufacturer's tolerance, the bearing is replaced.
Yatak boşluğu (bearing clearance) kurşun: Bearing clearance is measured with lead wire or feeler gauges. Excessive clearance causes low oil pressure and knocking.
Yatak boşluğu (clearance) lead wire, pla: Bearing clearance is measured with lead wire, Plastigage or feeler gauges. The clearance must comply with the maker's specifications.
Yatak malzemesi genellikle beyaz metal (: The bearing material is usually white metal (tin-based babbitt) or an Al-Sn alloy.
Yatak sıcaklık alarmı, OMD ile birlikte: Together with the OMD, the bearing temperature alarm is the second layer of crankcase protection. A sudden jump in temperature indicates loss of lubrication or metal-to-metal contact; in this case, the load is reduced and an inspection is made.
Yatak sıcaklığı sürekli izlenir; 65°C al: The bearing temperature is monitored continuously; 65 °C for the alarm and 75 °C for shutdown are typical levels.
Yatay eksen entalpi (kJ/kg), dikey eksen: The horizontal axis shows enthalpy (kJ/kg), the vertical axis pressure (bar) or log(P).
Yatay tip (horizontal shaft) windlass, t: In a horizontal-shaft windlass all components are on deck. It makes maintenance easier and is common on medium-sized ships.
Yavaş dümen yanıtı, anormal ses, aşırı y: Slow steering response, abnormal noise, excessive oil temperature, pressure fluctuation and recurring leaks are the main symptoms. If there is air in the system, it is bled. For a symptom that is beyond the engineer's scope or affects safety, the work is stopped and the bridge and the Chief Engineer are informed; "trial and error" is unacceptable on steering gear.
Yaygın C/P formları: kuru yükte GENCON,: Common C/P forms: GENCON for dry cargo, ASBATANKVOY for tankers, NYPE/BALTIME for time charters. The Chief Officer must know the NOR provisions, the conditions for the commencement of laytime and the special clauses (rider clauses) of the applicable C/P, because these determine the timing of the documents.
Yaygın bir yaklaşım: alımda filtrasyon (: A common approach: filtration on intake (holding back large organisms and sediment) + UV irradiation (preventing reproduction by damaging the DNA). It leaves no chemical residue and needs no neutralisation on discharge; however, UV efficiency falls in turbid water and the system needs a lot of power.
Yaygın kablo tipleri: XLPE izoleli, EPR: Common cable types: XLPE-insulated, EPR-insulated and silicone-insulated cables. Each has different temperature resistance and flexibility.
Yaygın tipler: katlanır (folding), kayar: The common types are folding, rolling (side- or end-rolling) and pontoon covers. Tightness is provided by steel-to-steel contact and the rubber packing around the edge; drainage channels and drain holes with non-return valves carry away any water that leaks in. Hydraulic cylinders or chain/wire systems are used to open the covers.
Yaygın yöntem biyolojik aktif çamur (aer: The common method is biological activated sludge (aerobic bacteria break down the organic matter) + settling + disinfection by chlorination or UV. Modern MBR (membrane bioreactor) systems give very clean effluent through membrane filtration. Electrochemical and chemical systems are also used.
Yayınlar (publications) da bu kapsamdadı: Publications are covered as well: Sailing Directions (Pilot Books), List of Lights, List of Radio Signals, Tide Tables, Tidal Stream Atlases, The Mariner's Handbook (NP100) and Admiralty Tide Tables (ATT). If these are uncorrected or out of date, this is recorded as a deficiency in a PSC inspection.
Yaz saati uygulaması (Daylight Saving Ti: Daylight Saving Time (Summer Time) moves standard time forward by one hour according to the season. For the port approach and the ETA calculation, the Second Officer must work from the legal time in force at the port rather than the ship's zone time; otherwise the pilot station appointment, the VTS reporting time or the start of the cargo operation will be out by one or more hours.
Yazılım/firmware güncellemeleri güvenlik: Software/firmware updates close security vulnerabilities but can disrupt an OT system if applied incorrectly. The ETO applies updates only from a trusted source (the manufacturer, with a verified digital signature), at a non-critical time if possible and after taking a backup. System behavior is verified before and after the update.
Yağ analizi ancak doğru alınmış numune k: Oil analysis is only as reliable as the sample taken. The sample is taken while the engine is running and the oil is hot, from a representative point of the system (usually a dedicated sampling cock on the circulation line). First, the line is flushed for a few seconds (stagnant oil is discarded), then the clean sample bottle is filled.
Yağ analizi trend'i, kişiden bağımsız ol: The oil analysis trend must be preserved independently of individuals. When the Chief Engineer is relieved, open follow-up items and the trend history are part of the handover; the new Chief Engineer continues the program without interruption.
Yağ analizi üç temel amaca hizmet eder:: Oil analysis serves three basic purposes: monitoring the oil's fitness for use (its condition), early detection of machinery wear and detection of contamination (water, fuel, sand). Together, these three are a cornerstone of predictive maintenance.
Yağ analizi, condition monitoring'in res: Oil analysis is included in the PMS scheme as a formal part of condition monitoring; regular and complete records are evidence of the program during inspections.
Yağ atığı, geminin atık yönetim sistemin: Depending on the ship's waste management system, waste oil is delivered either to an approved shipboard system (e.g. an oily waste tank/incinerator, if suitable) or to a shore reception facility in port. The delivery is recorded with a receipt.
Yağ basınç emniyet presostatı (oil press: The oil pressure safety switch (oil pressure differential) monitors whether compressor lubrication is adequate and stops the compressor on insufficient oil pressure. The ETO checks the time delay and trip value of this safety device; a disabled oil safety switch can lead to compressor seizure.
Yağ değişimi planlanırken eski yağın boş: When an oil change is planned, the old oil is drained, the system is flushed, new oil of the correct grade and quantity is filled and the level is verified. The drained oil never goes to the bilge; it is transferred to the waste oil/sludge tank and entered in the ORB.
Yağ veya solvent bulaşmış bezler (örneği: Cloths contaminated with oil or solvent (e.g. oily rags from the engine room) are NEVER put in the dryer; they can ignite at dryer temperatures (spontaneous combustion). No combustible material is placed next to a running dryer, and the machine is not left running unattended for long periods. Checks are made that the laundry fire detector and the fire damper are in working order, that the detector is not covered and that the damper flap is kept open.
Yağ yağlamalı düzenlerde kıç şaft yatağı: In oil-lubricated arrangements the stern tube bearing is supplied from a header tank above the waterline. The height of the tank gives an internal pressure higher than the seawater pressure, making it harder for water to get in; the tank level is therefore a critical indicator.
Yağ çözücü, pas sökücü, deterjan gibi ki: Chemicals such as degreasers, rust removers and detergents are used in accordance with the Safety Data Sheet (SDS): the rules on correct PPE, ventilation, preventing skin/eye contact and not mixing incompatible chemicals apply. The AB must know the SDS of every chemical they use and must not put chemicals in unlabeled containers.
Yağ, gres, su, buz, gevşek halat ve dökü: Oil, grease, water, ice, loose ropes and spilled materials make the deck slippery and dangerous. The AB cleans up spills immediately, marks wet or oily surfaces and reports worn anti-slip coating where it is needed. An icy deck creates a fatal risk of slipping in winter; salt or sand is spread and the ice is broken up.
Yağ, yakıt ve hava filtrelerinde diferan: On oil, fuel and air filters, the differential pressure gauge (DP gauge) shows how far the filter is clogged. When the DP rises, the filter is cleaned or replaced; on automatic backwash (auto-backwash) filters, the backflush frequency is monitored. Ignoring a high DP leads to the filter bypass opening and dirty fuel/oil reaching the engine.
Yağcı her turda günlük servis tanklarını: On every round, the Oiler checks the levels of the daily service tanks (FO/DO settling and service tanks), the lubricating oil sump/storage tanks, and the bilge and sludge tanks. A sudden drop in the crankcase (sump) oil level indicates an oil leak, while a sudden rise indicates fuel or water contamination (sump dilution) — the latter is a warning sign of a crankcase explosion risk.
Yağcı tur sırasında portatif sıcaklık öl: During rounds, the oiler carries a portable temperature gauge (infrared thermometer), a flashlight and a logbook/tablet. Readings at critical points (exhaust temperatures, bearing temperatures, cooling water outlet temperature) are noted and compared with the previous round. The trend is more important than the instantaneous value; a temperature that rises slowly is a warning of a fault before it reaches the alarm threshold.
Yağcı'nın değeri, otomasyonun göremediği: The Oiler's value lies in seeing what automation cannot see. Disciplined rounds, conscious use of all five senses, trend monitoring and timely reporting are the first line of defense that prevents a small fault in the engine room from turning into a major accident. A good Oiler is the person who notices a problem before the alarm sounds.
Yağcı, \"sadece bir bakayım\" diyerek iz: The Oiler never enters an enclosed space without a permit just to "take a quick look". Many deaths in the past have occurred when a second or third person rushing to rescue someone who had entered without a permit suffocated in the same atmosphere. Ventilation is kept running continuously and measurements are repeated throughout the entry.
Yağcı, DP değerini her turda not eder ve: The Oiler notes the DP value on every round and monitors its trend. A sudden jump in DP (within hours) is usually a sign of dirty fuel after bunkering or of an in-line fault; a slow rise is normal build-up. When the bypass valve opens, the filter is taken out of action and dirty fluid goes to the engine — this is never regarded as normal.
Yağcı, ECA geçişinde filtre DP'sini ve y: During the ECA changeover, the Oiler closely monitors filter DP and fuel temperature; a sudden change in viscosity can cause seal leaks or pump cavitation. The changeover is carried out gradually, and the time and position are recorded in the fuel changeover logbook.
Yağcı, OWS başında bekleyerek operasyonu: The Oiler stays at the OWS and monitors the operation, verifying that the separator is working correctly, that the 15 ppm alarm is active and not bypassed, and that the three-way valve is in the correct position. The separated oil goes to the sludge/waste oil tank. The operation is carried out only under permitted conditions (outside special areas, en route).
Yağcı, T/C filtresinin yağ banyolu (oil-: The Oiler knows whether the T/C filter is of the oil-bath or dry type; on the oil-bath type, the oil level and cleanliness are checked. When the filter is cleaned, the greatest care is taken that no foreign object falls into the compressor inlet.
Yağcı, bilge ve sludge seviyelerini izle: The Oiler monitors the bilge and sludge levels, informs the engineer before the tanks become full and provides on-site support for OWS/incinerator operation. Non-oil waste (detergent, chemicals) mixing with the bilge water impairs OWS performance; chemicals are therefore prevented from being poured into the bilge.
Yağcı, blackout anında sahada gözlem yap: At the moment of a blackout, the Oiler observes on site and gives the engineer real-time information: which generator tripped, what the alarm is, the state of fuel/oil pressure. The Oiler verifies that the emergency generator has started and that the emergency switchboard is energized.
Yağcı, bu acil kapatma noktalarının (eme: The Oiler knows by heart where these emergency shutdown points (emergency stop and QCV control boxes) are and can find them in the dark/in smoke. These shutdowns cut the fire off from fuel and air, so that the fixed system can be effective.
Yağcı, bu operasyonlarda \"sıfır kirlili: In these operations, the Oiler works to a "zero pollution" target: every flange, every hose and every valve is a potential leak point. Drip trays, scupper plugs and SOPEP material are prepared in advance. Even a small overflow or leak is reported immediately and cleaned up; it is never concealed.
Yağcı, bunker yoğunluğuna göre üretici t: The Oiler selects the correct disc from the manufacturer's table (gravity disc selection chart) according to the bunker density. When the densities of modern HFOs approach 991 kg/m³ (at 15°C), water separation in a conventional purifier becomes difficult; for this reason, new-generation separators (systems such as ALCAP) control the interface automatically without a gravity disc.
Yağcı, crane'i kullanmadan önce hareket: Before using the crane, the Oiler checks the path of travel (that no one is under the load), the limit switches and the brakes. A load above the SWL of the crane is never lifted; a lifting plan and a risk assessment are made before a heavy lift.
Yağcı, döner tezgahta çalışırken talaş i: When working at a rotating machine, the Oiler uses a face shield/goggles against swarf, never takes measurements or cleans without stopping the machine, and knows where the emergency stop button is. Checking the grinding wheel for cracks/wear and using it at the correct speed prevents the risk of it bursting.
Yağcı, filtre değişim sırasında ana hatt: During a filter change, the Oiler turns the duplex filter lever (changeover) without interrupting the main line, so the engine keeps running without interruption. The contents of the removed filter (metal particles, coal-like residue) are examined and any abnormality is reported to the engineer — metal swarf coming from a bearing is an early sign of failure.
Yağcı, gözlemlediği operasyon verilerini: By reporting the operational data observed accurately, the Oiler ensures that the records reflect reality. False/inconsistent records are among the most serious PSC findings and can lead to detention of the ship.
Yağcı, hangi separatörün hangi sisteme h: The Oiler knows which separator serves which system, the condition of the standby separator and the procedure for putting it into service. When a separator is taken out for maintenance, the standby one is put into service, so the supply to the engine is not interrupted.
Yağcı, her drill'i kendi görevini gerçek: The Oiler sees every drill as an opportunity to rehearse their own duty as if it were a real emergency: time taken to find the equipment, donning SCBA, closing valves, the escape route. Deficiencies identified in the debrief after the drill (equipment failure, unclear duties) are reported and corrected.
