Yukarı Strok: Piston yukarı hareket eder: Upward stroke: as the piston moves up, the ports are closed and the gas is compressed. Fuel is injected around TDC.
Yumuşak çamur tabanda zayıf yankı, yoğun: A weak echo from a soft mud bottom, a dense shoal of fish or a thermocline layer can show a wrong depth. A multiple echo can appear as a multiple of the real depth. In shallow and critical waters the echo sounder reading is cross-checked with other sources (chart, draft).
Yumuşatıcı (fabric softener) konfor sağl: Fabric softener adds comfort but, as it reduces the absorbency of towels, it is used sparingly on towels. Bleach (sodium hypochlorite) is used in a controlled way, only on whites and where disinfection is needed; it fades colors and wears out fabric. The most critical rule: bleach is never used together with acid-based products, as toxic chlorine gas is released.
Yük artığı, çöp, halat veya buz freeing: Cargo residues, garbage, ropes or ice can block a freeing port; it is cleaned before heavy weather. Blocked drainage leads to a deadly accumulation of water.
Yük artışında gerilim düşme eğilimi göst: When the load increases, the voltage tends to fall; the AVR increases the excitation current to bring the voltage back to the rated value. When the load decreases, the excitation is reduced.
Yük belgeleri yönetimi, denizcilik ile t: Cargo documentation management is an area where seafaring and commercial law meet. A single signature or a one-hour recording error by the Chief Officer can win or lose the company tens of thousands of dollars. Success comes from understanding the charter party, drawing up documents correctly and in real time, and protecting the ship against unjustified claims with records.
Yük dağılımı sagging/hogging dengesini b: The cargo distribution determines the balance between sagging and hogging; with high-density cargoes such as ore, the tank top load density limits are also checked.

The cargo distribution determines the balance between sagging and hogging; on container ships torsion is also critical because of the open deck structure. At every step the loading computer verifies that the values stay below 100% of the limits.
Yük dağılımı, gövde boyunca bending mome: Cargo distribution creates bending moments and shear forces along the hull. Heavy cargo amidships tends to cause sagging and heavy cargo at the ends tends to cause hogging; both strain the hull. The cadet learns that the loading computer is used to keep these values below the 100% limit.
Yük grup (A/B/C), stowage factor ve dens: The cargo is distributed according to its group (A/B/C), stowage factor and density; the loading sequence is planned within the limits approved in the loading manual. In alternate hold loading the shear force can reach a critical point.
Yük operasyonlarına destek, AB'nin deniz: Supporting cargo operations is where the AB's seamanship is seen most concretely: a lashing applied at the correct angle, a properly sealed hatch cover, an honestly read draft and a hold cleaned to the required standard ensure that the cargo arrives in port in good condition, the ship remains stable and the crew stay safe. In this work, haste and assumptions are expensive; discipline, checks and honest reporting protect both the cargo and the ship.
Yük operasyonunda Reis'in başarısı; plan: In cargo operations, the Bosun's success comes from carrying out the plan on deck completely, safely and on time. The weathertightness of the hatches, the soundness of the lashings and the correct preparation of the holds determine the safety of the cargo, the crew and the ship. A good Bosun never misses even a single slack lashing, because what is left loose at sea is what is lost in bad weather.
Yük operasyonunda bazı işler permit gere: In cargo operations, some jobs require a permit: enclosed space entry (hold), working aloft (upper tier of the lashing bridge), working overside and hot work. Through supervision on deck, the Bosun ensures that the team does not go beyond the scope of the permit, and monitors that the job-specific risk assessment is applied.
Yük operasyonunda dökülen tahıl, toz, hi: Grain, dust, hydraulic oil or chemicals spilled during cargo operations are both a safety and an environmental risk. Under MARPOL, discharging cargo residues or chemical spills into the sea is prohibited in port and within 12 NM of land; residues accumulating on deck are not swept overboard but collected. The AB fits the scupper plugs during operations involving oil, cleans up spills with absorbent and reports them.
Yük operasyonunda kaptanın başarısı, \"h: The Master's success in cargo operations comes from disciplined approvals, cross-checks and decisions to stop, which are invisible "when everything goes well" but are the only line of defence "when something goes wrong". The Master does not stow the cargo; but the Master guarantees that the cargo does not endanger the ship and the crew.
Yük operasyonunda sahil işçileri (steved: During cargo operations, shore workers (stevedores) work on deck. The Bosun watches stevedore movements, manages overlaps between crew and stevedore working areas and monitors compliance with safety rules. Differences in language and practice can create a risk of accidents; clear marking and supervision are important.
Yük operasyonunun sahada yürütülmesi Bir: Carrying out the cargo operation on site is the duty of the Chief Officer; but under ISM Code section 5 and SOLAS Chapter VI it is the Master's responsibility to verify that the operation is planned safely and carried out within the strength and stability limits. The Master can delegate the task but cannot delegate accountability. In a loading accident, PSC, class and the P&I club always ask the Master first.
Yük planının başlangıç noktası charter p: The starting point of the cargo plan is the charter party terms and the cargo nomination. The nomination states the number of parcels, the quantity of each parcel (bbl/MT), its API gravity or density, its temperature requirements and the order of the loading and discharge ports. The Chief Officer compares this information with the tank capacity tables (sounding/ullage tables) to work out which parcel will fit into which group of tanks.
Yük planının her ara aşaması (her tank d: Every intermediate stage of the cargo plan (each step in filling the tanks) is simulated in the loading computer. At each step the shear force (SF), bending moment (BM), trim, drafts (FP/AP/midships), GM and list are checked. The values are kept below the harbour and seagoing limits; above 85% is the alarm band and a sign that the plan needs revising.
Yük tanklarında hidrokarbon buharı (HC): In cargo tanks, hydrocarbon (HC) vapor forms a flammable/explosive atmosphere; crude oil may also contain substances such as toxic hydrogen sulfide (H₂S) and benzene. Tank cleaning releases this vapor and generates static electricity. If mismanaged, the combination of an ignition source (static spark) + flammable atmosphere + oxygen leads to an explosion.
Yükleme kapağı yanma sırasında açılmamal: The charging door must not be opened during combustion; there is a risk of blowback and flame. Ash is not removed until it has cooled sufficiently. The temperature and water content of the sludge service tank are checked; sludge with too much water disturbs combustion and can cause an explosion.
Yükleme sonrası Reis, ekiple birlikte tü: After loading, the Bosun and the team check the lashing pattern in all bays: are the twist locks locked, are the lashing rods tight, are the turnbuckles tightened? Before a voyage on which bad weather is expected, all lashings are checked twice and records are kept. In mid-voyage, the inspection is repeated during a weather window.
Yükleme sonunda hatlar son tanka veya te: At the end of loading the lines are cleared towards the last tank or the terminal (line clearing); cargo left in the lines can cause contamination in the next operation.
Yükleme sırasında taşmayı önlemek için b: To prevent overflow during loading there are independent high-level and high-high-level alarms; the high-high level is usually linked to automatic closing or the ESD. These alarms must work with sensors independent of the main level system, so that a single failure cannot lead to an overflow.
Yükleme sırasında yer değiştiren tank at: The tank atmosphere displaced during loading is released through the venting or vapour return system; the rate must not exceed the venting capacity, otherwise overpressure develops and the P/V valves are strained.
Yükleme yazılımı her loading kademesinde: At each loading stage, the loading software shows bending moment (longitudinal), shear force and, on container ships, torsion values. These values must be kept below 100% of the limit; above 85% an alarm is given and the loading sequence is revised.
Yükleme öncesinde charterer veya termina: Before loading, the pre-stowage plan sent by the charterer or terminal operator is the Chief Officer's first checkpoint. On container ships it comes in bay-row-tier format, on bulk carriers as hold-by-hold tonnage and on tankers as a tank-by-tank parcel distribution. The plan is loaded into the stability/trim/strength software specific to the ship type (e.g. LoadMaster, BluePrint, Cargomax); bending moment, shear force, torsion (for container ships), draft at FP/AP/Mid, GM and list values are checked.
Yükleme üç aşamada planlanır: initial (d: Loading is planned in three stages: initial (low rate, filling the lines and controlling static electricity), bulk (full rate up to the terminal limit) and topping-up (reduced rate as the final ullage approaches). The topping-up sequence defines which tank will be closed last and how the final ullage will be taken.
Yükleme/boşaltmada hose/manifold kaçakla: During loading and discharging, the risk of hose or manifold leaks, overflow and drips is monitored continuously. Even a single drop of oil spilled activates the SOPEP; the terminal and the port authority are informed at once. On tankers, ISGOTT requires the Ship-Shore Safety Checklist to be re-confirmed every watch.
Yüksek Fe içeriği (genelde >200 ppm bir: A high Fe content (generally >200 ppm is a warning, >400 ppm serious) means corrosive or adhesive wear of the liner, or the onset of scuffing. The residual BN (Base Number) of the drain oil shows the acid neutralization capacity; a low BN means inadequate lubrication against fuel sulfur and a risk of cold corrosion.
Yüksek basınç (HP) CO₂ silindirleri ~50: High-pressure (HP) CO₂ cylinders contain liquid CO₂ at about 50 bar; the most common type on ships.
Yüksek basınç borusu: Pompa ile enjektör: High-pressure pipe: the connection between the pump and the injector.
Yüksek basınç pompaları yakıtı ortak bor: High-pressure pumps keep the fuel in a common pipe (rail) at 800–1000 bar (2000 bar in some systems). Injection timing and duration are set by the electronic control unit (ECU).
Yüksek basınç pompası (55-70 bar) deniz: A high-pressure pump (55–70 bar) forces seawater through a semi-permeable membrane. Salts and minerals stay on the other side of the membrane.
Yüksek basınçlı hidrolik kaçağı cilt alt: A high-pressure hydraulic leak can inject oil under the skin; the pressure is released before maintenance.
Yüksek basınçlı yakıt borularında (HP fu: A leak in high-pressure fuel pipes (HP fuel pipe) is contained by the double-walled pipe (double-walled / sheathed pipe) system; the leak alarm of this system is never disabled. Under SOLAS II-2, shielding of fuel/oil lines near hot surfaces is mandatory.
Yüksek fribordda accommodation ladder +: With a high freeboard, a combination of accommodation ladder and pilot ladder is rigged; the transfer point, the angle and the trapdoor arrangement are verified. A manrope, lifebuoy, lighting and a heaving line are ready.
Yüksek gerilim shore connection (HVSC),: High-voltage shore connection (HVSC) involves cable connection, earthing, phase and voltage synchronisation and load transfer; the changeover from the ship's generators to shore power is made safely and without interruption.
Yüksek gerilim çalışması, ETO'nun en yük: High-voltage work is the ETO's task that requires the highest discipline; a single skipped step — unverified isolation, missing earthing, damaged PPE — can be fatal. A strict sequence of operations, prove-test-prove and the correct PPE are the unchanging foundation for working safely on HV systems.
Yüksek gerilim, alçak gerilimden farklı: Unlike low voltage, high voltage can kill even without contact (by jumping across an air gap), and in an arc flash it produces extreme heat, pressure and light within seconds, causing severe burns and death. This is why HV work requires much stricter procedures and special training.
Yüksek gürültülü bölgelerde işaretleme v: In high-noise areas, warning signs and access to hearing protection are provided (as required by MLC for the working environment). Build-up of dust, soot and leaking steam is cleaned regularly, which reduces both the respiratory risk and the fire risk.
Yüksek hızla dönen tambur (6000-9000 rpm: In a bowl rotating at high speed (6000–9000 rpm), centrifugal force pushes the heavy components (water, solid particles) outwards and the light component (clean fuel or oil) towards the centre.
Yüksek klorür, deniz suyu veya kötü kali: A high chloride level shows that seawater or poor-quality make-up water has got into the circuit. Topping up with distilled water and correct dosing directly affect the life of the heat exchangers and liners.
Yüksek kükürtlü yakıt daha çok asit üret: High-sulfur fuel produces more acid; this is why a cylinder oil with a higher BN or a higher feed rate is needed. MARPOL Annex VI sulfur limits (e.g. changeover to low-sulfur fuel) also affect the choice of cylinder oil; a wrong match causes corrosion or deposits.
Yüksek mekanik ve termal gerilmelere day: It must withstand high mechanical and thermal stresses. On four-stroke engines it is usually made as a high-strength ferrous casting, and on large two-stroke engines from forged steel.
Yüksek riskli bölgelerde (Aden Körfezi,: In high-risk areas (the Gulf of Aden, the Gulf of Guinea, the approaches to the Singapore Strait), the Master carries out, within the BMP (Best Management Practices) framework, reporting to UKMTO, hardening measures (razor wire, citadel, water hoses), group transits/convoys and, if necessary, coordination of an armed security team (PCASP). All this coordination is planned in advance with the CSO and the company.
Yüksek riskli bölgelerde (geçmişte Aden: In high-risk areas (in the past the Gulf of Aden / Indian Ocean, the Gulf of Guinea, some South-East Asian waters), BMP is applied. The Master carries out a risk assessment and prepares the ship protection measures (physical barriers, razor wire, water spray), the speed and manoeuvring plan and the lookout arrangements. Crew awareness and drills are critical.
Yüksek riskli elektrik işlerinde Permit: A Permit to Work (PTW) system is applied for high-risk electrical work: the job description, isolation list, risks, PPE and approval signatures are documented. The ETO tests the voltage detector used to prove absence of voltage on a known live source before and after use (prove-test-prove principle); this ensures that the instrument is sound.
Yüksek riskli işler (enclosed space, hot: High-risk work (enclosed space, hot work, aloft, electrical) is carried out under a Permit to Work; the job, the precautions and the approval are recorded. The cadet learns why the PTW exists and that no high-risk work may be done without a permit.
Yüksek riskli işler Permit-to-Work (PTW): High-risk jobs start with a Permit-to-Work (PTW): hot work (welding/grinding), enclosed/confined space entry, work at height, electrical isolation, opening up pressurized systems. The Second Engineer is usually the person who approves/coordinates the PTW; it is signed together with the Chief Engineer. Lock-Out/Tag-Out (LOTO) is applied for energy isolation; every energy source (electrical, compressed air, hydraulic, steam, spring energy) is made safe and tagged.
Yüksek riskli liman yaklaşmalarında 'pre: On high-risk port approaches a "pre-arrival risk trigger list" should be used (e.g. low pressure, a PMS alarm, a standby pump unavailable). When a trigger occurs, the procedure for automatically calling additional personnel should be activated.
Yüksek seviye alarmı (high level alarm): The high-level alarm and the high-high-level alarm prevent overflow. The low-level alarm prevents a pump from running dry.
Yüksek sıcaklık (HT) devresi ceket suyun: The high-temperature (HT) circuit cools the jacket water and the low-temperature (LT) circuit cools the L.O., the charge air and the auxiliaries; a thermostatic valve keeps the temperature constant.
Yüksek yoğunluklu yakıtlarda gravity dis: Because the gravity disc is inadequate for high-density fuels, manufacturers have developed systems without a gravity disc that monitor the interface automatically by means of a water sensor/conductivity. When these systems detect water, they trigger automatic water draining or a desludge. The Oiler knows which generation the ship's separator belongs to and the daily check points that go with it.
Yüksekte kullanılan takım (anahtar, fırç: Tools used aloft (spanners, brushes, paint, removed parts) are tied on (tool lanyard) or carried in a closed bag; a falling object can kill a person below. The work area below is cleared, and a "falling objects" warning and, if necessary, a barrier are put in place. When working above, the AB thinks of the team below; those below wear safety helmets and keep out of the drop zone.
Yüksekte ve overside çalışma, AB'nin en: Work aloft and overside is among the AB's highest-risk duties, and no shortcut is forgiven here. A correctly worn harness, a connection that is never broken, a locked-out radar, a tied-on tool and a lifebuoy standing ready make the difference between a seafarer coming home safely from the mast or the ship's side and not coming home at all. The AB's skill is shown in the discipline of "always full equipment, never rush, stop when conditions deteriorate", because falls from height and falls overboard are accidents that give no second chance.
Yüksekte çalışmada (working aloft) temel: In work aloft, the basic hazard is falling: slipping, loss of balance, equipment failure or the roll of the ship can make a person fall. Overside work adds the risk of falling overboard (man overboard); a person who falls into cold water faces hypothermia and drowning, and when the ship is under way there is also the propeller hazard. When these two risks combine, overside work becomes one of the most dangerous operations on board.
Yüksekte/overside erişimde bosun's chair: For access aloft/overside, a bosun's chair, a stage (hanging staging platform) or scaffolding is used. The hoisting line (gantline) and the safety line must be SEPARATE, so that if one parts, the other holds. The AB checks the soundness of the ropes, the connecting knots and shackles, and the blocks and sheaves. If a rope passes over a sharp edge, a chafe guard is fitted.
Yüksekte/overside çalışma yalnızca uygun: Work aloft/overside is done only in suitable weather and sea conditions; increasing wind, precipitation, icing, rolling of the ship or reduced visibility require the work to be stopped immediately. If the AB or the lookout sees that conditions are deteriorating, they stop the job; the "almost done, let's finish" mindset is an invitation to an accident.
Yüksekte/overside çalışma yalnızca yetki: Work aloft/overside is carried out only by authorized personnel who are physically and psychologically fit; a person who suffers from dizziness or fear of heights, or who is tired, is not given this work. The work is not started without the required permit and suitable weather and sea conditions. If the AB does not feel fit, they are obliged to tell the Bosun/officer.
Yüksekte/overside çalışmada full body ha: For work aloft/overside, a full body harness is used; a waist belt alone is not sufficient for fall arrest, because in a fall it causes internal organ and spinal injuries. The AB dons the harness correctly: leg and chest straps tight, buckles fastened, the dorsal D-ring centered between the shoulder blades. A loose harness can let the person slip out in a fall.
Yükseltme sonrası FMEA revizyonu, provin: The chain of FMEA revision, proving trials and class survey after the upgrade must be planned before the work is finished. Hardware and software changes can invalidate the failure mode assumptions of the old FMEA; the revision is therefore not a formality but a technical re-assessment.
Yükün gemi yapısına (deck fitting, lashi: The loads that the cargo imposes on the ship's structure (deck fittings, lashing points) are monitored; points of excessive stress, cracked welds or deformed fittings are reported. Deck cargo must also not block escape routes, bilge channels or access to safety equipment.
Yürüme yolları, geçiş güvertesi (fore-af: Walkways, the fore-and-aft passage, railings and lifelines are kept sound and continuous. The AB immediately marks and reports loose or broken railings, missing lifelines and deck openings left open (manholes, deck openings). An open deck opening is a risk of falling and even of an enclosed space accident.
Yürünebilir soğuk depo ve dondurucularda: In walk-in cold stores and freezers, being trapped inside is a life-threatening hazard; the door must be openable from inside and there must be an alarm/lighting inside. When working inside for a long time, the cook wears suitable clothing and, where possible, tells someone before entering. The door locking mechanism and the inside release handle are tested regularly.
Yüz yüze iletişimde gürültülü ortamdan u: For face-to-face communication, move away from the noisy area or use an intercom with headsets. Hand signals should be standardised.
Yüzdürme kuvveti (buoyancy), cismin batı: The buoyant force (buoyancy) is equal to the product of the submerged volume of the body, the density of the fluid and the acceleration due to gravity (F = ρ·g·V).
Yüzey hazırlığı, boyanın ömrünü %60-80 o: Surface preparation determines 60-80% of the life of the paint. ISO 8501-1 defines practical standards for surface cleanliness. There are the levels SA 1 (light brush-off blast), SA 2 (thorough blast), SA 2.5 (very thorough — the industry norm) and SA 3 (white metal — for special applications). For mechanical cleaning, ST 2 (thorough manual cleaning) and ST 3 (very thorough) are used.
Yüzeyde biriken tortu, biyofilm, kireç v: Deposits, biofilm, scale or an oil layer on the surface create an additional thermal resistance (fouling factor); U falls and less heat is transferred with the same area. Signs: the outlet temperature of the cooled fluid rises and the pressure difference (ΔP) increases. Performance is monitored by comparison with the reference values in the clean condition.
Yüzeysel neden (\"dikkatsizlik\") yeterl: A superficial cause ("carelessness") is not enough; the investigation goes deeper by asking "why was the person careless?". Latent (hidden) factors such as fatigue, inadequate training, missing procedures and poor design are brought to light. This is the only way to achieve real prevention.
Yıkama aşamalı yapılır: boşaltmanın başı: Washing is done in stages: a top wash at the start of discharge while the upper parts are exposed, and a bottom wash as the level falls and the tank bottom is exposed. The machines are programmed to cover all surfaces (including shadow areas); after washing the bottom is cleaned by stripping.
Yıkama suyu ve kalıntı slop tankında top: Washing water and residues are collected in the slop tank, where they separate with the oil on top and water underneath (settling). In the load-on-top method, the separated water is discharged overboard within the permitted criteria, and the new cargo is loaded on top of the oily part; this reduces waste and pollution.
Yıkama suyu ve kimyasal kullanımı, kayma: The use of washing water and chemicals creates slipping and breathing hazards; suitable PPE and ventilation are essential. After washing, the used water is discharged in compliance with MARPOL rules (especially if it contains cargo residues), in coordination with the Chief Officer.
Yıkama suyunun ve temizlik kimyasalının: Discharge of wash water and cleaning chemicals into the sea is subject to MARPOL rules; deck water containing oil is not discharged directly overboard, the scuppers (deck drains) are plugged when necessary and the waste is collected appropriately.
Yıkama öncesi ayrıştırma, hem çamaşırın: Sorting before washing determines both the life of the laundry and the standard of hygiene. Whites and light colors are separated from dark colors; otherwise color bleeding spoils the whole load. Fabric types are also separated: delicates, towels, sheets and uniforms require different programs and temperatures. Heavily soiled or oily work clothes are never washed in the same load as clean textiles.
Yıkama, boşaltmanın uygun aşamasında baş: Washing is started at the appropriate stage of the discharge; records are kept for each tank before, during and after washing. The hydrocarbon and oxygen levels and the line pressure are monitored. As crude oil is used instead of washing water, the tank bottom is drained continuously by stripping.
Yıkanan ve kurutulan tabaklar, bardaklar: Washed and dried plates, glasses, cutlery and serving dishes are put away in their correct places in tidy, clean cupboards. Items put away damp pick up stains and germs; thorough drying is essential. Well-organized crockery storage allows the next service to start quickly and hygienically.
Yılda en az bir kez fiziksel sayım (stoc: A physical count (stock-take) is carried out at least once a year; the PMS record is compared with the actual stock and discrepancies are corrected. A count before a survey and before a handover is critical. Parts liable to corrode in a humid environment are stored in VCI (Volatile Corrosion Inhibitor) packaging with grease protection.
Yıldırım radarı ve hava raporları izleni: The lightning radar and weather reports are monitored; if lightning comes within the specified distance (e.g. less than 5 NM), the transfer is stopped. Strong wind gusts are assessed for their effect on mooring line and hose tension.
Yıllık DCS verisi, yetkili bir doğrulayı: Annual DCS data are checked by an authorized verifier (RO), and a Statement of Compliance (SoC) is issued to a compliant ship. The Chief Engineer keeps all records and evidence ready for verification.
Yıllık emisyon raporu akredite doğrulayı: The annual emissions report is verified by an accredited verifier. Non-compliance is subject to penalties; a ship that has failed to meet its monitoring and reporting obligations for two or more consecutive reporting periods may be issued an expulsion order, after which EU Member States other than the flag State refuse it entry to their ports.
ZD'yi hesaplamak için boylam 15'e bölünü: To calculate the ZD, the longitude is divided by 15 and rounded to the nearest whole number. For example, 67° W divided by 15 gives 4.47; since the nearest whole number is 4, the ZD is +4. The zero zone centered on Greenwich covers ±7.5°; the boundary zones (±172.5° to 180°) are half zones and meet at the date line.
Zabit, AIS hedefini radar hedefiyle eşle: The officer correlates the AIS target with the radar target; if the AIS and radar positions do not coincide, priority is given to the real-time radar data. Small craft without AIS, fishing boats and targets with a weak radar echo can be picked up only by visual and radar lookout; relying on AIS and missing them is dangerous.
Zabit, COLREG'e tam uyumu sağlamak, emni: The officer is obliged to ensure full compliance with COLREG, maintain a safe speed, keep a continuous lookout and call the Master immediately in case of doubt. STCW stresses that "if in any doubt" the officer must call the Master without hesitation; a late call is the most frequently seen link in the accident chain.
Zabit, kısıtlı görüşe girer girmez sis i: As soon as the ship enters restricted visibility, the officer starts the fog signals, switches on the navigation lights, calls a lookout, puts the engine on stand-by and informs/calls the Master. The fog signal can be sounded automatically or manually; it must be confirmed that the automatic signal system operates at the correct interval.
Zaman, seyrin sessiz omurgasıdır. İkinci: Time is the silent backbone of navigation. The Second Officer's chronometer monitoring, UTC discipline and careful time zone management protect navigational accuracy, the reliability of records and the crew's rest pattern together.
Zararlı bulgusu gıda yüklerinde reddedil: A pest finding can lead to the rejection of a food cargo and to quarantine.
Zayıflamış halat mooring sırasında kopab: A weakened line can part during mooring; regular inspection reduces the snap-back risk.
Ziegler-Nichols yöntemi: Önce sadece P i: Ziegler-Nichols method: first the stability limit is found with P only (Ku, Tu). Then P, I and D are calculated from these values.
Zihinsel sağlık ve denizci intiharı, sek: Mental health and seafarer suicide are serious issues for the industry; isolation, fatigue and lack of contact with the family are the main risks. The Master observes the psychological state of the crew, creates an open communication environment and, if necessary, brings in the company's EAP (Employee Assistance Programme) or crisis line. Social security protection (health, disability, old age) is also within the scope of the MLC and usually runs through the flag state or the state of residence.
Zincir halkalarındaki uzama, aşırı yükün: Elongation of chain links is a sign of overloading; it is detected by measurement (with a gauge). When wear exceeds a specified percentage, the chain is scrapped. The Oiler checks the chain link by link along its full length; a single damaged link takes the whole chain out of service.
Zincir sapanlar yüksek sıcaklık ve aşınm: Chain slings are resistant to high temperature and wear and are often used in the engine room. Inspection looks for: link wear (reduced diameter), stretching/elongation (stretch — the links look elongated), cracks, nicks, deformation, damage to welds/joints and the condition of the master link/hook. The safety latch on the hook must work.
Zincir, gypsy'den spurling pipe (zincir: From the gypsy the chain runs down the spurling pipe into the chain locker. The bitter end (the last end of the chain) is secured in the locker in a way that allows it to be released in an emergency.
Zincir; depo tankı → çökeltme (settling): The chain runs: storage tank → settling tank → separator → service tank → supply pump → mixing tank → booster pump → final heater → viscometer → engine. Hot fuel returning from the engine goes back to the mixing tank.
Ziyaretçi ve misafir yönetimi desteği, k: Supporting visitor and guest management is the steward's contribution to the ship's corporate image and to successful inspections. Tidy accommodation, professional hospitality and security awareness strengthen the impression that the ship is well managed and pave the way for inspections to go well.
Ziyaretçi yönetimi, ISPS güvenlik kurall: Visitor management must comply with the ISPS security rules; visitors are registered, escorted and restricted to authorized areas. During service, the steward follows the security rules and reports unauthorized access/suspicious situations to the responsible officer.
Zone 0: Patlayıcı atmosfer sürekli mevcu: Zone 0: an explosive atmosphere is present continuously.
Zone 1: Normal çalışmada ara sıra patlay: Zone 1: an explosive atmosphere occurs occasionally in normal operation.
Zone 2: Anormal koşullarda kısa süreli p: Zone 2: an explosive atmosphere occurs only briefly under abnormal conditions.
Zone time ise idari kolaylık için 15° ge: Zone time, on the other hand, is time based on standard time zones 15° wide for administrative convenience, linked to UTC by whole-hour differences. Ship's time is usually kept as zone time, so that a whole-hour difference from UTC is used instead of fractions in minutes. The difference between LMT and zone time can reach at most half an hour (about 7.5°), depending on how far the ship is from the central meridian of the zone.
Zone time tamamen coğrafi 15°'lik diliml: While zone time is based purely on geographical 15° zones, the legal standard time of a country (standard / legal time) is set according to administrative boundaries and usually does not coincide exactly with the 15° zones. Some countries use a single time zone (e.g. China is run on a single ZD), while others apply half-hour (e.g. India UTC+5:30) or quarter-hour (e.g. Nepal UTC+5:45) offsets.
Zor koşullarda (kötü hava, uzun saatler,: In difficult conditions (bad weather, long hours, monotonous work), the Bosun's attitude is reflected in the team. A calm, determined Bosun who stands at the front carries the team; a Bosun who panics or constantly shouts breaks the team apart.
Zorunlu minimum yedekler (örn. ana makin: Mandatory minimum spares (e.g. one set of fuel injection equipment for the main engine, an exhaust valve spindle) must be carried at all times. A stock-out of these items is a direct nonconformity.
pH, alkalinite, iletkenlik/TDS, klorür,: The targets for pH, alkalinity, conductivity/TDS, chloride, phosphate and oxygen scavenger are set according to the boiler pressure, the metallurgy and the treatment programme used. A single range taken from the internet does not apply to all boilers.
pH, klorun dezenfeksiyon etkinliğini etk: pH affects the disinfecting effectiveness of chlorine; at very high pH, the killing power of chlorine falls, so pH is generally kept and monitored within a suitable range (roughly 6.5-8.5). Periodic samples are taken for bacteriological safety; the presence of E. coli and coliform bacteria is a sign of fecal contamination and requires zero tolerance. These samples are assessed with field kits or by accredited laboratory analysis.
Çakışma veya tutarsızlık, idare inceleme: An overlap or inconsistency raises the question of "document reliability" in the Administration's review and may lead to the entire file being subjected to further scrutiny. For this reason, each time a document is received, the cadet should enter the dates in a personal record sheet and check consistency continuously.
Çalışan motorlar hızla CO biriktirir; ve: Running engines build up CO quickly; entering without ventilation is dangerous.
Çalışma alanında daima açık bir kaçış yo: An open escape route is always planned in the work area; where to jump clear when the line comes under tension is known in advance. A crowded, slippery or obstructed deck makes escaping snap-back impossible; this is why the deck preparation described in 3.1 is critical.
Çalışma havası (control air, ~7 bar) ve: Control air (~7 bar) and starting air (~25-30 bar) pressures are critical. If the starting air pressure is low, the engine cannot start; for this reason the air compressors and the pressure of the air bottles are monitored continuously. The air bottles are drained daily to remove condensate.
Çalışma izni, rutin olmayan ve enerji/at: A permit to work is issued for non-routine jobs that carry a fatal risk from energy, atmosphere or height. The ship's SMS typically makes the following categories subject to a permit: enclosed space entry, hot work (welding, grinding, open flame), working aloft (height above 2 m), working overside (outside the ship's side), electrical isolation, opening of pressurized systems and cold work in hazardous areas.
Çalışma/dinlenme ve overtime kayıtları t: Work/rest and overtime records must be consistent; the engine log, watch bill, maintenance records and rest-hours records must not contradict each other. Before an MLC/PSC inspection, the Second Engineer checks that these records are consistent. Contradictory records produce a finding and also a loss of trust.
Çalışmalar; risk seviyesine göre permit: Depending on the level of risk, work may require a permit: hot work permit, enclosed space entry permit, working aloft permit, working overside permit, electrical isolation permit. Through supervision on site, the Bosun ensures that the team does not step outside the scope of the permit.
Çalışmayan 15 ppm alarmı hem MARPOL ihla: A 15 ppm alarm that does not work is both a MARPOL violation and an inspection finding.
Çalışma–dinlenme saatleri (STCW/MLC) göz: Hours of work and rest (STCW/MLC) are observed; critical jobs are not given to fatigued personnel. If intensive maintenance is planned during a port stay, the balance between overtime and rest is calculated in advance and, if necessary, the work is spread over the schedule.
Çamaşır makinesi ne aşırı doldurulur ne: A washing machine is neither overfilled nor underloaded. An overfilled machine does not wash or rinse properly; too small a load wastes water and energy. Laundry is put in loosely, not packed in. The program is selected according to the fabric type and degree of soiling; a high temperature disinfects but damages delicate textiles.
Çamaşır makinesi ve kurutucu yüksek ener: Washing machines and dryers draw a lot of power, and this power comes from the generators. Saving energy means saving fuel (bunkers) and reducing emissions. By planning laundry runs around the high-load periods of the bridge/engine room, the steward can help balance the electrical load.
Çamaşır toplama programı genellikle yata: The laundry collection schedule is usually weekly for bedding and as needed for uniforms and personal laundry. Depending on the ship's practice, officers' and ratings' laundry may be tracked with separate schedules or labeling, but the hygiene standard is the same for both. The steward applies the labeling/bagging system meticulously so as not to mix up which laundry has come from which cabin.
Çamaşırhane ekipmanı, hijyen kaynağı old: Laundry equipment is a factor in hygiene, and it also needs maintenance. The washing machine drum is cleaned periodically with an empty high-temperature cycle or a machine cleaner; otherwise detergent residue, mold and bad odors build up. The detergent drawer and the door seal (door gasket) are cleaned regularly; these are the most common places for mold to grow.
Çamaşırhane havalandırması önemlidir; ne: Ventilation of the laundry is important; a damp, hot environment produces mold and stuffy air. Ventilation grilles are kept clean, and moisture is removed by leaving the door/vent open. Laundry trolleys and bags are washed and disinfected regularly; equipment that carries dirty laundry is a carrier of bacteria.
Çamaşırhane havalandırmasındaki fire dam: The fire damper in the laundry ventilation and the smoke/heat detectors limit the spread of a fire and give early warning. The steward makes sure this equipment is not obstructed and takes part in the checks/tests. A damper/detector that does not work is reported immediately.
Çamaşırhane hizmetleri, kamarotun mürett: Laundry services are among the steward's tasks that most directly affect crew welfare: clean bedding, dry towels and neat uniforms are a quiet but decisive part of the ship's quality of life. This task also has a serious safety dimension; the risk of lint fires and chemical mixing makes the laundry one of the hidden fire points on board. When correct sorting, chemical discipline, lint control and stock tracking come together, the laundry becomes a reliable part of both MLC compliance and fire safety. Maintaining the standard every day is the fundamental professional principle of the steward's job.
Çamaşırhane kimyasalları (özellikle çama: Laundry chemicals (especially oxidizers such as bleach, and acid-based products) are stored separately and labeled, in accordance with the SDS information. Oxidizers (hypochlorite) and acids are kept on separate shelves; accidental contact between them causes a dangerous reaction. Chemicals are kept in their original labeled containers; decanting them into unlabeled containers is both misuse and a legal violation.
Çamaşırhane mahalli her gün temizlenir;: The laundry space is cleaned every day; the floor is swept and mopped, worktops are wiped and lint/dust deposits are removed. Lint accumulating on the floor is both a slipping hazard and fuel for a fire. Drains and water outlets are checked for blockages; a blocked drain causes flooding and odors.
Çamaşırhane ve depo düzenli, temiz ve ya: The laundry and store are kept tidy, clean and free of combustible accumulations. A cluttered area increases the risk of both fire and accidents. The steward keeps these areas in order at all times and does not allow combustible waste to accumulate.
Çamaşırhane ve depo kimyasal güvenliği,: Chemical safety in the laundry and store is an important task in which the steward manages two serious risks — chemical accidents and fire — in a "seemingly harmless" area. Storage in accordance with the SDS, regular lint cleaning and working fire equipment keep these silent risks under control and protect the ship and crew.
Çamaşırhane/depo iki risk taşır: yanlış: The laundry/store carries two risks: toxic gas/corrosion from chemicals mixed incorrectly, and fire caused by lint from the dryer/washing machine igniting. Because the steward uses these areas frequently, the steward is the natural lookout for both risks and prevents them through correct practices.
Çamaşırhanedeki en ciddi yangın riski, k: The most serious fire risk in the laundry is the combustible fluff that builds up in the dryer's lint filter and exhaust duct. Accumulated lint can be ignited by the dryer's heat and lead to a fire on board; P&I and loss prevention records frequently report laundry fires caused by lint. The lint filter is therefore cleaned after EVERY cycle, and the exhaust duct is checked periodically.
Çamaşırhaneden çıkan ambalaj atığı (dete: Packaging waste from the laundry (detergent drums, plastic, cardboard) is separated in accordance with MARPOL Annex V. Plastic waste is never discharged into the sea; it is retained on board and landed in port. Empty chemical containers are handled according to the SDS instructions; some may fall into the hazardous waste category and are collected separately.
Çamaşırhanenin kesintisiz çalışması, det: Uninterrupted operation of the laundry depends on detergent, softener, bleach, stain remover and pre-treatment products being kept in stock at all times. The steward sets a minimum stock level for these products and raises a resupply request when stock approaches that level. "Reporting when it runs out" is too late; running out of stock on long voyages stops the laundry cycle.
Çapraz bulaşma (cross-contamination); çi: Cross-contamination is the transfer of pathogens from raw to cooked food, from dirty equipment to clean surfaces or from dirty hands to food. Serving utensils are kept separate, surfaces are disinfected and raw and cooked food are kept apart. The WHO "Five Keys to Safer Food" (keep clean, separate raw and cooked, cook thoroughly, keep food at safe temperatures, use safe water and raw materials) form the framework of service discipline.
Çapraz bulaşma, çiğ gıdadaki (özellikle: Cross-contamination is the transfer of pathogens from raw food (especially raw meat/chicken/fish) to cooked or ready-to-eat food. The cook uses separate cutting boards, knives and containers for raw and cooked food; color-coded equipment (e.g. red = raw meat, green = vegetables) makes this separation easier. After handling raw meat, the cook does not move on to another task until hands, surfaces and equipment have been washed and disinfected.
Çapraz bulaşmanın en tehlikeli yolu, çiğ: The most dangerous route of cross-contamination is preparing raw meat/poultry/fish and cooked food or salad with the same board/knife. Professional kitchens use color-coded cutting boards (e.g. red: raw meat, blue: raw fish, green: vegetables/fruit, white: cooked food/dairy). In preparation support, the steward applies this separation meticulously.
Çarşaf, nevresim, yastık kılıfı ve havlu: Sheets, duvet covers, pillowcases and towels are changed on a regular schedule; the typical standard is once a week, and immediately if soiled or in case of illness. Used linen goes straight into the laundry trolley/bag; it is never put on the floor or shaken out (shaking spreads dust and microorganisms into the air). When making up the bunk, the corners are folded neatly and the pillow is placed tidily; this is a sign of both comfort and good order during inspections.
Çatal-bıçak diziminde standart düzen izl: A standard layout is followed when setting the cutlery, and the cutlery is kept spotless and clean; a stained fork makes the whole preparation look careless. Depending on the season and the voyage, the setting is kept simple, but the attention to detail never drops.
Çatal-bıçak ve servis araçları yıkanıp k: Cutlery and serving utensils are washed, dried and put away in a clean cupboard; cutlery put away damp picks up stains and germs. This cycle is repeated at every meal.
Çatışma kaçınılmaz hale geldiğinde son d: When a collision becomes unavoidable, the aim is to minimise the angle and speed of impact with a last-minute manoeuvre (COLREG Rules 8 and 17) and with the engine; if possible, the ship is manoeuvred so that the impact is taken in the bow area (the strongest structure). Immediately after a collision the Master simultaneously manages: checking for injured persons, assessing flooding, damage control, the risk of pollution and communication with the other ship. If the two ships are locked together, the decision to separate can increase flooding; this assessment is made carefully.
Çelik bobin (steel coil), levha, kütük (: Steel coils, plates, logs and breakbulk cargoes require special lashing. Steel coils are secured against shifting with wedges/chocks and lashings; wrong lashing leads to a deadly shift inside the hold. The Chief Officer applies the correct pattern for each cargo type in accordance with the CSS Code and the CSM.
Çelik gemi gövdesi, deniz suyu, klorür,: A steel ship's hull is under intense attack from seawater, chlorides, oxygen and UV radiation. Once corrosion starts, it accelerates geometrically: a small rust spot can affect hundreds of square meters of surface in 6 months. The Bosun's basic task is to find and remove "small rust spots" before they grow and to maintain the integrity of the protective paint system.
Çelik gemi, tuzlu su, nem, güneş ve meka: A steel ship is under constant attack from salt water, humidity, sun and mechanical wear. Corrosion is not just a cosmetic problem but a safety issue that threatens structural integrity; thinning plates, cracked welds and corroded deck equipment put cargo safety and the safety of life at risk. This is why surface protection (the paint system) and regular maintenance directly affect the ship's class certificate and PSC (port State control) compliance.
Çelik sapan keskin köşelerden geçerken y: If no softeners (softener/packing) are used where a wire sling passes over sharp edges, the wire is crushed and breaks. A sling is not knotted or kinked and is not bent under load. When not in use, it is stored dry, hung up and protected from corrosion; it is not dragged along the floor.
Çelik tel halatlar (kreyn, vinç, mooring: Steel wire ropes (crane, winch and mooring wires) are greased against corrosion and internal friction; the grease both prevents external corrosion and reduces friction between the wires. Before greasing, the wire is cleaned and inspected for damage (broken wires/birdcaging/crushing). If the limit for the number of broken wires is exceeded, the wire rope is replaced.
Çelik tel sapanlar zamanla yorulur ve ha: Wire rope slings fatigue and become damaged over time. Defects looked for during inspection: broken wires, kinks (permanent bends/loops), bird-caging (wires opening out like a cage), excessive wear, corrosion (rust), heat damage (discoloration) and damage at the eye/termination area (ferrule/splice). A specified number of broken wires (ISO 4309 criteria) takes the equipment out of service.
Çelik ve dökme demir metalurjisinin teme: It forms the basis of the metallurgy of steel and cast iron. The horizontal axis is the percentage of carbon (0–6.67%), the vertical axis the temperature.
Çelik ızgara zeminler (floor plates) ve: Steel grating floors (floor plates) and platforms are degreased regularly. The oil is dissolved using hot water, detergent/degreaser and a brush, and the surface is rinsed so that it does not become slippery. Deposits that fall between the gratings are also cleaned out; otherwise oil is carried down into the bilge below.
Çevre koruma, modern denizciliğin en sık: Environmental protection is the most strictly inspected and most heavily penalized area of modern shipping. The Chief Officer succeeds by instilling in the deck team a culture of honest record keeping, response equipment that is always ready, and the discipline of "not a single drop goes into the sea".
Çevre uyumluluğu, Baş Mühendis için tekn: For the Chief Engineer, environmental compliance is a test of honesty and discipline more than of technical knowledge. Equipment may fail and operations may become difficult, but correct recording and proper disposal are always the only legitimate course. A single false entry can destroy a career of many years and the company's reputation. A culture of transparent, traceable records that match reality exactly protects both the sea and the ship.
Çevre uyumsuzluğu near-miss/non-conformi: Environmental non-compliance is reported as a near-miss/non-conformity; deliberate violations such as a magic pipe (illegal bypass line) are a crime and expose the company to heavy penalties. A culture of transparent and honest record keeping is the Chief Officer's responsibility.
Çevresel uyumlulukta kaptanın gücü tekno: In environmental compliance the Master's strength lies not in technology but in honest records and the culture on board. A correctly kept ORB is the difference between a fine of millions of dollars and a PSC inspection of a few hours. The Master treats protecting the marine environment not only as a legal obligation but as part of professional honour.
Çevrim dört stroktan oluşur: emme (intak: The cycle consists of four strokes: intake, compression, power and exhaust. One power stroke is produced every two crankshaft revolutions (720°). The intake and exhaust valves are timed by the camshaft; valve overlap allows the cylinder to be scavenged with fresh air and increases turbocharger efficiency.
Çeşitlilik, menü döngüsünü uzatarak (örn: Variety is achieved by lengthening the menu cycle (e.g. from 7 days to 10-14 days), changing cooking techniques (rotating baking, grilling, steaming and boiling) and adding recipes from different culinary cultures. The cook breaks the monotony by creating inventive variations even from the limited ingredients on hand. Variety also supports balanced nutrition (different food groups) and a continuous supply of micronutrients.
Çift bumbalı vinç: İki bumba ile daha ge: Twin-jib crane: gives a wider working area with two jibs.
Çift karabinalı (twin/double lanyard) si: The purpose of the twin (double) lanyard system is for the person to stay attached to a secure point by at least one karabiner at all times ("100% tie-off"). When changing position, one karabiner is clipped to the new point, and only then is the other unclipped; in this way the connection is never broken. Climbing with a single karabiner and unclipping from time to time creates a fatal fall window.
Çizelge, gemiye katılım/iniş (crew chang: The watch bill is updated for crew changes (joining/leaving), leave and sickness. No watch is left uncovered; if there is a shortage of personnel, the Chief Engineer and the company are informed and a temporary arrangement is made (e.g. reducing the workload, making use of the port stay).
Çizimi okumak için stajyer \"akışı takip: To read the drawing, the cadet learns the method of "following the flow": tracing the line from the source (tank/pump) to the destination (equipment/tank) and identifying the valves and instruments along the way. A non-return valve indicates that the flow is one-way, a relief valve indicates overpressure protection and a three-way valve indicates diversion.
Çiğ tavuk ve et, Salmonella ve Campyloba: Raw poultry and meat carry serious pathogens such as Salmonella and Campylobacter; if these pathogens pass to cooked food, they cause an outbreak on board. After each use, the board and knife are washed and sanitized, and hands are washed after handling raw products.
Çok sayıda çarpışma ve karaya oturma rap: A common factor in many collision and grounding reports is "inadequate look-out": the OOW on a one-man watch being busy with radar/ECDIS/paperwork and not looking outside, night vision discipline breaking down, or the lookout not being called to duty. The AB's presence and effective reporting break this chain.
Çok uluslu ekiplerde ortak dil (working: In multinational crews, a common language (working language) and open communication reduce accidents. The Second Engineer strengthens the safety culture by encouraging a fair distribution of work, respectful leadership and everyone's right to say "stop" (stop-work authority). Reported errors/near-misses are not punished; they are turned into learning (just culture).
Çok uluslu ekiplerde ortak çalışma dili: In multinational teams, a common working language (usually English + maritime jargon) is used. The Bosun confirms by read-back that the instruction has been understood. An order that is not understood is carried out wrongly on site, and that means an accident. Visual demonstration and showing by doing are the most effective ways to overcome the language barrier.
Çok yumuşak GM ise \"tender\" gemi yarat: A GM that is too small makes a "tender" ship; the rolling period lengthens and the risk of listing increases. By keeping GM within the optimum range, the Chief Officer balances safety, passenger/crew comfort and cargo safety.
Çok yüksek GM, kısa ve sert yalpa periyo: A very high GM produces a short, violent rolling period (T = 2π·k/√(g·GM)). This increases the inertial forces on container stacks and lashing equipment and raises the risk of crew fatigue and injury. A stiff ship is uncomfortable and dangerous for cargo safety.
Çoklu-gaz dedektörlerinin kalibrasyon se: The calibration certificate of multi-gas detectors must not be more than one year old, and a bump test (function test with a known gas) must be carried out regularly (before each use). An instrument that has not been calibrated or bump-tested can give a false safe reading and cause a death. The Chief Officer checks the instrument records and the validity of the calibration.
Çoğu gemide ayrı subay mess'i (officers': Most ships have a separate officers' mess and crew mess; the cook serves the same menu to both, with an appropriate service arrangement. Self-service (buffet) or set-menu service may be used; for the night watch, food is left in hot-holding units. Cleanliness of the service area, cutlery hygiene and the drinks station are the responsibility of the cook/mess man.
Çoğu ticari gemide elektro-hidrolik düme: Most merchant ships have electro-hydraulic steering gear: ram type (cylinder-tiller) or rotary vane. Hydraulic pumps (usually variable displacement) move the rams; the gear is controlled from the bridge by telemotor or electric signal. The Third/Fourth Engineer monitors the oil, pressure and mechanical condition of this system.
Çoğu zero-tolerance politikasında doğrul: Under most zero-tolerance policies, a confirmed positive results in summary dismissal and sign-off at the first suitable port. Repatriation is governed by the MLC; however, the contract and the policy may provide that in the case of a positive result the repatriation costs can be recovered from the seafarer. The Master makes sure that the whole process is documented and that the seafarer's rights (for example, the right to ask for a confirmation test) are not breached.
Çoğu şirket, mürettebatın gemide kalış s: Most companies provide for an appraisal form filled in at the end of a crew member's time on board or periodically. This form scores dimensions such as technical competence, safety awareness, teamwork, leadership, discipline and development potential, and is the basis for decisions on promotion and re-employment. The Master or a senior officer makes an assessment based on observation, supported by concrete examples and shared with the person.
Çöp miktarını azaltmak için compactor (s: A compactor, a comminuter (food waste grinder) and an incinerator can be used to reduce the volume of garbage. Comminuted food waste ground to less than 25 mm may be discharged beyond 3 nm. Use of the incinerator is subject to Annexes V and VI; incineration of substances such as Annex I/II/III cargo residues and PVC (except in a type-approved incinerator) is prohibited, and incineration may be restricted in port and in Special Areas. The Chief Officer ensures that this equipment is used correctly and that its use is recorded.
Çöp poşetleri ağzı bağlı, sızdırmaz şeki: Garbage bags are carried tied and leak-tight; they are not left standing in alleyways or escape routes. As food waste causes odors and attracts pests, it is emptied as a priority. By separating correctly, the steward also makes accurate entries in the Garbage Record Book possible (responsibility for the record usually lies with a deck officer, but the data from the spaces comes from the steward).
Çöp sınıflandırma kategorileri (A-K aras: Garbage categories (11 categories, A to K).
Çözme sırasında halatlar köprüüstünün ta: During unmooring, lines are let go in a set order on the bridge's instructions; usually slack lines first and the "last line" last. The cadet observes the coordination with the shore linesmen and the timing needed to keep the line from falling into the water or fouling the propeller. Synchronizing the single-up (reducing to single lines) and let-go commands with the maneuver is critical.
Çıkış frekansı, rotorun devir hızı ve ku: The output frequency depends on the rotor speed and the number of poles.
The output is not controlled by feedback. The operator or a timer sets the value and the system works accordingly.
Çıkış sürekli ölçülerek set değeri ile k: The output is measured continuously and compared with the set value. The error signal goes to the controller and a correction is made.
Ödenmemiş maaş (wages outstanding), PSC: Unpaid wages (wages outstanding) are treated by PSC as a serious violation of the MLC and can lead to the ship being detained; the ITF also inspects ships in port for unpaid wages and, if necessary, has them arrested. When the Master notices a payment problem, he or she reports it at once to the DPA; the shipowner's financial difficulties cannot delay a seafarer's wages, and this situation is an early sign of the risk of abandonment.
Ölçü aletleri hassas ekipmandır; düşürme: Measuring instruments are precision equipment; dropping them, letting them rust or storing them incorrectly spoils their calibration. A micrometer is zeroed before use and stored clean and oiled after use.
Ölçülen ullage, geminin trim ve list değ: The measured ullage is corrected for the ship's trim and list with the trim correction in the tank calibration tables. The corrected ullage gives the gross observed volume (GOV) from the ullage table.
Ölçüm gerilimi devre nominal gerilimine: The test voltage is chosen according to the rated voltage of the circuit: 500 V DC is applied for 440 V circuits and 5000 V DC for 6.6 kV circuits.
Ölçümler trim ve density ile düzeltilir;: The readings are corrected for trim and density, and the net cargo is calculated by draft survey. The ship's figure is compared with the shore figure; if the difference exceeds the tolerance, a Letter of Protest is issued.
Ölüm, ciddi yaralanma, doğum, kaybolma (: Events such as a death, a serious injury, a birth or a disappearance (man overboard) are entered in the OLB at once and usually require a witness signature. These entries are primary evidence in consular, insurance and judicial proceedings. A back-dated entry destroys its value as evidence in law and exposes the Master to personal liability.
Ön işlem kimyasalları da kontrollü kulla: Pre-treatment chemicals are also used in a controlled way; too much bleach wears out fabric and causes yellowing/thinning. The steward avoids the "bleach for every stain" approach, applies the right product to the right stain and follows the washing instructions on the fabric care label.
Ön koşullar: tank oksijeninin hacmen ≤%8: Preconditions: verification that the tank oxygen content is ≤8% by volume, the IGS fully operational, the washing line and machines tested, a check for hydrocarbon leaks, and a briefing on duties. The AB assists with bringing the machines into service in the correct sequence, the hose/line connections and the leak-tightness checks. The program of washing in the approved COW manual is followed.
Ön şarj düşerse akümülatör kapasitesi az: If the pre-charge falls, the accumulator capacity decreases and the pump cuts in frequently; if it is too high, the oil volume cannot be used and the shock damping is lost. The pressure can only be read correctly after the system side has been depressurised.
Önce Auto Yaw ile baş stabilize edilir,: First the heading is stabilised with Auto Yaw, then the surge and sway axes are brought into Auto Position in a controlled way. The position setpoint is chosen close to the current position; no sudden large setpoint or heading change is given.
Önce brilliance/contrast ve background,: First the brilliance/contrast and background are set, then a suitable range scale, orientation and motion are selected. Unstabilised head-up gives a simple relative picture; gyro-stabilised course-up or north-up makes comparison with the chart and true bearings easier. Relative motion and true motion are the movement reference of the whole radar picture, not of the target vectors.
Önceliklendirme yapılmadan tek kişiye bi: The basic root causes were loading several critical tasks onto one person without prioritisation, not using a short time-critical checklist, and skipping confirmation of orders between the bridge and the engine room.
Önemli fazlar: Ferrit (α-demir, yumuşak): Important phases: ferrite (α-iron, soft), austenite (γ-iron, the high-temperature phase), cementite (Fe₃C, hard and brittle), pearlite (a mixture of ferrite and cementite).
Önlem olarak İkinci Zabit; her sefer baş: As a precaution, at the start of each voyage the Second Officer calculates the total time difference and its direction, divides the change over the days, obtains the Master's approval, announces it to the crew and enters every change consistently in the logbook and the rest records. Keeping the UTC reference fixed and noting the UTC equivalent in critical records prevents the great majority of errors from the outset.
Önleme ve hedefli mücadele yetersiz kala: In a widespread infestation where prevention and targeted control are not enough, professional ULV (ultra low volume) treatment or fumigation may be needed; this is coordinated by the person designated by the ship and is usually carried out in port with licensed operators/the port health authority. Fumigation uses powerful, toxic gases/chemicals; therefore human safety is the absolute priority. Before application, the area is evacuated, food is protected/removed and entry is prohibited.
Önlemler: çalışma alanını yanıcılardan a: Precautions: clear the work area of combustibles, close nearby openings, have a fire extinguisher and a fire watch present, test the atmosphere, and keep the area under watch for a set time after the work is finished (risk of a spark starting a delayed fire). Hot work is particularly restricted on tankers and near flammable cargo.
Önleyici bakım ve arıza analizi, genç mü: Preventive maintenance and failure analysis is the area where the junior engineer turns from a "repairer" into a "diagnostician". The engineer who sees the cause rather than the symptom, and catches a small deviation before it grows, is the engine room's most valuable safeguard.
Örnek: Kazan buhar basıncı kontrolü — ba: Example: boiler steam pressure control — the pressure sensor measures and the controller adjusts the burner.

Örneğin \"Maintain a safe engineering wa: For example, the competence "Maintain a safe engineering watch" is filled with watch participation records, "Operate main and auxiliary machinery" with system operation observations and "Maintenance and repair of shipboard machinery" with maintenance participation records. Knowing which task supports which competence, the cadet progresses through the book in a balanced way.
Örneğin bir silindirin egzoz sıcaklığı d: For example, if the exhaust temperature of one cylinder deviates noticeably from the others (deviation), that cylinder may have a combustion problem, an injector fault or a fuel index imbalance. By learning these correlations, the cadet grasps the physical meaning behind the panel readings.
Özel günler, monoton sefer rutinini kıra: Special days are important opportunities to break the monotonous voyage routine and lift morale. The cook prepares cakes/special desserts for birthdays, and special menus specific to the culture concerned for religious festivals (e.g. Eid al-Fitr/Eid al-Adha, Christmas, Diwali) and national days. In a multinational team, observing the important days of each major group gives the feeling that no one is forgotten.
Özellikle kritik ekipmanlarda (steering: Especially for critical equipment (steering gear, generators, fire/bilge pumps, emergency systems), testing requires not just a record but live functional verification: the emergency generator coming on load, the fire pump delivering pressure, the bilge alarm actually being triggered.
Özellikle tankerlerde vetting (SIRE insp: Vetting (SIRE inspection) is critical, especially on tankers; a negative vetting leaves the ship out of charter. SIRE 2.0 is risk-based and focused on the human factor; the inspector directly questions the competence of the engine team (open questions, hardware/process/human element).
Özellikle yakıt transferi gibi taşma (ov: Jobs with a risk of overflow, especially fuel transfers, are managed carefully at night with threshold warnings. The orders remind the watch of the checks that prevent overflow (level monitoring, confirming valve positions).
Özellikle yakıt tüketim ve performans ve: Fuel consumption and performance data in particular have legal consequences in charter party settlements and in EU MRV/IMO DCS reporting; accuracy is therefore vital.
Üretici/servis sağlayıcıların uzaktan te: Remote access to OT by manufacturers/service providers for diagnostics is common but is a major risk. The ETO keeps remote access under control: access is enabled only when needed, monitored, logged and closed afterwards. A permanently open remote connection is one of the most dangerous attack surfaces.
Üretilen buhar gemi ısıtma ihtiyaçları (: The steam produced is used for the ship's heating needs (fuel heating, accommodation heating, fresh water production). At full load it can allow the auxiliary boiler to be shut down.
Üretilen gerilimin frekansı rotor hızına: The frequency of the voltage generated depends on the rotor speed.
Üretilen suyun tuzluluğu salinometre ile: The salinity of the water produced is measured continuously by the salinometer; if the salt content exceeds a set limit (typically about 10 ppm), a solenoid dump valve diverts the water overboard or to waste instead of to the tank. In this way salty or poor water does not get into the fresh water tank.
Üretim kapasitesi HT soğutma suyu sıcakl: The production capacity depends directly on the HT cooling water temperature. If the engine load is low, the temperature falls and production decreases. The typical capacity is 10–30 tonnes per day.
Üst yapı buzlanması (icing/superstructur: Superstructure icing (icing) can adversely affect the center of gravity and stability; ice removal on deck is planned. Personnel use suitable PPE and take precautions against frostbite/slipping; work on open deck is restricted.
Ütü, kullanılmadığında mutlaka fişten çe: When not in use, the iron is always unplugged and left to cool. A hot iron forgotten on fabric or a combustible surface is one of the common causes of laundry fires. After ironing, the steward makes sure the iron is switched off and unplugged and is not put away until it has cooled completely.
Ütüleme, kumaş tipine göre sıcaklık ayar: Ironing requires the temperature to be set according to the fabric type: cotton is ironed at high heat and synthetics at low heat; the wrong temperature melts synthetic fabric or yellows and scorches cotton. The ironing board is set up properly, the iron is left standing upright, and it is never left switched on and unattended while hot. The risk of burns with a steam iron is high; care is taken with the water reservoir and steam vents.
Üç fazlı sistemde stator sargıları birbi: In a three-phase system, the stator windings are placed 120 electrical degrees apart. This arrangement produces three sinusoidal voltages with a 120° phase difference from one another.
Üç fazlı tam dalga köprü doğrultucu, gem: The three-phase full-wave bridge rectifier is the type most commonly used in ship power electronics. It uses 6 diodes or SCRs. It produces 6 pulses per cycle and gives a DC output with low ripple.
Üç kontrol bilgisayarı kullanılması, bil: Using three control computers allows majority voting between the computers and the rejection of a computer that has failed. The number of IO units is typically much higher in DP 2: there is a separate IO unit for each sensor set, each position reference system, the power supply and each thruster.
Üç terminalli (anot, katot, gate) yarı i: A three-terminal (anode, cathode, gate) semiconductor device. It is triggered by a gate signal and stays in conduction until the anode current falls below the holding current.
Üç yıl üst üste D veya bir kez E rating,: A D rating for three consecutive years, or an E rating, requires a corrective action plan.
A D rating for three consecutive years, or an E rating, requires a corrective action plan; efficiency is both a regulatory and a cost issue.
Üçüncü Zabit düzenli emniyet rondları ya: The Third Officer carries out regular safety rounds to catch housekeeping defects and corrects them, or has them corrected, immediately. For recurring problems, the Third Officer briefs the team; housekeeping is the continuous responsibility of the whole crew, not of one person.
Üçüncü Zabit, rondlarında şunları arar:: On rounds, the Third Officer looks for: obstructed fire-hose cabinets/extinguishers, material on escape routes, a deteriorated lifebuoy light, liferaft lashings stuck with paint (release not free), a hydrant box seized with rust and a fire door wedged open.
Üçüncü Zabit, rutin rondlarda emniyet ek: On routine rounds, the Third Officer picks up defects in safety equipment: an SCBA low-pressure whistle that does not work, a weak lifeboat battery, a cracked fire hose coupling, a broken EEBD seal, a leaking hydrant valve gland. Each one is opened as a defect.
Üçüncü Zabit; gündem hazırlar (önceki ak: The Third Officer prepares the agenda (previous actions, new near-misses, drill evaluations, inspection findings, suggestions), determines the participants and runs the meeting. The meeting is conducted so that everyone can speak, with the focus on solutions rather than blame.
Üçüncü Zabit; roket paraşüt fişeği, el m: The Third Officer tracks rocket parachute flares, hand flares, buoyant smoke signals (pyrotechnics), the HRU (Hydrostatic Release Unit), liferaft service dates, EPIRB/SART/portable radio batteries and immersion suit check/seam test dates. Each has a different validity period and service interval.
Üçüncü/Dördüncü Mühendis bu eğilimleri l: The Third/Fourth Engineer follows these trends through successive entries in the logbook and on the trend screens of the alarm/monitoring system. Early action as a trend approaches its limits prevents a sudden trip and a major breakdown.
Üçüncü/Dördüncü Mühendis için sıcak ve i: For the Third/Fourth Engineer, safety in hot work and isolated work is a habit earned through disciplined adherence to procedure. A single skipped step — pressure not released, isolation not verified, a fire watch withdrawn — can cancel out dozens of correct steps.
Üçüncü/Dördüncü Mühendis için yardımcı m: For the Third/Fourth Engineer, success in auxiliary machinery maintenance does not come from being able to "take equipment apart and put it back together", but from a discipline that is planned (PMS), isolated (LOTO), measured (clearance/ΔP/vibration) and recorded (ORB/PMS). A bearing noise or a filter ΔP caught early prevents an unplanned blackout or a pollution incident in mid-ocean.
Üçüncü/Dördüncü Mühendis, ballast operas: Before a ballast operation, the Third/Fourth Engineer verifies the line-up: correct suction/discharge selection, sea chest open, status of the overboard valve, and closing of the valves that prevent water from passing into unintended tanks. An incorrect line-up leads to list/trim problems through the wrong tank being flooded or through backflow.
Üçüncü/Dördüncü Mühendis, basit elektrik: In simple electrical maintenance, the Third/Fourth Engineer works with the electrical engineer/ETO: tightness of motor terminal boxes, megger (insulation resistance) measurement, greasing of motor bearings, checks of contactors/overcurrent relays, and engine room lighting (especially escape route and emergency lighting). All electrical work is done with isolation and LOTO.
Üçüncü/Dördüncü Mühendis, hazırlığı tama: After completing the preparations, the Third/Fourth Engineer hands over the engine room as "ready for UMS" and records this; the duty engineer and the bridge are informed.
Üçüncü/Dördüncü Mühendis, her cihazın ha: The Third/Fourth Engineer must know which level (alarm/slowdown/shutdown) each device is linked to, its setpoint and its test method. Tests are usually done without actually stopping the engine, by simulation (imitating the sensor signal) or with an independent test function.
Üçüncü/Dördüncü Mühendis, işin \"rutin\": The Third/Fourth Engineer knows that a job looking "routine" does not make it any less dangerous. Many engine room fires in the past started when sparks from a short grinding job, done without a permit or without supervision, ignited an oil-soaked rag or bilge residue.
Üçüncü/Dördüncü Mühendis; breaker'ı açar: The Third/Fourth Engineer opens the breaker, locks it, tags it and, where possible, verifies with a "try-out" (start attempt) that the equipment is actually de-energized. Stop valves are closed and locked, pressure is released, and "stored energy" (accumulators, pressurized lines, springs) is made safe.
İdarelerin TRB tamamlanma kriterleri far: Administrations' criteria for TRB completion may differ; the flag State's guidance must be read. Some Administrations require a minimum number of repetitions of certain tasks, others look for minimum evidence in each function. The cadet should learn the specific requirements of their own flag at the start of the voyage.
İdeal Rankine çevriminde türbin ve pompa: In the ideal Rankine cycle the turbine and pump are assumed to be isentropic. In reality the isentropic efficiency of the turbine and the moisture content, especially at low load, noticeably affect the net work obtained.
İdeal akışkan için bir akım çizgisi boyu: For an ideal fluid the total energy along a streamline is constant.
İdeal gaz denklemi PV = mRT veya Pv = RT: The ideal gas equation is written PV = mRT or Pv = RT, where P is the absolute pressure, V the total volume, m the mass, R the specific gas constant and T the absolute temperature.
İdeal gaz denklemi, düşük basınç ve yüks: The ideal gas equation is a good approximation for real gases at low pressure and high temperature. The deviation increases at high pressure or low temperature (close to a phase change).
İdeal gaz için izotermik süreçte Boyle-M: For an ideal gas the Boyle-Mariotte law applies in an isothermal process.
İdeal pratik, haftalık veya iki haftalık: The ideal practice is a weekly or two-weekly signing cycle. With this rhythm, the trainer assesses fresh entries and shows the cadet the areas for development. Signing hundreds of entries accumulated until the end of the voyage all at once both burdens the trainer and lowers the quality of the assessment.
İdeal trim, gemi tipine ve hız profiline: The ideal trim varies with ship type and speed profile; on modern container ships, "trim optimization" software gives 2-5% fuel savings. The Chief Officer sets the arrival trim as requested by the charterer (usually even keel or slightly by the stern). List is kept below 0.5° wherever possible; otherwise lashing forces are not evenly distributed.
İhlal kaçınılmazsa (örn. acil durum, uzu: If a violation is unavoidable (e.g. an emergency, a long maneuver), it must be recorded with its real reason and compensatory rest must be given. Systematically "fitting" the records within the limits is, when detected, a ground for a serious finding (deficiency) and even detention.
İki ağ kolunun fiziksel olarak ayrı güze: It must be verified that the two network branches run along physically separate routes and are not lost together in a single fire or flooding event. This is the basic check that shows whether dual network redundancy exists only on paper or also in the field.
İki aşamalı boşaltma: Önce alarm (sesli: Two-stage release: first the alarm (audible + visual), a time delay (e.g. 60 seconds), then the CO₂ release.
İki bağımsız ECDIS'li gemilerde her ikis: On ships with two independent ECDIS units, it is checked that both have the same up-to-date ENCs and settings; otherwise the backup cannot be relied on if the primary fails.
İki bağımsız GNSS alıcısı, dead reckonin: Two independent GNSS receivers, dead reckoning (DR) capability and the skill to take terrestrial fixes provide redundancy. If GNSS is lost, the officer must be able to continue navigating by DR and radar or visual fixes.
İki eğri arasında: Yaş buhar (iki fazlı: Between the two curves: the wet vapour (two-phase mixture) region.
İki farklı metalin birleşim noktalarında: It is based on the EMF created by the temperature difference at the junctions of two different metals (the Seebeck effect). Type K (Ni-Cr / Ni-Al) is the most common and is used between −200 °C and 1260 °C.
İki gemi yan yana geldiğinde mooring lin: When the two ships are alongside each other, the mooring line arrangement is specific to STS; head, stern, breast and spring lines are rigged evenly between the two ships. While the POAC (Person in Overall Advisory Control) carries out the overall coordination, the Chief Officer manages the work on deck on board their own ship.
İki generator'ı paralele almak için gele: To parallel two generators, the voltage, frequency and phase sequence of the incoming machine must match those of the live busbar. The ETO or the watchkeeping engineer watches the synchroscope (or the auto-synchronizer), keeps the frequency slightly higher than the busbar (slow clockwise rotation) and closes the breaker as the synchroscope approaches the 11–12 o'clock position (as the phase difference approaches zero). Closing at the wrong phase angle produces a large transient current and a mechanical shock, damaging the shaft and gears.
