İki iç içe kontrol döngüsünden oluşur. D: It consists of two nested control loops. The outer (master) loop controls the main variable and the inner (slave) loop controls an intermediate variable.
İki jeneratörü aynı baraya bağlamak için: To connect two generators to the same busbar, their frequency, voltage, phase sequence and phase angle must be equal.
İki kademeli koruma: Birinci kademe alar: Two-stage protection: the first stage gives an alarm and warns the operator. The second stage shuts down the burner automatically.
İki katman pratikte iç içe geçer: bir kl: In practice the two layers are intertwined: a class surveyor can close both statutory and class items in the same visit. The Master must know which item belongs to which regime, because a condition of class (CoC) or a memorandum has a different timetable and consequence from a statutory deficiency. If a CoC is not closed in time, class is suspended, which automatically takes the ship out of service and out of insurance cover.
İki radar varsa aynı ayar ve range'de ko: If there are two radars, they should not be used like copies of each other with the same settings and range. Independent pictures that reduce common blind spots are created with different bands, ranges, pulse/presentation and clutter settings.
İki yaygın BWMS tipi vardır: UV (ultravi: There are two common types of BWMS: UV (ultraviolet) systems disinfect with a filter + UV reactor, and electrochlorination (EC) systems disinfect by generating chlorine in situ from seawater. The Third/Fourth Engineer monitors filter backflush, UV lamp/sensor condition, TRO (Total Residual Oxidant) measurement and neutralization (neutralizing the chlorine during discharge) parameters. In EC systems, hydrogen gas ventilation is critical for preventing explosions.
İki zamanlı crosshead motorlarda piston: On two-stroke crosshead engines, the piston is in two parts: the crown and the skirt. The crown is made of heat-resistant alloy steel, and the skirt is a ferrous casting.
İki zamanlı motorda her krank mili dönüş: In a two-stroke engine there is one power stroke for every crankshaft revolution. As the piston descends it uncovers the ports, and the scavenge air drives the burnt gases out of the cylinder and fills it with fresh air.
İki zamanlı motorlarda emme supabı yoktu: Two-stroke engines have no intake valve (the scavenge ports are in the cylinder liner). In four-stroke engines both intake and exhaust valves are in the cover.
İki zamanlı motorlarda geri yol operasyo: On two-stroke engines reversing is achieved by a cam or electronic changeover (by software on ME engines).
İki zamanlı motorlarda yalnızca egzoz su: Two-stroke engines have only an exhaust valve. Four-stroke engines have intake and exhaust valves.
Two-stroke engines have only an exhaust valve, which is actuated hydraulically or pneumatically. On four-stroke engines the intake and exhaust valves are operated mechanically through the camshaft.
İki zamanlı çevrimde her krank dönüşünde: In the two-stroke cycle one power stroke is produced for every revolution of the crankshaft: compression as the piston rises, fuel injection and combustion at the top, the power stroke as it descends, and scavenging and exhaust at the bottom. Modern large engines use uniflow scavenging: scavenge air enters through ports at the bottom of the liner and the exhaust leaves through a single exhaust valve in the cylinder cover; this gives a clean charge and high efficiency.
İkinci Mühendis, T/C surging (ani hava g: The Second Engineer takes T/C surging (a sudden air blow-back noise and vibration) seriously; surging may result from heavy weather, sudden load changes, a fouled turbine or a single-cylinder fault, and causes mechanical damage to the T/C blades.
İkinci Mühendis, acil kapatma (emergency: During the housekeeping round, the Second Engineer verifies that the emergency shutdown points (emergency stop, remote shut-off, quick-closing valve) can be reached at all times. These points are marked consistently with the muster list and the fire plan.
İkinci Mühendis, anormal bir parametreyi: The Second Engineer does not interpret an abnormal parameter on its own; it is evaluated together with related parameters (e.g. high exhaust temperature + low Pmax + high Fe) and the likely root cause hypothesis is tested. This approach avoids costly and risky methods such as trial-and-error parts swapping.
İkinci Mühendis, bakım planlamasının ve: The Second Engineer is in practice responsible for maintenance planning and the organization of watches, and puts the Chief Engineer's strategic decisions into practice on the job. The ETO is responsible for automation, electrical and high-voltage systems and has a critical role on modern ships. Ratings report to a specific engineer and receive their work orders from that engineer.
İkinci Mühendis, bilge well seviyelerini: The Second Engineer monitors the bilge well levels and the operation of the high-level bilge alarms daily. A rising bilge level is the warning sign of a leak (seawater, cooling water, oil) and is followed up until the source is found. Bilge pumping records are kept consistent with the ORB under MARPOL Annex I.
İkinci Mühendis, bu veriyi cylinder oil: The Second Engineer evaluates this data together with the optimization of cylinder oil consumption (feed rate in g/kWh). When changing to low-sulfur fuel (MARPOL Annex VI VLSFO/MGO), a change to a lower-BN cylinder oil is required; the wrong BN choice leads either to cold corrosion or to deposit/blow-by problems.
İkinci Mühendis, denetim öncesi bir \"de: Rather than a "deep clean" before an inspection, the Second Engineer aims for continuous, standard order. An inspector can easily tell whether the order is "natural" or "last-minute cosmetics" from the way the hoses are coiled, the tool board and the bottom of the bilges.
İkinci Mühendis, devir standardını (chec: The Second Engineer sets the handover standard (checklist/format) and checks that it is applied. "Verbal, incomplete" handovers are a main source of errors; in particular, if a bypassed protection or an ongoing isolation is not handed over, an accident results.
İkinci Mühendis, gemi test kiti ile düze: The Second Engineer carries out regular (usually weekly) tests with the ship's test kit and records the results in the log. If the nitrite/inhibitor level is low, the calculated quantity of DCA/corrosion inhibitor is added. The correct quantity matters, because overdosing can also cause waste and side effects.
İkinci Mühendis, hafta başında (genelde: At the start of the week (usually Monday), the Second Engineer takes the 1–4 week due/overdue list from the PMS. Jobs are ranked by safety criticality, the class/PSC schedule, the port/sea status (at sea or in port), spare parts availability and personnel availability. Jobs that must be done during a port stay (requiring immobilization) are put in a separate bucket and coordinated with the Chief Engineer + Master.
İkinci Mühendis, işleri personelin ehliy: The Second Engineer allocates jobs according to the qualifications and experience of the personnel. The Third/Fourth Engineer carries out maintenance of the equipment in their area of responsibility (generators, boiler, purifiers, auxiliary systems); the fitter and oilers do the mechanical dismantling/assembly, cleaning and carrying. For jobs done for the first time or high-risk jobs, the Second Engineer personally supervises on site.
İkinci Mühendis, kapanan iş emirlerini g: The Second Engineer reviews closed work orders daily and rejects incomplete/superficial close-outs. If the feedback is poor, a finding (deficiency) arises at the next survey because of insufficient evidence.
İkinci Mühendis, makine dairesi yedekler: The Second Engineer tracks the ROB (Remaining On Board) of engine room spares through the PMS stock module. Minimum/maximum levels are defined for critical spares (injectors, fuel pump elements, separator gasket sets, compressor valve sets, main engine bearings); when the minimum is reached, a requisition is generated automatically. SOLAS and class require certain critical spares to be carried on board.
İkinci Mühendis, makine dairesini bölgel: The Second Engineer divides the engine room into zones and assigns responsibility for the cleanliness and order of each zone to the watch engineers and the oilmen/wipers. Daily, weekly and monthly housekeeping tasks are tracked with the PMS or a checklist; this clear ownership avoids the "everybody's job is nobody's job" trap.
İkinci Mühendis, mevcut kadroyu (Üçüncü/: The Second Engineer assigns the available personnel (Third/Fourth Engineer, fitter, oilers) to watches according to their competence and certification. It is essential that each watch has adequate competence (a competent watchkeeper), that the balance between experienced and inexperienced personnel is maintained and that language/communication barriers are overcome. The watch bill is drawn up so as not to breach the rest hour rules.
İkinci Mühendis, numune alma noktasının: The Second Engineer ensures that the sampling point is the ship's manifold (not the barge side); the barge representative witnesses the sealing and the seal numbers are entered on the BDN. In a dispute, this sample and the chain of seals are decisive.
İkinci Mühendis, periyodik performance r: The Second Engineer submits the periodic performance report to the Chief Engineer and to the company's technical department (superintendent). Most companies use shore-based performance monitoring platforms such as CASPER, Marorka or Eniram; the data from the ship is compared there with the fleet as a whole.
İkinci Mühendis, scupper plug'larının su: The Second Engineer makes sure that the scupper plugs do not cause ponding/deck loading if water accumulates; controlled draining is planned in case of rain. The manifold drip tray is checked regularly throughout the operation.
İkinci Mühendis, sızıntıları \"drip\", \: The Second Engineer classifies leaks as "drip", "weep" and "spray". A small leak dripping into a drip tray can be monitored, whereas a spray leak from a pressurized line requires immediate action, because atomized fuel can ignite instantly on a hot surface. The source of the leak (flange, fitting, pump gland, injector) is tagged and a work order is raised in the PMS.
İkinci Mühendis, yardımcı sistem bakımla: The Second Engineer plans auxiliary system maintenance according to the PMS schedule and the operating program; because some maintenance is done with the equipment stopped, it is timed to fit the port or sea passage window. Spare parts and tools are prepared in advance.
İkinci Mühendis; LOTO (enerji izolasyonu: The Second Engineer teaches the team the LOTO (energy isolation), Permit to Work, enclosed space entry and hot work procedures, and explains with examples why these high-risk jobs are subject to strict rules. A team that knows "why" it follows a procedure takes it seriously.
İkinci Mühendis; blackout recovery (kara: The Second Engineer takes part in blackout recovery (recovery from a blackout/loss of electrical power), engine room fire and flooding drills and trains the team. When these scenarios are drilled realistically, the team carries out the right actions in a real incident without having to think. Use of the quick-closing valves, emergency stops and the fixed extinguishing system is drilled.
İkinci Mühendis; nitrit (inhibitor seviy: The Second Engineer tests nitrite (inhibitor level), pH (acidity/alkalinity), chloride (indicator of a seawater leak) and total hardness. Low nitrite means insufficient corrosion protection; high chloride points to a seawater leak from the cooler. Each parameter is kept within its criteria range.
İkinci Mühendis; piston crown karbon bir: The Second Engineer inspects carbon deposits on the piston crown, ring condition (broken, sticking/collapsed, free movement), liner wear/scuffing and the underside of the cylinder cover. Ring sticking both lowers performance and increases the risk of scavenge fire through blow-by.
İkinci Mühendis; scrape-down ve scavenge: Based on the scrape-down and scavenge inspection findings, the Second Engineer increases or reduces the feed rate and, if necessary, applies run-in (increased lubrication after a new liner/new rings). All adjustments are recorded. Data-driven management optimizes both wear and cost.
İkinci Mühendisin ana makine performans: The Second Engineer's success in main engine performance management comes from disciplined measurement, trend reading and early intervention — work that remains invisible "while everything is going well" but protects the ship's voyage safety and commercial continuity when a failure comes. A well-kept performance log both prevents a mechanical disaster and maintains the ship's MARPOL Annex VI compliance and the charterer's confidence.
İkinci Mühendisin bakım yönetimindeki ba: The Second Engineer's success in maintenance management comes from the triangle of planned thinking, discipline on site and complete records. A well-run PMS reduces breakdowns, gets the ship through surveys without problems and, most importantly, protects the crew and the ship. Maintenance that is delayed or closed without evidence, on the other hand, always comes back as a more expensive breakdown and an inspection finding.
İkinci Zabit ayrıca kendi bilgisini günc: The Second Officer must also keep their own knowledge up to date; ECDIS software updates, COLREG interpretations and changes to company procedures must be reflected in the training content. On a bridge where the trainer has fallen behind, the trainee falls behind too.
İkinci Zabit periyodik iç kontrol (self-: The Second Officer carries out periodic internal checks (self-audit): for randomly selected charts, the log is compared with the last correction line on the chart, and the ENC update percentage and the edition years of the publications are checked. This catches gaps proactively before a PSC inspection or a company audit.
İkinci Zabit'in hava analizi, ancak köpr: The Second Officer's weather analysis is of value only when it is passed on clearly to the bridge team and the Master. The daily weather brief must include the current situation, the 24/48-hour forecast, the critical thresholds and the recommended measures. Any uncertainty is stated openly.
İkinci Zabit, MMSI'nin tüm DSC cihazları: The Second Officer verifies that the MMSI is programmed correctly in all DSC equipment (VHF, MF/HF) and, where the EPIRB is coded with the MMSI, in the EPIRB. A wrong or missing MMSI prevents the SAR authorities from matching the distress alert correctly.
İkinci Zabit, TRB'yi pasif bir imza deft: The Second Officer uses the TRB not as a passive signature book but as an active training plan: which tasks have been completed, which are outstanding, and how the voyage can be planned to close these gaps. For example, if the cadet's anchoring drill is outstanding, the procedure is taught to the cadet in a planned way before the next anchoring.
İkinci Zabit, akü değişim/servis tarihle: The Second Officer tracks the battery replacement/service dates and the date of the next annual capacity test in a planning table. An aging battery can put the GMDSS out of action at the worst possible moment (a real blackout).
İkinci Zabit, analizini (merkez konumu,: The Second Officer presents the analysis (position of the center, movement, semicircle, limit lines, alternative routes) clearly to the Master. The options may be altering course, adjusting speed, seeking shelter or waiting. The final decision rests with the Master; if a weather routing service is available, its recommendation is also considered.
İkinci Zabit, barometre eğilimini (mevsi: By assessing together the barometric tendency (corrected for season/geography), anomalies in the swell direction and the cloud patterns, the Second Officer can sense a TRS before an official warning arrives. This early detection gains extra hours for avoidance.
İkinci Zabit, deviation'ı düzenli olarak: The Second Officer checks the deviation regularly (usually at a suitable opportunity on every watch and on change of heading) and enters it in the deviation book. Variation is taken from the ENC/chart or from a magnetic model; deviation is found by observation.
İkinci Zabit, farklı kaynakların tutarlı: The Second Officer cross-checks the consistency of the different sources; if two independent forecasts show the same system in different positions, planning is based on the more cautious (worse) scenario. Relying blindly on a single source is dangerous.
İkinci Zabit, gemi saatini ZD esas alara: The Second Officer sets ship's time on the basis of the ZD. When going from UTC to zone time, the ZD is added in east longitude and subtracted in west longitude (Zone Time = UTC − ZD, with the signed ZD). This mechanical consistency ensures that the clock change plan is made in the right direction and by the right amount.
İkinci Zabit, harita ve yayın yönetimini: The Second Officer is the day-to-day operator of chart and publication management: applying corrections, keeping the records, managing the folios and reporting missing items to the Master. However, the ultimate responsibility for navigational safety rests with the Master; for this reason, critical corrections (e.g. a new danger) are passed on at a briefing.
İkinci Zabit, her saha için uygun derlem: For each area, the Second Officer uses the ENC/paper chart with a suitable compilation scale; for approaches and maneuvering, larger-scale cells (usage band 5-6) are preferred. Using a chart of the wrong scale leads to no-go areas and dangers being missed.
İkinci Zabit, ilk yardımda ABCDE (Airway: In first aid, the Second Officer assesses the patient systematically using the ABCDE (Airway-Breathing-Circulation-Disability-Exposure) approach, and measures and records the vital signs (pulse, respiration, blood pressure, temperature, level of consciousness). The guide (IMGS) leads from symptoms to diagnosis; however, in serious cases TMAS must always be consulted.
İkinci Zabit, log'u zamanında ve eksiksi: The Second Officer keeps the log on time and complete. The most frequent PSC finding is tests that have been carried out but not entered in the log; at an inspection, "done but not recorded" counts as "not done".
İkinci Zabit, passage plan'da kritik sah: The Second Officer checks the CATZOC value of the critical areas in the passage plan and adds an uncertainty allowance to the UKC calculation. For example, in a CATZOC C/D area a wider safety margin must be left for the same paper/ECDIS depth.
İkinci Zabit, plana işlenmiş fix interva: The Second Officer keeps to the fix intervals entered in the plan (e.g. 30-60 min in the open sea, 3-6 min in restricted waters, or continuous PI). Every fix is recorded in the logbook and in ECDIS.
İkinci Zabit, planı paylaşılan bir menta: By turning the plan into a shared mental model, the Second Officer ensures that the whole team sees the same picture. Even with a pilot on board, the plan is the team's reference for checking; the pilot's recommendations are assessed against the plan.
İkinci Zabit, portable VHF'lerin aylık o: The Second Officer carries out the monthly operational test of the portable VHFs, monitors the expiry date of the primary batteries and keeps the sets accessible near the boat station.
İkinci Zabit, reserve battery'nin haftal: The Second Officer follows the weekly voltage check (hydrometer/voltmeter), the monthly measurements and the annual capacity (discharge) test of the reserve battery. The battery cells are checked for corrosion, electrolyte level (if lead-acid) and ventilation.
İkinci Zabit, sefer boyunca düzenli köpr: The Second Officer plans regular bridge drills throughout the voyage. These include drills for a GPS loss (loss of position) scenario, steering gear failure and changeover to emergency steering, bridge management after a blackout, the man overboard (MOB) maneuver (Williamson/Anderson turn), navigation in restricted visibility, and changeover to the backup on failure of the primary ECDIS. Each drill must be realistic and planned in advance.
İkinci Zabit, sefer rotasının hangi bölg: The Second Officer must know which sea areas the voyage route passes through and verify the equipment and reserve power requirements accordingly. For example, a ship going into A4 (polar voyage) cannot rely on Inmarsat alone; HF DSC and MSI reception must be operational.
İkinci Zabit, sefere ait tüm hücrelerin: The Second Officer verifies that all cells for the voyage are licensed (permits) and loaded and that the update status is 100%. ECDIS reports the last update date of each cell and any missing updates; in a PSC inspection, this report is the digital equivalent of the paper log.
İkinci Zabit, seyir cihazlarının (ECDIS,: Because the Second Officer is responsible for the maintenance, updating and correction of the navigational equipment (ECDIS, radar/ARPA, GPS, AIS, gyro, echo sounder), the Second Officer has the deepest practical knowledge of this equipment. As the person who prepares the ENC updates, the ECDIS safety settings and the passage plan, the Second Officer is in the best position to provide the training.
İkinci Zabit, sounder'ın transducer kirl: The Second Officer watches that the sounder is not giving false readings because of transducer fouling, air bubbles (aeration) or false echoes (second reflection). A doubtful reading is confirmed immediately by another method.
İkinci Zabit, swell verisi ile gemi roll: At the Master's briefing, the Second Officer compares the swell data with the ship's roll period and presents which heading/speed combinations are dangerous. The general principle: to get out of the resonance zone, change either speed or heading.
İkinci Zabit, tatbikatları \"yapılmış gö: The Second Officer manages drills not as "a formality that must be seen to have been done" but as a real tool for measuring and developing team competence. Once realism is lost, the drill loses its value; if the team does not take the scenario seriously, no automatic reflex will develop for a moment of crisis.
İkinci Zabit, vardiyayı paylaşılan bir m: The Second Officer runs the watch on a shared mental model: the whole team knows the same traffic picture, the same plan and the same maneuvering intention. Fatigue, over-reliance on automation (automation complacency) and distraction are the greatest enemies of BRM; the officer manages them actively.
İkinci Zabit, yayın envanterini bir kayı: The Second Officer tracks the publication inventory in a register (publication record): the number, edition year, last correcting NtM and validity status of each publication are listed. For publications that have expired or for which a new edition has been issued, a supply request is raised.
İkinci Zabit, yeni zabit için yapılandır: For a new officer, the Second Officer uses a structured ECDIS familiarization checklist. This checklist verifies not merely that a function was "shown" but that the officer can carry it out on their own (demonstrated competence). The table below summarizes a typical familiarization scope.
İkinci Zabit; NAVTEX ice bulletin, ulusa: The Second Officer monitors the NAVTEX ice bulletin, the national ice services (BSH, AARI, Canadian Ice Service) and satellite ice charts. Sea ice concentration (egg code), ice type/thickness, areas of ice pressure and the direction of ice drift are assessed. Ice conditions are dynamic; the data are updated throughout the voyage.
İkinci Zabit; ilgili RSMC/uyarı merkezle: The Second Officer monitors the relevant RSMCs/warning centers (JMA, NHC, JTWC, etc.), NAVTEX/EGC messages and weather fax/GMDSS bulletins. Each warning gives the position of the center, the pressure, the maximum wind, the direction/speed of movement and the forecast cones. The position and the forecast are updated continuously.
İkinci aşama: Koalesans filtre ile ince: Second stage: fine droplets are combined in a coalescing filter and separated.
İkinci kategori \"insurance spare\"dır —: The second category is "insurance spares" — parts that rarely fail but have a long lead time and cause serious off-hire if they fail (e.g. main engine cylinder cover, crankshaft bearing shell). The third category is "running spares/consumables": frequently replaced items such as gaskets, O-rings, filters, V-belts and gland packing. The Chief Engineer manages these three categories with separate stock strategies.
İkinci toprak kaçağı farklı bir fazda ol: If a second earth fault occurs on a different phase, a phase-to-phase short circuit occurs and the protection operates.
İkincil kök neden, vardiya öncesi 'yükse: A secondary root cause was that no "high-risk manoeuvre briefing" was held before the watch, and no division of duties (alarm officer – telegraph officer) had been defined for the alarm and order workload.
İkincil olarak, yoğun operasyon anında i: Secondly, unnecessary traffic (non-essential talk) on the communication channel during intense operations made the critical orders harder to understand.
İkmal (provisioning) limanları arasında: Prices can differ greatly between provisioning ports; the cook gains a budget advantage by stocking up on durable provisions (dry, canned, frozen) at ports where cheap, good-quality products are available. However, the quality of fresh produce comes before price; if cheap, poor-quality produce ends up as waste, there is no saving. Quality control on receipt (see stock management) is an integral part of budget management.
İkmal limanına yaklaşırken Reis, tedarik: When approaching a supply port, the Bosun knows that the delivery window is limited; a requisition submitted late is carried over to the next port. Needs are therefore identified in advance and in a planned way, not reactively.
İkmal teslimatı geldiğinde aşçı, her kal: When a provisioning delivery arrives, the cook inspects every item for quantity, quality and temperature. The delivery temperature of chilled/frozen products is measured; any product showing signs of thawing, with damaged packaging, a short expiry date or a spoiled smell/appearance is rejected. Rejected items are marked on the delivery note and returned to the supplier.
İleri beslemede bozucu etki ölçülür ve e: In feedforward control the disturbance is measured and corrective action is applied before it takes effect. When used together with feedback (feedforward + feedback), it gives both fast disturbance rejection and removal of offset.
İletişim kalitesi aylık olarak near-miss: Communication quality should be measured monthly from near-miss records; targeted training should be given for recurring ambiguous order patterns.
İletişim kopukluğu da tehlikelidir; mani: A breakdown in communication is also dangerous; without clear and continuous communication between the manifold and the control room/terminal, an emergency stop is delayed. The Oiler keeps a communication device (UHF) with them and knows the signals by heart.
İletişim kopukluğu çoğu zaman rapora 'ya: A communication breakdown is often entered in a report as a "misunderstanding"; but the root cause is always systemic: the language standard, confirmation discipline and briefing quality.
İletişimde altın kural: sorulmayanı söyl: The golden rule of communication: do not volunteer what is not asked; answer what is asked honestly and clearly. Crew members should not guess on a subject they do not know but should say "let me check and give you the exact information". A lie or a contradictory statement is far more dangerous than a single finding, because it fundamentally shakes the inspector's trust in the ship and pulls the inspection into a defensive depth.
İlk akış düşük rate ile başlatılır; hatl: Initial flow is started at a low rate; it is verified that the lines lead to the correct tank, that there are no leaks and that the build-up of static electricity stays limited. The first 30 minutes or so at low rate are critical for static electricity.
İlk müdahale: kaynağı kes/izole et (valf: First response: cut off/isolate the source (close the valve), start the bilge/ballast pumps and, if necessary, use the emergency bilge suction (the main sea water pump drawing directly from the bilge). The aim is to bring the water level under control before it reaches electrical panels/machinery.
İlk müdahalede doğru söndürücü seçilir:: For the first response, the correct extinguisher is selected: for oil/fuel fires (class B), foam or dry chemical powder; for electrical fires (C/E), CO₂ or dry powder; water is not sprayed directly onto a liquid fuel fire (it spreads the flames). The Oiler knows the types of extinguisher, their range and how to use them (PASS: pull-aim-squeeze-sweep).
İmza atılırken \"for and on behalf of th: When signing, qualifications such as "for and on behalf of the Master" or "as agent only" can limit the Master's personal liability; but these wordings must be used carefully. If the Master signs documents prepared by the agent without reading them, this later leads to the presumption that "the Master approved", which is hard to reverse.
İnce paslanmaz çelik veya titanyum plaka: Thin stainless steel or titanium plates (0.5-1.0 mm) are joined leak-tight with NBR or EPDM gaskets. The hot and cold fluids pass through alternate channels.
İnert gaz sistemi (IGS), baca gazını işl: The inert gas system (IGS) produces low-oxygen gas by treating flue gas (or with an inert gas generator) and delivers it to the cargo tanks; the aim is to reduce the oxygen in the tank atmosphere to a level that will not support combustion. The IGS must be capable of delivering inert gas with an oxygen content not exceeding 5% by volume; SOLAS and ISGOTT require the oxygen in the cargo tank atmosphere not to exceed 8% by volume, and this limit also applies during COW.
İnert tanka izinsiz baş uzatma, gas-free: Putting one's head into an inerted tank without permission, not monitoring the atmosphere continuously in a tank considered gas-free, and entering without a standby are causes of enclosed space deaths on tankers. Even at the end of tank cleaning, the AB must treat the tank as an enclosed space and apply the entry rules in full.
İnsan faktörü açısından bakıldığında, za: From the human factors point of view, narrowing of attention under time pressure (tunnel vision) and confirmation bias (sticking to the first assumption) reduced the quality of the decisions.
İnsansız periyot süresince beklenen tüke: The expected consumption during the unmanned period is calculated, and it is verified that the fuel service tank, oil service/storage tanks, settling tank and fresh water tanks are at levels that will comfortably cover the period. Automatic transfer/filling systems must be active and in good order; even so, a manual reserve level is kept.
İnsansız periyotta nöbetçi (duty) mühend: A duty engineer is designated for the unmanned period; this person must be rested, reachable and able to get down to the engine room quickly when an alarm sounds. The communication channel between the bridge and the engine room, the dead-man alarm and the telephone/radio are tested.
İnsineratör (incinerator) ile atık yağ/s: When waste oil/sludge is burned in the incinerator, the Wiper provides feeding and cleaning support under the engineer's supervision. During delivery ashore (shore disposal), the Wiper helps with anti-pollution measures such as hose connections, drip trays and plugging the scuppers. The receipt (waste receipt) issued for each delivery is kept.
İnsineratör, brülörle ısıtılan yanma oda: The incinerator burns waste at high temperature (typically about 850–1200 °C) in a combustion chamber heated by a burner. Sludge oil is fed through a separate burner; solid waste (garbage) is loaded through the charging door. Sufficient temperature and air are essential for complete combustion and low emissions.
İntegral Zaman (Ti): Büyük Ti → yavaş of: Integral time (Ti): large Ti → slow removal of offset. Small Ti → fast removal of offset, possible overshoot and oscillation. Very small Ti → integral saturation (windup).
İnvertör, IGBT (Insulated Gate Bipolar T: The inverter uses IGBT (Insulated Gate Bipolar Transistor) switches to produce an AC output from the DC link voltage with the PWM (Pulse Width Modulation) technique. The effective value and frequency of the output voltage are controlled by changing the pulse widths.
İshal, kusma, sarılık veya enfekte yara: Personnel with diarrhea, vomiting, jaundice or an infected wound are barred from preparing food; they may spread pathogens. If the cook or mess man has gastrointestinal symptoms, this is reported to the Master and the person is kept away from food handling until recovered (usually 48 hours without symptoms). Wounds are covered with waterproof dressings.
İsrafın önlenmesi cimrilik değil, doğru: Preventing waste is not stinginess but the discipline of correct use. A painting job left half-done because of insufficient paint stock throws away all the surface preparation already done; this is the most expensive waste of all. The balance lies in planned consumption and timely resupply.
İstifleme yaparken kaçış yolları, kapıla: When stowing materials, escape routes, doors, safety equipment and maneuvering stations (mooring stations, fire stations) are kept clear. No material is ever placed in front of a lifebuoy, fire extinguisher, hose box or emergency exit. The AB knows that even material left "temporarily" can turn into a risk.
İtici akıntısının gövdeye veya başka bir: When a thruster's wash strikes the hull or another thruster, the net thrust is reduced. The barred angles and interaction corrections defined in the TCS are needed for the DP to estimate correctly the thrust it will actually obtain. If these definitions are wrong, the capability plot is also misleading.
İticiler prove edildikten sonra kontrol: Once the thrusters have been proved, control is handed over gradually. First, automatic heading control is engaged in joystick mode and the ship's response is observed; position control is added once the behaviour is stable.
İticinin ürettiği yanal kuvvet, gemi ile: The lateral force produced by the thruster falls quickly as the ship gains headway. The flow from the tunnel outlet interacts with the flow along the hull and cancels part of the force; thrusters are therefore typically effective only at very low speeds, and the manoeuvring plan is made with this limit in mind.
İtme kuvveti bedplate'e ve oradan gemi y: The thrust is transferred to the bedplate and from there to the ship's structure. On large two-stroke engines the thrust bearing is integrated into the engine bedplate.
İtme yatağı (Michell tipi): Tilting pad: Thrust bearing (Michell type): transfers the propeller thrust to the ship's structure with a tilting-pad bearing design. It runs on an oil film.
İyi bir Birinci Zabit, otorite ile erişi: A good Chief Officer balances authority with approachability. Regular department meetings, open feedback and fair allocation of work keep motivation high. In multinational teams, sensitivity to cultural differences and clear communication reduce misunderstandings and tension. A motivated team works both more safely and more efficiently.
İyi bir TRB kaydı şu sorulara yanıt veri: A good TRB entry answers these questions: What was done? On which equipment/system? Which procedure was followed? Which safety precautions were taken? What was learned? It must be concrete: not "I looked at the pump" but "I assisted, under the trainer's supervision, in replacing the mechanical seal of No. 2 transfer pump; LOTO was applied, the old seal was removed, a new gasket was cut".
İyi bir drill gerçekçi bir senaryoyla ba: A good drill starts with a realistic scenario: "fire in the engine room purifier room", "unconscious person in an enclosed space in No. 2 cargo hold", "MOB from the bridge wing". General, vague "there is a fire" scenarios teach nothing. The Safety Officer shares the scenario in advance with the Master and the Chief Officer and sets the intended learning outcome.
İyi bir gece talimatı tek yönlü emir değ: A good night order is not a one-way command; it is a two-way communication tool that also encourages the engineer officer of the watch to pass his or her observations and concerns to the Chief Engineer.
İyi bir komite, sadece zabitanın konuştu: A good committee is one where not only the officers speak, but even the most junior rating can give an opinion. The Chief Officer encourages people to speak up without fear, applies the principle that "there are no stupid questions", takes suggestions seriously and puts at least one of them into practice. An implemented suggestion is the factor that increases participation most.
İyi bir koordinasyon; sörveyin gecikmede: Good coordination ensures that the survey is completed without delay, without missing evidence and without additional cost.
İyi bir mühendisin kayıtları, kendisi va: A good engineer's records describe the machinery even when the engineer is not on watch. For the Third/Fourth Engineer, careful record-keeping is the foundation of both professional discipline and the ship's technical safety.
İyi bir operasyon: kapsamlı hazırlık (ch: A good operation means thorough preparation (checklist, scuppers, drip trays, SOPEP), starting at a low rate, a constant watch, care when topping off, honest records and immediate reporting of every deviation. "Do not rush, do not look away, do not conceal" are the three basic principles.
İyi bir passage plan, geminin karaya otu: A good passage plan is the first and strongest line of defense against grounding. The Second Officer's job is not only to prepare the plan but to make it a living document that is understood by the team, updated for weather and conditions, and cross-checked on every watch. Disciplined planning is the only practice that breaks, right at the start, the "human error" chain that keeps recurring in accident statistics.
İyi bir plan, hava durumunu, geminin dem: A good plan takes into account the weather, whether the ship is at anchor, at sea or in port, and the number of personnel. Painting cannot be done in the rain; overside work (outside the ship) is not planned in heavy weather; working aloft is postponed while there is vibration from the ship being under way. The Chief Officer leaves room for flexibility.
İyi bir self-audit, \"denetçi gözüyle\": A good self-audit is done "through the inspector's eyes"; that is, the Master must learn to look at his or her own ship as an outside inspector. Familiarity with the team (familiarity bias) makes real findings invisible; therefore having the self-audit done by a different officer, or a cross-audit (the chief officer audits the engine room, the 2nd engineer the deck), reduces blind spots.
İyi bir toolbox; somut, kısa ve işe özel: A good toolbox talk is concrete, short and specific to the job. Saying "be careful" is not enough; specific instructions are given, such as "when changing the grinder disc, cut off the air, check the flange, put on the face shield". For important jobs, a job-specific risk assessment (JSA) is completed and the participants sign it.
İyi bir yük planı sadece \"ne kadar yükl: A good cargo plan shows not only how much will be loaded but what is happening to the ship at every moment; checking the intermediate stages is therefore more critical than the final condition.
İyi boyanın sırrı yüzeyde gizlidir: pas,: The secret of a good paint job lies in the surface: paint applied before rust, old loose paint, oil and salt have been removed completely will soon flake off. Chipping is done with a hand hammer/scraper or a pneumatic needle gun; loose rust and blistered paint are removed from the surface. The surface is then roughened and cleaned with a wire brush or a disc grinder (grinding).
İyi gemi catering pratiği ve birçok bayr: Good ship catering practice and many flag/company procedures call for reference samples to be kept from the main meals served: a representative portion (typically around ~100 g) of each main dish is taken in a clean, labeled container and kept in the chiller for reference, typically for 48 hours. If a foodborne illness (food poisoning) is suspected, this sample can be sent to a laboratory to identify the source.
İyi housekeeping aynı zamanda kayma, tak: Good housekeeping also prevents slip, trip and fall (slip-trip-fall) accidents. An oil film building up on the floor plates, scattered tools or loose hoses can cause serious injuries, especially when the ship is moving. The Second Engineer proactively identifies and eliminates these risks during the daily round.
İyi iletişim kültürü yalnızca kaza önlem: A good communication culture not only prevents accidents; it also increases operational efficiency, because the team sees the same situation at the same time and fewer corrective manoeuvres are needed.
İyi koordinasyon; tamiratın doğru limand: Good coordination ensures that repairs are carried out in the right port, with the right team and without delaying the ship. Poor coordination leads to off-hire and runaway costs.
İyi mentorluk; hata yapıldığında suçlama: Good mentoring means not blaming when a mistake is made, but turning the mistake into a learning moment. By asking "why did you do it this way, what would the result have been, what would have been the right way?", the Second Officer develops the cadet's judgment. The aim is not rote learning of procedures but seamanship judgment.
İyi performans gösteren personelin terfi: Recommending well-performing personnel to the company for promotion/re-employment creates motivation and a sense of belonging in the team. Poor performance, on the other hand, is supported with coaching and additional training; if there is no improvement, it is reported on record.
İyi stripping düşük ROB demektir; bu hem: Good stripping means a low ROB, which is both a commercial and an environmental gain.
İyi uygulamalar; talimatı o geceye özgü: Good practices are writing the orders specifically for that night, giving concrete thresholds, stating the call-out criteria clearly, providing extra guidance to junior officers and reinforcing the "if in doubt, call" culture.
İyi yapılandırılmış bir gece talimatı; g: A well-structured night order covers the ship's status (at sea/maneuvering/in port), the specific equipment to be monitored that night, the expected risks, planned tasks and the "call the Chief" criteria. It must be clear, brief and action-oriented.
İyi yönetilen bir PMS, arızaları kaza ha: A well-managed PMS catches failures before they become accidents; a poorly managed PMS produces inspection findings, delays and safety risks. The Chief Officer's task is to combine planning with the reality on site and with record-keeping discipline.
İyi yönetilen bir vardiya düzeni, makine: A well-managed watch system is the engine room's "invisible safeguard": a competent person is on duty at all times, handovers are complete, personnel are rested and the records reflect reality. The Second Engineer's leadership here protects legal compliance, safety and team morale at the same time. A disciplined routine is where an accident is prevented before it happens.
İyonizasyon dedektörleri, küçük bir rady: Ionization detectors use a small radioactive source (Am-241) and detect the disturbance caused by smoke particles to the current in the ionized air; they are sensitive to fast, flaming fires but are less common today because of the radioactive source. Photoelectric (optical) detectors use a photocell to detect the scattering of an LED light beam by smoke particles; they are more sensitive to slow-developing, smoky fires and are common on ships.
İyonizasyon ve fotoelektrik duman dedekt: Ionisation and photoelectric smoke detectors are used in cabins, corridors and control rooms.
İzin akışı; talep eden (issuing officer': The permit flow separates the roles of the requester (who applies to the issuing officer), the issuer (generally the Chief Officer or the relevant head of department), the approver (the Master, for critical jobs) and the performer (performing personnel). A signature is not a transfer of responsibility; it is a record that the conditions have been verified.
İzin imzalanmasıyla iş bitmez; Birinci Z: The job does not end when the permit is signed; the Chief Officer or the designated officer inspects the site periodically. It is confirmed that the gas monitor is working, the standby person is in position and conditions have not changed. The job is stopped if the weather deteriorates, an alarm sounds or anything unexpected happens.
İzin süresi vardiya veya iş penceresiyle: A permit's validity is limited to a watch or to the work window (generally 8–12 hours or a single watch). If conditions change (weather deterioration, equipment failure, change in the atmosphere), the permit is suspended or canceled. When the job is finished, "permit closure" verifies that the site has been cleaned up, isolations removed and systems returned to normal.
İzlenebilirlik için ikmal kayıtları (ted: For traceability, provisioning records (supplier, batch, expiry date) are kept. In the event of an outbreak, the product it came from can be traced back. The cook labels opened products with the date of opening.
İzolasyon yapıldıktan sonra \"sıfır ener: After isolation, "zero energy" is verified: the start button is pressed to test that the equipment really does not start (try-out), the pressure gauge reads zero and rotating parts have stopped. If this step is skipped, someone may put their hands on equipment that appears to be isolated but is in fact energized.
İzolasyon, gerilimsizlik teyidi (HV volt: Isolation, proving the absence of voltage (with an HV voltage detector, using prove-test-prove), applying earthing and physical lock-out form the mandatory sequence. The ETO uses HV insulated PPE (Class 2/3 insulating gloves, arc flash suit, insulating mat) and verifies that the gloves have passed their periodic dielectric (electrical) test.
İzole edilen ve voltajsızlığı doğrulanan: An HV circuit that has been isolated and verified dead is earthed (earthing/grounding) before work starts. This makes capacitive residual charge and accidental energization safe. Earthing is done with the switchgear's earth switch or with a portable earthing set.
İzole nötr sistemde tek toprak kaçağında: In an isolated neutral system the current circuit is not completed by a single earth fault (apart from capacitive current). The system keeps working, but an alarm is given.
İzole çalışan bir jeneratörde governör i: On a generator running alone, the governor works in isochronous mode and keeps the frequency constant. In parallel operation it changes to droop mode.
İzotermik süreçte T = sabit olduğundan i: In an isothermal process T = constant, so for an ideal gas the change in internal energy is zero (ΔU = 0). By the first law Q = W; all the heat supplied to the system is transferred to the surroundings as work.
İzotermik süreçte sıcaklık sabit olduğun: In an isothermal process the temperature is constant, so the change in internal energy of an ideal gas is zero. By the first law, all the heat supplied to the system is transferred to the surroundings as work: Q = W.
İç döngü bozucu etkilere hızlı tepki ver: The inner loop responds quickly to disturbances.
İç koridorlarda ve kamaralarda da loose: Loose items (furniture, sliding equipment) in internal alleyways and cabins are also secured; the crew are told to expect violent motion and to hold on. Precautions are taken in the mess room/galley against slipping and burns.
İç mekanlarda gevşek eşyaların sabitlenm: Measures such as securing loose items inside the ship, instructions to the crew on moving about safely and restrictions on going out on deck (green water risk) are applied on the Master's instructions. Preparations cannot be made after the storm has started; timing is critical.
İç tatlı su devresine korozyon inhibitör: A corrosion inhibitor (typically nitrite-based) is dosed into the internal fresh water circuit and tested periodically; if the level falls, corrosion starts on the internal surfaces. On the seawater side, contact between different metals (steel, bronze, titanium) produces galvanic corrosion; sacrificial anodes and a suitable choice of materials are therefore used.
İç transfer; storage tanktan settling ta: Internal transfer is the transfer of fuel from a storage tank to a settling tank, from a settling tank to a service tank, or between tanks. On the engineer's instructions, the Oiler opens/closes the correct valves (line-up), starts the transfer pump and watches the levels of both the tank being emptied and the tank being filled. A wrong valve line-up can cause a transfer to the wrong tank or an overflow.
İçerideki kişi yanıt vermez, düşer veya: If the person inside does not respond, collapses or is taken ill, the standby AB's first action is NOT to jump in but to raise the alarm: call the rescue team by general alarm/PA and inform the bridge/officer. Seconds matter, but entering alone and unprepared loses two people instead of saving one. The alarm sets the rescue chain in motion.
İçerideki transfer dahi yanlış valfle ta: Even an internal transfer can overflow a tank through a wrong valve; the line-up check is never skipped.
İçine metal/somun konulmuş atış halatı u: Heaving line ends with metal/nuts placed inside have struck personnel on the quay on the head, causing fatal injuries. Company procedures require that only rope/sand is placed inside and that the weight is limited. The Bosun inspects the heaving lines periodically.
İçki sorunu olan bir personelin tespiti: A seafarer with a drinking problem is usually identified not suddenly but through gradual signs (lateness, falling performance, social withdrawal). The Master's ability to observe allows the problem to be caught early, before a for-cause test. Early intervention is the most effective defence for the safety of both the person and the ship.
İçme suyu (potable water), MLC ve gemi s: Drinking water (potable water) is as critical as food under the MLC and ship sanitation requirements. Water jugs and drinks stations are kept clean, and water taps/dispenser nozzles are disinfected. Water quality (chlorination, quality tests) is usually the responsibility of the deck/engine departments, but cleanliness at the point of service belongs to the steward.
İçme suyu için periyodik bakteriyolojik: Drinking water is tested periodically for bacteria.
İçme suyu kalitesi (potability) sağlık a: Drinking water quality (potability) is critical for health; tank chlorination, periodic water tests and cleaning of the hydrophore system are followed. Galley hygiene is managed on HACCP principles: preventing cross-contamination, temperature control (refrigerator below 4 °C, freezer below −18 °C), date control and personal hygiene. A food-borne outbreak (gastroenteritis) can paralyse operations on a ship.
İçme suyu klorlama veya UV ile dezenfekt: Drinking water is disinfected by chlorination or UV; demineralised water from the FWG is mineralised if necessary. Tanks are cleaned and disinfected periodically and water samples are tested. Low chlorine or stagnant water invites bacterial growth.
İçme suyu ve gıda kalite kontrolü, aşçın: Drinking water and food quality control is the essence of the cook's role as guardian of public health. Monitoring residual chlorine and bacteriological safety, recording the cold chain daily, keeping food samples for reference and linking all this into a chain of records that can be inspected is the only reliable way to prevent a food- or waterborne outbreak and to manage it quickly if one occurs. Accurately kept records are the quiet foundation of both crew health and the ship's legal protection.
İçme suyu, ayrı (sadece içme suyuna ayrı: Drinking water is supplied from a separate fresh water tank reserved for drinking water only; the tank and pipes must have food-safe coatings and materials and must not be mixed with technical water. Non-return valves and the ban on cross-connections prevent contamination.
İş akışı genelde şöyledir: haftalık NtM: The workflow is usually as follows: the weekly NtM is downloaded as a PDF/online, the ship's chart maintenance record (NP133A or electronic equivalent) is opened, the relevant chart numbers are matched, the corrections are entered on the charts, the last correction number is written in the bottom left-hand corner of the chart and the log is signed.
İş başlamadan önce işi yapacak ekip, fir: Before the job starts, the team doing the work, the fire watch and the supervising engineer hold a short toolbox talk: the sequence of work, who does what, who does what in an emergency, where the nearest extinguisher/hose is and what the escape route is. This short talk is the most practical step for preventing most accidents.
İş bitince iş emri kapatılır (close-out): When the job is finished, the work order is closed (close-out): the work done, hours spent, parts used, measurements (clearance, pressure) and observations are recorded. This close-out record builds up the equipment's maintenance history and is used in planning the next maintenance, as well as evidence in class surveys.
İş bittiğinde alan temizlenir, alet/malz: When the job is finished, the area is cleaned, tools and materials are collected, isolations are removed, systems are returned to normal and, if required, the fire watch is completed. The permit is signed as "closed" and filed; a permit left open creates a major finding at inspection.
İş güvenliği, bir prosedür dosyası değil: Occupational safety is not a file of procedures but a working culture. The safety of the Oiler/Fitter depends on recognizing hazards, complying with the permit system, isolating energy, using the correct PPE and the "stop and ask" discipline. The safest job in the engine room is one that is never rushed, is covered by a permit, is isolated and has someone keeping watch. Getting home safe and sound is the one priority ahead of every task.
İş sonrası alan temizlenir, sökülen cont: After the job, the area is cleaned, removed gaskets/waste oil are put into the correct waste stream (MARPOL/garbage management), the spare parts used are deducted in the PMS and the job is closed.
İş sonrası yapılan değerlendirmedir. Ne: A review held after a job. What went well? What went badly? What did we learn? What should change in future? A debrief is for learning, not for blaming. All team members are encouraged to take part.
İş sırasında yeni alarm veya konfigürasy: Any new alarm or configuration change during the work is reported to DP control at once. When the work is finished, a function test is carried out, all bypasses and isolations are removed and the consequence analysis is verified.
İş tamamlandığında kullanılan tüm alet,: When the job is finished, all tools, parts and consumables used are checked; a tool left behind in the work area (foreign object) can be caught by rotating equipment and cause damage or an accident. Cleaning and tidying up are an integral part of the job.
İş tamamlandığında sorumlu mühendis; bul: When the job is completed, the responsible engineer enters the findings (e.g. liner wear measurement, ring end gap, clearance values), the spares used, the time spent and any anomalies in the work order. The Chief Engineer reviews this record and approves closure (sign-off). Before approval, the measured values are checked against the tolerances in the manual; if a value is out of tolerance, a follow-up job is opened.
İş tamamlanınca ekipman soğutulur, alan: When the job is complete, the equipment is cooled, the area is checked, the fire watch period is completed and the permit is "closed". The Third/Fourth Engineer verifies that the area is clean, that the fire-fighting equipment has been put back in place, and that the LOTO isolation was removed only once the job was completely finished.
İş öncesi Risk Assessment (RA) formu dol: Before the work, a Risk Assessment (RA) form is completed; for work that requires a permit to work (PTW) (hot work, enclosed space, electrical work), the relevant permit is submitted to the duty engineer/Chief Engineer for approval. The job is not considered complete until the permit has been closed.
İş öncesi yapılan kısa toplantıdır. İçer: A short meeting held before a job. Content: the work to be done, the hazards, responsibilities, emergency procedure and the communication arrangements. The STICC model: Situation, Task, Intent, Concerns, Calibrate (questions).
İş, sorumlu mühendise atanır (örneğin ge: The job is assigned to the responsible engineer (e.g. generator overhaul to the Second Engineer, separator maintenance to the Third Engineer). For critical jobs or jobs requiring enclosed space entry, a separate permit to work is issued and a risk assessment is carried out. The work is scheduled so as not to affect main engine load and navigational safety.
İşe başlamadan toolbox talk / risk asses: Before starting work, a toolbox talk / risk assessment is held: which lines will go out in which order, the snap-back zones, wind/current conditions and the allocation of duties are discussed. The AB knows their own role and the "stop" signal clearly; if anything is unclear, they ask.
İşe başlamadan önce risk değerlendirmesi: Before starting work, the risk assessment is reviewed: falls, crushing, trapping, slipping, parting of equipment under tension and atmosphere risks are assessed. If anyone is to go down into a hold, atmosphere testing and the enclosed space procedure also apply; the AB does not enter a hold or tank without permission.
İşitme koruması (kulak tıkacı veya manşo: Hearing protection (earplugs or earmuffs) is mandatory in the engine room when noise is above 85 dB(A), and it is worn continuously in the main engine area. As the exposure time increases or the level rises, a higher attenuation rating (SNR) is required. Hearing loss is insidious; by the time it is noticed, it is permanent.
İşler maker aralığına göre planlanır; iş: Jobs are planned according to the maker's intervals; job records (hours, parts, measurements) are kept complete. A monthly overdue report is produced and critical overdue jobs have priority.
İşler; emniyet kritikliği, klas/PSC takv: Jobs are ranked according to safety criticality, the class/PSC schedule, the weather window and operational dependency. Safety equipment (liferaft servicing, fire main, LSA) and inspection preparation jobs always have priority. These are followed by voyage-critical jobs (lashing, hatch cover tightness), and then by cosmetic maintenance (painting, cleaning).
Şaft devri değiştiğinde üretilen frekans: When the shaft speed changes, the frequency generated changes too. Constant frequency is achieved in two ways: keeping the shaft speed constant with a controllable pitch propeller (CPP), or using a frequency converter to produce a constant output frequency at variable speed.
Şaft draw (çekme) gerektiren survey'lerd: In surveys requiring a shaft draw (withdrawal), wear-down measurement, seal renewal and NDT (non-destructive testing) are carried out. The Chief Engineer integrates this plan into the drydock master plan.
Şaft hattı, gövde deformasyonu ve sıcakl: The shaft line is aligned so that the bearings are loaded evenly despite hull deflection and temperature (bearing reactions / sag and gap). Wrong alignment leads to bearing overload, heating and vibration. The alignment is measured at the shipyard and verified under service conditions when necessary.
Şaft hattı, intermediate bearings + ster: The shaft line consists of the intermediate bearings + stern tube bearing + propeller shaft + propeller. Incorrect alignment leads to hot bearings, vibration and, in the long term, shaft cracking. Gap & sag measurements and bearing weight measurement are mandatory at class survey.
Şaft hattı, makineden pervaneye doğru sı: From the engine to the propeller, the shaft line consists of the thrust shaft, the intermediate shaft(s) and the propeller (tail) shaft. They are joined by flanged couplings. The tail shaft passes through the stern tube and carries the propeller.
Şaft hattı; thrust bearing, intermediate: The shaft line consists of the thrust bearing, intermediate shaft(s), intermediate bearings, stern tube (forward + aft bearing), propeller shaft (tail shaft) and the propeller. The stern tube is the critical section that carries the shaft through the hull and acts as both bearing and seal.
Şaft hattında torsional, axial ve latera: Torsional, axial and lateral vibrations are monitored on the shaft line. Bearing/shaft vibration measurements to ISO 20816 give early warning of developing misalignment, bearing wear or propeller damage. At sea, the barred speed range (critical rpm range) is passed through as quickly as possible.
Şaft hattının burulma (torsional) ve eği: The torsional and bending (whirling) natural frequencies of the shaft line must not create resonance within the engine speed range. Certain speed ranges may be barred (barred speed range); the engine is not run continuously in this range.
Şaft hizalaması lazer alignment veya sag: Shaft alignment is done by laser alignment or the sag-and-gap method. Misalignment can cause bearing wear, vibration and shaft fracture.
Şaft jeneratörü (PTO) ve emergency gener: The shaft generator (PTO) and the emergency generator are also sources of electrical power. The cadet learns how the electrical supply is managed in normal, maneuvering and emergency conditions, and why enough generators are kept in parallel to prevent the risk of a blackout.
Şaft ve stern tube sistemi yönetimi, gör: Shaft and stern tube system management is an unseen but vital responsibility of the Chief Engineer. A seal failure caught early through discipline in header tank level, oil analysis and weardown prevents an expensive drydock repair, bearing damage and MARPOL pollution all at once. The modern Chief Engineer uses data to "see" a system that cannot be opened up, and intervenes before trends grow.
Şaft, esas olarak burulma (tork) yükünü: A shaft mainly carries torsional (torque) load; the torque increases with the ratio of power to speed. Rule formulae give the diameter as a function of the power (P), speed (n), material strength (Rm) and the shaft type/design factor. The tail shaft has a larger diameter than the intermediate shaft because of additional bending and corrosion.
Şarj havası soğutma ısısı → ön ısıtma (y: Charge air cooling heat → preheating (fuel, boiler feed water).
Şartlandırılmamış soğutma suyu, motor iç: Untreated cooling water causes corrosion, cavitation damage and mineral deposits (scale) on the internal surfaces of the engine (liner, cylinder cover, cooling passages). A corrosion inhibitor (DCA — nitrite-based, etc.) prevents this damage. The Second Engineer protects the internal integrity of the engine by keeping the water within the correct range.
Şebeke aşırı yüklenince blackout'u önlem: When the switchboard is overloaded, preferential tripping disconnects non-essential loads (HVAC, heaters and so on) in a predefined order to prevent a blackout. Generator protection includes reverse power, overcurrent, under/over-voltage and frequency relays.
Şiddetli yalpada açık sıcak yağ ciddi ya: In heavy rolling, open hot oil is a serious burn hazard; when the bridge issues a heavy weather warning, use of the fryer is restricted or stopped. The fryer lid is closed, the heat is switched off and the equipment is secured. This is a decision for both equipment safety and personnel safety.
Şirket DOC (Document of Compliance), gem: The company holds a DOC (Document of Compliance) and the ship holds an SMC (Safety Management Certificate). These certificates are verified by periodic and intermediate audits. The Safety Officer ensures that records and practices on board are ready for audit at any time; missing records create a non-conformity.
Şirket SMS'i periyodik internal audit ya: Under the company SMS, periodic internal audits are carried out. Findings are classified as non-conformity (NC), observation or improvement. The Safety Officer prepares a response to the finding based on root cause analysis, defines the corrective action and closes it with evidence. A superficial response ("crew warned") does not close a finding.
Şirket UKC policy minimum bir değer şart: The company UKC policy specifies a minimum value; the planned UKC must never fall below this value. If it is insufficient, the speed is reduced (squat decreases), the tide window is moved or the route is changed.
Şirket genelde bir self-assessment check: The company usually provides a self-assessment checklist (PSC pre-arrival, vetting pre-vet); the Chief Officer applies it before arrival in port and closes out the gaps. This proactive approach eliminates surprises during the inspection.
Şirket merkezi (ofis) ile gemi arasında: Data synchronization (replication) between the company head office and the ship is carried out regularly; this lets the Superintendent see the ship's stock remotely and makes it possible to obtain the advantage of fleet-wide bulk purchasing (frame agreements).
Şirket veya kaptan talimatıyla belirlenm: If the minimum CPA set by company or Master's instructions (e.g. 2 miles in the open sea, less in restricted waters) looks like being infringed, the officer takes early action. The CPA margin is assessed not just as a number but together with the ship's maneuverability and the traffic density.
Şirket, kişi başı günlük gıda bütçesini: The company sets the daily food budget per person (victualling rate, USD/person/day). The cook keeps orders and consumption within this budget and plans a balanced but cost-effective menu. Cutting the budget with cheap filler food lowers quality and morale; extravagance, on the other hand, exceeds the budget. Striking the balance is the skill of an experienced cook.
